en:
Stockholm guards the narrow sound where Lake Mälaren meets the Baltic, its old town on the islet where a fishing settlement grew into a fortress. Birger Jarl founded the city in 1252, so the tradition runs, to bar the sea road after raiders burned Sigtuna in 1187. Hanseatic merchants made it their Swedish base, and through its quays moved iron and copper from the Bergslagen mines and grain from the Mälaren plain. During the rising against the Kalmar Union the town backed the rebels, and on 1 May 1436 the Swedish council gave it a charter of privileges, taken as the birth of Stockholm as the de facto capital of Sweden. A day's ride north, Uppsala, seat of the Swedish archbishop from 1164, held the largest church in Scandinavia, its cathedral consecrated only in 1435. In 1444 Stockholm, some 6,000 strong, owes allegiance to Christopher of Bavaria, the union king, while the council and its marshal Karl Knutsson Bonde keep the kingdom restive under Danish rule.

In 1448 the council elected Karl Knutsson king of Sweden, the first of several breaks with the union. Christian II of Denmark took the city in 1520 and on 8 November had scores of bishops, nobles and burghers beheaded in the Great Square, the Stockholm Bloodbath. Gustav Vasa entered Stockholm in June 1523, and the Västerås assembly of 1527 carried Sweden into the Reformation. Learning made its home at Uppsala, where the university had opened in 1477: in 1567 Erik XIV, in the grip of a breakdown, murdered five imprisoned nobles in Uppsala Castle, three of them Stures; the synod of 1593 fixed the Lutheran confession of the Swedish Church; and Carl Linnaeus, who formalised the system of naming plants and animals, taught botany there from the 1730s. The city's shipyards launched the warship Vasa in 1628, only for her to sink on her maiden voyage, and in 1634 Stockholm became the capital of the Swedish empire and the funnel for its foreign trade. The Tre Kronor castle burned in 1697 and the new royal palace rose on its site, finished in 1754. Plague carried off some 20,000 Stockholmers in 1710, and after the Great Northern War the city shrank with the empire it served. Gustav III founded the Royal Opera and the Academy of Arts, and was shot at a masked ball in 1792. The loss of Finland in 1809 brought Sweden a new Instrument of Government, and the Peace of Kiel in 1814 joined Norway to the Swedish crown.
zh:
斯德哥尔摩扼守梅拉伦湖注入波罗的海的狭窄水道，老城所在的小岛最初是渔村，后来筑起堡垒。相传比尔耶·雅尔于1252年建城，为的是在1187年入侵者劫掠西格蒂纳之后封锁这条海上通道。汉萨商人以此为在瑞典的据点，贝里斯拉根矿场的铁铜和梅拉伦平原的谷物都从这里的码头进出。在反抗卡尔马联盟的起义中，城市站在反叛者一边，1436年5月1日，瑞典枢密院颁给它特权状，这份文书被视为斯德哥尔摩成为瑞典实际首都的起点。向北一日马程的乌普萨拉自1164年起就是瑞典大主教的驻节之地，斯堪的纳维亚最大的乌普萨拉大教堂迟至1435年才举行祝圣。1444年的斯德哥尔摩约有六千居民，臣服于联盟国王巴伐利亚的克里斯托弗，而以元帅卡尔·克努特松·邦德为首的瑞典枢密院让丹麦人的统治并不安稳。

1448年，枢密院推举卡尔·克努特松为瑞典国王，开启了联盟的数次破裂。1520年丹麦国王克里斯蒂安二世入城，11月8日在大广场将数十名主教、贵族和市民斩首，是为斯德哥尔摩惨案；古斯塔夫·瓦萨1523年6月入城，1527年韦斯特罗斯会议推动瑞典改宗路德宗。学问在乌普萨拉有自己的位置：大学1477年创办；1567年，精神失常的埃里克十四世在乌普萨拉城堡亲手杀死五名在押贵族，其中三人出自斯图雷家族；1593年的宗教会议确立了瑞典教会的路德宗信仰；1730年代起，为动植物命名体系奠定格局的卡尔·林奈在此讲授植物学。1628年，船坞建成的战舰「瓦萨号」首航即沉；1634年，斯德哥尔摩成为瑞典帝国的首都，也是全国外贸的总汇。1697年三冠宫失火，新王宫在原址建起，1754年完工。1710年的瘟疫夺去约两万市民的生命，大北方战争结束后，城市随它效力的帝国一同收缩。古斯塔夫三世创办皇家歌剧院和美术学院，1792年在一场化装舞会上遇刺。1809年丧失芬兰后，瑞典颁行新的政府约法，1814年《基尔和约》使挪威与瑞典共戴一君。

en:
Östergötland covers the fertile plain between Lake Vättern and Bråviken, the Baltic inlet where the Motala ström reaches the sea. It was a heartland of medieval Sweden: the Sverker and Bjälbo dynasties held estates here, and its law code, the Östgötalagen, was written down in the early 1300s. Linköping grew around the Lionga thing market and a bishopric founded in the 1000s, with a cathedral begun in the 1230s. At the Motala falls stood Norrköping, mills and a Baltic harbour, its first surviving town charter dated 1384. In 1444 the province was a Swedish Catholic land within the Kalmar Union, living chiefly by its grain and salmon.

By the Vättern shore at Vadstena, Bridget of Sweden founded the motherhouse of the Bridgettine order in 1346, on a royal manor given by Magnus Eriksson and Queen Blanche. The double monastery held sixty nuns and twenty-five monks, grew into Sweden's greatest landowner and drew pilgrims after Bridget's canonisation in 1391; her remains were translated to the shrine in 1394. Kings treated it as a dynastic church, for Margaret invested Eric of Pomerania there with the three Nordic crowns in 1400, and Queen Philippa was buried in the abbey church in 1430, the year of its consecration. The last Bridgettine nun died there in 1605. Gustav I began a fortress beside it in 1545, which the Vasa kings rebuilt into Vadstena Castle, completed in 1620.

Danish troops burned much of Norrköping in 1567 during the Northern Seven Years' War, and John III laid out the rebuilt streets. At Stångebro bridge outside Linköping, Sigismund III Vasa lost the battle of 25 September 1598 against his uncle Duke Charles, and five of the king's councillors were beheaded in the Linköping Bloodbath of 20 March 1600. Gustavus Adolphus set up a weapons industry at Norrköping in 1618, and the Walloon entrepreneur Louis De Geer added paper mills, textile works and a shipyard; at his death in 1652 it was Sweden's second city. Fire destroyed much of it in 1655, and Russian raiders burned it to the ground in 1719 during the Great Northern War. Gustav IV Adolf was crowned in Saint Olaf's Church there in 1800.
zh:
东约特兰位于韦特恩湖与波罗的海布拉维肯湾之间的肥沃平原，穆塔拉河在北雪平注入海湾。这里是中世纪瑞典的核心地区之一，斯渥克尔王朝和比耶博王朝都在本地拥有庄园，地区法典《东约特兰法》于14世纪初成文。林雪平围绕柳恩加庭市集和11世纪设立的主教座发展，主教座堂自1230年代动工。穆塔拉瀑布旁的北雪平以水力磨坊和波罗的海港口立足，现存最早的城市特许状写于1384年。1444年，这里是卡尔马联盟内一片信奉天主教的瑞典土地，主要靠谷物和鲑鱼为生。

在韦特恩湖畔的瓦斯泰纳，瑞典的圣布里吉特于1346年创立布里吉特修会的母院，地皮是马格努斯·埃里克松和那慕尔的布兰卡王后捐出的王家庄园。这座男女双修道院有六十名修女和二十五名修士，后来成为瑞典最大的地主；1391年布里吉特封圣，遗骨于1394年迁入圣龛，朝圣者随之从斯堪的纳维亚各地赶来。王室把它当作王朝教堂：1400年，玛格丽特女王在此册封波美拉尼亚的埃里克为丹麦、挪威、瑞典三国国王，1430年，埃里克的王后菲莉琶葬入修道院教堂，教堂也在这一年祝圣。最后一名布里吉特修女1605年在院中去世。古斯塔夫一世1545年在修道院旁动工修建要塞，瓦萨诸王后来把它改建成瓦斯泰纳城堡，1620年完工。

北方七年战争期间，丹麦军队1567年焚毁北雪平大片城区，约翰三世随后规划了重建的街道。1598年9月25日，齐格蒙特三世·瓦萨在林雪平郊外的斯坦格布罗桥战败于叔父卡尔公爵；1600年3月20日，他的五名谋臣在「林雪平血案」中被斩首。1618年，古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫在北雪平兴办兵器工业，瓦隆裔实业家路易·德·伊尔又增设造纸厂、纺织作坊和船厂；到1652年他去世时，北雪平已是瑞典第二大城市。1655年大火烧毁大片城区，1719年大北方战争期间，俄罗斯袭掠者又把全城焚为平地。1800年，古斯塔夫四世·阿道夫在城中的圣奥洛夫教堂加冕。

en:
Kalmar lies on the Småland coast, facing Öland across the Kalmarsund, its medieval town lying beneath a royal castle on a harbour island. A round watchtower stood there from about 1180, and Magnus Ladulås ringed it with curtain walls and corner towers in the 1280s. The harbour drew German merchants early: Kalmar's city seal of 1255 to 1267 is the oldest known in Scandinavia. The castle was called Rikets nyckel, the key of the realm, because whoever held it commanded the sound and the sea road north towards Stockholm. In the summer of 1397 Margaret of Denmark had Eric of Pomerania crowned there as king of all three realms, and the union charter was issued in the castle that July. In 1444 Kalmar was the strongest town in south-eastern Sweden, a Catholic Hanseatic port inside the Kalmar Union, watching the Danish-held border at Blekinge while its merchants shipped Småland timber, pitch and naval stores.

The union wars kept Kalmar's garrisons occupied. In 1505 King Hans had the mayor and town council put to death, the first Kalmar Bloodbath. When her husband died during Gustav Vasa's rising, Anna Eriksdotter Bielke took over his fiefs and held the castle against the Danes. Swedish forces took the town in 1523 and its German garrison yielded the castle eight days later, leaving the union king only in name. Gustav Vasa and his sons Eric XIV and John III rebuilt the fortress as a lead-roofed Renaissance palace for John III. A garrison for King Sigismund withstood a siege by Duke Charles from March to May 1599, and after the surrender the duke had its three commanders and nineteen men executed, the second bloodbath. Christian IV's Danes besieged and took the castle in 1611, opening the Kalmar War, but it returned to Sweden with the 1613 Peace of Knäred. Fire gutted the castle in 1642, and from the 1640s the town was moved to the planned island of Kvarnholmen, where Nicodemus Tessin the Elder's cathedral rose between 1660 and 1703. After Roskilde pushed the Danish frontier south in 1658 and Karlskrona became the main naval base in 1689, Kalmar lost its border trade and the old castle was left to decay.
zh:
卡尔马位于斯莫兰海岸，隔卡尔马海峡与厄兰岛相望，中世纪老城依傍海港小岛上的王室城堡发展起来。约1180年岛上已有圆形瞭望塔，1280年代马格努斯·拉杜洛斯又围以幕墙和角塔。港口很早就吸引德意志商人：卡尔马1255年至1267年间的城市印章是斯堪的纳维亚现存最古的一枚。城堡被称作「王国之钥」（Rikets nyckel），谁占据它，谁就控制海峡和通往斯德哥尔摩的北方海路。1397年夏，丹麦的玛格丽特在这座城堡为波美拉尼亚的埃里克加冕，使他成为丹麦、挪威、瑞典三国共主，同盟盟约也于7月在城堡签署。1444年，卡尔马是瑞典东南部最坚固的城镇、卡尔马联盟境内的天主教汉萨港口，守军监视丹麦占据的布莱金厄边界，商人则运出斯莫兰的木材、沥青和船具。

联盟的战事让卡尔马驻军屡屡出动。1505年，国王汉斯处死市长和市议会，是为第一次「卡尔马血案」。古斯塔夫·瓦萨起义期间，贵族寡妇安娜·埃里克斯多塔·比尔克在丈夫死后接掌封地，率城堡抵抗丹麦人。1523年瑞典军队攻占城市，德意志驻军八天后献堡，联盟国王只剩虚名。古斯塔夫·瓦萨与儿子埃里克十四世、约翰三世把要塞改建成铅顶的文艺复兴宫殿。1599年3月至5月，效忠齐格蒙特的守军抵御卡尔公爵围攻，投降后公爵下令处死三名指挥官和十九名士兵，是为第二次血案。1611年，丹麦的克里斯蒂安四世围攻并夺取城堡，卡尔马战争随即爆发；城堡依1613年《克奈雷德和约》归还瑞典。1642年大火烧毁老城堡，从1640年代起，城市迁往规划中的克瓦尔霍尔门岛，小尼科德姆斯·特辛设计的主教座堂于1660年至1703年间建起。1658年罗斯基勒条约把丹麦边界推向南方，1689年卡尔斯克鲁纳成为主要海军基地，卡尔马失去边境之利，老城堡就此荒废。

en:
Bergslagen is the forested mining country north of Lake Mälaren, spread across Västmanland, southern Dalarna and the neighbouring uplands. Farmers were smelting iron there in the early Middle Ages, and at Falun the copper mountain of Stora Kopparberget drew Lübeck merchants by the thirteenth century. In 1288 the bishop of Västerås bought an eighth share in the Falun mine, Sweden's oldest surviving record of mining shares, and Magnus Eriksson's charter of 1347 organised its free miners as shareholders in the works. Västerås, where the Svartån runs into Mälaren, was the district's market and bishopric, with a stone cathedral consecrated in 1271. When Eric of Pomerania's union wars choked off iron exports to the Hanse towns, a mine owner of this district, Engelbrekt Engelbrektsson, led the rising of 1434 against the king; he was murdered by a rival noble in 1436. In 1444 the pits, forges and charcoal forests were Sweden's foremost metal country and the crown's most valuable asset inside the still-unsettled Kalmar Union.

Gustav Vasa set about turning that asset into crown revenue. The Västerås riksdag of 1527 put church lands and silver in his hands, and he rebuilt Västerås Castle, where his son Eric XIV was kept prisoner from 1573 to 1575; Johannes Rudbeckius opened Sweden's oldest gymnasium in the town in 1623. Falun, with some 6,000 people, held an effective town charter from 1641, and crown policy settled German, Scottish and Dutch craftsmen in the mines while Forest Finns worked the charcoal. In the seventeenth century Falun supplied up to two-thirds of Europe's copper, more than 3,000 tonnes in the peak year of 1650, and the council in Stockholm called the mine the realm's treasury; bar iron from the surrounding forges became Bergslagen's other great export. On Midsummer Eve 1687 the hollowed copper mountain caved in and opened the Stora Stöten pit, and nobody died because the miners were all away for the feast. Linnaeus went down the mine and wrote that Falun was one of Sweden's great wonders and as horrible as hell itself.
zh:
卑尔格斯拉根是梅拉伦湖以北的森林矿区，地跨西曼兰、达拉纳南部及邻近高地。中世纪早期，农户已在这里冶铁；到13世纪，法伦的大铜山铜矿引来了吕贝克商人。1288年，韦斯特罗斯主教购得法伦铜矿八分之一的份额，这是瑞典现存最早的采矿股份记录；1347年马格努斯·埃里克松颁布特许状，把自由矿工组织成矿山的持股人。斯瓦尔塔河注入梅拉伦湖处的韦斯特罗斯，是全区的市集和主教驻地，石砌主教座堂1271年举行祝圣。波美拉尼亚的埃里克发动联盟战争、切断铁料对汉萨城市的出口后，本区矿主恩厄尔布雷克特·恩厄尔布雷克特松于1434年领头起兵反王，1436年被一名敌对贵族杀害。1444年，矿坑、锻炉和烧炭林地是瑞典首屈一指的金属产区，也是尚未安定的卡尔马联盟里王室最值钱的资产。

古斯塔夫·瓦萨着手把这笔资产变成王室收入。1527年韦斯特罗斯议会把教会土地和银器交到他手中，他随后重建韦斯特罗斯城堡，其子埃里克十四世在1573年至1575年间被囚于此；1623年，约翰内斯·鲁德贝克在城中创办瑞典最古老的高级中学。法伦约有六千居民，1641年获得实际设市特许状，王室又引入德意志、苏格兰和荷兰工匠到矿区，让森林芬兰人负责烧炭。17世纪，法伦出产的铜一度满足欧洲三分之二的需求，1650年产量最高时超过三千吨，斯德哥尔摩的政务会议把这座铜矿称作「国库」；周围锻炉出产的条铁是卑尔格斯拉根另一项大宗出口。1687年仲夏节前夜，被掏空的铜山塌陷，形成「大坑」，矿工都在过节、矿中无人，因而没有死人。林奈曾下到矿中，他写道，法伦是瑞典的一大奇迹，却和地狱一样可怕。

en:
Värmland fills the lake-strewn forest belt north of Lake Vänern, its western parishes on the Norwegian border along the Klarälven. Medieval settlement kept to the lake shore and river valleys; farmers paid their taxes in butter and oxen, and the eastern hundreds reached into the iron country of Bergslagen. The marches made a rough neighbour: in 1225 Haakon IV's Norwegians burned the villages that refused ransom. On the largest islet of the Klarälven delta lay Tingvalla, a thing and market with Viking-age roots that served the whole district. In 1444, seven years after the peasant rising around Jösse hundred, this Catholic Swedish province was still thinly peopled and had no chartered town.

Iron drove its later growth. Duke Charles, the future Charles IX, chartered Karlstad at Tingvalla on 5 March 1584, gave the old market his own name, built a Kungsgården manor there and pushed on the province's mines; from about 1580 Finnish settlers moved into the backwoods, burning clearings in the woods later called Finnskog. The army that overturned a reign set out from here: on the night of 7 March 1809 Major General Georg Adlersparre occupied Karlstad with western-army troops, planted cannon in the square and proclaimed a revolution, then marched on Stockholm two days later, and Gustav IV Adolf abdicated before the month ended. In 1814 the Värmland regiments crossed into Norway with Charles John's army and fought at Fredrikstad and the Glomma crossings. Under the Continental System the timber sawn for export joined iron as the province's staple trade.
zh:
韦姆兰地处维纳恩湖北部湖泊密布的森林带，西部教区沿克拉尔河分布在挪威边境。中世纪聚落集中在湖岸与河谷，农户以黄油和牛只缴税，东部百户区则伸入产铁的贝里斯拉根。边区邻邦凶悍：1225年，哈康四世的挪威军队焚毁拒绝纳赎的村庄。克拉尔河三角洲最大的小岛上是廷瓦拉，早在维京时代就是全区人集会和交易的地方。1444年，即约瑟一带农民起义七年后，这片信奉天主教的瑞典地区仍人烟稀疏，没有获得特状的城镇。

后来带动这里发展的是铁。1584年3月5日，后来即位为卡尔九世的卡尔公爵在廷瓦拉为卡尔斯塔德颁发特许状，让这座古市集随自己得名，又在城中建起王家庄园，并大力推动本省矿山；约从1580年起，芬兰移民进入边远林地，在后来称为芬兰森林的林地里烧荒垦殖。推翻一位国王的军队正是从这里出发：1809年3月7日夜，格奥尔格·阿德勒施帕雷少将率西部军队占领卡尔斯塔德，在广场架起大炮并宣布革命，两天后进军斯德哥尔摩，古斯塔夫四世·阿道夫在当月结束前退位。1814年，韦姆兰各团随卡尔·约翰的军队攻入挪威，在腓特烈斯塔和格洛马河各渡口作战。大陆封锁时期，锯成木料出口的木材与铁并列，成为本省的大宗贸易。

en:
Lund was founded around 990 on the plains of Skåne, then the eastern heartland of the kingdom of Denmark. It became a bishop's see in 1060, and in 1103 an archbishopric covering all of Scandinavia, with the Norse sees of Greenland under its authority too; its sandstone cathedral, built between about 1090 and 1145, stands at the centre of the town. A cathedral school opened in 1085, the oldest in the Nordic countries, and in 1425 a studium generale in the Grey Friars' friary became Denmark's first university. The wealth of Skåne meanwhile was earned on the coast, where the herring runs of the Sound drew Hanseatic fleets to the Scania Market at Skanör and Falsterbo, and by the early fourteenth century Malmö, not the archbishop's seat, was the province's merchant city. In 1444 Lund was a small, firmly Catholic clerical town, the seat of the archbishop of Lund as primate of Denmark.

At the Danish Reformation in 1536 the archdiocese lost its lands and the old academy was closed. The Peace of Roskilde ceded Skåne to Sweden in 1658, and the new rulers founded Lund University in 1666 to bind the province to them. Denmark fought to take it back: its army re-entered Skåne in 1676, and on 4 December Christian V's 13,000 Danes met Charles XI's 8,000 Swedes in the Battle of Lund, fought just north of the town; in proportion to the numbers engaged it was one of the bloodiest battles ever fought in Scandinavia, and the Peace of Lund in 1679 left the province Swedish. A last Danish invasion was broken at Helsingborg in 1710. Charles XII made Lund his residence from 1716 to 1718, running his later wars from the little town; fires in 1703 and 1711 and plague in 1712-13 thinned its streets, and the Peace of Frederiksborg in 1720 confirmed Skåne to Sweden. In 1727 the young Carl Linnaeus enrolled at the university for a year before going on to Uppsala, and Lund ended the era as a quiet cathedral and university town of about 3,000 people.
zh:
隆德约建于990年，地处斯科讷平原，当时这里是丹麦王国的东部腹地。1060年隆德设主教区，1103年升格为统辖整个斯堪的纳维亚的大主教区，连格陵兰的北欧教区也在其管辖之下；约1090至1145年建成的砂岩大教堂矗立城中心。1085年开办的大教堂学校是北欧最古老的学校，1425年灰衣修士修道院内设立的综合学院成为丹麦第一所大学。斯科讷的财富却聚在海边：厄勒海峡的鲱鱼鱼汛吸引汉萨船队前往斯卡讷和法尔斯特博的斯科讷市集，到14世纪初，这片地区的商业大城已是马尔默，而不是大主教驻地。1444年的隆德是一座虔诚信奉天主教的小城，也是丹麦首席主教的驻地。

1536年丹麦宗教改革中，总教区领地被没收，古老的学院关闭。1658年《罗斯基勒条约》把斯科讷割让给瑞典，新主于1666年创办隆德大学，以维系这片新得的省份。丹麦曾力图夺回：1676年军队重返斯科讷，12月4日，克里斯蒂安五世的一万三千丹麦军与卡尔十一世的八千瑞典军在城北交战，即隆德战役；按参战人数的伤亡比例算，这是斯堪的纳维亚历史上最惨烈的战役之一，1679年《隆德和约》确认斯科讷留在瑞典。丹麦最后一次入侵于1710年在赫尔辛堡被击退。卡尔十二世1716至1718年驻跸隆德，在这座小城里指挥他晚年的战争；1703年和1711年的大火、1712至1713年的瘟疫使城中人口锐减，1720年《腓特烈斯贝和约》最终确认斯科讷归属瑞典。1727年，年轻的卡尔·林奈在隆德大学注册入学，一年后转赴乌普萨拉；到这一时代结束时，隆德是一座约三千人口、以大教堂和大学为中心的宁静小城。

en:
Skaraborg is the grain plain of Västergötland, crossed by the old roads where the Thing of all Geats once gathered. Skara became a bishop's seat around the year 1000 and is one of Sweden's oldest towns. At Husaby, by a spring beside the church, legend says Olof Skötkonung, the first Christian king of Sweden, was baptised. A short ride away the Cistercians built Varnhem Abbey around 1150; the House of Eric endowed it and buried three of its kings in its church, and Birger Jarl was laid to rest there after his death in 1266. Nearby Skövde drew pilgrims to the shrine of Saint Elin and was already a taxed market town by about 1400. In 1444 this was Swedish, Catholic country: an old cathedral town and small market places set among fields of grain.

In January 1458 councillors of Sweden, Denmark and Norway met at Skara. Christian II of Denmark's army burned Skara and Skövde in 1520, and Gustav Vasa's Reformation then dissolved the monasteries and ended the pilgrim trade that sustained Skövde; Danish troops burned Varnhem Abbey during the Northern Seven Years' War in 1566. The future Charles IX, then Duke Charles, founded Mariestad on Lake Vänern in 1583 and named it after his wife Maria of the Palatinate. John III turned Skara's old Dominican convent into Skaraborg Castle, completed in 1585, and Danish troops burned it in the Kalmar War of 1612. When Skaraborg County was formed in 1634 the governor eventually settled at the royal estate in Mariestad from 1660. Fire struck Skara in 1719 and the centre of Skövde in 1759, after which both towns were rebuilt.
zh:
斯卡拉堡是西约特兰的粮食平原，古老道路穿行其间，约塔人全体庭会曾在此集会。约1000年前后，斯卡拉成为主教驻地，是瑞典最古老的城镇之一。在胡萨比的教堂旁有一眼泉，相传瑞典第一位基督教国王奥洛夫·舍特科农就在此受洗。不远的瓦恩海姆，西多会修士约1150年建起修道院；埃里克王朝供养它，把三位国王葬在院中的教堂里，执政公爵比尔耶尔1266年死后也安葬于此。附近的舍夫德因圣埃林圣墓吸引朝圣者，约1400年已是纳税的集镇。1444年，这里是信奉天主教的瑞典：古老的主教城和小集镇散布在粮田间。

1458年1月，瑞典、丹麦和挪威三国政务会议的代表在斯卡拉集会。1520年，丹麦国王克里斯蒂安二世的军队焚毁斯卡拉和舍夫德；古斯塔夫·瓦萨推行的宗教改革随即解散修道院，支撑舍夫德的朝圣贸易就此断绝，瓦恩海姆修道院也在1566年北方七年战争中被丹军烧毁。当时还是公爵的卡尔九世1583年在维纳恩湖畔建立玛丽斯塔德，以妻子普法尔茨的玛丽亚命名。约翰三世把斯卡拉的旧多明我会修道院改建为斯卡拉堡，城堡1585年完工，1612年卡尔马战争中被丹军烧毁。1634年斯卡拉堡设郡，郡守几经搬迁，1660年起常驻玛丽斯塔德的王室庄园。1719年斯卡拉遭大火，1759年舍夫德市中心被焚，两镇灾后都得重建。

en:
Dalaskogen is the forested north-west of Dalarna, around Lake Siljan and the upper Österdalälven, where the river runs north through the woods towards Norway. Farmers had settled the neck of land between Orsasjön and Siljan at Mora by the 600s, and around the year 1000 they lived by fur hunting, bog-iron working and fishing. The market kept its name, Mora, first written in a document of 1325, and a small grey-stone church went up around 1300. In 1434 the miners and peasants of Dalarna rose under Engelbrekt Engelbrektsson against the bailiffs of Eric of Pomerania. In 1444 this Catholic Swedish forest country was a scatter of lake villages and parishes, eight years on from that revolt.

Late in 1520 Gustav Vasa reached Mora to raise the country against Christian II. The villagers at first refused him, then changed their minds and sent Lars Jakobsson and Engelbrekt Jonsson skiing after him; the two overtook him at Sälen on the Norwegian road, and the Dalecarlians became the first armed following of the rising that carried Vasa to the Swedish throne. Their own western frontier moved without a siege: on 1 March 1644 Daniel Buskovius, chaplain of Älvdalen, led some two hundred peasants of Mora and Älvdalen into Norwegian Särna and took it without a fight, an annexation only confirmed by the frontier regulation of 1751; Rots Sconce was built in 1677 to guard the new approach. The witch trials held in Mora and Älvdalen in 1668–1669 opened Sweden's great hunt of 1668–1676; seventeen of the Mora accused were beheaded, and a German print of the execution carried the case through Europe and is thought to have had some bearing on the Salem trials of 1692. In 1743 the Hats' restrictions on trade with Norway and levies for the Russian war brought the Dalecarlians out in the last major rural rising in Sweden. Later in the century famine emptied many Mora farms, and men returning from work in the south brought home cottage clock- and toolmaking trades.
zh:
达拉斯科根是达拉纳西北部的林乡，在锡利扬湖和东达尔河上游一带，河水向北穿过林地，流向挪威。莫拉位于奥尔萨湖与锡利扬湖之间的地峡，6世纪起已有农人定居；约1000年时，这里的人以毛皮狩猎、沼铁加工和渔业为生。当地市集所在的莫拉一名在1325年的文书中首次出现，约1300年还建起一座灰石小教堂。1434年，达拉纳的矿工和农民在恩厄尔布雷克特·恩格尔布雷克特松率领下起兵，反抗波美拉尼亚的埃里克派来的官吏。1444年，这片信奉天主教的瑞典林乡散布着湖滨村落和教区，距那场叛乱不过八年。

1520年末，古斯塔夫·瓦萨来到莫拉，号召乡民起兵对抗克里斯蒂安二世。村民起初拒绝，随后改变主意，派拉斯·雅各布松和恩格尔布雷克特·约恩松滑雪追赶，二人在通往挪威路上的赛伦追上了他，达拉纳人就此成为瓦萨起义的第一支武装，最终把他送上瑞典王位。他们自己西边的国境未经围城便向外推移：1644年3月1日，艾尔夫达伦牧师丹尼尔·布斯科维乌斯率领莫拉和艾尔夫达伦约两百名农民进入当时属于挪威的塞尔纳，兵不血刃拿下该地，这次吞并直到1751年边界调整才正式获得承认；1677年，罗茨炮台建成，守卫新拓的西路。1668至1669年在莫拉和艾尔夫达伦审理的猎巫案，是瑞典1668—1676年大猎巫的开端，莫拉的被告中有十七人被斩首，一幅描绘行刑场面的德国版画传遍欧洲，据说对1692年的塞勒姆审巫案也有影响。1743年，帽党限制对挪威贸易，对俄战争又强征兵员，达拉纳人再次出动，掀起瑞典最后一场大规模乡间起事。18世纪后期的饥荒使莫拉许多农家离散，从南部做工归来的人带回了钟表和工具制造的家庭手艺。

en:
This stretch of the Gulf of Bothnia runs from the Gavleån mouth in Gästrikland past Hälsingland to Näs, the medieval royal harbour at Selånger in Medelpad. In the high Middle Ages the whole Swedish-settled northern coast, as far as the Oulu River in Finland, went by the name of Stor-Hälsingland and followed the Hälsingelagen, the provincial law whose manuscript survives from 1320; seven royal farms along the coast shipped their produce to the crown by sea, and a copy of the law was kept at Selånger. An iron ring carved with runes from Forsa church, counted among the oldest legal texts in the Nordic countries, also served as the church door handle. Fishing boats worked the banks off the river mouths, and iron from inland foundries went out through Gävle. The place is first called a town in 1413, but in 1444 it had no charter; Christopher of Bavaria granted one in 1446, making Gävle the oldest town in Norrland.

For a long time the crown strictly limited Gävle's foreign trade: Sten Sture let it trade only with Stockholm and Åbo, six ships carrying iron, copper and pelts were cleared in 1531, and Gustav Vasa opened the port in 1546. John III founded Hudiksvall in 1582 and began Gävle Castle the following year; Söderhamn followed in 1620, and Sundsvall, with interim privileges in 1621 and its final charter in 1624, drew trade away from old Näs. The Bottnian restrictions of 1636 cut these towns off from direct foreign shipping until Gävle recovered its staple rights in 1673.

The Russians came during the Great Northern War. In July 1719 some 5,000 men under Peter von Lacy attacked Gävle from land and sea, and the ten guns of Fredriksskans beat back three attempts on the harbour before the fleet sailed off on 2 August. Sundsvall did not hold: Russian troops burned it in 1721 after the fighting at Selånger. Gävle was rebuilt after its fire of 1776 with straight streets and regular blocks, and in 1792 Gustav III opened his last Riksdag in a temporary building beside the castle; weeks later he was shot at a masked ball in Stockholm.
zh:
这段波的尼亚湾海岸南起耶斯特里克兰的耶夫勒河口，中经哈尔辛兰，北抵梅代尔帕德塞隆厄的中世纪王家港口奈斯。盛期中世纪时，整个瑞典人定居的北方海岸（最远到芬兰的奥卢河）都叫「大哈尔辛兰」，遵行抄本成书于1320年的《哈尔辛兰法》；沿海七座王家农庄经海路为王室运货，法典的一份抄本就存在塞隆厄。福萨教堂（Forsa）一枚刻有卢恩文的铁环被视为北欧最古老的法律文本之一，还当过教堂的门环。渔船在各河口外的渔场作业，内陆铁厂的铁材从耶夫勒运出。耶夫勒1413年首见城镇之名，1444年却还没有特许状；巴伐利亚的克里斯托弗1446年颁下特许状，耶夫勒就此成为诺尔兰最古老的城市。

很长时间里，王室严格限制耶夫勒的对外贸易：斯滕·斯图雷只准它与斯德哥尔摩和奥布通商，1531年才放行六艘运载铁、铜和毛皮的商船，1546年古斯塔夫·瓦萨开放港口。约翰三世1582年建立胡迪克斯瓦尔，次年动工修建耶夫勒堡；瑟德港1620年设城；松兹瓦尔1621年获临时特权、1624年取得最终特许状，把贸易从奈斯旧港吸引过去。1636年的波的尼亚贸易限制切断了这些城镇的直接外洋航运，耶夫勒直到1673年才恢复集散港权利。

大北方战争期间，俄军打上门来。1719年7月，彼得·冯·拉西率约五千人从海陆两路进攻耶夫勒，弗雷德里克斯坎要塞的十门大炮三次击退进犯港湾的敌船，舰队8月2日扬帆撤走。松兹瓦尔没有挡住：1721年塞隆厄之战后，俄军将它付之一炬。1776年大火后，耶夫勒按笔直的街道和整齐的街区重建；1792年，古斯塔夫三世在城堡旁一座临时建筑里召开他最后一次议会，几周后他在斯德哥尔摩的一场假面舞会上遇刺。

en:
Jämtland is the high farming country around Lake Storsjön, with the forested fells of Härjedalen to the south. Villages ring the lake, and Frösön island held the Jamtamót, the assembly through which the Jamts kept their own law and market long before they paid taxes to a distant king. The Frösö Runestone, cut around 1030-1050 and the only runestone in the province, says plainly that it was raised when Jämtland was Christianised. During the reign of King Sverre of Norway, Norwegian forces defeated Jamt leaders on Storsjön, and the country became a Norwegian tributary while keeping its assembly. In 1444 Jämtland and Härjedalen belonged to the Norwegian crown in the Kalmar Union, a Catholic farmer country without a noble class, trading furs and iron for dried fish from the Norwegian coast.

After Denmark and Norway came under one crown in 1536, the Reformation was ordered from Copenhagen. Mountain passes then made Jämtland a recurring prize: English Wikipedia records thirteen changes of alignment through occupations between 1563 and 1677. Swedish troops seized it in 1644, and Brömsebro ceded it to Sweden in 1645. In 1657 Jørgen Bjelke's 2,500 Trønder soldiers retook the Frösö sconce and were welcomed by the people, but Roskilde confirmed Swedish rule in 1658; Norwegian troops who returned in 1677 met the same welcome and were withdrawn. The Jamts received Swedish citizenship only in 1699. In the winter of 1718-1719, after Charles XII died at Fredriksten, Carl Gustaf Armfeldt's roughly 6,000 men retreated from Trøndelag toward Jämtland. A storm caught them on the mountains; 4,273 froze to death, survivors reached Handöl and Duved, and field surgeons amputated frozen limbs before the remaining regiments could be brought farther down from the hills.
zh:
耶姆特兰是斯图尔湖周围的高原农牧之地，南方连着海里耶达伦林木覆盖的山地。村落环湖分布，弗勒瑟岛上的耶姆特莫特议事会让耶姆特人在向远方国王纳税之前很久，就按自己的法律自治并保有市集。约1030至1050年凿刻的弗勒瑟符文石是省内唯一符文石，铭文直接写明它立石时耶姆特兰正皈依基督教。挪威国王斯韦雷在位期间，挪威军队在斯图尔湖击败耶姆特首领，此地成为挪威的纳贡之地，但议事会仍被保留。1444年，耶姆特兰与海里耶达伦属于卡尔马联盟中的挪威王冠，是信奉天主教、没有贵族阶层的农民之乡，以毛皮和铁换取挪威海岸的鳕鱼干。

1536年丹麦与挪威共戴一君后，宗教改革由哥本哈根下令推行。山间通道随后使耶姆特兰反复成为战利品：1563至1677年间，占领军曾让它的归属立场改变十三次。1644年瑞典军队占领此地，1645年布勒姆瑟布鲁和约将它割让给瑞典。1657年，约尔根·比耶克率二千五百名特伦德拉格士兵夺回弗勒瑟要塞并受到居民欢迎，但1658年罗斯基勒和约确认了瑞典统治；1677年重返的挪威军队得到同样接待，却再次撤离。耶姆特人迟至1699年才获得瑞典公民身份。1718至1719年冬，卡尔十二世在腓特烈斯滕死后，卡尔·古斯塔夫·阿姆费尔特率领约六千人从特伦德拉格向耶姆特兰撤退。暴风雪在山中困住军队，四千二百七十三人冻死，残部抵达汉德尔和迪韦德，军医截除冻坏的四肢，剩余各团才被继续转移到山下。

en:
This province follows the long north shore of the Gulf of Bothnia, from the Ångermanälven past Umeå and Skellefteå to the Torne älv. Swedish farming and fishing parishes formed a thin coastal strip; Sámi hunters and reindeer herders held the forests and fells behind, and squirrel and marten pelts went south through the birkarlar, crown-licensed traders who ran the Pite, Lule and Torne Lappmarks. On the Ångermanälven stood Styresholm, raised in the 1390s on a river island by the Victual Brothers, pirates who also held Åbo and Viborg. It passed to Queen Margaret in 1398; her Danish bailiffs taxed river traffic there until locals tore it down in 1434 during Engelbrekt's rising. In 1444 Catholic Sweden's hold still rested on its coastal parishes, boat routes and fur revenues.

Gustav Vasa put Sámi taxation under crown officials in 1548 to 1550, ending the birkarlar privileges. John III founded Härnösand in 1585, Gustavus Adolphus chartered Torneå on 12 May 1621, and Umeå was re-established in 1622. Built on the Suensaari islet at the river mouth, it was the northernmost town in the world, the funnel for all Lapland furs and for some years Sweden's richest merchant town. Its wooden church, finished in 1686, served the French mathematician Maupertuis as a survey mark in 1736 and 1737, when he measured a meridian arc up the Torne valley and showed the earth flattened at the poles. Tar, timber and iron works later strengthened the southern towns.

In the Great Northern War Russian raiders burned Torneå, rebuilt on a plan shifted slightly south in 1718, burned Umeå in 1720, and on 28 May 1721 destroyed Härnösand, where only two houses survived. They returned in 1809: in March Barclay de Tolly crossed the frozen Kvarken and took Umeå, in May a column forced its way past Skellefteå, and on 19 August Kamensky met Wachtmeister at Sävar, one of the bloodiest battles of the war and the last pitched battle on Swedish soil. A Swedish landing at Ratan the next day failed to cut him off. The Treaty of Fredrikshamn on 17 September drew the border up the Torne and Muonio rivers, and at the tsar's request Torneå itself lay on the Russian side; the old fur-trading coast was split in two.
zh:
这个省份是波的尼亚湾狭长的北岸，从翁厄曼河深水河口，经于默奥和谢莱夫特奥，一直延伸到托尔讷河。瑞典人的农耕与渔业教区在海边排成稀薄一线，后方的森林和山地属于萨米猎人与驯鹿牧人；灰鼠皮和貂皮经比尔卡尔商人南运，这些持王室执照的商人把持着皮特、吕勒和托尔讷拉普马克的贸易。翁厄曼河上有斯提雷什霍尔姆堡（Styresholm），1390年代由「粮食兄弟会」的海盗筑在河心岛上，这伙人一度还占着奥布和维堡。城堡1398年落入玛格丽特女王手中，她的丹麦税吏驻在堡内向河上商船抽税，1434年恩厄尔布雷克特起义时被愤怒的当地人拆毁。1444年，信奉天主教的瑞典对这段海岸的掌握仍只靠教区、水路和毛皮收入。

古斯塔夫·瓦萨在1548年至1550年把萨米税收收归王室官员，比尔卡尔商人的特权告终。城市随后出现：约翰三世1585年建立海讷桑德，古斯塔夫二世1621年5月12日向托尔讷奥颁发特许状，于默奥则于1622年重建。托尔讷奥建在河口的苏恩萨里岛（Suensaari）上，建城时是世界上最靠北的城市，也是全拉普兰毛皮的总汇，有几年是瑞典最富庶的商镇。它1686年落成的木教堂，在1736年至1737年给法国数学家莫佩尔蒂充当测量标志：他沿托尔讷河谷测量子午线弧度，证明地球两极稍扁。木焦油、木材和冶铁业后来支撑起南部诸城。

大北方战争把俄国袭掠者带到这里的每处港湾：托尔讷奥被俄军焚毁后，1718年按略向南移的规划重建；于默奥1720年被烧，1721年5月28日海讷桑德被毁，仅两座房子幸存。1809年俄军再来：3月，巴克莱·德托利跨过冰封的克瓦尔肯海峡拿下于默奥；5月，一支俄军纵队在谢莱夫特奥附近强行通过；8月19日，卡缅斯基与瓦赫特迈斯特在塞瓦尔交战，这是战争中最惨烈的战役之一，也是瑞典国土上最后一场会战。次日瑞典人在拉坦登陆，仍未能截断俄军。9月17日的《弗雷德里克港和约》把边界划在托尔讷河与穆奥尼奥河上，并应沙皇本人的要求让托尔讷奥落在俄国一侧；这条古老的毛皮贸易海岸就此被一分为二。

en:
Zealand lies between the Great Belt and the Øresund, the sounds linking the Baltic to the Kattegat, and it was the old heartland of the Danish kingdom. Its first centre was Roskilde, capital from the eleventh century to 1443; Absalon began its brick cathedral in 1170, and the finished church became the burial church of the Danish kings, their sarcophagi filling its chapels. On the eastern shore Absalon also raised a fortress on Slotsholmen in 1167, guarding Havn, a good herring harbour. Sacked by the Hansa in 1368, the town rose again when Eric of Pomerania moved his court there around 1416; it became Copenhagen, capital of Denmark in 1443. At the narrowest neck of the Sound, where the water is only four kilometres wide, Eric had built Krogen in the 1420s, and from 1429 every ship sailing between the Baltic and the North Sea paid the Sound Dues there. In 1444 the island was the Catholic Danish core of the Kalmar Union, rich on herring and toll silver.

The toll fortress made Helsingør a name every sailor knew. Frederick II rebuilt Krogen as the Renaissance Kronborg between 1574 and 1585, facing Kärnan on the opposite shore; a Swedish army stormed and looted it in 1658, and after later refortification it was counted among the strongest fortresses in Europe, and Shakespeare made it Elsinore, the castle of Hamlet. War came to Copenhagen as well: loyal to the captive Christian II, the city endured a year-long siege in 1535-36 during the Count's Feud before opening its gates to Christian III, who carried the Lutheran Reformation through Denmark. In 1658 the Swedes marched across the frozen belts to force the Treaty of Roskilde, then returned to besiege Copenhagen, but their assault of February 1659 broke against the walls. A British fleet attacked the city in 1801 and came back in 1807 to bombard it and carry off the Danish fleet; the wars ended with the Treaty of Kiel in 1814.

Christian I founded the University of Copenhagen in 1479, the oldest in Denmark. Christian IV gave the capital its landmarks: the Børsen with its twisted dragon-tail spire, the Round Tower completed in 1642 as an astronomical observatory, and Rosenborg Castle. Fire destroyed most of medieval Copenhagen in 1728 and again in 1795; Christiansborg Palace rose in 1733-45, and the Frederiksstaden district was laid out from 1749 around Frederik's Church.
zh:
西兰（西兰岛）横亘在大贝尔特海峡与厄勒海峡之间，波罗的海经这两道海峡连通卡特加特海峡，丹麦王国就是在岛上的田野与港湾间成长起来的。岛上最早的中心是罗斯基勒，11世纪至1443年的丹麦首都：阿布萨隆1170年动工修建砖石大教堂，落成后成为历代丹麦国王的安葬之地，各个礼拜堂里摆满王室石棺。东岸，阿布萨隆还于1167年在城堡岛修筑要塞，扼守鲱鱼良港哈文。城镇1368年遭汉萨劫掠，波美拉尼亚的埃里克约在1416年把宫廷迁此后复兴，便是后来的哥本哈根，1443年成为丹麦首都。海峡最窄处仅四公里，埃里克15世纪20年代在那里建起克罗根要塞，从1429年起，所有往返波罗的海与北海的船只都要在此缴纳海峡税。1444年的西兰是卡尔马联盟信奉天主教的丹麦核心，财富来自鲱鱼鱼汛和关税白银。

关税要塞让赫尔辛格成为每个水手都知道的名字。1574至1585年，腓特烈二世把克罗根本垒改建为文艺复兴式的克伦堡宫，与对岸的克尔南塔隔海相望；1658年瑞典军队攻破并洗劫了宫殿，日后经重新加固，它被视为欧洲最坚固的要塞之一。莎士比亚以它为埃尔西诺，写成《哈姆雷特》中的城堡。哥本哈根同样久经战阵：伯爵战争期间，城市忠于被俘的克里斯蒂安二世，1535至1536年被围一年才向克里斯蒂安三世开城，后者把路德宗改革推行到整个丹麦。1658年，瑞典军队踏过封冻的海峡逼迫丹麦签订《罗斯基勒条约》，随后又回师围攻哥本哈根，但1659年2月的强攻在城墙下被击退。1801年英国舰队来袭，1807年再至，炮轰城市并掳走丹麦舰队，战争最终在1814年以《基尔条约》收场。

1479年，克里斯蒂安一世创办丹麦最古老的大学，即哥本哈根大学。克里斯蒂安四世给首都留下一批地标：龙尾盘绕尖顶的旧证券交易所、1642年落成并用作天文观象台的圆塔，以及罗森堡宫。1728年和1795年的两场大火烧掉中世纪老城的大半，第一座克里斯蒂安堡宫于1733至1745年为王室建成，腓特烈斯塔登区则从1749年起围绕腓特烈教堂铺开。

en:
Schleswig, the old South Jutland, is the strip of land between the Eider and the Kolding area, with the Schlei inlet cutting in from the Baltic and Flensburg Fjord on its eastern edge. The Danevirke, the Danish kings' wall across the narrow waist of the country, marks how early this was a border ground; behind it Hedeby grew into one of the great trading places of the Viking age, where goods from the North Sea met goods from the Baltic. After Hedeby's destruction in the mid-eleventh century its merchants moved to the town of Schleswig on the Schlei, and Haderslev, chartered in 1292, carried Ribe traffic on towards the Baltic. The duchy remained a Danish fief even as its ducal house drew close to Holstein. In 1444 its ruler was Adolph VIII of Schauenburg, count of Holstein-Rendsburg and duke of Schleswig; Danish and North Frisian farmers, Low German-speaking townsmen and Catholic parish priests shared a country that lived from cattle and inshore waters.

Adolph died without an heir, and in 1460 Christian I of Denmark took the duchy after the Ribe Letter promised that Schleswig and Holstein would never be parted. Gottorf Castle on its island in the Schlei became the seat of the new line: Frederick I made it his chief residence, and the partition of 1544 turned Adolf's share into the duchy of Holstein-Gottorp, a house that later gave Sweden four kings and Russia several emperors. Duke Frederick III ran a European-scale court there, and in the 1650s his librarian Adam Olearius had the walk-in Globe of Gottorf built, just over three metres across, with the world mapped outside and the constellations turning over seats inside, an ancestor of the planetarium. Schleswig Cathedral keeps Ghert Klinghe's bronze font and Hans Brüggemann's carved Bordesholm Altar, and Frederick I lies buried in the church; in 1486 a town press produced the Missale Slesvicense. Swedish armies swept the duchy in Torstensson's war and again in 1657, and the Gottorp shares were not incorporated into the Danish crown until 1721. The great manors then turned to cattle and dairy produce.
zh:
石勒苏益格古称南日德兰，是艾德河与科灵一带之间的条状陆地，施莱湾自波罗的海切入，东缘是弗伦斯堡峡湾。丹麦历代国王在陆地最窄处修筑的丹尼弗克防线，说明这里早就是边境地带；防线内侧的海泽比是维京时代最大的贸易地之一，北海与波罗的海的货物在此交换。11世纪中叶海泽比被毁后，商人转移到施莱湾畔的石勒苏益格城；1292年获得特许状的哈泽斯莱乌，则把里伯的商货继续运往波罗的海。公国始终是丹麦封邑，尽管公爵家族与荷尔斯泰因越走越近。1444年，统治者是绍恩堡家族的阿道夫八世，身兼荷尔斯泰因-伦茨堡伯爵与石勒苏益格公爵；丹麦人和北弗里斯兰人农户、操低地德语的市民和天主教本堂神父，共处在这片靠畜牧和近岸水域为生的土地。

阿道夫无嗣而终。1460年，丹麦国王克里斯蒂安一世依据《里伯信约》接管公国，信约规定石勒苏益格与荷尔斯泰因永不分离。施莱湾岛洲上的戈托普城堡成为新支系的驻地：腓特烈一世以它为主要居所，1544年的分封把阿道夫那份领地变成荷尔斯泰因-戈托普公国，这个家族后来出了四位瑞典国王和数位俄国皇帝。腓特烈三世公爵的宫廷具有欧洲气象，1650年代，他的图书馆长亚当·奥莱留斯（Adam Olearius）主持造出可走入的戈托普地球仪，直径三米有余，外壳绘世界，内壁星图在坐席上方转动，是天象仪的前身。石勒苏益格大教堂藏有格尔特·克林格（Ghert Klinghe）铸造的青铜洗礼盆和汉斯·布吕格曼雕刻的博尔德斯霍尔姆祭坛，腓特烈一世就葬在堂中；1486年，城中印坊印出了《石勒苏益格弥撒经本》。瑞典军队在托尔斯滕松战争中横扫此地，1657年再度占领，戈托普支系的领地直到1721年才并入丹麦王冠。此后大庄园转向养牛和乳制品生产。

en:
Funen, Denmark's third-largest island, lies between the Great and Little Belts, with Langeland off its southern shore. Its loam is among the best farmland in the kingdom, and by the later Middle Ages the island carried more manors than any other part of Denmark, ringed by market towns at Odense, Nyborg and Svendborg. Odense had become a bishop's see by the late tenth century, and pilgrims came after rebel peasants killed King Canute IV in St Alban's Priory in 1086; canonised in 1100, he is the patron saint of Denmark and his shrine rested in the town's cathedral. At Nyborg, on the shortest crossing of the Great Belt to Zealand, Valdemar the Great raised a royal castle around 1170, and Eric V granted Denmark's first royal charter in 1282; for two centuries the Danehof, the assembly of king and nobles, met in that castle. In 1444 Funen was a Catholic crown island whose manors and fisheries shipped grain, cattle and fish across the belts.

In 1482 the German printer Johann Snell printed the Breviarium Ottoniense in Odense, the first book produced in Scandinavia. During the Count's Feud, Count Christopher of Oldenburg's men held Nyborg until Johan Rantzau defeated them at Øksnebjerg in June 1535, and the Reformation reached Funen the next year. Frederick I made Nyborg his residence in 1525, and Christian III enlarged the castle; for some forty years it served as the working seat of the Danish crown. Frands Brockenhuus built Egeskov near Kværndrup in 1554, a Renaissance moated castle on oak piles in a lake; legend says an entire oak forest went into its foundations, giving the castle its name. Odense grew rich on the cattle trade to North Germany. In 1658 Charles X Gustav marched his army across the frozen belts and occupied Nyborg; the Peace of Roskilde gave Funen back, but the Swedes returned in the renewed war until a Dutch fleet under Michiel de Ruyter bombarded Nyborg and an allied army defeated them there in November 1659. The shoemaker's son Hans Christian Andersen was born in Odense in 1805. In August 1808 some 1,500 Spanish soldiers under the Marquis de la Romana seized Nyborg fortress and were taken off by the British navy to fight Napoleon in Spain.
zh:
菲英是丹麦第三大岛，横在大贝尔特海峡与小贝尔特海峡之间，南边与朗厄兰岛隔海相望。岛上的壤土是王国最上等的耕地之一，到中世纪晚期，菲英的庄园数量已冠于丹麦各地，欧登塞、尼堡、斯文堡等集镇环列四周。欧登塞在10世纪末已是主教驻地；1086年，起事的农民在圣阿尔班修道院杀死国王克努特四世，他于1100年被封圣，是丹麦的主保圣人，圣骸安放在城中的主教座堂，引来朝圣者。尼堡扼守大贝尔特海峡通往西兰岛最窄的渡口，瓦尔德马大王约在1170年在此建起王室城堡，1282年埃里克五世在堡中颁布丹麦第一部王室宪章；此后两百年间，国王与贵族的王国大会都在这座城堡召开。1444年，菲英是信奉天主教的王属岛屿，庄园和渔村把谷物、牛只和渔获运过海峡。

1482年，德意志印刷匠约翰·施奈尔在欧登塞印成《欧登塞日课经》，这是斯堪的纳维亚印出的第一本书。伯爵战争期间，奥尔登堡伯爵克里斯托弗的军队占据尼堡，直到1535年6月约翰·兰曹在厄克斯内比约击败他们，次年宗教改革推行到岛上。1525年腓特烈一世把尼堡定为驻跸之地，克里斯蒂安三世又扩建城堡，此后约四十年间，这座城镇实际充当丹麦王室的驻地。1554年，弗兰斯·布罗肯胡斯在克文德鲁普附近修建伊埃斯科城堡（Egeskov）：这座文艺复兴式水堡立在湖中的橡木桩基上，相传打桩用尽了整片橡树林，城堡也因此得名。欧登塞靠向北德贩运牛只致富。1658年，卡尔十世·古斯塔夫率军踏冰越过海峡，占领尼堡；《罗斯基勒条约》把菲英归还丹麦，战火重燃后瑞典军却卷土重来，1659年11月，米希尔·德·鲁伊特率领的荷兰舰队炮轰尼堡，联军在此击败瑞典军。1805年，鞋匠之子汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生出生在欧登塞。1808年8月，拉罗马纳侯爵麾下约一千五百名西班牙士兵夺取尼堡要塞，由英国舰队接走，回西班牙对拿破仑作战。

en:
Western Jutland faces the North Sea behind dunes, tidal marshes and Ringkøbing Fjord. Ribe, the oldest town in Denmark, traded with Frisia and England in the early eighth century and became a bishopric in 948; its cathedral was begun in 1150 beside Riberhus, the royal castle on a moated mound. Danish folk ballads place Queen Dagmar's death at the castle in 1212. Farther north, Ringkøbing used the sheltered harbour cut off by the dunes, and Christopher of Bavaria confirmed its market rights in 1443. In 1444 this was Catholic Danish cattle country, where Ribe merchants collected oxen for export and fishermen and small traders used Ringkøbing.

Christian I summoned the Schleswig-Holstein nobility to Ribe in 1460 and secured both lands for the Oldenburg dynasty with a proclamation that they should remain undivided. During the Count's Feud of 1534, Johan Rantzau's royal troops passed through an abandoned Ringkøbing on their march to Aalborg; two years later the Reformation closed Ribe's Catholic diocese. Cattle remained the district's richest product. Ringkøbing won the right to ship stall-fed oxen in 1553 and became a customs place under Christian IV in 1599, sending oxen, grain and fish to Norway, Holland and Hamburg.

Water and war marked the following two centuries. Storm floods struck in 1615 and 1624, and the Burchardi flood of 1634 left flood marks on Ribe Cathedral. Riberhus was damaged in the fighting of 1644 and 1657-1660, and its stone was later reused for church repairs and roads. Ringkøbing became an administrative seat in 1794, lost most of its ships in the war of 1807-1814, and had rebuilt a fleet of fourteen by 1816.
zh:
西日德兰面向北海，沿岸是沙丘、潮汐沼泽和灵克宾峡湾。里伯是丹麦最古老的城镇，8世纪初已与弗里斯兰和英格兰通商，948年成为主教驻地；1150年动工的大教堂紧邻建在护城壕土丘上的王室城堡里伯城堡。丹麦民谣相传，达格玛王后1212年就在这座城堡去世。北面的灵克宾依托沙丘围出的避风港，1443年巴伐利亚的克里斯托弗确认了它的市镇权。1444年，这里是丹麦天主教徒的牛乡，里伯商人收购牛只出口，渔民和小商人则使用灵克宾。

1460年，克里斯蒂安一世召集石勒苏益格和荷尔斯泰因贵族到里伯，以两地不得分割的宣告为奥尔登堡王朝取得这两片领地。1534年伯爵战争期间，约翰·兰曹率领勤王军队穿过居民弃守的灵克宾，向奥尔堡进军；两年后，宗教改革废除里伯天主教教区。牲畜仍是这一带最值钱的物产。灵克宾1553年获得圈养牛只出口权，1599年在克里斯蒂安四世治下成为税关，把牛、谷物和鱼运往挪威、荷兰和汉堡。

随后两个世纪里，洪水和战争反复袭来。1615年和1624年发生风暴潮，1634年布哈尔迪洪灾在里伯大教堂留下水位痕迹。里伯城堡在1644年以及1657年至1660年的战事中受损，石料后来被挪去修缮教堂、修筑道路。灵克宾1794年成为行政中心，在1807年至1814年战争中损失几乎全部船只，到1816年又重建起十四艘船的船队。

en:
Known to its Norwegian rulers as Båhuslen, Bohuslän is a narrow belt of skerries and fishing harbours along the Skagerrak. It took its name from Båhus, raised from 1308 on a cliff above the Göta älv to guard Norway's southern frontier; in time it became the strongest fortress in Norway, besieged at least fourteen times but never taken by storm. River tolls at Båhus prompted the Swedes to refound their trading town of Lödöse nearer the mouth in 1473. Marstrand, on an island beyond the river mouth, had traded and fished since the thirteenth century, and the herring years of 1420–1490 filled its quays with ships and salters; Uddevalla and Strömstad shared the traffic. In 1444 this Catholic, Norwegian border country lived by fish, shipping and the protection of Båhus.

In 1449 Christian I of Denmark was elected king of Norway at Marstrand. The deposed Christian II occupied the island in 1531 and twice failed to storm Båhus in the following year. In 1566, in the Northern Seven Years' War, Swedish storm troops seized the Red Tower; the garrison blew it up, the 'Båhus bang', killing some 250 men, and the siege collapsed. By the Treaty of Roskilde in 1658 Båhuslen passed to Sweden; the Danes wrecked the interiors as they marched out, and work began at once on Carlsten above Marstrand. Gyldenløve's Danish-Norwegian force stormed Carlsten on 23 July 1677, and in 1678 Båhus survived two months of bombardment by 15,000 men until a relief army arrived.

On 8 July 1716 Tordenskiold destroyed a Swedish supply fleet at Dynekilen, and on 15 July 1719 he took Marstrand and bluffed Carlsten into surrender; its commandant was beheaded, and peace returned the fortress to Sweden in 1720. Gustav III made Marstrand a free port on 15 August 1775; merchants and up to a hundred Jews settled there, and a synagogue opened in 1780. The free-port privilege was withdrawn in 1794, and when the great herring period ended in 1808 the island town lost much of its wealth.
zh:
布胡斯在挪威统治者口中称博胡斯伦，是斯卡格拉克海峡沿岸一条由岩礁与渔港组成的狭长地带。它得名于布胡斯要塞：这座要塞1308年起建于约塔河畔的悬崖上，扼守挪威南境，后来成为挪威最坚固的堡垒，先后被围至少十四次，却从未被强攻拿下。它在河道上设卡征税，也是瑞典人1473年把贸易城勒德瑟迁往更靠近河口的新址另建新城的原因之一。河口外岛上的马斯特兰德13世纪起便是贸易与渔港，1420至1490年的鲱鱼丰期把船只和腌鱼商带到码头，乌德瓦拉和斯特伦斯塔德也处在同一沿海商路上。1444年，这片信奉天主教的挪威边陲之地以渔业、航运和布胡斯要塞的庇护为生。

1449年，丹麦的克里斯蒂安一世在马斯特兰德被推举为挪威国王。被废黜的克里斯蒂安二世1531年占领该岛，次年两度攻打布胡斯，均告失败。1566年北方七年战争中，瑞典突击队一度夺取红塔，守军当即将塔炸毁，约二百五十名进攻者死于这次被称为「布胡斯巨响」的爆炸，围城随之瓦解。1658年《罗斯基勒条约》把博胡斯伦割让给瑞典：丹麦守军砸毁内部陈设后开城撤离，瑞典人随即在马斯特兰德高处动工修建卡尔斯坦要塞。1677年7月23日，居伦勒夫率丹挪联军强攻夺取卡尔斯坦；1678年，布胡斯本身在一万五千人长达两个月的炮击中苦撑，直到援军赶到才解围。

1716年7月8日，托登舍尔德在迪讷基伦峡湾歼灭一支瑞典补给舰队；1719年7月15日，他攻占马斯特兰德，又用虚张声势的办法逼降卡尔斯坦守军，要塞司令后来被斩首。1720年和议后，这座堡垒仍归瑞典。1775年8月15日，古斯塔夫三世给予马斯特兰德自由港地位，商人与一度多达百人的犹太人社群迁居于此，1780年犹太会堂设立。自由港特权1794年被收回，1808年鲱鱼大盛期结束后，这座岛城也失去了大量财富。

en:
The head of the Oslofjord is the richest corner of eastern Norway. Oslo was laid out as a trading town in the 1040s by Harald Hardrada and became a bishop's see in 1070, but it stayed a small wooden town until Håkon V took up permanent residence there in 1299 and moved his capital up from Bergen. On the headland beside the town he raised Akershus, one of the North's strongest fortresses, where Olaf, Norway's last king before the Kalmar Union, was born in 1370. A day's sail south lay Tønsberg, an old market town crowned by its royal hill-castle. The Black Death emptied the fjord country in 1349; under the union the kings ruled from Copenhagen, leaving Akershus to fiefholders while Hanseatic merchants took its foreign trade. In 1444 it was a provincial corner of Christopher of Bavaria's realm, and the castle mattered more than the king: a Norwegian saying held that whoever held Akershus ruled Norway.

No foreign storm ever took the fortress. A Swedish siege had already failed in 1308, and Karl Knutsson of Sweden battered it in vain in 1449–50. In 1502 the Norwegian lord Knut Alvsson seized it and was murdered on his way to peace talks. Swedes came again in 1523, and the townsmen burned their houses rather than shelter them. The deposed Christian II tried in 1531–32: barely twenty or thirty men held the walls and span out a truce until a Danish and Lübeck fleet relieved them, and the ex-king was carried off a prisoner. The Reformation reached Norway in 1537, binding the kingdom closer to the Danish crown. In 1567 the fiefholder Christen Munk burned the town again before another Swedish siege.

Christian IV rebuilt Akershus as a Renaissance bastion from 1593. When the old wooden city burned down in 1624 he founded a new town of straight streets and square blocks beneath the fortress walls and named it Christiania. On 8 March 1716 Charles XII of Sweden attacked with 10,000 men; Colonel Klenow's 3,000 held, and the campaign collapsed. In 1814 the Peace of Kiel handed Norway to Sweden, but Christian Frederik and the Eidsvoll assembly proclaimed independence on 17 May; a short war ended in the Convention of Moss, and Christiania remained Norway's capital.
zh:
奥斯陆峡湾湾顶是东挪威最富庶的一角。奥斯陆是哈拉尔·哈德拉德在1040年代开辟的商埠，1070年成为主教驻地，但直到1299年哈康五世长年驻跸于此、把都城从卑尔根迁来，它始终只是一座木构小城。他在城边岬角筑起阿克什胡斯，北方最坚固的堡垒之一；卡尔马联盟之前最后一位挪威国王奥拉夫，1370年就出生在城堡里。南下一日航程是滕斯贝格，一座古老集镇，山丘上立着王家堡寨。1349年黑死病让峡湾一带十室九空；联盟时期国王远在哥本哈根治国，阿克什胡斯交给封臣，外贸则被汉萨商人把持。1444年，在巴伐利亚的克里斯托弗治下，这座渔农与木材商贾的小城只是王国的边远角落，堡垒比国王更要紧——挪威有句俗话：谁占据阿克什胡斯，谁就统治挪威。

阿克什胡斯从未被外敌强攻拿下。1308年瑞典人已被击退过一次，1449至1450年瑞典国王卡尔·克努特松又猛攻不克。1502年，挪威贵族克努特·阿尔夫松占据城堡，却在赴和谈途中被杀。1523年瑞典军队再来，市民奉命亲手烧毁自家房屋，不给围攻者留下栖身之处。最大胆的一次是被废国王克里斯蒂安二世1531至1532年的围攻：守军只有二三十人，却靠着一纸停战拖延时间，直到丹麦与吕贝克的舰队驶入峡湾解围，克里斯蒂安反成了阶下囚。1537年宗教改革传到挪威，王国被丹麦王冠束得更紧。1567年瑞典军队又至，封臣克里斯滕·蒙克再度烧掉城市，不给敌军留一粒粮。

1593年起，克里斯蒂安四世把阿克什胡斯改建成文艺复兴式棱堡。1624年整片木构老城焚于大火，他不许在原地重建，而在堡垒墙下另筑一座街道笔直、街区方正的新城，以自己的名字命名为克里斯蒂安尼亚。1716年3月8日，瑞典国王卡尔十二世率一万之众来攻，克莱诺上校的三千守军据城不退，瑞典征挪之役就此瓦解。1814年，《基尔条约》把挪威从丹麦手中交给瑞典，但克里斯蒂安·弗雷德里克与埃兹沃尔德会议在5月17日宣布王国独立；短暂的战争以《莫斯公约》收场，克里斯蒂安尼亚作为挪威首都进入新的联盟。

en:
This interior province covers the Ume, Ångermanna, later called Åsele, and Pite lappmarks, the lake and river basins behind Umeå and Skellefteå. Long before any town existed, forest and fell Sámi households moved between fishing waters, hunting grounds and reindeer pastures, paying tribute in squirrel and marten pelts; the Pite trade passed through crown-licensed birkarlar, while Ume and Ångermanna Sámi dealt with royal bailiffs. Arvidsjaur's winter village stood by a lake well stocked with fish. In 1444 the Catholic Swedish crown claimed the country and its furs, but its reach ran only to tax journeys and meetings on the coast; there were no roads, garrisons or settled parishes.

After the Reformation the crown fixed those meetings as church markets. When Sámi assemblies in 1606 refused to share a single church between the distant Ume and Pite districts, Lycksele and Arvidsjaur were designated in 1606 to 1607, and Arvidsjaur built its church in 1607; Åsele received its own in 1648. Sweden's first large mining venture in the far north followed the fur trade to Nasafjäll, a mountain just inside the border. A Sámi man found the silver ore, and from 1635 conscripted farmers from the coastal parishes dug it while Pite Sámi hauled it sixty kilometres on reindeer sledges to the smelter at Silbojokk on the Skellefte River. They could not refuse the hauling, reindeer herding broke down, and many families crossed into Norway. In August 1659 a Norwegian force came over the mountains, plundered the works and burned them; the mine ran again from 1770 to 1810. In 1732 Carl Linnaeus set out from Umeå for a six-month journey through these lappmarks, and his observations became his Flora Lapponica.
zh:
这个内陆省份包括乌默、翁厄曼纳（后来称奥瑟勒）和皮特拉普马克，即于默奥与谢莱夫特奥后方的河湖流域。早在任何城镇出现之前，森林和山地的萨米家庭便在渔场、猎场和驯鹿牧场之间辗转，以灰鼠皮和貂皮纳贡；皮特的贸易经持王室执照的比尔卡尔商人进行，乌默和翁厄曼纳的萨米人则直接同王室税吏打交道。阿尔维斯尧尔的冬营坐落在一座渔产丰足的湖畔。1444年，信奉天主教的瑞典王室宣称领有这片土地和它的毛皮，但王权只能伸到收税行程和海岸集会；没有道路，没有驻军，也没有定居教区。

宗教改革后，王室把这些集会固定为教堂市场。1606年，萨米集会拒绝让相距遥远的乌默和皮特两区共用一座教堂，吕克瑟勒和阿尔维斯尧尔遂在1606至1607年被定为教堂市场，阿尔维斯尧尔教堂1607年建成，奥瑟勒1648年也有了自己的教堂。毛皮贸易之后，瑞典在极北的第一项大型矿业落到紧贴边界的纳萨菲耶尔山。矿石最初由一名萨米人发现；1635年起，沿海教区被征发的农户进山挖矿，皮特萨米人则用驯鹿雪橇把矿石运到六十公里外谢莱夫特河畔西尔博约科（Silbojokk）的冶炼场。这种运输劳役无法拒绝，驯鹿牧业随之凋敝，许多人家越境逃往挪威。1659年8月，一支挪威军队翻山而来，劫掠并焚毁了矿场；矿山1770年至1810年一度复工。1732年，卡尔·林奈从于默奥出发，在这些拉普马克里走了六个月，考察所得后来汇成《拉普兰植物志》。

en:
Österbotten is the southern coastal plain of historical Ostrobothnia on the Gulf of Bothnia, flat farmland behind a skerry coast. Swedish settlers had held the shoreline since the thirteenth century, and in the 1370s the crown raised Korsholm Castle beside the sea lanes; a single castellan there governed all of Ostrobothnia and gathered the region's tribute of furs, while Finnish settlers moving in from Savonia burned and cleared the inland woods. In 1444 this was a thinly peopled Swedish frontier, its pelts shipped south through Åbo and Stockholm.

The peasants' rising of 1596-1597, the Cudgel War, began here. Twenty-five years of war with Russia had loaded the farmers with taxes and the hated 'castle camp', the duty to board and pay the soldiery, whom Clas Fleming kept under arms long after the peace of 1595. On 25 November 1596 the farmers attacked the church village of Isokyrö, armed with cudgels, flails and maces against plate armour, and beat several bodies of infantry. Their leader Jaakko Ilkka was captured and beheaded at Ilmajoki on 27 January 1597, and on 24 February the last peasant army was ridden down on Santavuori Hill, where more than a thousand died and five hundred were taken.

Nine years later Charles IX founded a town by the old Korsholm trading place; chartered in 1611 as Vasa, named for his royal house, it grew rich on tar and shipbuilding over the seventeenth century. War came back from the east: on 19 February 1714 a Swedish army made up mostly of Finns was destroyed by the Russians at Napue near Isokyrö, opening the seven-year occupation Finns call the Great Wrath, which lasted until 1721. In the Finnish War of 1808-1809 Vasa suffered more than any other Finnish town, stormed and plundered after a Swedish landing was beaten off on 25 June, and on 14 September the Russians won the decisive battle at Oravais, a day's march to the north. The Peace of Fredrikshamn in 1809 left Österbotten in the Russian Grand Duchy of Finland.
zh:
东博滕位于波的尼亚湾畔，是历史上波赫扬马南部的沿海平原，礁岸背后是平坦的农田。13世纪起瑞典移民定居海岸，1370年代王室在航道旁修建科什霍尔姆城堡，整个波赫扬马由一名城堡长官统辖，在此征收以毛皮缴纳的贡赋；从萨沃西来的芬兰移民则烧垦内陆林地。1444年，这里是瑞典治下地广人稀的边陲，皮货经图尔库和斯德哥尔摩南运。

1596年至1597年的农民起义「棍棒战争」就从这里爆发。与俄国打了二十五年仗后，农民承受重税，最招人恨的是「城堡营」：1595年议和之后，克拉斯·弗莱明仍长年维持军队，农户得继续为士兵提供食宿军饷。1596年11月25日，农民进攻伊索屈勒教堂村，他们以棍棒、连枷和钉头锤对抗铁甲军，几度击败步兵。领袖亚科·伊尔卡被俘，1597年1月27日在伊尔马约基被处斩；2月24日，最后一支农民军在伊尔马约基的桑塔沃里山被骑兵冲垮，上千人战死，五百人被俘。

九年后，卡尔九世在科什霍尔姆旧日贸易点旁建城，1611年获特许状，以其王家族姓命名为瓦萨；17世纪里，瓦萨靠焦油贸易和造船致富。战火仍从东方而来：1714年2月19日，一支主要由芬兰人组成的瑞典军队在伊索屈勒附近的纳普埃被俄军歼灭，随后是芬兰人称为「大愤怒」的七年占领，直到1721年才结束。1808年至1809年芬兰战争中，瓦萨受灾超过芬兰其他任何城镇：6月25日瑞典登陆部队被击退，城市随即遭俄军洗劫；9月14日，俄军在以北一天路程的奥拉瓦伊斯赢得决定性会战。1809年《弗雷德里克港和约》签订，东博滕划入俄国治下的芬兰大公国。

en:
Trøndelag is the land of the trønder: eight coastal districts round the wide Trondheim Fjord. They shared the Frostating law, proclaimed at the assembly on Frosta, and their kings were hailed at the Øreting by the mouth of the Nidelva. Olaf Tryggvason founded Nidaros there in 997, and it served as the capital of Norway until 1217. In 1030 Olaf Haraldsson fell at Stiklestad, a day's ride north of the town, fighting his own people, with his fifteen-year-old half-brother Harald, later king of Norway, in his ranks. Nidaros Cathedral rose over the dead king's grave, and pilgrims from across the North walked the road to his shrine. From 1152 the Archbishop of Nidaros led a province that reached to Iceland and Greenland; some scholars believe the walrus-ivory Lewis chessmen were carved in the city. In 1444, under the Danish-dominated Kalmar Union, the archbishop remained one of Norway's great lords, the taxes of the northern lands reached him mostly as dried fish, and Trondheim below the cathedral was a small wooden trading town.

When the Reformation reached Norway the old church made its last stand at Steinvikholm, a fortress finished in 1534 on a fjord islet, where Archbishop Olav Engelbrektsson held out until Danish ships bombarded Munkholmen in 1537 and he fled abroad. Swedish columns crossed Jämtland to the city during the Nordic Seven Years War but could not take the islet fortress, which Christian IV later had demolished. Copper opened another life in the inland mountains: the Røros works began smelting in 1644 and grew into a mining town of dark log houses, which Swedish armies burned in 1678 and 1679. The whole province was ceded to Sweden at Roskilde in 1658 and recovered after a three-month siege of Trondheim, the Peace of Copenhagen confirming the return in 1660. Fire destroyed most of the city in 1681; General Cicignon rebuilt it with broad firebreak streets and raised the Kristiansten fortress above the rooftops. In 1718 General Armfeldt's ten thousand Swedes failed to starve Trondheim into surrender, and after Charles XII fell at Fredriksten more than three thousand of his men froze to death in the Tydal mountains. The Royal Norwegian Society of Sciences and Letters was founded in the city in 1760.
zh:
特伦德拉格是特伦德人的土地：特隆赫姆峡湾沿岸八个行政区共用一部《弗罗斯塔法》，在弗罗斯塔召开大会宣布法律，历代国王则在尼德河口的厄于雷庭接受拥立。997年，奥拉夫·特里格瓦松在此建起尼达罗斯，直到1217年它都是挪威的都城。1030年，奥拉夫二世在城北一日骑程的斯蒂克莱斯塔德同自己的臣民作战时战死，即斯蒂克莱斯塔德之战，他十五岁的异母弟哈拉尔，也就是后来的挪威国王哈拉尔三世，当时就在阵中。尼达罗斯大教堂在他的墓上建起，北欧各地的朝圣者沿路而来。1152年起，尼达罗斯大主教的教区远及冰岛和格陵兰；还有学者认为，海象牙雕成的刘易斯棋子就出自这座城市的工匠之手。1444年，在丹麦人主导的卡尔马联盟之下，大主教仍是挪威最有权势的领主之一，北方的税赋多以鱼干运抵他的府库，大教堂脚下的特隆赫姆则是一座木制商城。

宗教改革波及挪威时，旧教会在斯泰因维克霍尔姆做了最后抵抗：这座1534年建于峡湾小岛的要塞由大主教奥拉夫·恩格尔布雷克特松据守，1537年丹麦舰队炮轰蒙克霍尔门岛，他出逃海外。北方七年战争中，瑞典纵队经耶姆特兰兵临特隆赫姆，却拿不下岛上要塞，后来克里斯蒂安四世下令将其拆毁。铜矿为内陆山地带来另一种生计：勒罗斯1644年开炉炼铜，发展成黑色木屋组成的矿镇，1678和1679年两度被瑞典军队焚毁。整个地区在1658年依《罗斯基勒条约》割让给瑞典，特隆赫姆被围三个月后收复，1660年《哥本哈根条约》予以确认。1681年大火烧毁大半个城市，西希尼翁将军按宽阔防火街的格局重建，并在高处建起克里斯蒂安斯滕要塞。1718年，阿姆费尔特将军率一万瑞典军队围困特隆赫姆不克，卡尔十二世战死于腓特烈斯滕后，他部下三千余人在蒂达尔群山中冻死。1760年，挪威皇家科学与文学院在城中成立。

en:
Hålogaland is the old name for Norway's long Arctic coast, where fjords and island banks run from Helgeland past Salten and Steigen to Lofoten and Vesterålen. Norse farmers and chieftains at Trondenes and Bjarkøy lived beside Saami neighbours, and in the 1230s Håkon Håkonarson settled Bjarmar from the White Sea at Malangen. Fish gave the coast its wider importance. Vágar, by present-day Kabelvåg in Lofoten, was the first organised trading town north of Trondheim and flourished between about 1000 and 1400; King Øystein is said to have built a church and fishermen's hostel there early in the 1100s. Winter cod was dried as stockfish and shipped south, making it Norway's greatest export. The Black Death thinned the settlements, and the large fortified stone church at Trondenes was completed only around 1440. In 1444 Hålogaland was Catholic Norwegian country in the Kalmar Union, and its catch went to Bergen.

The Reformation of 1536-1537 moved the old church estates to the crown, but Lofoten cod still drew fleets each winter even though Vágar never recovered its medieval position. On St Lucy's night in 1657 lightning struck the stone church at Steigen and burned it to bare walls. The coast found its best-known writer in Petter Dass, born on Dønna around 1647 and parish priest at Alstahaug from 1689; his verse survey 'Nordland's Trumpet' described the fishermen, seas and parishes of Nordland, and after his death northern fishing boats carried black cloth in their sails as mourning for a century. From 1740 Pomor traders sailed from the White Sea each summer with cheap rye flour, iron and tar, bartering them for cod; in some harbors the ruble circulated as currency. The trade was opened further in 1789, giving the fishing villages a regular summer market beyond Bergen and Trondheim.
zh:
霍洛加兰是挪威绵长北极海岸的古名，峡湾和岛岸从海尔格兰经萨尔顿、斯泰根延伸到罗弗敦与韦斯特罗伦。以特隆内斯、比亚克伊为据点的诺斯农民和酋长与萨米邻居杂处；13世纪30年代，哈康·哈康松还把来自白海的比亚尔马人安置在马朗恩峡湾。鱼类使这条海岸在更广的贸易中占有一席之地。罗弗敦今卡贝尔沃格附近的瓦加尔是特隆赫姆以北最早的建制商镇，约1000至1400年间繁盛；据传12世纪初，国王厄斯泰因曾在那里修建教堂和渔民旅舍。冬季鳕鱼制成鳕鱼干南运，成为挪威最大宗的出口货。黑死病使各定居点人口大减，特隆内斯带防御设施的大石堂迟至1440年前后才完工。1444年，霍洛加兰是卡尔马联盟中天主教挪威的土地，渔获输往卑尔根。

1536至1537年宗教改革后，旧教产转归王室，但罗弗敦鳕鱼每年冬天仍招来船队，只是瓦加尔再未恢复中世纪的地位。1657年圣露西亚之夜，雷电击中斯泰根石堂，把教堂烧得只剩墙壁。这一带最出名的作家是彼得·达斯：他约1647年生于登纳岛，1689年起任阿尔斯特豪格教区牧师；韵文地志《诺尔兰的号角》描写诺尔兰的渔民、海域和教区。他死后，北方渔船在船帆上挂黑布致哀，这一习俗延续了一个世纪。1740年起，波莫尔商人每年夏天从白海驶来，用廉价黑麦粉、铁和焦油换取鳕鱼；在一些港口，卢布也可流通。1789年贸易进一步开放，渔村除卑尔根和特隆赫姆之外又有了固定的夏季市场。

en:
Opplandene, the 'uplands', are the inland valleys north of historic Viken, gathered around Lake Mjøsa, Norway's largest lake. Their common thing met at Eidsvoll in the Eidsivating law region, and their only medieval market town was Hamar on the lake's eastern shore. A bishopric was founded there in 1152 by the papal legate Nicholas Breakspear, later Pope Adrian IV, and its Christ Church cathedral was finished in the thirteenth century; a chapter of ten canons, a Dominican priory and the bishop's fortified manor of Hamarhus made Hamar one of Norway's five cathedral towns, known for its apple orchards. One of its bishops, Thorfinn, was driven into exile, died in Flanders in 1285 and was later canonised. The Black Death emptied the valleys in 1349. In 1444 this poor Catholic countryside belonged to the kingdom of Norway inside the Kalmar Union, and farmers floated timber and tar down the Glomma to the coast.

The Reformation put an end to the old cathedral town. In 1537, as Denmark imposed Lutheranism, Truid Ulfstand seized Hamar's last Catholic bishop, Mogens Lauritssøn, in his manor and took him to Antvorskov in Denmark, where he died in 1542; most of what is known of medieval Hamar comes from the Hamar Chronicle written around 1550. Swedish troops sacked the town in 1567 during the Northern Seven Years' War, wrecking the cathedral and Hamarhus, and in 1587 the merchants of Christiania had Hamar's market closed, after which the town disappeared into the Storhamar farm. In the east the old Vinger road crossed into Sweden, and from 1682 the star-shaped Kongsvinger Fortress above the Glomma guarded that crossing. A Swedish column was beaten at Trangen on 25 April 1808, and on 5 August 1814 the bloodiest fight of the Swedish-Norwegian war was waged on the Eidskog road south of the fortress.
zh:
奥普兰（Opplandene，意为「高地」）是古维肯以北的内陆谷地，环聚在挪威最大湖米约萨湖周围，属埃兹沃尔庭法区，全区共同庭会在埃兹沃尔召开。这里唯一的中世纪集镇是湖东岸的哈马尔：1152年，教皇特使尼古拉·布雷克斯皮尔（日后的教宗亚德四世）设立主教区，基督教堂大教堂于13世纪完工；由十位司铎组成的座堂参事会、多明我会修道院和设防的哈马尔胡斯主教庄园，使哈马尔位列挪威五座主教城镇，当地的苹果园也颇有名气。主教索尔芬遭放逐，1285年死于佛兰德斯，后来被封圣。1349年黑死病使谷地人口一空。1444年，这片贫瘠的天主教乡野属于卡尔马联盟中的挪威王国，农户把木材和柏油沿格罗马河漂运到海岸。

宗教改革终结了这座古老的主教城镇。1537年丹麦推行路德宗时，特鲁德·乌尔夫斯坦德在庄园里逮捕哈马尔末任天主教主教莫根斯·劳里茨松，押往丹麦的安特沃斯考，后者于1542年死于那里；后人对中世纪哈马尔的了解，多来自约1550年写成的《哈马尔编年史》。北方七年战争期间，瑞典军队1567年洗劫城镇，摧毁大教堂和哈马尔胡斯；1587年克里斯蒂安尼亚的商人促成关闭哈马尔集市，城镇就此消失，土地并入斯托尔哈马尔农庄。东面的温厄古道是进出瑞典的孔道，1682年起由格罗马河畔星形的孔斯温厄尔要塞扼守。1808年4月25日，一支瑞典纵队在特朗恩被击败；1814年8月5日，瑞挪战争中最惨烈的一战在要塞以南的埃兹库格道上展开。

en:
Bergenhus is the fortress and old royal quarter at the mouth of Bergen's harbour, and Bergen itself is the reason for both: a town tucked between steep mountains at the head of a long fjord, traditionally founded by King Olav Kyrre in 1070 and named Bjørgvin, 'the green meadow among the mountains'. Through the thirteenth century Norway's kings kept court on the Holmen promontory, where Christ Church hosted their coronations and weddings and held the shrine of St Sunniva; at least six kings were buried there. Håkon's Hall, the royal stone hall, went up around 1260, and the fortress walls begun in the 1240s closed the seaward side. From the 1360s German merchants ran one of the four Hanseatic kontore at Bryggen, exchanging grain and cloth for the dried cod fishermen brought south each summer from the Arctic coast; the crown had granted Bergen a monopoly of all northern Norwegian trade. The Victual Brothers sacked the town in 1429 and burned the royal castle, yet in 1444 Bergen was still the largest city in the Nordic world, where Low German was the language of the quays.

The kontor kept its hard edge: in 1455 German merchants stormed Munkeliv Abbey and killed the royal commander and the bishop. The Reformation closed the town's monasteries, and a royal governor soon curbed the kontor's privileges. In 1665 an English squadron sailed into the harbour to seize a Dutch treasure fleet, and the Bergenhus guns opened fire in the Battle of Vågen. Fires were a standing danger in the wooden town: the blaze of 1702 destroyed some ninety per cent of its houses, after three plague outbreaks between 1618 and 1637 had each killed around 3,000 people. Ludvig Holberg was born in the rebuilt city in 1684; he wrote his comedies in Copenhagen and became the founder of modern Danish and Norwegian literature. A Norwegian kontor replaced the Hanseatic one in 1754, the northern-trade monopoly ended in 1789, and in 1765 thousands of farmers marched in from the countryside in the Strile War tax revolt.
zh:
卑尔根胡斯既是扼守卑尔根港口的要塞，也是旧日的王家园地，两者都因卑尔根而存在。这座城深藏在漫长峡湾的尽头、群山之间，相传1070年由挪威国王奥拉夫三世所建，得名比约尔格温，意为「群山间的绿色草地」。整个13世纪，挪威列王都驻跸在霍尔门角：基督教堂在此举行国王的加冕礼和婚礼，供奉着圣孙尼瓦的圣龛，至少有六位国王安葬于此；王室石厅霍肯大厅约在1260年建成，1240年代起修筑的要塞围墙封住了朝海一侧。自1360年代起，德意志商人在布吕根经营汉萨同盟四大商站之一，用粮食和布匹换取渔民每年夏天从北极海岸南运的鳕鱼干；王室早已把挪威北方贸易的独占权授予卑尔根。粮食兄弟会海盗1429年洗劫城市、焚毁王城，但1444年的卑尔根仍是北欧最大的城市，码头上通用的是低地德语。

商站依旧凶悍：1455年，德意志商人攻入蒙克利夫修道院，杀死王室长官和主教。宗教改革中城中修道院被关闭，王室长官随后削夺了商站的特权。1665年，一支英国分舰队驶入港口企图截夺荷兰宝船队，卑尔根胡斯的守军开炮迎击，是为瓦根海战。对这座木城来说火灾始终是大患：1702年的大火烧毁约九成房屋，而1618年至1637年的三次瘟疫，每次都夺去约三千人的生命。1684年，路维·郝尔拜出生在重建后的卑尔根，他后来在哥本哈根写下一系列喜剧，被视为丹麦和挪威近代文学的奠基人。1754年，挪威人的商站取代了汉萨商站，古老的北方贸易独占权也在1789年终结；1765年，数千农民从四乡进城抗税，史称斯特里尔战争。

en:
Stavanger huddles round the Vågen inlet on the Jæren coast, the open south-west corner of Norway facing the North Sea. Just beyond the town lies Hafrsfjord, where Harald Fairhair won the naval battle of 872 that made him king of a united Norway. Stavanger itself grew up as a church town. Bishop Reinald, probably an Englishman from Winchester, began the Romanesque cathedral around 1100, the new bishopric of St Svithun was created in the 1120s, and after a fire in the later 1200s the choir was rebuilt in high Gothic. The town received full market-town privileges in 1425. In 1444 it was a small Catholic bishop's seat under the Norwegian crown within the Kalmar Union, its people living off the harbour and the fisheries off Jæren.

The Reformation hit the church town hard: the cathedral estates were seized in 1537, the church plundered and the shrine of St Svithun lost. From the early 1600s immigrant north German painters and craftsmen redecorated its churches in the 'Stavanger Renaissance', but fire destroyed two thirds of the town in 1633 and some 150 of its 350 houses in 1684; two years earlier the king had moved the bishop's seat to Christianssand. Rebuilt in white-painted timber, the town lived modestly until the herring fishery swelled in the early 1800s and ships and salters returned to its quays. In 1814 Stavanger passed with Norway to Sweden.
zh:
斯塔万格依着耶伦海岸的沃根湾而建，地处挪威朝向北海的开阔西南角。城郊不远便是哈夫斯峡湾，金发王哈拉尔872年在峡湾中的水战获胜，就此成为统一挪威的国王。这座城本身是作为教堂之城发展起来的：主教雷纳尔德很可能是来自温切斯特的英格兰人，约1100年动工修建罗曼式大教堂，供奉圣斯威辛的新教区于1120年代设立，13世纪后期的一场大火后，歌坛按高哥特风格重建。1425年，城镇获得完整的商业市镇特权。1444年的斯塔万格是卡尔马联盟挪威王冠治下一座小小的天主教主教城，居民靠港口和耶伦沿海的渔业为生。

宗教改革沉重打击了这座教堂之城：1537年大教堂教产被没收，教堂遭洗劫，圣斯威辛圣龛不知所终。17世纪初，迁居而来的北德画家和工匠以「斯塔万格文艺复兴」风格重新装饰各教堂；但1633年大火烧毁三分之二城区，1684年又有350栋房屋中的约150栋化为灰烬，此前两年国王已把主教座迁往克里斯蒂安桑。重建后的城镇一片白色木屋，日子过得平淡，直到19世纪初鲱鱼渔业勃兴，船只和腌鱼商重新挤满码头。1814年，斯塔万格随挪威并入瑞典。

en:
Gotland is the largest island in the Baltic, the country of the Gutes, who spoke their own Gutnish and ordered their affairs through twenty local things under one island assembly; their law, the Gutalagen, was written down around 1220. Visby, ringed by a wall 3.4 kilometres long that still encloses the old town, was the leading Hanseatic mart of the Baltic: Gotlandic merchants met German traders by the quays, Arab silver from the Russian river roads accumulated in island hoards, and the maritime Laws of Wisbuy were followed across the sea. The Black Death around 1350 and Valdemar Atterdag's invasion of 1361 ended it. At Korsbetningen outside the wall the Danish king's mercenaries cut down the peasant levy by the thousand; tradition says the townsmen watched from behind the wall and afterwards bought fresh privileges from Valdemar, and legend adds that three vats of ransom silver were lost in the sea off the Karlso islands. The Victual Brothers later made the island a pirate nest, the Teutonic Order took it in 1398 and sold it to the Kalmar Union in 1408. Eric of Pomerania raised Visborg castle beside the town, and after losing his union thrones withdrew there with a fleet in 1437 and lived by piracy. In 1444 Gotland is the old king's outlaw stronghold, its trade dead and its countryside given over to sheep runs and wool.

In 1446 Christopher of Bavaria brought forty ships against Visborg and settled for an armistice. A Swedish army took Visby town two years later but not the castle, and in 1449 Eric handed Visborg to Christian I of Denmark in exchange for three castles and a pension; he died at Rügenwalde in Pomerania ten years later. Danish fiefholders then kept the island for two centuries. In 1525, while Sören Norrby held Visborg for the deposed Christian II, Lübeck stormed the town and the defenders fired it; three churches burned, and the Reformation closed most of the rest, leaving a ring of church ruins inside the wall. Gotland passed to Sweden at Brömsebro in 1645 and the Gutalagen lapsed. Admiral Niels Juel occupied the island without a fight in 1676, and the Danes blew Visborg up when they left after the Peace of Fontainebleau in 1679. In 1808, during the Finnish War, 1,800 Russians landed and took Visby unopposed on 22 April; a Swedish squadron retook the island within weeks, and the last Russians sailed away on 18 May.
zh:
哥得兰是波罗的海第一大岛，岛上的哥得兰人说自己的古特兰语，二十个地方庭之上设全岛大会，约1220年写定的《哥得兰法》处理全岛事务。维斯比被一道3.4公里长的城墙环抱，城墙大体完好地围住老城；它曾是汉萨同盟在波罗的海的头号商埠，哥得兰商人在码头与德意志客商交易，沿罗斯河道商路而来的阿拉伯银钱积存在岛上的窖藏中，《维斯比海法》通行于波罗的海各地。约1350年的黑死病和瓦尔德马四世1361年的入侵终结了这一切：在城外的科斯贝特宁（Korsbetningen），丹麦国王的雇佣兵屠戮农民军逾千，相传市民据守城墙作壁上观，事后又用金钱从瓦尔德马手中换得新的特权；另有传说称，三桶赎金银子在卡尔瑟群岛外海沉入海底。粮食兄弟会后来把全岛变成海盗巢穴，条顿骑士团1398年取岛，1408年又把它卖给卡尔马联盟。波美拉尼亚的埃里克在城边修建维斯堡，被废去联盟王位后在1437年率舰队退据于此，以海盗为业。1444年的哥得兰是这位老王的法外据点，商路断绝，乡野尽是牧羊场，出产羊毛。

1446年，巴伐利亚的克里斯托弗率四十艘战船来攻维斯堡，只换来一纸停战。两年后瑞典军队拿下维斯比城，却没能拿下城堡；1449年，埃里克把维斯堡交给丹麦国王克里斯蒂安一世，换取三座城堡和一份年金，十年后死在波美拉尼亚的鲁根瓦尔德。此后两百年由丹麦封臣统治此岛。1525年，瑟伦·诺比为被废的克里斯蒂安二世据守城堡期间，吕贝克军队攻破维斯比，守军纵火焚城，三座教堂烧毁，宗教改革中其余教堂大多关闭，城墙之内留下一圈教堂废墟。1645年《布勒姆瑟布鲁和约》把哥得兰划归瑞典，《哥得兰法》同时停用。1676年，海军上将尼尔斯·尤尔兵不血刃占领全岛，1679年丹军依《枫丹白露和约》撤离时炸毁维斯堡。1808年芬兰战争期间，1800名俄军于4月22日登陆，未遇抵抗便占领维斯比，瑞典舰队几周内收复海岛，最后一批俄军5月18日离去。

en:
Halland is the narrow farming coast between the wooded Halland Ridge and the Kattegat. Its fields lie along the road and sea lane connecting Scania with the Swedish lands to the north, so Danish kings guarded it from Halmstad at the mouth of the Nissan and from Varberg on its rocky headland. Halmstad had held a town charter since 1307, its landsting under Scanian Law met at Getinge, and the Kalmar Union treaty named the town as the place where a union king should be chosen. In 1444 Halland belonged to the Danish crown, a Catholic cattle-raising border country whose castles were kept ready for Swedish raids.

Varberg fortress was built in 1287-1300 by Count Jacob Nielsen after Eric VI of Denmark declared him an outlaw, with Norwegian money and masons supporting the work; the fortress and half of Halland passed to Norway in 1305. It later came to Ingeborg Håkansdotter and Duke Erik Magnusson, who held their Norwegian, Swedish and Danish lands from there, and their son Magnus Eriksson also stayed at the castle. The border wars kept the province under arms: Daniel Rantzau's Danes defeated the Swedes at Axtorna on 20 October 1565, and Christian IV later rebuilt Halmstad's ramparts into a crescent-shaped work using the Nissan as a moat. In March 1619 he met Gustav II Adolf at Halmstad Castle to mark payment of the Älvsborg ransom; fire gutted the town five months later. Brömsebro gave Halland to Sweden for thirty years in 1645, Roskilde made the cession permanent in 1658, and Charles XI beat the returning Danes at Fyllebro on 17 August 1676.
zh:
哈兰是哈兰山脊林地与卡特加特海峡之间的狭长农牧海岸，田野沿着连接斯科讷与北方瑞典土地的陆路和海路展开。丹麦王室因此在尼桑河口的哈尔姆斯塔德和海岬上的瓦尔贝里设防。哈尔姆斯塔德1307年已获城市特许状，行斯科讷法的地区庭在耶廷厄召开，卡尔马联盟盟约还指定在此选出联盟国王。1444年，哈兰属丹麦王室，是信奉天主教、饲养牲畜的边境地区，城堡随时防备瑞典人来袭。

1287至1300年，被丹麦国王埃里克六世宣布为不法之徒的雅各布·尼尔森伯爵在挪威资金和工匠支持下修筑瓦尔贝里要塞；1305年，要塞连同半个哈兰归入挪威。它后来属于英格堡·哈康斯多塔和埃里克·马格努松公爵，二人从这里统辖散布在挪威、瑞典和丹麦的领地，他们的儿子马格努斯·埃里克松也曾驻留堡中。边境战争使这里长期武装对峙：1565年10月20日，丹尼尔·兰措率领丹麦军在阿克斯托纳击败瑞典军；克里斯蒂安四世后来把哈尔姆斯塔德城墙改造成半月形工事，引尼桑河水作护城壕。1619年3月，他在哈尔姆斯塔德城堡与古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫会面，确认艾尔夫斯堡赎金付清，五个月后城中大火焚毁大片城区。1645年布勒姆瑟布鲁和约把哈兰割让瑞典三十年，1658年罗斯基勒和约确认永久割让，1676年8月17日卡尔十一世又在菲勒布鲁击败卷土重来的丹麦军。

en:
Åbo, the Finnish Turku, stands at the mouth of the Aura River on the south-west coast of Finland Proper, where the traffic of the archipelago meets the Baltic. The Finnish bishopric moved upriver to Koroinen in 1229, the cathedral on Unikankare hill was consecrated in 1300, and the castle founded around 1280 became the strongpoint through which Sweden governed its eastern lands; in the 1390s the Victual Brothers may even have used that castle as a pirate base. German merchants from the Baltic towns lived in the wooden town alongside Finnish and Swedish settlers and shipped its fish and furs to Danzig and Lübeck. In 1444 Åbo held perhaps 2,000 to 3,000 people: Sweden's largest town in Finland, the seat of the only Finnish bishopric and a Catholic port linked by castle, cathedral and shipping to Stockholm.

Danish armies sacked Åbo twice in the Kalmar wars, in 1509 and 1522, before Gustav Vasa recovered Finland in 1523. The Reformation came with Mikael Agricola, a local clergyman made bishop of Åbo in 1554, who printed the first Finnish ABC book and translated the Gospels and apostolic letters into Finnish; his books fixed the spelling on which written Finnish still rests, and he died in 1557 on his way back from peace talks with Moscow. Gustav Vasa's son John kept a Renaissance court in the castle as Duke of Finland with his Polish wife Catherine Jagellon, until the army of his brother Eric XIV took Åbo in 1563 and carried the couple off to prison in Sweden. After Duke Charles defeated King Sigismund, the Åbo Bloodbath of 1599 executed the nobles who had fought against him. The Royal Academy, opened in 1640, was Finland's first university. Russian troops held the town through the Great Wrath until the Peace of Nystad in 1721, and again in 1742 to 1743, when the Peace of Åbo ended the occupation. Conquered once more in 1808, Åbo became the first capital of the autonomous Grand Duchy of Finland the next year, until Alexander I moved the court to Helsinki in 1812.
zh:
奥布（芬兰语称图尔库）位于芬兰本部西南海岸、奥拉河河口，群岛区的往来航路在此接入波罗的海。1229年，芬兰主教座迁至河上游的科罗伊宁，乌尼坎卡雷山丘上的主教座堂于1300年祝圣，约1280年始建的奥布城堡则成为瑞典治理东部疆土的支点；1390年代，维塔利兄弟会的海盗据说还曾以这座城堡为巢穴。波罗的海诸城的德意志商人与芬兰人、瑞典人共居这座木构城镇，把鱼和毛皮运往但泽和吕贝克。1444年的奥布约有二三千人，是瑞典治下芬兰最大的城镇、芬兰唯一主教区的驻地，也是凭城堡、座堂和航线与斯德哥尔摩相连的天主教港口。

卡尔马联盟战争期间，丹麦军队在1509年和1522年两度洗劫奥布，1523年古斯塔夫·瓦萨收复芬兰。宗教改革随米卡埃尔·阿格里科拉而来：这位本地教士1554年出任奥布主教，印出芬兰语第一本识字课本，又把《新约》译成芬兰语，他的著作奠定了芬兰语书写规范的基础；1557年，他在与莫斯科方面议和归来途中病逝。古斯塔夫·瓦萨之子约翰受封芬兰公爵，与波兰妻子卡塔日娜·雅盖隆卡在城堡中维持文艺复兴式宫廷，1563年其兄埃里克十四世的军队攻占奥布，把二人押回瑞典囚禁。卡尔公爵击败西吉斯蒙德国王后，1599年的奥布血案处决了与他为敌的贵族。1640年开办的奥布皇家学院是芬兰第一所大学。大愤怒时期俄军占领全城，直到1721年《尼斯塔德和约》；1742年至1743年俄军再度占领，以《奥布和约》结束。1808年奥布又被攻占，次年成为自治芬兰大公国的第一个首都，1812年亚历山大一世把宫廷迁往赫尔辛基。

en:
Nyland, in Finnish Uusimaa, the 'new land', is the forested Gulf of Finland coast between Finland Proper and Viborg, broken into rivers and skerries. Tavastian and Finnish fishermen used its waters before Swedish settlers arrived in the crown-sponsored colonisation that followed the mid-thirteenth-century crusade. By the 1370s the province was run from two castle fiefs: Raseborg in the west, raised on an islet to watch the sea road to Reval, and Borgå, Finnish Porvoo, in the east, whose burghers held town rights by about 1380 and traded mostly across the gulf with that Hanseatic city. In 1444 Catholic Sweden ruled a thinly peopled archipelago coast whose timber, pitch, fish and harbours served Stockholm and the Baltic shipping lanes.

Danish raiders burned Borgå early in the sixteenth century. In 1550 Gustav Vasa founded Helsingfors, later Helsinki, ordering merchants from Borgå and Raseborg to people a town meant to rival Reval. Raseborg castle was abandoned only three years later, its harbour shallowing as the land rose out of the sea, and Helsingfors was moved to its peninsular site in 1640. Borgå recovered its town rights in 1602 and channelled Tavastian furs out to the Baltic. War then filled the century: plague in 1710, Russian capture in 1713, the Peace of Nystad in 1721, a second Russian occupation in 1742 to 1743 that ended with the Peace of Åbo. From 1748 Augustin Ehrensvärd built the Swedish crown's great sea fortress of Sveaborg on the islands off Helsingfors on Vauban's principles; called the Gibraltar of the North, it surrendered to the Russians in May 1808 after a two-month siege and opened the coast to the conquest of Finland. At Borgå in 1809 the Finnish estates swore fealty to Alexander I, who confirmed Finland as an autonomous grand duchy; in 1812 he made Helsingfors its capital.
zh:
尼兰（芬兰语称乌西马，意为「新地」）是芬兰本部与维堡之间、濒临芬兰湾的森林海岸，河流与岛礁交错。13世纪中期十字军之后瑞典王室组织移民登岸，在此之前，海梅人和芬兰渔民已在这片水域谋生。到14世纪70年代，全省由两座城堡郡管辖：西边的拉塞博里建于小岛之上，监视通往雷瓦尔的海路；东边的博尔戈（芬兰语称波尔沃）约在1380年已享有城市权，商人主要跨海同这座汉萨城市贸易。1444年，信奉天主教的瑞典统治着人烟稀少的群岛海岸，木材、沥青、渔获和港口维系着斯德哥尔摩与波罗的海航线。

16世纪初，丹麦袭掠者焚毁博尔戈。1550年，古斯塔夫·瓦萨建立赫尔辛福斯，即后来的赫尔辛基，命令博尔戈和拉塞博里的商人迁入，以同雷瓦尔抗衡。仅仅三年后拉塞博里城堡即遭废弃：陆地抬升使港口逐渐淤浅，而赫尔辛福斯在1640年迁至半岛上的现址。博尔戈于1602年重新获得城市权，海梅的毛皮经此运往波罗的海。随后百年战火不断：1710年瘟疫，1713年俄军攻占，1721年《尼斯塔德和约》，1742年至1743年再度被占并以《奥布和约》收场。1748年起，奥古斯丁·厄伦斯瓦德奉瑞典王室之命，按沃邦的原则在赫尔辛福斯外海的群岛上修建斯韦阿堡大海军要塞；这座号称「北方直布罗陀」的要塞在1808年5月被俄军围攻两个月后投降，为俄军征服芬兰打开了海岸。1809年，芬兰各等级在博尔戈向亚历山大一世宣誓效忠，芬兰获确认为自治大公国；1812年，他把赫尔辛福斯定为首都。

en:
Tavastland, Finnish Häme, is the inland lake country of southern Finland, centred on Lake Vanajavesi and reaching north toward Päijänne. Tavastian farmers worked the southern waterways, while hunting parties ranged into the northern wilderness for the furs that were the province's most valuable export. A Swedish thrust toward the Neva was broken by Prince Alexander Yaroslavich in 1240, earning him the name Nevsky, and the Second Swedish Crusade bound Häme to the Swedish crown and the Catholic Church in 1249. Häme Castle rose on Vanajavesi on the orders of Birger Jarl and is first listed in a royal document in 1308; with Åbo and Viborg it was one of the three castle fiefs through which Sweden governed Finland. Novgorod raiders plundered Häme in 1311, and after the 1323 Treaty of Nöteborg drew the frontier far to the east, the castle administered roads, courts and tax districts instead of watching a border. In 1444 a small garrison and a service village guarded a Finnish-speaking Catholic backcountry of farms, lakes and hunting grounds.

In the Kalmar wars the castle passed to the Danish admiral Søren Norby in 1522 and returned to Sweden without fighting in 1523. Gustav Vasa declared uncleared wilderness crown land in 1542, opening Häme's northern hunting grounds to Savonian slash-and-burn settlers. Round gun towers were added in 1559, and a powder explosion wrecked part of the castle in 1599. In 1639 Count Per Brahe chartered the village beneath the walls as Tavastehus, Finland's first inland town; its summer and winter markets drew traders up the old Ox Road from Åbo. Russian garrisons held the castle in 1713-1721 and again during the war of 1741-1743. Gustav III moved Tavastehus a kilometre south in 1777, visited it four times and built the town a round church modelled on the Pantheon in Rome. The fortress surrendered to Russian troops in March 1808. When the Russian Grand Duchy of Finland was formed the next year, Georg Magnus Sprengtporten proposed Tavastehus as its capital; Alexander I weighed the idea and chose Helsinki instead, and the old castle became a prison.
zh:
塔瓦斯特兰（芬兰语称海梅）是芬兰南部的湖区内陆，以瓦纳亚韦西湖为中心，向北一直伸到派延奈湖。海梅农民经营南部水道，狩猎队深入北部荒野收取毛皮，那是本省最贵重的出口货。1240年，瑞典人向涅瓦河的扩张被亚历山大·雅罗斯拉维奇公爵击退，公爵由此得名涅夫斯基；1249年第二次瑞典十字军把海梅纳入瑞典王室和天主教会治下。海梅城堡奉比里耶·亚尔之命矗立在瓦纳亚韦西湖畔，1308年首见于王室文书，它与奥布、维堡并称瑞典统辖芬兰的三大城堡郡。1311年诺夫哥罗德人洗劫海梅；1323年《内特堡和约》把边界划到遥远的东方后，城堡不再盯防边境，转而管理道路、法庭和税区。1444年，一支小驻军和服役者村落守着这片说芬兰语、信天主教的内陆，四围尽是农田、湖泊和猎场。

卡尔马战争期间，城堡1522年落入丹麦海军上将瑟伦·诺比手中，1523年未战而归还瑞典。古斯塔夫·瓦萨1542年宣布未开垦荒野归王室所有，海梅北部猎场从此向萨沃的火耕移民敞开。1559年城堡加修圆形炮塔，1599年一次火药爆炸又炸毁了部分建筑。1639年，佩尔·布拉赫伯爵将城堡脚下的聚落特许设为塔瓦斯滕胡斯，这是芬兰第一座内陆城市，夏冬两季的市集吸引商人沿古老的牛路从奥布而来。俄军在1713年至1721年、又在1741年至1743年的战争中两度占据城堡。古斯塔夫三世1777年把塔瓦斯滕胡斯城南迁一公里，他曾四次到访，还为该城修了一座仿照罗马万神庙的圆形教堂。1808年3月，要塞向俄军投降。次年俄罗斯人的芬兰大公国成立，格奥尔格·马格努斯·斯普伦特波滕提议以塔瓦斯滕胡斯为都，亚历山大一世斟酌后选了赫尔辛基；这座老城堡则被改成监狱。

en:
Viborg guards the head of a narrow bay on the Karelian Isthmus, close to the old Vuoksi trading route. Sweden placed its eastern border there in 1293, when Marshal Torkel Knutsson built a castle on the remains of a burned Karelian fort. The Treaty of Noteborg confirmed the place to Sweden in 1323, and Eric of Pomerania granted town privileges in 1403. Reval and Lubeck merchants handled Karelian furs, while Dominican and Franciscan houses served the Karelian and Swedish townspeople. Castle commanders kept crown revenues and defended the border, so the fief often operated like a margraviate. In 1444 it belonged to Karl Knutsson, who took the Swedish crown four years later.

Knut Posse gave the castle its most famous siege story. In November 1495 his garrison beat off a Muscovite storm, and a great explosion during the attack became known as the 'Viborg Bang'. The Reformation made Viborg Lutheran under Gustav Vasa, who brought in German merchants and made tar a major export beside the older fur trade. Russian forces attacked in 1555, 1556 and 1706, and Peter the Great's army took the town in June 1710 after a three-month siege; the Treaty of Nystad confirmed it to Russia in 1721. Viborg became the seat of the Vyborg Governorate in 1744, and its bay saw one of the largest naval actions of the Russo-Swedish wars in 1790, when Gustav III's fleet broke through a Russian blockade. In 1812 Alexander I attached the town and district to the new Grand Duchy of Finland.
zh:
维堡扼守卡累利阿地峡上的窄湾湾顶，靠近武奥克萨老商路。1293年，瑞典元帅托克尔·克努特松在一座被焚毁的卡累利阿堡寨旧址修建城堡，把瑞典东界推到这里。1323年《内特堡和约》确认其归属瑞典，1403年波美拉尼亚的埃里克颁赐城市特许状。雷瓦尔和吕贝克商人经营卡累利阿毛皮，多明我会与方济各会修院则为卡累利阿和瑞典市民服务。城堡长官保留王室收入并防守边境，这块封地常像边侯领地。1444年它属于卡尔·克努特松，四年后此人取得瑞典王位。

克努特·波塞为城堡留下最有名的围城故事。1495年11月，他的守军击退莫斯科军队强攻，战事中的大爆炸后来被称为「维堡巨响」。宗教改革后，维堡在古斯塔夫·瓦萨治下改宗路德宗；他招来德意志商人，在旧有毛皮贸易之外推动焦油出口。俄军1555年、1556年和1706年先后来攻，彼得大帝的军队又在1710年6月经三个月围城拿下此城，1721年《尼斯塔德和约》确认其归属俄国。1744年维堡成为维堡省省会；1790年维堡湾爆发俄瑞战争中规模最大的海战之一，古斯塔夫三世的舰队冲过俄军封锁。1812年，亚历山大一世将城市和辖区并入新的芬兰大公国。

en:
Savolax, Finnish Savo, is a labyrinth of lakes and forests between Tavastia and Karelia. Savonian families lived by fishing, hunting and slash-and-burn farming, burning fresh clearings in the woods and carrying furs along the water routes. Swedish rule reached the country in the late 13th century, and after the 1323 Treaty of Nöteborg the eastern frontier ran through these very straits and lakes; medieval Savonians defended their hunting grounds from Tavastian rivals and Novgorod's border claims as well as from raiders out of the east. Juva parish was set up in 1442. In 1444 Catholic Sweden held a poor, thinly peopled severe-winter borderland, rich chiefly in furs, with no stone fortress yet on the Kyrönsalmi strait.

That changed in 1475, when Erik Axelsson Tott founded Sankt Olofsborg on a Kyrönsalmi island as Ivan III's conquest of Novgorod unfolded, siting it to lay claim to the Russian side of the old border. Master builders came from Reval, and its thick round towers were the first in Sweden built to withstand cannon fire; the keep was finished in 1485 and the outer walls in 1495.
