比尔森位于姆热河、拉德布扎河、乌赫拉瓦河与乌斯拉瓦河汇合处，四水合为贝龙卡河，城又正卡在布拉格通往巴伐利亚的大道上。1295年瓦茨拉夫二世规划新比尔森，这座规整的王家城市很快成为波希米亚仅次于布拉格和库特纳霍拉的第三大城，1307年已有酿酒业。胡斯战争确定了它的立场：1419年末，扬·杰式卡率领小队人马在城西北约17公里的内克米日，用车阵击败一支天主教地方同盟军队，这是胡斯战争中最早有记载的车阵战例。1420年，激进教士随杰式卡离开，比尔森转而站在天主教一方；杰式卡和后来的大普罗科普先后围城，大普罗科普两次攻城都被击退。1444年，这座王家城市扼守波希米亚西路，靠边境转运贸易为生。

战后，布拉格主教座堂教士团于1467年移驻比尔森；1476年，本地印刷所印出帕尔杜比采的阿尔诺什特《教规集》，是波希米亚已知最早的印刷本。1599年9月至1600年6月，鲁道夫二世为躲避布拉格瘟疫把宫廷迁到这里。三十年战争开始后，曼斯费尔德率领波希米亚等级军队在1618年攻占比尔森，皇帝派军队1621年收复。阿尔布雷希特·冯·华伦斯坦1633年在此设立冬季大本营，几个月后在海布遇刺。瑞典人1637年和1648年两度围攻不克；扬·范德克龙则在1645至1649年间把城墙改建成棱堡。1695年，霍德农民起义领袖扬·斯拉德基·科齐纳在主广场被处决。

en:
Suceava stands on the river of the same name, where the Moldavian highlands slope down to the Siret, on the roads north to Lviv and west through the Carpathians into Hungary. Petru Mușat moved his capital here from Siret and built the Seat Fortress, first named in a charter of 1388. The town ran on Magdeburg law; Transylvanian Saxon potters and merchants from Bistrița handled its trade, and Prince Alexandru cel Bun strengthened the citadel. In 1444 Suceava was the fortified princely seat of Orthodox Moldavia, stone strongholds ringing the principality's frontiers.

The town belongs to Stephen the Great, who girdled the old citadel with a second, artillery-proof wall. Mehmed II's army battered it in 1476, but the garrison held out and the Ottomans marched away; a later Ottoman assault and the siege laid by the Polish king John Albert in 1497 failed as well. Stephen founded Putna, his burial church, and Voroneț, later covered in the blue frescoes of the Last Judgment that made the Moldavian painted monasteries famous. In 1538 disaffected boyars opened the gates to Suleiman while Petru Rareș fled. A generation later, in 1564, Alexandru Lăpușneanu moved the court to Iași at Ottoman bidding and had the strongholds slighted; in 1675 Prince Dumitrașcu Cantacuzino burned the Seat Fortress on the sultan's order. Habsburg troops occupied the town in 1774, and the convention of the following year ceded it with the rest of Bukovina to Austria, where it lived on as a free market town on the Moldavian border.
zh:
苏恰瓦位于同名河畔，摩尔达维亚高地在此向锡雷特河缓降，北通利沃夫、西越喀尔巴阡山进入匈牙利的道路都经过这里。彼得·穆沙特把都城从锡雷特迁来，修建座堂堡，1388年的一份诏书首次提到它。城市按马格德堡法治理，来自比斯特里察的特兰西瓦尼亚撒克逊陶工和商人经营贸易，善人亚历山德鲁又加固了城防。1444年的苏恰瓦是东正教摩尔达维亚设防的公国都座，一座座石砌要塞环守着公国边境。

这座城属于斯特凡大公：他给旧堡加筑一道能抵御火炮的新城墙。1476年穆罕默德二世的军队猛攻不克，守军坚持到奥斯曼人拔营撤走；此后又一次奥斯曼进攻、以及1497年波兰国王扬·阿尔布雷赫特的围攻，也都无功而返。斯特凡修建了自己安葬于此的普特纳修道院和沃罗内茨修道院，后者外墙的蓝色《最后的审判》壁画让摩尔达维亚彩绘修道院群闻名于世。1538年，心怀不满的波雅尔趁彼得·拉雷什出逃，向苏莱曼一世开门献城。1564年，亚历山德鲁·勒普什内亚努奉奥斯曼之命把宫廷迁往雅西，下令拆毁各处要塞；1675年，大公杜米特拉什库·坎塔库济诺又奉苏丹之命焚毁座堂堡。1774年哈布斯堡军队占领苏恰瓦，次年的公约把它连同整个布科维纳割让给奥地利，此后它作为摩尔达维亚边境上的自由商镇延续下来。

en:
Podlasie is the wooded Bug and Narew country controlled by old strongholds at Drohiczyn, Mielnik, Bielsk and Tykocin. Drohiczyn stood over a Bug customs crossing. Daniel of Galicia was crowned king of Ruthenia there in 1253, and the district later passed between Mazovian, Ruthenian and Lithuanian rulers before Drohiczyn received an urban charter in 1429. In 1440 Bolesław IV of Warsaw occupied Podlasie with local noble support, but Lithuanian troops drove his garrisons out of Mielnik and Drohiczyn. In November 1444, two years before the settlement at Parczew, the region was still a disputed Masovian-Lithuanian march where Catholic and Orthodox communities shared ferries, forest pasture, livestock herds and river trade.

Drohiczyn received Magdeburg rights in 1498. Sigismund I formed Podlasie Voivodeship in 1513, Drohiczyn became its capital in 1520, and after the Union of Lublin in 1569 the region passed to the Polish Crown. By 1580 the town had about 320 houses and 2,000 inhabitants. Tykocin Castle, begun in 1433 for Jonas Goštautas, became Sigismund II Augustus's residence, treasury, library and main crown arsenal. Knyszyn was his favourite residence, and he died there in 1572, the last Jagiellon king.

The Deluge broke the province. Janusz Radziwiłł's army occupied Tykocin, and Radziwiłł died in the besieged castle on 31 December 1655; the castle fell to Tyszowce Confederation troops in January 1657. Drohiczyn was looted by Swedish and Crimean Tatar forces, then destroyed in May 1657 by George II Rákóczi's composite army, with the parish church and castle ruined; by 1660 only eighty of 380 houses remained. Stefan Czarniecki received the Tykocin estate after the war. In November 1705 Augustus the Strong met Peter the Great at the rebuilt castle and instituted the Order of the White Eagle. During the 1794 Kościuszko Uprising, Andrzej Karwowski raised the Podlasie Division at Drohiczyn. The Third Partition of 1795 split the old region along the Bug between Prussia and Austria.
zh:
波德拉谢是布格河与纳雷夫河流域的林木边陲，德罗希琴、梅利尼克、别尔斯克和蒂科钦的旧要塞控扼河谷。德罗希琴居高临下，守着布格河上的税关渡口。1253年，加利西亚的丹尼尔在那里加冕为罗斯国王；后来这片地区在马佐夫舍、鲁塞尼亚和立陶宛统治者之间易手，德罗希琴则在1429年获得城市状。1440年，华沙王公博莱斯瓦夫四世依靠当地贵族占领波德拉谢，但立陶宛军队把他的驻军逐出梅利尼克和德罗希琴。1444年11月，距离帕尔切夫和解还有两年，这里仍是马佐夫舍与立陶宛争议中的边区，天主教和东正教居民共用渡口、林间牧场、畜群和河上商路。

德罗希琴1498年获得马格德堡权利。齐格蒙特一世1513年设立波德拉谢省，德罗希琴1520年成为省会；1569年卢布林联合后，这一地区划归波兰王国。到1580年，这座城镇约有三百二十栋房屋、两千名居民。蒂科钦城堡1433年为约纳斯·戈什陶达斯始建，后来成为齐格蒙特二世·奥古斯特的王宫、宝库、藏书室和王冠大军火库。克内申是他喜爱的驻跸地，他也于1572年死在那里，是雅盖隆王朝最后一位国王。

大洪水重创了这个省。雅努什·拉齐维乌的军队占领蒂科钦，拉齐维乌本人于1655年12月31日死在被围的城堡中，城堡则在1657年1月被蒂绍夫采联盟军队攻破。德罗希琴先遭瑞典和克里米亚鞑靼军队劫掠，1657年5月又被拉科齐·捷尔吉二世的混合军队摧毁，教区教堂和城堡都成了废墟；到1660年，三百八十栋房屋仅余八十栋。战后，斯特凡·恰尔涅茨基获赐蒂科钦领地。1705年11月，强力王奥古斯特二世在重建的蒂科钦城堡会见彼得大帝，并设立白鹰勋章。1794年柯斯丘什科起义期间，安杰伊·卡尔沃夫斯基在德罗希琴组建波德拉谢师。1795年第三次瓜分后，旧地区沿布格河被普鲁士和奥地利分割。

en:
Trakai lies among a chain of lakes west of Vilnius, with castles on a peninsula and on an island in Lake Galvė. Old Trakai was a residence of Grand Duke Gediminas and first appears as Tracken in the chronicles of the Teutonic Knights in 1337; Vytautas was born there around 1350. Kęstutis moved the town to the lakes and built the Peninsula and Island castles, which the Teutonic Order raided again and again. The castles were the stake in the family war of 1382, when Jogaila seized Trakai and left Kęstutis to die in prison at Kreva. The Astrava Agreement of 1392 returned the lands to Vytautas, who liked them better than Vilnius, rebuilt the island fortress in brick and moved the state treasury and the Lithuanian Metrica there in 1409, making Trakai the de facto working capital of the grand duchy. He settled Karaim and Tatar families brought home from his Crimean campaigns to guard the castles, so the town kept Karaim and Tatar communities with their own tongues and rites. Magdeburg rights were granted the same year, and from 1413 Trakai was the seat of the Trakai Voivodeship. In 1444, under the young Grand Duke Casimir, it was a lakeside garrison and market town of ducal residences.

Vytautas himself died in the Island Castle in October 1430, while the envoys carrying the papers for his coronation as King of Lithuania were held at the Polish border, and the kingship died with him. In 1477 Casimir IV, now king of Poland, received Venetian envoys at the castle. It later served as a state prison: Sigismund I held members of the Goštautas family there and kept Helena, widow of King Alexander, on the island to stop her fleeing to Moscow, before making the castle his summer residence. After the Union of Lublin in 1569 the town kept only its local sejmik. The war with Muscovy of 1654 to 1667 ended its prosperity: the town was sacked in 1655 and both castles were demolished, and the Great Northern War brought another round of plunder, famine and plague. With the Third Partition in 1795 Trakai passed to the Russian Empire.
zh:
特拉凯坐落在维尔纽斯以西的一串湖泊之间，城堡分别建在加尔瓦湖的半岛上和湖心岛里。旧特拉凯曾是格迪米纳斯大公的驻地，1337年条顿骑士团编年史首次以「特拉肯」之名记载此地，维陶塔斯约于1350年出生在这里。科斯图提斯把城镇迁到湖边，建起半岛城堡和岛堡，却仍一再遭条顿骑士团洗劫。两座城堡也是1382年家族内战的争夺目标：约盖拉夺取特拉凯，科斯图提斯最终死在克列瓦的囚所。1392年的《阿斯特拉瓦协议》把这片土地归还维陶塔斯，他爱这里胜过维尔纽斯，把湖心要塞改建成砖石城堡，又在1409年把国库和立陶宛大公国档案迁来，特拉凯成了大公国实际理政的都城。他把从克里米亚远征带回的卡拉伊姆人和鞑靼人家庭安置在此戍守城堡，城里便有了各守其语言和仪轨的卡拉伊姆、鞑靼社群。城镇同年获颁马格德堡法，1413年起成为特拉凯省治所。1444年，在年轻的卡齐米日大公治下，这里是湖群之间一座遍布王公宅邸的戍兵与集市之城。

1430年10月，维陶塔斯在岛堡去世；为他运送立陶宛国王加冕文书的使节正被阻于波兰边境，加冕之事随他一同了结。1477年，已是波兰国王的卡齐米日四世在岛堡接见威尼斯使节。城堡后来改成国家监狱：齐格蒙特一世把戈什陶塔斯家族成员关押于此，又将亚历山大国王的遗孀海伦娜困在岛上、防她逃往莫斯科，之后才把城堡辟为夏宫。1569年卢布林联合后，城镇只保留了地方议会所在地的地位。1654至1667年对莫斯科的战争终结了它的富庶：1655年城镇遭劫掠，两座城堡都被拆毁，大北方战争又带来一轮抢掠、饥荒和瘟疫。1795年第三次瓜分后，特拉凯并入俄罗斯帝国。

en:
Samogitia, 'the Lowlands', is the wet, wooded country west of the Neman and Dubysa, and for two hundred years its peasant levies were the shield of Lithuania against the Teutonic and Livonian Orders. They destroyed the host of the Livonian Knights at Saule in 1236 and routed the combined crusader armies at Durbe in 1260. The grand dukes ceded the land to the crusaders three times, in 1382, 1398 and 1404, and three times the lowlanders rose again; after Grunwald in 1410 the Treaty of Melno of 1422 fixed the border and returned them to Lithuania. They were the last pagans in Europe. In November 1413 Vytautas sailed to Betygala and baptised the first parishes, and the pagan temple at Medininkai was torn down on his and Jogaila's orders; on 23 October 1417 the Diocese of Samogitia was erected, with Matthias of Trakai as its first bishop. Medininkai, later called Varniai, remained the bishops' seat, its cathedral built around 1464. In 1441 Grand Duke Casimir confirmed the land's autonomy and the nobles' right to elect their own Elder, so in 1444 Samogitia was a self-governing, newly Catholic and Lithuanian-speaking eldership of free farmers, cattle and horses.

Medininkai received Kulm town rights in 1491. During the Reformation the bishopric became a centre of Lithuanian writing: Bishop Merkelis Giedraitis backed Mikalojus Daukša, whose catechism, printed in 1595, was the first Lithuanian-language book published in the Grand Duchy, and the Jesuits opened Kražiai College in 1616. Swedish troops sacked Varniai in 1655 and 1656, and the Deluge cut the population from roughly 400,000 to 250,000. In December 1701 Charles XII routed Hetman Ogiński at Tryškiai and placed a Swedish garrison in Kaunas; the Altranstädt settlement followed in 1706 and plague swept the lowlands in 1710. Samogitians joined the Kościuszko rising at Vilnius in 1794, and the Third Partition of 1795 assigned the land to Russia. In 1812 Napoleon's Grande Armée crossed the lowlands on the march to Moscow, and its frozen remnants retreated through them that winter.
zh:
萨莫吉希亚意为「低地」，是涅曼河与杜比萨河以西潮湿多林的乡野。两百年间，这里的农民军是立陶宛抵挡条顿骑士团和利沃尼亚骑士团的屏障：1236年他们在苏勒歼灭利沃尼亚骑士团的大军，1260年又在杜尔贝击溃十字军联军。立陶宛大公先后在1382、1398和1404年三次割让这片土地，低地人也三次重新举事；1410年格伦瓦德之战后，1422年的《梅尔诺条约》划定边界，把他们归还立陶宛。他们是欧洲最后的异教徒。1413年11月，维陶塔斯乘船到贝蒂加拉为第一批堂区施洗，梅迪宁凯的异教神庙按他和约盖拉的命令拆毁；1417年10月23日，萨莫吉希亚教区设立，特拉凯的马蒂亚斯为首任主教。驻地梅迪宁凯后来改名瓦尔尼艾，主教座堂约在1464年建成。1441年，卡齐米日大公确认这里的自治地位和贵族自选长老的权利，因此1444年的萨莫吉希亚是一个自治长老区：新奉天主教、讲立陶宛语，居民多为自由农，出产牛和马。

梅迪宁凯1491年获得库尔姆城市法。宗教改革时期，主教区成了立陶宛书面语的中心：主教梅尔凯利斯·盖德拉伊蒂斯支持米卡洛尤斯·道克沙，后者的教理问答1595年印行，是大公国出版的第一本立陶宛语书籍；耶稣会又在1616年开办克拉日艾学院。1655和1656年，瑞典军队两度洗劫瓦尔尼艾，「大洪水」战祸使人口从约四十万降到二十五万。1701年12月，瑞典国王卡尔十二世在特里什基艾击溃盖特曼奥金斯基，并在科夫诺驻扎守军；1706年《阿尔特兰施泰特条约》签订，1710年瘟疫横扫低地。1794年，萨莫吉希亚人参加维尔纽斯的柯斯丘什科起义，1795年第三次瓜分后这片土地划归俄国。1812年，拿破仑的大军越过低地向莫斯科进军，当年冬天，冻溃的残部又经这里退回。

en:
Vilnius lies among hills at the meeting of the Neris and Vilnia. Legend says that Grand Duke Gediminas, hunting in the valley, dreamed of an iron wolf howling on a hilltop; the pagan priest Lizdeika read it as a sign to build a castle and a city whose fame would ring out like iron across the world. Gediminas built his wooden castle on that hill, and letters of 1323 already name Vilnius his capital; two years later he wrote to the Hanse towns inviting Germans and Jews of every trade to settle under his rule. The Teutonic Order burned the town in 1365, 1377 and 1383 without ever taking the hilltop castle, and Henry Bolingbroke, the future Henry IV of England, rode with the Order's siege of 1390 and spent a year before its walls to no purpose. In 1387 Jogaila, newly king of Poland, brought Lithuania into the Catholic Church, raised the cathedral where later grand dukes were crowned with Gediminas' Cap, and granted the town Magdeburg rights. In 1444 it was the capital of the Grand Duchy, where the young Grand Duke Casimir Jagiellon held court: a Catholic Lithuanian town of timber houses and German merchants, whose river roads carried Lithuanian grain north, with Orthodox and Jewish quarters long established.

The Reformation reached Vilnius before the Jesuits, and Calvinist burghers and Orthodox magnates shared the town until the Counter-Reformation: in 1579 Stephen Báthory chartered the Jesuit Academy, the future Vilnius University and the only university in the Grand Duchy. Disaster came in the Deluge, when in August 1655 Russian and Cossack troops stormed in, the first foreign army ever to take the castle; the massacre, seventeen days of fires and a six-year occupation left the city depopulated for generations. Its Jewish quarter grew back into one of the most famous in Europe, home to the Talmudist Elijah, the Vilna Gaon (1720–1797); Napoleon, riding through in 1812, called Vilnius the Jerusalem of the North. In the Kościuszko rising Jakub Jasiński expelled the Russian garrison on 22 April 1794, but the Third Partition of 1795 gave the city to Russia. Napoleon's Grande Armée marched in on 28 June 1812, and Russian troops returned on 10 December.
zh:
维尔纽斯位于内里斯河与维尔尼亚河交汇处的丘陵间。相传立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯在河谷打猎时，梦见一头铁狼在山顶长嚎；异教祭司利兹代卡解梦说，应当在此山筑起城堡、建起大城，这座城市的声名将如铁狼之嚎传遍世界。格迪米纳斯果然在山上建起木堡，1323年的书信已称维尔纽斯为都城，两年后他又致函汉萨诸城，邀请各行各业的德意志人和犹太人入境定居。条顿骑士团曾在1365、1377和1383年焚毁城区，却始终攻不下山顶城堡；后来的英格兰国王亨利四世（当时还是博林布鲁克的亨利）也随骑士团参加1390年的围城，在城下耗了一年无功而返。1387年，新登波兰王位的雅盖沃使立陶宛皈依天主教，建起大教堂，后来的立陶宛大公便在此戴上格迪米纳斯帽加冕，城市也获授马格德堡法。1444年的维尔纽斯是立陶宛大公国的首都，年轻的大公卡齐米日·雅盖隆在此临朝；这座天主教立陶宛城市木屋连片，德意志商人借河路把立陶宛谷物运往北方，东正教徒与犹太人的街区也早已扎根。

宗教改革先于耶稣会士传到维尔纽斯，加尔文宗市民与东正教贵族一度共处一城。反宗教改革中，斯特凡·巴托里于1579年敕建耶稣会学院，即后来的维尔纽斯大学，也是大公国唯一的大学。大洪水时代带来灭顶之灾：1655年8月，俄国与哥萨克军队攻破城市，这是外国军队第一次拿下城堡；屠杀、连烧十七天的大火和历时六年的占领使人口凋敝，几代人都未恢复。此后犹太街区重新兴旺，成为欧洲最有名的犹太区之一，塔木德学者以利亚（即维尔纳迦昂，1720—1797）便在此治学；1812年拿破仑路过时把维尔纽斯称作「北方的耶路撒冷」。1794年柯斯丘什科起义中，雅库布·亚辛斯基于4月22日驱逐俄国守军，但1795年第三次瓜分后城市被并入俄国。1812年6月28日拿破仑的大军入城，12月10日俄军便卷土重来。

en:
Latgalia is the rolling, lake-strewn country north of the middle Daugava, the eastern march of medieval Livonia on the river road that carried trade between Riga and the Russian lands at Polotsk and Pskov. In the twelfth century it belonged to the Latgalian principalities of Jersika and Atzele. Jersika, allied with Polotsk and Lithuania, fell to Bishop Albert and the Sword Brethren in 1209, and when King Visvaldis died the rest of Latgalia passed to the Livonian Order in 1239. The Order built Wolkenburg by Lake Rāzna in 1263 and Dinaburg Castle at Naujene in 1275; Grand Duke Traidenis of Lithuania besieged the new castle in 1277 without taking it. Raids from Lithuania and Pskov kept this a hard frontier of Catholic Livonia. In 1444 it was a thinly peopled Order march of commandery castles, river traffic and cattle, with no large town.

The Livonian War brought a generation of fighting to Dinaburg. The Order pawned the castle to Sigismund II Augustus in 1558, and Ivan the Terrible's army stormed and destroyed it in 1577. Stephen Báthory founded a new fortress and town twenty kilometres downriver, on the site of present Daugavpils, which received Magdeburg rights in 1582 after the Peace of Jam-Zapolski. When Sweden overran most of Livonia in 1621, Latgalia stayed with the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth as the Inflanty Voivodeship and kept the Catholic faith while the rest of the Baltic went Lutheran; Dyneburg became the voivodeship's administrative centre in 1677. Russian troops took the town in 1656, renamed it Borisoglebov and held it for eleven years until the Treaty of Andrusovo returned it. At the First Partition in 1772 Latgalia passed to Russia, assigned first to Pskov Governorate and from 1802 to Vitebsk. In 1810 the imperial government began a great fortress at Dinaburg on the route between St Petersburg and Warsaw, so in 1821 the old Order march was a Russian garrison and county town on the empire's western frontier.
zh:
拉特加尔位于道加瓦河中游以北，是一片丘陵起伏、湖泊密布的乡野，也是中世纪利沃尼亚的东部边区，扼守里加通往波洛茨克、普斯科夫等罗斯之地的河水道。12世纪，这里分布着拉特加人的耶尔西卡和阿采莱等公国。耶尔西卡因与波洛茨克和立陶宛结盟，于1209年被阿尔伯特主教和佩剑兄弟会攻灭；国王维斯瓦尔迪斯死后，余下的土地在1239年并入利沃尼亚骑士团。1263年骑士团在拉兹纳湖畔修筑沃尔肯堡，1275年又在瑙耶内建起迪纳堡；1277年，立陶宛大公特拉伊代尼斯围攻新城不克。立陶宛和普斯科夫不断袭掠，使这里长期是天主教世界一条吃紧的边疆。1444年的拉特加尔人烟稀少，只有骑士团的管区城堡、河上货运和乡间牛群，没有大城镇。

利沃尼亚战争把迪纳堡卷入连年战火。1558年骑士团把城堡抵押给齐格蒙特二世·奥古斯特，1577年伊凡雷帝的军队攻陷并拆毁了它。斯特凡·巴托里在下游二十公里、即今陶格夫匹尔斯的位置另筑要塞和城镇，《亚姆—扎波利斯克和约》后的1582年，新城获得马格德堡法。1621年瑞典席卷利沃尼亚大部，拉特加尔却留在波兰—立陶宛，成为因弗兰蒂省；波罗的海其他地区改宗路德宗时，这里仍信奉天主教。1677年，迪纳堡成为该省的行政中心。俄军1656年攻占此城，改名鲍里索格列博夫，统治十一年后才由《安德鲁索沃停战协定》归还。1772年第一次瓜分波兰后，这里并入俄国，先属普斯科夫省，1802年起划归维捷布斯克省。1810年，帝国当局在迪纳堡动工修建大型要塞，拱卫圣彼得堡通往华沙的要道；到1821年，旧日的骑士团边区已是俄国西境上的驻军县治。

en:
Pskov sits on the Velikaya River at the southern edge of Lake Peipus, where the road from the Rus interior crosses toward the Baltic ports. The Teutonic Knights seized the town in 1240; Alexander Nevsky retook it in 1242, and on 5 April of that year defeated the Livonian Order on the frozen lake in the Battle on the Ice. Dovmont, a Lithuanian prince who converted to Orthodoxy and was elected ruler in 1266, fortified the Krom headland, and the walled ward beneath it kept his name as Dovmont Town. From the Treaty of Bolotovo in 1348 the city governed itself through its veche, subject neither to Novgorod nor to a prince. Its merchants sent flax, honey, wax and furs to Hanse markets and struck silver coin of their own from 1425. In 1444 Pskov was an Orthodox boyar republic, strongly walled and busy with trade, while Moscow reached steadily deeper into its affairs.

The republic ended in January 1510, when Vasily III arrived with an army: the last veche was dismissed, the assembly bell taken down, and three hundred leading families deported inland. The walls held. In August 1581 Stephen Báthory's Polish-Lithuanian army sat down before Pskov after taking Polotsk and Velikiye Luki; over five months it delivered thirty-one assaults, the garrison under Ivan Shuisky made forty-six sallies, and a force sent against the Pskovo-Pechorsky Monastery was thrown back. The siege was abandoned after the Treaty of Jam Zapolski in January 1582. Gustavus Adolphus of Sweden failed before the city in 1615 and made peace at Stolbovo two years later. In 1650 small traders, craftsmen and streltsy seized Pskov for months rather than load scarce grain for Sweden. The Great Northern War later pushed the frontier far to the west, and in 1777 the town became the seat of Pskov Governorate.
zh:
普斯科夫位于韦利卡亚河临近楚德湖南缘之处，罗斯内地通往波罗的海港口的道路在此渡河。北方十字军战争期间，条顿骑士团1240年攻占该城，亚历山大·涅夫斯基1242年将其收复，并在同年4月5日于结冰的湖面上击败利沃尼亚骑士团，此战即楚德湖战役。立陶宛王公多夫蒙特改宗东正教后于1266年被推为首领，他在克罗姆高地上加筑城防，崖下的围城区便以「多夫蒙特城」为名。1348年《博洛托沃条约》之后，城市由维彻自治，不臣服于诺夫哥罗德，也不受王公统属。商人把亚麻、蜂蜜、蜂蜡和毛皮运到汉萨各市场，1425年起还自行铸造银币。1444年的普斯科夫是波雅尔主政的东正教共和国，城墙坚固、商旅繁忙，而莫斯科正越来越深地介入它的事务。

共和国在1510年1月走到尽头：瓦西里三世率大军抵达，最后一次维彻被解散，维彻钟被拆下，300个望族家庭流放内地。但城墙守住了。1581年8月，斯特凡·巴托里的波兰立陶宛军队在攻占波洛茨克和大卢基后围攻普斯科夫；五个月内发动31次强攻，伊万·舒伊斯基麾下守军出击46次，攻打普斯科沃-佩切尔斯基修道院的一支分队也被击退。1582年1月《亚姆·扎波尔斯基和约》签订后，围城方才撤去。1615年，瑞典国王古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫同样未能破城，两年后以《斯托尔博沃和约》收场。1650年，小商人、手工业者和射击军不愿再为瑞典装运紧缺粮食，起事控制城市数月。大北方战争后来把边界远远推向西方，1777年普斯科夫成为省治。

en:
Polotsk, also called Polatsk, stands where the Palata runs into the Western Dvina, on the river route between the Baltic and the Dnieper and Volga portages. Its old princely landmark is the Cathedral of Holy Wisdom, built for Prince Vseslav between 1044 and 1066 and modelled in name and ambition on the great churches of Kyiv and Novgorod. The stone cathedral held the burials of Polotsk princes and reminded travellers that this had once been the seat of a powerful Rurikid dynasty. When Lithuania secured the city in 1307, its charter promised not to introduce new customs or destroy the old ones, while Lithuanian control of Polotsk also closed the Dvina route to rivals. In 1444 it was the leading Orthodox Ruthenian city of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, a river port facing both Moscow and the Livonian borderlands.

The humanist, physician and printer Francysk Skaryna was born in Polotsk around 1470-1490 and became one of the earliest book printers in Eastern Europe. The city's position made it a prize in the Livonian War: Ivan IV's army besieged it for two weeks in 1563 and forced its surrender, then Stephen Báthory retook it in 1579. Báthory opened a Jesuit college there in 1580 with Piotr Skarga as first rector, and Holy Wisdom later passed to the Uniate Church. Russian troops held Polotsk from 1654 until a Commonwealth army recovered it in 1660. The right bank passed to Russia in the First Partition of 1772 and the left bank in 1793. Catherine II refused to enforce the papal suppression of the Jesuits, so displaced Jesuits brought books and scientific collections to Polotsk; their college became the Polotsk Academy in 1812, the year French and Russian armies fought two battles outside the town. Alexander I closed the academy only eight years later and broke up its great library.
zh:
波洛茨克（白俄罗斯语称波拉茨克）位于波洛塔河注入西德维纳河之处，处在波罗的海通往第聂伯河、伏尔加河水陆联运线的河路上。城内最古老的王公地标是圣索菲亚大教堂，由弗谢斯拉夫王公在1044年至1066年间修建，名称和气势都效仿基辅与诺夫哥罗德的同名大教堂。这座石造教堂安葬过波洛茨克诸王公，也向旅人表明这里曾是留里克王朝一支强藩的都城。1307年立陶宛控制城市时，特许状承诺不增设新规、不废旧俗；控制波洛茨克，也使立陶宛把西德维纳河路握在手中。1444年时，它是立陶宛大公国首要的东正教罗塞尼亚河港，前方同时对着莫斯科和利沃尼亚边境。

人文主义者、医生兼印刷人弗兰齐斯克·斯科里纳约于1470年至1490年间出生在波洛茨克，后来成为东欧最早的书籍印刷者之一。河港的位置使它在利沃尼亚战争中成为必争之地：1563年，伊凡四世的军队围城两周后迫使城市投降；1579年，斯特凡·巴托里又将它夺回。巴托里于1580年在城内开设耶稣会学院，由皮奥特尔·斯卡尔加担任首任院长，圣索菲亚大教堂后来也转入联合教会。1654年俄军占领波洛茨克，联邦军队直到1660年才将其收复。1772年第一次瓜分波兰时，右岸并入俄国，左岸则在1793年随之并入。叶卡捷琳娜二世拒绝执行教皇取缔耶稣会的命令，流散的会士把书籍和科学藏品带到波洛茨克；旧学院于1812年升格为波洛茨克学院，也正是在这一年，法俄两军在城外打了两场战役。八年后，亚历山大一世关闭学院，并拆散了它的大型图书馆。

en:
Minsk stands on the Svislach, where the small Nyamiha once flowed through the settlement. Its first appearance in the Primary Chronicle is also a battle note. On 3 March 1067 the princes of Kievan Rus' defeated Vseslav of Polotsk on the Nemiga, and the fortified place named in the account later became the seat of the Principality of Minsk. It entered the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in the early fourteenth century without a recorded conquest, and Casimir IV listed it among the grand duchy's privileged towns in 1441. In 1444 Minsk was an Orthodox Ruthenian town on the forest routes between Vilna and the Dnieper, whose merchants sent timber, furs and honey between the river systems.

Crimean Tatars burned Minsk in 1505, when only the castle held out, and Glinski's rebels besieged it in 1508. A fire in 1547 destroyed the castle and most of the houses, after which the centre was rebuilt around the High Market. Minsk had received Magdeburg law in 1499, became the seat of Minsk Voivodeship in the 1560s, and from 1588 the Lithuanian Tribunal sat there in alternate years. After the Union of Brest, Orthodox, Uniate and Catholic parishes divided the town. Russian troops held it from 1655 to 1660, and John Casimir recovered a place of about three hundred houses; Swedish and Russian armies occupied it again during the Great Northern War. Minsk passed to Russia in 1793 and was occupied and looted by Napoleon's army in 1812.
zh:
明斯克位于斯维斯洛奇河畔，小支流涅米加河曾穿过聚落。《往年纪事》第一次提到它，也是在记载一场战斗：1067年3月3日，罗斯诸王公在涅米加河击败波洛茨克王公弗谢斯拉夫，史册中出现的设防据点后来成为明斯克公国的中心。14世纪初，明斯克未见战事便并入立陶宛大公国，1441年卡齐米日四世把它列入大公国享有特权的城市。1444年时，明斯克是维尔纽斯与第聂伯河之间林间商路上的东正教鲁塞尼亚城镇，商人把木材、毛皮和蜂蜜运往各条水系。

1505年，克里米亚鞑靼人焚毁明斯克，只有城堡未失；1508年，格林斯基的叛军又围攻此城。1547年的大火烧毁城堡和大半房屋，重建后的市中心围绕高市场展开。明斯克1499年获得马格德堡法，1560年代成为明斯克省治所，1588年起立陶宛高等法庭每隔一年在此开庭。布列斯特联合之后，东正教徒、合并派信徒和天主教徒在城中各有教区。1655至1660年俄军占领明斯克，扬·卡齐米日收回时城中只剩约三百栋房屋；大北方战争期间，瑞典和俄国军队又先后进驻。1793年明斯克划归俄国，1812年被拿破仑的军队占领并劫掠。

en:
Brest stands at the confluence of the Mukhavets and the Bug, where the river crossing carries traffic between Masovia, Volhynia and the Lithuanian interior. The Primary Chronicle names Berestii in 1019, a stronghold long contested between Rus princes and the dukes of Masovia. The Mongols burned it in 1241; Gediminas of Lithuania took the town in 1319 and wintered there while preparing to march on Kyiv. Vytautas granted Magdeburg rights in 1390, the first town in what later became Belarus to receive them, and its merchants grew rich on trade with Poland. In December 1409 Władysław Jagiełło and Vytautas met there with the Tatar khan Jalal al-Din to arrange his horsemen for war with the Teutonic Knights; a Brest cavalry banner fought at Grunwald the next year. In 1440 a Lithuanian Sejm in the town chose Casimir IV Jagiellon as grand duke. In 1444 Brest is an Orthodox Ruthenian trading town with a castle, its wealth drawn from river cargo and the wool trade with Poland.

The town's printers and bishops drew it into the Commonwealth's religious quarrels. In 1563 the Calvinist prince Mikołaj Radziwiłł the Black had Bernard Wojewodka print the Brest Bible there, the first complete Protestant Bible in Polish, dedicated to Sigismund II Augustus. In 1596 a council of Orthodox bishops accepted the Pope's authority while keeping the Eastern rite; the Union of Brest created the Uniate Church. Armies kept returning to the crossing. A Crimean Tatar army under Mengli Giray burned the town in 1500 but failed against the castle; during the Deluge Khmelnytsky's Cossacks took Brest in 1648, a Muscovite siege failed in 1655, and Swedish and Transylvanian troops entered in 1657. In January 1660 Ivan Khovansky's Muscovites stormed the castle at dawn and killed 1,700 to 1,900 defenders and townspeople; Paweł Jan Sapieha retook it that December, and John II Casimir opened a mint there in 1665. The Swedes returned in 1706, and in 1769 the Bar Confederates made the town a base. On 19 September 1794 Alexander Suvorov defeated General Karol Sierakowski between Brest and Terespol, and the Third Partition assigned Brest to Russia in 1795.
zh:
布列斯特位于穆哈韦茨河汇入布格河的河口一带，渡口上的水陆往来连通马佐夫舍、沃伦和立陶宛腹地。《往年纪事》在1019年已提到别列斯季耶，这座要塞长期是罗斯王公与马佐夫舍公爵争夺的目标。1241年蒙古人焚城；1319年立陶宛大公格迪米纳斯夺取布列斯特，还在此过冬，筹划进军基辅。1390年维陶塔斯授予它马格德堡法，使布列斯特成为后来构成白俄罗斯的土地上第一个获此权利的城市，商人靠与波兰的贸易致富。1409年12月，瓦迪斯瓦夫·雅盖沃和维陶塔斯在此与鞑靼汗札兰丁会商，约定他的骑兵参加对条顿骑士团的战争；次年布列斯特骑兵旗队在格伦瓦德参战。1440年，立陶宛大公国议会在此推举卡齐米日四世·雅盖隆奇克为大公。1444年的布列斯特是一座信奉东正教的鲁塞尼亚商业城市，有城堡戍守，财富来自河运货物和对波兰的羊毛贸易。

这座城的印刷商和主教把它卷进联邦的宗教纷争。1563年，加尔文宗王公米科瓦伊·「黑衣」·拉齐维乌在布列斯特由贝尔纳·沃耶沃德卡印出《布列斯特圣经》，这是第一部完整的波兰语新教圣经，题献给齐格蒙特二世·奥古斯特。1596年，东正教主教们在布列斯特召开会议，承认教宗权威但保留东方礼，协议称《布列斯特联合》，东仪合并派随之成立。军队也一再回到这个渡口。1500年明格里·格来的克里米亚鞑靼军队烧毁城区，却未能攻下城堡；大洪水时代，赫梅利尼茨基的哥萨克1648年入城，1655年莫斯科围城不克，1657年瑞典和特兰西瓦尼亚军队占领该城。1660年1月，伊万·霍万斯基的莫斯科军队在黎明突袭城堡，杀死一千七百至一千九百名守军和居民；帕维尔·扬·萨佩哈在当年12月收复城市，扬二世·卡齐米日1665年在此开设造币厂。瑞典军队1706年再度占领，1769年巴尔同盟以布列斯特为据点。1794年9月19日，亚历山大·苏沃洛夫在布列斯特与特雷什波尔之间击败卡罗尔·谢拉科夫斯基将军；1795年第三次瓜分后，布列斯特划归俄国。

en:
Pinsk lies at the mouth of the Pina on the Pripyat, among flooded oak woods, reedbeds and shifting channels in Polesia. The chronicles first name it as a town of the princes of Turov, and a Mongol attack in 1240 damaged it so badly that the Orthodox diocese of Turov moved to the town soon afterward. Around 1320 Gediminas brought the lands into Lithuania, and Orthodox Gediminid princes held Pinsk while Franciscan friars built a church there in 1396. In 1444 it was a compact wooden trading town: rafts, barges and local boats carried wool, timber, tar and honey along the Pripyat, while the surrounding marshes left roads few and narrow.

After the local princely line ended, Sigismund I granted Pinsk to his Italian-born queen, Bona Sforza, in 1523. Her agents cut a canal from the Pina, enlarged the town and settled new households there; four years later Konstanty Ostrogski routed Crimean Tatars who had ravaged the outskirts. Jesuits opened a college in 1631 and later ran a pharmacy and a printing house, but the wars of the next generation emptied much of Pinsk. Orthodox townspeople let Cossacks in during 1648, Lithuanian troops retook the burning town, and Russian and Cossack attacks in 1655 and 1657 left houses and churches in ruins. Charles XII's Swedes blew up the Wiśniowiecki castle during their occupation in 1706. Late-eighteenth-century canal works linked the Pripyat basin with the Neman and the Bug, putting Black Sea river traffic within reach of Baltic ports. Pinsk passed to Russia in 1793 and held a French garrison in 1812.
zh:
平斯克位于皮纳河注入普里皮亚季河之处，周围是波列西耶的水淹栎林、芦苇荡和变化不定的河道。编年史最早把它记作图罗夫王公治下的城镇；1240年蒙古人来犯后破坏严重，图罗夫东正教区很快迁入。1320年前后，格迪米纳斯把这片土地并入立陶宛，信奉东正教的格迪米纳斯家族王公在此统治，方济各会则于1396年建起教堂。1444年的平斯克是一座紧凑的木制商城：木筏、驳船和本地小船沿普里皮亚季河运送羊毛、木材、焦油和蜂蜜，城外沼泽则使道路稀少而狭窄。

当地王公世系绝嗣后，齐格蒙特一世于1523年把平斯克封给出生在意大利的王后博娜·斯福尔扎。她的臣属从皮纳河开凿运河、扩建城区并迁入新住户；四年后，康斯坦丁·奥斯特罗日斯基击败了前来劫掠城郊的克里米亚鞑靼人。耶稣会1631年开办书院，后来又经营药房和印刷所，但随后几十年的战乱使平斯克大半残破。1648年，东正城市民放哥萨克入城，立陶宛军队最后夺回燃烧中的城镇；1655年和1657年俄军与哥萨克接连进攻，房屋和教堂多成废墟。1706年，卡尔十二世的瑞典军占领此地，炸毁了维希尼奥维茨基城堡。18世纪后期的运河工程把普里皮亚季河流域与涅曼河、布格河连通，使黑海方向的河运能够接近波罗的海港口。1793年平斯克并入俄国，1812年曾驻有法国守军。

en:
Volhynia is a historic region between the Western Bug and the southern tributaries of the Pripyat, where towns grew on river crossings along the old Ruthenian trade routes. Volodymyr, first chronicled in 988, was the capital of the Principality of Volhynia and later one of the chief cities of Galicia–Volhynia, while Lutsk grew into its other fortified princely seat. When the Galician-Volhynian monarchy collapsed around 1340, Poland and Lithuania divided the inheritance and went on contesting it for generations. In 1440 Grand Duke Casimir IV recognised Svidrigailo as prince of a restored Volhynia, so in 1444 Orthodox Ruthenian boyars, townsmen and peasants live under a prince who still keeps real autonomy within the Lithuanian world.

On Svidrigailo's death the principality became a Lithuanian province, administered from Volodymyr, Lutsk and Kremenets, while repeated Tatar raids drove the boyars to build private castles and keep armed retinues. The Union of Lublin transferred all of Volhynia to the Polish Crown in 1569. Orthodoxy answered with learning: at Ostroh, Prince Konstanty Wasyl Ostrogski opened an academy, the first higher school in the East Slavic lands, and Ivan Fyodorov printed the Ostrog Bible there in 1581, the first complete Bible printed in Church Slavonic. After the 1596 Union of Brest most Orthodox dioceses in Volhynia passed to the Greek Catholics; the monastery at Pochaiv, whose abbot Job drew pilgrims from across the land, was for decades the stronghold of the old faith. Khmelnytsky's Cossack rising swept the region in 1648, and at Berestechko in 1651 the Crimean Tatars rode off the battlefield and left the Cossacks to one of their worst defeats; war, plague and slave raiding emptied whole districts. The Koliivshchyna revolt of 1768 was put down here by Polish and Russian troops acting together, and the partitions of 1793 and 1795 assigned almost all of Volhynia to Russia, where the Ruthenian peasantry remained enserfed.
zh:
沃里尼亚是西布格河与普里皮亚季河南部支流之间的历史地区，城镇多在古老罗斯商路的河流渡口兴起。988年首见于编年史的沃洛德米尔曾是沃里尼亚公国都城，后来又是加利西亚-沃里尼亚的首要城市之一；卢茨克则发展为另一处设防的王公驻地。加利西亚-沃里尼亚王权约在1340年崩溃后，波兰和立陶宛瓜分了这份遗产，此后又争夺了好几代人。1440年，立陶宛大公卡齐米日四世承认斯维特里盖拉为恢复后的沃里尼亚公国之主；因此1444年时，东正教鲁塞尼亚波雅尔、市民和农民仍生活在一位于立陶宛世界内保有实际自治权的王公治下。

斯维特里盖拉去世后，公国成为立陶宛行省，由沃洛德米尔、卢茨克和克列梅涅茨三地管辖；鞑靼人连年袭掠，波雅尔纷纷修筑私家城堡、蓄养武装随从。1569年卢布林联合把整个沃里尼亚划归波兰王冠领。东正教以学问回应：康斯坦丁·瓦西尔·奥斯特罗兹基王公在奥斯特罗格创办了东斯拉夫土地上第一所高等学院，伊万·费多罗夫1581年在此印成《奥斯特罗格圣经》，即第一部完整刊印的教会斯拉夫语圣经。1596年布列斯特联合后，沃里尼亚的东正教教区大多转入希腊天主教会；波恰耶夫修道院在院长约伯主持下吸引全沃里尼亚的朝圣者，几十年来都是旧信仰的重镇。1648年，赫梅利尼茨基的哥萨克起义席卷此地；1651年别列斯捷奇科战役中，克里米亚鞑靼人临阵撤离战场，哥萨克遭到最惨重的失败之一，战争、瘟疫和掳奴使整片整片地区人烟断绝。1768年科利伊夫希纳起义在此被波兰和俄国军队联手镇压；1793年和1795年的两次瓜分把几乎整个沃里尼亚划给俄国，鲁塞尼亚农民仍身为农奴。

en:
Kyiv stands on the high bluffs of the Dnieper, on the river road that carried Varangian longships south to Constantinople. Oleg of Novgorod made it the capital of Rus in 882, and under Yaroslav the Wise the Cathedral of St Sophia rose above a city of eight markets and hundreds of churches. In caves dug into the hills to the south Anthony of Kiev founded the Caves Monastery, whose monks compiled the Primary Chronicle; princes were buried and pilgrims prayed in its Dormition Cathedral. Batu Khan's Mongols stormed the city in December 1240 and left it in ruins. After Algirdas of Lithuania won the Battle of Blue Waters around 1362, Kyiv entered the Grand Duchy of Lithuania under its own princes, who held an eighteen-tower castle on Castle Hill above the Podil wharves. In 1444 it was an Orthodox Ruthenian city ruled by the Olelkovych dynasty, and grain and furs passed through its Dnieper landings.

The Olelkovych line died out in 1470, and Vilnius turned the principality into a voivodeship; in 1482 Crimean Tatars sent by Meñli I Giray burned Kyiv and carried its people into captivity. The Union of Lublin in 1569 transferred the city to the Polish Crown, and after the Union of Brest its Orthodox faithful faced a state-backed Uniate Church. The Caves Monastery led their revival: it opened a printing house in the 1620s, and the school Metropolitan Petro Mohyla founded there in 1632 grew into the Kyiv Mohyla Academy, the foremost Ruthenian school of its day. Bohdan Khmelnytsky entered Kyiv at the head of his Cossacks in 1649; a Muscovite garrison followed in 1654, and the 1667 Truce of Andrusovo left the city with the tsars. In 1768-1769 the haydamak rising called Koliivshchyna, led by Maksym Zalizniak and Ivan Gonta, swept the Kyiv and Bratslav lands until Polish and Russian troops put it down. In 1797 the January Contract Fair moved to Kyiv from Dubno, and for a month every winter its Podil halls drew landowners and merchants from across the empire.
zh:
基辅雄踞第聂伯河高岸，瓦良格人的长船沿这条河南下君士坦丁堡。882年，诺夫哥罗德的奥列格以此为罗斯都城；智者雅罗斯拉夫时代，圣索菲亚大教堂在一座有八处市集、数百座教堂的城中耸起。基辅的安东尼在南边山冈凿洞修行，建起洞窟修道院，修士们在此编成《往年纪事》，修道院里的安息大教堂历代是王公安葬、信众朝圣之地。1240年12月，拔都的蒙古军破城，基辅化为废墟。1362年前后，立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯赢得蓝水之战，基辅归入立陶宛大公国，仍由本邦王公统治，王公在波迪尔码头上方城堡山的一座十八塔城堡中理政。1444年的基辅是奥列尔科维奇王朝治下的东正教鲁塞尼亚城市，粮食和毛皮经第聂伯河码头运出。

奥列尔科维奇家族1470年绝嗣，维尔纽斯当局把公国改为总督区；1482年，明格里·格莱派来的克里米亚鞑靼人焚毁基辅，将居民掳走。1569年卢布林联合把基辅划给波兰王国王冠领地，布列斯特联合之后，当地东正教徒要面对受国家支持的合并派教会。洞窟修道院领导了东正教的复兴：17世纪20年代办起印刷所，都主教佩特罗·莫希拉1632年在此创办的学校后来成为基辅莫希拉学院，是当时鲁塞尼亚的最高学府。1649年，赫梅利尼茨基率哥萨克进入基辅；1654年莫斯科驻军随之而来，1667年安德鲁索沃停战协定把基辅留给沙皇。1768至1769年，扎利兹尼亚克和贡塔领导的盖达马克起义「科利伊夫希纳」席卷基辅和布拉茨拉夫一带，被波兰和俄国军队镇压。1797年，一月契约集市从杜布诺迁到基辅波迪尔，每年一月都有成千上万的地主和商人到此签约交易。

en:
Podolia is the plateau between the Dniester and the Southern Boh, the Ruthenian Ponizie, or lowlands. Its black soil carried grain and cattle, and its river gardens were known for cherries and melons. The Mongols overran it after Halych-Volhynia, until Algirdas of Lithuania broke the Golden Horde at the Blue Waters in 1362 and brought the plateau under Lithuanian rule; western Podolia passed to the Polish crown in 1366. The land's defence rested on Kamieniec, where the Smotrych winds through a rocky gorge and the castle perches on a peninsula joined to the town by a single bridge. Yuriy Koriatovych's charter of 1374 granted Magdeburg rights, a Latin diocese followed in 1378, and from 1434 Kamieniec headed the Podolian Voivodeship. Its walls faced the steppe and the Tatar slave roads, and people called it the gateway of Poland. In 1444 its Orthodox Ruthenian peasants and townsmen lived under a Polish Catholic nobility, and the cash-starved crown had pledged the castle to the starosta Teodoryk Buczacki two years before.

After the Union of Lublin in 1569 eastern Podolia passed to the Crown, and the frontier burned for decades. After Batih in 1652 Khmelnytsky's Cossacks killed several thousand Polish prisoners there. In 1672 Sultan Mehmed IV came in person with a vast army; Kamieniec surrendered on 18 August, and Buchach made it an Ottoman eyalet centre for twenty-seven years. The Turks turned the Latin cathedral into a mosque and built a minaret beside it; in 1674 they expelled the Armenian townsmen, whose colony went back to the thirteenth century; after years in the Balkans they settled chiefly in Lwów. Jan Sobieski built the Holy Trinity entrenchments nearby to pin the garrison in. Karlowitz returned Podolia to Poland in 1699, when Kamieniec was judged the strongest fortress in the Commonwealth. In 1768 nobles formed the Bar Confederation at Bar, Casimir Pulaski among them, and the haidamaka Koliyivshchyna swept the region; several thousand Poles, Jews and Uniates died at Uman. The First Partition gave the western fringe to Austria in 1772. The Second Partition handed Kamieniec to Russia in 1793, whose commandant took the castle keys to a 101-gun salute.
zh:
波多里亚是德涅斯特河与南布格河之间开阔的高原，鲁塞尼亚人称之为「波尼济亚」，意为低地。这里的黑土出产粮食和牲畜，河畔果园以樱桃和甜瓜闻名。加利奇-沃伦王国之后，蒙古人占据此地；1362年，立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯在蓝水之战击溃金帐汗国，把高原纳入立陶宛治下，西波多里亚1366年并入波兰王冠领。这片土地的防务系于卡缅涅茨：斯莫特里奇河在岩石峡谷中绕出河环，城堡坐落在一座半岛上，只靠一座桥与城区相连。1374年尤里·科里亚特维奇王公的特许状授予该城马格德堡法，1378年设拉丁教区，1434年起卡缅涅茨为波多里亚省省会。城墙之外就是草原和鞑靼掠奴道，时人称它为「波兰之门」。1444年，信奉东正教的鲁塞尼亚农民和市民受波兰天主教贵族统治，国库空虚的王室已于两年前把城堡抵押给长官特奥多里克·布恰茨基。

1569年卢布林联合后，东波多里亚从立陶宛划归王冠领，此后边境燃烧了几十年。1652年巴季格战役后，赫梅利尼茨基的哥萨克在当地杀死数千名波兰俘虏。1672年，苏丹穆罕默德四世亲率大军前来，卡缅涅茨于8月18日投降，《布恰奇条约》把它定为奥斯曼一个行省的中心，历时二十七年。土耳其人把拉丁大教堂改为清真寺，在旁边建起宣礼塔；1674年他们驱逐亚美尼亚市民，这个社群的历史可追溯到13世纪，被逐者在巴尔干流落数年后大多定居利沃夫。扬·索别斯基在附近修筑圣三一堑壕，用来困住守军。1699年《卡尔洛维茨条约》把波多里亚归还波兰，卡缅涅茨当时被视为联邦最坚固的要塞。1768年，贵族在巴尔成立巴尔同盟，卡齐米日·普瓦斯基也在其中；同年，号称「科利伊夫希纳」的海达马克起义席卷各地，数千波兰人、犹太人和东仪派信徒在乌曼遇害。1772年第一次瓜分把西缘划给奥地利。1793年第二次瓜分将卡缅涅茨交给俄国，新任长官接收城堡钥匙时，101门大炮鸣放礼炮。

en:
Yedisan is the Black Sea steppe between the Dniester and the Southern Bug, the western end of the Wild Fields. Its one anchorage was Khadjibey, on the Gulf of Odessa. Grain from 'port Kaczubyeiow' reached Constantinople in 1413, the first mention of the place; a charter of Grand Duke Švitrigaila names it in 1431, and in 1442 it was enfeoffed to the Podolian magnate Teodor Buczacki, under whom grain from the hinterland and salt evaporated in the coastal lagoons made the station prosperous enough for a lawsuit over its customs revenues. In 1444 this was a remote Lithuanian march, where Ruthenian merchants and Tatar herders lived under the grand duke's nominal rule.

The Ottoman conquest of the Crimea in the later fifteenth century wrecked the port, and Khadjibey lay abandoned for generations while the Crimean khanate used the coast as a base for slave raids and Nogai herders pastured their flocks across the steppe. The Ottomans refortified the haven only in 1764, with the Yeni Dünya fortress in Silistra province. Russian troops raided it during the war of 1735-1739 and handed it back at the Peace of Niš; the war of 1768-1774 ended with the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca, and the steppe passed to Russia with the annexation of the Crimea in 1783. On the night of 24 September 1789 a flying column of Black Sea Cossacks and grenadiers under José de Ribas, marching by night from Ochakov ahead of the main army, stormed the little fort, whose three hundred men and twelve guns faced a Turkish fleet of some forty sail in the roadstead. The 1792 Treaty of Jassy carried the Russian frontier to the Dniester, and on 7 June 1794 Catherine II signed the rescript founding Odessa on the old harbour. De Ribas and de Volant laid the new port out, and Moldavian, Ukrainian, Russian and German colonists settled it.
zh:
叶迪山是德涅斯特河与南布格河之间的黑海草原，即「荒野」的西缘，唯一的港湾是敖德萨湾畔的哈西贝（Khadjibey）。1413年，「卡丘别伊港」的粮食运抵君士坦丁堡，这是此地最早的记载；1431年立陶宛大公斯维特里盖拉的敕书提到它，1442年港口被封给波多利亚豪强费奥多尔·布恰茨基。在他经营下，内地粮食和海滨潟湖晒出的食盐让这个商站富庶到要为关税收入打官司。1444年时，这里是立陶宛偏远的边疆，鲁塞尼亚商人和鞑靼牧人在大公的名义统治下生活。

15世纪后期奥斯曼征服克里米亚，港口毁于兵燹，哈西贝荒废了几代人；克里米亚汗国把这片海岸当作掳掠人口的基地，诺盖牧人则在草原上放牧。奥斯曼人直到1764年才重新加固港湾，建起「新世界」（Yeni Dünya）堡垒，划入锡利斯特拉省。俄军在1735至1739年的战争中曾袭占此地，战后依尼什和约归还；1768至1774年的战争以库楚克开纳吉和约告终，1783年俄国吞并克里米亚，这片草原随之归俄。1789年9月24日夜，何塞·德里巴斯率黑海哥萨克与掷弹兵组成的突击队从奥恰科夫连夜行军，赶在主力之前攻下这座小堡垒；守军只有三百人、十二门炮，锚地还泊着一支约四十艘船的土耳其舰队。1792年雅西和约把俄国边界推到德涅斯特河；1794年6月7日，叶卡捷琳娜二世签署敕令，在旧港建立敖德萨，由德里巴斯和德沃兰规划营建，迁入摩尔多瓦、乌克兰、俄罗斯和德意志移民。

en:
Zaporozhia is the land beyond the Dnieper rapids. Nine cataracts split the lower river over about seventy kilometres, and south of them the Great Meadow's wooded islands, marshes and floodlands gave cover in the open steppe. In 1444 this was Lithuania's empty southern march: Kyiv claimed it, patrols rode farther than tax collectors, Crimean raiders crossed it to seize captives, and Ruthenian fishermen and graziers kept close to the river islands. The self-defence bands gathering on those islands became the Zaporozhian Cossacks.

In the 1550s Prince Dmytro Vyshnevetsky united those bands and built a wooden stronghold on Little Khortytsia. The Host kept its sich in a chain of island forts, Tomakivka, Bazavluk, Mykytyn and Chortomlyk among them. Cossacks elected their kosh otaman in an open rada, and their longboats raided as far as Caffa and the walls of Constantinople. Bohdan Khmelnytsky seized Mykytyn Sich in 1648 and began the revolt that created the Cossack Hetmanate. After Ivan Mazepa joined the Swedes, Russian troops sacked Chortomlyk Sich in May 1709; the Zaporozhians built Kamianka Sich, withdrew after 1711 to Oleshky Sich under Crimean protection, and returned in 1734 to build the Nova Sich. On 4–5 June 1775 General Tekeli surrounded it with infantry and artillery. The aged otaman Petro Kalnyshevsky surrendered without fighting and was exiled to Solovki, where he died in 1803; Catherine II abolished the Host on 3 August. About five thousand Cossacks fled to the Danube delta, while others joined the Black Sea Host in 1787 and were later resettled on the Kuban.
zh:
扎波罗热是第聂伯河险滩以南的土地。九处险滩在约七十公里长的下游河道上截住航路，险滩以南的「大草甸」遍布林木岛屿、沼泽和河漫滩，在开阔草原中提供了隐蔽处。1444年，这里是立陶宛空旷的南方边地：基辅名义上领有此地，巡逻队能到的地方却比税吏远，克里米亚鞑靼人经此掳走人口，鲁塞尼亚渔民和牧人则紧贴河洲居住。在这些岛屿上聚集的自卫队伍，后来成为扎波罗热哥萨克。

16世纪50年代，德米特罗·维什涅韦茨基王公把这些队伍联合起来，在小霍尔季察岛修建木寨。哥萨克军的塞契先后设在托马基夫卡、巴扎夫卢克、米基京、乔尔托姆利克等一连串岛屿堡垒中。哥萨克在公开拉达上推举科舍沃伊统领，乘长船袭掠，兵锋远达卡法和君士坦丁堡城下。1648年，博格丹·赫梅利尼茨基夺取米基京塞契，从这里起兵反抗波兰王国，后来建立哥萨克盖特曼国。伊万·马泽帕倒向瑞典后，俄军于1709年5月洗劫乔尔托姆利克塞契；扎波罗热人先建卡缅卡塞契，1711年后又在克里米亚庇护下退往奥列什基塞契，1734年才返回修建新塞契。1775年6月4至5日，特克利将军率步兵和炮兵将其包围。年迈的统领彼得罗·卡尔尼舍夫斯基不战而降，被流放索洛维茨基，1803年死于彼处；叶卡捷琳娜二世在8月3日下诏解散哥萨克军。约五千名哥萨克逃往多瑙河三角洲，另一些人则在1787年加入黑海哥萨克军，后来被迁往库班。

en:
The Crimean khans held the inland valleys and the steppe running up to the peninsula's neck, not the coast. Their seat was Qırq Yer, a fortress on a cliff edge that Mongol governors had kept since the thirteenth century; William of Rubruck heard the place named in 1253, and Qırq Yer means 'forty castles'. As the Golden Horde broke apart, Hacı I Giray, a prince of Genghis Khan's line once sheltered by Vytautas of Lithuania, made himself master of the peninsula and was enthroned in the cliff fortress in 1441, backed until her death in 1437 by Canike Hanım, daughter of Tokhtamysh. In 1444 his Sunni Tatar riders pastured their herds in the foothills and rode north for captives, while Genoese Caffa took the sea trade and the Christian principality of Theodoro held the western mountains.

Ottoman armies seized Caffa and Theodoro in 1475, and from 1478 the khan ruled as the sultan's privileged vassal: Tatar cavalry served in the Ottoman campaigns, and the 'harvest of the steppe', the captives driven off from Poland-Lithuania and Muscovy, filled the khan's slave market at Bakhchysarai as well as the ports. Devlet I Giray carried the raiding war to Moscow itself and burned the city in 1571, only to be crushingly beaten at Molodi the next year. In 1532 Sahib I Giray moved the seat to Bakhchysarai, the 'garden palace', a new residence two kilometres from the old cliff raised by Ottoman, Persian and Italian craftsmen; its Fountain of Tears moved Pushkin to write a poem after he visited in 1820. The empty Qırq Yer, by then called Chufut-Kale, became a state prison, where the Russian boyar Sheremetev spent twenty-one years after his capture in 1660. Field-Marshal Münnich burned Bakhchysarai in 1736, and the palace seen there now was rebuilt in the 1740s and 1750s.

The treaty of Küçük Kaynarca of 1774 cut the tie to Istanbul, and on 8 April 1783 Catherine II annexed the peninsula. The last khan, Şahin Giray, was put to death on Rhodes in 1787.
zh:
克里米亚诸汗掌握的是内陆河谷和一直伸向半岛颈部的草原，而不是海岸。他们的驻地基尔克耶尔是一座崖顶要塞，13世纪以来由蒙古封君据守；1253年鲁不鲁乞就听过这个名字，基尔克耶尔意为「四十堡」。金帐汗国瓦解之际，曾受立陶宛大公维陶塔斯庇护的成吉思汗后裔哈吉·格莱成为半岛之主，1441年在崖堡登位称汗；脱脱迷失之女贾尼凯哈农支持他起事，直到1437年去世。1444年，他手下的逊尼派鞑靼人在山麓放牧、北上掳人，海上贸易归热那亚人的卡法，西部山地则在基督徒的狄奥多罗公国手中。

1475年奥斯曼大军攻占卡法和狄奥多罗，1478年起可汗成为苏丹享有特权的封臣：鞑靼骑兵随奥斯曼军队出征，从波兰-立陶宛和莫斯科维亚掳来的人口被称作「草原收成」，在巴赫奇萨赖的汗廷奴隶市场和各港口出售。德夫莱特一世·格莱把掳掠战争打到莫斯科城下，1571年火烧该城，次年却在莫洛季惨败。1532年，沙希布一世·格莱把驻地迁到巴赫奇萨赖，意为「花园宫」；这座新城距旧崖堡两公里，由奥斯曼、波斯和意大利工匠营建，宫中的泪泉让1820年到访的普希金写下一首长诗。旧要塞此时已称丘富特卡列，成了关押要犯的国家监狱，俄罗斯大贵族舍列梅捷夫1660年被俘后在此度过二十一年。1736年米尼希元帅焚毁巴赫奇萨赖，现在看到的宫殿是1740至1750年代重建的。

1774年的库楚克开纳吉和约割断了汗国与伊斯坦布尔的臣属关系，1783年4月8日叶卡捷琳娜二世兼并半岛。末代可汗沙希恩·格莱1787年在罗得岛被处死。

en:
Kaffa occupies the finest harbour on the Crimean shore, on the site of the Greek city of Theodosia. Genoese traders bought the ground from the Golden Horde in the late thirteenth century and raised a walled port that became the seat of their consul and the centre of Gazaria, the chain of Genoese colonies around the Black Sea. Caravans from the east ended here, and its slave market was one of the greatest in Europe; the town ran its own mint, a branch of the Bank of Saint George and a theatre. Ibn Battuta counted some two hundred ships in the harbour, and by the mid-fifteenth century Kaffa held more than 70,000 people and was said to outsize Constantinople. In 1346 Jani Beg's plague-stricken army besieged the town, and the Italian notary Gabriel de Mussis, who was never in Caffa, wrote that infected corpses were catapulted over the walls; a Genoese ship sailing from the port is said to have carried the Black Death into Europe. In 1444 Genoese, Greeks, Armenians and Jews lived under a Genoese administration, shipping caravan silk and steppe slaves to the Mediterranean, and the city's safety hung on the khans' goodwill.

Mehmed II's fleet under Gedik Ahmed Pasha took Kaffa in June 1475 after a siege of a few days, and its Latin inhabitants were carried off to Istanbul, where they formed the Kefeli quarter. As the Ottoman port of Kefe it kept the greatest slave market of the northern Black Sea and was called Little Istanbul. In 1616 the Zaporozhian hetman Sahaidachny stormed the town, scattered the garrison and freed several thousand captives. The last Crimean khan, Şahin Giray, set up a mint there and began a palace before Russian troops stormed the fortress in 1771. Catherine II walked through its ruins in 1787 with the emperor Joseph II; the town was declared a free port in 1798, and in 1804 it took back its ancient Greek name, Feodosia.
zh:
卡法占着克里米亚海岸最好的港湾，建在希腊古城费奥多西亚的故址上。13世纪末，热那亚商人从金帐汗国手中买下这块地皮，筑起有城墙的港口，设置执政官，统辖热那亚人在黑海沿岸的殖民地群加扎里亚。东方商队以这里为终点，奴隶市场位列欧洲之最；城里还开着自己的造币厂、圣乔治银行分行和一座剧院。伊本·白图泰在港中数到约两百艘船，到15世纪中叶，卡法人口超过七万，据说比君士坦丁堡还大。1346年札尼别汗的染疫大军围城，从未到过卡法的意大利公证人加布里埃尔·德·穆西斯记载，染疫尸体被抛石机投进城内；据说一艘从该港开出的热那亚船把黑死病带进了欧洲。1444年，热那亚人、希腊人、亚美尼亚人和犹太人在热那亚官署治下生活，把商队丝绸和草原奴隶运往地中海，城市安危系于可汗们的善意。

1475年6月，格迪克·艾哈迈德帕夏率领穆罕默德二世的舰队只围了几天便攻下卡法，拉丁裔居民被迁往伊斯坦布尔，在那里形成凯费利街区。成为奥斯曼的凯费港后，它保有黑海北岸最大的奴隶市场，人称「小伊斯坦布尔」。1616年，扎波罗热哥萨克盖特曼萨盖达奇内突袭该城，击溃守军，解救数千名俘虏。末代克里米亚可汗沙希恩·格莱曾在此开设造币厂、动工修建宫殿；1771年俄军强攻夺取要塞。1787年，叶卡捷琳娜二世与皇帝约瑟夫二世一同走过城中废墟；1798年这里被辟为自由港，1804年恢复古希腊旧名费奥多西亚。

en:
The Don enters the Sea of Azov here, some sixteen kilometres from the open water, and the river mouth has drawn traders since antiquity. Bosporan Greeks founded Tanais at the end of the third century BC, the emporion where steppe nomads bartered slaves and hides for wine and cloth. The medieval town of Tana grew up beside the Golden Horde city of Azak, a station on the caravan route from China, where Venetian and Genoese merchants held walled quarters of their own; after Timur sacked Azak in 1395 the Genoese rebuilt the colony. In 1444 Tana, administered from Caffa, was the busiest slave market on the northern Black Sea shore. Tatar raiders sold Rus' and Circassian captives there for Mediterranean galleys and the Mamluk army in Egypt, while grain, furs and salt fish moved west in payment.

In 1475 the Ottoman fleet of Gedik Ahmed Pasha, on the same Crimean expedition that stormed Caffa, took Tana for Mehmed II and rebuilt it as the stone fortress of Azak, the empire's northernmost port. A stone wall with eleven towers girdled the hill, ditches and ramparts covered the suburbs, and a garrison of 4,000 foot served more than 200 guns. In June 1637 Don and Zaporozhian Cossacks under Ataman Tatarinov stormed the fortress, and in 1641 they held the ruins for months against Hüseyin Pasha's army: Turkish fire left only three of the eleven towers standing, and the Cossacks answered with countermines that blew up hundreds of janissaries. Tsar Mikhail in Moscow wanted no Ottoman war and ordered them out in 1642.

Peter the Great's first Azov campaign failed beneath the walls in 1695; after he built a fleet at Voronezh, Cossacks broke into two bastions in July 1696 and the garrison surrendered, a gain confirmed by the Treaty of Constantinople in 1700. Peter lost Azov again after the Prut campaign of 1711. In 1736 Marshal Lacy bombarded it until a powder magazine blew up on 19 June, and his night assault forced the pasha to surrender; the Peace of Belgrade in 1739 left Azov to Russia on condition its fortifications were razed. Cossacks reoccupied the town in 1769, and the Treaty of Küçük Kaynarca in 1774 confirmed it to Russia in perpetuity.
zh:
顿河在距海十六公里处注入亚速海，河口自古以来就吸引着商人。公元前3世纪末，博斯普鲁斯王国的希腊人在此建立塔纳伊斯，草原牧民在这座商埠用奴隶和皮货换取葡萄酒和布匹。中世纪的塔纳城兴起于金帐汗国城市阿扎克旁，是通往中国的商路上的一站，威尼斯和热那亚商人各自建有围墙环绕的商馆；1395年帖木儿洗劫阿扎克后，热那亚人重建了殖民地。1444年的塔纳由卡法管辖，是黑海北岸最繁忙的奴隶市场：鞑靼人把掳来的罗斯人和切尔克斯人卖到地中海的桨帆船上和埃及的马穆鲁克军队里，粮食、毛皮和咸鱼则源源西运，抵作货款。

1475年，格迪克·艾哈迈德帕夏的奥斯曼舰队在攻取卡法的同一次克里米亚远征中，为穆罕默德二世夺下塔纳，将它改建为石砌要塞阿扎克，这是帝国最北的港口。一道带十一座塔楼的石墙围住山丘，壕沟与土垒屏护城郊，四千步兵守军操作两百多门火炮。1637年6月，顿河与扎波罗热哥萨克在首领塔塔里诺夫率领下袭取要塞；1641年，他们据守残垣顶住侯赛因帕沙大军数月围攻：炮火过后十一座塔楼只剩三座，哥萨克则对挖地道爆破，一次能炸死数百名耶尼切里。莫斯科的米哈伊尔沙皇不愿与奥斯曼开战，1642年下令弃城。

彼得大帝1695年第一次远征顿兵坚城之下，无功而返；他在沃罗涅日建起舰队后，1696年7月哥萨克攻入两座棱堡，守军投降，1700年《君士坦丁堡条约》确认亚速归俄国。1711年普鲁特远征失败，彼得又失去它。1736年，拉斯元帅持续炮击，6月19日火药库爆炸，夜袭迫使帕沙献城；1739年《贝尔格莱德和约》把亚速留给俄国，条件是拆毁城防。1769年哥萨克再度占领，1774年《小凯纳尔贾条约》予以永久确认。

en:
The Kuban rises in the Caucasus highlands and runs west through open grassland to the Sea of Azov, dividing two kinds of country: the bare right-bank steppe where Tatar herds graze, and the wooded left bank and foothills held by Circassian tribes. Greeks of the Bosporan kingdom planted colonies on the coast, and after the Mongol conquest Genoese factories such as Kopa on the lower river shipped grain, salt fish and steppe slaves to Caffa and Constantinople. In 1444 the Golden Horde is breaking apart: Hacı Giray, newly returned from long exile in Lithuania, is fighting his way to the Crimean throne and founding the Giray khanate on the Horde's ruins, Tatar clans moving on to the right bank lean toward him, and the Circassians keep to their forests across the river.

From the sixteenth century the Nogais nomadized the right bank and supplied the Giray khans with horses for their slave raids into Rus; after 1475 the coastal factories belonged to the Ottoman sultans and the khans ruled the steppe as their vassals. The Kuban also became a refuge for runaways from Russia. Old Believers settled at the mouth of the Laba with the khan's leave in 1688, and after Bulavin's revolt collapsed in 1708 Ignat Nekrasov brought some 3,000 Don Cossacks with their families to the same country; his Nekrasovtsy raided the Russian border from Kuban camps until the 1730s, when most moved on to Ottoman lands on the Danube. Russian troops reached the steppe in 1777, when the Stavropol fortress went up on the Azov-Mozdok fortified line, and after the khanate's annexation in 1783 Suvorov smashed the Nogai rising on the river. In 1792 Catherine II granted the right bank to the Black Sea Cossack Host; tens of thousands of these former Zaporozhians crossed from Ukraine, strung a cordon facing the Circassian highlands and in 1793 founded Yekaterinodar, whose name means Catherine's gift.
zh:
库班河发源于高加索山地，向西穿过开阔草原注入亚速海，把两岸分成两种地方：右岸是裸露的草原，牧放鞑靼人的畜群；左岸林木繁盛，山前地带归切尔克斯诸部所有。博斯普鲁斯王国的希腊人曾在沿海广建殖民城市，蒙古征服之后，科帕等热那亚商站设在下游，把粮食、咸鱼和草原奴隶运往卡法和君士坦丁堡。1444年正值金帐汗国崩解：从立陶宛长期流亡归来的哈吉·格来正以武力争夺克里米亚汗位，在汗国废墟上建立格来王朝，迁到右岸的鞑靼部落倒向他，切尔克斯人则守着河对岸的山林。

16世纪起，诺盖人游牧于右岸，为格来诸汗供应马匹，支撑他们深入罗斯掳人为奴；1475年后沿海商站归奥斯曼苏丹所有，汗王们作为藩属统治草原。库班也成了俄国逃亡者的去处。1688年，旧礼仪派经汗王许可在拉巴河口落脚；1708年布拉文起义失败后，伊格纳特·涅克拉索夫带着约三千名顿河哥萨克和家小来到同一地带，其部「涅克拉索夫派」从库班营地袭扰俄国边境，直到1730年代大部分人继续迁往多瑙河畔的奥斯曼属地。1777年俄军进入草原，亚速—莫兹多克防线上建起斯塔夫罗波尔要塞；1783年汗国被兼并，苏沃洛夫在河畔击溃诺盖起义。1792年，叶卡捷琳娜二世把右岸封给黑海哥萨克军，数以万计的扎波罗热哥萨克从乌克兰迁来，朝切尔克斯山地布下警戒线，并于1793年建起叶卡捷琳诺达尔，城名意为「叶卡捷琳娜的礼物」。

en:
The lower Don crosses open grassland from the great bend at Tsaritsyn to the sea below Azov, the old corridor where herdsmen pastured their stock and travellers between the Volga and the Black Sea changed horses. In 1444 it belonged to the Great Horde, whose Tatar clans grazed cattle and horses along the river in the name of their khan; fish, salt and livestock were its only wealth, and it had no towns. After the Crimean Girays destroyed the Horde in 1502, the empty pastures between Crimean and Nogai grazing grounds filled with fugitive peasants and freebooters, who by the mid-sixteenth century had formed Cossack fishing and raiding camps along the river.

In 1570, the year Ivan the Terrible sent the Don Cossacks their first tsar's charter, Don and Zaporozhian men built a fortified camp called Cherkassk on a Don island. From there in 1637 they and their Zaporozhian allies stormed the Ottoman fortress of Azov and defended it against the sultan's armies until 1642, a defense Russian historiography calls the Azov Sitting; a Turkish raid burned Cherkassk in 1643, but the town was rebuilt and in 1644 became the Don Host's capital. The island was home to the most famous Don atamans. Yermak Timofeyevich, who led the Cossack conquest of Siberia, is counted among its men; Stepan Razin's revolt began here in 1667, and chains said to have held him were long shown in the cathedral; Kondraty Bulavin was killed in his own house after his rising of 1707-08 failed. Peter I mustered his armies at Cherkassk for the Azov campaign of 1696, and the Resurrection Cathedral, with its famous gilded wooden iconostasis, was consecrated in 1719. Spring floods drowned the island most years and a fire in 1744 gutted the crowded wooden town, so in 1805 Ataman Matvei Platov moved the Host capital to the new hill town of Novocherkassk; the old island became Starocherkassk, Old Cherkassk.
zh:
下顿河穿过一片开阔草原，从察里津附近的大河曲直到亚速以下的海口，早年间牧人在此放牧畜群，往来伏尔加河与黑海的旅人在此换马。1444年它属于大帐汗国，鞑靼诸部奉汗的名义沿河放牧牛马；这里没有城镇，财富只有鱼、盐和牲畜。1502年克里米亚格来王朝攻灭大帐后，夹在克里米亚与诺盖牧场之间的空旷草原聚满逃亡农民和武装流民，到16世纪中叶，沿河已出现一座座哥萨克的渔村和劫掠营地。

1570年，即伊凡雷帝向顿河哥萨克颁下第一道沙皇诏书的同一年，顿河人与扎波罗热人在顿河一座岛上筑起设防营地切尔卡斯克。1637年，他们联合扎波罗热盟友从这里攻克奥斯曼要塞亚速，顶住苏丹大军坚守到1642年，俄国史书称这场守卫为「亚速守城」；1643年土耳其人袭毁切尔卡斯克，但城很快重建，1644年成为顿河军首府。这座岛城出过几代最有名的顿河首领：远征西伯利亚的叶尔马克·季莫费耶维奇就被算作此城出身；斯捷潘·拉辛的起义1667年始于这里，教堂里长期陈列着相传锁过他的铁链；孔德拉季·布拉文在1707至1708年起义失败后，死在自己的宅第中。1696年彼得一世为亚速远征在此集结大军，1719年复活节大教堂祝圣，堂内有名的木雕饰金圣像屏也随之落成。春汛年年淹没岛城，1744年一场大火又烧毁了拥挤的木城，1805年首领马特维·普拉托夫把军首府迁往高地上新建的新切尔卡斯克，旧城遂称旧切尔卡斯克。

en:
Chernihiv rises on the Desna, the stronghold of the Siverian tribe and one of the oldest towns of Rus, named in the Rus-Byzantine treaty of 907 and for long the second city of the land after Kyiv. From the 11th century its princes held the largest principality in Rus, whose lands at their height reached Murom, Ryazan and Tmutarakan. Prince Mstislav founded a stone court and began the Transfiguration Cathedral; when he died in 1036, the story went, its walls stood no higher than a horseman, and the restored church is one of the few pre-Mongol Rus buildings to survive. A Chernihiv hegumen, Daniel, wrote one of Rus's first travel books after he reached Jerusalem, and Igor Svyatoslavich, hero of the Tale of Igor's Campaign, ended his life as prince of Chernihiv around 1201. The great Black Grave burial mound of the town's earlier rulers rises on its outskirts. Chernihiv held perhaps 25,000 people when Batu's armies sacked it in 1239, and it then fell into centuries of obscurity.

It passed to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in 1353, and its wooden fortress was rebuilt in the 1370s; Moscow held it from 1408 to 1420 before it reverted to Lithuania. In 1444 Chernihiv was a Lithuanian marcher town on the Desna, half recovered from the Mongol ruin, watching both the steppe and Muscovy. Tatar raiders burned it in 1482 and 1497, and Moscow conquered it in 1503 and rebuilt the citadel.

By the Deulino truce of 1618 it went to the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, which gave the town Magdeburg law in 1623 and made it the seat of Chernihiv Voivodeship in 1635. Its people rose with the Khmelnytsky Uprising in 1648 and the town became the headquarters of a Cossack regiment; the Andrusovo truce of 1667 confirmed it to Russia, inside the autonomous Hetmanate. Archbishop Lazar Baranovych brought a printing press here in 1675, the Chernihiv Collegium opened in 1700 as the first higher school on the Dnieper's left bank, and the old churches were rebuilt in Ukrainian baroque. Catherine II's administration made Chernihiv a viceroyalty seat in 1782.
zh:
切尔尼戈夫坐落于杰斯纳河畔，是谢韦里安人的重镇、罗斯最古老的城市之一，其名已见于907年罗斯与拜占庭签订的条约，长期是仅次于基辅的罗斯第二大城。11世纪起，这里的王公统治着罗斯最大的公国，疆土最广时远及穆罗姆、梁赞和特穆塔拉干。姆斯季斯拉夫公在此建起石造王府，动工修建变容大教堂；相传他1036年去世时，墙才砌到一个骑马人那么高，这座后来几经修复的教堂是少数保存下来的蒙古入侵前罗斯建筑之一。切尔尼戈夫修道院长丹尼尔远行耶路撒冷，写下罗斯最早的行记之一；《伊戈尔远征记》的主人公勇者伊戈尔约在1201年死在切尔尼戈夫公任上。城郊还立着更早统治者的大冢「黑坟」。1239年拔都的大军洗劫此城时，城中约有两万五千人，此后它陷入了长达数百年的沉寂。

1353年它并入立陶宛大公国，1370年代木构要塞得以重修；1408至1420年莫斯科一度占据该城，随后它又回到立陶宛手中。1444年的切尔尼戈夫是杰斯纳河畔立陶宛的一座边城，正从蒙古浩劫中慢慢恢复，同时戒备着草原与莫斯科两个方向。1482年和1497年，鞑靼人两度焚城；1503年莫斯科将其征服，改建了内城堡垒。

1618年杰乌利诺停战把它划给波兰立陶宛联邦，1623年城市获颁马格德堡法，1635年成为切尔尼戈夫省省会。1648年城里人随赫梅利尼茨基起义举事，城市成为一个哥萨克团的驻地；1667年安德鲁索沃停战确认其归属俄国，但仍属自治的盖特曼国。1675年大主教拉扎尔·巴拉诺维奇把印刷所迁到此地，1700年切尔尼戈夫学堂开办，成为第聂伯河左岸第一所高等学校，老教堂也按乌克兰巴洛克风格重修。1782年叶卡捷琳娜二世的行政改革把切尔尼戈夫定为总督区驻地。

en:
Poltava occupies rising ground on the Vorskla, where grain country meets the Pontic steppe. The Hypatian Chronicle first records a crossing here as Ltava in 1174. Archaeology does not support the old story that Mongols destroyed it in 1238-39; Ukrainian sources place the ruin of the early settlement after the Battle of the Vorskla in 1399. The name Poltava appears by 1430, when a later Glinski genealogy says Grand Duke Vytautas granted the place to Alexander Glinski, a Tatar noble who had entered Lithuanian service and accepted baptism. The story is not well attested, but it fits the border population of Lithuanian, Ruthenian and Tatar riders. In 1444 Poltava was a small Orthodox Ruthenian settlement in the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, surrounded by grain lands and exposed to raids from the steppe.

Crimean Tatars under Mengli I Giray sacked it in 1482, and after the Union of Lublin in 1569 the town passed to the Polish Crown. Poltava became a Cossack centre during the Khmelnytsky Uprising in 1648, when the Poltava Regiment made its headquarters here. Colonel Martyn Pushkar helped finance the Holy Cross Exaltation Monastery, founded in 1650 after a Cossack victory on the Poltavka River. Pushkar later rebelled against Hetman Ivan Vyhovsky; Crimean Tatar allies helped crush the rising in 1658 and burned Poltava. The town had accepted Muscovite authority at Pereiaslav in 1654, and the Andrusovo truce confirmed the Left Bank under Moscow in 1667. Poltava entered European history in 1709, when Charles XII's Swedish army besieged its fortress and supply depot on the Vorskla. Swedish troops occupied the monastery and used its raised ground against the fortress. On 8 July Peter I's relieving army defeated the Swedes nearby; Charles XII and Ivan Mazepa escaped south to Ottoman territory.
zh:
波尔塔瓦位于沃尔斯克拉河畔高地，粮田地带在这里接上黑海草原。《伊帕季耶夫编年史》在1174年首次记载这处名为勒塔瓦的渡口。考古发现并不支持它在1238至1239年被蒙古人摧毁的旧说；乌克兰文资料把早期聚落的毁坏放在1399年沃尔斯克拉河战役之后。波尔塔瓦之名到1430年已经出现，后来的格林斯基家谱称，立陶宛大公维陶塔斯把此地封给进入立陶宛效力并受洗的鞑靼贵族亚历山大·格林斯基。这一说法缺少充分佐证，却符合这里混居着立陶宛人、鲁塞尼亚人和鞑靼骑兵的边疆状况。1444年，波尔塔瓦是立陶宛大公国境内一座信奉东正教的鲁塞尼亚小镇，周围是粮田，也容易受到草原袭掠。

1482年，明格里·格来率领的克里米亚鞑靼人洗劫了城镇；1569年卢布林联合后，波尔塔瓦转入波兰王权治下。1648年赫梅利尼茨基起义期间，这里成为哥萨克据点，波尔塔瓦团把总部设在城中。团长马丁·普什卡尔曾出资资助1650年建立的圣十字荣举修道院，修道院的建立是为了纪念哥萨克人在波尔塔夫卡河取胜。普什卡尔后来起兵反对盖特曼伊万·维戈夫斯基；克里米亚鞑靼盟军在1658年帮助镇压起事，并焚毁波尔塔瓦。市民已于1654年在佩列亚斯拉夫接受莫斯科权威，1667年安德鲁索沃停战确认第聂伯河东岸归莫斯科。1709年，卡尔十二世的瑞典军队围攻沃尔斯克拉河畔的波尔塔瓦要塞和军需库，使这座城写入欧洲战史。瑞军占领修道院，利用高地炮击要塞。7月8日，彼得一世的援军在附近击败瑞典人，卡尔十二世和伊万·马泽帕向南逃入奥斯曼领土。

en:
The chalk hills and grasslands along the upper Seversky Donets formed the southern edge of the Severian lands. After Algirdas defeated the Golden Horde at Blue Waters in 1362, Lithuanian sovereignty reached the country, but in 1444 no permanent garrison line held it. Crimean and Nogai raiders followed the Muravsky and Izyum trails through the Wild Fields, seizing people and livestock on the way north. Neither Belgorod nor Kharkiv yet stood as fortified towns.

Muscovy answered the raids with a belt of forts. In 1596 Tsar Feodor I ordered a fortress raised on a white chalk bluff above the Donets, the beginning of Belgorod. A Polish-Lithuanian army took and burned it in 1612, Cossacks besieged the rebuilt post in 1633 and 1634, and the fortress was moved again in 1646. From 1658 Belgorod headed the earthen ramparts, forts and regiments of the Belgorod Line. Farther south, Ruthenian refugees and Cossacks fortified Kharkiv in 1654 at the meeting of the Lopan and Kharkiv rivers; its timber walls carried ten towers, and tax-free sloboda settlements supplied the Sloboda Cossacks who patrolled the frontier. Catherine II abolished the Cossack regiments in 1765 and made Kharkiv the seat of Sloboda Ukraine Governorate. Its university opened in 1805.
zh:
北顿涅茨河上游的白垩丘陵和草原，原是谢韦尔斯克土地的南缘。1362年阿尔吉尔达斯在蓝水河击败金帐汗国后，立陶宛的宗主权延伸到此，但1444年时这里还没有常驻防线。克里米亚和诺盖袭击者沿穆拉夫斯基古道、伊久姆古道穿过荒野，北进时掳走人口和牲畜。别尔哥罗德与哈尔科夫当时都还不是设防城镇。

莫斯科国以一连串要塞应对袭扰。1596年，费奥多尔一世下令在顿涅茨河畔的白色白垩崖上修筑要塞，这便是别尔哥罗德的开端。1612年，波兰—立陶宛军队攻占并焚毁该城；重建后的据点在1633年和1634年遭哥萨克围攻，要塞又于1646年再次迁移。1658年起，别尔哥罗德统辖别尔哥罗德防线的土垒、要塞和各团。更南面的鲁塞尼亚难民和哥萨克于1654年在洛潘河与哈尔科夫河汇流处筑成哈尔科夫堡；木墙上设有十座塔楼，免税的斯洛博达居留地为斯洛博达哥萨克提供人手，由他们巡守边疆。1765年，叶卡捷琳娜二世废除哥萨克军团，将哈尔科夫设为斯洛博达乌克兰省省会。哈尔科夫大学于1805年创立。

en:
Mogilev occupies the high right bank of the Dnieper at the mouth of the Dubrowenka. First recorded in 1267, it belonged to the Grand Duchy of Lithuania from the fourteenth century. Its wharves, ferry crossing and customs post served routes running east toward Muscovy, north toward the Baltic and south toward the Black Sea. In 1444 it was an Orthodox Ruthenian river town under Lithuanian rule; merchants and craft guilds lived from the carrying trade, while a castle on the high ground watched the river approaches.

War helped make the town larger. When Smolensk fell to Muscovy in 1514, many merchants moved downstream to Mogilev, and a new castle was completed there in 1526. A first grant of Magdeburg law came in 1561, and Stephen Báthory confirmed full rights and the first coat of arms in 1577, when 1,261 houses were counted. Muscovite troops burned the Zadubrovien suburb in 1581 during the Livonian War, but the old town and castle held. By 1604 Mogilev had about 15,000 inhabitants, 2,211 houses, eighteen guilds and two regular fairs; its walls were developed into three rampart lines, and an Orthodox brotherhood ran a printing house from 1616. The townsmen admitted the tsar's army in 1654, and Lithuanian sieges failed in 1655 and 1660. On 1 February 1661 the burghers attacked and destroyed the Russian garrison; John Casimir rewarded Mogilev with rights equal to Vilnius and a new coat of arms. A brick town hall rose on the market square in 1681. Peter I had the town burned in September 1708 during the Great Northern War. After the First Partition of 1772 it became a Russian governorate capital; Catherine II met Joseph II here in 1780, and French troops held Mogilev briefly in 1812.
zh:
莫吉廖夫位于第聂伯河高岸、杜布罗文卡河汇入处，1267年首见记载，14世纪起属于立陶宛大公国。这里的码头、渡口和税卡服务于几条商路：向东前往莫斯科，向北通往波罗的海，向南则接黑海。1444年时，它是立陶宛治下一座信奉东正教的鲁塞尼亚河城；商人和行会靠转运贸易为生，高地上的城堡监视着临河通道。

战争也促成了这座城市的扩大。1514年斯摩棱斯克落入莫斯科之手后，许多商人顺河南迁到莫吉廖夫，新城堡也于1526年完工。1561年它首次获得马格德堡法，1577年斯特凡·巴托里确认全部城市权并赐下首枚城徽；当时城中登记有1261栋房屋。1581年利沃尼亚战争期间，莫斯科军队烧毁扎杜布罗文郊区，却没能攻下旧城和城堡。到1604年，莫吉廖夫约有1.5万名居民、2211栋房屋、十八个行会和两个定期集市；城防逐步扩成三道土垒线，一所东正教兄弟会从1616年起经营印刷所。1654年，市民放沙皇军队入城，立陶宛军队随后在1655年和1660年两度围攻不克。1661年2月1日，市民起事歼灭俄国驻军；扬·卡齐米日赏给莫吉廖夫与维尔纽斯同等的权利和一枚新城徽。1681年，市集广场上建起砖砌市政厅。1708年大北方战争期间，彼得一世于9月下令焚毁此城。1772年第一次瓜分波兰后，它成为俄罗斯的省会；1780年叶卡捷琳娜二世在此会见约瑟夫二世，1812年法军曾短暂占领莫吉廖夫。

en:
Smolensk commands the upper Dnieper and the short portages between the Dnieper, Western Dvina and Volga, hinge of the route from the Varangians to the Greeks. First recorded in 863 as a Krivichi stronghold, it became the seat of its own principality in 1054, and by the late twelfth century its princes could contest the throne of Kiev. The Mongols did not take the city in 1240, but it paid tribute to the Golden Horde. Vytautas of Lithuania seized it by a ruse in 1395; in August 1401 Oleg of Ryazan restored Prince Yury Svyatoslavich, and pro-Lithuanian boyars opened the gates to Vytautas on 24 June 1404. Smolensk regiments fought for him at Grunwald in 1410. In 1444 the Orthodox river city was Lithuania's chief fortress facing Moscow.

Vasily III's armies took Smolensk in 1514 after three campaigns. To secure the western border, Boris Godunov put Fyodor Kon in charge of a brick wall built from 1595 to 1602, 6.5 kilometres long, with three tiers of gun embrasures and more towers than any earlier Russian fortress. In September 1609 Sigismund III of Poland-Lithuania laid siege, and Mikhail Shein's garrison held for twenty months, refusing even the Seven Boyars' order to surrender. When the city fell in June 1611 the last defenders and townspeople crowded into the old Assumption Cathedral above the powder store; as the Poles broke in, a townsman named Andrei Belyanitsyn set off the powder, and the cathedral blew up with many of the attackers. Shein was pulled from a tower, tortured and carried to eight years in Polish captivity, and the siege cost Sigismund so many men that he could not march on Moscow. The Truce of Deulino confirmed Commonwealth rule in 1618, and a Russian attempt to retake Smolensk failed in the Smolensk War of 1632-1634. Russian troops returned in 1654 and took the garrison's surrender on 23 September; the Truce of Andrusovo confirmed the transfer in 1667. In August 1812 Napoleon fought his way into the city, his bombardment burned most of Smolensk, and the road to Moscow lay open.
zh:
斯摩棱斯克扼守第聂伯河上游，以及第聂伯河、西德维纳河与伏尔加河之间的短途水陆转运点，是「从瓦良格人到希腊人」商路的枢纽。863年记载初现时，它是克里维奇人的重镇；1054年成为独立公国都城，到12世纪末，斯摩棱斯克王公已能角逐基辅大公之位。1240年蒙古人未能破城，但城市仍须向金帐汗国纳贡。立陶宛的维陶塔斯1395年用计夺取斯摩棱斯克；1401年8月，梁赞王公奥列格帮助尤里·斯维亚托斯拉维奇复位，亲立陶宛波雅尔又在1404年6月24日向维陶塔斯打开城门。1410年，斯摩棱斯克军团随他参加格伦瓦德之战。1444年，这座东正教河畔城市是立陶宛面向莫斯科的首要要塞。

瓦西里三世三征之后，于1514年攻下斯摩棱斯克。为巩固西部边界，鲍里斯·戈东诺夫把修筑砖墙的工程交给费奥多尔·孔；城墙1595年至1602年建成，长6.5公里，设三层射击孔，塔楼比以往任何一座俄罗斯要塞都多。1609年9月，波兰立陶宛国王齐格蒙特三世围城，米哈伊尔·沙因率守军坚守二十个月，连莫斯科七波雅尔政府令其投降都拒不从命。1611年6月城破时，最后的守军和百姓退入火药库上方的旧圣母升天大教堂；波兰人冲入之际，市民安德烈·别利亚尼钦引爆火药，大教堂连同许多敌军一同炸毁。沙因在一座塔楼中力竭被俘，遭受酷刑，被押往波兰囚禁八年；围城也让齐格蒙特折损太多人马，再无力进军莫斯科。1618年《杰乌利诺停战协定》确认联邦统治，1632年至1634年的斯摩棱斯克战争中，俄军再次夺城失败。1654年俄军卷土重来，9月23日接受守军投降，1667年《安德鲁索沃停战协定》确认归属变更。1812年8月，拿破仑攻入斯摩棱斯克，炮火焚毁大半城区，通向莫斯科的道路就此打开。

en:
Tver grew up where the Tvertsa and Tmaka enter the Volga, on the river route linking Novgorod's western trade with the Volga towns. It began as a Novgorodian trading station, then in 1247 became the seat of Yaroslav Yaroslavich, younger brother of Alexander Nevsky. Woods and bogs sheltered refugees from the southern steppe lands, and the new principality became Moscow's strongest rival for leadership of the Russian towns. Its princes paid for that challenge. The Horde killed Mikhail Yaroslavich in 1318; the anti-Tatar rising of 1327 was put down with Moscow's help and the city was sacked; even so, Dmitry Donskoy's great siege of 1375 failed before its ramparts. Tver struck its own coins, kept a Tatar merchants' court, and sold local locks as far as Bohemia. In 1444 Grand Prince Boris Aleksandrovich still ruled an Orthodox trading city allied with Lithuania, the last major Russian principality outside Moscow's control.

The merchant Afanasy Nikitin gave Tver its best-known journey when he travelled from the Volga to India and wrote A Journey Beyond the Three Seas, one of the earliest European eyewitness accounts of the subcontinent. Ivan III's armies ended Tver's independence on 12 September 1485. The old ruling house suffered again under Ivan the Terrible, and the deposed Metropolitan Philip was strangled at the Otroch Monastery in 1569. Polish-Lithuanian troops wrecked the town during the Time of Troubles. After the fire of 1763, Catherine II had the medieval centre rebuilt as a regular neoclassical town; Matvei Kazakov's Travel Palace, built in 1764-1766, lodged emperors on the Moscow-St Petersburg road. The limestone White Trinity Church had been completed in 1564, before the fire and the neoclassical rebuilding. In the early nineteenth century the historian Nikolai Karamzin read chapters of his History of the Russian State to Alexander I in the governor's palace.
zh:
特维尔在特维尔察河和季马卡河注入伏尔加河处兴起，处在诺夫哥罗德西线贸易与伏尔加城镇之间的水路上。它起初是诺夫哥罗德商人的驿站，1247年成为亚历山大·涅夫斯基之弟雅罗斯拉夫·雅罗斯拉维奇的驻地，后来发展成莫斯科争夺罗斯诸城领导权时最强的对手。森林和沼泽为南方草原来的流民提供遮蔽，特维尔的王公也付出沉重代价。金帐汗国1318年处死米哈伊尔·雅罗斯拉维奇；1327年反鞑靼起义在莫斯科协助下被镇压，城市遭劫；德米特里·顿斯科伊1375年率大军围攻，仍被城墙和壕沟挡住。特维尔自铸钱币，设有鞑靼商人客栈，本地锁具在14世纪已卖到波希米亚。1444年，鲍里斯·亚历山德罗维奇仍统治着这座与立陶宛结盟的东正教商业城市，也是莫斯科之外最后一个重要的罗斯公国。

商人阿法纳西·尼基京为特维尔留下最有名的远行：他从伏尔加河一路前往印度，写下《三海航行记》，是欧洲人最早根据亲身见闻记述印度的作品之一。1485年9月12日，伊凡三世的军队结束了特维尔的独立。旧王族在伊凡雷帝时代再度遭难，遭黜的都主教菲利普1569年在奥特罗奇修道院被缢杀。动荡时期，波兰立陶宛军队摧毁了城区。1763年大火后，叶卡捷琳娜二世按规整的新古典主义方案重建中世纪旧城；马特维·卡扎科夫在1764至1766年设计巡幸宫，供皇室往返莫斯科与圣彼得堡途中驻跸。白色石灰岩圣三一堂已于1564年建成，早于这场大火和新古典主义重建。19世纪初，史学家尼古拉·卡拉姆津曾在省长宫中向亚历山大一世诵读《俄罗斯国家史》的章节。

en:
Moscow grew up on the Moskva River, where the low Borovitsky Hill commanded the river crossings. Chronicles first name it in 1147, Yuri Dolgorukiy fortified the hill in 1156, and the Mongols burned the settlement in 1237–38. In 1263 Daniel, youngest son of Alexander Nevsky, inherited the small outpost and founded the princely line that built the state. The metropolitan moved his see from Vladimir in 1325, Ivan Kalita rebuilt the fortress in oak in 1339, and Dmitry Donskoy put up white-stone walls in 1366–68 before Kulikovo in 1380; the icon painter Andrei Rublev was a monk of the Andronikov Monastery on the Yauza. In 1444, under Vasily II, Moscow was the Orthodox spiritual centre of northeastern Rus and a rising capital of merchants and craftsmen.

After the standoff on the Ugra ended Tatar suzerainty in 1480, Ivan III put Italian architects to rebuilding the Kremlin: Aristotele Fioravanti built the Dormition Cathedral there, brick walls and towers went up from 1485 to 1495, and the Faceted Palace rose beside them. Ivan IV was crowned tsar in the Kremlin in 1547, and his Kazan and Astrakhan campaigns were marked by St Basil's Cathedral on Red Square, raised in 1555–61 with nine onion domes; legend says Ivan blinded its architect so he could never build anything to rival it. On 24 May 1571 Devlet Giray's Crimean army bypassed the Oka line and burned all of Moscow outside the Kremlin. The famine of 1601–03 opened the Time of Troubles, a Polish-Lithuanian garrison held the Kremlin from 1610 until Minin and Pozharsky's militia forced it out in 1612, and the Zemsky Sobor elected Michael Romanov tsar in 1613. The Salt Riot of 1648 and the Copper Riot of 1662 shook the merchant posads outside the walls.

Peter I moved the court to Saint Petersburg in 1712, and the coronations stayed in Moscow. Moscow University was founded in 1755 at the urging of Lomonosov and Shuvalov. Napoleon entered the city on 14 September 1812 after Borodino; fires from 14 to 18 September destroyed most of the wooden houses, and the French left on 19 October. Alexander I put Osip Bove in charge of rebuilding, and the old earthen ramparts gave way to ring boulevards.
zh:
莫斯科兴起于莫斯科河畔，低矮的博罗维茨基山扼守着河上渡口。编年史1147年首次提到它，尤里·多尔戈鲁基1156年在山上筑垒，蒙古人1237至1238年焚毁了居民点。1263年，亚历山大·涅夫斯基的幼子丹尼尔继承这座小据点，开创了莫斯科王公世系。1325年都主教把教座从弗拉基米尔迁来，1339年伊凡·卡利塔以橡木重建堡垒，1366至1368年德米特里·顿斯科伊筑起白石城墙，随后是1380年的库里科沃之战；圣像画家安德烈·鲁布廖夫是雅乌扎河畔安德罗尼科夫修道院的修士。1444年瓦西里二世在位时，莫斯科已是东北罗斯的东正教精神中心、一座商人与工匠的崛起之都。

1480年乌格拉河对峙结束鞑靼宗主权后，伊凡三世命意大利建筑师重建克里姆林：阿里斯多泰尔·菲奥拉万蒂建起圣母升天大堂，砖砌城墙和塔楼1485至1495年修成，多棱宫也在旁落成。伊凡四世1547年在克里姆林加冕为沙皇；为纪念攻取喀山和阿斯特拉罕，红场边1555至1561年竖起九座洋葱穹顶的圣瓦西里大教堂，相传伊凡弄瞎了建筑师，让他无法再造匹敌之作。1571年5月24日，德夫列特·格莱的克里米亚军队绕过奥卡河防线，烧毁克里姆林以外的整个莫斯科。1601至1603年饥荒开启动乱时代，波兰-立陶宛驻军1610年占据克里姆林，1612年被米宁和波扎尔斯基的民军逼退，缙绅会议1613年立米哈伊尔·罗曼诺夫为沙皇。1648年盐税暴动和1662年铜币暴动震动城墙外的商人城关。

彼得一世1712年把宫廷迁往圣彼得堡，加冕礼仍在莫斯科举行。1755年，经罗蒙诺索夫和舒瓦洛夫倡议，莫斯科大学创办。1812年9月14日（俄历9月2日），拿破仑在博罗季诺战役后进入莫斯科；9月14日至18日的大火烧毁大部分木房，法军10月19日撤离。亚历山大一世命奥西普·博韦主持重建，旧土垒改造成环形林荫道。

en:
Kaluga guards the Oka crossings about 150 kilometres southwest of Moscow, on the Kaluzhka and Yachenka streams. It first appears in writing in 1371, when Grand Duke Algirdas of Lithuania named the volost of Koluga in a complaint to the Patriarch of Constantinople that Moscow had seized it; Dmitry Donskoy bequeathed it to his son Andrei in 1389. Through the next half-century it was a Muscovite frontier stronghold, watching Lithuania and holding the Oka defence line against steppe raiders. In 1444 its garrison and the grain villages around it covered one of Moscow's most exposed southwestern approaches.

The Great Stand on the Ugra River unfolded just west of the town in 1480, when Ivan III's army shadowed Akhmat Khan until the Great Horde withdrew, an event Russian tradition counts as the end of Tatar suzerainty. Early in the next century the kremlin was moved to a higher bluff above the Oka. In the Time of Troubles Ivan Bolotnikov gathered some ten thousand rebels in Kaluga, held the town against the tsar's army through the winter of 1606-1607, and broke the blockade in May. After the Tushino camp broke up, False Dmitry II made Kaluga his capital; on 21 December 1610 Peter Urusov, a baptized Tatar prince, shot and sabred him while he hunted hare outside the town, and the townspeople answered by killing every Tatar in Kaluga. Polish forces held the town in 1611-1612.

Later in the seventeenth century Kaluga opened one of Russia's first iron foundries, and in 1697 the Korobov family's stone chambers went up. Catherine II made the town the seat of Kaluga Viceroyalty in 1776, and its theatre opened the next year; from 1786 Shahin Giray, the last Crimean khan, lived there in exile. In 1812 Kaluga was the main Russian rear base, mustering militia and gathering grain, while Kutuzov barred the Kaluga road to Napoleon and turned the retreating French onto the wasted Smolensk road.
zh:
卡卢加扼守莫斯科西南约一百五十公里处的奥卡河渡口，卡卢日卡河与亚琴卡河从旁流过。它最早见于文字是在1371年：立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯在致君士坦丁堡牧首的信中提到科卢加乡，指责莫斯科夺走了它；1389年，德米特里·顿斯科伊在遗嘱中把它分给儿子安德烈。此后半个世纪，这里一直是莫斯科的边境要塞，既要防备立陶宛，又要在奥卡防线上抵御草原袭掠者。1444年，城中的驻军和周围的谷物村庄掩护着莫斯科西南方向最暴露的一条通道。

1480年，乌格拉河对峙就发生在城西，伊凡三世的军队与阿黑麻汗隔河周旋，直到大帐汗国撤军，俄罗斯传统把这次对峙视为鞑靼宗主权终结的标志。16世纪初，克里姆林迁到奥卡河畔更高的崖岸。动乱时期，伊凡·博洛特尼科夫在卡卢加聚集约一万名叛军，1606至1607年冬顶住沙皇军队的围攻，并在5月打破封锁。图希诺营寨瓦解后，伪德米特里二世把卡卢加定为自己的都城；1610年12月21日，受洗的鞑靼王公彼得·乌鲁索夫趁他在城外猎兔，开枪再用马刀将他杀死，市民随即杀尽城中的鞑靼人。1611至1612年，波兰军队占领了这座城。

17世纪后期，卡卢加办起俄国最早的铸铁厂之一，1697年科罗博夫家族的石宅落成。1776年，叶卡捷琳娜二世把这里设为卡卢加总督区驻地，次年当地剧院开幕；末代克里米亚汗沙希恩·格莱自1786年起被流放于此。1812年，卡卢加是俄军主要的后方基地，征召民团、囤积粮草，库图佐夫则在卡卢加大道挡住拿破仑，迫使撤退的法军走上已遭破坏的斯摩棱斯克大道。

en:
Bryansk lies on the Desna, deep in the thick woods that gave it its name, for debry meant dense woodland in the old Slavic tongue. It is first recorded as Debryansk in 1146, the northernmost Severian town held by the Olgovichi of Chernigov. After the Mongols destroyed Chernigov and put its prince Mikhail to death in 1246, his son Roman Mikhailovich made the surviving forest town his capital; it later passed to the princes of Smolensk and was sacked again in 1310. Algirdas of Lithuania took it in 1356 and enfeoffed it to his son Dmitry. In 1444 Bryansk is a Lithuanian marcher town of timber ramparts and Orthodox merchants on the forest road between Kyiv and Moscow.

In 1500 Ivan III's army entered Bryansk without a fight, and the truce of 1503 confirmed it as Muscovite; it served as a Russian base in every later war with Lithuania. In 1607 the forces of False Dmitry II attacked twice: the citizens burned their own town rather than surrender, then rebuilt the walls within months and beat the siege. Three miles from the town, at the mouth of the Sven, stood the Svensky Monastery. Church legend credits Prince Roman with its foundation on the spot where a miraculous icon of the Theotokos cured him of blindness, an icon later attributed to the monk Alypius of the Kiev Caves Monastery. Crimean Tatars sacked it repeatedly in the sixteenth century, and Ivan the Terrible paid for a new five-domed cathedral; after the Andrusovo truce of 1667 the liveliest fair in the region gathered under its walls every year.

Peter the Great had Bryansk refortified and set up a shipyard on the Desna, where the vessels of the Bryansk flotilla were built for his campaigns against the Ottoman Empire; he stayed at the Svensky Monastery before the Battle of Poltava in 1709. The town became part of the new Oryol Viceroyalty in 1778, and in 1783 the crown founded the Bryansk Arsenal to cast siege and field artillery. The poet Fyodor Tyutchev was born in 1803 at Ovstug, his family's estate in Bryansk county.
zh:
布良斯克位于杰斯纳河畔，深藏在密林之中，城名即来自古东斯拉夫语对密林的称呼「德布尔」。1146年它以「杰布里扬斯克」之名首见记载，是切尔尼戈夫奥尔戈维奇家族手中最北的谢韦尔斯克城镇。1246年蒙古人摧毁切尔尼戈夫、处死王公米哈伊尔后，其子罗曼·米哈伊洛维奇把这座幸存的林中之城立为都城；后来它转归斯摩棱斯克王公，1310年再遭洗劫。1356年立陶宛大公阿尔吉尔达斯夺取布良斯克，封给其子德米特里。1444年的布良斯克是立陶宛的边塞重镇，木墙环绕，东正教商人往来于基辅与莫斯科之间的林中路。

1500年，伊凡三世的军队兵不血刃进入布良斯克，1503年的停战协定确认它归属莫斯科；此后历次对立陶宛的战争，它都是俄军的据点。1607年伪德米特里二世的军队两度来攻，市民纵火焚毁自己的城市也不投降，数月内又修好城墙击退围攻。城外三英里、杰斯纳河与斯文河汇流处是斯文斯基修道院。相传它由罗曼王公始建，地基就选在一幅显灵的圣母圣像治好他眼疾的地方，这幅圣像后来被认为出自基辅洞窟修道院修士阿利皮之手。16世纪克里米亚鞑靼人屡次洗劫修道院，伊凡雷帝出资新建了五穹顶大教堂；1667年《安德鲁索沃停战协定》签订后，这一带最热闹的集市每年都在修道院墙下开集。

彼得大帝下令重修布良斯克城防，并在杰斯纳河开设船厂，布良斯克舰队的船只在这里下水，用于对奥斯曼帝国的战争；1709年波尔塔瓦战役前，他曾在斯文斯基修道院驻留。1778年布良斯克划入新设的奥廖尔总督区，1783年官府又创办布良斯克兵工厂，铸造攻城炮和野战炮。1803年，诗人费奥多尔·秋切夫生于自家在布良斯克县的庄园奥夫斯图格。

en:
Kursk stands at the meeting of the Kur and Tuskar with the Seym, in black-earth country that opens south into the Wild Fields. It began as a Severian frontier fortress of Kievan Rus, and in The Tale of Igor's Campaign Prince Igor calls his Kurskers 'famous knights, swaddled under war-horns, nursed under helmets, fed from the point of the lance'. The Mongols wrecked the town, and Nogai's Horde sacked it again in 1285. After 1362 the Severian lands came under Lithuanian sovereignty, but in 1444 no town is known to have stood on the old hillfort. The name 'Kursk' survived only in treaties and frontier lists while Crimean and Nogai raiders crossed the empty steppe.

Muscovy drew the district into its southern border system in 1508, and Kursk was refounded on two hills above the Tuskar in 1586; a wooden fortress went up in the summer and autumn of 1596 by order of Tsar Feodor I. It formed part of the Belgorod Line, and its garrison, over 1,300 strong in 1616, never let the place fall, through Polish-Lithuanian assaults in 1612, 1616, 1617 and 1634 and repeated Tatar raids. The Znamensky Monastery was founded in the town in 1612. The icon of the Sign called the Kursk Root had been found about 1295 among the roots of a tree in a forest near Kursk and was kept at the Root Hermitage; each year thousands of pilgrims walked with it in procession between the hermitage and the monastery, and the fair beside the hermitage became one of the largest in Russia. Grain and salt moved on the Moscow-Crimea road, a gostiny dvor was built by the mid-seventeenth century, and boats carried goods down the Seym toward Kyiv.

The eighteenth century ended its frontier role. Kursk became the seat of a viceroyalty in 1779, the field marshal Pyotr Rumyantsev its first viceroy, and after the fire of 1781 Catherine II approved its first regular plan the next year. Seraphim of Sarov, later among the most venerated Russian saints, was born here in 1754 to a Kursk merchant family, and in 1797 Kursk became the capital of Kursk Governorate.
zh:
库尔斯克地处库尔河、图斯卡里河汇入谢伊姆河之处，周围是向南铺向荒野的肥沃黑土地。它起初是基辅罗斯的塞韦里安人边塞，《伊戈尔远征记》里，伊戈尔王公出征波洛伏齐人之前这样夸赞自己的库尔斯克部下：他们是「闻名的武士，在军号声中裹襁褓，在头盔下长大，以矛尖为食」。蒙古人摧毁了这座城，1285年那海的汗国军队又将它洗劫。1362年后谢韦尔斯克土地归入立陶宛势力范围，但1444年的旧城高地上已无确证存在的城镇，「库尔斯克」只留在条约和边疆名录中，克里米亚与诺盖袭击者穿行在空旷草原上。

1508年，这一地区被纳入莫斯科国的南部边防体系；1586年，库尔斯克在图斯卡里河畔的两座山丘上重建，1596年夏秋又奉费奥多尔一世之命筑起木堡。它是别尔哥罗德防线的一环，1616年守军已超过一千三百人；面对1612、1616、1617、1634年的波兰—立陶宛进攻和鞑靼、诺盖人不断来犯，这座要塞始终没有陷落。兹纳缅斯基修道院1612年建于城中。与之相关的「库尔斯克根圣像」是一幅征兆圣像，约1295年在城旁森林的一棵树根间被发现，平日供在根隐修院；每年都有数千名朝圣者随行，把圣像在隐修院与兹纳缅斯基修道院之间迎来送往，隐修院旁聚集的集市后来成为俄国最大的集市之一。商人沿莫斯科通往克里米亚的道路买卖粮食和食盐，17世纪中叶建起客商市场，船只也顺谢伊姆河驶向基辅方向。

18世纪，库尔斯克不再是边疆要塞。1779年它成为总督辖区治所，首任总督是陆军元帅彼得·鲁缅采夫；1781年大火后，叶卡捷琳娜二世次年批准了第一份规整城市规划。后来最受崇敬的俄罗斯圣徒之一萨罗夫的塞拉芬1754年生于此地一个商人家庭，1797年库尔斯克成为库尔斯克省省会。

en:
The Voronezh River runs through oak woods and open steppe to join the Don. The chronicles used 'Voronozh' as the name of a whole river region as early as 1177, but its early Slavic forts had mostly failed by the thirteenth century.
