In 1444 the Middle Don belonged to the border world of the Great Horde: Mishar Tatar herdsmen pastured cattle on the grasslands and raiding parties followed the old trails toward Ryazan, and no Russian fortress yet stood on the site.

Muscovy closed the frontier in 1586, when the first voivode, Semyon Saburov, raised the Voronezh fortress above the river. Cossack raiders burned it in April 1590 and it was rebuilt by 1594; during the Time of Troubles the townsmen beat Ivan Zarutsky's rebel Cossacks outside the walls in 1613 and held out against a Polish siege in 1617. From 1613 the garrison shipped grain, cloth, powder and lead downriver to the loyal Don Cossacks, and after 1637 the Voronezh stretch of the Belgorod Line covered the southern settlements. A new oak fortress was built after the fire of 1672, and an Orthodox see was created in 1682.

The town made its name in the Azov campaigns. Peter the Great came in 1695 and turned Voronezh into a state naval yard: about 1,500 barges and sea-boats were built locally, twenty-two galleys and four fire ships were prefabricated at Preobrazhenskoye and reassembled here, and the fleet he gathered cut Azov off from the sea in 1696. That October the Boyar Duma decreed Russia's first regular navy, and by 1711 the Voronezh yards had launched about 215 vessels. Among them was the 58-gun Goto Predestinatsia of 1700, the first Russian ship of the line, built to the tsar's own design without foreign master shipwrights. As the river shoaled the English engineer John Perry dammed it with a sluice, but in 1705 the admiralty moved downriver to Tavrov. Voronezh became the seat of Azov Governorate in 1715 and of Voronezh Governorate in 1725; recruits were formed into jaeger regiments here in 1812. The poet Aleksey Koltsov, son of a local cattle dealer, was born here in 1809.
zh:
沃罗涅日河穿过橡树林和开阔草原，汇入顿河。早在1177年的编年史里，「沃罗涅日」已是一整片河区的名字，但当地早期的斯拉夫人要塞到13世纪已大多废弃。1444年，顿河中游属于大帐汗国的边疆世界：米舍尔鞑靼牧人在草原上放牧牲畜，袭掠队伍沿古道奔向梁赞，后来沃罗涅日城所在的地方还没有罗斯要塞。

1586年，首任督军谢苗·萨布罗夫在河畔筑起沃罗涅日要塞，把这条边疆纳入莫斯科的防线。1590年4月哥萨克袭扰者焚毁要塞，到1594年城已重建。混乱时期，市民1613年在城外击败伊万·扎鲁茨基的叛乱哥萨克，1617年又顶住波兰人的围攻。自1613年起，守军沿水路向效忠莫斯科的顿河哥萨克运送粮食、布匹、火药和铅弹；1637年后，别尔哥罗德防线的沃罗涅日段为南部定居点提供屏障。1672年大火后，一座新的橡木要塞建成，东正教区也于1682年设立。

让沃罗涅日留名青史的是亚速远征。1695年彼得大帝亲临此地，把它变成国营造船场：全地区建造约一千五百艘驳船和海船，二十二艘桨帆船和四艘火船在普列奥布拉任斯科耶村造成后拆散运来、在此重新拼装；他集结的舰队1696年从海上切断了亚速的外援。同年10月，波雅尔杜马颁令建立俄国第一支正规海军，到1711年沃罗涅日各船厂共下水约二百一十五艘舰船，其中包括1700年的58炮战舰「神意」号。它是俄国第一艘战列舰，按沙皇本人的设计建成，没有外国造船师参与。河道日渐淤浅，英国工程师约翰·佩里筑坝设闸抬升水位，但1705年海军部仍顺流迁往塔夫罗夫。沃罗涅日1715年成为亚速省治，1725年改为沃罗涅日省治；1812年这里的粮食和牲畜贸易依旧兴旺，新兵在此编成猎兵团。诗人阿列克谢·科尔佐夫是沃罗涅日牲畜商人之子，1809年生于城中。

en:
Tula sits on the Upa, a tributary of the Oka, in the forest-steppe country where trails from the southern steppe ran north toward Moscow. Its first firm mention is a treaty of 1381 between Dmitry Ivanovich of Moscow and Oleg Ivanovich of Ryazan, which calls it a Ryazan border fortress. In 1444 it still belonged to Orthodox Ryazan: an oak stockade watched the steppe roads, and its blacksmiths already worked the district's iron ore.

Moscow annexed Tula in 1503 and had a brick kremlin built on the Upa in 1514-1521, the southern keep of the Great Abatis Belt. In 1552 Devlet I Giray led a Crimean army of thirty thousand against it while Ivan IV marched on Kazan; the garrison under Prince Grigory Temkin-Rostovsky held, and the khan withdrew before the tsar could turn back. During the Time of Troubles the rebel Ivan Bolotnikov made Tula his main base. Vasily Shuysky's army launched twenty assaults on the kremlin between June and October 1607 and broke it only by damming the Upa and flooding the town, after promising the defenders their lives; Shuysky did not keep the promise.

Tula's smiths made the town famous. In 1595 Tsar Fyodor freed its master gunsmiths from taxes and duties in return for making the crown's weapons; the Dutchman Andrei Vinius built the district's first ironworks, and late in the seventeenth century Nikita Demidov took the forges over. A decree of Peter the Great in 1712 established Russia's first state arms factory in Tula, and the Demidovs made the town the empire's gun-making centre. In 1812-1814 its works supplied 600,000 muskets to the army fighting Napoleon, and the Tula militia marched as far as Paris. The town was known for two other wares: the stamped honey-and-spice cakes called Tula pryanik, baked here since the seventeenth century, and the samovars its coppersmiths began turning out in the eighteenth.
zh:
图拉位于奥卡河支流乌帕河畔，地处森林草原地带，南方草原通往莫斯科的道路就经过这里。它第一条可靠记载是1381年莫斯科的德米特里·伊凡诺维奇与梁赞的奥列格·伊凡诺维奇所订条约，其中称图拉为梁赞边境要塞。1444年时它仍属东正教的梁赞：橡木栅栏监视着草原道路，铁匠已在开采本区的铁矿。

1503年图拉并入莫斯科，1514—1521年乌帕河畔建起砖砌克里姆林，是大林障防线南端的支柱。1552年，杰夫列特一世·格莱趁伊凡四世远征喀山，率三万克里米亚大军来攻，格里戈里·捷姆金-罗斯托夫斯基王公指挥守军坚守，汗在沙皇回师前撤走。混乱时期，叛军首领伊凡·博洛特尼科夫以图拉为主要基地。1607年6月至10月，瓦西里·舒伊斯基的军队向克里姆林发动二十次强攻，最后筑坝截断乌帕河、水淹城区，并许诺保全守军性命才破城；舒伊斯基没有兑现承诺。

让图拉出名的是这里的铁匠。1595年，沙皇费奥多尔免除火器匠人师傅的赋税和徭役，条件是为国家制造武器；荷兰人维尼乌斯在本区建起最早的炼铁厂，17世纪末尼基塔·德米多夫接手各作坊。1712年彼得大帝颁令，在图拉建立俄国第一座国营兵工厂，德米多夫家族把此城经营成帝国的枪炮制造中心。1812—1814年，兵工厂向对拿破仑作战的军队提供六十万支火枪，图拉民团一直打到巴黎。图拉还有两样名产：17世纪起在此烤制的印花蜂蜜香料姜饼「图拉姜饼」，以及18世纪当地铜匠开始成批制造的茶炊。

en:
Ryazan lies on the middle Oka, where woodland gives way to steppe. In 1444 the prince's seat was Pereyaslavl-Ryazansky, not the abandoned old capital. Batu Khan's army had destroyed Old Ryazan in December 1237, making it one of the first Rus cities overwhelmed by the Mongol invasion, and the princely court moved upstream. The memory of that frontier shaped the later principality. Under Oleg Ivanovich, Ryazan troops fought beside Muscovites against Mamai's commander Begich on the Vozha in 1378, while Oleg himself balanced between Moscow, Lithuania and the Golden Horde and stayed out of Kulikovo two years later. In 1444 Ivan Fyodorovich still ruled a separate Orthodox principality, exposed to steppe raids and pressed by a rapidly expanding Moscow.

When Ivan Fyodorovich died in 1456, Moscow guarded his young heir for eight years before Vasily Ivanovich began his reign in 1464 and married Ivan III's sister. The marriage did not preserve the dynasty. The last prince, Ivan Ivanovich, was summoned to Moscow and imprisoned in 1520 on suspicion of treating with the Crimean khan; in 1521 he escaped to Lithuania while Ryazan was merged into the Russian state. Crimean raids continued to strike the land later in the century. During the Time of Troubles the Ryazan noble Prokopy Lyapunov became one of the leaders of the first national militia, which marched on Polish-held Moscow in 1611; he was killed there that July. In 1778 Catherine II made Pereyaslavl-Ryazansky the seat of the Ryazan viceroyalty and renamed the town Ryazan, and Paul I reorganized it as a governorate in 1796.
zh:
梁赞位于奥卡河中游，森林在这里让位于草原。1444年时，大公的驻地是佩列亚斯拉夫尔-梁赞斯基，而不是已经荒废的旧都。1237年12月，拔都的军队摧毁旧梁赞，使它成为蒙古入侵中最早被吞没的罗斯城市之一，梁赞宫廷随后迁往上游。边疆的记忆也塑造了后来的公国。奥列格·伊万诺维奇治下，梁赞军队曾在1378年与莫斯科军队一同在沃扎河对抗马迈的将领别吉奇；奥列格本人却在莫斯科、立陶宛和金帐汗国之间周旋，两年后没有参加库里科沃之战。1444年，伊凡·费奥多罗维奇仍统治着一个独立的东正教公国，既暴露在草原袭扰之下，也承受着迅速扩张的莫斯科压力。

1456年伊凡·费奥多罗维奇去世后，莫斯科监护他年幼的继承人达八年，瓦西里·伊凡诺维奇才在1464年继位，并娶伊凡三世的妹妹。这场婚姻没有保住王朝。末代大公伊凡·伊凡诺维奇因涉嫌与克里木汗往来，1520年被召往莫斯科拘禁；1521年他逃往立陶宛，梁赞也并入俄罗斯国家。该世纪后期，克里木人的袭击仍不断落到这片土地。混乱时期，梁赞贵族普罗科皮·利亚普诺夫成为第一支民军的首领之一，于1611年向波兰人占据的莫斯科进军，同年7月在那里被杀。1778年，叶卡捷琳娜二世把佩列亚斯拉夫尔-梁赞斯基设为梁赞总督区驻地，并将城镇改名为梁赞；1796年，保罗一世将其改组为梁赞省。

en:
The Tambov country is black-earth forest-steppe on the middle Tsna. Moksha Mordvins had lived there from the sixth century, hunting, keeping bees and tilling clearings among oak woods. Slavic settlers appeared before the Mongol conquest but did not remain in large numbers. In 1444 the Great Horde's reach extended over the country: Mishar Tatar herders pastured livestock along the rivers, while steppe trails farther south carried Crimean and Nogai raiders toward the Russian borderlands. A Mordvin settlement called Tonbov stood on the Lipovitsa, but no Russian fortress yet guarded the Tsna crossings.

Tsar Mikhail Fyodorovich's decree of 17 April 1636 ordered a town built near the mouth of the Lipovitsa, but Roman Boborykin, the first voivode and builder, chose the mouth of the Studenets on the Tsna, a better site for defence and river trade. Tambov fortress joined Kozlov and other new strongholds on the Belgorod defensive line. Crimean and Nogai attacks came in its first years. A surprise raid in spring 1644 carried off twenty Cossacks, and thirty more men died in the pursuit. From 1647 the timber defences were rebuilt over seven years, supplied with new cannon from Tula and state grain stores for a siege. Regiments for Peter the Great's Azov campaigns also mustered at Tambov.

Roads from Moscow, the Black Earth country and the Volga passed through the town, and about five hundred Tambov coachmen served them. Livestock and wool sales encouraged the first local cloth mills. Tambov became an administrative centre in 1719 and the seat of a viceroyalty in 1779; Catherine II approved its beehive coat of arms in 1781. Gavrila Derzhavin, the leading Russian poet before Pushkin, governed here in 1786–1788. He opened a printing house, the first local newspaper, a theatre and a public school, promoted a brickyard and planned sluices so timber and building stone could reach the town by the Tsna. Several of those works stopped after he left office.
zh:
坦波夫一带是茨纳河中游的黑土森林草原。莫克沙摩尔多瓦人从6世纪起在此生活，在橡树林间狩猎、养蜂、开垦空地。斯拉夫移民在蒙古征服前已经出现，却没有成规模定居。1444年，大帐汗国的势力延伸到这里：米萨鞑靼牧人沿河放牧畜群，更南边的草原小路则把克里米亚和诺盖袭掠者引向罗斯边境。利波维察河畔有个叫通博夫的摩尔多瓦村落，但茨纳河渡口还没有罗斯要塞把守。

1636年4月17日，沙皇米哈伊尔·费奥多罗维奇下诏在利波维察河口附近建城，但首任军政长官和建城负责人罗曼·博博雷金改在斯图杰涅茨河注入茨纳河处选址，认为那里更利于防御和河运。坦波夫要塞与科兹洛夫等新城共同组成别尔哥罗德防线。最初几年，克里米亚和诺盖人接连来攻。1644年春的一次突袭掳走20名哥萨克，追击过程中又有30人死亡。1647年起，木构防御用七年时间重修，配备图拉运来的新炮，还设置官仓储备围城时使用的粮食。彼得大帝远征亚速时，各团也在坦波夫集结。

从莫斯科、黑土区和伏尔加河方向来的道路经过这里，约500名坦波夫车夫在道路上服役。牲畜和羊毛买卖促成了当地最早的呢绒工场。坦波夫1719年成为行政中心，1779年成为总督区首城；叶卡捷琳娜二世1781年批准绘有蜂巢的城徽。普希金之前最重要的俄国诗人加甫里尔·杰尔查文在1786至1788年担任此地长官。他开办印刷所、当地第一份报纸、剧院和公立学校，推动砖厂建设，并规划水闸，让木材和建筑石料能沿茨纳河运入城中。他离任后，其中几项工程随之停工。

en:
The high right bank of the Volga here was called Sary-Tau, the Yellow Mountain, by the Tatars, and a little downstream stood Uvek, a city of the Golden Horde that Timur's army sacked in 1395. In 1444 its dressed stone stood empty above the river, the surrounding steppe belonged to the dissolving Great Horde, and Mishar Tatars and Nogai herders pastured their flocks along the watercourses; Volga shipping paid tribute or ransom to whoever was strong enough to take it. No permanent town yet stood on the bluffs.

The Russian fortress of Saratov went up on 2 July 1590, when Prince Grigory Zasekin and Fyodor Turov built it halfway between Samara and Tsaritsyn to guard the Volga traffic. It was a restless foundation: the town burned in the winter of 1613–14, was rebuilt on the left bank in 1617, and moved a third time to the right-bank hills in 1674, while Kalmyk and Kuban raiders went on plundering the district. Stepan Razin gave it over to three days of plunder in 1670, Bulavin's rebels besieged it in 1708, and Pugachev won his last real success here when his army stormed the town on 7 August 1774; Mikhelson's troops were already on his heels and retook it on 11 August.

Peter I's Tsaritsyn defence line made the right bank safe for ploughmen, and Saratov then grew on trade. After a salt office opened in 1747, salt hauliers carried salt from Lake Elton to the wharves and founded the Pokrovskaya sloboda across the river; in 1750 more than two hundred thousand poods of Volga fish went out by cart, for the town stood on the shortest land road to Moscow and the water road from the Caspian and the lower Volga. From 1766 its Chancellery of Guardianship of Foreigners ran the German colonies planted on Catherine II's invitation, and Old Believers resettled the trans-Volga steppe under her manifestos. Saratov became the seat of a viceroyalty in 1780 and of the Saratov Governorate in 1796; after 1813 French prisoners of war were put to work here, and many stayed on as shoemakers, cabinet-makers and tutors.
zh:
伏尔加河在此处的高岸被鞑靼人称作萨雷套，意为「黄山」；下游不远立着乌韦克，一座1395年遭帖木儿军队洗劫的金帐汗国城市。1444年，故城的琢石空立河畔，周围草原归于正瓦解的大帐汗国，米萨鞑靼人与诺盖牧人沿水道放牧，伏尔加河上的商船要向有实力收取的人纳贡或输赎。此时的河岸高坡上还没有常驻城镇。

1590年7月2日，格里戈里·扎谢金公爵与费奥多尔·图罗夫在萨马拉与察里津之间的中点筑起萨拉托夫要塞，护卫伏尔加航运。这座城建得并不安稳：1613至1614年冬城池焚毁，1617年在左岸重建，1674年第三次迁址、搬到右岸高地，卡尔梅克人与库班鞑靼人对这一带的袭掠也始终未断。1670年斯捷潘·拉辛纵兵在城内大掠三日，1708年布拉文起义军围攻该城。1774年8月7日普加乔夫的军队攻破萨拉托夫，这是他最后一次得手，米赫尔松所部紧追不舍，8月11日便将城池收复。

彼得一世修筑察里津防线后，右岸才适于农夫定居，萨拉托夫随即靠贸易兴起。1747年盐务署设立，运盐车夫把埃尔通湖的食盐运到码头，并在河对岸建起波克罗夫镇；1750年，经大车运出的伏尔加河鱼超过二十万普特。这座城正处在通往莫斯科的最短陆路与从里海、伏尔加下游而来的水路交会处。1766年起，设于此处的「外籍移民监护公署」统管奉叶卡捷琳娜二世诏书迁来的德意志人殖民地，旧礼仪派也按她的诏书迁往伏尔加河东岸垦殖。1780年萨拉托夫成为总督区驻地，1796年改设萨拉托夫省；1813年后法国战俘被押到这里服劳役，其中许多人留了下来，做了鞋匠、细木匠和家庭教师。

en:
The upper Sura and Moksha country belonged to the Moksha Mordvins. Their princes had a capital called Noronshasht on the ground later named Narovchat. Batu's army destroyed it in 1237, and the Golden Horde built the city of Mukhshi, also called Nurinjat, on the ruins. It became the administrative centre of the Mukhsha ulus and one of the Horde's mints, striking dangs, dirhams and copper puls from 1313 to 1367. Öz Beg Khan kept court there between 1313 and 1342, and the khan's court adopted Islam in 1320. Merchants also used the route from the Don toward Black Sea ports and the Genoese colonies in Crimea. Timur's troops sacked Mukhshi in 1395. By 1444 it was a reduced place among Mordvin villages, and its surviving Tatar and Mordvin lords looked toward Kazan.

Narovchat was fortified again from 1520, and in the sixteenth century it had a six-towered wooden ostrog. After Kazan fell in 1552, Russian service settlers entered the country, and in 1627 Narovchat was named a mustering point for Russian armies. The stronger fortress rose on the Sura at Penza. A small stockade stood there before May 1663, when the architect Yuri Kontransky arrived to build a wooden kremlin for the new frontier town. Cossacks garrisoned the settlement, whose Cherkassy ostrog formed part of the Lomov sentry line against Crimean raids. The name Penza comes from a Moksha word for the end of a swampy river.

In 1774 the people of Penza opened the town to Yemelyan Pugachev's insurgents. Near Narovchat, however, government troops destroyed a rebel band of about four thousand under Yelistratov. Penza became the seat of a viceroyalty in 1780, and Narovchat became one of its district towns. Stone houses began to appear in Penza after 1801, and by 1809 the town had more than 13,000 inhabitants.
zh:
苏拉河与莫克沙河上游是莫克沙摩尔多瓦人的土地。他们王公的都城诺龙沙什特，位于后来称作纳罗夫恰特的地方。1237年拔都的军队摧毁此城，金帐汗国在废墟上建起莫赫什，又称努林贾特。它成为莫赫什兀鲁思的行政中心，也是金帐汗国的铸币地之一，1313年至1367年间铸造当格、迪拉姆和铜普尔。月即别汗1313年至1342年驻跸于此，汗廷1320年接受伊斯兰教。商人也利用从顿河通往黑海港口和克里米亚热那亚殖民地的道路。1395年，帖木儿的军队洗劫莫赫什。到1444年，这座城已经衰败，周围是摩尔多瓦村落，幸存的鞑靼和摩尔多瓦领主投向喀山。

纳罗夫恰特1520年起重新设防，16世纪已有一座六塔木栅要塞。1552年喀山陷落后，俄国军役移民进入这片土地；1627年，纳罗夫恰特被指定为俄军集结地。更坚固的要塞设在苏拉河畔的奔萨。1663年5月之前这里只有一座小木寨，建筑师尤里·孔特兰斯基随后奉命前来，为这座新边城修建木构克里姆林。哥萨克驻守此地，他们的「切尔卡瑟寨」并入洛莫夫警戒防线，用于防备克里米亚袭掠。奔萨一名来自莫克沙语，意为「沼泽河的尽头」。

1774年，奔萨居民向叶梅利扬·普加乔夫的起义军打开城门。但在纳罗夫恰特附近，官军击溃了叶利斯特拉托夫率领的约四千人起义队伍。1780年，奔萨成为总督区首城，纳罗夫恰特成为其下辖县城之一。1801年后，奔萨开始出现石砌房屋；到1809年，城中居民已超过13000人。

en:
The Kama cuts west from the Ural foothills through Perm, a land Komi-Permyak hunters and herdsmen shared with Bashkir groups near the mouth of the Chusovaya. Upriver, Cherdyn was the seat of the Komi princes of Great Perm. Novgorod's merchants had travelled this way for sable and squirrel pelts since the twelfth century, and salt boiling began at Sol-Kamskaya in 1430. The middle Kama was less settled: trappers moved through its forests, tribute gatherers followed the river, and neither Novgorod nor Moscow held the crossings firmly. In 1444 the Kama peoples were numbered among the tribute-bearers of the new khanate of Kazan.

Moscow's governors brought Cherdyn under control before Ivan the Terrible took Kazan in 1552. Six years later the tsar granted empty lands along the Kama and Chusovaya to the Stroganovs. The salt-merchant family built saltworks and the fort of Kargedan, settled Russian peasants, mined ore, kept armed retainers and supplied Yermak's Cossacks for their 1581 campaign into Sibir. The future Kama district capital began more modestly as Yagoshikha, a village on a copper-bearing tributary. Peter the Great sent Vasily Tatishchev to organize the Ural works, and Georg Wilhelm de Gennin saw the Yegoshikha copper smelter built there in 1723; soldiers, smelter workers and river traffic turned the works into a town. Catherine II named it Perm and opened it as a city in 1781.
zh:
卡马河从乌拉尔西麓流出，穿过彼尔姆；在丘索瓦亚河口附近，科米-彼尔姆克猎人和牧人与巴什基尔群体共用这片林地。上游的切尔登是大彼尔姆的科米王公驻地。自12世纪起，诺夫哥罗德商人便为紫貂和灰鼠皮来到这一带，1430年索尔-卡姆斯卡亚开始煮盐。中卡马一带人烟较稀，猎人穿行森林，征贡者沿河道往来，诺夫哥罗德和莫斯科都没有牢牢控制渡口。1444年，卡马河诸族被新生的喀山汗国算作纳贡之民。

伊凡雷帝1552年攻陷喀山以前，莫斯科的官员已经制服切尔登。六年后，沙皇把卡马河与丘索瓦亚河沿岸的空旷土地封给斯特罗加诺夫家族。这个盐业商人家族开设盐场，筑起卡尔格丹堡，安置俄罗斯农民，开采矿石，蓄养武装随从，并在1581年为叶尔马克的哥萨克提供装备，送他们进攻西伯利亚汗国。后来卡马地区首府的起点更低，只是含铜支流旁的亚戈希哈村。彼得大帝派瓦西里·塔季谢夫筹办乌拉尔工厂，格奥尔格·威廉·德·亨宁主持营建，叶戈希哈炼铜厂于1723年在那里建成；士兵、冶铜工和河运把工厂变成城镇。1781年，叶卡捷琳娜二世将它定名彼尔姆并设市。

en:
Nizhny Novgorod, 'Lower Novgorod', guards the confluence of the Oka and the Volga. Grand Prince Yuri II of Vladimir founded it in 1221 as an eastern border fortress against the Mordvins and Volga Bulgars, and for a century and a half it was the easternmost Russian town. It briefly headed its own principality, a rival of Moscow, and there in 1377 the monk Lavrenty copied the Laurentian Codex of the Primary Chronicle; Moscow annexed the principality in 1392. In 1444, under a Muscovite governor, its timber kremlin and wharves made Nizhny Moscow's main forward base in the long contest with the Tatar khanate of Kazan.

The Tver merchant Afanasy Nikitin passed through around 1469 on his voyage to India. The red-brick Kremlin above the two rivers went up in 1508-1515 under the Italian architect Pietro Francesco, and neither the Kazan sieges of 1521 and 1536 nor any later assault ever took it; after Kazan fell in 1552 the frontier rolled far to the east. Through the Time of Troubles the city stood by Moscow, and in 1611-1612 the merchant Kuzma Minin and Prince Dmitry Pozharsky raised a national militia beneath its walls and marched on to free the city. The Stroganovs made Nizhny their chief trading seat in the 1600s, patronising the church builders and icon painters of the Stroganov school, while Old Believers fleeing Nikon's reforms settled the Kerzhenets forests nearby. Ivan Kulibin, born here to a trader's family in 1735, built clocks and river-going vessels and drew up plans for a single-arched bridge across the Neva, the most famous of Russia's self-taught mechanics. In 1817 the Makaryev Fair, burned out at its Volga monastery, was moved to the low ground across the Oka: every July merchants from India, Iran and Central Asia traded there beside Russians, and Nizhny became the market of the Russian interior.
zh:
下诺夫哥罗德意为「下游的新城」，扼守奥卡河汇入伏尔加河之处。1221年，弗拉基米尔大公尤里二世在此筑城，作为抵御莫尔多瓦人和伏尔加保加尔人的东部边塞，此后一个半世纪里它都是罗斯最东端的城镇。它曾一度统领与莫斯科争雄的本邦公国，1377年修士拉夫连季在此抄成《往年纪事》的拉夫连季抄本；1392年莫斯科兼并该公国。1444年，在莫斯科派来的总督治下，木构克里姆林和河港使下诺夫哥罗德成为对抗喀山鞑靼汗国的主要前沿据点。

1469年前后，特维尔商人阿法纳西·尼基京在前往印度途中经过此地。俯瞰两河的红砖克里姆林建于1508至1515年，由意大利建筑师彼得罗·弗朗切斯科主持，1521年和1536年两度顶住喀山鞑靼人的围攻，此后也从未被攻陷；1552年喀山陷落，边界远远东移。混乱时期全城支持莫斯科，1611至1612年，商人库兹马·米宁和德米特里·波扎尔斯基在城墙下组建全俄民军，从这里出发解放莫斯科。17世纪，斯特罗加诺夫家族把下诺夫哥罗德作为主要经营据点，资助斯特罗加诺夫画派的教堂建筑师和圣像画师；逃避尼康改革的旧礼仪派则迁入附近克尔热涅茨河畔的森林。1735年，伊万·库里宾出生在本地一个商人家庭，他造出多种钟表和内河船只，还设计过横跨涅瓦河的单拱桥，是俄国最有名的自学成才的机械师。1817年，毁于火灾的马卡里耶夫集市迁到奥卡河对岸的低地：每年七月，来自印度、伊朗和中亚的商人与俄国商人在此交易，下诺夫哥罗德成为俄国内陆的大市场。

en:
Vladimir rises on the Klyazma, the strongpoint that Vladimir Monomakh planted around 1108 on the eastern edge of the Rostov-Suzdal land. Andrey Bogolyubsky made it his capital in 1157 and brought Russian, Georgian and German masons to build the white-stone Dormition Cathedral, the Golden Gate and nearby palaces. He was murdered at Bogolyubovo in 1175, and under Vsevolod the Big Nest the city overshadowed the other towns of northern Rus. Batu Khan's army stormed and burned it in February 1238. The metropolitan's see moved from Kiev to Vladimir in 1299 and on to Moscow in the 1320s, and the revered Vladimir Icon of the Mother of God followed in 1395. Andrei Rublev and Daniil Chyorny repainted the cathedral in 1408. By 1444 Vladimir belonged to Vasily II's Muscovy and had lost political power, but its Dormition Cathedral remained the coronation church of the grand princes of Vladimir.

Aristotele Fioravanti used that cathedral as his model for the Dormition Cathedral in the Moscow Kremlin, built from 1475 to 1479, and coronations moved to Moscow. Warfare returned in the Time of Troubles: in April 1609 the townspeople beat off a six-day siege by Polish-Lithuanian troops. In 1724 Peter I had Alexander Nevsky's relics carried from Vladimir's Nativity Abbey to the new Alexander Nevsky Lavra in St Petersburg. The old Golden Gate needed emergency works under Catherine II, whose officials recorded it in 1779 and pulled down its weakened barbican church in 1795. Catherine also made Vladimir a viceroyalty seat in 1778 and approved its regular rebuilding after 1781. The first printing press opened in 1797 by the Vladimirka, the road along which convict parties walked toward Siberia.
zh:
弗拉基米尔位于克利亚济马河畔，约1108年由弗拉基米尔·莫诺马赫设为罗斯托夫—苏兹达尔东缘的据点。1157年，安德烈·博戈柳布斯基迁都于此，召来罗斯、格鲁吉亚和德意志石匠修建白石圣母升天大教堂、金门和附近宫苑。1175年，他在博戈柳博沃遇刺；到弗谢沃洛德「大窝」时，这座城已压过东北罗斯其他城镇。1238年2月，拔都的军队攻破并焚毁弗拉基米尔。1299年都主教驻地从基辅迁来，1320年代又迁往莫斯科；备受崇敬的弗拉基米尔圣母圣像也在1395年移往莫斯科。1408年，安德烈·鲁布廖夫和丹尼尔·乔尔内为大教堂重绘壁画。1444年，弗拉基米尔已是瓦西里二世治下莫斯科公国的城市，不再掌握旧日政权，但圣母升天大教堂仍是弗拉基米尔大公加冕的教堂。

1475至1479年，阿里斯托泰莱·菲奥拉万蒂以这座大教堂为蓝本，建成莫斯科克里姆林宫的圣母升天大教堂，加冕礼随之改到莫斯科。大动乱年代战火重至：1609年4月，市民击退波兰—立陶宛军队历时六天的围攻。1724年，彼得一世把亚历山大·涅夫斯基的遗骨从弗拉基米尔圣诞修道院迁往圣彼得堡的亚历山大·涅夫斯基修道院。叶卡捷琳娜二世时期，古老的金门不得不紧急修缮：官员在1779年测绘建筑，1795年拆除已经受损的门楼教堂。1778年，弗拉基米尔成为总督区首府，1781年后按规整规划重建。1797年，第一家印刷所在「弗拉基米尔卡」路旁开业，流放犯队伍正是沿这条路走向西伯利亚。

en:
Yaroslavl stands on the steep Strelka cape where the Kotorosl enters the Volga, on the site of a Meryan settlement called Bear Corner. Tradition gives its founding to Yaroslav the Wise while he ruled Rostov in the early eleventh century: legend says locals loosed a sacred bear at him and he killed it with a battle-axe, and a bear with a halberd appears on the city's later arms. In 1218 the town became the capital of its own principality under Vsevolod, son of Konstantin of Vladimir. The Mongols sacked it in 1238 and killed Prince Vsevolod at the Sit River; raids, fires and plague recurred for two centuries, and in 1332 Ivan I of Moscow burned the town on the khan's orders. In 1444 it was still the seat of its own Rurikid prince, an Orthodox Volga town overshadowed by an expanding Moscow.

The last prince surrendered the succession to Ivan III in 1463, and the legal annexation followed in 1471. A Polish raid under Aleksander Lisowski failed to take the town in May 1609. In the spring and summer of 1612 Minin and Pozharsky's Second People's Militia camped at Yaroslavl for three months; state business was run from the town before the army marched on Polish-held Moscow. Peace made the town rich. Volga boats carried goods between Arkhangelsk, the Orient and Siberia, the leather shops alone employed about seven hundred men, and textiles and silverwork flourished beside them. Merchant money built the Church of Elijah the Prophet in 1647-1650 and other brick churches, frescoed by Yaroslavl and Kostroma painters around 1680. The fire of 1658 had already burned the old wooden Kremlin, and by 1700 the brick town held about 15,000 people, second in the tsardom to Moscow.

In 1750 Fyodor Volkov opened the public theatre regarded as Russia's first permanent stage. Catherine II made Yaroslavl a governorate centre in 1777. The town's twelfth-century Transfiguration Monastery kept one more treasure: in 1795 the only known manuscript of The Tale of Igor's Campaign was found in its library. Aleksei Musin-Pushkin published it in 1800, and the original burned with his collection in the Moscow fire of 1812.
zh:
雅罗斯拉夫尔位于科托罗斯尔河汇入伏尔加河的陡峭斯特列尔卡角，其前身是梅里亚人的聚落「熊角」。相传智者雅罗斯拉夫11世纪初统治罗斯托夫时建城：当地人放出一头被奉为神物的熊袭击他，雅罗斯拉夫抡斧将熊杀死，后来的城徽上便画着一头持斧的熊。1218年，这里成为弗谢沃洛德（弗拉基米尔的康斯坦丁之子）治下独立公国的都城。1238年蒙古人洗劫城市，王公弗谢沃洛德也在同次远征的锡季河之战中被杀；此后两百年间，金帐汗国袭掠、火灾和瘟疫一再重来，1332年莫斯科的伊凡一世还奉汗命焚毁雅罗斯拉夫尔。1444年，它仍是留里克王公的都城、一座处在扩张中的莫斯科阴影下的东正教伏尔加城市。

末代王公1463年把继承权交给伊凡三世，法律上的兼并1471年完成。1609年5月，亚历山德尔·利索夫斯基率领的波兰军队攻城不克。1612年春夏，米宁和波扎尔斯基的第二人民义军在雅罗斯拉夫尔驻扎三个月，全国政务都在城中处理，随后才进军波兰占据的莫斯科。和平带来财富：伏尔加河上的商船往返于阿尔汉格尔斯克、东方和西伯利亚之间，仅皮革作坊就雇工约七百人，纺织和银器行当同样兴旺。商人出资在1647至1650年建起先知以利亚教堂和其他砖石教堂，雅罗斯拉夫尔与科斯特罗马的画师约在1680年为四壁画满壁画。1658年的大火已烧毁旧木克里姆林，到1700年，这座砖城约有一万五千人，在沙皇俄国仅次于莫斯科。

1750年，费奥多尔·沃尔科夫在此开设公共剧院，被视为俄罗斯第一个常设剧场。叶卡捷琳娜二世1777年将雅罗斯拉夫尔设为省治。城中12世纪创立的主显圣容修道院还藏着一件宝物：1795年，《伊戈尔远征记》唯一传世的手抄本在修道院藏书楼被发现，阿列克谢·穆辛-普希金1800年将其刊印，原件却在1812年莫斯科大火中随他的藏书一同焚毁。

en:
Olonets lies on the Olonka east of Lake Ladoga, in Karelian country of river pogosts, forests and fur trapping. Under the Novgorod Republic the district belonged to the archbishop of Novgorod rather than to a secular prince, and the chronicles first name it in 1228. In 1444 it was a quiet Orthodox back country of the republic, settled around the Rozhdestvensky pogost and tied to Ladoga by canoe routes, with no fortress of its own.

The frontier arrived after the Peace of Stolbovo in 1617, when the Swedish border was drawn only forty kilometres away. In September 1649 Tsar Alexis had a border fortress raised where the Olonka meets the Megrega, under Prince Fyodor Volkonsky and the clerk Stepan Elagin: walls more than 1.5 kilometres long, nineteen towers, 1,300 embrasures, thirty-one guns and 824 muskets, a stronghold said to outrank Arkhangelsk and every town in Siberia. Well-off peasants were moved in from the Zaonezhye pogosts to trade and work iron, and by the end of the century Olonets had 726 households and merchants sailing their own small ships to Stockholm. Peter the Great turned the local ironworks into an arsenal, ordering a hundred cannon cast in January 1702 for the Great Northern War, and from 1703 the Olonets shipyard at Lodeinoye Pole on the Svir launched the Baltic Fleet's early frigates, armed with local guns; the town's later coat of arms bore two crossed chain shot. Peter himself took the waters at the iron-bearing springs nearby from 1719. The Peace of Nystad pushed the border far north in 1721 and ended the fortress's purpose, it burned in 1741 and was never rebuilt, and in 1784 Petrozavodsk took Olonets's place as the regional center.
zh:
奥洛涅茨位于拉多加湖以东的奥洛尼卡河畔，是一片卡累利阿人的土地，沿河分布着教区聚落、森林和猎场。诺夫哥罗德共和国时期，这一地区归诺夫哥罗德大主教管辖，而不属于世俗王公，编年史最早在1228年提到它。1444年时，这里还是共和国治下平静的东正教边地，居民围绕圣诞教区而居，靠独木舟水路与拉多加湖往来，自己并没有要塞。

边界是1617年《斯托尔博沃和约》之后压到这里来的，瑞典边境划在距奥洛涅茨教区仅40公里处。1649年9月，沙皇阿列克谢下令在奥洛尼卡河与梅格列加河汇流处修筑边境要塞，由费奥多尔·沃尔孔斯基王公和书吏斯捷潘·叶拉金督办：城墙长逾1.5公里，19座塔楼，1300个射击孔，配31门火炮、824支火枪，据说规模在阿尔汉格尔斯克和西伯利亚所有城市之上。政府又从外奥涅加各教区迁来富农经商冶铁；到17世纪末，奥洛涅茨有726户人家，商人驾着自己的小船远航斯德哥尔摩。彼得大帝把当地铁厂变成兵工厂，1702年1月下令铸造100门火炮供应大北方战争；1703年起，斯维里河畔洛杰伊诺耶波列的奥洛涅茨造船厂造出波罗的海舰队早期的巡航舰，舰上装的就是本地铁炮，后来的城市纹章上画着两枚交叉的链弹。彼得本人还从1719年起在附近含铁的矿泉疗养。1721年《尼斯塔德和约》把边界远远推向北方，要塞就此失去作用；它在1741年失火焚毁，再未重建，1784年彼得罗扎沃茨克取代奥洛涅茨成为地区中心。

en:
Novgorod straddles the Volkhov where it leaves Lake Ilmen, tying the Baltic river roads to the fur forests of the Russian north; its republic's hinterland ran from the Gulf of Finland to the Urals. Its stone Cathedral of St Sophia was built in 1045–50. After the townsmen dismissed Prince Vsevolod in 1136 the city summoned and dismissed its princes at will, and power rested with the veche, the elected posadniks and the archbishop. A called-in prince could still overawe the city, as Alexander Nevsky did when he led its army against the Swedes on the Neva in 1240 and against the German crusaders on the ice of Lake Peipus in 1242. Hanseatic merchants kept the Peterhof, their easternmost kontor, through which sable, ermine and squirrel pelts and beeswax moved to northern Europe; about 200 German merchants lived there in the 1430s. The city struck its own silver coins from 1420 and from the end of that century styled itself Sovereign Lord Novgorod the Great. In 1444 it was still a great Orthodox merchant republic living on northern furs, but its grain came from the southwest and Moscow was closing in.

Ivan III ended that independence. He routed the Novgorodian militia at Shelon in 1471, and in January 1478 the city submitted; the veche was broken up, its bell was carried to Moscow and boyar families were deported. The brick citadel walls went up in 1484–90, and Ivan closed the Peterhof in 1494, and Hanseatic trade only briefly reopened in 1514. In winter 1569–70 Ivan IV's oprichniki sacked the city for six weeks on the strength of a document, probably forged, that accused it of plotting to surrender to Poland-Lithuania; an estimated 2,000 to 15,000 people were killed, and church and merchant property was seized. During the Time of Troubles Jakob de la Gardie's Swedes took Novgorod in 1611 and held it to the Treaty of Stolbovo in 1617, by which time recorded households had fallen from 1,158 in 1607 to 493. The town revived late in the century as a craft centre, its silversmiths and chest-makers known across Russia, and after the Schism it was an Old Believer stronghold; in 1727 it became the seat of Novgorod Governorate.
zh:
诺夫哥罗德横跨沃尔霍夫河，城在伊尔门湖出水口，把波罗的海河水商路和俄罗斯北方的毛皮林地连在一起；共和国的腹地西起芬兰湾，东到乌拉尔山。石造圣索菲亚大教堂建于1045至1050年。1136年市民赶走王公弗谢沃洛德后，城市可以自行迎废王公，权力归于维彻、选举产生的行政长官和大主教；不过被请来的王公仍可能压倒全城，亚历山大·涅夫斯基就是一例，他率领诺夫哥罗德军队1240年在涅瓦河击败瑞典人，1242年在楚德湖冰面击败德意志十字军。汉萨商人在此设有他们最东端的商站彼得霍夫，紫貂、白鼬、松鼠皮和蜂蜡经此输往北欧；1430年代约有200名德意志商人住在这里。城市1420年开始自铸银币，14世纪末起以「大诺夫哥罗德」自居。1444年，它仍是靠北方毛皮兴盛的东正教商业大国，但粮食要从西南方运入，莫斯科又步步紧逼。

伊凡三世终结了这种独立。他1471年在舍隆河击溃诺夫哥罗德民军，1478年1月城市臣服；维彻被解散，维彻钟运往莫斯科，波雅尔家族遭流放。砖砌内城城墙1484至1490年修成，伊凡1494年关闭彼得霍夫，汉萨贸易只在1514年短暂恢复。1569至1570年冬，伊凡四世的特辖军凭一份很可能伪造的文书，指控全城图谋投降波兰-立陶宛，洗劫城市达六周，估计有两千到一万五千人被杀，教会与商人财产被没收。动乱时代中，雅各布·德·拉加尔迪的瑞典军队1611年攻占诺夫哥罗德，占据到1617年《斯托尔博沃和约》签订，登记户数也从1607年的1158户降到493户。17世纪末，此城以手工业复苏，银匠和箱子匠人闻名全俄；教会分裂后这里成为旧礼仪派据点，1727年成为诺夫哥罗德省省会。

en:
Kholm is the only town on the middle and lower Lovat, built on the high bank where the Kunya runs into that river amid wide marshes. The Lovat carried the old Varangian water road from the Baltic toward the Dnieper and the Black Sea, and boats stopped at the confluence on their way south. Novgorod chronicles mention the early settlement as Klin in 1131-1132; by the fifteenth century its people had moved to the opposite high bank, and from 1471 the place appears in documents as the Kholmovsky pogost. In 1444 the country around it belonged to the Novgorod republic's Derevskaya pyatina, on the forest fringe of the southeast, where boatmen, fishermen, and trappers lived off the river and the marsh.

After the Moscow-Novgorod war the victors made Kholm one of the four administrative centres of the pyatina, and in the 1530s a timber-and-earth fortress went up on Tatilova Hill. Stephen Bathory's troops stormed it in the Livonian War, and the Truce of Yam-Zapolsky returned it to Moscow only in 1582. Polish and Lithuanian raids went on through the Time of Troubles, and from 1593 Kholm is recorded as an ordinary posad under civilian governors. In 1777 it was raised into an uyezd town under Pskov.
zh:
霍尔姆是洛瓦季河中下游唯一的城镇，建在库尼亚河汇入洛瓦季河处的高岸上，四周是大片沼泽。洛瓦季河上承波罗的海、下接第聂伯河与黑海，瓦良格人的古水路途经此地南下，船只常在汇流处停靠。诺夫哥罗德编年史在1131至1132年已提到这片早期聚落，当时称克林；到15世纪，居民迁到对岸的高坡，1471年起这里以霍尔姆乡之名见于文书。1444年时，这一带属于诺夫哥罗德共和国杰列夫斯卡亚皮亚季纳的东南森林边缘，船工、渔夫和猎户靠河流与沼泽为生。

莫斯科与诺夫哥罗德交战后，胜利者把霍尔姆设为该皮亚季纳四个行政中心之一，1530年代又在塔季洛瓦山上建起一座土木要塞。利沃尼亚战争期间，斯特凡·巴托里的军队攻下了它，直到1582年亚姆—扎波利斯克停战协定签订才交还莫斯科。波兰和立陶宛的袭掠在动乱时期仍未停止，1593年的文书已把霍尔姆记作由文官治理的普通城镇聚落。1777年，它升格为普斯科夫管辖下的县治。

en:
Beloozero, the white lake town, stands on the south shore of Lake Beloye in the country of the Veps, whom the chronicles call the Ves. The Primary Chronicle names it in 862 among the five oldest towns of the Russian north and says Rurik set his brother Sineus to rule it, though archaeology dates the actual trading town on the Sheksna to the mid-tenth century, and a fur customs post stood there from the eleventh. From 1238 it was the seat of its own small principality. Its first prince, Gleb, married a daughter of Sartaq, khan of the Golden Horde, which let the later Beloozero princes claim Genghisid descent. Plague all but emptied the town in 1352, and it was rebuilt on the present lakeside site in 1363-1364. Moscow probably gained it as early as 1328, through Ivan Kalita's Tatar grants, and in 1444 it was an Orthodox lake town living by north-south transit, its old fur wealth already giving way to ploughland.

The trade then moved away from it. As northern commerce shifted to the Sukhona and the Northern Dvina route toward Arkhangelsk, the lake road lost traffic, and on 10 July 1612 Lisowczycy raiders walked into Beloozero and looted it: its earthen rampart and wooden walls were obsolete against cannon, while the nearby town of Kirillov, girdled with new stone walls, held out. Beloozero kept its old name until 1777, when it became Belozersk. The Mariinsk water system, opened in 1810, linked the Volga basin with the Baltic past its quays and brought a little of the old transit trade back.
zh:
别洛奥泽罗（1777年后改名别洛焦尔斯克）意为「白湖」，坐落在白湖南岸，周围是编年史称作「维西人」的维普斯人之地。《往年纪事》在862年把它列为俄国北方最古老的五座城镇之一，称留里克派兄弟西涅乌斯在此统治；不过考古所见舍克斯纳河畔的商城要到10世纪中叶才出现，11世纪起那里还设有毛皮关卡。1238年起，它成为一个独立小公国的都城。首任王公格列布娶金帐汗王撒里答的女儿为妻，后来的别洛奥泽罗王公因此自称有成吉思汗血统。1352年瘟疫几乎使全城死绝，1363—1364年城镇在现存城址所在的湖岸重建。莫斯科可能早在1328年就凭伊凡·卡利塔的鞑靼封赐取得此地；1444年，它是一座靠南北转运为生的东正教湖城，旧日的毛皮之利已让位于耕地。

后来商路绕开了它。北方贸易改走苏霍纳河与北德维纳河、朝阿尔汉格尔斯克而去后，湖路日渐冷清；1612年7月10日，利索夫奇基轻骑长驱直入洗劫全城：土垒和木墙在火炮前早已过时，邻近的基里洛夫靠着一圈新石墙守住了围攻。别洛奥泽罗保留旧名直到1777年，这一年改名别洛焦尔斯克。1810年通航的马里因斯克水系从它的码头旁连通伏尔加河流域与波罗的海，为它挽回了一点旧日的转运生意。

en: Soroka was a small White Sea landing where the Vyg River enters Onega Bay, first mentioned in 1419. In 1429 the monks Herman and Savvatiy sailed from this shore to the empty Solovetsky Islands; Zosima joined them and founded Solovetsky Monastery in 1436, and Soroka stayed the crossing point for monks, pilgrims and supplies bound for the islands. In 1444 its Orthodox fishermen and trappers belonged to Novgorod, whose northern coast sent furs, fish and salt south to the Russian towns. Soroka passed to Moscow with the rest of Novgorod in 1478, and in 1551 Ivan IV granted the village to the Solovetsky community; its fishing and trapping belonged from then on to a monastery that grew into one of the greatest landowners of the Russian north, with saltworks, forges and its own boats along the White Sea.
zh: 索罗卡是维格河注入奥涅加湾处的小白海渡口，最早见于1419年记载。1429年，修士格尔曼和萨瓦季从这片海岸渡海，前往无人的索洛韦茨基群岛；佐西马随后加入，于1436年开创索洛韦茨基修道院，索罗卡也一直是修士、朝圣者和补给去往群岛的渡口。1444年时，村里的东正教渔民和捕兽人属于诺夫哥罗德，北方海岸的毛皮、鱼和盐南运俄罗斯诸城。1478年索罗卡随诺夫哥罗德并入莫斯科；1551年伊凡雷帝把该村赐给索洛韦茨基修道院，渔猎所得也归修院，它日后成为俄罗斯北方最大的教会产业之一，在白海沿岸拥有盐场、作坊和自己的船队。

en:
Vologda lies on the river of the same name, between the Volga and Northern Dvina systems, where boats and portages linked Moscow, Novgorod and the White Sea. A later tradition gives its start in 1147, when the monk Gerasimus founded a Trinity monastery, but the first secure document is a Novgorod treaty in 1264. In 1371 Dmitry Prilutsky founded the Spaso-Prilutsky Monastery with Dmitry Donskoy's backing, giving Moscow a religious house on the northern fur routes; Vasily I took Vologda by force in 1397. In 1444 it was a wholly wooden Muscovite frontier town, where furs and other northern goods changed hands on the way to and from the White Sea.

Vasily II's civil war quickly pulled the town into the succession struggle: in September 1446 Dmitry Shemyaka granted Vologda to Vasily after his capture and blinding, and the hegumen of Kirillo-Belozersky released him from his oath in 1447. Shemyaka besieged Vologda in 1450 and failed. After Richard Chancellor reached the White Sea in 1553, English merchants opened a post in 1555, and Vologda became the main mart between Moscow and the English and Dutch ships. Ivan IV treated it as the centre of his oprichnina: he founded the Nason-gorod fortress in April 1566, and St Sophia Cathedral was built in 1568-70 on a scale meant to rival Moscow's Dormition Cathedral, though it was consecrated only in 1587 after he abandoned the project. In November 1608 the town rose against False Dmitry II and supplied the northern militias; after many townsmen had marched with Minin and Pozharsky, a Lithuanian band sacked Vologda in 1612. Peter I stopped here on his journeys to Arkhangelsk, but his restrictions on White Sea commerce in 1722 turned the old mart into a quieter provincial seat.
zh:
沃洛格达位于同名河畔，地处伏尔加河与北德维纳河水系之间，船只和连水陆路把莫斯科、诺夫哥罗德与白海连在一起。晚出传说称，1147年修士格拉西姆在此修建圣三一修道院，并把它当作城市开端；但第一份可靠文献是1264年诺夫哥罗德条约中的边远领地。1371年，德米特里·普里卢茨基在德米特里·顿斯科伊支持下创办斯帕索-普里卢茨基修道院，使莫斯科在北方毛皮商路上拥有一座修道院据点；1397年，瓦西里一世以武力夺取沃洛格达。1444年，这里是一座全木结构的莫斯科边塞城镇，毛皮和其他北方货物在通往白海的路上成交。

瓦西里二世内战很快把这座城镇卷入继承权之争：1446年9月，德米特里·舍米亚卡在瓦西里被俘并失明后把沃洛格达封给他；1447年，基里洛-别洛泽尔斯基修道院院长解除了他的誓约。1450年舍米亚卡围攻沃洛格达，却未能破城。1553年理查德·钱塞勒抵达白海后，英国商人于1555年开设商站，沃洛格达成为莫斯科与英、荷商船之间的主要市场。伊凡四世把它当作特辖区中心：1566年4月他下令修建纳索城要塞，1568至1570年又建成圣索菲亚大教堂，规模足以同莫斯科圣母升天大教堂相比；但沙皇放弃计划后，教堂直到1587年才祝圣。1608年11月，市民起兵反抗伪德米特里二世，并向北方民军供给物资；许多人随米宁和波扎尔斯基出征后，一支立陶宛匪帮在1612年洗劫了这座城。彼得一世前往阿尔汉格尔斯克途中曾在此停驻，但他在1722年限制白海贸易，使沃洛格达从国际市场转为安静的省城。

en:
Finnmark is Norway's Arctic edge, where Sámi hunters and reindeer herders met Norwegian fishing settlements strung along the outer fjords. The crown's claim rested on Vardøhus: King Haakon V raised the first fort, Varghøya, on the island of Vardøya in 1306, and the Archbishop of Trondheim consecrated Vardø Church there the next year. Rivalry with Novgorod over the right to tax the Sámi ended with the 1326 Treaty of Novgorod, although some Sámi bands went on paying tribute to both courts. The real wealth was fish: dried cod sailed south as stockfish to Bergen and into Hanseatic hands. In 1444 Vardø was a remote Catholic garrison and trading haven under the Norwegian crown, living from the sea rather than the plough.

In 1511 Erik Valkendorf visited the fortress and wrote that only the abundance of fish made the land habitable for Christians, and that its stockfish went to nearly every Christian country. England recognised Norway's Arctic rights in 1583, requiring every ship bound for the White Sea to stop at Vardøhus and pay duty. The claim had to be defended: in 1597 Boris Godunov asserted that Vardøhus had always belonged to the tsars, and in 1599 Christian IV sailed north with eight ships to answer him, ordering the governor to tax Russians on the Kola peninsula; the fortress was so run down that he lived aboard his ship Victor. A darker fame attached to the place in the seventeenth century, when 91 people, 77 of them women, were executed for witchcraft in Finnmark, many at Vardøhus, and eighteen women burned at the great Vardø trial of 1662-1663. The present star-shaped fortress was built in 1734-1737 facing the Russian border. Bergen merchants held the Finnmark trade monopoly until 1787, Vardø received town rights in 1789, and its quays throve in the Pomor trade with the White Sea, where fish bought Russian grain and timber.
zh:
芬马克是挪威的北极边陲，萨米猎人与牧鹿人在此活动，挪威人的渔村则沿外峡湾一字排开。挪威王权的依托是瓦尔德胡斯：1306年，哈康五世在瓦尔德岛上筑起最早的要塞，次年特隆赫姆大主教为瓦尔德教堂祝圣。挪威与诺夫哥罗德围绕向萨米人征税的争夺，随1326年《诺夫哥罗德条约》告终，但一些萨米部落照样向两边纳贡。真正的财富是鱼：干鳕鱼作为鳕鱼干南运卑尔根，再流进汉萨商人之手。1444年的瓦尔德是挪威王冠治下遥远的天主教驻军地和贸易港，靠海吃海，而不是靠犁耕作。

1511年，埃里克·瓦尔肯多夫到访要塞后写道，要不是鱼产丰饶到足以吸引人定居，这片土地本不适于基督徒居住，而这里的鳕鱼干货好价高，几乎输往每一个基督教国家。1583年英国承认挪威在北极的权利，规定所有驶入白海的船只都要在瓦尔德胡斯停泊纳税。这种权利确有捍卫的必要：1597年鲍里斯·戈东诺夫声称瓦尔德胡斯向来属于沙皇，1599年克里斯蒂安四世便率八艘船北上作答，命要塞长官向科拉半岛上的俄国人征税；要塞破败到他只能住在座舰「胜利者号」上。17世纪，这里又添上一段阴沉的名声：芬马克共有91人因巫术被处死，其中77人是女性，许多人丧命于瓦尔德胡斯，1662年至1663年的瓦尔德大审一次就烧死18名妇女。现存的星形要塞建于1734年至1737年，正对俄罗斯边界。卑尔根商人对芬马克贸易的垄断维持到1787年，瓦尔德1789年获得城市权，码头在与白海的波莫尔贸易中兴旺起来，用鱼换回俄国的谷物和木材。

en:
Kocaeli is the peninsula and coast around the Gulf of Izmit, the funnel through which the Anatolian roads run to the Bosphorus. Its chief town, Nicomedia, was refounded in 264 BC by Nicomedes I of Bithynia and became Diocletian's eastern capital in 286, under the Tetrarchy the senior seat of the Roman Empire; the edict of 303 that opened the Great Persecution of Christians was issued from its palace. Hannibal killed himself at nearby Libyssa in his final years, and the historian Arrian was born in the city, but after Constantinople was founded a short way west in 330 Nicomedia lived in the new capital's shadow. The Ottoman warrior Akça Koca, who gave the region its name, overran the southern shore of the gulf in 1327, and famine helped his master Orhan take the city in 1337; Orhan's son Süleyman Paşa became its first sanjak governor. Handed back to the Byzantines during the Interregnum after 1402, the town returned to Ottoman rule and was rebuilt after Mehmed I's victory in 1413. In 1444 Izmit was a grain port and market on the sea road to Constantinople, with a shipyard on its shore.

The shipyard and the sea walls took the first blow of every disaster. In the earthquake of 14 September 1509 that also shook Constantinople, the walls, five mosques and three hundred houses fell, the Süleyman Paşa Medresesi among them. Plague came from the capital in 1592 and kept the bazaars closed for six months, and in the winter of 1621 the head of the gulf froze. In the 1650s the rebel Gürcü Abdünnebi marched this way against Istanbul, and Abaza Hasan Ağa's revolt left the district plundered. Damat Ibrahim Pasha restored the town in Ahmed III's Tulip Period, but the earthquakes that began on 22 May 1766 and ran for two months largely destroyed Izmit and put its shipyard out of action. The town rebuilt slowly and kept feeding the capital grain and timber.
zh:
科贾埃利是环绕伊兹密特湾的半岛与滨海地带，安纳托利亚的道路经这个漏斗口通往博斯普鲁斯。首府伊兹密特古称尼科米底亚，公元前264年由比提尼亚王尼科美德一世重建，286年成为戴克里先的东都，在四帝共治体制下是罗马帝国位次最高的都城；303年开启对基督徒大迫害的敕令，就是从这里的宫殿颁布的。汉尼拔晚年在附近的利比萨自尽，史家阿瑞安出生于此，但330年君士坦丁堡在西边不远处定都后，尼科米底亚便生活在新都的阴影里。为地区留下名字的奥斯曼战将阿克恰·科贾1327年席卷海湾南岸，饥荒又帮助他的主公奥尔汗于1337年攻下城市，奥尔汗之子苏莱曼帕夏成为首任桑贾克贝伊。1402年后的大空位期里城市一度交还拜占庭，随后复归奥斯曼，1413年穆罕默德一世取胜后得到重建。1444年的伊兹密特是通往君士坦丁堡海路上的谷物港与商埠，岸边设有船厂。

船厂和海墙总是最先承受灾祸。1509年9月14日，那场也震动君士坦丁堡的大地震摧毁了海墙、五座清真寺和三百栋房屋，苏莱曼帕夏经学院同在废墟之中。1592年瘟疫自都城传入，市集关闭了半年；1621年严冬，海湾尽头封冻。17世纪50年代，叛乱的阿卜敦内比取道此地进军伊斯坦布尔，阿巴扎·哈桑阿加之乱又使这一带遭到劫掠。达马特·易卜拉欣帕夏在艾哈迈德三世的郁金香时代修复了城市，但1766年5月22日起持续两个月的地震群把伊兹密特大部摧毁，船厂也无法使用。城市慢慢重建，继续向都城供应谷物与木材。

en:
Bursa lies below Mount Uludağ, the Bithynian Olympus of the ancients, where thermal springs rise at Çekirge. As the Byzantine town of Prusa it had been a garrisoned spa and a silk-weaving centre since the sixth century. The Ottomans blockaded it for nine years before Orhan's troops entered in 1326, and in 1335 it became their first capital: they opened their first official mint here and raised their first imperial mosque complex, and even after the court moved to Edirne the sultans were brought back to Bursa for burial. Bayezid I built the Great Mosque at the end of the fourteenth century, yet after the Ottoman defeat at Ankara Timur's grandson sacked and burned the city in 1402. Mehmed I reunited the state and raised the tile-faced Green Mosque and his own Green Tomb; the Muradiye complex of Murad II came after them. In 1444 Bursa was the Ottomans' richest Anatolian city, its bazaars fed with Iranian raw silk and its springs full of bathers. The shadow-play pair Karagöz and Hacivat are said, in some tellings, to have been two workmen who lived and died in the fourteenth-century town.

When the court settled in Constantinople after 1453, silk kept Bursa rich. Bayezid II had the Koza Han built next to the old bazaar in 1490 and 1491, a great stone caravanserai for the cocoon trade, where raw silk from Iran and, at times, Ming China was auctioned; within a generation an agent of the Medici of Florence was working its galleries. The 1487 registers counted 174 quarters and 6,457 taxpaying heads, and Sephardic Jews expelled from Spain in 1492 joined the Romaniote community that predated the conquest. Through the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries Bursa looms wove the palace's kaftans, velvets and embroidery, and the Yeni Kaplıca bath was built under Süleyman. The cocoon auctions in the Koza Han continued into the nineteenth century, and the first Ottoman sultans still lay in their mausoleums beneath Uludağ.
zh:
许达文迪加尔以布尔萨为中心。布尔萨位于乌鲁达山下，古希腊人称之为比提尼亚的奥林匹斯山，切基尔盖一带温泉涌出。拜占庭时代这里叫普鲁萨，6世纪起就是有驻军的温泉城和丝织业中心。奥斯曼人围城九年，奥尔汗的部下1326年入城，1335年定都于此：第一座官方铸币厂和最早的皇家清真寺建筑群都修在这里，后来宫廷迁往埃迪尔内，历代苏丹仍归葬布尔萨。巴耶济德一世在14世纪末建成大清真寺，但安卡拉一役战败后，帖木儿之孙于1402年纵兵焚掠此城。穆罕默德一世重新统一国家，修建了满贴彩釉瓷砖的绿色清真寺和他自己的绿色陵墓，穆拉德二世的穆拉迪耶建筑群随后落成。1444年的布尔萨是奥斯曼在安纳托利亚最富庶的城市，市集靠伊朗生丝供料，温泉中尽是浴客。相传皮影戏里的一对搭档卡拉格兹和哈西瓦特，就是14世纪在这座城里生活过、死去的两个工匠。

1453年宫廷定都君士坦丁堡之后，撑起布尔萨富庶的是丝绸。巴耶济德二世1490至1491年下令在旧市集旁建起蚕茧客店科扎罕，这座巨大的石砌商队客栈用来拍卖伊朗、间或还有明代中国运来的生丝，不到一代人的时间，佛罗伦萨美第奇家族的代办已在它的廊下经营。1487年的册籍载有174个街区、6457名纳税男丁；1492年被逐出西班牙的塞法迪犹太人来到这里，加入奥斯曼征服之前就已存在的罗曼尼奥犹太人社群。整个16、17世纪，布尔萨织机为宫廷织造长袍、丝绒和绣品，苏莱曼时期又建起耶尼卡普勒贾浴场。科扎罕的蚕茧拍卖一直延续到19世纪；乌鲁达山下，奥斯曼最初几代苏丹的陵寝也在城中。

en:
Smyrna, the future İzmir, lies at the head of a deep Aegean gulf beneath Mount Pagos and its citadel, the Kadifekale. In the 14th century the Aydınid Turks used the upper castle as a base for naval raids under Umur Bey, whose ships preyed on Christian commerce across the Aegean; a crusader league took the harbour castle in 1344, and for sixty years Christian knights held the waterfront while Turks held the heights. Bayezid I took the upper city in 1390, but after his defeat at Ankara Timur's army stormed Smyrna in December 1402, razed the Knights' castle and killed much of the population. Murad II made the town firmly Ottoman in 1424 by overcoming the last Aydınid, Cüneyd Bey. In 1444 Smyrna was a modest market town under the sanjak of Aydın, its Aegean cotton, fruit and cordage shipped from a half-silted harbour.

A Venetian fleet raided the town in 1475, and Sephardic Jews expelled from Spain in 1492 brought crafts and capital. Around 1573 Smyrna became the seat of the new Sığla sanjak, and Aegean cotton then drew French, English and Dutch merchants to the gulf; the French and English consulates moved over from Chios in 1619-1621, each with its own quay, and caravans from inner Anatolia and Iranian silk rerouted through Erzurum and Tokat made it the busiest port in the Levant. Smyrna also gave the age its most notorious messianic claimant. Sabbatai Zevi, born here to a Romaniote Jewish family, proclaimed himself the Jewish messiah in 1648 and drew communities across the Mediterranean into his following, until the grand vizier gave him the choice of death or Islam in 1666 and he converted. The port provisioned the Ottoman fleet through the long Cretan war of 1648-1669. Plague, the great earthquake of 1688 and a fire in 1743 failed to check its growth, and by 1700 perhaps 90,000 people, Turks with Greeks, Armenians, Jews and Franks, lived around the gulf. In 1770 a Russian fleet burned the Ottoman fleet at nearby Çeşme, and in 1797 a janissary riot sacked the Frankish quarter.
zh:
苏拉以士麦那（今伊兹密尔）为中心，地处爱琴海一处深水海湾的湾顶，帕戈斯山和山上的卡迪费卡莱城堡俯瞰全城。14世纪，艾登奥卢突厥人在乌穆尔贝伊统率下以上城堡为海上袭掠基地，他的船队在整个爱琴海劫掠基督徒商船；1344年十字军联盟夺取海港城堡，此后六十年基督徒骑士守着港区、突厥人占着山冈。1390年巴耶济德一世取下上城堡，但安卡拉战役之后，帖木儿的军队在1402年12月攻陷士麦那，夷平骑士团城堡，屠戮大量居民。1424年穆拉德二世讨平末代艾登奥卢王公居内伊德贝伊，城池才彻底归入奥斯曼。1444年的士麦那只是艾登桑贾克治下一座普通集镇，爱琴海的棉花、果品和船具从半淤塞的港口运出。

1475年威尼斯舰队袭掠此城；1492年被逐出西班牙的塞法迪犹太人带来手艺和资本。约1573年士麦那成为新设的瑟拉桑贾克驻地，爱琴海棉花随后吸引法、英、荷商人来到海湾；法国和英国领事馆在1619至1621年间从希俄斯迁来，各据一处码头，安纳托利亚内陆的商队和改经埃尔祖鲁姆、托卡特转运的伊朗丝绸，则使它成为黎凡特最繁忙的港口。士麦那还走出了那个时代最有名的弥赛亚宣称者。沙巴泰·泽维出生在本地一个罗马尼奥特犹太人家庭，1648年自称犹太人期待的弥赛亚，把地中海两岸的犹太社团卷入他的运动，1666年大维齐尔令他在死亡和皈依伊斯兰教之间择一，他选择了改宗。1648至1669年的长期克里特战争中，这个港口为奥斯曼舰队提供补给。瘟疫、1688年的大地震和1743年的大火都没能阻止它扩张，到1700年海湾周围已有约九万人，突厥人与希腊人、亚美尼亚人、犹太人和法兰克人杂处。1770年俄国舰队在附近的切什梅焚毁奥斯曼舰队，1797年耶尼切里哗变劫掠了法兰克人街区。

en:
The forested mountains and three Aegean peninsulas of ancient Caria form the land of Menteşe. Menteşe Bey made Muğla his prize and his dynasty ruled from Milas, building the first naval power among the Turkish principalities of Anatolia. Its captains, called the Sea Turks, raided as far as Rhodes under Mesut Bey in 1300, while Mağrı, later Fethiye, shipped grain, horses and alum to Venetian Crete. The coastal forests supplied timber for well-built hulls. Weakened by an earthquake in 1389, the dynasty submitted to Bayezid I in 1391, returned after Timur's invasion, and entered the Ottoman realm under Murad II in 1425.

The Ottomans placed the sanjak seat at inland Muğla, but the shore still held a Christian fortress. At Bodrum, ancient Halicarnassus and the native city of Herodotus, the Knights Hospitaller built the Castle of Saint Peter after 1402 and quarried stone from the ruined Mausoleum, the tomb of Mausolus counted among the Seven Wonders of the ancient world. In 1444 that castle still faced Ottoman shipyards and harbours along the gulfs.

Those shipyards mattered in 1453, when Menteşe yards and seamen provided roughly two in five vessels in Mehmed II's fleet at Constantinople. Bodrum outlasted the Byzantine capital by nearly seventy years; only after Süleyman I took Rhodes in 1522 did the Hospitallers surrender it, and the Ottoman expedition against Rhodes assembled in these waters. When Evliya Çelebi travelled through in the seventeenth century, he found Muğla a small, inward-looking mountain town, while the forested coast continued to launch timber and ships for the Ottoman navy.
zh:
门泰谢是古卡里亚的林地山地和三道伸向爱琴海的半岛。门泰谢贝伊夺取穆拉，其王朝以米拉斯为都，在安纳托利亚突厥诸侯国中最早建立海上力量。它的船长被称为「海上土耳其人」，1300年在梅苏德贝伊率领下袭扰远至罗得岛；后来称费特希耶的马厄勒港，则把粮食、马匹和明矾运往威尼斯治下的克里特。沿海山林提供造船木材，当地船匠以坚固船体闻名。1389年地震削弱了这个王朝，它于1391年臣服巴耶济德一世，帖木儿入侵后一度恢复，1425年穆拉德二世在位时并入奥斯曼。

奥斯曼人把桑贾克治所设在深处内陆的穆拉，但海岸仍有一座基督徒要塞。博德鲁姆古称哈利卡纳苏斯，是希罗多德的故乡；1402年后，医院骑士团在这里修建圣彼得城堡，并从摩索拉斯陵墓遗址拆取石料。这座陵墓是摩索拉斯的王陵，被列为古代世界七大奇迹之一。到1444年，城堡面对的已是海湾沿岸一连串奥斯曼船厂和港口。

这些船厂在1453年显出分量：穆罕默德二世进攻君士坦丁堡的舰队中，约五分之二的船只由门泰谢船厂建造或由当地水手操纵。博德鲁姆比拜占庭都城多守了近七十年，直到1522年苏莱曼一世攻克罗得岛，医院骑士团才把它交出；远征罗得岛的奥斯曼舰队也在这一带水域集结。17世纪爱维亚·瑟勒布经过这里时，看到的穆拉是一座不大而封闭的山城，林木海岸则继续为奥斯曼海军提供木材和新船。

en:
Rhodes is the largest of the Dodecanese and the closest large Greek island to the Anatolian coast, with a northern harbour that could shelter war galleys sailing between Cyprus, Crete and the Aegean. The Knights Hospitaller seized it in 1306-1309 and turned Rhodes into their convent and arsenal. Behind the harbour stood the Palace of the Grand Master, the inns of the Order's Tongues, and walls repeatedly thickened by Italian engineers for cannon fire and mine warfare. The knights formed a Latin garrison and ruling caste; Greek Rhodians kept their Orthodox church, fields, markets and suburbs. In August 1444 a Mamluk army from Egypt stormed the western walls and Mandraki harbour, but re-embarked the next month. By November 1444 Jean de Lastic still held one of the best-armed fortresses in the eastern Mediterranean.

Two Ottoman sieges tested those works. Mehmed II sent about 70,000 men in 1480; Grand Master Pierre d'Aubusson held the breach and the attack failed. Suleiman the Magnificent came in person in 1522 with some 400 ships and 100,000 men, and after six months of artillery fire and mines Grand Master Philippe Villiers de L'Isle-Adam surrendered. On 1 January 1523 the surviving knights sailed away, followed by 3,000 to 4,000 Rhodians; their exile took them by way of Sicily to Malta. The Ottomans turned the church of St John into a mosque, set up medreses and an imaret, and moved Greek households outside the walls, from where they entered by day to work in the markets and shipyards. Rhodes remained an Ottoman naval base and sanjak centre when the Greek revolt began in 1821.
zh:
罗得岛是多德卡尼斯第一大岛，也是最靠近安纳托利亚海岸的希腊大岛；北部海港可以为往来塞浦路斯、克里特和爱琴海的战桨提供遮蔽。医院骑士团1306—1309年夺取该岛，把罗得城经营成修会的营房和军火库。港后有大教长宫、各语区会馆，以及意大利工程师一再加厚、用来抵御火炮和地道的城墙。骑士是拉丁守军和统治阶层，希腊岛民则保留东正教教会、田地、市集和城外社区。1444年8月，埃及马穆鲁克军队猛攻西墙和曼德拉基港，到次月便登船撤离。到1444年11月，让·德·拉斯蒂克的旗帜仍悬在东地中海武备最强的要塞之一上空。

两次奥斯曼围城检验了这些工事。1480年，穆罕默德二世派出约七万人；大教长皮埃尔·德·奥比松守住突破口，进攻失败。1522年，苏莱曼大帝亲率约四百艘战船和十万大军前来，炮火与地道持续六个月后，大教长菲利普·维利耶·德·利勒—亚当投降。1523年1月1日，幸存骑士登船离去，随行的还有三四千罗得岛人，他们经西西里流亡，最后抵达马耳他。奥斯曼人把圣约翰教堂改为清真寺，设立经学院和施粥所，并把希腊居民迁到城外，他们白天入城，在市集和船坞做工。1821年希腊独立战争爆发时，罗得岛仍是奥斯曼海军基地和桑贾克治所。

en:
Cyprus is the large island off the southern coast of Anatolia; its capital Nicosia stands inland on the Mesaoria plain between the Troodos and Kyrenia ranges, beyond the reach of sea raiders. From 1192 the French house of Lusignan ruled as kings of Cyprus, holding a Latin court and crowning its kings in the Gothic cathedral of Saint Sophia while Orthodox Greek peasants worked the estates of the Frankish nobles. The island's most famous export was wine: a sweet wine made from sun-dried grapes in the villages of the Templar commandery at Kolossi, later called Commandaria, which Richard the Lionheart had drunk at his wedding in Limassol and which was served across Latin Europe. Genoese fleets sacked Nicosia in 1373, and in 1426 a Mamluk army captured King Janus at Khirokitia, plundered the capital and made the kingdom tributary to Cairo. In 1444 John II still held the old royal palace, Catholic Franks ruling over Orthodox Greeks, while the island's wine and the plain's produce left through Famagusta and the coast towns.

After John's death in 1458 his daughter Charlotte fought his illegitimate son James, once Archbishop of Nicosia. James called in Mamluk troops, took the crown as James II and married a Venetian noblewoman, Caterina Cornaro. He died in 1473, their infant son followed him within the year, and the queen ruled until Venice obtained her abdication in 1489. The Venetians ringed Nicosia with new star-shaped bastioned walls, but in 1570 an Ottoman army under Lala Mustafa Pasha forced the city after a siege of about forty days; some 20,000 died in the storm, and Saint Sophia was turned into the great mosque. Famagusta held out until August 1571, when its Venetian commander Marco Antonio Bragadin surrendered on terms and was flayed alive; Cyprus became an Ottoman province, and later legend had it that Selim II conquered the island for its Commandaria. Power in the capital then passed largely to the Orthodox archbishop and his Greek dragoman, until the Greek rising of 1821 spread fear through the island: on 9 July the governor hanged Archbishop Kyprianos before the old palace and had 470 other Cypriot notables put to death.
zh:
塞浦路斯是安纳托利亚南岸外的大岛，首府尼科西亚深居岛内，坐落在特罗多斯山与凯里尼亚山之间的梅萨奥里亚平原上，拜占庭人把首府设在这里，正为躲避海上盗寇。1192年起，法兰西的吕西尼昂家族统治塞浦路斯，开立拉丁宫廷，国王在哥特式的圣索菲亚大教堂加冕，信东正教的希腊农民则在法兰克贵族的庄园上耕作。全岛最有名的出口货是葡萄酒：科洛西的圣殿骑士团管区各村用晒过的葡萄酿出一种甜酒，即后来的卡曼达蕾雅酒，狮心王理查在利马索尔举行婚礼时就饮过它，这种酒也远销拉丁欧洲。1373年热那亚舰队洗劫尼科西亚；1426年马穆鲁克军队在希罗基蒂亚生擒国王雅努斯、劫掠都城，王国沦为向开罗纳贡的藩属。1444年，约翰二世仍住在旧王宫里，奉天主教的法兰克人统治着信东正教的希腊人，岛上的甜酒和平原物产经法马古斯塔等沿海城镇运出。

约翰1458年去世后，其女夏洛特与私生子詹姆斯反目，詹姆斯曾被立为尼科西亚大主教。他借马穆鲁克之兵夺得王冠，是为詹姆斯二世，并娶威尼斯贵族女子卡特琳娜·科纳罗为妻。他1473年死去，幼子不出一年也夭亡，科纳罗以女王身份继续统治，1489年被迫让位给威尼斯。威尼斯人为尼科西亚筑起新的星形棱堡城墙，但1570年拉拉·穆斯塔法帕夏率奥斯曼军围城约四十日破城，攻杀约两万人，圣索菲亚大教堂被改作主清真寺。法马古斯塔坚持到1571年8月，威尼斯守将马可·安东尼奥·布拉加丁有条件投降后仍被活活剥皮，塞浦路斯成为奥斯曼行省；后世传说塞利姆二世攻岛，为的就是卡曼达蕾雅酒。都城的权势此后大半落入东正教大主教和希腊译员之手，直到1821年希腊起义的消息令全岛陷入恐慌：7月9日，总督把大主教基普里亚诺斯绞死在旧王宫前，又处死了470名塞浦路斯显贵。

en:
Kütahya, the Cotyaeum of Roman Phrygia, sits on the Porsuk River beneath its citadel, and Justinian ringed it with a double line of walls. The city has a grim link with Byzantium's worst defeat: after Manzikert the deposed emperor Romanos IV Diogenes, ransomed and then hunted down by the Doukas family, was blinded at Cotyaeum in 1072 and died of the wound. It later became the capital of the Germiyanid beylik. In 1381 Süleyman Bey married his daughter Devletşah Hatun to the Ottoman prince Bayezid and handed over Kütahya with the surrounding lands as her dowry, and the young prince governed from the citadel. Timur restored Yakub II after the battle of Ankara in 1402, and in 1428 the last Germiyanid bequeathed his lands to Murad II. In 1444 Kütahya was a newly integrated Ottoman Turkish and Sunni town on the roads between Bursa, Ankara and the Aegean lowlands, its first tile kilns already at work.

From 1451, when İshak Pasha took up residence there, Kütahya was the seat of the Anatolia beylerbeyilik, at its height overseeing fourteen sancaks. The pro-Safavid Şahkulu rising reached the town under Bayezid II and was put down in 1511. During the Celali disorders Deli Hasan trapped Vizier Hafız Ahmed Pasha in Kütahya Castle for three days in August 1601 until heavy snow drove him off, though his men plundered the houses outside the walls. In 1657 the townspeople killed some three hundred soldiers of Governor Can Mirza Pasha after he joined Abaza Hasan Pasha's revolt, and then withstood his siege. The travel writer Evliya Çelebi, born in Istanbul in 1611, came of a Kütahya family at court, his father a palace jeweller. Kütahya's own craft outlasted these troubles: excavated kiln wasters show its potters making blue-and-white fritware in the İznik manner by the early sixteenth century, many of them Armenians, and when İznik's kilns failed in the seventeenth century Kütahya became the empire's surviving tile centre, shipping tiles and vessels to mosques, churches and official buildings across the Middle East.
zh:
屈塔希亚是罗马时代弗里吉亚的科泰乌姆，坐落在波尔苏克河畔，城堡雄踞城头，查士丁尼曾为它修筑双重城墙。这座城与拜占庭最惨重的一败有一段残酷渊源：曼齐刻尔特战役后，被赎回又遭杜卡斯家族追杀的废帝罗曼努斯四世·第欧根尼1072年在科泰乌姆被刺瞎双眼，最终因伤死去。它后来成为格尔米扬贝伊国的都城。1381年，苏莱曼贝伊把女儿德夫莱特沙哈·哈敦嫁给奥斯曼王子巴耶济德，把屈塔希亚连同周边土地作为嫁妆交出，年轻的王子曾在这座城堡中理政。1402年安卡拉战役后，帖木儿恢复了亚库布二世的领地；1428年末代格尔米扬君主把领土遗赠给穆拉德二世。1444年时，屈塔希亚是一座刚并入奥斯曼的土耳其人、逊尼派城镇，地当布尔萨、安卡拉与爱琴海低地之间的道路，最早的瓷砖窑已经开工。

1451年伊沙克帕夏驻节于此，屈塔希亚成为安纳托利亚贝伊莱尔贝伊利克的驻地，极盛时管辖十四个桑贾克。巴耶济德二世时期，归附萨法维的沙赫库鲁之乱波及此城，1511年被镇压。杰拉里动乱期间，德利·哈桑在1601年8月把维齐尔哈菲兹·艾哈迈德帕夏困在屈塔希亚城堡中三日，后因大雪撤围，其部下仍洗劫了城外民居。1657年，总督詹·米尔扎帕夏投奔阿巴扎·哈桑帕夏叛乱后，市民杀死他约三百名士兵，又坚守城池顶住了他的围攻。旅行家埃夫利亚·切莱比1611年生于伊斯坦布尔，出身屈塔希亚的宫廷人家，父亲是宫中珠宝匠。屈塔希亚自己的手艺熬过了这些乱局：出土的窑址残件证明，16世纪初本地陶工已在烧制伊兹尼克风格的蓝白釉陶，其中不少是亚美尼亚人；17世纪伊兹尼克窑业衰败后，屈塔希亚成为帝国仅存的瓷砖重镇，把瓷砖和器皿运往中东各地的清真寺、教堂和官署。

en:
Konya, the Greek Iconium, spreads across the Lycaonian plain at the south-western edge of the central Anatolian plateau. The Seljuks took it in 1084 and, after losing Nicaea in 1097, made it the capital of their Sultanate of Rum; under Ala al-Din Kayqubad I (1220-1237) its walls enclosed 45,000 to 50,000 people and seven Friday mosques, the greatest city in Anatolia. Its later fame rests on one man. Jalal al-Din Rumi, a scholar's son who fled Balkh ahead of the Mongols, settled here young and taught in the city; after the wandering dervish Shams Tabrizi changed the course of his life he composed the Masnavi, and when he died on 17 December 1273 his followers raised the Green Tomb over his grave, around which the Mevlevi order of whirling dervishes took shape. When Seljuk power dissolved, the Karamanids took the city in 1322 as their capital, and it changed hands between them and the Ottomans sixteen times. In 1444 it belonged to Ibrahim II of Karaman, who had raided Karahisar and Bolvadin while Murad II fought at Varna and been forced to terms that August.

In April 1468 the Ottoman army stormed the Gevele fortress and took Konya, and Mehmed II made his son Prince Mustafa, a grandson of Ibrahim II, its governor. The fallen Karamanids held out in the Taurus until 1474, and Bayezid II annexed the last of the beylik in 1487. Konya then became the usual seat of imperial princes: after Mustafa came Cem, who claimed the throne on Mehmed II's death in 1481, lost to Bayezid, and died in Italy in 1495 after years as a captive of the Knights of Rhodes and the Pope; the future Selim II governed the city later. A rising of old Karamanid cavalrymen in a pretender's name in 1500-1501 was put down, while the Mevlevi lodge kept the sultans' patronage and the city's textiles and mines made the provincial capital prosperous.
zh:
科尼亚希腊时代称以哥念，展开在安纳托利亚高原西南缘的吕考尼亚平原上。1084年塞尔柱人攻占该城，1097年尼西亚失守后成为鲁姆苏丹国的都城；阿拉丁·凯库巴德一世在位时（1220—1237年），城墙之内有居民四万五千至五万、七座聚礼清真寺，是安纳托利亚最大的城市。让它名传后世的是一个人：哲拉鲁丁·鲁米是学者之子，幼时随家人赶在蒙古人之前逃离巴尔赫，少年时定居科尼亚并在此讲学；游方德尔维希沙姆斯·大不里士改变了他的人生，此后他写成《玛斯纳维》。1273年12月17日鲁米去世，门徒在他墓上建起绿顶陵墓，旋转托钵僧的梅夫拉维教团围绕陵墓形成。塞尔柱政权瓦解后，卡拉曼人1322年取该城为都，此后它在卡拉曼与奥斯曼之间十六度易手。1444年，科尼亚属于卡拉曼君主易卜拉欣二世：穆拉德二世在瓦尔纳作战时，他攻掠了卡拉希萨尔和博尔瓦丁，同年8月被迫求和。

1468年4月，奥斯曼军队攻破盖韦莱要塞、拿下科尼亚，穆罕默德二世任命自己的儿子、易卜拉欣二世的外孙穆斯塔法皇子为总督。亡国的卡拉曼人在托罗斯山区坚持到1474年，巴耶济德二世1487年吞并侯国残余。科尼亚此后通常由皇子坐镇：穆斯塔法之后是杰姆，他在1481年穆罕默德二世死后争位，败于巴耶济德，后来作为罗得岛骑士团和教皇的囚徒，1495年死于意大利；日后的塞利姆二世也曾在此任职。1500至1501年，旧卡拉曼骑兵拥立一名宗室起事，被镇压下去。梅夫拉维道堂一直受历代苏丹庇护，科尼亚的纺织和矿藏也维持着这座省会的富庶。

en:
Karaman lies on a high plain north of the Taurus Mountains, a hundred kilometres south of Konya. The Greeks called the town Laranda, and in the mid-thirteenth century the Turkmen chief Karaman Bey made it his seat and renamed it after himself; from 1275 it was the capital of the Karamanid dynasty, the Ottoman Turks' longest-lived Anatolian rival. It is also a town of Sufi memory. In 1222 Baha al-Din Walad, Rumi's father, settled here with his family, and the Karamanid emir built a madrasa to house them; Rumi married Gevher Hatun in Laranda, and his mother, who died in 1224, lies in the Aktekke Mosque, the 'Mother of Mevlana', which Alaeddin Ali Bey rebuilt in 1370. The folk poet Yunus Emre, whose plain Turkish verses carried Sufism to village audiences, spent his last years in the town and is buried beside the Yunus Emre Mosque. In 1444 Karaman was the chief seat of Ibrahim II, who had raided Ottoman lands while Murad II fought at Varna and accepted terms that August; his imaret and medrese of 1432 stood in the town.

Mehmed II's army took the Karamanid towns in 1468, though loyalists held out in the Taurus, and in 1483 the Ottoman provincial capital moved to Konya, leaving Karaman a walled castle town ringed by the old dynasty's mosques and medreses; the Dikbasan Mosque went up in 1493. In 1500 the old country rose once more, when Karamanid cavalrymen angered by cuts to their fief revenues proclaimed a prince of the fallen house, until the revolt was crushed. When Evliya Celebi visited in the seventeenth century the castle was still maintained, the main street held 470 shops, and pilgrims still came to Yunus Emre's tomb.
zh:
卡拉曼在托罗斯山脉以北的高原上，位于科尼亚以南约一百公里。希腊人称此城为拉兰达，13世纪中叶，土库曼首领卡拉曼贝伊以此为据点，并以自己的名字改名；自1275年起，这里是卡拉曼王朝的都城，这个王朝也是奥斯曼人在安纳托利亚相持最久的对手。这座城也留有浓厚的苏菲印记：1222年鲁米之父巴哈丁·瓦拉德携家眷定居于此，卡拉曼埃米尔还专门修建经学院安置他们；鲁米在拉兰达娶盖芙赫尔哈屯为妻；他的母亲1224年去世，葬在阿克泰克清真寺，阿拉丁·阿里贝伊1370年在原址重建该寺，寺名意为「梅夫拉纳之母」。民间诗人尤努斯·埃姆雷用朴素的突厥语诗句把苏菲信仰讲给乡间听众，他晚年寓居此城，死后葬在尤努斯·埃姆雷清真寺旁。1444年，卡拉曼是君主易卜拉欣二世的主要驻地：他乘穆拉德二世在瓦尔纳作战时攻掠奥斯曼领土，同年8月接受和议；他1432年修建的济贫院和经学院就在城中。

1468年，穆罕默德二世的大军攻占卡拉曼各城，残余势力仍在托罗斯山区坚持；1483年，奥斯曼新省的省会迁往科尼亚，卡拉曼于是成为一座有城墙的城堡城镇，旧王朝的清真寺和经学院环绕四周，1493年又添建迪克巴尚清真寺。1500年，旧地再度起兵：卡拉曼骑兵因封地收入遭削减而拥立亡国宗室，直到叛乱被镇压。17世纪埃夫利亚·切莱比到访时，城堡仍有人维护，大街上有四百七十家店铺，尤努斯·埃姆雷的墓前仍有朝圣者前来。

en:
Kastamonu lies in the wooded Paphlagonian highlands south of the Black Sea, in a valley of the Gökırmak system, with a citadel above the town. The Candar lords came to it through a service to a captive sultan: their commander Temür Yaman Candar freed the Seljuk ruler Mesud II from Mongol hands, and the sultan granted him the region. His son Süleyman seized Kastamonu from the Çobanid lords in 1309 and made it the seat of the beylik. The Candarids built an arsenal at Sinop and shipped the copper and iron of Küre, called Küre-i Nuhas, Copper Küre, through that port to Genoese and Venetian buyers. Ibn Battuta, who stayed forty days, called Kastamonu one of the largest and finest cities he knew, with goods plentiful and prices low. In 1444 İsmail Bey held the town as an Ottoman tributary; his brother Kızıl Ahmed, having lost the succession dispute, had taken refuge with the sultan.

In 1461 Mehmed II annexed the beylik on his way back from the Trebizond campaign and brought Paphlagonia under direct rule. Küre's copper already fed the Ottoman cannon foundries, and the Sinop arsenal passed whole to the Ottoman navy; Kızıl Ahmed, briefly put in charge of the region, was soon removed and served elsewhere. The town kept its older monuments, above all the Çobanid Mahmut Bey Mosque, a wooden building joined without nails, and the citadel over the rooftops. The Sufi teacher Şaban-ı Veli, who died in 1569, drew pupils to Kastamonu, and his tomb became one of the chief Sunni shrines of the Black Sea interior.
zh:
卡斯塔莫努位于黑海以南林木茂密的帕夫拉戈尼亚山地，坐落在格克河水系的一条河谷中，城堡高踞城镇上方。詹达尔王公得到此地，靠的是对一位被俘苏丹的功劳：他们的将领泰穆尔·亚曼·詹达尔从蒙古人手中救出塞尔柱苏丹梅苏德二世，苏丹便把这一地区赐给他。其子苏莱曼1309年从乔班王公手中夺取卡斯塔莫努，定为贝伊国的都城。詹达尔人在锡诺普设有船坞，把库雷（当时称库雷-伊·努哈斯，意为「铜之库雷」）出产的铜铁经该港卖给热那亚和威尼斯商人。伊本·白图泰曾在此停留四十天，称卡斯塔莫努是他所知最大最好的城市之一，货物丰足、物价低廉。1444年，伊斯玛仪贝伊以奥斯曼藩属的身份统治该城，争位失败的兄弟克孜勒·艾哈迈德已投奔苏丹宫廷。

1461年，穆罕默德二世在特拉布宗远征回师途中吞并贝伊国，帕夫拉戈尼亚并入帝国直辖。库雷的铜此前已供应奥斯曼的铸炮工场，锡诺普船坞也整体归入奥斯曼海军；克孜勒·艾哈迈德一度受命管辖此地，很快被调走，改在别处任职。城中保留着更古老的建筑，尤其是乔班王朝时期的马哈茂德贝伊清真寺：整座木构建筑不用一根钉子拼合而成，城堡则俯临连片的屋顶。神秘派学者沙班·韦利于1569年去世，他吸引弟子来到卡斯塔莫努，其陵寝也成为黑海内陆主要的逊尼派圣迹之一。

en:
Ankara sits on a rocky ridge above the Ankara River, where the main roads across inner Anatolia meet beneath its castle. The old city of Ancyra had been the stronghold of the Galatian Tectosages and the capital of Roman Galatia, and its ruined Temple of Augustus still carried the inscription of the emperor's own deeds. In the fourteenth century the Ahiler craftsmen's brotherhood governed the town before it passed under Ottoman rule; from 1393 the Ottomans used it as the seat of their governor-general in Anatolia.

Its best-known battlefield lies on the Çubuk plain outside the walls. There, on 28 July 1402, Timur defeated Bayezid I and led the Ottoman sultan away captive, a defeat that opened the Ottoman Interregnum and left Ankara damaged. In 1444 the town was being rebuilt under Murad II. The Sufi poet Hacı Bayram Veli had died there in 1430, and his lodge, tomb and later mosque stood beside the Roman temple; accounts of his meeting with Murad II name the infant prince Mehmed, later the conqueror of Constantinople, as the ruler who would take the city.

Caravans and cloth paid for much of Ottoman Ankara. Herders on the surrounding steppe kept long-haired Angora goats, whose fleece was woven and sold in Europe as mohair. Merchants bargained in the hans below the citadel, and English factors of the Levant Company bought fleece and cloth there from 1639 to 1768. The Karacabey Mosque, Kurşunlu Han and Cenabi Ahmet Pasha Mosque joined the older walls and Sufi shrines in the town; by the later eighteenth century, caravan traffic had thinned and Ankara lived chiefly as a provincial cloth market.
zh:
安卡拉位于安卡拉河畔的岩石高地上，城堡俯视着安纳托利亚内陆几条主要道路的会合处。古城安基拉曾是加拉太人特克托萨格部的据点、罗马加拉太行省的首府，奥古斯都神庙残壁上还刻有这位皇帝自传式的功业铭文。14世纪时，阿希工匠兄弟会曾治理此城，后来它归入奥斯曼统治；1393年起，奥斯曼人把安纳托利亚总督驻地设在这里。

城外的丘布克平原是安卡拉之战的战场。1402年7月28日，帖木儿在此击败巴耶济德一世，并把这位奥斯曼苏丹俘走，战败引发奥斯曼大空位期，安卡拉也受到破坏。1444年，城市正在穆拉德二世治下修复。苏菲诗人哈吉·拜拉姆·韦利已于1430年在这里去世，他的道堂、圣墓和后来修建的清真寺紧邻罗马神庙；关于他觐见穆拉德二世的记载称，当时还是婴孩的皇子穆罕默德将是攻克君士坦丁堡的人，也就是后来的「征服者」穆罕默德二世。

商队和布匹支撑着奥斯曼时代的安卡拉。周围草原上的牧人饲养长毛安哥拉山羊，羊毛织成布料，以马海毛之名销往欧洲。商人在城堡下的客店里议价，英国黎凡特公司的商馆也在1639至1768年间驻在这里收购羊毛和布匹。卡拉卡贝伊清真寺、库尔顺卢客店和杰纳比·艾哈迈德帕夏清真寺先后加入旧城墙与苏菲圣所之间的城市轮廓；到18世纪后期，商队往来减少，安卡拉主要作为行省布匹集市维持生计。

en:
Adana stands on the Seyhan River, where the Çukurova, the wide Cilician plain below the Taurus passes, opens the road from Anatolia into Syria. When the Mamluks overran Armenian Cilicia in the fourteenth century they entrusted the plain to Ramazan Bey's Yüreğir Türkmens, whom Cairo had allowed to settle just south-east of the town, and the Ramadanid emirs made Adana their seat, holding the frontier as a buffer between the Mamluk sultanate and the rising Ottomans, with Cairo's garrisons planted around them at Tarsus, Ayas and Sis. One emir took Tarsus and gave his daughter in marriage to the Mamluk sultan; his heir İbrahim later lost favour in Cairo and was executed there, and the emirate never recovered its old weight. In 1444 Eylük Bey held Adana as a de facto independent Sunni Türkmen prince, and the harvests of the great plain were his wealth.

Halil Bey's long rule drew the beylik toward the Ottomans, and the family hall he built in Adana, its harem quarter completed in 1495, lodged Selim I and Süleyman when they passed through the town. When Cairo deposed his successor Mahmut, the bey fled to Selim, fought at Marj Dabiq and was killed at Ridaniye in the campaign that, by 1517, had brought the whole Çukurova under Ottoman rule. The Ramadanids kept Adana as a hereditary governorate: Piri Mehmet Paşa built the bazaar bath and in 1541 completed the Great Mosque his father had begun. They were the last of the Anatolian beylik houses to retain power, and their rule ended in 1608 when Pir Mansur Bey stood aside and Adana became an ordinary sanjak of the Aleppo eyalet. In 1658 the great Celali revolt of the Aleppo governor Abaza Hasan Pasha spread into the plain, until his assassination in Aleppo the following February closed the episode. Through the eighteenth century Adana remained the market town of a farming plain, shipping its grain and other harvests from the river quays.
zh:
阿达纳位于塞伊汉河畔；托罗斯山口下，丘库罗瓦（即奇里乞亚大平原）在城边展开，是安纳托利亚通往叙利亚的大路。14世纪马穆鲁克攻灭亚美尼亚人的奇里乞亚后，把平原交给拉马赞贝伊率领的于雷吉尔土库曼人。他们此前已获开罗方面许可在城东南定居，拉马赞家族以阿达纳为都城，在马穆鲁克苏丹国与崛起中的奥斯曼之间充当边疆缓冲，塔尔苏斯、阿亚斯和西斯还环驻着开罗的守军。一位埃米尔曾夺取塔尔苏斯，把女儿嫁给马穆鲁克苏丹；他的继承人易卜拉欣后来在开罗失宠被杀，侯国的分量大不如前。1444年，埃伊吕克贝伊据有阿达纳，是个事实独立的逊尼派土库曼王公，大平原上的收成就是他的财富。

哈利勒贝伊的长期统治把侯国引向奥斯曼一边。他在阿达纳修建的家族宅邸，内宅1495年完工，后来塞利姆一世和苏莱曼路过此城时都曾驻跸。继任的马哈茂德被开罗废黜后投奔塞利姆，随其征战迈尔季·达比克，又在里达尼耶阵亡；到1517年，整个丘库罗瓦已在这场战事中归入奥斯曼。拉马赞家族以世袭方式保有阿达纳的治理权：皮里·穆罕默德帕夏修建了市集浴场，1541年完成其父始建的大清真寺。他们是安纳托利亚诸侯国世家最晚失去权柄的一家，1608年皮尔·曼苏尔贝伊退位，阿达纳成为阿勒颇行省属下的普通桑贾克。1658年，阿勒颇总督阿巴扎·哈桑帕夏的杰拉勒大叛乱蔓延到这片平原，次年2月他在阿勒颇遇刺，乱局随之收场。整个18世纪，阿达纳始终是农耕平原上的集镇，粮食和各种收成从河畔码头运出。

en:
Sinop occupies a walled headland that forms the safest natural harbour on the southern shore of the Black Sea. As Greek Sinope, a colony of Miletus in Paphlagonia, it produced Diogenes the Cynic, and Mithridates VI of Pontus, who spent decades at war with Rome, was born and buried in the city. The Seljuk sultan Kaykawus I took it in 1214, his men seizing the local governor while he was out hunting, and the cathedral became the Alaeddin mosque. After the Mongol withdrawal the town and its shipyard passed to the Candar, or İsfendiyar, Turks, the strongest maritime power among the Anatolian beyliks; when Ibn Battuta stayed here for some forty days in the 1330s he found, in his own words, a superb city that joined strong walls to beauty. In 1444 İsmail Bey held Sinop and Kastamonu as an independent Sunni prince, the fortress watching the sea road to the Crimea and the dockyards turning out Black Sea shipping.

The fortress changed hands without a siege. Mehmed II reached Sinop in late June 1461 on his march against Trebizond, with İsmail's estranged brother Kızıl Ahmed in his camp, and the bey surrendered the castle without a fight and went into exile at Philippopolis in Thrace; his brother governed the town for the Ottomans. The old Candar shipyard was taken into the sultan's service and enlarged to build war galleys for the Black Sea fleet. Raiders came the other way once, in 1614: Zaporozhian Cossacks in light boats swept into the harbour, looted the town and burned much of it, shocking Ottoman observers. Sinop then settled into life as a fortified provincial port, administered from Samsun under the Canik district, its quays shipping timber and stores through the eighteenth-century wars with Russia.
zh:
锡诺普据有一座筑墙设防的海岬，环抱着黑海南岸最安全的天然良港。古时这里是帕夫拉戈尼亚的米利都殖民城邦锡诺普，犬儒派哲人第欧根尼出生于此，与罗马连年交战的本都国王米特拉达梯六世也出生并安葬于此。1214年，鲁姆苏丹凯考斯一世攻取此城，部下趁当地总督出猎将其擒获，大教堂随即改作阿拉丁清真寺。蒙古势力退去后，城池和船厂归入詹达尔（一称伊斯凡迪亚尔）突厥人，这是安纳托利亚诸侯国中最强的海上势力；伊本·白图泰在14世纪30年代在此停留约四十天，用他自己的话说，这座出色的城池兼具坚固的城墙与美观。1444年，伊斯梅尔贝伊以独立的逊尼派王公身份据有锡诺普和卡斯塔莫努，城堡扼守通往克里米亚的海路，船坞中建造着黑海船只。

这座城堡未经围攻便换了主人。1461年6月下旬，穆罕默德二世进军特拉比松途中抵达锡诺普，随军带着与伊斯梅尔反目的弟弟克孜勒·艾哈迈德，贝伊不战交出城堡，本人被流放色雷斯的菲利普波利斯，他的弟弟则代奥斯曼人治理此城。詹达尔旧船厂被苏丹接收并扩建，为黑海舰队建造战舰。劫掠者也曾从海上来：1614年，扎波罗热哥萨克人乘轻舟突入港口，洗劫全城、焚毁大半街区，令奥斯曼观察者大为震惊。此后锡诺普成为一座设防的地方港口，归驻萨姆松的贾尼克辖区管辖，在18世纪对俄战争期间，码头始终外运木材和船具。

en:
Sivas, the Byzantine Sebasteia, lies at 1,278 metres in a broad valley of the upper Kızılırmak, where caravan roads from the Black Sea turned toward Syria and Iran. The Danishmend Turks held it after Manzikert until the Seljuk sultan Kılıç Arslan II took the city in 1174 and made it, with Konya, one of the two capitals of the Sultanate of Rum. The trade of those years paid for a row of stone monuments: Izzeddin Keykavus built his hospital, the Şifaiye, in 1217 and was buried in its tomb chamber; in 1271-72 the Ilkhanid vizier Shams al-Din Juvayni founded the Çifte Minareli Medrese, with its two tile-faced minarets. When Ibn Battuta visited in the early fourteenth century he called Sivas the largest city the Ilkhanids held in Anatolia. Eretna and Kadı Burhaneddin ruled it in turn, and in 1398 the townsmen submitted to Bayezid I. Timur stormed the city in the summer of 1400, put its garrison to the sword, sacked it and broke its walls. Ottoman rule returned between 1403 and 1408, and in 1444 Sivas was a fortified caravan market and staging town in the province of Rum, though the governor's seat was then at Tokat.

The Rum governors later moved from Tokat to Amasya and then, in 1526, to Sivas. The Celali risings that began late in the sixteenth century hit the region hard, as Turkmen bands and unpaid musketeers turned on tax collectors and garrisons; the same years give the traditional story of the Alevi folk poet Pir Sultan Abdal, a bard from a village near the city who, as his songs tell, was hanged in Sivas by its governor Hızır Paşa, and whose verses dervish singers carried across Anatolia. When Evliya Çelebi passed through in 1649 he counted 44 quarters and 4,600 houses within the walls, and 6,060 once the Inner Citadel and Pasha Castle were included. Order returned under the Köprülü viziers; in 1813 the governorship was again given to a vizier, and plague reached the city a year later.
zh:
锡瓦斯古称塞巴斯蒂亚，地处克孜勒河上游海拔1278米的宽阔谷地，黑海沿岸通往叙利亚和伊朗的商队道路在此转弯。曼齐刻尔特战役后达尼什曼德突厥人长期据有此城，1174年罗姆塞尔柱苏丹基利杰·阿尔斯兰二世将其攻取，与科尼亚并列为罗姆苏丹国的两座都城。商路之利为城中带来一批石建筑：伊兹丁·凯考斯1217年建起名为希法耶的医院，死后葬在医院的墓室内；1271至1272年，伊儿汗国维齐尔沙姆斯丁·朱韦尼又创办双塔伊斯兰学校，两座宣礼塔贴满彩釉砖。伊本·白图泰14世纪初到访时，称锡瓦斯是伊儿汗国在安纳托利亚最大的城市。此后埃雷特纳和卡迪·布尔汉丁相继统治，1398年市民向巴耶济德一世投降。1400年夏帖木儿破城，处死守军、纵兵洗劫并拆毁城墙。奥斯曼统治在1403至1408年间恢复；1444年的锡瓦斯是鲁姆行省设防的商队市场和驻兵要地，只是行省长官当时驻在托卡特。

鲁姆行省长官驻地后来从托卡特迁至阿马西亚，1526年再迁到锡瓦斯。16世纪末开始的杰拉里起事沉重打击这一带，土库曼武装和欠饷火枪手攻打卡税吏和驻军；相传阿列维派游吟诗人皮尔·苏丹·阿卜达尔就活动在这些年，他出身城边村庄，歌谣里唱他被锡瓦斯长官赫泽尔帕夏处以绞刑，诗句则由托钵僧歌手传遍安纳托利亚。1649年埃夫利亚·切莱比途经此地，记载城墙内有44个街区、4600户，加上内堡和帕夏堡共6060户。柯普吕律家族任大维齐尔期间秩序恢复；1813年锡瓦斯长官重新由维齐尔出任，一年后城中又闹瘟疫。

en:
Trebizond is a Black Sea port on the rocky Pontic coast, founded by Greek traders from Miletus in the eighth century BC. Its narrow coastal strip produced little; the city lived from Persian caravans over the Zigana Pass meeting Italian ships in its harbour. The Genoese bought the sea-fort of Leonkastron west of the harbour in 1306 for their Black Sea trade, the Venetians an outpost a few hundred metres away; the ground between became the European Quarter. Marco Polo took ship there for Venice on his way home from China, and in the mountains behind the city Greek monks had founded the cliffside monastery of Sumela in the fourth century. After the Fourth Crusade, Alexios Komnenos, a grandson of Emperor Andronikos I, seized the city with Georgian help in 1204 and founded the longest-lived of the Byzantine successor states. In 1444 John IV Komnenos still ruled an Orthodox, Greek-speaking city, his dynasty married to the Ak Koyunlu and Kara Koyunlu Turkmen; two years earlier a seaborne attack by Murad II had been broken up by heavy surf.

John IV gave his daughter Theodora, called Despina Khatun, to Uzun Hasan of the Ak Koyunlu in marriage; her grandson was Ismail I, the founder of Safavid Persia. Its native son, the Greek scholar Bessarion, attended the Council of Florence, became a Catholic cardinal and twice came close to the papacy. Neither marriage nor scholarship saved the empire: in summer 1461 Mehmed II seized Sinope, marched inland to pin Uzun Hasan down and put Trebizond under siege. The Emperor David, John's brother, surrendered after a month, on 15 August, and he and his sons were put to death in Constantinople two years later. Turkish families were settled in the conquered city, yet the registers of 1523 still counted 1,473 taxable men, about 85 per cent of them Christians. Prince Selim, later Selim I, governed the sanjak under his father, and his son, the future Süleyman the Magnificent, was born here in 1494. In 1598 Trebizond became the seat of its own eyalet, and its quays went on handling Persian and Caucasian caravan goods through the wars of the next two centuries.
zh:
特拉比松（今特拉布宗）坐落在本都的岩石海岸上，是公元前8世纪米利都希腊商人建立的黑海港口。沿海平原狭窄，出产有限，城市靠的是从波斯经扎加纳山口而来、在港中与意大利商船交接的商队。热那亚人1306年买下港西的海防堡垒莱昂卡斯特隆，以此经营黑海贸易；威尼斯人在几百米外另设商站，两者之间便被称作欧洲人街区。马可·波罗从中国返乡时就是从这里搭船回威尼斯的；城后的山中，希腊修士在4世纪修建了悬于崖壁的苏美拉修道院。第四次十字军东征后，安德洛尼卡一世皇帝之孙阿莱克修斯·科穆宁于1204年借格鲁吉亚之兵夺取此城，建立了拜占庭诸继承国中国祚最长的一个。1444年，约翰四世·科穆宁仍统治着这座说希腊语的东正教城市，王室与阿克科雍鲁、卡拉科雍鲁土库曼首领联姻；两年前穆拉德二世的一次海上进攻刚被巨浪打散。

约翰四世把女儿狄奥多拉（土库曼人称作德斯皮娜·哈敦）嫁给阿克科雍鲁的乌尊·哈桑，她的外孙就是萨法维波斯的开创者伊斯玛仪一世。本城出生的希腊学者贝萨里翁出席佛罗伦萨大公会议，后来当上天主教枢机，两度被视为教宗人选。联姻和学问都没能保住帝国：1461年夏，穆罕默德二世先取锡诺普，再进军内陆牵制住乌尊·哈桑，随即围攻特拉比松。皇帝大卫（约翰之弟）坚守一个月后于8月15日投降，两年后他和诸子在君士坦丁堡被处死。征服者向城中迁入突厥民户，但1523年的税册仍登记1473名纳税男丁，其中约85%是基督徒。皇子塞利姆（后来的塞利姆一世）在其父巴耶济德二世朝出任本地桑贾克长官，他的儿子、后来的苏莱曼大帝1494年生于此城。1598年，特拉比松成为独立行省的省会，此后两百年的历次战争中，码头依旧吞吐波斯和高加索商队的货物。

en:
Set on a plateau 1,900 metres up, Erzurum commands the high grasslands of eastern Anatolia. The Armenians called it Karin, and the Romans fortified it as Theodosiopolis, their strongest fortress on the Armenian frontier. After Manzikert the Saltukid Turkmen held the city until 1202, and between 1191 and 1200 the beylik was ruled by a woman, Melike Mama Hatun. Under Seljuk rule Hüdavent Hatun, daughter of Sultan Alaeddin Keykubad, founded the twin-minaret Çifte Minareli Medrese, the largest Seljuk madrasa in Anatolia. The Mongols of Bayju Noyan sacked the city in 1242, and after the Ilkhanids it fell to Timur and then to the Black Sheep Turkmen. In 1444 the Black Sheep ruler Jahan Shah held the citadel while his White Sheep rivals gathered in the west, and Armenian merchants and herdsmen lived off the Trabzon–Tabriz caravan road that crossed the plateau.

In 1467 the White Sheep sultan Uzun Hasan surprised and killed Jahan Shah, and the city passed to the White Sheep. His 'Law of Hasan Padishah' remained in force after the Ottoman conquest. Shah Ismail took the city in 1502 and imposed Shiism on its people; Sunni families fled and the town stood half empty; when Selim I passed nearby after Chaldiran in 1514 he is said to have refused to enter rather than see the ruined citadel. Suleiman I rebuilt and repeopled it as the Ottomans' forward base for the Iranian wars, lodging here in 1534 and 1554. It became the seat of the eyalet of Erzurum; commanders of the eastern campaigns kept their headquarters in the citadel, Lala Mustafa Pasha among them.

The large janissary garrison in the inner castle feuded with the townspeople, and in 1622 the governor Abaza Mehmed Pasha rose to avenge the murdered Osman II, had the garrison put to the sword and held the citadel until his pardon in 1628. Murad IV passed through in 1635 on his Yerevan campaign. The Sufi scholar İbrahim Hakkı, born here in 1703, wrote fifteen works and in 1756 completed an encyclopedia of religious and natural sciences compiled, he claimed, from some 400 books. Nader Shah's Iranians took it in 1733, and it returned to the sultan after his death in 1747.
zh:
埃尔祖鲁姆坐落在海拔近两千米的高原上，扼守安纳托利亚东部的高山牧场。亚美尼亚人旧称卡林，罗马人将其加固为狄奥多西波利斯，作为亚美尼亚边防最坚固的要塞。曼齐刻尔特战役后，萨尔图克突厥蛮据有此城，直到1202年；1191至1200年间，这个贝伊国还由一位女主梅莉凯·玛玛·哈通统治。塞尔柱时期，阿拉丁·凯库巴德苏丹之女胡达万特·哈通修建了双宣礼塔经学院，是安纳托利亚规模最大的塞尔柱经学院。1242年，拜住那颜的蒙古军洗劫全城，伊儿汗国之后城市先归帖木儿，后落入黑羊突厥蛮之手。1444年，黑羊君主贾汉·沙据守城堡，西边的白羊正集结兵力，亚美尼亚商人和牧民靠着穿越高原、连接特拉布宗与大不里士的商路为生。

1467年，白羊苏丹乌尊哈桑突袭并击杀贾汉·沙，城市转入白羊之手。他在此颁行的税律《哈桑帕迪沙法典》，奥斯曼征服后仍施行了一段时间。伊斯玛仪沙1502年攻占此城，强迫居民改宗什叶派，逊尼派家庭纷纷出走，城市十室九空；据说1514年塞利姆一世查尔迪兰战后回师经过附近，宁可不入城，也不愿看那座荒废的城堡。苏莱曼一世重建城池、招民实边，把埃尔祖鲁姆经营成对伊朗战争的前进基地，1534年和1554年两度在此驻留。此后这里成为埃尔祖鲁姆行省首府，东征军的统帅们（拉拉·穆斯塔法帕夏也在其中）把大营设在城堡中。

驻防内堡的新军人数众多，与市民积怨甚深，最终酿成阿巴扎·穆罕默德帕夏之乱：1622年，总督以为遇害的奥斯曼二世复仇为名起兵，杀尽堡中新军，据城坚守，至1628年投降获赦。穆拉德四世1635年远征埃里温途中经过此地。苏菲学者易卜拉欣·哈克1703年生于埃尔祖鲁姆，一生著述十五部，1756年完成一部兼宗教学问与自然科学的百科，自称参考约四百部书编成。1733年纳迪尔沙的伊朗军队攻占此城，1747年纳迪尔沙死后复归奥斯曼。

en:
Maraş sits below Mount Ahır on the roads from the Anatolian plateau down into Cilicia and northern Syria. Its citadel commanded the plain for the Neo-Hittite kings of Gurgum, for Arab frontier armies and later for Armenian lords who held the district after Byzantium lost the east. The Armenian lord Tatoul supplied and hosted the exhausted army of the First Crusade for four days before it marched on Antioch. Matthew of Edessa records that an earthquake in 1114 killed about 40,000 people around Maraş. From 1337 the city was one of the principal strongholds of the Dulkadir Turcomans, who balanced between their Mamluk overlords in Cairo and the other Anatolian princes. In 1444 Süleyman Bey ruled the buffer principality from Elbistan, while Maraş bazaars handled wool from Turcoman flocks pastured in the surrounding mountains.
