Around 1537 Shah Tahmasp brought Sistan under direct rule and the last malik departed for the Mughal court in India. The Hotak Afghans took Zaranj in 1717; Nader Shah retook it in 1738 on the eve of his siege of Kandahar, and after Nader's death in 1747 it passed to the Durrani Afghans, with the Baloch khans of Kalat holding it for a time.
zh:
扎兰季是锡斯坦历代都城沿用的名字。锡斯坦地势低平，赫尔曼德河在哈蒙湖的芦苇荡和潟湖间走到尽头，其古波斯语名扎兰卡意为「水乡」，这里的生计全看河水：古都拉姆·沙赫里斯坦因引水坝决口、渠水中断而被放弃，居民出走，另筑新扎兰季。中世纪城址在今城以北数公里的纳迪阿里，阿拉伯地理学家记下它坚固的城垣、拥挤的巴扎和马利克们的宏阔官署。

9世纪时，扎兰季是叶尔孤白·伊本·莱伊斯的都城：这位铜匠出身的军阀在此建立萨法尔王朝，从三角洲出兵横扫大半个伊斯兰东方，直到900年被萨曼王朝挡住。同一时代的穆斯林地理学家还记下锡斯坦的立式风车：漫长的夏季风催动布帆绕立轴旋转，用以磨面或提水，这是现存最早的风车明确记载。此后该城又作过纳西尔王朝和米赫拉卜王朝马利克的都城。1383年帖木儿大军攻入锡斯坦，洗劫扎兰季、屠戮居民、毁坏沟渠。1444年，这片逊尼派之地由米赫拉卜王朝的尼扎姆丁·叶海亚在锡斯坦城统治，农田、枣椰、畜群和羊毛地毯都靠赫尔曼德河。

末代马利克苏丹·马哈茂德1507年被乌兹别克的昔班尼汗夺去锡斯坦；1510年秋，他在赫尔曼德河畔趁乌兹别克人不备发动突袭，斩杀其将沙·曼苏尔，收复扎兰季，随后向沙阿·伊斯玛仪称臣，接受萨法维宗主权和在当地极不得人心的什叶派礼仪。约1537年塔赫玛斯普将锡斯坦收归朝廷直辖，末代马利克远赴印度投奔莫卧儿宫廷。1717年霍塔克阿富汗人攻占扎兰季，1738年纳迪尔沙在围攻坎大哈前夜将其收复；1747年纳迪尔沙死后，扎兰季归杜兰尼阿富汗所有，俾路支的卡拉特汗一度控制此地。

en:
Birjand is an oasis town on the dry southern fringe of Khorasan, in the medieval region of Quhistan. Streams off the arid hills water gardens that produced saffron, barberries and jujube, the crops for which the district was known. Yaqut al-Hamawi, writing in the thirteenth century, called it the most beautiful town in Quhistan, though Tun and Qa'en remained the chief towns of the region. It was also the birthplace of the Ismaili poet Nizari Quhistani, who died in 1320 and is the only Ismaili poet of that generation whose verse survives; his tomb lies in Birjand. In 1444 its Sunni Khorasani inhabitants held a small fortified oasis, a minor Timurid post on the roads south from Herat.

Two fortresses guarded the district in later centuries. The castle above the town was built up under Safavid rule and again under the Qajars, and in the 1740s Mirza Baqha Khan raised the hilltop citadel of Furg nearby, which his son Mirza Rafi Khan completed. Forbes, visiting it in 1814, found three cisterns cut into the rock that were said to hold enough water for a large garrison for a year and a half. After Nader Shah died in 1747, Afghan rulers briefly held parts of Khorasan and such local strongholds mattered the more; by the early Qajar decades Birjand had overtaken the older Quhistan towns as the district's centre.
zh:
比尔詹德是呼罗珊南部干旱边缘的绿洲城镇，属中世纪的古希斯坦地区。旱山流下的溪水浇灌着园圃，出产藏红花、小檗和枣，这一带正是以这些作物闻名。13世纪的雅库特·哈马维称它是古希斯坦最美的城镇，尽管当时地区首镇仍是图恩和加延。这里还是伊斯玛仪派诗人尼扎里·库希斯塔尼（Nizari Quhistani）的故乡，他卒于1320年，是那一代唯一有诗作传世的伊斯玛仪派诗人，陵墓就在比尔詹德。1444年，逊尼派呼罗珊人守着这座设防小绿洲，它是帖木儿帝国设在赫拉特以南诸路上的次要据点。

此后几个世纪，守护这一地区的是两座堡垒。城中山上的城堡在萨法维时期修筑，卡扎尔时期又加扩建；18世纪40年代，米尔扎·巴加汗在附近山顶修起富尔格要塞，由其子米尔扎·拉菲汗完工。1814年福布斯到此，见到岩凿的三座蓄水池，据说存水可供一支大军饮用一年半。1747年纳迪尔沙死后，阿富汗统治者一度据有呼罗珊部分地区，这类地方堡垒更显要紧；到卡扎尔王朝初期，比尔詹德已超过古希斯坦的老城，成为这一地区的中心。

en:
Snowmelt streams off the Kopet Dag water a chain of foothill oases called the Etek, or 'skirt': Nisa, Abivard and Anau, set along the caravan road between Khurasan and Khwarazm. Abivard belonged to an older Iranian chain of frontier posts raised against Inner Asian raiders. Nisa was an Arsacid fortress and reputed royal residence in Parthia, a trading post whose pastures were famous for strong horses, before an earthquake destroyed it in the first decade BC. In 1444 the fields and camps around its ruins made a remote Timurid border, loosely ruled from Shah Rukh's Herat; Persian-speaking villagers and Salor Turkmen herdsmen shared the water under Sunni overlordship.

The Anau mosque, built in 1456-1457, gave the oases one of their most distinctive Timurid landmarks: tiled mosaic on its portal showed two dragons facing each other. It went up as Timurid power on the steppe was breaking apart. Muhammad Shaybani's Uzbeks took Khwarazm in 1505 and overthrew the Timurid kingdom of Herat in 1507. Shah Ismail's Qizilbash killed Shaybani near Merv in 1510, but Ilbars Khan expelled their garrison in 1511 and founded the khanate of Khiva. Etek riders and villages then lay between Khiva, Bukhara and Shi'a Persia, all of which exacted tribute or launched raids.

The wars of Abu al-Ghazi Bahadur Khan from 1643 to 1663, followed by years of drought, pushed Turkmen clans toward Ahal and the Etrek River. Nadir Shah of Persia defeated Khiva in 1740 and crossed the region with his army; after his murder in 1747, Khivan claims returned, but day-to-day control over wells, pastures and village gates rested mainly with Turkmen auls.
zh:
科佩特山的融雪溪流在北麓滋养出一串山麓绿洲，穆斯林地理学家称之为埃泰克，意为「裙边」。尼萨、阿比沃尔德和阿瑙沿呼罗珊通往花剌子模的商路排列。阿比沃尔德古时属于伊朗人抵御内亚袭掠的边境据点链；尼萨则是安息的阿尔沙克要塞，相传也是王室居所，这座商站以牧场上的良马闻名，公元前1世纪头十年毁于地震。1444年，尼萨故址周围的农田和牧帐构成帖木儿帝国遥远的边境，由沙哈鲁在赫拉特的朝廷松散统辖；波斯语乡民与萨洛尔土库曼牧人共用山水，尊奉逊尼派宗主。

1456—1457年建成的阿瑙清真寺，是这片绿洲最有特点的帖木儿地标之一，门廊瓷砖马赛克上绘有双龙相对。它建起时，帖木儿人在草原上的权势已经分裂。1505年，穆罕默德·昔班尼的乌兹别克人攻下花剌子模，1507年又推翻赫拉特的帖木儿王朝。1510年，沙阿·伊斯玛仪的红头军在木鹿附近击杀昔班尼；但伊尔巴思汗在1511年逐出红头军守军，建立希瓦汗国。在这之后，埃泰克的骑手和村庄夹在希瓦、布哈拉与什叶派波斯之间，三方都会索贡或发动抄掠。

阿布·哈齐·巴哈杜尔汗1643—1663年的征战和随后的连年旱灾，把土库曼氏族推向阿哈尔和阿特列克河一带。1740年，波斯的纳迪尔沙击败希瓦并率军穿过这一地区；他1747年遇刺后，希瓦的宗主权名义上恢复，但水井、牧场和村门的日常控制主要落在土库曼人的阿吾勒手中。

en:
The Karakum, the 'black sand', fills the land between the Caspian and the Oxus with dune ridges, takyr flats and hand-dug wells; the Tejen and Murghab disappear into its southern sands. Until the seventeenth century the Uzboy carried water from Sarykamysh Lake about 750 kilometres to the Caspian, supporting fields and fishing villages in the north-western desert. In the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries its channel still ran. Elsewhere, Salor herdsmen moved sheep and camels between wells along the caravan road from Khwarazm to Khurasan. In 1444 these camps and river villages were loose subjects of the Timurid ruler Shah Rukh at Herat.

Muhammad Shaybani took Khwarazm in 1505, and Ilbars founded the khanate of Khiva in 1511. Khan Sufyan campaigned against Turkmen clans along the lower Uzboy in the 1520s and 1530s. Around 1600 the Oxus shifted its main current toward the Aral Sea, the Daryaliq branch and Uzboy dried up, and Sarykamysh shrank into salt marsh; riverside farmers and fishermen scattered into the desert, while Khwarazm's capital moved south from Konye-Urgench to Khiva. Drought and Abu al-Ghazi's wars from 1643 to 1663 pushed more clans toward Ahal and the Murgab, and the old Salor union broke apart later in the century. Nadir Shah crossed the sands to defeat Khiva in 1740, but after his murder in 1747 many wells answered only to local Turkmen auls. The Qongrat dynasty formally took power at Khiva in 1804; in 1821 Muhammad Rahim Khan could tax and recruit Turkmen riders wherever his army could reach the wells.
zh:
卡拉库姆意为「黑沙」，铺展在里海与乌浒水之间，地貌是连绵沙垄、龟裂黏土平地和人工挖掘的井泉；南端的捷詹河与穆尔加布河都消失在沙中。17世纪以前，乌兹博伊河把萨雷卡梅什湖的水送向约750公里外的里海，在西北沙漠中滋养农田和渔村；14、15世纪时，这条河道仍有水。其余地区由萨洛尔牧人使用，他们沿花剌子模通往呼罗珊的商路，赶着羊群和骆驼在井泉之间转场。1444年，这些牧帐与滨河村庄松散臣属于赫拉特的帖木儿统治者沙哈鲁。

1505年，穆罕默德·昔班尼攻取花剌子模；1511年，伊尔巴思建立希瓦汗国。1520—1530年代，苏菲扬汗在乌兹博伊下游征讨土库曼诸部。约1600年，乌浒水干流改向咸海，达里亚雷克支流与乌兹博伊河干涸，萨雷卡梅什缩成盐沼；滨河农户和渔人散入沙漠，花剌子模的都城也从库尼亚-乌尔根奇南迁希瓦。1643—1663年阿布·哈齐的征战和旱灾，把更多氏族推向阿哈尔和穆尔加布，古老的萨洛尔联盟也在17世纪后期解体。1740年，纳迪尔沙穿越沙漠击败希瓦；他1747年遇刺后，许多井泉只听命于当地土库曼人的阿吾勒。1804年，弘吉剌王朝在希瓦正式掌权；1821年穆罕默德·拉希姆汗在位，凡是军队能抵达井泉的地方，就能向土库曼骑手征税和征兵。

en:
Mangyshlak is the arid extension of the Ustyurt Plateau into the Caspian, fronted by the Tyub-Karagan and Buzachi capes. No river or freshwater spring breaks its coast, so winter pasture, fish shoals and seals mattered more than farmland. Mahmud al-Kashgari recorded the name Man Qishlag in the eleventh century and explained it as the wintering ground of the Man people. Pechenegs and then Oghuz, the people later called Turkmens, camped there, and a small Oghuz port at Tyub-Karagan served boats crossing the Caspian. In 1444 the peninsula belonged to the grazing circuit of the Sunni Nogai Horde, whose winter camps lined the eastern Caspian shore.

About 1520 the Kazakh khan Qasim overran the Nogai pastures and Nogai uluses moved west across the Volga. Khiva also claimed Mangyshlak, and under Khan Sufyan its Turkmen clans were assigned to Arabshahid sultans. Kalmyk forces seized the peninsula in 1639. In 1717 Alexander Bekovich-Cherkassky, leading the first Russian military expedition into Central Asia, built Fort St Peter at Tyub-Karagan before marching on Khiva; Khivan troops destroyed his main column and the fort was abandoned. In the eighteenth century the Adai clan of the Kazakh Junior Jüz made Mangyshlak its winter refuge and absorbed some Turkmen clans, while other Turkmens crossed west to the North Caucasus. In 1821 the shore camps lived mainly by their nets and paid tribute to whichever khan could reach them with enough riders.
zh:
曼格什拉克是乌斯秋尔特高原伸入里海的干旱半岛，前方是图布-卡拉甘角和布扎奇角。海岸上没有河流，也没有淡水泉，因此冬牧场、近岸鱼群和海豹比农田更重要。11世纪，马赫穆德·喀什噶里记下「曼基什拉克」（Man Qishlag）一名，把它解释为曼人的冬牧地。佩切涅格人之后，乌古斯人，也就是后来的土库曼人，在此扎营；图布-卡拉甘的小港供横渡里海的船只停泊。1444年，半岛属于逊尼派诺盖汗国的游牧圈，他们的冬营排列在里海东岸。

约1520年，哈萨克可汗哈斯木攻占诺盖牧场，诺盖诸部西迁，渡过伏尔加河。希瓦也对曼格什拉克提出主权要求；苏菲扬汗在位时，当地土库曼氏族被分封给阿拉伯沙希王朝的诸苏丹。1639年，卡尔梅克军队攻占半岛。1717年，亚历山大·别科维奇-切尔卡斯基率领俄国第一支中亚远征军，在进军希瓦前于图布-卡拉甘修建圣彼得要塞；希瓦军队歼灭远征军主力后，这座要塞也被放弃。18世纪，哈萨克小玉兹的阿代部把曼格什拉克作为冬牧避难所，并吸收部分土库曼氏族，另一些土库曼人则西迁北高加索。1821年，沿岸营地主要靠渔网为生，哪位可汗能带足够骑手抵达海岸，他们就向哪位可汗纳贡。

en:
Qaraqalpak covers the marshy northern edge of Khwarazm, where Amu Darya branches and the Kegeyli canal wind through reed beds, sheep walks and small fields around Chimbay. Fishermen worked the channels, herders raised sheep for wool, and fortresses and irrigation works had sustained settlement here long before the fifteenth century. The people who later gave the district their name were still far away in 1444: the Qaraqalpaqs, the 'black hats' of the Turkic steppe, were gathering as a confederation along the Syr Darya, while the lower Amu Darya delta had just become Abu'l-Khayr's Uzbek frontier after his men occupied Urgench in 1430 or 1431. Its Sunni farmers, shepherds and fishermen lived from river and pasture, linked by boat and caravan track to the old delta cities.

Outside records first clearly place the Qaraqalpaqs on the middle Syr Darya in the sixteenth century, and Abu al-Ghazi's chronicle still locates them there early in the seventeenth. In 1723 Kalmyk invaders seized that stretch of river and split the confederation into upper and lower groups; the lower communities drifted south-west down the dry Zhanadarya channel into the Amu Darya's old Aral delta. After Muhammad Amin, head of the Uzbek Qongirat clan, took power in Khwarazm in 1763, he settled a large Qaraqalpak group within the khanate and had canals dug for them. Chimbay became their market town, where boats from Khiva and Khodzheli unloaded beside caravans assembling for the road north to Orenburg.
zh:
卡拉卡尔帕克位于花剌子模北部的水网边缘，阿姆河各支汊与凯盖利运河穿行在钦博伊周围的芦苇荡、牧羊场和小块农田之间。渔夫在水道里打鱼，牧人放羊取毛；早在15世纪以前，堡垒和灌溉工程就已支撑起这里的定居生活。1444年，后来为这片地区命名的人还在远方：突厥草原上的「黑帽」卡拉卡尔帕克人正在锡尔河沿岸结成联盟，而阿姆河下游三角洲刚成为阿布勒海尔的乌兹别克边境，他的人马在1430年或1431年攻占了玉龙杰赤。当地信奉逊尼派的农民、牧人和渔夫靠河流与草场过活，靠船只和商道与旧三角洲诸城往来。

外界文献最早明确把卡拉卡尔帕克人记在锡尔河中游，时为16世纪；阿布·哈齐在17世纪初的编年史里仍把他们写在那里。1723年，入侵的卡尔梅克人夺取这段河道，把联盟截成「上部」与「下部」两支；下部各部顺着干涸的扎纳达里亚河道向西南迁徙，进入阿姆河注入咸海的旧三角洲。1763年，乌兹别克昆格拉特部首领穆罕默德·阿敏在花剌子模掌权，把一大群卡拉卡尔帕克人安置在汗国内，还为他们开挖灌渠。钦博伊就此成为他们的集镇，来自希瓦和霍杰伊利的船只在此停靠，北往奥伦堡的商队也在此集结。

en:
Khiva is the walled oasis town of Khwarezm south of the Aral Sea, where canals drawn from the Amu Darya water the fields and the caravan road runs between Gurganj and Hazarasp. Its inner town, the Itchan Kala, holds the old Juma Mosque, founded in the tenth century, and the shrine of Pahlavon Mahmud, a champion wrestler, poet and Sufi teacher who died in 1322 and became the city's patron saint; the astronomer al-Biruni, born late in the tenth century, was a native of Khiva or of nearby Kath. The Arab geographer al-Istakhri counted it among Khwarezm's thirty largest towns in 930. In 1444 it was a Turkic-speaking Sunni frontier town of the Timurid world, its bazaars fed by oasis gardens and by flocks pastured along the semi-desert edge, while Gurganj and Konye-Urgench drew the bigger caravans.

Khiva's name came with its own khanate. Muhammad Shaybani's Uzbeks took Khwarezm in 1505, and after his death and a short Persian occupation Ilbars expelled the Safavid garrison and in 1512 founded the Arabshahid line of khans; late in the sixteenth century Khiva replaced Konye-Urgench as their capital. Abu al-Ghazi Bahadur, who came to the throne in 1643, twice beat off Kalmyk raiders and wrote a genealogy of the Turks that remains a main source for the region. In 1717 the khan's men wiped out Alexander Bekovich-Cherkassky's Russian expedition out on the desert edge, and in 1740 Nadir Shah stormed the city and freed thousands of slaves. The slave market was Khiva's other trade: through the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries Turkmen raiders sold Persian and Russian captives here. In 1821 Muhammad Rahim Khan of the Qongrat line ruled a rich caravan city ringed with new madrasas and caravanserais.
zh:
希瓦是咸海以南花剌子模的绿洲城，引阿姆河的运河灌溉田园，商路连接古尔根奇与哈扎拉斯普。内城伊钦卡拉城墙环绕，其中有10世纪始建的聚礼日清真寺，还有帕赫拉万·马哈茂德的圣陵：此人力大绝伦，是摔跤冠军、诗人和苏菲行者，1322年去世后成为希瓦的守护圣徒；10世纪末出生的天文学家比鲁尼，故乡便是希瓦或附近的柯提。阿拉伯地理学家伊斯塔赫里930年已把希瓦列入花剌子模三十座大城。1444年的希瓦是帖木儿世界边缘一座讲突厥语的逊尼派城镇，巴扎靠绿洲田园和半荒漠边缘的畜群供货，更大的商队则往古尔根奇和库尼亚-乌尔根奇去。

希瓦的声名，是从有了自己的汗国开始的。1505年穆罕默德·昔班尼的乌兹别克人夺取花剌子模，他死后波斯人短暂占领，伊勒巴斯逐走萨法维驻军，于1512年建立阿拉伯沙希王朝；16世纪后期，希瓦取代库尼亚-乌尔根奇成为王都。1643年即位的阿布·哈齐·巴哈杜尔两次击退卡尔梅克袭掠者，还撰写了一部突厥世系，是研究这一地区的主要史料之一。1717年，汗的军队在沙漠边缘歼灭亚历山大·别科维奇-切尔卡斯基率领的俄国远征队；1740年纳迪尔沙破城，释放数千名奴隶。奴隶买卖是希瓦的另一桩生意：17至18世纪，土库曼袭掠者把掳来的波斯人和俄国人带到这里发卖。1821年，弘吉剌系的穆罕默德·拉希姆汗统治着一座富庶的商队之城，新城墙内外建起经学院和商馆。

en:
Bukhara stands on the lower Zeravshan, where the Silk Road divided between Merv and the oases north of the Pamirs. In the ninth century it was the capital of the Samanids, a Persianate city of libraries and mosques where the poet Rudaki sang and the traditionist Imam Bukhari was born; the brick Samanid mausoleum is the oldest of its monuments. The Kara-Khanids raised the Kalan minaret in 1127, and when Genghis Khan sacked the city after a fifteen-day siege in 1220 the tower alone was spared, so tall did he find it. It was also called the Tower of Death, for criminals were hurled from its gallery for centuries. The Timurids revived the city and built the Ulugh Beg madrasa in 1417, and outside the walls lay the shrine of Baha al-Din Naqshband, centre of the Naqshbandi Sufi order. In 1444 Bukhara was a Sunni, Persian-speaking city governed from Samarkand, its Ark citadel and roofed bazaars drawing the caravans as before.

In the spring of 1501 Muhammad Shaybani's Uzbeks defeated the Timurid princes at Sar-i Pul and took Bukhara. Ubaydullah Khan made the city his seat and lies buried in the Mir-i-Arab madrasa, and Abdullah Khan II made it the permanent capital of the Bukhara khanate in 1561, ringing it with new walls, madrasas and the covered trading domes; the Kukeldash madrasa and the Janid Lab-i Hauz pool followed. The bazaars dealt in men as well as goods: Bukhara and Khiva were the great slave markets of Central Asia, where Turkmen raiders sold their captives. The khanate fractured early in the eighteenth century, and in 1740 the city opened its gates to Nader Shah of Iran. The Manghit ataliqs then took power, Shah Murad taking the title of emir in 1785 and founding the Emirate of Bukhara; the four-towered Chor Minor was built for his son Haydar. In 1821 Bukhara was a walled city of two hundred madrasas under its own Uzbek emirs.
zh:
布哈拉位于泽拉夫尚河下游，丝绸之路在此分道，一路奔木鹿，一路通向帕米尔以北的绿洲。9世纪时它是萨曼王朝的都城，一座图书馆与清真寺林立的波斯语城市，诗人鲁达基在此吟唱，圣训学家伊玛目·布哈里出生于此；砖砌的萨曼王陵是城中最古老的建筑。喀喇汗王朝1127年建起卡兰宣礼塔，1220年成吉思汗围城十五日破城洗劫，唯独留下这座高塔，嫌它太过高大。此塔又叫「死亡之塔」，数百年间犯人从塔顶环廊被掷下行刑。帖木儿王朝时期城市复苏，1417年建成兀鲁伯经学院；城外的巴哈丁·纳格什班德圣陵，是纳格什班迪苏菲教团的中心。1444年的布哈拉是一座逊尼派波斯语城市，政令出自撒马尔罕，城堡与有顶巴扎照旧吸引着商队。

1501年春，穆罕默德·昔班尼的乌兹别克人在萨尔普勒击败帖木儿诸王，攻占布哈拉。乌拜杜拉汗以这里为王都，死后葬在米里·阿拉伯经学院；阿布都拉二世1561年定其为布哈拉汗国的永久都城，环城修筑城墙、经学院和有顶的贸易圆顶巴扎，库克达什经学院和札尼王朝的拉布·豪兹水池也相继建成。这里经手的不只有商货：布哈拉与希瓦是中亚两大奴隶市场，土库曼袭掠者把掳来的人发卖于此。18世纪初汗国分裂，1740年布哈拉向伊朗的纳迪尔沙开城。此后曼吉特世家的阿塔里克掌权，沙·穆拉德1785年自称埃米尔，建立布哈拉埃米尔国；四柱式的乔尔·米纳尔为其子海达尔而建。1821年的布哈拉是乌兹别克埃米尔治下一座城墙环绕、拥有两百座经学院的城市。

en:
The Ustyurt is the high clay tableland between the Caspian and the Aral, ringed by the pale sheer cliffs called chinks. No river crosses it; salt hollows and a chain of wells are the only breaks in the flat, and its people have always moved camels, goats and sheep between the wells along the caravan track that joined Khwarazm with the Yaik and the Volga mouth. In the fifteenth century the plateau belonged to the Manghit riders of the Nogai Horde, and in 1444 their Sunni uluses pastured across it from the Emba to the approaches of Khwarazm.

Around 1520 the Kazakh khan Qasim's victories shattered the Nogai order and pulled the western uluses across the Volga, leaving the Ustyurt a march disputed between the Kazakhs, the Karakalpaks by the Aral and the khan of Khiva. In the 1630s the Kalmyks swept over the tableland, and the Aral Turkmen clans, pressed from both sides, migrated as far as Astrakhan and the North Caucasus. In 1717 a Russian army crossed the wells. Its commander, Prince Alexander Bekovich-Cherkassky, was a Kabardian officer who had mapped the Caspian for Peter the Great, and the tsar sent him to bring Khiva into vassalage and reopen the old bed of the Amu Darya, rumoured to carry gold sand. Marching from Guryev over the Emba, Bekovich beat the khan's 24,000 men in three days of fighting at Karagach, within 120 versts of Khiva, then accepted the khan's peace offer and let his troops be lodged in five separate towns. Khivan riders destroyed the detachments one by one; Bekovich was killed, his head was sent as a gift to the khan of Bukhara, and the Yomut Turkmens of the Caspian shore were blamed for his death. Russians later said of a man who vanished that he had perished like Bekovich. Through the eighteenth century Adai Kazakhs grazed the tableland and Khivan raiders took what tribute they could, and in 1821 the wells still answered to the strongest ulus nearby.
zh:
乌斯秋尔特是横亘在里海与咸海之间的高耸黏土台地，四周边缘是被称作「钦克」的浅色陡崖。台地上没有一条河，只有盐碱洼地和一线串联的水井；居民向来半游牧，沿连接花剌子模与乌拉尔河、伏尔加河口的商道，赶着骆驼、山羊和羊群在井泉间转场。15世纪时，台地归诺盖汗国的曼格特骑手所有；1444年，他们的逊尼派兀鲁思从恩巴河一直游牧到花剌子模门口。

约1520年，哈萨克可汗哈斯木连胜，瓦解了诺盖秩序，把西部兀鲁思卷过伏尔加河，乌斯秋尔特成了哈萨克人、咸海边的卡拉卡尔帕克人和希瓦汗之间争夺的边地。1630年代，卡尔梅克人席卷台地，咸海沿岸的土库曼氏族两面受挤，一度远迁阿斯特拉罕和北高加索。1717年，一支俄国军队越过这片水井地带。统帅亚历山大·别科维奇-切尔卡斯基是卡巴尔达王公，曾为彼得大帝测绘里海；彼得要他迫使希瓦称臣，并重新开通乌浒水故道，据说故道里有金沙。别科维奇从古里耶夫出发，跨过恩巴河，在距希瓦不到120俄里的卡拉加奇与希瓦汗的24000人激战三天，将其击退，随后接受议和，听任军队分驻五城。希瓦骑兵把各分队逐个消灭，别科维奇被杀，头颅作为礼物送给布哈拉汗，里海岸边的约穆特土库曼人被指参与了对他的袭击。俄国民间后来形容人一去不回，就说他「像别科维奇一样送了命」。整个18世纪，阿代哈萨克人在台地上放牧，希瓦劫掠者尽力搜刮贡赋；到1821年，水井仍归附近最强的兀鲁思支配。

en:
Charjuy is the principal crossing on the middle Oxus. The old town of Amul stood on the left bank, where routes to Bukhara, Khiva and Merv came together; the Amu Darya is said to take its name from Amul. Out on the Khiva road stood Dayahatyn, one of the finest Seljuk brick caravanserais in Central Asia. It began as a ninth-century fortress and was converted in the eleventh century into a square fortified enclosure, with sides fifty-three metres long, where merchants and envoys could lodge. The Mongols razed Amul in 1221 after it resisted, but the ferry returned. In 1444 the crossing belonged to Ulugh Beg's Timurid government in Transoxiana. A citadel watched the boats, and merchants paid toll before entering the desert or travelling upstream to Bukhara.

The name Charjuy comes from Persian Chahardjuy, 'four channels'. In 1511 Babur camped by four canals near the ruins of Amul and used the name in his memoir. After Muhammad Shaybani's Uzbek conquest of Transoxiana and the rise of a separate Khiva, Charjuy became a border town between Bukhara and Khiva. In 1740 Nader Shah, campaigning against both khanates, had a bridge thrown across the Oxus wide enough for two laden camels to pass abreast, then sent his army over. Bukharan troops took the town in November 1762 and subdued nearby Turkmen tribes. Under the Manghit emirate founded in 1785, the walled town became the seat of the begs of Charjuy, living on tolls and traffic between Bukhara, Khiva and Merv.
zh:
查尔朱伊是阿姆河中游的主要渡口。旧城阿穆尔位于左岸，通往布哈拉、希瓦和木鹿的道路在附近会合，据说阿姆河的名字便得自阿穆尔。希瓦道旁的达亚哈顿是中亚最出色的塞尔柱砖构商队客栈之一。它本是9世纪堡垒，11世纪改作方形设防客栈，围墙每边长五十三米，商人和使节都可在此住宿。1221年，阿穆尔因抵抗蒙古人被夷平，但渡口后来恢复。1444年，此地归乌鲁伯格治下的河中帖木儿政权管辖。城堡看守着渡船，商人完税之后，或进入沙漠，或溯河北上布哈拉。

「查尔朱伊」来自波斯语「恰哈尔朱伊」，意为「四条渠」。1511年，巴布尔在阿穆尔废墟旁的四条水渠边扎营，并在回忆录中使用这个名字。穆罕默德·昔班尼率乌兹别克人征服河中、希瓦另立汗国后，查尔朱伊成了布哈拉与希瓦之间的边镇。1740年，纳迪尔沙阿进讨这两个汗国，命人在阿姆河上架起一座宽到可供两匹驮货骆驼并行的桥，随即率军渡河。1762年11月，布哈拉军队攻占城镇，降服附近的土库曼部落。1785年曼吉特埃米尔国建立后，这座带城墙的城镇成为查尔朱伊省长官驻地，靠布哈拉、希瓦和木鹿之间的通行税与商队贸易维持。

en:
Merv is the old oasis city on the Murghab River, where the Silk Road runs along the southern edge of the Karakum. Canals from the river watered its cotton fields and a ring of walled towns, and in the twelfth century geographers called it 'mother of the world' and 'capital of the eastern Islamic world'; around 1200 it may have held half a million people, perhaps more than any other city on earth. It was the capital of the Great Seljuk sultans, above all Ahmad Sanjar, buried there in the great domed mausoleum named after him. Nizam al-Mulk founded a library and madrasa in the city, Yaqut counted ten libraries, one of them holding 12,000 volumes, and Omar Khayyam worked for years at its observatory. In 1221 the Mervis opened their gates to Tolui, Genghis Khan's son, and his army killed almost the whole population; Arab and Persian writers put the dead at 700,000 or even 1.3 million, and the Mongols burned Sanjar's mausoleum and dug up his grave in search of treasure. Partly rebuilt, it belonged to Timur's empire by 1380. In 1444 its walled towns, canals and cotton fields were a Timurid possession, linking Khurasan with the roads to Bukhara and Samarkand.

The Uzbeks occupied Merv in 1505, but on 2 December 1510 Shah Ismail I's Safavid army met them outside the oasis and killed Muhammad Shaybani, bringing Khurasan to the Safavids. Abdullah Khan II of Bukhara took the city in 1593, until Shah Abbas recovered it and set Safavid governors over it; in 1608 Mihrab Khan Qajar began nearly two centuries of rule by his family over the oasis. Nader Shah campaigned against the Turkmen raiders and restored the irrigation works, and after his death the local Qajars ruled Merv on their own. In 1785 Shah Murad of Bukhara took the city and killed Bayram 'Ali Khan Qajar, and in 1788 and 1789 his army razed Merv, broke its dams and deported about 100,000 people of the city and oasis to Bukhara and Samarkand. The old site was left empty and the canals ran dry, and in 1821 the walled cities were uninhabited ruins.
zh:
木鹿（又译梅尔夫）是穆尔加布河畔的古老绿洲城市，丝绸之路沿卡拉库姆沙漠南缘经过这里。河水引出的渠网浇灌着棉田和一圈带城墙的城镇；到12世纪，地理学家给它的称号有「世界之母」「东方伊斯兰世界之都」，1200年前后城中人口可能达五十万，也许是当时世界第一大城。它是大塞尔柱帝国的都城，最著名的苏丹艾哈迈德·桑贾尔就葬在为他修建的宏伟穹顶陵墓中。尼扎姆·穆勒克在此创办图书馆和经学院，雅古特统计城中有十座图书馆，其中一座藏书一万二千卷，奥马尔·海亚姆也在木鹿的天文台工作多年。1221年，木鹿人向成吉思汗之子拖雷的军队开城，结果几乎全城人口遇害，阿拉伯和波斯史家笔下的死者达七十万甚至一百三十万；蒙古人焚毁桑贾尔陵墓，掘开他的坟墓搜刮金银。城市后来部分重建，1380年已归入帖木儿帝国。1444年，这里的城郭、渠系和棉田属帖木儿王朝所有，把呼罗珊同通往布哈拉、撒马尔罕的道路连接起来。

1505年乌兹别克人占领木鹿，但1510年12月2日，沙阿·伊斯玛仪一世的萨法维军队在绿洲外交战，杀死穆罕默德·昔班尼，呼罗珊并入萨法维王朝。布哈拉的阿卜杜拉汗二世1593年夺取此城，后来沙阿·阿拔斯将其收复并设置总督；1608年，米赫拉卜汗·卡扎尔就任总督，开始卡扎尔家族对绿洲近两百年的统治。纳迪尔沙阿出兵征讨土库曼袭扰者，修复灌溉设施；他死后，当地卡扎尔势力独自统治木鹿。1785年，布哈拉的沙阿·穆拉德攻陷此城，杀死拜拉姆·阿里汗·卡扎尔；1788至1789年，他的军队夷平木鹿、拆毁水坝，把城市和绿洲约十万人迁往布哈拉与撒马尔罕。旧城就此荒弃，渠道干涸；1821年时，城墙围起的诸城只剩无人居住的废墟。

en:
Herat lies in the fertile valley of the Hari River below the Paropamisus range, on the roads that join the Mediterranean to India and China. It was old and rich before the Mongols: the Ghurid sultan Ghiyath al-Din began its Great Mosque in 1201, and its bronze workshops inlaid their wares with gold and silver. The Mongols besieged it twice; the second siege lasted seven months and ended in June 1222 with a massacre, and the city lay in ruins until the Kart dynasty rebuilt it, when poets called it the 'pearl of Khorasan', the pearl in Khorasan's oyster. Timur ended Kart rule in the 1380s. His son Shah Rukh made Herat his capital after Timur died, and with his wife Gawhar Shad raised the Musalla complex, her madrasa and gardens, and enlarged the bazaar; a Ming embassy that included Chen Cheng arrived in 1413. In 1444 the aged Shah Rukh still ruled his empire from here.

The city's finest years came under Sultan Husayn Bayqara, who reigned here from 1469 to 1506. His minister Ali-Shir Nava'i, a poet in Persian and Turkic, built mosques, madrasas and baths and gathered writers and musicians at court; the painter Behzad led the Herat school of miniatures. Armies soon followed one another through its walls. The Uzbeks seized Herat in 1507, Shah Ismail took it for the Safavids three years later, and Tahmasp retook it in 1528. The Safavids called it the greatest of the cities of Iran and sent every heir to the throne, from Tahmasp I to Abbas I, to govern it in his youth; Abbas the Great was born here. In 1716 Abdali Afghans drove out the Safavid garrison and set up a Sadozai sultanate. Nader retook the city in the Safavid name in 1732, and after his murder it passed to Ahmad Shah Durrani's Afghan empire; before the century ended Herat was ruled as a principality of its own.
zh:
哈烈（赫拉特）位于帕罗帕米苏斯山南麓哈里河的肥沃河谷，地当地中海通往印度和中国的商路。蒙古人到来之前它已富庶而古老：古尔王朝苏丹吉亚斯丁1201年动工兴建聚礼大清真寺，铜器作坊以金银镶嵌闻名。蒙古军两度围城，第二次围了七个月，1222年6月城破后大肆屠戮，城市就此荒废，直到卡尔特王朝将其重建；诗人们称它为「呼罗珊的珍珠」——呼罗珊蚌壳中含着的那颗珠。帖木儿在14世纪80年代终结了卡尔特王朝。其子沙哈鲁在帖木儿死后以哈烈为都，与妻子高哈尔·沙德建起穆萨拉建筑群、以她命名的经学院和多处园林，扩建巴扎；1413年，明朝派出包括陈诚在内的使团抵达此地。1444年，年迈的沙哈鲁仍坐镇哈烈统治帝国。

哈烈最辉煌的年代在速檀忽辛·拜哈拉治下，他从1469年统治到1506年。宰相阿里希尔·纳沃伊以波斯语和突厥语写诗，修建清真寺、经学院和浴场，把文士和乐师聚集到宫廷；画家贝赫扎德领衔的赫拉特细密画派名重一时。此后军队接踵穿过它的城墙。1507年乌兹别克人夺取哈烈，三年后伊斯玛仪一世为萨非王朝攻下此城，塔赫马斯普又于1528年收复。萨非王朝把它称作伊朗诸城之首，从塔赫马斯普一世到阿巴斯一世，每位王储年少时都出镇哈烈，阿巴斯大帝就出生于此。1716年，阿布达里部阿富汗人赶走萨非守军，建立萨多扎伊苏丹国；纳迪尔1732年以萨非王朝的名义收复此城，他遇刺后哈烈并入艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的阿富汗帝国，18世纪末已自成一个公国。

en:
Kandahar lies on a hot plain between the Arghandab and Tarnak rivers, astride the old highway between Iran and India. Greeks founded Old Kandahar in the fourth century BC as Alexandria of Arachosia; the edicts of Ashoka were cut in Greek and Aramaic on the Chil Zena rock beside its citadel. Arab armies brought Islam, and in 870 Ya'qub ibn al-Layth al-Saffar overthrew the Zunbils. Ibn Battuta in 1333 found a prosperous town three days' ride from Ghazni; Timur took it in 1383 and put his grandson Pir Muhammad in charge. In 1444 Kandahar was a frontier march of Shah Rukh's Timurid realm, garrisoned for Herat while Afghan tribes pastured flocks in the hills and cotton, figs and pomegranates moved through its bazaars.

Late in the fifteenth century the Timurids of Herat left Kandahar to the Arghun chief Dhu'l-Nun Beg and his son Shah Beg, who ruled it as their own. Babur of Kabul annexed it in 1508 and had forty stone steps cut into the Chil Zena rock above the citadel; his son Humayun later carved the record of his conquests there. Mughals and Safavids disputed the city for the next century and a half. Humayun surrendered it to Shah Tahmasp in return for troops to reconquer India, Akbar recovered it by negotiation in 1595, Shah Abbas I retook it in 1622, the governor Ali Mardan Khan delivered it to Shah Jahan in 1638, and Shah Abbas II captured it in 1649 after a two-month siege. Three Mughal attempts failed, the last abandoned by Dara Shukoh with 70,000 men in 1653; Sa'ib Tabrizi made the long contest the subject of his Qandahar-nama.

In 1709 the Ghilji chief Mirwais Hotak slew the Safavid governor Gurgin Khan, made Kandahar his capital and routed two Persian armies; his son Mahmud seized Isfahan in 1722. Nader Shah's guns destroyed Old Kandahar in 1738, and he built Naderabad beside the ruins. Ahmad Shah Durrani made it his capital in 1747 and in 1761 laid out a walled rectangle three miles around, with six gates and a moat; at its centre he put his mausoleum and the Kirka Sharif, the shrine holding the cloak of Muhammad brought from Fayzabad in Badakhshan. His son Timur Shah moved the court to Kabul in 1776.
zh:
坎大哈坐落在阿尔甘达卜河与塔尔纳克河之间的炎热平原，横亘在伊朗与印度之间的古道上。公元前4世纪，希腊人在此建起老坎大哈，名为阿拉霍西亚的亚历山大城；城堡旁的「四十阶」岩壁（Chil Zena）上，留有阿育王以希腊文和阿拉米文镌刻的敕文。阿拉伯军队把伊斯兰带到这里，870年叶尔孤白·本·莱斯·萨法尔推翻尊比勒王朝。伊本·白图泰1333年路过时，这里是距加兹尼三日骑程的繁荣城镇；1383年帖木儿攻克此城，命其孙皮儿·马黑麻镇守。1444年，坎大哈是沙哈鲁帖木儿帝国的边疆要地，替哈烈宫廷戍守通道，阿富汗诸部在周围山地放牧，棉花、无花果和石榴在城中巴扎集散。

15世纪末，哈烈的帖木儿君主把坎大哈交给阿尔浑部首领祖勒农·别格及其子沙·别格，父子据地自治。1508年，据守喀布尔的帖木儿宗王巴布尔兼并此城，又命人在俯瞰城堡的四十阶岩壁上凿出四十级石阶；其子胡马雍后来把巴布尔征战的经过刻在岩上。此后一个半世纪，莫卧儿与萨法维反复争夺这座城：胡马雍以它向塔赫玛斯普换取收复印度所需的波斯援军，1595年阿克巴经谈判收回，1622年阿拔斯一世攻占，守将阿里·马尔丹汗1638年把城献给沙贾汗，1649年阿拔斯二世围城两月后再度攻克。莫卧儿三次反攻均告失败，最后一次是1653年达拉·舒科率军七万围城又被迫撤兵；诗人萨伊卜·塔布里齐把这场漫长争夺写入《坎大哈书》。

1709年，吉尔吉部首领米尔维斯·霍塔克杀死萨法维总督古尔金汗，以坎大哈为都建立霍塔克政权，两度击溃波斯大军；其子马哈茂德挥军远征，1722年攻克伊斯法罕。1738年，纳迪尔沙的炮火摧毁老坎大哈，他在废墟旁另建纳迪拉巴德。1747年艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼定都于此，1761年动工兴建矩形新城：城墙周长三英里，开六座城门，外绕壕沟；他把自己的陵墓和圣袍清真寺安置在城中心，寺中供奉他从巴达赫尚法扎巴德迎来的先知穆罕默德斗篷。其子帖木儿沙1776年把宫廷迁往喀布尔。

en:
Ghazni stands on the high plateau of Zabulistan at more than 2,200 metres, holding the ancient road between Kabul and Kandahar. In 962 the Turkic mamluk Alp Tigin besieged its citadel for four months and took it from its Lawik kings; his successor Sabuktigin made it the seat of his house. Under Sabuktigin's son Mahmud (r. 998-1030) it was the capital of an empire reaching from Iran to the Punjab: his armies came back from India with temple plunder, and his court drew the best Persian writers of the age. Firdawsi is said to have recited the Shahnameh there, and al-Biruni worked and was buried in the city. Mahmud's mausoleum is still among its shrines, and outside the city stand the two Ghaznavid victory minarets of Mas'ud III and Bahram Shah, their brick shafts sheathed in terracotta geometric patterns and Qur'anic verses.

The Ghurid Ala al-Din Husayn sacked Ghazni in 1151, and the city burned for seven days and seven nights; the Ghurids made it their second capital in 1173. Genghis Khan's son Ogedei destroyed it in 1221; Ibn Battuta in 1333 found the tomb of 'the warrior-sultan Mahmud' standing amid largely ruins. Timur's grandson Pir Muhammad held Ghazni with Kabul and Kandahar from 1401, but by 1444 it was a shrunken provincial town under loose Timurid overlordship, its citadel and old minarets above the bazaars and the surrounding hills in the hands of Afghan tribes.

After Shah Rukh died in 1447 it passed among local chiefs. Babur took it with Kabul in 1504 and enfeoffed his half-brother Jahangir Mirza, who held it until his death in 1507; Babur himself called the place 'mean' and wondered why princes had chosen it as their seat. It remained a Mughal fortress, and when Akbar's half-brother Mirza Hakim ruled Kabul as a virtually independent prince, Ghazni joined his rebellions of 1566 and 1581. After Hakim died in 1585 the appanage was dissolved and Kabulistan came under direct imperial rule. Nader Shah overran it in 1738, marching from Kandahar to Kabul, and in 1747 it passed to Ahmad Shah Durrani, serving its kings as a fortress between their Kandahar and Kabul capitals.
zh:
加兹尼坐落在扎布尔斯坦海拔2200多米的高原上，扼守喀布尔与坎大哈之间的古道。962年，突厥奴隶将领阿尔普特勤围攻加兹尼城堡四个月，从劳维克王族手中夺城；他的后继者苏布克特勤把这里立为本家族的根基。到苏布克特勤之子马哈茂德（998—1030年在位）时，加兹尼成为一个疆域从伊朗延伸到旁遮普的帝国的都城：他的军队从印度掠回神庙财宝，宫廷又汇聚了当时最优秀的波斯语文人。菲尔多西据传在此诵读《列王纪》，比鲁尼在此治学，身后也葬在城中。马哈茂德的陵墓仍是城里的圣迹，城外立着马斯乌德三世和巴赫拉姆沙两座伽色尼胜利塔，砖制塔身饰满陶砖拼出的几何纹样和《古兰经》经文。

1151年古尔王公阿拉乌丁·侯赛因洗劫加兹尼，城烧了七天七夜；1173年古尔人又把它定为副都。1221年成吉思汗之子窝阔台摧毁此城，1333年伊本·白图泰到访时，只见「战将苏丹马哈茂德」的陵墓孑立于大半废墟之间。帖木儿之孙皮儿·马黑麻自1401年起领有加兹尼、喀布尔与坎大哈，但到1444年，它已是一座萎缩的边镇，只承着哈烈松散的帖木儿主权，城堡和古塔立于巴扎之上，四周群山尽在阿富汗部落手中。

1447年沙哈鲁死后，它在地方酋长之间易手。1504年巴布尔攻取喀布尔时连下加兹尼，把它封给异母弟只罕杰儿·米儿咱，他领有加兹尼直至1507年去世；巴布尔本人却嫌此地「鄙陋」，想不通诸王公为何选它建都。此后它一直是莫卧儿军镇，阿克巴之弟米尔扎·哈基姆以喀布尔割据称雄时，加兹尼也随他卷入1566年和1581年的两次叛乱。1585年哈基姆死后，封地被废，喀布里斯坦收归帝国直辖。1738年，纳迪尔沙从坎大哈进军喀布尔途中拿下加兹尼；1747年它归入艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼，历代国王把它当作坎大哈与喀布尔两都之间的要塞。

en:
Ghor is the mountain core of Afghanistan, a tangle of high valleys where the Hari Rud and its tributaries cut through cold pasture between Herat and Ghazni. These remote hills were the homeland of the Ghurid chiefs, whose summer capital Firozkoh stood by the Jam river. From Ghor the brothers Ghiyath al-Din Muhammad and Muhammad of Ghor built an empire that stretched from Khorasan to Bengal: Muhammad's victory over Prithviraj Chauhan in 1192 opened northern India to Muslim rule, and his mamluk Qutb ud-Din Aibak took the Indian conquests and founded the Delhi Sultanate. About 1190 the Ghurids raised the 65-metre Minaret of Jam, a baked-brick tower sheathed in Kufic and Naskhi calligraphy, perhaps to proclaim that victory; Aibak's Qutb Minar at Delhi was built on its pattern. Firozkoh's Friday mosque was swept away by a flash flood before the Mongols burned the city in 1222, and the minaret alone survived.

In 1444 Ghor was a backwater of the Timurid realm, its Afghan and Aimaq clans living by their flocks around the small town of Ahangaran, which Babur, riding through early in 1507 on his march to Kandahar, calls Chakhcheran in his memoirs. The armies of Uzbeks, Safavids and Mughals mostly kept to the roads around the mountains and left the clans to themselves; the valleys were drawn into the Durrani empire with Herat only in the eighteenth century.
zh:
古尔是阿富汗腹地的山乡，哈里河及其支流在哈烈与加兹尼之间切出一片片高寒牧场。这片偏远群山是古尔诸酋的故土，他们的夏都菲鲁兹库赫就坐落在贾姆河畔。吉亚斯丁·穆罕默德与穆罕默德·古尔兄弟从这里起家，把疆域从呼罗珊一直推到孟加拉：1192年穆罕默德击败普里色毗罗阇，为穆斯林统治北印度打开大门，他的奴隶将领库特布丁·艾伊拜克接管印度征服地，建立德里苏丹国。约1190年，古尔人建起高65米的贾姆尖塔，砖塔通体饰以库法体与纳斯赫体书法，可能就是为宣告这场大捷而立；艾伊拜克在德里修建的顾特卜塔便取法于它。菲鲁兹库赫的聚礼清真寺在蒙古人1222年焚城之前已被山洪冲走，城中只剩尖塔独存。

1444年，古尔是帖木儿治下的偏远边地，阿富汗与艾马克诸部围着阿亨格兰小镇以牧群为生；巴布尔1507年初进军坎大哈时途经此地，在回忆录里把它写作恰赫恰兰。乌兹别克、萨法维和莫卧儿的军队多走山外的大路，听任诸部自行其是，直到18世纪这些山谷才随哈烈并入杜兰尼帝国。

en:
Balkh stands in an oasis on the seasonal Balkh River, south of the Amu Darya. As Bactra it was the chief city of Bactria and later Tokharistan, and a centre of Zoroastrianism and Buddhism: when the Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang visited in 630 he counted about a hundred monasteries and 3,000 monks, and the Nava Vihara monastery kept a giant image of the Buddha. Its hereditary guardians, the Barmakids, turned Muslim and went on to run the Abbasid Caliphate; Khalid ibn Barmak and his son Yahya served Harun al-Rashid as viziers. Jalal al-Din Rumi was born in Balkh in 1207 and fled west with his family before the Mongol armies. The Mongols sacked the city, and Timur, who had himself proclaimed amir at Balkh, destroyed its citadel in 1389; Shah Rukh rebuilt the fortress. When the Ming envoy Chen Cheng passed through in 1413 he found wide fields, plentiful food and merchants gathered from many countries. In 1444 Balkh was a Sunni town of the Timurid Empire, a crossing between the Iranian plateau, the Central Asian steppe and the roads to Kabul.

Muhammad Shaybani's Uzbeks entered Balkh in 1506. Safavid troops expelled them in 1510, and Babur held the city in 1511–12 as a Safavid vassal until the Khanate of Bukhara drove him back to Kabul; Bukhara kept it apart from a brief Safavid reoccupation around 1600. Shah Jahan campaigned in the oasis in the 1640s, turned Balkh into an imperial province in 1646 and lost it the next year; the young Aurangzeb held his first governorship there.

Among the monuments standing in the ruined old city were the shrine-mosque of Khwaja Nasr Parsa, known as the Green Mosque, the ninth-century Nine Domes Mosque, the oldest Islamic building in Afghanistan, and the tomb of the poet Rabi'a Balkhi, the first woman to write Persian verse. Nader Shah conquered Balkh in 1736, and after his death the Uzbek leader Haji Khan made it independent in 1747 under the Maimana Khanate. By the early nineteenth century the Uzbek Qataghan dynasty dominated the oasis from Khulm.
zh:
巴尔赫位于阿姆河以南、季节性的巴尔赫河畔绿洲。古时它叫巴克特拉，是巴克特里亚及后来吐火罗斯坦的首要城市，也是琐罗亚斯德教和佛教的中心：中国僧人玄奘630年到访时，记下城内有佛寺约百所、僧徒三千余人，纳瓦-维哈拉（Nava Vihara，意为新寺）中还供着一尊巨佛。这座佛寺的世袭住持家族巴尔马克人后来改宗伊斯兰，进入阿拔斯哈里发国的权力中枢，哈立德·伊本·巴尔马克及其子叶海亚相继为相，叶海亚正是哈伦·拉希德的维齐尔。苏菲诗人鲁米1207年生于巴尔赫，蒙古军到来前随家人西逃，最终定居科尼亚。蒙古军洗劫此城，曾在巴尔赫被拥立为埃米尔的帖木儿又于1389年摧毁城堡，后来由沙哈鲁重建。明朝使臣陈诚1413年路过，看到的是「田地宽广，食物丰饶」、各国商人聚居的城池。1444年的巴尔赫是帖木儿帝国的一座逊尼派城市，地处伊朗高原、中亚草原与通往喀布尔诸路之间的往来要冲。

1506年，穆罕默德·昔班尼率乌兹别克人进入巴尔赫。1510年萨法维军队将其逐出，巴布尔1511—1512年作为萨法维附庸据有此城，随后被布哈拉汗国逼回喀布尔；除1600年前后萨法维人短暂收复外，巴尔赫长期属布哈拉。1640年代，沙贾汉在这片绿洲用兵，1646年把巴尔赫改为帝国行省，次年即告失守；年轻的奥朗则布正是在这里出任他的第一个总督职务。

老城大半已成废墟，其间立着和卓·纳斯尔·帕尔萨圣祠清真寺（绿色清真寺），还有9世纪的九穹顶清真寺，是阿富汗现存最早的伊斯兰建筑；波斯文学第一位女诗人拉比雅·巴尔希（Rabi'a Balkhi）也葬在此城。纳迪尔沙1736年征服巴尔赫，他死后乌兹别克首领哈吉汗于1747年宣布独立，臣属迈马纳汗国。到19世纪初，乌兹别克卡塔甘王朝以胡勒姆为中心控制着这片绿洲。

en:
Kabul sits in a high, narrow valley of the Hindu Kush, on the Kabul River, where the roads of Persia, Turkestan and Hindustan meet. It passed from the Kabul Shahis through the Ghaznavids to the Ghurids and weathered the Mongols, but never quite recovered. When Ibn Battuta passed through in 1333 he found a village in the old city's ruins, held by Afghan tribesmen. Timur's empire made it a trading centre once more, and Timurid princes kept it afterward. In 1444, with the aged Shah Rukh reigning from Herat, Kabul was a Muslim frontier town beneath the Bala Hisar citadel, its bazaars moving Badakhshan's lapis lazuli and balas rubies and the valley's fruit toward India.

While the rest of the Timurid inheritance broke into warring principalities, Ulugh Beg II gave Kabul and Ghazni four decades of stable rule, and Yusufzai Pashtuns drifted into the country. After his death the Arghun chief Mukim seized it, until his Timurid kinsman Babur drove him out in 1504 and made Kabul his base. Babur liked its climate and laid out gardens above the town; from here he crossed the Indus, took Delhi in 1526 and founded the Mughal Empire, and when he died his remains were brought from Agra to the garden he had loved. Mughal Kabul was an imperial summer retreat and, from Akbar's reign, capital of the Kabul Subah: about 60,000 people, a gold and silver mint, and the covered Char Chatta bazaar, where Central Asian and Indian goods changed hands. Akbar's chronicler Abul Fazl called Kabul one of the two gates of Hindustan, the other being Kandahar. The emperor's half-brother Mirza Hakim ruled the city almost on his own until his death in 1585, when Mughal armies reclaimed it. Nader Shah took Kabul in 1738 on his march to Delhi, and after his murder it passed to Ahmad Shah Durrani; Timur Shah moved the Durrani capital from Kandahar here in 1776. The English traveller George Forster called it the best and cleanest city in Asia. After the Barakzai overthrew the Durranis, Mohammad Azim Khan governed Kabul in 1821 behind a puppet shah, the old empire dissolving around him.
zh:
喀布尔坐落在兴都库什山脉一处高而窄的山谷中，喀布尔河穿城而过，波斯、突厥斯坦与印度斯坦的商路在此交汇。它先后历经喀布尔沙希王朝、加兹尼王朝和古尔王朝的统治，挺过了蒙古人却没能恢复元气。1333年伊本·白图泰途经时，旧城废墟上只剩一座阿富汗部族占据的村落。帖木儿的帝国使此地重成商路重镇，其后由帖木儿王公的支系统治。1444年，年迈的沙哈鲁仍在赫拉特君临天下，喀布尔是巴拉希萨尔城堡下一座穆斯林边城，集市把巴达赫尚的青金石、巴拉斯红宝石和谷地果品输往印度。

帖木儿的遗产分裂为互相攻伐的小邦时，兀鲁伯·米尔扎二世却给喀布尔和加兹尼带来四十年的安定，优素福扎伊部普什图人也在这一时期迁入。他死后，阿尔浑部首领穆基姆篡据该城，其帖木儿同族亲眷巴布尔于1504年将他逐出，以喀布尔为根基。巴布尔喜爱这里的气候，在城坡上开辟花园；他由此渡过印度河，1526年攻取德里，建立莫卧儿帝国，死后遗骨也从阿格拉迁葬到他心爱的那座花园。莫卧儿时代的喀布尔是皇帝的避暑行在，阿克巴时成为喀布尔苏巴的首府：人口约六万，造币厂铸造金银钱币，名为查尔查塔的有顶大集市集散着中亚和印度的货物。阿克巴的史官阿布勒·法兹勒称喀布尔为印度斯坦两座门户之一，另一座是坎大哈。皇帝的异母弟米尔扎·哈基姆在此近乎独立地统治，1585年他死后莫卧儿军队收回此城。纳迪尔沙1738年进军德里途中攻取喀布尔；他遇刺后，城市归入艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的帝国，帖木儿·沙1776年把杜兰尼王朝的首都从坎大哈迁到这里。英国旅人乔治·福斯特称它是亚洲最好、最干净的城市。巴拉克扎伊人推翻杜兰尼王朝后，1821年的喀布尔由穆罕默德·阿齐姆汗拥立傀儡沙阿、实际执掌，旧日帝国在他周围分崩离析。

en:
Badakhshan is the high country between the Hindu Kush and the upper Oxus, where narrow, irrigated valleys wind between snow-covered ranges. The mountains also held its most dependable wealth. At Sar-e Sang in the Kokcha valley, miners cut lapis lazuli from veins worked since antiquity; caravans carried the deep-blue stone west to Iran, Mesopotamia and the Mediterranean. Badakhshan's red spinels travelled under the name balas ruby, from Balascia, an old name for the country. Marco Polo crossed the mines and mountain valleys in the 1270s and recorded the rubies in his account. In 1444 a dynasty of local mirs still ruled the land. Its last king, Sultan Muhammad, claimed descent from Alexander the Great, and his court accepted only a loose overlordship from the Timurids; the ruler had also sent tribute to the Ming court in 1420.

The Timurid prince Abu Sa'id Mirza killed Sultan Muhammad and brought Badakhshan under direct Timurid rule, but the mountains kept pulling it back toward local government. Babur gave the province to his kinsman Khan Mirza, whose son Mirza Sulaiman held it for most of the sixteenth century. Sulaiman survived surrender to Kamran Mirza and restoration by Humayun, sent raiders toward Kabul, and lost his son Ibrahim in an invasion of Balkh. His own grandson Shahrukh drove him out shortly before Abdullah Khan II of Bukhara overran the country in 1584; Sulaiman died at Akbar's court in Lahore five years later. Shah Jahan's armies took Badakhshan in 1641 and lost it before the decade ended, after which the Yarid mirs ruled again from the Kokcha valley. Durrani forces first entered the country in 1753, and in 1768 Shah Wali Khan stormed Fayzabad and killed Sultan Shah, completing the Afghan conquest.
zh:
巴达赫尚位于兴都库什山与阿姆河上游之间，雪山环抱着一条条引水灌溉的窄谷。山地也提供了此地最可靠的财富：科克恰河谷萨尔桑的矿脉自古出产青金石，商队把这种深蓝色矿石运往伊朗、美索不达米亚和地中海；当地的红色尖晶石则以「巴拉斯红宝石」之名西行，「巴拉斯」来自这片土地的古称巴拉斯基亚。1270年代，马可·波罗穿过矿区和山谷，在游记中记下这些红宝石。1444年，本地米尔王朝仍在此统治，末代国王苏丹穆罕默德自称亚历山大大帝的后裔。他的朝廷只承认帖木儿人的松散宗主权，还曾在1420年向明朝遣使朝贡。

帖木儿王公阿布·赛义德·米尔扎杀死苏丹穆罕默德，把巴达赫尚纳入直接统治，但山地很快又把它推向地方自治。巴布尔后来把此地交给宗亲汗·米尔扎，汗·米尔扎之子米尔扎·苏莱曼在16世纪的大部分时间里据有此地。苏莱曼曾向卡姆兰·米尔扎投降，又经胡马雍复位；他出兵喀布尔，又在进攻巴尔赫时失去儿子易卜拉欣。他的孙子沙哈鲁先将他逐走，1584年布哈拉的阿卜杜拉汗二世随即攻占全境；苏莱曼逃往阿克巴宫廷，五年后死于拉合尔。1641年，沙贾汗的军队夺取巴达赫尚，却在数年内失守，雅尔家族的米尔们随后又在科克恰河谷统治。杜兰尼军队1753年首次进入此地，1768年沙·瓦利汗攻陷费扎巴德、杀死苏丹沙，完成了阿富汗人的征服。

en:
Qarshi lies in the fertile Qashqadaryo oasis south of Samarkand, on the eleven-day caravan road from Bukhara to Balkh. The old Sogdian city was called Nakhshab and then Nasaf, and its scholars, bearing the name al-Nasafi, carried the town's reputation through the Islamic east; the theologian Abu al-Mu'in al-Nasafi and the jurist Abu Hafs al-Nasafi were among them. In the 1320s Kebek Khan of the Chagatai khanate built a residence beside the old settlement, and the name Qarshi came into use; Timur added a moated fortified palace there in 1364. Wheat, cotton and silk sustained the oasis. In 1444 its Sunni, Turkic-speaking townspeople lived under Timurid rule, with Ulugh Beg governing from Samarkand.

Muhammad Shaybani took Samarkand and Bukhara in 1500 and 1501, bringing Qarshi under his Shaybanid khanate. War reached the oasis in 1512, when a Safavid Qizilbash army under Najm-e Sani stormed Qarshi and put its Chaghatay and Tajik townspeople to the sword, not sparing even the sayyid families; the massacre turned Transoxiana against the Qizilbash and opened the way for Ubaydullah Khan. The town grew under the Shaybanids: the Kok Gumbaz Friday mosque and the old bath went up in the sixteenth century, the brick bridge over the Qashqadaryo in 1583, and Abdullah Khan added a madrasa and another bath around 1590. The Sharafboy madrasa followed early in the eighteenth century. Nader Shah conquered Bukhara in 1740, and when Shah Murad founded the Manghit emirate in 1785 Qarshi became the seat of the Bukharan crown prince, ringed by double walls with ten caravanserais and four madrasas inside.
zh:
卡尔希位于撒马尔罕以南肥沃的卡什卡达里亚绿洲，坐落在布哈拉通往巴里黑、全程约十一天的商路上。旧城先后称那黑沙不和纳萨夫；中世纪时，这里出身的学者以「纳萨菲」为号，把城名带入了整个伊斯兰东方，神学家阿布·穆因·纳萨菲和法学家阿布·哈夫斯·纳萨菲都是其中人物。1320年代，察合台汗国的怯别汗在旧聚落旁营建宫室，卡尔希之名开始使用；1364年，帖木儿又在这里修建了带壕沟的坚固宫殿。绿洲以小麦、棉花和丝绸为生。1444年，城中说突厥语的逊尼派居民处在帖木儿系政权治下，兀鲁伯在撒马尔罕主持政务。

1500至1501年，穆罕默德·昔班尼连克撒马尔罕和布哈拉，卡尔希归入他的昔班尼汗国。1512年战火烧到绿洲：萨法维波斯的克孜勒巴什军队在纳吉姆·萨尼统率下攻破卡尔希，大肆屠城，察合台人和塔吉克人横遭杀戮，连圣裔赛义德家族也未能幸免；这场屠杀使河中上下敌视克孜勒巴什，乌拜杜拉汗随之崛起。城市在昔班尼王朝治下发展起来：科克贡巴兹清真大寺和古浴场建于16世纪，卡什卡达里亚河上的砖桥建于1583年，阿卜杜拉汗又在1590年前后添建了经学院和另一座浴场，沙拉夫波伊经学院则于18世纪初落成。1740年纳迪尔沙征服布哈拉；1785年沙赫·穆拉德建立曼吉特王朝后，卡尔希成为布哈拉王储的驻所，双重城垣环绕，城内设有十座商队旅馆和四所经学院。

en:
Samarkand lies in the oasis of the Zeravshan, on the old Silk Road between China and Persia; the Greeks knew it as Marakanda, chief city of Sogdia. Its fortune came with Timur, who made it his capital in 1370 and peopled it with craftsmen brought back from Damascus, Delhi and Aleppo. After his Indian campaign he raised the Bibi-Khanym Friday Mosque, named for his wife Saray Mulk Khanum, who commissioned it, and he was buried under the fluted dome of the Gur-i Amir. His grandson Ulugh Beg, himself an astronomer, built the madrasa facing the Registan and in 1428 an observatory outside the city, where al-Kashi, Qadi Zada al-Rumi and Ali Qushji mapped 1,018 stars; in 1444 he completed the Zij-i Sultani, his new astronomical tables. The city was then the showplace of the Timurid Renaissance, a Persian-speaking Sunni world of tilework, gardens and libraries ruled by an astronomer-king.

It did not hold. Ulugh Beg was put to death on his own son's order in 1449, and the Timurid princes tore the empire apart; Babur of Fergana took Samarkand twice and could not keep it. In 1501 Muhammad Shaybani's Uzbeks made themselves masters of the city, and even after Ubaydullah Khan moved the khanate's capital to Bukhara in 1533 the Bukharan khans came back to be enthroned at the Kuksarai palace, on Timur's old stone throne. The governor Yalangtush Bahadur raised the Sherdar and Tilya-Kari madrasas between 1612 and 1656, completing the three sides of the Registan. The eighteenth century nearly finished the city: after Kazakh raids, famine and plague it stood almost deserted when Nader Shah's troops sacked it in 1740 and carried off Timur's jade gravestone, later returned. The Manghit emir Muhammad Rahim began to resettle Samarkand in 1756, and in 1821 it was a much-shrunken city of the Bukharan emirs, ringed by the madrasas the khans had left.
zh:
撒马尔罕位于泽拉夫尚河的绿洲，在连通中国与波斯的古丝绸之路上；古希腊人称它为马拉坎达，是粟特的首城。它的气运得自帖木儿：帖木儿1370年定都于此，把从大马士革、德里和阿勒颇掳回的工匠安置在城里，印度班师后建起比比哈奴聚礼日清真寺，寺名取自下令建寺的王后萨莱·穆尔克·汗努姆；他本人死后葬在古尔-埃米尔陵的肋形穹顶下。其孙兀鲁伯自己就是天文学家，他在雷吉斯坦对面建起经学院，1428年又在城外造了天文台，卡西、卡迪扎达·鲁米和阿里·库什奇在那里测定了1018颗恒星的位置；1444年，他完成新历数书《新古拉干历数书》。此时的撒马尔罕是帖木儿文艺复兴的橱窗，一座瓷砖、园林与图书馆辉映的逊尼派波斯语城市，统治者本人便是天文学家。

好景不长。1449年兀鲁伯被亲子下令处死，帖木儿诸王把帝国撕扯得四分五裂；费尔干纳的巴布尔两度拿下撒马尔罕，都没能守住。1501年，穆罕默德·昔班尼的乌兹别克人成为城市之主；1533年乌拜杜拉汗把汗国都城迁往布哈拉，此后历代布哈拉汗仍要回到库克萨莱宫，在帖木儿留下的石座上登基。城主雅兰图什·巴哈杜尔于1612至1656年建起希尔·多尔和季里·牙·卡尔里经学院，补齐了雷吉斯坦的三面。18世纪几乎毁掉这座城：哈萨克袭掠、饥荒和瘟疫之后，全城十室九空，1740年纳迪尔沙的军队破城洗劫，把帖木儿的玉碑掠走，后来送还。曼吉特埃米尔穆罕默德·拉希姆1756年着手重新安置居民；1821年的撒马尔罕已大为萧条，是布哈拉埃米尔治下一座缩小了许多的城市，汗们留下的经学院环列四周。

en:
Kyzylkum, the Red Sand, is the desert between the Amu Darya and Syr Darya, running north-west to the Aral Sea: roughly 300,000 square kilometres of dunes and stony flats where every road depended on its wells. Caravans used those water holes to pass between Khwarezm, the Syr Darya towns of Sighnaq and Sozak and the oases of Transoxiana, and camel, horse and sheep herds bred along the desert edge supplied the same trade. In 1444 the clans pasturing that edge belonged to Abu'l-Khayr's Uzbek confederation, which had already raided into Timurid Transoxiana and was pressing hard on the Syr Darya cities.

In 1465 Kerei and Janibek broke from Abu'l-Khayr with their clans and founded the Kazakh Khanate, and after his state collapsed the desert herds went largely with them. Qasim Khan, ruling from 1511, pushed Kazakh power onto the Syr Darya pastures and in 1520 took Saray-Juk, the Nogai capital. The blow the steppe remembered came from the east: in spring 1723 the Dzungars overran the southern grasslands in the calamity the Kazakhs call Aqtaban Shubyryndy, the Bare-Footed Flight, and starving clans crossed the Syr Darya and scattered into the Kyzylkum and Karakum sands. The Junior Juz sought Russian protection in 1731; through the rest of the century the desert clans kept most of their seasonal movement between well and pasture.
zh:
克孜勒库姆意为红沙，是阿姆河与锡尔河之间、西北直抵咸海的沙漠，约30万平方公里的沙丘和砾石滩，穿越它的道路没有一条不依靠沿途的水井。商队靠这些水源往来于花剌子模、锡尔河畔的斯格纳克和苏扎克，以及河中各绿洲之间，沙漠边缘牧养的驼、马和羊群也供给同一宗商队贸易。1444年，在这一带游牧的部族属于阿布海尔的乌兹别克联盟，此时他们已攻入帖木儿治下的河中，正向锡尔河诸城进逼。

1465年，克烈和贾尼别克率部脱离阿布海尔，建立哈萨克汗国；阿布海尔的国家崩溃后，沙漠里的牧人大多随他们而去。哈斯木1511年称汗，把哈萨克势力推到锡尔河牧场，1520年攻占诺盖都城萨赖奇克。草原人记得最深的打击来自东方：1723年春，准噶尔大军横扫南部草原，哈萨克人把这场灾难称为阿克塔班·舒贝伦迪，意为赤脚溃逃，挨饿的部族渡过锡尔河，散进克孜勒库姆和卡拉库姆的沙地。小玉兹1731年向俄国寻求庇护；此后直到18世纪末，沙漠部族在水井和夏冬牧场之间仍大体保留着逐季迁牧的生活。

en:
Yasi, the future Turkestan, stood on the Syr Darya on the caravan road between Khwarezm and Transoxiana. Its fame came from Khoja Ahmad Yasawi, a Turkic Sufi poet born at Ispidjab in 1093 who taught in Yasi and died there in 1166; his school made the town a centre of learning on the steppe, and pilgrims called it Hazrat-i Turkistan. After defeating Tokhtamysh in 1395 Timur ordered a grand mausoleum and khanaqah over the grave, and work began in 1397 with craftsmen brought from Shiraz and Isfahan. The central hall was built for the taiqazan, a two-tonne bronze cauldron holding 3,000 litres, cast at Karnak in 1399 by Abd al-Aziz of Tabriz to hold sacred water for pilgrims on feast days. Timur's death in 1405 stopped the work and left the entrance portal unfinished; the Bukharan ruler Abdullah Khan II had it completed in the sixteenth century. In 1444 Yasi was a shrine town living by pilgrimage and the caravan trade, on a Timurid frontier pressed by Abu'l-Khayr's Uzbek confederation, which seized Sighnaq and Sozak in 1446.

The name Turkestan is first recorded in the mid-sixteenth century, when the town passed to the Kazakh khans, who made it their chief seat on the Syr Darya. The khans were enthroned and buried in the mausoleum, foreign missions were received there, and a copper and silver mint worked in the town. Tauekel took the river towns from Bukhara before 1598 and Esim held them against Tashkent and the Oirats until 1628; Tauke Khan, who died about 1715, ruled and judged from Turkestan in the khanate's last strong decades. In spring 1723 the Dzungar invasion remembered as the Great Disaster stormed the Syr Darya oases and the Kazakh capital, and Dzungar armies returned in 1739-1741. The city changed hands between Kazakh sultans and the rulers of Tashkent and Bukhara until Alim Khan of Kokand took it with the Tashkent lands in 1809. Lost to Bukhara, it was retaken by Umar Khan in 1815, who sacrificed seventy rams at Yasawi's tomb and had himself proclaimed amir al-muslimin at the Friday prayer. By 1821 the Syr Darya towns were held by Kokand governors.
zh:
亚西，即后来的突厥斯坦，位于锡尔河畔、连接花剌子模与河中的商道上。它的名声来自霍贾·艾哈迈德·亚萨维：这位突厥语苏菲派诗人1093年生于伊斯比贾布（今赛兰），一生在亚西讲学，1166年终老于此；他的修会使亚西成为草原上的学术中心，朝圣者把这里称作「哈兹拉特-突厥斯坦」。1395年帖木儿战胜脱脱迷失后，下令在墓上修建宏大的陵寝和道堂，1397年工程动工，工匠从设拉子和伊斯法罕征来。中央大殿安置着一口巨型青铜圣锅，重两吨、容水3000升，1399年由大不里士匠人阿卜杜勒·阿齐兹在卡尔纳克铸成，节日里用来向朝圣者施圣水。1405年帖木儿去世，工程中辍，正门没有建成；直到16世纪，布哈拉君主阿卜杜拉汗二世才把门楼完工。1444年，亚西是靠朝觐和商队贸易为生的圣城，地处帖木儿王朝边境，城外阿布海尔的乌兹别克联盟日益强大，1446年攻取了瑟格纳克和苏扎克等锡尔河诸城。

「突厥斯坦」这一新名最早见于16世纪中叶，当时城市转入哈萨克汗之手，并成为他们在锡尔河上的首要驻地。汗王在亚萨维陵登基、安葬，邻国使节也在那里觐见，城中还设有铜银铸币作坊。塔乌凯勒汗1598年以前从布哈拉手中夺得沿河诸城，叶斯穆汗又顶住塔什干和卫拉特，将其守到1628年；约1715年去世的头克汗，在汗国最后强盛的数十年里以突厥斯坦为统治和断案之所。1723年春，被称为「大灾难」的准噶尔入侵攻破锡尔河诸绿洲和这座哈萨克都城，1739至1741年准噶尔军队再度横扫此地。此后城市在哈萨克苏丹与塔什干、布哈拉的统治者之间几度易手，直到1809年浩罕的阿里姆汗随塔什干政权一并将其攻占。城市一度落入布哈拉之手，1815年由乌马尔汗夺回：他在亚萨维陵献祭七十只羊，并在周五聚礼上受封为「信士之长」。1821年时，锡尔河诸城已处于浩罕长官的治下。

en:
Tashkent lies in the Chirchik oasis south of the Syr Darya, the last well-watered ground before the Kazakh steppe. Its older name was Chach, and the Turkic-Persian name Tashkent means 'stone city'. Sogdian market towns of the oasis had long traded with the nomads beyond; the Mongols sacked Chach, and Timur rebuilt the town and used it as a base for his steppe campaigns. Under his grandson Ulugh Beg it was governed from Samarkand, and in 1444 Tashkent was a walled Sunni town that lived by its citadel and its caravans. Scholars and saints gave it weight of another kind: the Naqshbandi master Ubaydallah Khoja Ahrar taught in the oasis before he moved to Samarkand, and the tomb of the local Sufi Sheikh Khovendi at-Takhur gave one of the town's four quarters its name.

Yunus Khan, the Moghul ruler whose grandson Babur founded the Mughal empire, seized Tashkent in 1485 and lies buried in the mausoleum in the old town. The Shaybanids followed, and under Suyunchkhoja Khan poets and scholars gathered at the city's court; later Shaybanid governors struck silver and copper coin there and raised the Kukeldash Madrasa beside the central bazaar. In 1598 the Kazakh khans took Tashkent, and Bukhara fought them for it for the next century. Dzungar armies overran it in 1723. In 1784 Yunus Khoja, chief of the Sheikhantaur quarter, subdued the other three warring quarters and made himself ruler of an independent Tashkent state, whose caravans traded across the steppe from behind nearly nineteen kilometres of earthen wall. Kokand took the city in 1807–1808, when it was already counted the richest city in Central Asia, with perhaps 100,000 people, and the new masters ringed it with a moat and twelve gates. By 1820 travellers counted ten madrasas and textile workshops working at full stretch.
zh:
塔什干位于锡尔河以南的奇尔奇克绿洲，是进入哈萨克草原前最后一片水草丰足的地方。旧城名赭时，突厥—波斯语名称塔什干意为「石城」。绿洲上的粟特城镇历来与草原牧民交易；蒙古人曾洗劫赭时，帖木儿将其重建，作为出兵草原的基地。在他的孙子兀鲁伯治下，城市由撒马尔罕派员管理，1444年的塔什干是一座筑有城墙的逊尼派城镇，靠城堡和商队立足。学者与圣徒给了它另一种分量：纳格什班迪教团大师乌拜杜拉·和卓·阿赫拉尔迁往撒马尔罕之前，曾在这片绿洲讲学；本地苏菲谢赫·霍文迪·塔胡尔的陵墓，则为城里四个城区中的一个命了名。

蒙兀儿统治者羽奴思汗1485年夺取塔什干，死后葬在旧城的陵墓中，他的外孙就是建立莫卧儿帝国的巴布尔。随后是昔班尼王朝：苏云奇·和卓汗的宫廷招聚诗人与学者，后来的昔班尼长官在此铸造银币和铜币，又在中心市集旁建起库克尔达什经学院。1598年哈萨克汗取得塔什干，布哈拉为它和哈萨克打了一百年仗。1723年准噶尔军队攻占此城。1784年，谢赫安陶尔区的首领尤努斯·和卓压服长期混战的其他三区，建立独立的塔什干政权；商队以周长近十九公里的土墙为依托，贸易远及草原。浩罕1807—1808年攻取此城时，它已被算作中亚最富庶的城市，人口约十万，新主人在城外挖下壕沟、开十二座城门。到1820年，旅人数出十座经学院和全力开工的纺织作坊。

en:
Kokand holds the southwestern approach to the Ferghana Valley, where caravan roads from Tashkent and Khujand enter the irrigated Sokh oasis. Tenth-century geographers listed a town here called Khavakand, a station between Persia and China, but the Mongol sack in the thirteenth century left it a modest market long overshadowed by Akhsikath and Andijan. Farms, orchards and iron workings gave the district value, and merchants could choose there between the road to Tashkent and the route west through Khujand. In 1444 the land belonged to the Timurid realm governed from Samarkand; it was valuable Ferghana countryside, not yet a royal capital.

The khanate began with a fort. In 1709, as Bukhara's hold on Ferghana loosened, Shahrukh Biy of the Uzbek Ming tribe founded an independent principality near Kokand. Refugees from war-torn Samarkand and Bukhara moved into the valley during the following decades. Shahrukh's son Abd al-Rahim raided Khujand, Urateppe and Samarkand, then was murdered at Khujand in 1734. His brother Abd al-Karim built the Kokand fortress on an old fort site in 1740 and moved his capital there; the town endured Dzungar attacks in 1742 and 1745. Irdana Biy opened contacts with the Qing court after Altishahr came under Qing rule, Narbuta Biy united much of the valley, and Alim Khan dredged the Yangi Ariq canal, struck silver coin, took Khujand and Tashkent, and was killed by his brother Umar in 1811. Under Umar, Kokand's merchants grew rich on the trade with Qing Xinjiang.
zh:
浩罕控制着费尔干纳盆地的西南口，从塔什干和苦盏而来的商路进入这片灌溉的索赫绿洲。10世纪的地理学家已提到这里的哈瓦干德，称它是波斯与中国之间的驿站；13世纪蒙古人劫掠后，它长期只是普通集镇，声势在阿赫西肯特和安集延等费尔干纳古城之下。农田、果园和铁作坊使这片地方颇有价值，商人也可在此选择北往塔什干或西经苦盏的道路。1444年，它属于以撒马尔罕为中心的帖木儿帝国，是费尔干纳的富庶乡区，还不是王都。

浩罕汗国的崛起从一座堡垒开始。1709年，布哈拉对费尔干纳的控制松弛，乌兹别克明格部首领沙鲁克·比在浩罕附近建立独立政权。此后二三十年，战乱中的撒马尔罕和布哈拉难民迁入费尔干纳。沙鲁克之子阿卜杜勒·拉希姆曾攻入苦盏、乌拉秋别和撒马尔罕，1734年在苦盏遇刺。其弟阿卜杜勒·卡里姆1740年在旧堡遗址修筑浩罕城堡并迁都于此，城池又撑过1742年和1745年的准噶尔进攻。清朝控制天山南路后，伊尔达那·比与清廷建立联系；纳尔布塔·比大体统一了盆地。爱里木汗疏浚扬吉阿雷克渠、铸造银币，攻下苦盏和塔什干，1811年被弟弟奥马尔所杀。奥马尔在位时，浩罕商人靠与清朝新疆的贸易富足起来。

en:
Taraz, called Talas in medieval Arabic and Persian sources, lies on the Talas River where the road from Transoxiana enters Zhetysu and the Ili country. Sogdian merchants had made it a trading town by its first surviving mention in 568. The valley is best known for the battle fought there in 751, when an Abbasid army under Ziyad ibn Salih and Karluk forces defeated Gao Xianzhi's Tang troops; the reverse ended Tang westward expansion, and later accounts say Chinese prisoners taken at Talas carried papermaking westward, though the story is disputed. Under the Karakhanids the Muslim city had paved streets, terracotta water pipes and drains, and the mausolea of Karakhan and Aisha-Bibi took shape. Local tradition makes Aisha-Bibi a noble girl who died from a snakebite while travelling to marry the emir of Taraz; her tomb was raised eighteen kilometres west of the city. Mongol troops sacked Talas in 1220, and by 1444 only a much smaller caravan settlement lived on among the old ruins, nominally under Moghulistan.

In the 1460s the Moghul khan Esen Buqa granted the Chu and Talas valleys to the sultans Kerei and Janybek, and the settlements around old Talas became part of the Kazakh Khanate proclaimed around 1465. Dzungar armies overran the valley in 1723, in the calamity Kazakhs call the Great Disaster, and held it until about 1756. After the Qing campaigns that destroyed the Dzungar state in 1755 and 1757, the Qianlong Emperor allowed Kazakh clans to resettle the empty pasture in 1766. Early in the nineteenth century Qipchaq soldiers of Kokand raised the Namangan-i Kochek fortress on the ancient ruins; a new caravan town grew around it between Tashkent, the steppe and the Talas-Alatau passes.
zh:
怛罗斯在中世纪阿拉伯和波斯文献中称塔拉斯，位于塔拉斯河畔，是河中通向七河与伊犁流域的道路经过之地。早在568年，粟特商人已把它经营成商镇。这条河谷最出名的是751年的战役：齐亚德·本·萨利赫率领的阿拔斯军队与葛逻禄人击败高仙芝统领的唐军，唐朝向西扩张就此止步；后世记载称怛罗斯被俘的中国工匠把造纸术带到西方，但这一说法仍有争议。喀喇汗国时期，这座穆斯林城市有铺砌街道、陶制水管和排水沟，喀喇汗与艾莎-比比的陵墓也在这时形成。当地相传艾莎-比比是一位贵族女子，在前往塔拉兹嫁给埃米尔的途中被毒蛇咬死；她的陵墓建在城西十八公里处。1220年蒙古军队洗劫塔拉斯，到1444年，旧城废墟间只剩一个小得多的商队聚落，名义上归东察合台统治。

15世纪60年代，东察合台汗也先不花把楚河与塔拉斯河谷封给克烈和贾尼别克两位苏丹，古塔拉斯周围的聚落随后成为约1465年建立的哈萨克汗国的一部分。1723年，准噶尔军队在哈萨克人称为「大灾难」的浩劫中席卷河谷，并占据到1756年前后。清朝在1755至1757年的战事中攻灭准噶尔国家后，乾隆帝于1766年准许哈萨克部落重返空旷牧场。19世纪初，浩罕的钦察士兵在古城废墟上筑起「小纳曼干」堡垒；一座新的商队城镇在堡旁兴起，往来于塔什干、草原和塔拉斯-阿拉套山口之间。

en:
Uzgen guards the point where the road out of the Ferghana basin climbs toward Kashgar, and Chinese annals mention a settlement here in the second century BC. Arab geographers of the tenth century ranked it the fourth town of Ferghana, after Akhsikath, Kuva and Osh, and its mint struck coins from the 930s. From the later eleventh to the thirteenth century it was the Karakhanid governor's seat in Ferghana. Three Karakhanid mausolea flank the old tenth-century memorial mosque, with the brick minaret beside them: the portal inscriptions date the north tomb to 1152, built for the Ferghana ruler Toghrul Hussein, and the south tomb to 1187, where Nasr, who held Kasan, was buried next to his father. The city never regained its size after the Mongol years, and in 1444 it was a quiet market town in Timurid Ferghana, overshadowed by Andijan, while Kyrgyz herders grazed the high pastures above it.

When the Uzbek leader Muhammad Shaybani overran the Timurid lands, he defeated the young Babur, who had ruled Ferghana from Andijan; by 1504 Babur had abandoned the valley and taken Kabul, and Uzgen passed to the Shaybanids with the rest of Ferghana, and later to the khans of Bukhara. In 1709 Shahrukh-biy, chief of the Uzbek Ming tribe, broke from a weakening Bukhara and founded the principality that grew into the Khanate of Kokand, and his son Abdurahim-biy added Andijan and Khujand to it. Dzungar armies swept through the valley in 1745–1747, taking Osh, Andijan and Margilan and besieging Kokand; Kyrgyz sources record that Uzgen itself passed under Kokand's rule only in the early nineteenth century.
zh:
乌兹根扼守费尔干纳盆地通往喀什噶尔的山道，中国史籍在公元前2世纪已记载此地有城。10世纪的阿拉伯地理学家把它列为费尔干纳第四城，排在阿赫西肯特、库瓦和奥什之后，930年代起本地铸币厂已开始铸钱。11世纪下半叶到13世纪，它是喀喇汗王朝费尔干纳省的治所。三座喀喇汗王陵分列一座10世纪纪念清真寺的两侧，砖砌宣礼塔立在近旁：门楣铭文记载，北陵建于1152年，墓主是费尔干纳统治者图格里尔·侯赛因；南陵建于1187年，镇守卡桑的纳赛尔葬在父亲身旁。蒙古时代以后，城势再未恢复旧观，到1444年已是帖木儿王朝治下费尔干纳一座冷清的商镇，声望远在安集延之下，吉尔吉斯牧人在城上方的高山牧场放牧。

乌兹别克首领穆罕默德·昔班尼席卷帖木儿故土时，曾以安集延为治所统治费尔干纳的年轻巴布尔为其所败；到1504年巴布尔放弃谷地、南下夺取喀布尔，乌兹根随整个费尔干纳归入昔班尼王朝，后来又受治于布哈拉的汗。1709年，乌兹别克明格部首领沙鲁克·比摆脱衰微的布哈拉建立政权，即后来的浩罕汗国，其子阿卜杜拉欣·比又为汗国攻取安集延与苦盏。1745至1747年，准噶尔军队横扫谷地，连克奥什、安集延、马尔吉兰并围攻浩罕；据吉尔吉斯方面的史料，乌兹根本城直到19世纪初才归入浩罕统治。

en:
Beneath the snowy wall of the Trans-Ili Alatau, mountain streams water the alluvial fans above the Ili steppe. The Silk Road branch between Taraz and Almalyk ran through this country, and between the eighth and tenth centuries a town called Almatau stood here, its name preserved on silver dirhams of the thirteenth century. Long before that, Saka kings lay under the great kurgans along the Almatinka; the richest, the Issyk mound fifty kilometres east of Almaty, held a royal Saka body of the fourth century BC armoured from head to foot in gold, the burial known as the Golden Man. The Mongols took Zhetysu in the early thirteenth century, and Timur's wars later drove the caravan roads south into the Tarim basin, leaving the towns to shrink into villages. In 1444 the country belonged to Moghulistan, its pastures grazed by Turkic and Mongol clans for whom Islam was still chiefly the ruler's creed.

By the early sixteenth century the Senior Juz of the Kazakhs pastured here. The Dzungar invasion of 1723 emptied the valleys, the catastrophe the Kazakhs call the Great Disaster, and the clans fled west and south with their herds. In the spring of 1730 a Kazakh army under Abulkhair met the Dzungars in the Anyrakai hills, seventy kilometres north-west of Almaty, and defeated them. Qing armies destroyed the Dzungar state in 1755–57, and Senior Juz clans came back to these pastures as nominal tributaries of the Qing. Through the later eighteenth century the land remained grazing country on the approaches of the Khanate of Kokand, and no town yet stood on the Almatinka.
zh:
外伊犁阿拉套雪峰之下，山溪灌溉着伊犁草原上方的冲积扇。连接怛罗斯与阿力麻里的丝绸之路支线经过此地，8至10世纪间，一座名为阿尔马图的城镇兴起于此，13世纪的银迪尔汗上铸有它的名字。更早的时候，萨卡君王长眠在阿拉木丁卡河畔的大墓之下；其中随葬最丰的伊塞克墓在阿拉木图以东五十公里，墓中是公元前4世纪一位萨卡王室成员的遗体，从头到脚披金饰甲，即著名的「金人」。13世纪初蒙古人征服七河，后来帖木儿的战祸迫使商路南迁塔里木盆地，城镇纷纷萎缩为村庄。1444年的阿拉木图属东察合台，草场上的突厥、蒙古诸部还大多把伊斯兰教视为统治者的信仰。

到16世纪初，哈萨克大玉兹在此游牧。1723年准噶尔人入侵，诸谷为之一空，哈萨克人称之为「大灾难」，诸部带着牲畜向西、向南逃散。1730年春，阿布勒海尔率领的哈萨克军在阿拉木图西北七十公里的安拉凯山区迎战准噶尔人，将其击败。1755至1757年清军攻灭准噶尔，大玉兹诸部作为清朝名义上的藩属返回这片牧场。整个18世纪后期，这里仍是浩罕汗国方向上的游牧之地，阿拉木丁卡河畔还没有城镇。

en:
Odishi, later called Samegrelo or Mingrelia, is the Black Sea coastal plain between the Tskhenistsqali and Enguri rivers, homeland of the Mingrelians and the domain of the Dadiani, who ruled from Zugdidi as eristavi, or duke. Vineyards and Black Sea traffic gave the land its wealth, and at Tsalenjikha the Dadiani kept their family church: Vameq I Dadiani (r. 1384-1396) brought Cyrus Emanuel Eugenicus from Constantinople to cover its walls with late Palaiologan frescoes. In 1444 Liparit I Dadiani, ruling since 1414, governed this wine-growing and trading land while the unified Kingdom of Georgia broke apart around him.

In 1463 Liparit joined Bagrat of Imereti at the battle of Chikhori; after the victory Bagrat was crowned at Kutaisi and made the Dadiani princes of Mingrelia, a title that became hereditary and fully independent under Levan I in 1557. The Ottomans seized the northern port of Tskhumi in 1578, and by about 1615 Mingrelia paid them tribute as Abkhazia broke away to the north. Levan II Dadiani (r. 1611-1657), the strongest ruler of the line, turned raiding into a business: he led western Georgia in taking captives for ransom, sold slaves, iron and wool to Sultan Murad IV in return for Turkish cavalry, battered Kutaisi's walls with cannon in 1646 and blinded the Imeretian prince Mamuka, whom Georgian leaders had meant as a future unifying king. He also drew foreign merchants to Zugdidi, patronised goldsmiths and churches and added a portrait chapel at Tsalenjikha; in 1646 the scribe Mamuka Tavakalashvili copied the epic 'The Knight in the Panther's Skin' at his court. Jean Chardin, visiting late in the seventeenth century, found the villages emptied by the sale of Christian captives to Istanbul. After Levan's death the courtier Katsia Chikovani seized power, and his son ruled as Giorgi IV Dadiani; in 1702 Imeretian and Mingrelian forces halted the Abkhazians at the Enguri, which became the border. In 1802 Grigol Dadiani submitted to the Russian tsar, and in 1804 Mingrelia became an autonomous Russian protectorate; when Grigol died later that year his widow Nino, a daughter of George XII, was regent for their son Levan until 1811.
zh:
奥迪希（后称萨梅格雷洛，俄罗斯文献作明格列利亚）是茨赫尼斯茨卡利河与因古里河之间的黑海沿岸平原，明格列尔人世居之地，达迪亚尼家族以祖格迪迪为首府、以埃里斯塔维（公爵）身份世代领有。葡萄园和黑海贸易是这片土地的财源；达迪亚尼的家族教堂在察伦吉哈，瓦梅克一世·达迪亚尼（1384—1396年在位）曾从君士坦丁堡请来拜占庭画师，在四壁绘满晚期帕里奥洛加斯风格的壁画。1444年，自1414年在位的利帕里特一世·达迪亚尼统治着这片出产葡萄酒、经营海上贸易的土地，而统一的格鲁吉亚王国正在他身边四分五裂。

1463年，利帕里特在奇霍里战役中加入伊梅列季王公巴格拉特一方；获胜后巴格拉特在库塔伊西加冕，封达迪亚尼为明格列利亚王公，1557年列万一世时这一头衔成为世袭，公国也完全独立。1578年，奥斯曼攻占北方港口茨胡米；到1615年前后，明格列利亚已向奥斯曼纳贡，北面的阿布哈兹也脱离而去。列万二世·达迪亚尼（1611—1657年在位）是这一系最强势的统治者，把劫掠做成了生意：他在西格鲁吉亚带头掳人勒赎，以奴隶、生铁和羊毛从苏丹穆拉德四世手中换取土耳其骑兵，1646年用大炮轰塌库塔伊西城墙，又刺瞎了被格鲁吉亚诸方寄予统一之望的伊梅列季王公马穆卡。他也招徕外国商人到祖格迪迪，资助金匠和教堂，在察伦吉哈增建绘有家族肖像的礼拜堂；同年，书吏马穆卡·塔瓦卡拉什维利在他的宫廷抄录了史诗《虎皮武士》。法国旅行家让·夏尔丹17世纪后期到访时，见到基督徒被卖往伊斯坦布尔、村野为之一空。列万二世死后，廷臣卡齐亚·奇科瓦尼夺权，其子改称格奥尔基四世·达迪亚尼统治；1702年，伊梅列季与明格列利亚联军在因古里河挡住阿布哈兹人，此河随后成为边界。1802年格里戈尔·达迪亚尼向俄罗斯沙皇称臣，1804年明格列利亚成为俄罗斯治下的自治藩属；格里戈尔同年去世，王后妮诺（格鲁吉亚国王格奥尔基十二世之女）为幼子列万摄政，直到1811年。

en:
The wooded foothills between the Kuban River and the main Caucasus range, watered by the Belaya and Laba, are the western heartland of the Adyghe, the Circassians whom earlier writers called Zikhi or Kassogs. Christianity reached them from Byzantium in Justinian's time, and the Orthodox see of Zichia long answered to Constantinople. The Mongols raided from the 1220s, and in 1395 Timur's armies wasted the land 'from Azov to the Elbrus', forcing the tribes back behind the Kuban. Tradition tells how Prince Inal united the feuding clans, winning a battle on the Msimta where thirty lords submitted, ruled from Shanjir near Taman, planted his kinsmen in the Kabarda country and drove Tatar bands beyond the river. In 1444 Inal reigned as grand prince over Orthodox clans that grazed cattle and horses on the foothill pastures and sold them through the Genoese factories at Matrega and Kopa, while each prince, the pshi, stayed master of his own valley. The same ports also shipped boys south: in 1382 a Circassian mamluk, Barquq, seized the throne in Cairo, and for the rest of the Mamluk era the sultans of Egypt were mostly Circassians bought as children in the Black Sea trade.

Tradition dates Inal's death to 1458, when his lands were divided among his sons; Circassia became a patchwork of tribal principalities, Temirgoy, Besleney, Zhaney and the rest, whose ways the Genoese Giorgio Interiano described near the end of the century. The Ottoman capture of Caffa in 1475 ended the Genoese trade and put the coast under the sultan and the Crimean khan, whose raids and slave-tribute shadowed the valleys for three hundred years. The western clans turned to Moscow, sending embassies to Ivan the Terrible in the 1550s and storming the Crimean-Ottoman forts at Temryuk and Taman in 1556, but the alliance withered as Crimea revived, and during the seventeenth century Sunni Islam, often blended with older custom, slowly displaced Orthodoxy. Between 1770 and 1803 the free Abzakh, Natukhaj and Shapsug mountain farmers killed or expelled their princes and ruled through village assemblies. After Russia annexed the Crimea in 1783 it built forts along the Kuban, and the Caucasian War that opened in 1817 brought the fighting to these foothills.
zh:
库班河与高加索主脉之间林木茂密的山麓，由别拉亚河与拉巴河浇灌，是阿迪格人（即切尔克斯人，古籍中的济赫人、卡索格人）西部的腹心。基督教在查士丁尼时代从拜占庭传入，隶属君士坦丁堡牧首的东正教济希亚教区延续很久。蒙古人自1220年代起不断入侵，1395年帖木儿的军队「从亚速夫一直劫掠到厄尔布鲁士」，把各部逼退到库班河以南。相传王公伊纳尔统一了互相仇杀的氏族，在姆西姆塔河畔一战迫使三十名领主归附；他以塔曼附近的尚吉尔为都，把亲族安置到东方的卡巴尔达地方，又将鞑靼部落逐过库班河。1444年，伊纳尔以大公身份统治着信奉东正教的各氏族：他们在山麓牧场牧养牛马，经马特列加、科帕的热那亚商站外销，而每个王公仍是自己山谷的主人。这些港口也把男孩贩往南方：1382年，切尔克斯出身的马穆鲁克巴尔库克在开罗夺位，此后直到马穆鲁克时代终结，埃及苏丹大多是在黑海贸易中被买走的切尔克斯男孩。

传说伊纳尔于1458年去世，土地分给诸子；切尔克西亚后来成为捷米尔戈耶夫、巴斯列涅耶夫、扎涅耶夫等部落公国拼成的拼盘，热那亚旅行家乔治·因特里亚诺在该世纪末记下了他们的风俗。1475年奥斯曼攻占卡法，热那亚贸易终结，海岸落入苏丹与克里木汗之手，此后三百年间，入寇和奴隶贡赋一直笼罩着各山谷。西部各部转而求助莫斯科，1550年代向伊凡雷帝遣使，1556年又攻陷克里木—奥斯曼在捷姆留克和塔曼的据点；但随着克里木重新得势，联盟瓦解，17世纪里常与旧俗混杂的逊尼派伊斯兰教逐渐取代东正教。1770年至1803年间，阿布扎赫、纳图哈伊、沙普苏格的自由山民杀死或驱逐王公，改由村社会议议事。俄国1783年吞并克里木，沿库班河修筑要塞；1817年高加索战争爆发，战火烧到了这片山麓。

en:
Hajji Tarkhan, the town that became Astrakhan, stood on the right bank of the Volga near the head of its delta, twelve kilometres upstream from the later city. Golden Horde caravans from Sarai brought eastern silk and spices through it to Tana on the Sea of Azov, where Venetian and Genoese ships loaded cargo; fish, salt, hides and Turkic slaves moved in the opposite direction. Ibn Battuta wintered there with Khan Özbeg in 1333. Timur's army sacked and burned Hajji Tarkhan in 1395. In 1444 it belonged to the Great Horde, a Sunni Tatar market town on the lower Volga with ruined quarters and traffic still tied to Sarai, the Caspian and the Black Sea.

In 1459 Mahmud, son of Küchük Muhammad, made Hajji Tarkhan the capital of his own Astrakhan khanate, though the regime only became fully separate after the Great Horde fell in 1502. Afanasy Nikitin passed through around 1469 on his way to India; the Venetian Ambrogio Contarini in 1476 found mud-brick houses behind a low stone wall. Crimean troops seized the town briefly in 1523 and 1549. Ivan the Terrible's forces entered it in 1554 and abolished the khanate in 1556, closing the largest slave market on the Volga. Russians moved the town twelve kilometres downstream in 1558 and built a wooden kremlin, replaced in 1582 by stone walls and towers. An Ottoman-Tatar army failed to take the new fortress in 1569.

Muscovite rule brought merchants from Armenia, Safavid Persia, Mughal India and Khiva, and the delta supplied sturgeon, fish, salt and caravan supplies. Stenka Razin's Cossacks and townsmen held Astrakhan in 1670-71 before tsarist troops retook it. The Assumption Cathedral inside the kremlin was begun in 1699 and built over about twelve years with moulded brick and carved white stone. Streltsy, fishermen and townspeople rose again in 1705-06 against taxes, uniforms and foreign officers. Peter the Great made Astrakhan the seat of a governorate in 1717, placing the Volga mouth and the Caspian trade under a direct imperial administration.
zh:
阿斯特拉罕的前身哈吉塔尔汉位于伏尔加河三角洲上端的右岸，在后来城区以北十二公里。金帐汗国时期，萨莱商队把东方丝绸和香料经此运往亚速海畔的塔纳，威尼斯和热那亚商船在那里装货；鱼、盐、皮革和突厥奴隶则反向运送。1333年，伊本·白图泰随月即别汗在此过冬。1395年，帖木儿的军队洗劫并焚毁哈吉塔尔汉。1444年，它属于大帐汗国，是伏尔加河下游一座逊尼派鞑靼商镇；城中仍有被毁的街区，商路则连着萨莱、里海和黑海。

1459年，库楚克·马哈麻之子马哈茂德以哈吉塔尔汉为自己的阿斯特拉罕汗国都城；这个政权直到1502年大帐汗国灭亡后才完全独立。阿法纳西·尼基特约在1469年前往印度途中经过此地。1476年，威尼斯人安布罗焦·孔塔里尼看到的是矮石墙内的一片土坯屋。克里米亚军队曾在1523年和1549年短暂占城。伊凡雷帝的军队1554年进入哈吉塔尔汉，1556年废除汗国，关闭伏尔加河上最大的奴隶市场。1558年，俄罗斯人把城南迁十二公里，先修建木构克里姆林，1582年又改筑石墙和塔楼。1569年，奥斯曼与鞑靼联军未能攻下这座新要塞。

莫斯科统治时期，亚美尼亚、萨法维波斯、莫卧儿印度和希瓦的商人来到这里，三角洲则出产鲟鱼、鱼货、盐，并为商队提供补给。1670年至1671年，斯捷潘·拉辛的哥萨克和市民占据阿斯特拉罕，最后被沙皇军队夺回。克里姆林内的圣母安息主教座堂1699年动工，用时约十二年，以模制砖和白石雕刻装饰。1705年至1706年，射击军、渔民和市民因赋税、军服和外籍军官问题再度起事。1717年，彼得大帝设立阿斯特拉罕省，把伏尔加河口和里海贸易直接置于帝国行政之下。

en:
The lower Yaik, renamed the Ural in 1775, crosses the flat Caspian steppe to its delta, past self-sown salt lakes; Inder, the largest of them, supplied the salt carried by steppe traders. Fifty kilometres above the delta stood Saraychik, on the right bank where the road from Tana to Khwarazm crossed the river by a bridge of boats. Ibn Battuta passed through around 1333, sold his horses and bought camels for the run to Konye-Urgench; the Florentine merchant Pegolotti also listed the town on the same route. Under the Golden Horde it struck coins, worked metal and pottery, and used ceramic water pipes. Abu al-Ghazi names it as the burial place of the khans Jani Beg and Berdi Beg. Timur's army sacked the city in 1395, but it was rebuilt in 1430–1440. In 1444 the heirs of Edigu ruled there over the Sunni Manghit clans of the Nogai yurt, while caravans again watered their animals between the Yaik and Volga.

From the 1490s Saraychik was the capital and only real city of the Nogai Horde, where furs, livestock and salt commonly changed hands by barter. Qasim Khan's Kazakhs took it around 1520 and used it as an administrative base for their western lands; Qasim was later buried there. After Muscovy conquered Astrakhan in 1556, the bey Ismail accepted Ivan the Terrible's suzerainty, and a rival group under Kazi Mirza moved to the Kuban in 1557 to form the Lesser Nogai Horde. Haqnazar Khan seized Saraychik again in 1577. Three years later the free Cossack atamans Nechai and Bogdan Barbosha stormed and burned the city, and survivors fled to Khiva. The Kalmyks of Kho-Urluk overran the Great Nogai Horde in 1628–1634, after which most Nogais moved from the Yaik to the Volga. Russian settlers built a small ostrog beside the ruins in 1640.
zh:
亚伊克河（1775年改名乌拉尔河）下游穿过平坦的里海草原，经多座自沉积盐湖注入里海；最大的因杰尔湖出产食盐，由草原商人转贩。萨莱楚克在三角洲以北约50公里的右岸，塔纳通往花剌子模的商道在此用舟桥渡河。约1333年，伊本·白图泰途经此城，卖掉马匹、换成骆驼，再前往库尼亚乌尔根奇；佛罗伦萨商人裴哥罗梯也在商路手册中记过这座城。金帐汗国时期，萨莱楚克自铸钱币，有金属器和陶器作坊，还用陶管供水。阿布勒·哈齐记载，札尼别汗和别儿迪别汗都安葬于此。1395年帖木儿军队洗劫城市，1430至1440年间城址得到重建。1444年，也迪古的后裔在此统辖诺盖帐的逊尼派曼吉特各部，商队又在亚伊克河与伏尔加河之间歇脚饮马。

1490年代起，萨莱楚克成为诺盖汗国的都城，也是汗国唯一真正的城市，毛皮、牲畜和盐多在市上以物易物。1520年前后，哈斯木汗率哈萨克人夺取此城，把它当作治理西部疆土的据点，哈斯木后来也葬在这里。1556年莫斯科攻灭阿斯特拉罕后，诺盖别克伊斯梅尔向伊凡雷帝称臣；1557年，哈孜·米尔咱率一支异己部众迁往库班，建立小诺盖帐。1577年，哈克纳扎尔汗再次攻占萨莱楚克。三年后，不受莫斯科管束的哥萨克首领涅恰伊和波格丹·巴尔博沙攻破并焚毁城市，幸存者逃往希瓦。1628至1634年，霍·乌尔留克率领卡尔梅克人击灭大诺盖帐，多数诺盖人随后从亚伊克河迁往伏尔加河。1640年，俄罗斯移民在废墟旁建起一座小堡。

en:
Sarai was the khan's court on the lower Volga, set among Akhtuba channels, pastures and landing grounds. Batu founded it in the early 1250s, and William of Rubruck found a new town on the Itil in 1254. Under Öz Beg and Jani Beg it became the main city of the Golden Horde, where envoys, caravan merchants and steppe nobles met. Florentine handbooks listed raw silk, furs, sturgeon, caviar, hides and Turkic slaves among its goods. Ibn Battuta described broad streets and crowded bazaars, with separate quarters for Mongols, Kipchaks, Circassians, Russians and visiting merchants. Timur's army destroyed the newer of the two places called Sarai in 1395. In 1444 Sarai was the capital of Küchük Muhammad's Great Horde, though archaeologists still debate which ruined site held the khan's court and whether the older town survived.

Afanasy Nikitin passed the lower Volga around 1469 on his journey to India. Vyatka river raiders sacked Sarai in 1471, and in 1502 the Crimean khan Mengli I Giray, allied with Ivan III of Moscow, burned the city and overthrew the Great Horde. Crimea then claimed the Golden Horde's inheritance. Sarai was not rebuilt; its brick remains stood in pastures used by Nogai herdsmen. After Moscow took Kazan and Astrakhan in 1552-56, Muscovite boats and patrols moved along the lower Volga past the old khan's grounds. Stenka Razin's Cossacks swept the river in 1670, and Yemelyan Pugachev's rebels crossed these same lower Volga pastures in 1774.
zh:
萨莱是伏尔加河下游的汗廷，坐落在阿赫图巴河汊、牧场和泊地之间。1250年代初拔都建城，1254年鲁不鲁乞见到它时，伊蒂尔河畔已是一座新城。月即别和札尼别统治时期，萨莱成为金帐汗国的主城，使节、商队和草原贵族都在这里会合。佛罗伦萨商人的行商手册把生丝、毛皮、鲟鱼、鱼子酱、皮革和突厥奴隶列为当地货物。伊本·白图泰写到这里宽阔的街道和拥挤的市集，蒙古人、钦察人、切尔克斯人、罗斯人和外来商人各有居住区。1395年，帖木儿的军队摧毁了两处萨莱遗址中较新的一座。1444年，萨莱是库楚克·马哈麻治下大帐汗国的都城；但哪一处遗址曾是汗廷、旧城是否仍存，学界仍有争议。

阿法纳西·尼基特约在1469年前往印度途中经过伏尔加河下游。1471年，维亚特卡河上武装洗劫萨莱；1502年，与莫斯科伊凡三世结盟的克里米亚可汗明里一世·格莱焚毁城市，攻灭大帐汗国，克里米亚随后宣称继承金帐汗国。萨莱没有重建，砖构遗址留在诺盖牧人的牧场中。1552年至1556年莫斯科攻灭喀山和阿斯特拉罕后，莫斯科的船只和巡逻队沿伏尔加河下游驶过旧汗廷之地。1670年，斯捷潘·拉辛的哥萨克席卷这条大河；1774年，叶梅利扬·普加乔夫的叛军也穿过伏尔加河下游的这些牧场。

en:
The Borisoglebsk country is forest-steppe between the upper Khopyor and its tributary the Vorona, where oak woods, above all the great Tellerman forest, break up the open grassland. In 1444 these pastures were the north-western fringe of the Great Horde: Tatar herds grazed here in summer, and Crimean and Nogai raiding parties rode through on their way north to Ryazan. A few Mishar and Mordvin fishing and beekeeping camps were the only settled spots. As Muscovy built its fortified frontier lines southward, Voronezh and Tambov went up nearby in the late sixteenth and early seventeenth centuries, while the empty woods and waters here were leased out as hunting and fishing grounds.

The place first mattered to Moscow through timber. While preparing his Azov campaigns, Peter I had Tellerman oaks felled here and built into barges and auxiliary vessels for the Azov fleet, and in 1698 the Pavlovsk fortress rose on the Vorona to guard the district against Crimean, Azov and Nogai raids. A church of Saints Boris and Gleb was built in 1704, and the fort took the name Borisoglebsk. Four years later the townsmen joined Kondraty Bulavin's Cossack revolt and held the town until the tsar's troops retook it; the last Kalmyk and Tatar raid reached the walls in 1713. With the frontier pushed farther south the fortress became a market town, sending sixty to ninety barges a year of rye, flour, oats and timber down the Khopyor and the Don to Azov and the Black Sea. In 1779 Borisoglebsk became an uyezd town of Tambov Governorate.
zh:
鲍里索格列布斯克一带位于霍皮奥尔河上游与其支流沃罗纳河之间，属森林草原，开阔草场间散布着成片橡林，其中以泰列尔曼大橡林最有名。1444年，这片牧场是大帐汗国的西北边缘：鞑靼牧群夏天在此吃草，克里米亚与诺盖的劫掠队伍则取道北上奔袭梁赞，全境只有米萨尔鞑靼人和莫尔多瓦人几处零星的捕鱼、养蜂营地。莫斯科公国把设防边墙向南推进时，16世纪末至17世纪初附近先后建起沃罗涅日和坦波夫要塞，此地空旷的林地和水面则被出租作渔猎场。

这里最早因木材进入莫斯科的视野。彼得一世筹备亚速远征时，命人砍伐泰列尔曼橡林，就地建造驳船和辅助船只供亚速舰队使用；1698年，沃罗纳河畔建起巴甫洛夫斯克要塞，防备克里米亚、亚速和诺盖人入寇。1704年，圣鲍里斯与格列布教堂落成，要塞得名鲍里索格列布斯克。四年后，市民加入孔德拉季·布拉文的哥萨克起义，据城坚守，直到被沙皇军队夺回；1713年，卡尔梅克与鞑靼人的最后一次入寇兵临城下。边界继续南移后，要塞变成商镇，每年有六十至九十条满载黑麦、面粉、燕麦和木材的驳船顺霍皮奥尔河、顿河驶往亚速和黑海。1779年，鲍里索格列布斯克成为坦波夫省的县城。

en:
Manych takes its name from the shallow, brackish Manych, whose salt lakes and marshes string out along the Kuma-Manych Depression, the low trough between the Don, the lower Volga and the Caucasus. In 1444 these grasslands belonged to the Great Horde, the surviving core of the Golden Horde ruled from Sarai. Astrakhani Tatar and Nogai herders drove sheep, cattle and horses between the Manych pastures and the Volga crossings, and caravans and river boats carried goods down toward Hajji-Tarkhan, the great market at the Volga mouth. A black-earth bluff on the Volga's right bank, later called Chyorny Yar, commanded a stretch of that road, but no fort stood there yet.

Mahmud, son of Küchük Muhammad, formed the Astrakhan polity around Hajji-Tarkhan in 1459, and it became fully independent only after the Crimeans destroyed the Great Horde in 1502. Nogai riders held most of the western steppe and crossed the Volga against Astrakhan in 1521. Moscow set Dervish Ali on the khan's throne in 1554; in June 1556 a Cossack vanguard found Hajji-Tarkhan abandoned, and Russian troops ended the khanate. The Persian diplomat Oruj beg Bayat, travelling to Spain by way of the Volga in 1599, recorded the black bluff under the name Chyorny Yar. In 1627 the Russians built the fort of Mikhailov Novgorod there to guard the Volga trade route; a collapsing bank forced it half a mile upstream in 1634 under the name Chyorny Yar, which neighbouring Nogais called Yankala, 'new town'. Kalmyk victories over the Great Nogai Horde in the 1630s pushed the surviving Nogais west to the right bank. Stenka Razin's rebels took the fort in 1670-1671, and Astrakhan rebels seized it again in 1705. In 1785 Chyorny Yar became an uyezd town of Astrakhan Governorate.
zh:
马内奇得名于水浅味咸的马内奇河；一连串咸水湖和沼泽沿库马—马内奇洼地展开，横在顿河、伏尔加河下游与高加索之间的低槽中。1444年时，这片草原属于以萨莱为都的大帐，即金帐汗国残存的核心。阿斯特拉罕鞑靼人与诺盖牧人赶着羊、牛和马，在马内奇牧场与伏尔加河渡口之间转场，商队与河船把货物运往伏尔加河口的大市场哈吉—塔尔汗。伏尔加河右岸有一道黑土崖，后来称乔尔内亚尔，扼守这段河路，当时崖上还没有要塞。

1459年，小穆罕默德之子马哈茂德以哈吉—塔尔汗为中心建立阿斯特拉罕政权，直到1502年克里米亚人攻灭大帐后才完全独立。诺盖骑兵掌握着西部草原的大部，1521年渡过伏尔加河进攻阿斯特拉罕。1554年，莫斯科把德尔维什·阿里扶上汗位；1556年6月，一支哥萨克前锋抵达时哈吉—塔尔汗已是空城，俄军随即灭亡汗国。1599年，取道伏尔加河出使西班牙的波斯外交官奥鲁奇·别克·巴亚特把这道黑土崖记作乔尔内亚尔。1627年，俄国人在此修筑米哈伊洛夫新城要塞，护卫伏尔加商路；河岸崩塌迫使要塞在1634年向上游迁移半英里，定名乔尔内亚尔，邻近的诺盖人称之为扬卡拉，意为「新城」。1630年代，卡尔梅克人连破大诺盖帐，残存的诺盖部众西迁至右岸。斯坚卡·拉辛的起义军在1670—1671年攻占要塞，1705年阿斯特拉罕起义者再次夺取。1785年，乔尔内亚尔成为阿斯特拉罕省的县城。

en:
The Ryn sands fill the watershed between the lower Volga and the lower Yaik, a belt of dunes and salt-marsh in the Caspian lowland where shallow streams run out among reed-fringed lakes. No town stood here and the grass was thin, but the hollows gave shelter from winter winds, so the Nogai Horde used the desert as its southern pasture. In 1444 Manghit herdsmen grazed sheep, horses and camels around the wells and took sturgeon from the two great rivers bordering the sands.

Kazakh pressure pushed the Nogais west of the Volga in the early sixteenth century, and the empty sands passed to the Kalmyks: Kho-Urluk's Torghut Oirats crossed the Yaik in 1628–1630 and made the Ryn their winter ground. They held it until 1771, when the Torghuts struck their camps and marched back to Dzungaria, leaving the desert nearly uninhabited. During Pugachev's revolt of 1773–1774 Kazakh bands from beyond the Yaik rode across these pastures with the rebels. In 1801 Tsar Paul allowed Bukey, a sultan of the Junior Jüz, to bring five thousand tents, more than 22,000 people, across the Yaik into the vacant steppe; their Bukey Horde, also called the Inner Horde, held the Ryn under Russian suzerainty.
zh:
莱恩沙地横亘在伏尔加河下游与亚伊克河下游的分水岭上，是里海低地上一片沙丘与盐沼交错的地带，水浅的河流消失在芦苇丛生的湖泊之间。这里没有城镇，草也稀疏，只有洼地能避冬风，诺盖汗国便把这片沙漠当作南部牧场。1444年，曼格特牧人绕着水井放牧羊、马和骆驼，还在沙地两侧的两条大河里捕捞鲟鱼。
