In 1444 the throne belongs to Zain-ul-Abidin, the Bud Shah, who won the civil war in 1420 with Jasrat Khokhar's help. He recalled exiled Pandits, abolished the jizya, and brought in Persian and Central Asian craftsmen; Srinagar wove shawls and carpets, made paper and books, and used the new Zaina Kadal bridge and Mar canal to move people and goods between its quarters.

After Zain-ul-Abidin died in 1470, his successors could not hold the valley intact. Mirza Haidar Dughlat, a Chagatai general and cousin of Babur, conquered Kashmir in 1540 and ruled it until his death in 1551. The Shia Chaks, highlanders whose families had come from Gilgit, seized Srinagar under Ghazi Shah in 1561 and held the sultanate until Akbar's Mughal armies conquered the valley in 1586. Mughal emperors spent summers beside Dal Lake: Jahangir laid out Shalimar Bagh in 1619, and Asif Khan built the terraced Nishat Bagh in 1633. Kashmir shawls became robes of honour in Mughal service. Afghan Durrani armies took Srinagar in 1752 and governed the valley harshly until Ranjit Singh's Sikhs defeated the Afghans near Shopian in the summer of 1819. By 1821 Kashmir was a Sikh province, and its shawls remained among the most costly textiles in India.
zh:
克什米尔谷地是皮尔潘贾尔岭与大喜马拉雅山围出的高山沃土盆地。军队和商队只能从少数险峻山口进入，杰赫勒姆河与达尔湖则把人流和货物引向斯利那加；自6世纪以来，这里就是谷地首府。早先的印度教和佛教宫廷使斯利那加成为学术之地，王统记载保存在《王河》中。1339年，沙阿·米尔建立穆斯林苏丹国，米尔·赛义德·阿里·哈马丹尼的门徒后来把伊斯兰教传遍各河谷。1444年在位的是臣民称为「大德王」的扎因·乌尔·阿比丁，他1420年借贾斯拉特·霍哈尔之助赢得内战。他召回流亡的潘迪特，废除人丁税，从波斯和中亚招来工匠；斯利那加织造披肩和地毯，造纸、制书，新建的扎伊纳卡达尔桥与马尔运河把城区和商货连接起来。

扎因·乌尔·阿比丁1470年去世后，后继苏丹无力保全谷地。1540年，察合台将领、巴布尔的表亲米尔扎·海达尔·杜格拉特征服克什米尔，统治到1551年身亡。先世来自吉尔吉特山地的什叶派查克家族1561年在加齐·沙率领下夺取斯利那加，直到1586年阿克巴的莫卧儿军队征服谷地。莫卧儿皇帝常在达尔湖畔避暑：贾汉吉尔1619年辟建夏利玛尔花园，阿萨夫汗1633年建成台地式的尼沙特花园。克什米尔披肩也成为莫卧儿朝服和荣誉礼服的一部分。1752年，阿富汗杜兰尼军队攻占斯利那加，统治严酷；1819年夏，兰季特·辛格的锡克军队在绍皮安附近击败阿富汗人。到1821年，克什米尔已是锡克行省，其披肩仍是印度最昂贵的织物之一。

en:
Kangra is the foremost of the Punjab Hills states, ruled from early times by the Katoch Rajputs. Their citadel, Kot Kangra or Nagarkot, rises on a rock between the Manjhi and Banganga rivers beneath the Dhauladhar peaks, the largest fort in the Himalayas. Below it stands the Bajreshwari temple, one of the Shakti Pithas, where pilgrims and heaped treasure drew Mahmud of Ghazni to plunder Kangra in 1009. The Tughluq sultans of Delhi stormed the fort more than once in the fourteenth century without ever holding the surrounding hills, and the Punjabi chieftain Jasrat fought a Delhi army beneath its walls in 1428. In 1444 the Katoch raja still reigned unbowed from his rock, the oldest and largest lordship between the Ravi and the Sutlej.

Raja Dharam Chand did homage to Akbar in 1556, but the fort defied the Mughals until November 1620, when a fourteen-month siege starved the garrison into surrender and a mosque went up inside the walls. In the 1780s Sansar Chand recovered his ancestors' stronghold, forced Chamba, Mandi and the neighbouring hill rajas to pay him tribute, and made his court the leading centre of Pahari painting: painters settled there on grants of land and painted the loves of Radha and Krishna in mineral colours. The Gurkhas of Nepal poured into the valley in 1806 and pressed the fort for three years, until Sansar Chand called in Ranjit Singh; in 1809 the Sikhs drove the Gurkhas back across the Sutlej, kept the fortress for Lahore and added its final gate, which bears Ranjit Singh's name.
zh:
冈格拉是旁遮普山区首屈一指的山邦，自古由拉杰普特人的卡托奇王朝统治。他们的要塞科特·冈格拉（又名纳加尔科特）雄踞道拉达尔雪峰下、曼吉河与班甘加河之间的岩丘，是喜马拉雅山区最大的堡垒。山下的巴杰雷什瓦里神庙是印度教性力派圣地之一，香客与财富汇聚于此，1009年招来伽色尼的马哈茂德洗劫。14世纪，德里的图格鲁克苏丹不止一次攻下堡垒，却始终守不住周围的山地；1428年，旁遮普首领贾斯拉特曾在堡下同德里军队激战。1444年，卡托奇拉杰仍据这座岩堡自立，是拉维河与萨特莱杰河之间最古老、也最大的山邦。

1556年，拉杰达拉姆·昌德向阿克巴称臣，但城堡拒不从命，直到1620年11月，莫卧儿军队在长达十四个月的围困后以饥饿迫降守军，堡内随后建起一座清真寺。1780年代，桑萨尔·昌德收复祖先的要塞，迫使昌巴、曼迪等邻近山邦纳贡，又把自己的宫廷办成帕哈里细密画最主要的中心：画师们受封土地定居下来，用矿物颜料描绘拉达与黑天的爱情。1806年，尼泊尔的廓尔喀军涌入河谷，围攻堡垒三年之久，桑萨尔·昌德只得向兰吉特·辛格求援；1809年锡克军把廓尔喀人逐回萨特莱杰河对岸，将堡垒收归拉合尔，还修了要塞最后一道城门，此门便以兰吉特·辛格为名。

en:
Sirhind guards the high road between Delhi and Lahore, the passage out of the Punjab into the Ganges plain, and later generations read its name as Sar-i Hind, the frontier of Hind. Under Prithviraj Chauhan it was a Rajput military outpost, and the Khokhar chief Jasrat besieged it without success in 1421. By 1444 it had become the stronghold of Bahlul Khan Lodi, the Afghan chief who held Lahore and Dipalpur and overawed the feeble Sayyid sultans at Delhi.

In 1451 Bahlul marched from Sirhind to Delhi and founded the Lodi dynasty, and the town stayed the key fortress on the road from the capital to the Punjab. After the Lodi defeat at Panipat in 1526 it passed to Babur, and in June 1555 Humayun broke Sikandar Shah Suri at the battle of Sirhind on his way back to Delhi. Mughal peace made it the administrative seat of the eastern Punjab: Akbar founded the Aam Khas Bagh highway-inn, later rebuilt by Shah Jahan, and the city was said to hold three hundred and sixty mosques, gardens, tombs, caravanserais and wells. Sheikh Ahmad Sirhindi, the Naqshbandi scholar whom Sunni India honours as the renewer of the second millennium, died here in 1624 and lies in the Rauza Sharif. In 1705 its faujdar Wazir Khan had the two young sons of Guru Gobind Singh, aged seven and nine, bricked up alive after they refused conversion; on 12 May 1710 Banda Singh Bahadur's Khalsa killed him at Chappar Chiri and sacked the city. The Sikhs defeated its Afghan governor Zain Khan in 1763 and plundered Sirhind again; the town never recovered, and Sikh gurdwaras rose over its ruins.
zh:
西尔欣德扼守德里至拉合尔的官道，是旁遮普出入恒河平原的孔道，后人把它的名字解作「萨里—欣德」，意为印度的边疆。普利色毗罗阇·兆汉时代，这里是拉杰普特人的军镇，1421年科卡尔人首领贾斯拉特围攻不克。到1444年，它已是阿富汗首领巴鲁勒·汗·洛迪的大本营，此人据有拉合尔与迪帕尔普尔，声势盖过德里孱弱的赛义德苏丹。

1451年，巴鲁勒从西尔欣德进军德里，建立洛迪王朝，此城也一直是都城通往旁遮普大道上的首要要塞。1526年洛迪王朝在帕尼帕特战败后，西尔欣德归属巴布尔；1555年6月，胡马雍在西尔欣德之战击败锡坎达尔·沙·苏利，继而收复德里。莫卧儿的太平岁月里，这里成为东旁遮普的行政中心：阿克巴始建名为「公私园」的官道驿馆，后由沙贾汉重建，据说城中有三百六十处清真寺、园林、陵墓、商队客栈和水井。纳合什班底教团的大学者谢赫·艾哈迈德·西尔欣迪1624年卒于此，葬在「圣陵」，逊尼派尊他为第二个千年的革新者。1705年，城守瓦齐尔汗下令把古鲁·戈宾德·辛格两个年仅七岁和九岁的儿子活活砌进墙里，因他们拒绝改宗；1710年5月12日，班达·辛格·巴哈杜尔的卡尔萨军队在恰帕尔奇里阵斩瓦齐尔汗，随即洗劫全城。1763年锡克军队击败阿富汗总督扎因汗，再掠西尔欣德；此城再未恢复，废墟上建起一座座谒师所。

en:
Garhwal, the 'land of forts', is a tangle of ridges and valleys around the sources of the Ganges, once parcelled among fifty-two petty hill chieftains, each holding his own garh. High in these mountains stands Badrinath, the Vishnu temple of the Char Dham pilgrimage, open for only six months a year under the snow; the rajas of Garhwal were its patrons, granting villages to feed the pilgrims and bearing the title 'speaking Badrinath'. Tradition brings the first Panwar prince, Kanak Pal, from Malwa in 823 on a pilgrimage to Badrinath, where he married the heiress of Chandpur Garhi. His descendants mastered the fifty-two forts, and Ajay Pal united them into one kingdom in 1358 with its seat at Devalgarh. In 1444 a Hindu raja of the Panwar line still reigned there over Pahari herdsmen and terraced fields, screened from the plains by the forested Siwalik hills.

The first raja to take the title Shah did so late in the 1500s, and in 1623 Mahipat Shah moved the court downstream to Srinagar. His widow Karnavati, ruling for her young son, cut to pieces a Mughal army under Najabat Khan in 1640, and was called Nakti Rani for the noses she took from invaders. Fateh Shah fought Guru Gobind Singh at Bhangani in 1688 and gave shelter to Ram Rai, the estranged son of Guru Har Rai; Ram Rai's camp in the Dun valley grew into the town of Dehradun. Rohilla troops under Najib-ud-daula seized Dehradun in 1757 and held it until the Garhwalis drove them out. The Gurkhas of Nepal struck in 1803 and slew Raja Pradyumna Shah in January 1804; their twelve years in Garhwal brought crushing taxes, and hill families were sold into slavery at Hardwar. Their defeat in the war of 1814-15 and the Treaty of Sugauli split the country: the British kept the eastern half with Srinagar, while Sudarshan Shah received the western half in 1815 as the new state of Tehri Garhwal.
zh:
加瓦尔意为「堡垒之地」，是恒河源头一带山岭与谷地交错的山区，从前分属五十二座山寨（加尔）的小首领。群山深处坐落着巴德里纳特——毗湿奴神庙、印度教四大圣地之一，每年被大雪封山，只开放六个月；加瓦尔的拉杰是神庙的护主，赐下村庄供养香客，还拥有「代巴德里纳特发话」的称号。相传帕瓦尔家族的第一位王公卡纳克·帕尔823年从马尔瓦来巴德里纳特朝香，娶了昌德普尔加尔希首领的独女；他的后人逐个降服五十二寨，阿贾伊·帕尔终于在1358年将众寨合并为一个王国，定都代瓦尔加尔。1444年，帕瓦尔家族的印度教拉杰仍在此统治着帕哈里牧民和梯田村落，林木密布的西瓦利克山把这片山地与平原隔开。

第一位采用「沙阿」称号的拉杰在16世纪末即位，1623年马希帕特·沙阿把王庭沿河谷迁到斯利那加。他死后，遗孀卡尔纳瓦蒂代幼子听政，1640年击溃纳贾巴特汗率领的莫卧儿军队，因割去入侵者的鼻子而得了「割鼻王后」的绰号。法塔赫·沙阿1688年在邦加尼与古鲁·戈宾德·辛格交战，又收容了与教团失和的古鲁·哈尔·拉伊之子拉姆·拉伊；后者在栋河谷地的营地后来发展成德拉敦城。1757年，纳吉卜·乌德·道拉率罗希拉军队攻占德拉敦，直到加瓦尔人将他们逐走。1803年尼泊尔的廓尔喀军攻入，1804年1月杀死拉杰普拉迪尤姆纳·沙阿；他们统治加瓦尔十二年，赋税沉重，山区人家被卖为奴，押到赫尔德瓦尔出售。1814至1815年的战争与《苏高利条约》把这个国家一分为二：东半部分连同斯利那加归英国，西半部分则在1815年封给苏达尔尚·沙阿，成为新的特里加瓦尔土邦。

en:
Jangladesh, the 'rough and dry country', also called Janglu, is the arid belt of northern Rajasthan, a thorn-and-dune plain covering the Bikaner and Churu tracts. Jat clans long pastured its flocks under their own headmen; Bhati Rajputs held the north and west, and Muslim Bhattis and Johiyas grazed their herds around Bhatner. Its chief fort was Pugal, seized in 1414 by the Bhati chieftain Rao Kelana, who raided as far as Bhatinda and Abohar and defeated the Baloch beyond Dera Ghazi Khan. In 1444 his descendants still held Pugal as a small desert chiefdom set among the Jat villages, living off its flocks, wells and the caravans passing through.

In the last quarter of the century Rao Bika, a fifth son of Rao Jodha of Marwar, left his father's court with the blessing of Karni Mata, the Charan holy woman who was tutelary goddess of the Rathor royal houses, at the head of a following of Rathores, Charans and Godara Jats, and set out to master Jangladesh. Rao Shekha of Pugal gave him his daughter Rang Kanwar in marriage; Bika raised his first fort in 1478 and founded the city of Bikaner in 1488, the Jat headmen submitted, and the country took his name. Karni Mata laid the foundation stone of Bikaner's fort, and her temple at nearby Deshnoke was kept as a sanctuary where no living thing was to be harmed. The oasis town grew rich on the caravan road between Central Asia and the Gujarat coast. Under Rai Singh, who accepted Mughal vassalage in 1571 and rose to high command under Akbar and Jahangir, the Junagarh fort was built. Long wars with Jodhpur wore the kingdom down in the eighteenth century, until Maharaja Surat Singh accepted British protection in 1818.
zh:
禅伽罗意为「干旱粗粝之地」，又称姜加尔卢，是拉贾斯坦北部的干旱地带，一片覆盖比卡内尔与久鲁一带的荆棘沙丘平原。贾特诸部长期在此放牧，由本族头人治理；北部和西部为巴蒂拉杰普特人所据，珀特纳周边住着穆斯林巴蒂人和乔希亚人。境内要堡是普格尔，1414年被巴蒂首领拉奥·凯拉纳夺取，他四出劫掠，兵锋远达珀丁达和阿博哈尔，又远征德拉加齐汗之外击败俾路支人。1444年，他的后人仍据守普格尔，在贾特村落之间维持着这个沙漠小邦，靠畜群、水井和过境商队为生。

15世纪后期，马尔沃尔的拉奥·乔达第五子拉奥·比卡，得到拉索尔王族供奉的查兰圣女卡尔尼·玛塔的祝福，率领拉索尔人、查兰人和戈达拉贾特人离开父亲的宫廷，前去征服禅伽罗。普格尔的拉奥·谢卡将女儿朗格·坎瓦尔嫁给他为妻；比卡1478年筑起第一座堡垒，1488年兴建比卡内尔城，贾特头人相继臣服，整片土地也以他的名字改称。卡尔尼·玛塔为比卡内尔堡奠基，她在附近德斯赫诺凯的神庙被奉为圣地，任何生灵都不得伤害。这座绿洲城镇扼守中亚通往古吉拉特海岸的商队大道，因贸易而富庶。1571年，拉伊·辛格接受莫卧儿封臣地位，在阿克巴与贾汉吉尔朝中升至高位，朱纳加尔堡即建于其治内。18世纪与焦特布尔的连年战争使国势凋敝，1818年摩诃罗阇苏拉特·辛格接受英国保护。

en:
In the heart of the Thar, Rawal Jaisal of the Bhati Rajputs founded Jaisalmer in 1156, abandoning the exposed old capital at Lodhruva for a yellow-sandstone fort on Trikuta Hill. Its walls, ninety-nine bastions around the Sonar Quila or Golden Fort, looked over the caravan roads between Sindh, Multan, Gujarat and northern India, and Jain merchants built a cluster of carved temples inside them between the twelfth and fifteenth centuries. The Bhatis charged the caravans toll and sometimes raided them instead; a raid on Alauddin Khalji's treasure train brought his army to the hill. His long siege ended in 1294 with jauhar, the women burning on the pyre while 3,800 riders under Mularaja charged out to die, and a second siege under Firoz Shah Tughluq ended the same way. Surviving Bhatis retook the empty fort. In 1444 Rawal Bersi Singh ruled a small kingdom of herdsmen, camels, wool and caravan tolls between the Rajput states and Sindh.

The grimmest of these tales came under Rawal Lunakaran. An Afghan chief, Amir Ali, smuggled armed men into the fort inside palanquins; when the defence looked hopeless Lunakaran killed his own womenfolk, there being no time to build a pyre, and the reinforcements that could have saved them arrived only minutes later. The fort held, and the episode was remembered as the 'half jauhar'. In 1541 Lunakaran fought Humayun, who attacked the fort on his march to Ajmer. In 1570 Rawal Harraj submitted to Akbar and gave him his daughter Nathi Bai; another Jaisalmer princess became Jahangir's queen Malika Jahan. For nearly two centuries the Bhatis sent troops to the Mughal armies and kept their own throne, while their merchants grew rich on the carrying trade. Maharawal Mulraj threw off the weakening empire in 1762, and carved sandstone havelis spread below the fort. On 12 December 1818 he signed a subsidiary alliance with the East India Company.
zh:
斋沙默尔地处塔尔沙漠腹地。1156年，巴蒂族拉杰普特王公拉瓦尔·贾萨尔放弃易受袭扰的旧都罗德鲁瓦，在特里库塔山上用黄色砂岩筑起城堡。九十九座棱堡环绕着索纳尔奎拉，即「金色城堡」，俯瞰信德、木尔坦、古吉拉特与北印度之间的商路；12至15世纪，耆那商人在堡内建起一组雕刻精美的神庙。巴蒂人向商队收税，有时也直接劫掠；一次打劫阿拉丁·卡尔吉财宝车队的举动，把他的大军引到了山下。长期围城于1294年以乔哈尔收场：妇女投火自焚，三千八百名战士在穆拉杰率领下开城赴死；菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克在位时的第二次围城也以同样方式结束。幸存的巴蒂人后来收回空城。1444年，拉瓦尔·贝尔西·辛格统治着一个夹在拉杰普特诸邦与信德之间、以牧人、骆驼、羊毛和商队税为生的小邦。

这些故事里最惨烈的一桩发生在拉瓦尔·卢纳卡兰在位时。阿富汗首领阿米尔·阿里把武士藏进花轿混入堡中；眼看守不住，卢纳卡兰来不及垒火葬堆，亲手杀死自家女眷，而本可救下她们的援军几分钟后便赶到了。城堡守住了，此事后来被称作「半次乔哈尔」。1541年，胡马雍进军阿杰梅尔途中攻堡，卢纳卡兰据堡迎战。1570年，拉瓦尔·哈拉杰臣服阿克巴，将女儿纳蒂·拜嫁给他；另一位斋沙默尔公主后来成为贾汉吉尔的王后玛莉卡·贾汉。此后近两百年，巴蒂人派兵加入莫卧儿军队，本族王位也一直保留，商人们靠转运贸易致富。摩诃拉瓦尔·穆尔杰吉1762年摆脱衰乱中的帝国，堡下铺开商人们雕饰的砂岩宅邸。1818年12月12日，他与东印度公司签订附属同盟条约。

en:
Marwar, the 'land of death and thirst', is the Thar country west of the Aravallis, and its old seat was Mandore, held by the Pratihara kings from the sixth century. The Rathores, driven west after Kannauj fell to the Delhi sultans, won Mandore when Rao Chunda married a Pratihara princess and received its fort as dowry. His son Rao Ranmal ruled neighbouring Mewar as regent, until Rana Kumbha had him murdered at Chittor in 1438, seized Mandore and overran Marwar; Rao Jodha got away with seven companions. In 1444 the dispossessed Rathore prince lived as an exile in the desert while Kumbha's Mewar held Mandore and its cotton lands.

Jodha surprised Mandore in 1453, while Kumbha was hard pressed by the sultans of Malwa and Gujarat. On 12 May 1459 he founded Jodhpur on Bhakurcheeria, the hill of birds nine kilometres south of the old capital, and began Mehrangarh, the 'fort of the sun', named for the Rathores' claimed descent from Surya; legend says the bird-hermit who lived on the hill cursed the citadel to scarcity of water, and the warrior-saint Karni Mata of Deshnoke came in person to lay its foundation stone. The walls rose above the Delhi-Gujarat road, where caravans carried opium, silk, copper and sandalwood. Rao Maldeo (1532-1562) made Marwar feared across Hindustan, and his commanders Jaita and Kumpa made Sher Shah Suri pay for his victory at Sammel in 1544. Akbar's armies entered in 1561; after Rao Chandrasen's death in 1581 the Mughals ruled Marwar directly until Udai Singh received its administration in 1583. When Jaswant Singh died at his Jamrud post, Aurangzeb's troops sacked Jodhpur in 1679. Durgadas Rathore then fought a thirty years' guerrilla war for the posthumous Ajit Singh and retook the city after Aurangzeb died in 1707; the fort's Fateh Pol gate was raised to mark that victory. Maratha pressure followed, and the Scindia general Jai Appa was killed besieging Nagaur in 1755. In January 1818 Jodhpur accepted a British subsidiary alliance.
zh:
马尔瓦尔意为「死亡与干渴之地」，是阿拉瓦利山脉以西的塔尔地带，其旧都曼多尔自6世纪起便是波罗提诃罗诸王的居城。拉索尔人在卡瑙季被德里苏丹攻灭后西迁，拉奥·春达娶波罗提诃罗公主，以嫁妆取得曼多尔堡。其子拉奥·兰马尔曾为邻邦梅瓦尔摄政，却于1438年被拉那·贡波杀死在奇托尔，曼多尔被占，马尔瓦尔尽陷，拉奥·乔达仅带七骑脱身。1444年，这位失国的拉索尔王子流落沙漠，贡波的梅瓦尔占据着曼多尔和它的棉花之乡。

1453年，贡波被摩腊婆与古吉拉特的苏丹牵制，乔达突袭收复曼多尔。1459年5月12日，他在旧都以南九公里的巴库尔切里亚山（意即「鸟山」）建立焦特布尔，动工修建梅兰加尔堡；堡名意为「太阳堡」，对应拉索尔人自称源出太阳神苏利耶的世系。相传住在山上的鸟仙诅咒这座城堡永远缺水，德斯赫诺凯的武圣克勒妮·玛塔亲自前来安放奠基石。城墙高踞德里—古吉拉特商路之上，商队往来贩运鸦片、丝绸、铜和檀香木。拉奥·马尔德奥1532年至1562年在位，让马尔瓦尔威震印度斯坦；他的将领杰伊塔和昆帕在1544年的萨姆梅尔让舍尔沙·苏利为胜利付出惨重代价。阿克巴的军队1561年入境；拉奥·昌德拉森1581年死后，莫卧儿直接统治马尔瓦尔，直到1583年乌代·辛格接掌政务。贾斯万特·辛格在贾姆鲁德任上去世后，奥朗则布的军队于1679年洗劫焦特布尔。杜尔加达斯·拉索尔为遗腹子阿吉特·辛格打了三十年游击战，1707年奥朗则布死后收复焦特布尔，堡内的法塔赫门即为纪念此役而建。此后是马拉塔的压迫，信迪亚将领贾伊·阿帕1755年围攻纳高尔时被杀。1818年1月，焦特布尔接受英国的附属同盟。

en:
Girnar is a great isolated peak above the southern flats of Saurashtra, reached by a long stone stairway that Jain pilgrims have climbed for more than a thousand years. Jains call it a Mahatirth: their twenty-second tirthankara Neminatha is believed to have gained omniscience and final liberation on the highest summit, with 533 enlightened sages. The temples stand on a shelf of the mountain, led by the Neminatha shrine and the Vastupala–Tejapala temple consecrated in 1230 by two Jain merchant-ministers of the Gujarat kings, which drew merchant pilgrims from across the region. At the foot lies the Uparkot, Junagadh's ancient citadel on a Mauryan site; tradition says a woodcutter found its walls buried in jungle and a holy man could tell him only that the place was juna, old, which gave Junagadh its name. A short way off stands a boulder carrying fourteen of Ashoka's rock edicts, with later inscriptions of Rudradaman and Skandagupta cut on the same stone. The Chudasama raos held the fort and the land of Sorath, owing the sultan in Ahmedabad little more than nominal allegiance. In 1444 the mountain and the rock were still in Hindu hands.

The last rao, Mandalika III, faced Mahmud Begada, who attacked Junagadh three times and forced the hill-fort to surrender in 1472; Mandalika accepted Islam under the name Jahan Khan, and the town was renamed Mustafabad. As the Gujarat Sultanate broke up, Tatar Khan Ghori and his son Amin Khan ruled Sorath almost as kings until Akbar's generals stormed the Uparkot in 1591–92. Mughal faujdars then held the fort, and Sardar Khan laid out the Sardar Baug palace in 1681. In 1730 Sher Khan Babi broke away amid Maratha raids and founded the nawabi state of Junagadh, which accepted British protection in 1807. Pilgrims kept climbing the stairway through these changes, and a new Rishabhanatha shrine was consecrated on the mountain in 1792.
zh:
吉纳尔是索拉什特拉南部平野上拔起的孤峰，香客沿漫长石阶攀登已有一千多年。耆那教把它尊为大圣地：第二十二代祖师内米纳特据说在最高峰证得全知并最终解脱，随他解脱的还有533位圣者。山腰台地上分布着寺庙群，以内米纳特主寺和1230年开光的瓦斯图帕拉与特贾帕拉寺为首，该寺由古吉拉特国王的两位耆那教商人出身的大臣施建，吸引全地区的商人香客。山脚是乌帕尔科特堡，即朱纳格特的旧城寨，所在可追溯到孔雀时代；相传一个樵夫在丛林中发现被掩埋的城墙，隐者只说此地叫「朱纳」，意为旧，朱纳格特便以此为名。不远处一块巨石上刻着阿育王的十四道岩石敕令，石上还有后来鲁陀罗达曼和斯坎达笈多的铭文。丘达萨马罗阇据有古堡和索拉特之地，对艾哈迈达巴德的苏丹只在名义上称臣。1444年，圣山与敕令石都还在印度教徒手中。

末代罗阇曼达利卡三世遇上马哈茂德·贝加达：后者三次攻打朱纳格特，1472年迫使山寨投降。曼达利卡改宗伊斯兰教，改名贾汉汗，城市更名穆斯塔法巴德。古吉拉特苏丹国瓦解时，塔塔尔汗·古里和儿子阿明汗在索拉特几乎以君主自居，直到1591至1592年阿克巴的将领攻陷乌帕尔科特。此后莫卧儿的法乌吉达尔镇守古堡，萨达尔汗于1681年营建萨达尔巴格宫。1730年，谢尔汗·巴比趁马拉塔袭扰自立，建立朱纳格特纳瓦卜政权，1807年接受英国保护。历次易主之间香客仍沿石阶登山，1792年山上又有一座新的黎舍婆那特祠庙开光。

en:
Baroda, called Vadodara in Gujarati, is a market city on the Vishwamitri River in the plain between the Mahi and the Narmada. Next door stood the older town of Akota, ancient Ankottaka, whose merchants traded with the Arabian Sea and buried a hoard of Jain bronzes spanning five centuries. By the 1100s Baroda itself was a Chaulukya city where Jain scholars copied manuscripts and merchants raised shrines. In 1344 it became the base of the Afghan amirs called the 'nobles of the hundred', who led the great Gujarat revolt against Muhammad bin Tughluq until his army scattered them near Bharuch the next year. In 1444 the town answered to the Gujarat sultans at Ahmadabad, and its Jain and Hindu merchants sent goods to Patan and the port of Khambhat.

Firuz Khan, the sultan's son and governor of Baroda, claimed the throne against his nephew Ahmad Shah I in 1411 and gave up without a battle. Troops of Mahmud Khalji of Malwa sacked the town in 1451, and Mahmud Begada later refounded it as a new city named Daulatabad beside the old site. After Akbar conquered Gujarat in 1573 he gave Baroda to the amir Aurang Khan. As Mughal rule loosened, Koli raiders looted the city for two days in 1705 and Maratha armies swept into Gujarat. Pilaji Gaekwad, a Maratha general sent south to collect tribute, founded his dynasty's state in 1721 at Songadh, and his Gaekwads in time made Baroda their capital. After the Second Anglo-Maratha War of 1803-1805 the Gaekwads kept their court in the city and acknowledged British suzerainty.
zh:
巴罗达（古吉拉特语称瓦多达拉）是维什瓦米特里河畔的商业城市，地处默希河与讷尔默达河之间的平原。紧邻它的阿科塔古称安科塔卡，那里的商人经营阿拉伯海贸易，埋藏的耆那教铜像前后跨越五个世纪。到12世纪，巴罗达本身已是乔鲁基亚王国的城市，耆那教学者在此抄写典籍，商人捐资修建神殿。1344年，号称「百户贵族」的阿富汗埃米尔以这里为据点，领导了反抗穆罕默德·伊本·图格鲁克的古吉拉大叛乱，次年被苏丹的军队在布罗奇附近击溃。1444年，城镇听命于艾哈迈达巴德的古吉拉特苏丹，耆那教和印度教商人把货物运往帕坦和港口坎贝。

苏丹之子、巴罗达总督菲鲁兹汗1411年向侄子艾哈迈德沙阿一世争夺王位，最终未战而罢兵。1451年，马尔瓦的马哈茂德·卡尔吉派兵洗劫此城；后来马哈茂德·贝加达在旧城旁重建新城，取名道拉塔巴德。1573年阿克巴征服古吉拉特后，把巴罗达封给埃米尔奥朗汗。莫卧儿统治松弛之际，科利人1705年入城劫掠两日，马拉塔大军席卷古吉拉特。南下征收贡赋的马拉塔将领皮拉吉·盖克瓦德1721年在松加尔赫建立政权，他的盖克瓦德家族后来定都巴罗达。1803至1805年第二次英国—马拉塔战争后，盖克瓦德家族承认英国宗主权，仍在城中保有宫廷。

en:
Surat stands on the lower Tapti a short sail from the Arabian Sea, and in 1444 it was the smaller, fortified neighbour of Rander on the same river. Arab merchants from Kufa had settled Rander in 1225, and their Navayat descendants ran large ships to Mecca, Malacca, Bengal, Pegu and Sumatra, trading spices, silk, musk and porcelain. Firuz Shah Tughlaq of Delhi had built a fort at Surat in 1373, when the settlement was still small, and after 1407 both towns belonged to the sultans of Gujarat. Surat was a guarded river port, while Rander's Arab merchants and ocean-going fleet took the trade of the Tapti mouth.

The Portuguese burned Surat in 1512 and again in 1530 and sacked Rander about the same time, and the river trade moved to Surat. Malik Gopi, a Brahmin governor of the Gujarat sultans, laid out the new town and had the Gopi Talav tank dug in 1516; the name Surat was in use by 1520. Akbar took the port in 1573, and under Mughal rule it became the empire's busiest harbour, where pilgrims embarked for the Hajj, textiles were woven and ocean-going ships built. Travelers found a crowded town of mud-and-bamboo houses and narrow lanes, lined along the riverfront with merchants' mansions and the factories of Turkish, Armenian, English and Dutch traders; Jains even ran shelters for cows and sick animals. Virji Vora, who dealt in spices, ivory, coral and opium and lent money to both European companies, was called the richest merchant in the world in the English factory records.

The English East India Company opened its first Indian factory at Surat in 1612. Shivaji's Marathas sacked the city in January 1664, burning two-thirds of it and carrying the plunder south to Rajgad, and raided again in October 1670. European pirates then preyed on the Red Sea and Persian Gulf shipping lanes, and when they seized Mughal pilgrim ships the emperor had the European factors locked up. By about 1725 the Marathas controlled the countryside, the English took Surat castle in 1759 and the city's administration in 1800, and Bombay had taken its trade.
zh:
苏拉特在达布蒂河下游，离阿拉伯海仅一段航程。1444年，它只是同河畔兰德尔旁边一座较小的设防城镇。1225年，来自库法的阿拉伯商人定居兰德尔，他们的纳瓦亚特后裔驾着大船往来麦加、马六甲、孟加拉、勃固和苏门答腊，经营香料、丝绸、麝香和瓷器。德里的菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克1373年在苏拉特筑堡时，这里规模还不大；1407年以后，两城都归属古吉拉特苏丹。苏拉特是一座有人戍守的河港，而达布蒂河口的贸易掌握在兰德尔的阿拉伯商人和他们的远洋船队手中。

葡萄牙人1512年、1530年两度焚毁苏拉特，又在差不多同期洗劫兰德尔，河口贸易就此转到苏拉特。古吉拉特苏丹的婆罗门长官马利克·戈皮营建新城，1516年主持开挖戈皮湖；到1520年，苏拉特之名已经通用。阿克巴1573年夺取此港，莫卧儿治下它成了帝国最繁忙的海港：朝觐者从这里登船去麦加，城里织造布匹，也建造远洋大船。外来旅客看到的是一座拥挤的贸易城，泥土竹木的房舍夹着窄巷，河畔却排满商人宅邸，以及土耳其人、亚美尼亚人、英国人和荷兰人的商馆；耆那教徒甚至开办了收容牛和病弱牲畜的处所。商人维尔吉·沃拉经营香料、象牙、珊瑚和鸦片，还向两家欧洲东印度公司放债，英国商馆的记录把他称作当时世界上最富有的商人。

1612年，英国东印度公司在苏拉特设立其在印度的第一座商馆。1664年1月，希瓦吉的马拉塔军洗劫全城，三分之二的街区被焚，掠得的财物南运至拉杰加尔；1670年10月他们再次来犯。此后欧洲海盗在红海和波斯湾航线上出没，截获莫卧儿的朝觐船，皇帝随即把欧洲商馆人员关押问罪。到1725年前后，乡间已落入马拉塔人之手；英国人1759年拿下苏拉特城堡，1800年接管城市行政，而它的贸易已经被孟买接走。

en:
Chittor (Chittorgarh, 'the fort of Chittor') is the great hill fortress of Mewar, a walled plateau 180 metres above the Berach valley holding four palaces, nineteen temples and some twenty reservoirs. It guarded the roads into Malwa and Gujarat. Alauddin Khalji of Delhi took it in 1303 after an eight-month siege; later legend says he came for Queen Padmini, who led the fort's women in jauhar, though most historians reject her story. Hammir Singh of the Sisodia clan won the fort back and made it the capital of a revived Mewar. Rana Kumbha fought off Malwa and Gujarat through the mid-fifteenth century and raised the Vijaya Stambha, the Tower of Victory, in 1440-1448 after defeating Mahmud Khalji at Sarangpur. In 1444 the carved tower stood above a fortress capital at the height of its power.

Rana Sanga carried Mewar to the head of a Rajput confederacy and marched against Babur, whose artillery broke him at Khanwa in 1527; he swore never to enter Chittor again and died the next year while preparing another campaign. When Bahadur Shah of Gujarat breached the walls in 1535, Rani Karnavati led thirteen thousand women onto the pyres while three thousand warriors rode out to die in the saka, and the Gujaratis soon withdrew and the Sisodias retook the fort. The nursemaid Panna Dai saved the infant Udai Singh II from his usurping uncle by yielding her own son Chandan in his place; as ruler he founded a safer capital at Udaipur in 1559. The Bhakti poet Mirabai, whose Krishna hymns are sung across India, is tied to Chittor, where a temple keeps her memory.

Akbar marched on Chittor in 1567. Udai Singh withdrew to the hills with his family and left the commanders Jaimal and Patta eight thousand men. The siege lasted four months; in February 1568 Akbar himself shot Jaimal with a matchlock, the women performed jauhar again, and the fort fell. Under the peace of 1615 between Amar Singh I and Jahangir, Chittor returned to Mewar on condition that its walls be neither repaired nor re-fortified. In 1680 Aurangzeb ordered the destruction of sixty-three temples in and around the city.
zh:
吉多尔（即吉多尔格尔，「格尔」意为堡垒）是梅瓦尔的巨型山堡，踞守在贝拉奇河谷上方180米高的岩台上，围墙之内有四座宫殿、十九座神庙和约二十处水池，护卫着拉杰普特高地通往马尔瓦与古吉拉特平原的道路。1303年，德里的阿拉丁·卡尔吉围攻八个月才攻下它；后世传说他攻城是为掳走王后帕德米妮，她率众妇女行乔哈尔自焚，不过多数史学家认为帕德米妮的故事并不可靠。西索迪亚家族的哈米尔·辛格收复山堡，把它定为复兴的梅瓦尔的都城。拉纳·昆巴在15世纪中期接连击退马尔瓦与古吉拉特，1440年至1448年间修建胜利塔，纪念在萨朗普尔击败马哈茂德·卡尔吉。1444年，这座雕饰的高塔立在正值鼎盛的要塞都城上方。

拉纳·桑加把梅瓦尔推上拉杰普特联盟的首领地位，举兵迎战巴布尔，却在1527年的坎瓦战役中被炮火击溃；他立誓不再踏入吉多尔，次年备战期间死去。1535年，古吉拉特的巴哈杜尔沙阿攻破城墙，拉妮·卡尔纳瓦蒂率一万三千名妇女登上火葬堆，三千名武士则杀出堡门赴死，是为「萨卡」；古吉拉特人很快撤走，西索迪亚人收复山堡。乳母潘娜·达伊为救下年幼的乌代·辛格二世、让他躲开篡位的叔父班维尔，献出亲生儿子钱丹替他赴死；乌代继位后，于1559年在更安全的乌代布尔建立新都。巴克提诗人米拉拜以颂赞黑天的圣诗闻名印度，吉多尔是与她渊源最深的地方，堡内有纪念她的神庙。

1567年，阿克巴进兵吉多尔。乌代·辛格带着家眷退入山区，留下杰马尔、帕塔两将率八千人据守。围城四个月后，阿克巴本人于1568年2月用火绳枪击毙杰马尔，妇女们再次行乔哈尔，山堡陷落。按1615年阿马尔·辛格一世与贾汉吉尔的和约，吉多尔归还梅瓦尔，条件是城墙既不修复、也不重新设防。1680年，奥朗则布下令毁坏城内及周边的六十三座神庙。

en:
Dhundhar is the hilly country east of the Aravalli range, the land that later took the name Jaipur. Its old capital, Amer, sits on a rocky ridge above the plain, its fort looking down on Maota Lake; the Kachwaha Rajputs took the settlement from its Meena chiefs and ruled from it for centuries. On a higher spur above the palace, the Hill of Eagles carried the still stronger Jaigarh Fort, and a covered passage joined the two strongholds so the court could fall back on Jaigarh in a siege. In 1444 the Kachwaha raja kept a small Hindu court at Amer, a modest kingdom beside Mewar and the other Rajput powers.

Prithviraj Singh rode with Rana Sanga against Babur and died in the year of the Rajput defeat at Khanwa in 1527. The house rose through Mughal service. Raja Bharmal gave his daughter to Akbar in 1562, and the Kachwahas became the emperor's most trusted Rajput generals: Bhagwant Das and Man Singh I led armies from Kabul to Bengal, and Man Singh, counted among Akbar's nine gems, fought sixty-seven battles and raised most of the palace at Amer, with its public audience hall and mirror chamber in mixed Rajput and Mughal work. As Mughal power loosened, Sawai Jai Singh II, given his title by Aurangzeb while still a boy, made himself independent and in 1727 laid out the walled city of Jaipur on the plain below. He equipped his new capital with a great stone observatory, had Euclid's Elements translated into Sanskrit, and built matching observatories at Delhi, Ujjain, Benares and Mathura. In 1818 Jaipur accepted a subsidiary alliance with the East India Company.
zh:
敦达尔是阿拉瓦利山脉以东的丘陵地区，后来得名斋浦尔。旧都安贝尔坐落在俯瞰平原的石脊上，堡垒下临毛塔湖；卡奇瓦哈拉杰普特人从米纳酋长手中夺下这座聚落，在此统治了数百年。宫殿上方更高的山嘴「鹰山」上，是更坚固的杰加尔堡，两堡之间有一条暗道相连，遭围时王室可退往杰加尔堡据守。1444年，卡奇瓦哈王公在安贝尔维持着一个印度教小朝廷，国势平平，夹在梅瓦尔等拉杰普特强权之间。

普里特维·辛格曾随拉纳·桑加迎战巴布尔，1527年拉杰普特联军在坎瓦战败，他也于同年去世。这个家族后来的兴旺，靠的是为莫卧儿效力：巴尔马尔王公1562年把女儿嫁给阿克巴，卡奇瓦哈人成为皇帝最信任的拉杰普特将领，巴格万特·达斯和曼·辛格一世统兵转战，从喀布尔一直打到孟加拉。曼·辛格位列阿克巴宫廷的「九宝」，一生打了六十七场重要战役，安贝尔宫的主要殿宇也多由他主持修建，公共觐见厅和镜殿混用拉杰普特与莫卧儿风格。莫卧儿势力松动后，幼年即获奥朗则布赐号「萨瓦伊」的贾伊·辛格二世自立为王，1727年在山下平原上建起城墙环绕的斋浦尔城。他在新都设置了宏大的石造天文台，命人把欧几里得《几何原本》译成梵文，又在德里、邬阇衍那、贝拿勒斯和马图拉各建一座同类天文台。1818年，斋浦尔接受东印度公司的辅助联盟。

en:
Mewat is the broken ridge-country of the Aravallis directly south of Delhi, where the roads out of the capital run through narrow valleys between bare rocky hills, their valleys walled and fortified. The strongest fort is the Alwar fort above its town, and the countryside is peopled by the Meos. The Khanzada lords of these hills began as Hindu Jadaun Rajputs: Bahadur Nahar, born Sonpar Pal, accepted Islam at the court of Firuz Shah Tughlaq in 1355 and held the title Wali-e-Mewat. His grandsons defended Kotla for a year against the Delhi sultan Khizr Khan and drove Mubarak Shah out of the Tijara hills, ruling afterwards as sovereigns. In 1444, under Ahmad Khan, Mewat was an independent Muslim Rajput kingdom commanding the roads south from Delhi.

The Mughals ended Khanzada rule. Hasan Khan Mewati, who had taken the Alwar fort from the Nikumbh Rajputs in 1492, fought for Ibrahim Lodi at Panipat in 1526 and the following March joined Rana Sanga against Babur at Khanwa; when Sanga was carried wounded from the field, Hasan Khan took command and was killed, and Babur annexed Mewat. The hills later produced another enemy of the Mughals. Hemu, born at Machari near Alwar, rose to be wazir and chief general of the Sur emperor Adil Shah, and after winning twenty-two battles he entered Delhi on 7 October 1556 and took the title of Vikramaditya; a month later a chance arrow felled him at the second battle of Panipat and Akbar had him beheaded. Under Akbar it became the four sarkars of Alwar, Tijara, Sahar and Rewari, growing indigo, sugarcane and cotton for Agra and Delhi and trading salt and iron. Aurangzeb's generals crushed a rebel Khanzada at Tijara; after the emperor's death the south passed to the Jat rajas of Bharatpur while Marathas overran the north. In 1775 Pratap Singh Naruka made the captured Alwar fort the seat of a new Rajput state, and in 1803 his successor Bakhtawar Singh became the first ruler in Rajputana to sign a treaty with the East India Company.
zh:
梅瓦特是德里正南方阿拉瓦利岭的破碎山地，光秃秃的石山间夹着一条条筑墙设防的山谷，诸堡之中以雄踞山头的阿尔瓦尔堡最强，居民以梅奥人为主。山中的汗扎达统治者本是印度教贾东族拉杰普特：巴哈杜尔·纳哈尔原名松帕尔·帕尔，1355年在菲鲁兹沙·图格鲁克朝中改宗伊斯兰教，领有「梅瓦特瓦利」（梅瓦特之主）的头衔。他的子孙据守科特拉堡一年，顶住德里苏丹希兹尔汗的围攻，又把穆巴拉克沙逐出蒂贾拉山区，此后便以独立君主自居。1444年艾哈迈德汗在位，梅瓦特是一个扼住德里南出道路的穆斯林拉杰普特独立王国。

汗扎达王朝亡于莫卧儿人之手。哈桑汗·梅瓦蒂1492年从尼康布拉杰普特手中夺得阿尔瓦尔堡，1526年在帕尼帕特为易卜拉欣·洛迪作战，次年3月又随拉纳·桑伽在坎瓦迎战巴布尔；桑伽负伤退出战场后，哈桑汗接掌全军，战死阵中，梅瓦特随后被巴布尔吞并。这片山地后来又走出一位与莫卧儿为敌的人物：生于阿尔瓦尔附近马查里村的赫姆，官至苏尔王朝皇帝阿德尔沙的维齐尔兼主将，连胜二十二仗后于1556年10月7日进入德里，取号维克拉马蒂亚；一个月后，他在第二次帕尼帕特战役中被流矢射落，阿克巴下令将他斩首。阿克巴将此地划为阿尔瓦尔、蒂贾拉、萨哈尔、雷瓦里四个萨尔卡尔，种植靛蓝、甘蔗和棉花供应阿格拉与德里，并经营盐铁贸易。奥朗则布的将领镇压了蒂贾拉反叛的汗扎达；皇帝死后南部落入婆罗多布尔的贾特首领之手，北部被马拉塔人攻占。1775年，普拉塔普·辛格·纳鲁卡以夺取的阿尔瓦尔堡为都建立新的拉杰普特邦；1803年，继任的巴克塔瓦尔·辛格成为第一个与东印度公司缔约的拉杰普塔纳君主。

en:
Rajkot lies on the Aji river in central Kathiawar, open grazing country where the Kathi clans pastured their herds and Rajput landholders held scattered walled villages. The district was then called Sardhar after its older seat. In 1444 its headmen answered loosely to the strongest lord of the peninsula, the Chudasama rao of Junagadh, and officers of the sultan in Ahmedabad seldom showed their faces. No town yet bore the name Rajkot, 'the king's fort'.

The town was founded in 1620 by Thakur Vibhoji Ajoji Jadeja, grandson of Jam Sataji of Nawanagar, who held the Sardhar pargana under a sanad of the emperor Jahangir and built his Jadeja line's new seat on the Aji. His successors kept their independence through most of the Mughal period, though an imperial subedar once occupied the town. In 1808 the settlement negotiated with the Kathiawar chiefs by Colonel Alexander Walker made Rajkot tributary to the Gaekwad of Baroda, and in 1820 the British leased ground beside the town for a cantonment, their first permanent footing in the peninsula.
zh:
拉杰果德位于卡提阿瓦半岛中部的阿吉河畔，这一带是开阔牧场，卡提诸部在此放牧，拉杰普特地主据守着零星的围壁村庄。地区当时以更古老的治所萨尔达尔为名。1444年，各首领只松散地听命于半岛上最强的领主、朱纳格特的丘达萨马罗阇，艾哈迈达巴德苏丹的官吏也很少露面。当时还没有一座叫拉杰果德的城镇，这个名字意为「王城」。

1620年，塔库尔·维博吉·阿乔吉·贾德贾建城。他是纳瓦纳加尔的贾姆·萨塔吉之孙，凭皇帝贾汉吉尔的敕书领有萨尔达尔帕尔格纳，在阿吉河畔建起贾德贾家族的新治所。其后人在莫卧儿时代大部分时间里保持独立，只有一位帝国苏贝达尔一度占领此城。1808年，亚历山大·沃克上校与卡提阿瓦诸首领议定的协定使拉杰果德向巴罗达的盖克瓦德纳贡；1820年英国人在城边租地设立军营，这是他们在半岛上的第一个永久立足点。

en:
Delhi stands on the Yamuna on the road between the Punjab and the Ganges valley, and a string of walled cities has risen in turn. The Tomara Rajputs built the Lal Kot in 1052, which the Chauhans took and renamed Qila Rai Pithora. After Muhammad of Ghor defeated Prithviraj Chauhan at Tarain in 1192, his general Qutb-ud-din Aibak made Delhi his capital and began the Qutb Minar, finished under Iltutmish. Later sultans raised Siri, Tughlaqabad, Jahanpanah and Firozabad beside the old city, until Timur sacked Delhi in 1398. In 1444 the Sayyid sultans ruled little beyond the walls, overshadowed by the Afghan lords of the Punjab.

Bahlul Lodi took Delhi in 1451, and his dynasty ended at Panipat in 1526, when Babur entered the city. Humayun began the Din Panah citadel by the Purana Qila before Sher Shah Suri drove him out in 1540; Sher Shah's son Salim Shah built the island-fort Salimgarh in 1546. Humayun recovered Delhi in 1555, but the Sur general Hemu seized it and had himself crowned in 1556, only to fall at the second Panipat later that year. The court long preferred Agra, until Shah Jahan laid out the seventh city, Shahjahanabad, from 1639: the Red Fort was completed in 1648 and the imperial Jama Masjid in 1656, while his daughter Jahanara laid out the Chandni Chowk bazaar in 1650, its central canal catching the moonlight; it was counted the grandest market in India.

After Aurangzeb died in 1707 the empire unravelled fast. Baji Rao's Marathas sacked Delhi in 1737, and in 1739 Nader Shah crushed Muhammad Shah at Karnal and carried off the Peacock Throne and the Koh-i-Noor. Durrani's Afghans sacked it again in 1757 and raided it after Panipat in 1761; in 1765 the Jats of Bharatpur seized the Red Fort. Mahadji Shinde's Marathas restored the exiled Shah Alam II in 1771, and after the Rohilla chief Ghulam Kadir blinded the emperor and wrecked the city in 1788, Maratha arms restored order. The East India Company defeated Daulat Rao Sindhia at the battle of Delhi in 1803, and in 1821 the Mughal emperor still lived in the Red Fort as a Company pensioner.
zh:
德里坐落于亚穆纳河畔，扼守旁遮普与恒河平原之间的大道，一座座带城墙的城池在此相继而起。1052年，托马拉拉杰普特人筑起拉尔科特堡，后被兆汉人夺取，改名拉伊·皮多拉堡。1192年穆罕默德·古尔在塔兰战役击败普利色毗罗阇·兆汉后，部将库特卜—丁·艾伯克以德里为都，动工修建库特卜尖塔，后由伊尔杜特米什完工。此后的苏丹们在旧城旁另筑新都：锡里、图格鲁克巴德、贾汉帕纳、菲罗扎巴德，直到1398年帖木儿攻陷洗劫。1444年，赛义德朝苏丹的号令不出城墙，声势全在旁遮普的阿富汗贵族之下。

1451年巴鲁勒·洛迪入主德里，其王朝在1526年帕尼帕特之战后告终，巴布尔进入此城。胡马雍在古堡旁开建迪恩帕纳堡垒，1540年被舍尔沙·苏利逐出；1546年舍尔沙之子萨利姆沙在河心岛上修筑萨利姆加尔堡。胡马雍1555年还都，苏利朝将领黑穆1556年进占德里、加冕称王，同年便在第二次帕尼帕特之战败亡。莫卧儿朝廷久居阿格拉，直到1639年沙贾汉动工兴建第七座都城沙贾贾纳巴德：红堡1648年落成，皇家清真寺贾玛清真寺1656年建成；1650年，沙贾汉之女贾哈娜拉主持开辟月光集市，街心引水成渠，渠中映月，号称印度最壮观的市集。

1707年奥朗则布死后，帝国迅速瓦解。1737年巴吉·拉奥率马拉塔人洗劫德里；1739年纳迪尔沙在格尔纳尔击溃穆罕默德沙，掠走孔雀宝座与光之山钻石。1757年艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的阿富汗人再度洗城，1761年帕尼帕特之战后又来劫掠；1765年婆罗多布尔的贾特人攻占红堡。1771年玛哈吉·辛迪亚的马拉塔人护送流亡的沙·阿拉姆二世复位；1788年罗希拉首领古拉姆·卡迪尔弄瞎皇帝、蹂躏京城，又是马拉塔军队定乱。1803年东印度公司在德里之战击败道拉特·拉奥·辛迪亚；1821年，莫卧儿皇帝仍居红堡，已是领取公司年金的人。

en:
Lucknow lies on the Gomti, in the fertile Awadh plain north of the Ganges, a country later called the granary of India. In older times it was part of Kosala, and from 1394 it belonged to the Sharqi sultans of Jaunpur, who broke from Delhi as the Tughluq empire fell apart. Ibrahim Shah Sharqi, reigning from 1402 to 1440, made Jaunpur the leading Muslim kingdom of the upper Ganges, filling its capital with mosques and colleges, while Lucknow remained a small town of Avadhi-speaking Hindus. In 1444 his son Mahmud Shah Sharqi was on the throne, and Lucknow's turn as a capital lay more than three centuries away.

The Sharqi kingdom fell to Bahlul Lodi's Afghans in the wars of 1478 to 1486, and Lucknow passed to the Mughals after Panipat in 1526. Under Jahangir an estate here went to his favourite Sheikh Abdul Rahim, who built Machchi Bhawan, the house from which his heirs long ran the district. In 1722 Saadat Khan Burhan-ul-Mulk, a Persian adventurer, was made governor of Awadh and held his court at nearby Faizabad; his successor Shuja-ud-Daula marched with the fugitive Nawab of Bengal, Mir Qasim, and was crushed at Buxar in 1764. Lucknow's turn came in 1775, when the fourth nawab, Asaf-ud-Daula, moved his court from Faizabad and set out to build. The Bara Imambara, raised between 1780 and 1784 through a decade of famine, was a work relief project: commoners laid its walls by day and noblemen came at night to pull down what had gone up, so that high-born families could draw relief wages without being seen; it cost between half a million and a million rupees. Beside it stood the sixty-foot Rumi Darwaza, copied from the Sublime Porte in Istanbul. Lucknow became the centre of Shia Islam in India, a city of Urdu poets, Shia processions and the mixed Hindu-Muslim Ganga-Jamuni culture. In 1801 the British-backed Saadat Ali Khan ceded half of Awadh to the East India Company and disbanded his army; in 1819 Ghazi-ud-Din Haidar dropped the Mughal emperor's nominal overlordship and struck coins in his own name.
zh:
勒克瑙位于戈默蒂河畔、恒河以北肥沃的阿瓦德平原，这片地方后来被称为印度的粮仓。上古时这里属拘萨罗，1394年起归章普尔的沙尔基苏丹统治；图格鲁克王朝瓦解时，他们脱离德里自立。1402至1440年在位的易卜拉欣沙·沙尔基把章普尔建成恒河上游首屈一指的伊斯兰王国，都城内清真寺和经学院林立，而勒克瑙还只是一座居民多说阿瓦德语的印度教小镇。1444年在位的是其子马哈茂德沙·沙尔基，勒克瑙成为都城还要再等三百多年。

1478至1486年的战争中，巴赫鲁尔·洛迪的阿富汗人灭掉沙尔基王国；1526年帕尼帕特战役后，勒克瑙又归莫卧儿。贾汉吉尔把此地一处庄园赐给宠臣谢赫·阿卜杜勒·拉希姆，他建起马奇巴万宫，后代长期在那里治理这一地区。1722年，波斯来的冒险家萨阿达特汗·布尔汉·穆勒克被任命为阿瓦德总督，在附近的法扎巴德开府；继任者舒贾·乌德·道拉收留逃亡的孟加拉纳瓦卜米尔·卡西姆，1764年与其一同在布克萨尔惨败。勒克瑙的转机在1775年到来：第四代纳瓦卜阿萨夫·乌德·道拉把宫廷从法扎巴德迁来，着手营建新城。巴拉伊玛目巴拉建于1780至1784年的连年饥荒期间，是一项以工代赈的工程：平民白天砌墙，贵族夜里再把白天砌起的部分拆倒，让出身高贵的人家也能不为人知地领取赈济工钱；工程耗资五十万到一百万卢比。旁边是高六十英尺的鲁米门，仿照伊斯坦布尔的高门而建。勒克瑙成为印度什叶派的中心，乌尔都诗人、什叶派游行和印度教徒与穆斯林共处的「甘加—贾穆尼」风尚汇集于此。1801年，靠英国人上位的萨阿达特·阿里汗把半个阿瓦德割让给东印度公司，解散了自己的军队；1819年，加齐·乌德·丁·海达尔不再奉莫卧儿皇帝为名义上的宗主，以自己的名义铸币。

en:
The Central Doab is the broad middle reach of the Ganges–Yamuna wedge, and its oldest city is Mathura on the Yamuna, the traditional birthplace of Krishna, born there in a prison cell where his uncle King Kamsa held his parents; Hindus number Mathura among their seven holy cities, and pilgrims crowd its river steps at every festival. It was old even as a Buddhist and Jain merchant city at the fork of the roads to Malwa and the western ports, when Mahmud of Ghazni sacked it in 1018 and carried its golden idols away on a hundred camels, and the rebuilt shrines were harried again under later sultans. In 1444 the country is a march disputed between Delhi and the Sharqi rulers of Jaunpur, Mathura a pilgrim city governed by Muslim officers, while Agra downstream is still a village.

Agra's turn came under the Lodis: Sikandar Lodi rebuilt the town in 1504 and moved his court there, and the Mughals kept it. After the Sur interlude Akbar raised the great red-sandstone fort and built the new city of Fatehpur Sikri on the ridge nearby, only to abandon it within fifteen years; by the 1580s Agra was among the greatest cities in the world, and the English traveller Ralph Fitch in 1585 thought it larger than London. Shah Jahan gave it the Taj Mahal on the river and the marble halls within the fort. When he lost the battle of Samugarh to his son Aurangzeb in 1658, he spent his last eight years a prisoner in the fort and died there in 1666. At Mathura stood the grand Keshavadeva temple raised by the Bundela raja Bir Singh Deo at a cost of thirty-three lakhs of rupees; Tavernier saw its octagonal red-sandstone tower in 1650. Aurangzeb had the temple torn down in 1670 and raised the Shahi Eidgah mosque on its plinth, a year after the Jat rebel Gokula was put to death in Agra.

As the empire crumbled, the Jat raja Suraj Mal took Agra in 1761 and melted down the fort's silver doors; the Mughals won the city back in 1774, lost it to the Marathas in 1785, and Lord Lake seized it for the East India Company in 1803.
zh:
中河间地是恒河与亚穆纳河之间楔形沃土的中段，最古老的城市是亚穆纳河畔的马图拉。相传黑天就降生在这里的一间囚室——他的舅父刚沙王把他的父母囚禁于此；印度教徒把马图拉列为七大圣城之一，每逢节庆，香客挤满河畔石阶。早在佛教与耆那教商人往来的年代，它已是通往马尔瓦和西海岸诸港的大道分岔处的名城。1018年伽色尼的马哈茂德破城，把金像用一百头骆驼驮走，重建的神庙在后世苏丹治下又屡遭毁坏。1444年，这里是德里与章普尔沙尔基王朝反复争夺的边地，马图拉是穆斯林官吏管辖下的朝圣城，下游的阿格拉还是一座村庄。

阿格拉的时运随洛迪王朝而来：西坎达尔·洛迪1504年重建此城并迁都于此，莫卧儿人沿袭不改。经过苏尔王朝的插曲，阿克巴筑起宏伟的红砂岩城堡，又在附近山脊上营建新都法塔赫布尔西格里，不到十五年便将其废弃；到1580年代，阿格拉已是世上首屈一指的大城，英国旅人拉尔夫·菲奇1585年断言它比伦敦还大。沙贾汗为它在河边修建泰姬陵，在堡内修建大理石殿阁。1658年萨穆加尔战败后，他被儿子奥朗则布囚禁于阿格拉堡，度过最后八年，1666年死在堡中。马图拉那边，本德拉王公维尔·辛格·迪奥曾耗资三百三十万卢比建起宏大的凯沙瓦提婆神庙，塔韦尼耶1650年见到它的红砂岩八角高塔。1670年奥朗则布下令拆庙，在台基上修建皇家会礼清真寺，而贾特起义者戈库拉一年前刚在阿格拉被处死。

帝国崩解之际，贾特王公苏拉杰·马尔1761年攻陷阿格拉，熔掉城堡的银门；莫卧儿1774年收复此城，1785年又落入马拉塔人之手，1803年莱克勋爵替东印度公司取下阿格拉。

en:
Gird is the plain around the rock of Gwalior, Gopachal in the old inscriptions, where a single sandstone bluff rises three hundred feet from the plain, crowned by one of India's strongest forts. Babur called Gwalior the pearl of the fortresses of Hind, and wrote that not even the wind could touch its masts. Iltutmish of Delhi took the rock in 1232, and in the 1390s the Tomar Rajput Virasimha seized it as Tughlaq authority collapsed. In 1444 Dungar Singh Tomar rules an independent kingdom from the clifftop, while Jain monks and merchants carve the colossal Gopachal images, work that ran from 1440 to 1473; his court is already known for its dhrupad singers, an island of Rajput power between Delhi, Jaunpur and Malwa.

Man Singh Tomar (r. 1486-1516) gave the fort its show-pieces, the Man Mandir with its painted and tiled halls and the Gujari Mahal below the walls, built for his queen Mrignayani of the Gurjar community. He bought Bahlul Lodi off with 800,000 tankas; Sikandar Lodi wasted the countryside in 1505-1506 but never climbed the rock. His son Vikramaditya surrendered to Ibrahim Lodi in 1518 and fell fighting for him at Panipat in 1526. The fort passed to Babur, to Sher Shah in 1542 and to the Hindu general Hemu, before Akbar retook it in 1558 after a long siege. Under the Mughals the clifftop became a state prison, where Aurangzeb's brother Murad Bakhsh and nephew Sulaiman Shikoh were put to death in the Man Mandir and Jahangir confined the Sikh Guru Hargobind. The singer Tansen, born near Gwalior and first employed at the Tomar court, joined Akbar in 1562 as one of his nine navaratnas and was buried here. The last Tomar raja Ram Shah fell at Haldighati in 1576 with three sons.

Bhim Singh Rana of Gohad seized the fort in 1740. The Scindias took it in 1755-1756, lost it on the night of 3 August 1780 when Captain Popham's twelve grenadiers and thirty sepoys climbed the rock with under twenty casualties, and won it back in 1784. Daulat Rao Scindia afterwards laid out Lashkar below the hill as the capital of his state.
zh:
吉尔德是瓜廖尔巨岩周围的平原，古碑铭中称戈帕查尔；平原上一整块砂岩崖壁拔地三百英尺，顶上是印度最坚固的堡垒之一。巴布尔把瓜廖尔称作印度斯坦诸堡之冠，还说连风都摸不到堡顶。德里苏丹伊勒杜迷失1232年攻下山岩；14世纪90年代图格鲁克王朝权威崩溃，托马尔家族的拉杰普特人维拉辛哈乘机夺取此堡。1444年，东加尔·辛格·托马尔在崖顶统治着独立王国，耆那教僧人和商人正在崖壁上开凿戈帕查尔巨型造像，工程从1440年持续到1473年；他的宫廷已因德鲁帕德歌唱闻名，是德里、江布尔与摩腊婆之间的一座拉杰普特强权孤岛。

曼·辛格·托马尔（1486至1516年在位）给堡垒留下了最出风头的建筑：饰有彩绘瓷砖厅堂的曼曼迪尔宫，以及墙外的古杰里宫，后者是他为出身古贾尔族的王后所建。他曾以八十万坦卡向巴赫卢勒·洛迪买和；西坎达尔·洛迪1505至1506年纵兵蹂躏四乡，却始终没能爬上崖顶。曼·辛格死后，儿子维克拉马蒂亚1518年向易卜拉欣·洛迪交出堡垒，1526年又在帕尼帕特为其战死。堡垒先后归入巴布尔、1542年的舍尔沙和印度教将领黑姆之手，1558年阿克巴久攻之后将其收复。莫卧儿时期，崖顶成了关押要犯的国家监狱：奥朗则布的弟弟穆拉德·巴赫什和侄子苏莱曼·舒科在曼曼迪尔宫被处死，锡克古鲁哈尔戈宾德也曾被贾汉吉尔囚禁于此。歌唱家坦森生于瓜廖尔附近，最初在托马尔宫廷得到职位，1562年作为宫廷「九宝」之一进入阿克巴朝堂，身后归葬瓜廖尔。末代托马尔罗阇拉姆·沙阿1576年带着三个儿子战死于哈尔迪加蒂。

1740年，戈赫德的比姆·辛格·拉纳夺取堡垒。辛迪亚家族1755至1756年占领，1780年8月3日夜失守：波帕姆上尉率十二名掷弹兵和三十名土兵攀上崖壁，双方伤亡合计不到二十人；1784年辛迪亚又将堡垒收回。道拉特·拉奥·辛迪亚后来在崖下营建拉尔什卡尔，作为本邦都城。

en:
Mandu, also called Mandavgad, occupies a long rocky ridge of the Vindhya Range. The Malwa plateau lies to its north and the Narmada valley drops away below its southern cliffs, so the Paramaras used the height as a safer royal residence than Dhar. Alauddin Khalji's Delhi army took the fort in 1305 after a guide showed troops a way inside. After Timur's occupation of Delhi weakened the provincial government, Dilawar Khan established an independent Malwa sultanate, and his son Hoshang Shah moved the capital from Dhar to Mandu and called it Shadiabad. In 1444 Mahmud Khalji ruled from this ridge-top capital, where gates, mosques, courtyards and palaces stretched for miles along the fortified plateau.

The Khalji sultans kept building on the site. Ghiyas-ud-din, who came to the throne in 1469, kept a household said to number thousands of women and built the ship-shaped Jahaz Mahal between two royal tanks. The last sultan, Baz Bahadur, gave much of his attention to music and built the Rewa Kund reservoir with an aqueduct toward the Narmada. His consort Rani Roopmati was herself a poet, and the story of the musician-sultan and Roopmati became one of the best-known romances in Malwa folklore.

Bahadur Shah of Gujarat captured Mandu in 1531 and ended Khalji rule. Humayun occupied the fortress in 1534, before ten years of officers' revolts and invasions left Baz Bahadur in control. On 29 March 1561 a Mughal army under Adham Khan and Pir Muhammad Khan defeated him at Sarangpur; Roopmati poisoned herself when Mandu fell. Baz Bahadur briefly returned after a Khandesh-Berar coalition killed Pir Muhammad and drove the Mughals out, but Akbar sent another army that conquered Malwa in 1562. Mandu remained a Mughal fortress until Baji Rao I's Marathas took it in 1732, after which the Pawar rulers moved their seat back to Dhar.
zh:
曼杜又称曼达瓦加德，坐落在温迪亚山脉一道狭长的岩石山脊上。山脊北面是摩腊婆高原，南面崖下便是讷尔默达河谷，因此帕拉马拉王朝把这里当作比达尔更安全的王宫驻地。1305年，阿拉乌丁·卡尔吉的德里军队靠向导引路进入要塞，将其攻占。帖木儿占领德里、削弱地方政权后，迪拉瓦尔汗建立独立的摩腊婆苏丹国；其子胡尚格沙把都城从达尔迁至曼杜，改称沙迪阿巴德。1444年，马哈茂德·卡尔吉在这座山脊都城中统治，城门、清真寺、庭院和宫殿沿设防台地绵延数英里。

卡尔吉王朝的苏丹们继续在此营建。1469年即位的吉亚斯丁拥有据说多达数千人的后宫，并在两座御池之间修建船形的贾哈兹宫。末代苏丹巴兹·巴哈杜尔把许多精力放在音乐上，还修建雷瓦昆德蓄水池，以水道通向讷尔默达河。他的伴侣拉妮·鲁普马蒂本人也是诗人，这位通晓音乐的苏丹与鲁普马蒂的故事后来成为摩腊婆最知名的民间爱情传说之一。

1531年，古吉拉特的巴哈杜尔沙攻占曼杜，终结卡尔吉王朝的统治。胡马雍1534年占据这座要塞，此后十年间军官叛乱与外敌入侵交织，巴兹·巴哈杜尔最终掌握权力。1561年3月29日，阿扎姆汗和皮尔·穆罕默德汗率领莫卧儿军队在萨兰布尔击败他；曼杜陷落时，鲁普马蒂服毒自尽。后来坎德什与贝拉尔联军杀死皮尔·穆罕默德汗，把莫卧儿人逐出摩腊婆，巴兹·巴哈杜尔一度返回，但阿克巴另派军队，于1562年征服摩腊婆。曼杜仍是莫卧儿要塞，直到1732年被巴吉拉奥一世的马拉塔军队夺取；此后帕瓦尔统治者把治所迁回达尔。

en:
Burhanpur lies on the north bank of the Tapti, twenty miles south of Asirgarh Fort. The fort crowns a peak in the Satpuras and commands the pass between the Narmada and Tapti valleys, the road from Hindustan into the Deccan, and generals knew it as the key to the Deccan. Malik Nasir Khan of the Faruqi dynasty made the riverside settlement his capital in 1388 and named it after the Sufi saint Burhan-ud-din. In 1444, under Miran Mubarak Khan I, Burhanpur was the young capital of the independent Faruqi sultans of Khandesh, guarded by Asirgarh and already placed on the trade roads between Malwa, Hindustan and the Deccan.

Miran Adil Khan II, who came to the throne in 1457, built the citadel and palaces and filled the town with weavers. Akbar occupied Burhanpur in 1599, and Asirgarh fell in January 1601 after the last Faruqi sultan, Bahadur Shah, was tricked into surrender; the town became the seat of the Mughal subah of Khandesh. Abdul Rahim Khan-i-Khanan gave it new waterworks and gardens, Prince Parviz made it his Deccan headquarters in 1609, and Shah Jahan enlarged the Shahi Qila, whose royal bath was decorated for Mumtaz Mahal. She died here in 1631 giving birth to her fourteenth child and was first buried in the Ahukhana garden; six months later her body was carried to Agra, and a painting on the bath ceiling is locally said to show the domed tomb that became the Taj Mahal. Cotton, indigo and cloth made the district's fortune under Mughal rule. The Marathas took the town in the 1720s and again in the 1760s, and it passed to the East India Company in 1818. Asirgarh held out a few months longer: its twelve hundred defenders endured a British bombardment until 9 April 1819, the last siege of the last Maratha war.
zh:
布尔汉普尔（又译布尔汉布尔）在塔普蒂河北岸，阿西尔加尔堡在其以北二十英里。堡垒雄踞萨特普拉山脉的峰顶，扼守讷尔默达河与塔普蒂河河谷之间的山口，控制着从印度斯坦进入德干的大路，将领们称之为「德干之钥」。1388年，法鲁奇王朝的马利克·纳西尔·汗把这座河畔聚落立为都城，以苏菲圣徒布尔汉丁的名字命名。1444年米兰·穆巴拉克·汗一世在位，布尔汉普尔是独立的坎德什法鲁奇苏丹国年轻的都城，外有阿西尔加尔堡屏障，又处在马尔瓦、印度斯坦与德干之间的商路上。

1457年继位的米兰·阿迪勒·汗二世修筑城堡和宫殿，招徕织工，使城市成为纺织重镇。阿克巴1599年占领布尔汉普尔；末代法鲁奇苏丹巴哈杜尔沙阿中计投降，阿西尔加尔堡于1601年1月陷落，城市成为莫卧儿坎德什行省的治所。阿卜杜勒·拉希姆·汗伊汗南为它修建供水设施和园林，王子帕尔维兹1609年把这里作为经略德干的大本营，沙贾汉则扩建皇家城堡，堡内的皇家浴室是为穆姆塔兹·玛哈尔装饰的。1631年，她在这里生下第十四个孩子时去世，最初葬在阿胡哈纳花园，半年后遗体才被运往阿格拉；当地人说，浴室天花板上的一幅壁画所绘的穹顶陵墓，就是后来泰姬陵的雏形。莫卧儿治下，棉花、靛蓝和布匹让这一地区致富。马拉塔人在18世纪20年代和60年代两度攻取此城，城市1818年转入东印度公司之手。阿西尔加尔堡又多撑了几个月：一千二百名守军顶住英军炮击，一直守到1819年4月9日，这是最后一场英马战争的最后一次围城。

en:
Hadoti is the south-eastern corner of Rajasthan, the country of the Hada Chauhans: a rolling upland between the Aravalli hills and the Malwa plateau, cut by the Chambal River and planted with cotton. The Hadas are a branch of the Chauhan clan. Under Rao Deva they took Bundi from the Meena and Bhil clans in 1241 and seized Kota in 1264, which gave the country its older name of Haravati; the walled town of Kota grew up on the Chambal in the century after that. In 1444 the Hada raos rule from the hill fort of Bundi as vassals of the Sisodias of Mewar, holding the marches on the road between Mewar and Mandu, the capital of Malwa.

The armies of the long Malwa-Mewar wars crossed these marches: the Battle of the Banas in 1446, and Mahmud Khalji of Malwa's siege of Mandalgarh in 1456-1457; around 1468-1473 the great fort of Ranthambore passed into Hada keeping. Bahadur Shah of Gujarat held it briefly in 1532-1535, and when Rao Surjan Singh surrendered Ranthambore to Akbar in 1568 the Hadas entered Mughal service. In 1631 the Emperor Shah Jahan split their lands, granting Kota to Rao Madho Singh, the second son of Ratan Singh of Bundi, and Kota outgrew its parent state. Weavers who came up from the south settled at Kaithoon and wove the light, checkered Kota doria cloth; the Kota school of miniature painting worked for the court, and Maharao Bhim Singh held a mansab rank of five thousand under Bahadur Shah I. From 1771 Zalim Singh, regent for a minor raja, reformed Kota's revenue and irrigation with the Chambal's water, and in 1817 he placed the state under British protection.
zh:
哈多蒂在拉贾斯坦东南角，是哈达·乔汉人的土地：阿拉瓦利山岭与摩腊婆高原之间一片起伏高地，昌巴尔河穿境而过，地里种着棉花。哈达人是乔汉人的一支，在拉奥·德瓦率领下于1241年从米纳和比尔诸部手中夺取本迪，1264年又夺得科塔，这一带因此得名哈拉瓦蒂；此后一个世纪，筑有城墙的科塔城在昌巴尔河畔发展起来。1444年，哈达诸拉奥以本迪山寨为治所，作为梅瓦尔西索迪亚王公的藩属统治这片棉花之地，扼守着梅瓦尔与摩腊婆都城曼杜之间的边境通路。

摩腊婆与梅瓦尔长期交战，两军反复穿过这片边境：1446年的巴纳斯河之战，1456至1457年摩腊婆的马哈茂德·卡尔吉围攻曼达尔加尔；约1468至1473年，重镇伦滕波尔堡转入哈达人之手。古吉拉特的巴哈杜尔·沙1532至1535年一度占据该堡，1568年拉奥·苏尔詹·辛格把伦滕波尔交给阿克巴，哈达人就此进入莫卧儿效力。1631年，皇帝沙贾汗拆分哈达领地，把科塔封给本迪的拉坦·辛格次子拉奥·马多·辛格，科塔后来居上，超过母邦。南方来的织工在凯通落户，织出轻薄带方格纹的科塔多里亚布；科塔细密画派为宫廷作画，马哈拉奥·比姆·辛格在巴哈杜尔·沙一世治下领有五千品级的曼萨卜。1771年起，扎利姆·辛格以幼主摄政的身份借昌巴尔河水整顿田赋、兴修水利，1817年使科塔接受英国保护。

en:
Thana, the old harbour of Shristhanaka, lies at the north-eastern end of Salsette Island, at the centre of a chain of North Konkan ports running through Mahim, Bombay and Bassein. Creeks wind between them and carry salt, timber, rice and cotton cloth out to sea. The Shilahara kings ruled the coast from the ninth century, and an inscription of 1094 already called their town a harbour active in import and export; the Yadavas and lords tied to Delhi followed before the Muzaffarid sultans of Gujarat took over. In 1444 the Gujarat sultan held a Marathi-speaking Hindu shore of fishermen, farmers and cotton fields, whose goods moved through the wharves of Thana and Bassein.

Portuguese raids in the early 1530s ended when Sultan Bahadur Shah signed a treaty aboard the galleon Sao Mateus on 23 December 1534, ceding Bassein, Bombay and the adjoining waters to Portugal. Bassein became the Corte da Norte, the Court of the North, seat of the Portuguese northern province, where Portuguese nobles built town houses and fifteen churches stood in its territory by the late seventeenth century. The seven islets of Bombay went another way. In 1661 they passed to England as part of Catherine of Braganza's dowry to Charles II; the East India Company leased the islands and in 1687 moved its chief western seat there from Surat. The Marathas took the older ports by force. Chimaji Appa's army stormed Thana and Salsette, and Bassein Fort surrendered on 16 May 1739 after a siege in which the Portuguese lost four ports, eight cities, 340 villages and twenty fortresses. Company troops occupied Salsette during the First Anglo-Maratha War and kept it by the Treaty of Salbai. On 31 December 1802 the peshwa Baji Rao II, driven from Poona, signed the Treaty of Bassein in the same fort and accepted British protection; the Maratha wars that followed ended with the British taking the whole coast in 1818.
zh:
塔那古称什里斯塔纳卡，位于萨尔塞特岛东北端，是北康肯一连串港口的中心，马希姆、孟买和巴塞因依次排列在这条海岸上。港湾之间水道纵横，盐、木材、稻米和棉布经此外运。希拉哈拉王朝从9世纪起统治这段海岸，1094年的铭文已把这里称作从事进出口的港口；其后是雅达瓦王朝和依附德里的首领，再由古吉拉特的穆扎法尔王朝苏丹接手。1444年，古吉拉特苏丹治下是一片说马拉地语的印度教海岸，渔民、农户和棉田的出产经塔那与巴塞因的码头外运。

16世纪30年代初的葡萄牙袭掠，以巴哈杜尔沙阿1534年12月23日在「圣马太号」大帆船上签约告终，巴塞因、孟买及邻近水域就此割让给葡萄牙。巴塞因成为葡属印度北方省的驻地，号为「北方宫廷」，葡萄牙贵族在此营建宅邸，到17世纪末辖区内已建起十五座教堂。孟买七岛另有去向。1661年，七岛作为布拉干萨的凯瑟琳嫁给查理二世嫁妆的一部分转归英国；东印度公司租下群岛，1687年把西海岸的首要驻地从苏拉特迁到孟买。马拉塔人以武力夺取这些旧港。奇马吉·阿帕的军队攻下塔那和萨尔塞特，巴塞因堡在围攻后于1739年5月16日投降，此役葡萄牙人失去四处港口、八座城市、340个村庄和二十座堡垒。东印度公司军队在第一次英国—马拉塔战争期间占领萨尔塞特，并凭《萨尔拜条约》保有此地。1802年12月31日，被逐出浦那的佩什瓦巴吉拉奥二世在同一座堡垒签订《巴塞因条约》，接受英国保护；此后的马拉塔战争以英国1818年夺取整个海岸告终。

en:
Dabhol commands the finest anchorage on the South Konkan coast, where the Vashishti River meets the Arabian Sea. Arab and Persian merchants had settled among its Marathi-speaking fishermen and farmers by the tenth century, and the port's mosques and merchant elders ran much of its own affairs. Ships from the Red Sea, the Persian Gulf and Ethiopia called here, landing horses from Arabia and Khorasan for the Deccan armies and taking on spices and textiles. Under the Bahmanis the town was named Mustafabad, the most convenient seaport for the court at Bidar, and at its height it was the leading Muslim port between Chaul and Goa. In 1444 wealthy Muslim merchants work its wharves while the hinterland stays Hindu and Marathi, with the Bahmani sultanate and Vijayanagara pressing in from both sides.

In 1453 Mahmud Gawan, later the Bahmani kingdom's great vizier, first landed at Dabhol to sell horses to the court; a few years later the Russian traveller Afanasy Nikitin found a large town with an extensive harbour. Its wealth drew the Portuguese. On 29 December 1508 the viceroy Francisco de Almeida, sailing to Diu, retaliated against the port for harassing his armada: his guns broke the double wooden wall and ditch, his men took the town in a pincer assault, then slaughtered the population and fired the streets before sailing on 5 January 1509, the fort untaken. In Indian memory the massacre stood with Vasco da Gama's burning of the Hajj ship Miri. The Portuguese returned several times, the last recorded attack in 1571 against the governor Khwaja Ali Shirazi. As the Bahmani kingdom split into Deccan sultanates with new capitals, Dabhol's roadstead lost its advantage and its trade drifted south to Rajapur. Shivaji took the town about 1660 for his Maratha kingdom, and his son Sambhaji later granted it and its revenues to Khando Ballal Chitnis, the courtier who had pulled him from a drowning river in Goa.
zh:
达布尔扼守瓦希什蒂河注入阿拉伯海的河口，是南康坎海岸最优良的锚地。早在10世纪，阿拉伯和波斯商人便定居于此，与讲马拉地语的渔民、农户杂处，港内的清真寺和商人长老在很大程度上自理港务。从红海、波斯湾和埃塞俄比亚驶来的船只在此靠岸，卸下阿拉伯和呼罗珊的战马供德干诸邦军队采购，再装上香料和布匹。巴赫曼尼时期此城称穆斯塔法巴德，是进出比达尔宫廷最便捷的海港，最兴旺时为焦尔与果阿之间首屈一指的穆斯林商港。1444年，富有的穆斯林商人经营码头，内陆乡邻仍是信奉印度教的马拉地人，巴赫曼尼苏丹国与毗奢耶那伽罗从南北两面夹着它。

1453年，日后成为巴赫曼尼名相的马哈茂德·加万首次在达布尔上岸，向苏丹宫廷兜售战马；几年后俄罗斯旅行家阿法纳西·尼基京到此，见到的是一座大城和宽阔的港湾。它的财富招来葡萄牙人。1508年12月29日，正驶往第乌的印度总督弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达以此港袭扰其舰队为由前来报复：炮火轰开双重木栅和壕沟，步兵两翼夹攻破城，随后屠戮居民、纵火焚街，1509年1月5日才登船离去，堡垒并未攻下。在印度人的记忆里，这场屠杀与瓦斯科·达·伽马烧毁朝觐船「米里号」相提并论。葡萄牙人后来又几度来犯，史籍记载的最后一次在1571年，对手是守将赫瓦贾·阿里·设拉子。巴赫曼尼王国分裂为另立新都的德干诸苏丹国后，达布尔的锚地失去地利，生意南移到拉贾布尔。约1660年希瓦吉为他的马拉塔王国取下此城；其子桑巴吉后来把达布尔连同赋税赐给近臣坎多·巴拉尔·奇特尼斯，以谢他在果阿一条河里把溺水的自己救起。

en:
North Kanara is the narrow strip where the forested Western Ghats drop straight into the Arabian Sea, a coast of river mouths and roadsteads: Bhatkal, Honnavar and the creeks of the Kali river. Arab traders, the Nawayath, settled its ports early and set up small Muslim chiefdoms there; when Ibn Battuta landed at Honnavar about 1342, he found a Muslim ruler and a busy pepper trade. Jain and Hindu chiefs of the Ghats, among them the lords of Haduvalli, held the hinterland, and with the break-up of Hoysala power the coast passed to Vijayanagara. In 1444 it is a valued edge of the empire: the pepper and cardamom of the rainy Ghat forests go out through Bhatkal, and Arab horses for the imperial cavalry come in over the same quays.

In 1479 imperial troops sacked Bhatkal and Honnavar, saying their merchants traded with the Bahmani sultans, but the ports stayed in Vijayanagara's sphere. A Portuguese fleet sacked Bhatkal in 1542, yet trade bent rather than broke. From 1552 the ports were ruled by the Jain queen Chennabhairadevi of Gerusoppa, whose pepper cargoes earned her the Portuguese name the Queen of Pepper; her reign ran fifty-four years to 1606, regarded as the longest of any queen in India, and in the wars of 1559 and 1570 she fought the Portuguese fleets to a standstill. Under the Keladi nayakas who inherited the coast, English traders opened a factory up the Kali at Kadwad in 1638, and Shivappa Nayaka drove the Portuguese out of Honnavar in 1653. Keladi fell to Hyder Ali of Mysore in 1763, and after Tipu Sultan's defeat the ports passed with the rest of the coast to the British in 1799.
zh:
北卡纳达是西高止山密林直插阿拉伯海之间的一条狭长海岸，河口与锚地星罗棋布：巴特卡尔、霍纳瓦尔，还有卡利河畔的港湾。阿拉伯裔的纳瓦亚特商人很早就定居各港，还建起过小的穆斯林酋长政权；伊本·白图泰约1342年在霍纳瓦尔登岸时，见到一位穆斯林统治者和繁忙的胡椒贸易。内陆由西高止山的耆那教与印度教首领把持，哈杜瓦利的领主便是其中之一；曷萨拉政权瓦解后，海岸归入毗奢耶那伽罗。1444年，这里是帝国珍视的海疆：湿润山林出产的胡椒和豆蔻从巴特卡尔出海，帝国骑兵所需的阿拉伯马也在同一批码头登岸。

1479年，帝国军队以商人私通巴赫曼尼苏丹为由洗劫巴特卡尔与霍纳瓦尔，但诸港依旧处在毗奢耶那伽罗势力范围内。1542年葡萄牙舰队劫掠巴特卡尔，贸易却只是受挫、并未断绝。1552年起，盖鲁索帕的耆那教女王琴娜巴伊拉黛薇统治这些港口，她外销胡椒数量巨大，葡萄牙人称她「胡椒女王」；她在位54年、直到1606年，被视为印度在位最久的女王，并在1559年和1570年的战事中力抗葡萄牙舰队，使其无法得逞。继承海岸的凯拉迪纳亚克王朝治下，英国商人1638年在卡利河上游的卡德瓦德开设商馆，希瓦帕·纳亚克1653年把葡萄牙人逐出霍纳瓦尔。1763年凯拉迪被迈索尔的海德尔·阿里攻灭；1799年蒂普苏丹战败，巴特卡尔、霍纳瓦尔连同整条海岸一并归入英国。

en:
Raichur is the fortress town at the centre of the Raichur Doab, the fertile wedge between the Krishna and the Tungabhadra whose silt and water make some of the best crop land in the Deccan. The first fort on the hill went up under the Kakatiyas of Warangal in 1294; an inscription names Raja Vithala as its builder, acting for Gona Gannaya, minister of Queen Rudrama Devi, and the Bahmanis later enlarged the walls. The doab was the prize of the long border war between the Bahmani sultans and Vijayanagara, whose armies came against the forts of Raichur and Mudgal again and again; after taking the town in 1363 the Bahmanis held it. In 1444 Raichur is their garrison town set in a Kannada-speaking Hindu countryside, facing the emperors beyond the Tungabhadra.

When the Bahmani kingdom broke up the fort passed to the Adil Shahi sultans of Bijapur in 1489. Krishnadevaraya conquered the doab for Vijayanagara in 1512 and won the decisive Battle of Raichur in 1520, driving the Bijapur army back across the Krishna; he marked the victory by raising the fort's north gate. Forty-five years later the confederate Deccan sultans destroyed Vijayanagara at Talikota in 1565 and Bijapur retook the doab. Aurangzeb's Mughals took Raichur in 1686, and from 1724 the district was held for the Nizam of Hyderabad. Its walls carry inscriptions in several languages, cut by the dynasties that garrisoned it in turn.
zh:
赖丘尔（中文维基译赖久尔）是赖丘尔河间地中心的要塞城镇。这片夹在克里希纳河与栋格珀德拉河之间的肥沃三角地，靠两河的淤泥和水源成为德干最好的农耕地之一。山上最初的城堡建于瓦朗加尔卡卡提雅王朝治下的1294年；铭文记载营建者为维塔拉王，他奉鲁德拉玛·德维女王的大臣戈纳·甘纳亚之命修城，后来巴赫曼尼王朝又扩建了城墙。河间地是巴赫曼尼苏丹国与毗奢耶那伽罗长期边境战争的争夺目标，赖丘尔和穆德加尔两堡一再遭到围攻；巴赫曼尼1363年取城后一直据守。1444年，赖丘尔是他们的驻军城镇，坐落在说卡纳达语的印度教乡野中，与栋格珀德拉河彼岸的帝国对峙。

巴赫曼尼王国解体后，要塞于1489年归比贾布尔的阿迪勒·沙希王朝。克里希纳德瓦拉亚1512年为毗奢耶那伽罗夺取河间地，又在1520年的赖丘尔战役中取得决定性胜利，把比贾布尔军队逐过克里希纳河；他还修筑城堡的北门以纪念这场胜利。四十五年后的1565年，德干诸苏丹联盟在塔利科塔摧毁毗奢耶那伽罗，比贾布尔夺回河间地。1686年奥朗则布的莫卧儿军队攻占赖丘尔；1724年起，这片地区由海得拉巴尼扎姆的手下管辖。城墙上留有多种语言的铭文，都是历代在此驻军的王朝所刻。

en:
The Mysore country is rolling upland south of the Kaveri. Above the fort-town of Mysore rise the Chamundi Hills, where the Wadiyar rajas worshipped their tutelary goddess Chamundeshwari; legend derives the name Mysore from the buffalo demon she slew on the hill. Around 1399 the chief Yaduraya founded the Wadiyar line there with the title wodeyar, 'lord', and in 1444 his successors still rule a small chiefdom of villages as feudatories of the Vijayanagara emperors. South-east of Mysore, at Ummattur near Yelandur, another line of palaigars holds an older fortified town: a thirteenth-century Jain basadi and garuda pillars stand before its Ranganatha temple, and the place is named in eleventh-century Jain inscriptions.

Krishnadevaraya's armies crushed the rebel palaigar of Ummattur between 1512 and 1514, and Chamaraja Wodeyar III built the fort of Mysore in 1524. After the Vijayanagara collapse at Talikota the Wadiyars struck out on their own. In 1610 Raja Wodeyar I took Srirangapatna from the emperor's governor, moved his court to the island and held Navaratri there, the nine-night feast of Chamundeshwari at which the state sword, weapons and elephants were displayed; every Wadiyar after him kept the festival as the rite of kingship. Chikka Devaraja added Bangalore and Salem before 1700. In 1761 the general Hyder Ali seized power, planted mulberry for silk and fought four wars against the British alongside his son Tipu Sultan, who fell defending Srirangapatna in 1799. The boy Krishnaraja Wodeyar III was restored, the court returned to Mysore, and the Dasara procession set out each autumn from the palace below Chamundi Hills.
zh:
迈索尔地方是高韦里河以南一片起伏的高原。迈索尔堡城背后矗立着查蒙迪山，瓦迪亚罗阇世代祭祀的保护神查蒙德斯瓦里神庙就在山顶；相传女神在山上诛杀牛魔，迈索尔的地名便由这位魔神而来。约1399年，首领亚杜拉亚在迈索尔开创瓦迪亚家族，取号「瓦迪亚」，意为领主；1444年，其后人仍作为毗奢耶那伽罗皇帝的藩臣，统治着由若干村落组成的小酋邦。迈索尔东南、耶兰杜尔附近的乌马图尔另有一支帕莱加尔，守着一座更古老的堡城：13世纪的耆那教天衣派寺院和嘉鲁达石柱立在朗加纳塔神庙前，11世纪的耆那教铭文已提到此地。

1512至1514年，克里希纳德瓦拉亚的大军讨平乌马图尔帕莱加尔的叛乱；1524年，查马拉贾·瓦迪亚三世修筑迈索尔堡。毗奢耶那伽罗在塔利科塔之战崩溃后，瓦迪亚家族自立门户。1610年，拉贾·瓦迪亚一世从帝国总督手中夺取塞林伽巴丹，把宫廷迁上河洲，并在岛上举行九夜节：祭祀查蒙德斯瓦里的九夜庆典上陈列国刀、兵器和象队，此后每一代瓦迪亚君主都把它当作王权仪式。奇卡·德瓦拉贾在1700年前后兼并班加罗尔和塞勒姆。1761年，将领海德尔·阿里夺权，种桑养蚕，并和儿子蒂普苏丹一道同英国四度开战；1799年蒂普在守卫塞林伽巴丹时战死。幼王克里希纳拉贾三世复位，宫廷迁回迈索尔，达萨拉节的队伍每年秋天从查蒙迪山下的王宫出发。

en:
Calicut, the City of Spices, faces an open roadstead on the Malabar coast. The Eradi lords of inland Nediyiruppu fought their way to this shore in the 13th century and moved their seat to the new port; their ruler took the title Samoothiri, which Europeans wrote as Zamorin. He kept the harbour open to ships buying pepper, ginger and other Malabar goods. Arab and Persian merchants lived around its bazaars, Muslim Mappila merchants ran much of the sea trade, and cotton cloth shipped from here gave English the word calico. Ibn Battuta visited six times in the 1340s and found merchants from many countries; Zheng He's Ming fleets also returned here, and Chinese sources place the admiral's death at Calicut in 1433. In 1444 the Zamorin was the strongest ruler on this coast, with chiefs north of Cochin acknowledging his overlordship and cargoes waiting in the anchorage.

Vasco da Gama landed near Kappad on 20 May 1498, and the Portuguese soon tried to turn the pepper trade into a controlled route. Their fleet destroyed the combined Mamluk, Gujarati and Calicut force at Diu in 1509, but the Zamorin's admirals, the four Kunjali Marakkars, organised prolonged naval defence along the Malabar shore between 1520 and 1600. A Portuguese fort built at Calicut in 1511 was gone by 1525, and Calicut troops stormed the Portuguese fort at Chaliyam in 1571. The Dutch East India Company signed its first treaty with an Indian ruler with the Zamorin in 1604, and Dutch forces helped clear the Portuguese from their Malabar strongholds in 1663. English and French factories followed in the same century.

The Zamorin's final defeats came by land. Travancore defeated his army at Purakkad in 1755, and when Hyder Ali of Mysore occupied Calicut in 1766, the reigning Zamorin set fire to his palace and died there. The peace of 1792 placed Malabar in British hands, and Calicut became the chief town of the British Malabar District.
zh:
卡利卡特又称「香料之城」，面朝马拉巴尔海岸的开阔锚地。13世纪，内陆内迪伊鲁普的埃拉迪领主打到这段海岸，把治所迁到新港口；其统治者采用「萨穆特里」称号，欧洲人写作「扎莫林」。他向收购胡椒、生姜和其他马拉巴尔货物的船只开放港湾，阿拉伯、波斯商人住在市肆周边，穆斯林马皮拉商人掌管大量海运，从这里运出的棉布还使英语有了「卡利科布」一词。伊本·白图泰在14世纪40年代六次到访，见到各国商人；郑和的宝船也曾多次停泊，中文史料把这位航海家1433年的去世之地记在卡利卡特。1444年，扎莫林已是这片海岸最强的统治者，科钦以北的酋长承认其宗主权，港湾中停满待运的货物。

1498年5月20日，瓦斯科·达·伽马在卡帕德附近登陆，葡萄牙人随即将胡椒贸易纳入受控航路。1509年，他们在第乌击溃马穆鲁克、古吉拉特和卡利卡特的联合舰队；但扎莫林的四代海军统帅昆贾利·马拉卡尔，在1520至1600年间沿马拉巴尔海岸长期组织海上抵抗。葡萄牙人1511年在卡利卡特筑堡，1525年前即已失去，1571年卡利卡特军队又攻破查利亚姆的葡军要塞。1604年，荷兰东印度公司与扎莫林签约，这是它同印度统治者订立的第一份条约；1663年，荷兰军队又协助把葡萄牙人赶出马拉巴尔各据点。英国和法国商馆也在同一世纪相继设立。

扎莫林最后的失败来自陆上。1755年，特拉凡哥尔在普拉卡德击败其军队；1766年迈索尔的海德尔·阿里占领卡利卡特时，在位的扎莫林纵火焚毁宫殿，自焚而死。1792年和议后，马拉巴尔落入英国之手，卡利卡特成为英属马拉巴尔县的首城。

en:
Kochi occupies a sheltered chain of lagoons and islands on the Malabar Coast. The Periyar flood of 1341 opened a harbour here as the old spice roadstead at Muziris silted up, and the Perumpadappu rulers moved their seat to the rising port. Arab, Chinese, Jewish, Syrian Christian and Malayali merchants dealt in pepper, and Chinese fishing nets introduced in the fourteenth century became a familiar sight along the water. Ma Huan described Kochi after sailing with Zheng He's fleets, and Niccolò da Conti visited in 1440. In 1444 the Hindu raja ruled a Malayalam-speaking trading state, while the Zamorin of Calicut had exploited quarrels among the royal branches, stripped away vassals and pressed on its northern approaches.

On 24 December 1500 Raja Unni Goda Varma welcomed Pedro Álvares Cabral and made Cochin Portugal's first ally on this coast. In September 1503 the raja allowed Afonso de Albuquerque to build Fort Emmanuel, the first European fort in Asia. Its first walls were double rows of coconut timber packed with rammed earth and protected by a water-filled ditch, and the Portuguese settlement behind them included St Francis Church. The fort's guns helped Cochin survive the Calicut siege of 1504. Vasco da Gama was buried in that church in 1524 before his remains were returned to Portugal. A Dutch fleet took Fort Cochin in 1663. Mysorean invasions after 1766 forced Cochin to pay tribute, British power displaced the Dutch in the 1790s, and the Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1814 placed Fort Kochi under British rule while the raja retained his inland state.
zh:
科钦位于马拉巴尔海岸一串受潟湖和岛屿掩护的水域。1341年培里亚尔河洪水冲出海口，古老香料港穆济里斯逐渐淤塞，佩鲁姆巴达普统治者把驻地迁往这座兴起的港口。阿拉伯、中国、犹太、叙利亚基督教和马拉雅拉姆商人在此交易胡椒，14世纪传入的中式吊网成为水边常见景象。马欢随郑和船队记录过科钦，尼科洛·达·孔蒂也在1440年到访。1444年，印度教罗阇统治着这个讲马拉雅拉姆语的贸易小国；卡利卡特扎莫林利用王族分支间的纷争，夺去其属国，并从北方施压。

1500年12月24日，罗阇乌尼·戈达·瓦尔马迎接佩德罗·阿尔瓦雷斯·卡布拉尔，使科钦成为葡萄牙在这片海岸的第一个盟友。1503年9月，罗阇准许阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克修建伊曼纽尔堡。这是亚洲第一座欧洲堡垒，最初的墙体以双排椰木夹住夯土，外有灌水壕沟，堡后聚落中建有圣弗朗西斯教堂。堡垒炮火帮助科钦挺过1504年卡利卡特的围攻。瓦斯科·达·伽马1524年在科钦去世，葬于这座教堂，遗骨后来才运回葡萄牙。1663年，荷兰舰队攻占科钦堡。1766年后的迈索尔入侵迫使科钦纳贡，英国势力在1790年代取代荷兰；1814年《英荷条约》把科钦堡划归英国统治，罗阇则保留内陆土邦。

en:
Madurai lies on the banks of the Vaigai, deep in the Tamil country, and for close on two thousand years it was the seat of the Pandyas. Their kings patronised the third Tamil Sangam, the assembly of Tamil poets, and the Meenakshi temple on the river drew pilgrims from across southern India; the second book of the Tamil epic Silappatikaram is set in the city's streets. The Cholas held Madurai through most of the 9th to 13th centuries, until a revived Pandya line made it their capital again. In 1311 Malik Kafur, the general of Alauddin Khalji, sacked the city on his raid into the far south, wrecked the Meenakshi shrine and carried its gold and jewels to Delhi, and the governors the sultan left behind broke away as the Madurai Sultans. The Vijayanagara prince Kumara Kampana overthrew their kingdom in 1378, brought the hidden idols back into the rebuilt temple, and his queen Gangadevi sang the campaign in her Sanskrit poem Madhura Vijayam. In 1444 Madurai is a southern governorship of Vijayanagara, a Tamil Hindu temple city living by weaving and the coastal trade.

In 1529 the emperor made Viswanatha Nayak governor of Madurai, and his house turned the office into a hereditary kingdom. Viswanatha fortified the temple and, with his minister Ariyanatha Mudaliar, added its hall of a thousand pillars; the Nayaks ruled the countryside through the palaiyakkarar military chieftains. Tirumala Nayak brought the court back from Tiruchirappalli in 1635, raised the great Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace, stopped his tribute to Vijayanagara and set the sultans of Golconda and Bijapur against the failing empire. From 1689 the regent Rani Mangammal kept the peace for fifteen years, building roads and pilgrim rest houses and paying the Mughal armies besieging Gingee. After a bitter succession quarrel the Arcot general Chanda Sahib swore his way into the Tiruchirappalli fort and seized the kingdom, ending Nayak rule in 1736; the widowed queen Meenakshi died by poison in his custody three years later, by traditional account. Madurai changed hands through the Carnatic Wars until the English East India Company annexed it to the Madras Presidency in 1801.
zh:
马杜赖位于韦加伊河畔，地处泰米尔之地腹地，近两千年间是潘地亚王朝的都城。潘地亚诸王赞助了第三届泰米尔桑伽姆诗人集会，河畔的米纳克希神庙吸引着南印度各地的香客；泰米尔史诗《脚镯记》的第二篇就以这座城的街巷为背景。9至13世纪的大部分时间里马杜赖在朱罗治下，其后复兴的潘地亚再次定都于此。1311年，阿拉乌德丁·卡尔吉的将领马利克·卡富尔南征至此，洗劫城市、捣毁米纳克希神庙，把金器珠宝掠往德里；苏丹留守的将领随后割据，建立马杜赖苏丹国。1378年，毗奢耶那伽罗王子库马拉·坎帕纳攻灭苏丹国，迎回藏匿的神像、重修神庙，王妃甘加黛维以梵语长诗《马杜拉之捷》（Madhura Vijayam）歌咏这场远征。1444年的马杜赖是毗奢耶那伽罗南部的一处总督辖地，一座以纺织和沿海贸易为生的泰米尔印度教圣城。

1529年，皇帝任命维斯瓦纳特·纳亚克为马杜赖总督，他的家族把这一职位变成世袭王国。维斯瓦纳特加固神庙，并在大臣阿里亚纳塔·穆达利尔主持下增建千柱厅；纳亚克诸王通过帕莱亚卡拉尔军事首领治理乡野。蒂鲁马拉·纳亚克1635年把宫廷从蒂鲁吉拉帕利迁回马杜赖，兴建宏伟的蒂鲁马拉·纳亚克宫，停止向毗奢耶那伽罗纳贡，并挑动戈尔康达与比贾布尔的苏丹去对付走向末路的帝国。1689年起，摄政的芒格玛尔女王主政十五年间维持安定，修筑道路和香客旅舍，并向围攻金吉的莫卧儿大军纳贡。继承之争激化后，阿尔科特将领昌达·萨希卜立誓进入蒂鲁吉拉帕利堡，随即夺权，于1736年终结纳亚克统治；守寡的米纳克希女王三年后在囚禁中服毒而死，这是传统的说法。卡纳提克战争期间马杜赖几度易手，1801年被英国东印度公司并入马德拉斯管区。

en:
Venad lay between the Western Ghats and the Arabian Sea, with its rulers at Quilon on Ashtamudi Lake. The roadstead was one of Malabar's oldest pepper ports: Arab, Persian, Chinese, Jewish, Syrian Christian and Malayali merchants had long done business there, and Chinese junks had called there for centuries. Ibn Battuta listed Quilon among the Indian ports he saw, and local tradition also places one of Saint Thomas's seven churches and an early mosque in the town. Ravi Varma Kulasekhara used the Pandya civil wars to lead Venad raids into the Tamil country in 1312-1316, while Deva Raya II of Vijayanagara received tribute from Kollam in 1426. In 1444 Venad was a Hindu, Malayalam-speaking coastal kingdom whose rulers lived on pepper trade and balanced stronger powers beyond the Ghats.

The Portuguese opened a trading post at Tangasseri in 1504 and built St Thomas Fort there in 1518 to cover their pepper purchases. In 1578 Quilon printed the Tamil Christian book Thambiran Vanakkam, the first book published in an Indian language. A Dutch force took the town and fort in 1661 and made Tangasseri the capital of Dutch Malabar. The English East India Company opened a factory at Vizhinjam in 1664 and built Anjengo Fort in 1695; resentment of the English connection helped bring on the Attingal attack of 1721. Marthanda Varma, ruling from 1729 to 1758, broke the regional nobles and reshaped Venad into Travancore. British forces took Quilon in 1795 and defeated Velu Thampi Dalawa's rising at the Battle of Quilon in 1809.
zh:
韦纳德位于西高止山脉与阿拉伯海之间，统治者驻在阿什塔穆迪湖畔的奎隆。这片锚地是马拉巴尔最古老的胡椒港之一，阿拉伯、波斯、中国、犹太、叙利亚基督教和马拉雅拉姆商人久已在此交易，中国帆船也已停泊数百年。伊本·白图泰曾把奎隆列入他见过的印度港口；当地相传，圣多马建立的七座教堂之一和一座早期清真寺都在城中。1312年至1316年，拉维·瓦尔马·库拉谢卡拉乘潘地亚内战，率军攻入泰米尔地区；1426年，毗奢耶那伽罗的德瓦·拉亚二世接受奎隆纳贡。1444年，韦纳德是一个印度教、马拉雅拉姆语的海岸王国，统治者依靠胡椒贸易，同时周旋于西高止山以东的强国之间。

1504年，葡萄牙人在坦加塞里开设贸易站，1518年又在当地修建圣多马堡，掩护胡椒采购。1578年，泰米尔语基督教著作《坦比兰·瓦纳卡姆》在奎隆印成，是第一本以印度语言出版的书。1661年，荷兰军队夺取城镇和堡垒，并把坦加塞里设为荷属马拉巴尔的首府。英国东印度公司1664年在维津詹姆开设商馆，1695年修建安金戈堡；对英国势力的不满推动了1721年的阿廷加尔袭击。1729年至1758年在位的玛尔坦达·瓦尔马打击地方贵族，把韦纳德改造为特拉凡哥尔。英军1795年占领奎隆，1809年在奎隆战役击败韦卢·坦皮·达拉瓦的起事。

en:
Kongu is the upland country west of the Tamil plain, where the Kaveri, Bhavani, Amaravati and Noyyal cut valleys through the Ghats. Its town of Karur was ancient Karuvur, a Chera seat on the road from the Malabar port of Muziris through the Palghat Gap to Arikamedu on the Coromandel coast. Excavations at Karur and Kodumanal have yielded Roman amphorae, coins, beads and traces of jewellery workshops, and Ptolemy described Karuvur as an inland trading centre. Cholas, Pandyas and Western Gangas held the country in turn before Vijayanagara arrived in the fifteenth century. In 1444 Kongu was a Tamil Hindu border country under Vijayanagara, valued for the Palghat road, river crossings and the cloth, gems and other goods moving between the two coasts.

After 1646 Nayak governors divided Kongu into palayams, whose military chiefs held forts beside the roads and fords. The kingdom of Mysore pressed into the country in the eighteenth century, and Karur passed back and forth during the Anglo-Mysore wars. British troops took the town for the third time in 1790, and after Tipu Sultan's defeat in 1799 Kongu was attached to the Madras Presidency. Karur fort remained a Company garrison until 1801, the year the Kongu chieftain Dheeran Chinnamalai fought in these hills during the Second Polygar War; he was hanged in 1805.
zh:
贡古是泰米尔平原以西的山地，高韦里河、巴瓦尼河、阿默拉沃蒂河和诺伊尔河在高止山中切出河谷。首府卡鲁尔古称卡鲁武尔，曾是哲罗人的要地；从马拉巴尔港口穆济里斯穿过帕尔加特山口、通往科罗曼德海岸阿里卡梅杜的商路经过这里。卡鲁尔和科杜马纳尔的发掘出土过罗马陶罐、钱币、珠饰和珠宝作坊遗迹，托勒密也曾把卡鲁武尔记为南印度内陆商镇。朱罗、潘地亚和西恒伽王朝先后统治此地，15世纪毗奢耶那伽罗势力进入。1444年，贡古是毗奢耶那伽罗治下的泰米尔印度教边地，价值在帕尔加特商路、各处渡口以及往来两海之间的布匹、宝石和其他货物。

1646年后，纳亚克总督把贡古划分为若干帕莱亚姆，军事首领在道路和渡口旁筑堡据守。18世纪，迈索尔王国不断压入此地，英迈战争中卡鲁尔反复易手。英军1790年第三次攻占该城；提普苏丹1799年战败后，贡古并入马德拉斯管辖区。卡鲁尔堡垒作为东印度公司驻军据点使用至1801年，就在这一年，贡古首领迪兰·钦纳马莱在第二次波利加尔战争中转战这些山地，后于1805年被处以绞刑。

en:
Tondainadu is the northernmost plain of the Tamil country, flat land of weaving villages and palm-fringed backwaters behind the Coromandel shore. Its seaward gate is Pulicat, the town on the long sandspit that walls a salt lagoon from the Bay of Bengal. Pallavas and Cholas ruled the plain in turn, the Madurai Sultans passed over it after the Pandya collapse, and Vijayanagara's generals secured it in the 1360s. In 1444 it is a prosperous Tamil province of Deva Raya II's empire: its cotton looms feed the coasting trade, and the Gajapati kings of Odisha press against the northern marches.

The frontier wars came in the next reign, when Kapilendra Deva's Gajapatis overran Udayagiri and Chandragiri in 1463; the general Saluva Narasimha won the country back and later seized the Vijayanagara throne for himself. Europeans then made Pulicat their own. The Portuguese opened a trading post in 1502; the Dutch drove them out and raised Fort Geldria, the first Dutch fort in India, in 1613. For most of the seventeenth century the town was the seat of the Dutch government on the Coromandel, shipping the cloth of more than a thousand inland looms to Batavia and minting copper coins for the eastern trade; from 1621 to 1665 its slavers also carried some 38,000 people taken on the Coromandel coast to the plantations of Java. After Vijayanagara fell, the coast passed to Golconda and then to the Nawabs of Arcot, and in 1760 the Carnatic Wars ended nearby when Eyre Coote defeated Lally at Wandiwash. British troops occupied Pulicat in 1795 and blew up Fort Geldria nine years later.
zh:
通代纳杜（Tondaimandalam）是泰米尔之地最北端的平原，科罗曼德海岸内侧是一片平地，遍布织村和椰林环抱的潟湖。平原面向大海的门户是布利格德（泰米尔语称帕扎韦尔卡杜），长沙洲把咸水潟湖与孟加拉湾隔开，城镇就坐落在沙洲上。帕拉瓦与朱罗两朝先后统治此地，潘地亚衰亡后马杜赖苏丹国一度席卷而过，14世纪60年代毗奢耶那伽罗的将领平定了平原。1444年，这里是德瓦·拉亚二世治下富庶的泰米尔省份：棉织机供养着沿海贸易，奥里萨的加贾帕提王则压迫着北方边境。

边境战争在下一朝爆发：卡皮伦德拉·德瓦的加贾帕蒂大军1463年攻陷乌德耶吉里和昌德拉吉里，将领萨卢瓦·纳拉辛哈收复故土，后来还自己夺取了毗奢耶那伽罗皇位。随后欧洲人把布利格德据为己有：葡萄牙人1502年开设商馆，荷兰人将其逐出，并在1613年建起印度第一座荷兰堡垒海尔德兰堡。17世纪的大部分时间里，此城是荷兰在科罗曼德的统治中心，上千架内地织机的布匹经此运往巴达维亚，还铸造铜币供应东方贸易；1621至1665年，这里的奴隶船又把约三万八千名从科罗曼德沿海掳来的人运往爪哇的种植园。毗奢耶那伽罗灭亡后，海岸先归戈尔康达，再属阿尔科特的纳瓦布；1760年，艾尔·库特在附近的万迪瓦什击败拉利，卡纳提克战争就此终结。1795年英军占领布利格德，九年后炸毁海尔德兰堡。

en:
Cuddalore is a Tamil roadstead on the Coromandel coast, where the Ponnaiyar and Kedilam rivers meet the sea through a tangle of backwaters; its Tamil name Kudalur means 'confluence'. A few miles up the shore lies Pondicherry. Roman traders knew an emporium here as Poduke, and beads and wine jars from the Mediterranean have been dug up at Arikamedu. Pallavas, Cholas and Pandyas held the coast in turn before Vijayanagara, whose vassals the Nayaks of Gingee governed it by the fifteenth century. In 1444 it is a string of fishing and weaving villages in Deva Raya II's empire, and its cloth moves down the estuaries to foreign shipping.

In 1608 Krishnappa Nayak of Gingee let the Dutch build at Devanampatnam, but Portuguese pressure on his Vijayanagara overlord made him revoke the grant. Francois Martin founded French Pondicherry on the same shore in 1674, and in 1690 the Maratha ruler Rajaram, besieged by the Mughals in Gingee, sold the half-built fort to the highest European bidder. Elihu Yale, the Welsh-born governor of Madras, bought it for the English and named it Fort St David after the patron saint of Wales; the sale covered every village within range of a cannon shot, the settlements known as the 'cannonball villages'. After Madras fell to the French in 1746, Fort St David became the British headquarters in south India and Dupleix's attacks were beaten off. Robert Clive was its governor when Lally stormed it in 1758; Eyre Coote retook it two years later after Wandiwash, and Pondicherry fell in January 1761. A French fleet put troops back into Cuddalore in 1782 and the garrison withstood a British siege in 1783, but in 1785 the fort passed back to the British and changed hands no more. Pondicherry, occupied again in 1793, was returned to France in 1814.
zh:
古达罗尔（泰米尔语名库达卢鲁，意为「汇流」）是科罗曼德海岸的泰米尔锚地，蓬奈亚尔河与凯迪拉姆河穿过纵横潟湖在此汇流入海，沿海岸北上不远便是本地治里。罗马商人早就知道此地有个叫波杜凯的商站，阿里卡梅杜还出土过地中海来的珠子和酒罐。帕拉瓦、朱罗、潘地亚先后据有这片海岸，其后归入毗奢耶那伽罗，到15世纪由封臣金吉纳亚克治理。1444年，这里是德瓦·拉亚二世帝国境内一串渔村与织村，布匹已顺着河口运上外洋商船。

1608年，金吉的克里什纳帕·纳亚克准许荷兰人在德瓦南帕特纳姆筑堡，葡萄牙人却向其宗主毗奢耶那伽罗施压，特许终被收回。1674年，弗朗索瓦·马丹在同一海岸建起法属本地治里；1690年，被莫卧儿大军围困在金吉的马拉塔君主拉贾拉姆把半成的堡垒卖给出价最高的欧洲人。生于威尔士的马德拉斯总督伊莱胡·耶鲁替英国人买下，以威尔士主保圣人之名称为圣大卫堡；交易把一炮射程内的村落尽数划给英方，这些村落后来被称作「炮弹村」。1746年马德拉斯陷敌后，圣大卫堡成为英国在南印度的总部，杜布雷的进攻被击退。1758年拉利攻陷堡垒时，堡督正是罗伯特·克莱夫；两年后艾尔·库特在万迪瓦什大捷后将其收复，本地治里也于1761年1月陷落。1782年法国舰队派兵重占古达罗尔，守军顶住了1783年的英军围攻，但1785年堡垒还是交还英国，再未易手。本地治里1793年再被占领，1814年归还法国。

en:
Vijayanagara, the City of Victory, occupied a granite stretch of the Tungabhadra around Hampi, already a Shaiva pilgrimage place around the Virupaksha temple. Harihara I and Bukka, commanders from the fallen kingdom of Kampili, founded the capital in 1336, by tradition with the guidance of the Sringeri sage Vidyaranya. Their Sangama dynasty used the river, ridges and tanks as defence against the Bahmani sultans to the north. Niccolò de' Conti, visiting about 1420, reckoned the walls and suburbs stretched for sixty miles. In 1444 Deva Raya II ruled from the city; his campaigns had reached Ceylon and drawn tribute from Pegu and Tenasserim, while renewed war with the Bahmanis in 1443 strained the frontier. The Persian envoy Abdur Razzak described seven layers of fortification and bazaars crowded with overseas merchants.

The capital reached its peak under Krishna Deva Raya of the Tuluva line, who reigned from 1509 to 1529. He defeated Ismail Adil Shah of Bijapur at Raichur in 1520, the same year Domingo Paes came with Goa traders and compared the well-supplied city with Rome. Foreign estimates put its population near half a million, making Hampi-Vijayanagara one of the largest cities in the world. Krishna Deva Raya raised the Vitthala and Krishna temple complexes, enlarged the waterworks, and wrote the Telugu poem Amuktamalyada; his court also gathered the eight Telugu poets called the Ashtadiggajas.

After his death, power passed to the regent Rama Raya. His interventions in Deccan wars brought Bijapur, Golconda, Ahmadnagar, Bidar and Berar into one coalition. At Rakshasi-Tangadi, usually called the battle of Talikota, on 23 January 1565, the allied army defeated the Vijayanagara forces and killed Rama Raya. The victors occupied the capital and looted and burned it for six months. The court fled to Penukonda; two years later Cesare Federici found empty houses where tigers and other wild animals were said to live. Colin Mackenzie's surveyors recorded the Hampi ruins in the early 19th century.
zh:
