It stands on the oldest branch of the Silk Road, the road along the desert's southern rim, and caravans carried the nephrite of its riverbeds east into China for two thousand years; Chinese lapidaries prized the white jade above all other stone. The oasis also wove carpets and atlas silk, and Xuanzang records how a Chinese princess, married to a Khotan prince, hid silkworm eggs and mulberry seed in her headdress and so took sericulture beyond the Chinese frontier. Khotan was once a fervently Buddhist Saka kingdom of some four hundred monasteries until the Kara-Khanid Turks under Yusuf Qadir Khan took the city around 1006 and made it Muslim; Marco Polo, passing through under Mongol rule, found a quiet people living by cotton, orchards and trade. In 1444 the Dughlat emirs, Mongol nobles long settled in the Tarim cities, held the oasis under the loose overlordship of Moghulistan.

In 1514 Sultan Said Khan drove out the Dughlat Mirza Abu Bakr and made Hotan one of the chief cities of his Yarkand Khanate, whose Chinggisid khans held the Tarim Basin for nearly two centuries while the White Mountain and Black Mountain khojas fought over its mosques and shrines. Galdan's Dzungars overran the khanate in 1680 and ruled the oasis through puppet khans and the Sufi orders. Qing armies broke the Dzungars in 1755, and in 1759, after putting down the revolt of the Khoja brothers, they stationed an imperial resident at Hotan; the white jade dug from the two rivers then went north as tribute to the Beijing workshops.
zh:
和阗是塔克拉玛干沙漠南缘的大绿洲，喀拉喀什河与玉龙喀什河（即墨玉河与白玉河）出昆仑山流入沙海。它在丝绸之路最古老的南道上，商队把河床里的软玉东运中原，两千年不绝；中国玉工最看重的便是其中的白玉。绿洲还织造地毯和艾德莱斯绸。据玄奘记载，一位远嫁和阗王子的中国公主把蚕种和桑籽藏在冠帽里带出边关，养蚕缫丝之法就此传入。这里曾是香火极盛的塞人佛教王国，境内约有四百座寺院，直到1006年前后优素福·卡迪尔汗率喀喇汗突厥攻取此城，使其改宗伊斯兰。马可·波罗在蒙古统治时期路过，看到居民安于棉花、果园和买卖，不好征战。1444年的和阗由久已定居塔里木诸城的蒙古朵豁剌惕异密统治，名义上臣属于蒙兀儿斯坦。

1514年，苏丹萨亦德汗赶走朵豁剌惕的米儿咱·阿巴·癿乞儿，和阗成为叶尔羌汗国的重镇之一。此后近两百年，成吉思汗后裔的汗据有塔里木盆地，白山派与黑山派和卓则为清真寺和圣墓争斗不止。1680年噶尔丹的准噶尔人攻灭汗国，借傀儡汗和苏菲教团统治这片绿洲。1755年清军击破准噶尔，1759年平定大小和卓之乱后，在和阗派驻办事大臣；两河挖出的白玉此后作为贡玉北上，进入北京的玉作。

en:
Qarqan, or Qiemo in Chinese, is an oasis on the southern rim of the Taklamakan, where the Cherchen River carries Kunlun meltwater out into the sands. The Han knew a kingdom here of 230 households, 1,610 people and 320 bearing arms; its orchards grew grapes, and caravans carried Khotan jade east along the southern route to Dunhuang. In 442 Bilong, king of Shanshan, fled here with half his people before the army of Juqu Anzhou, and Shanshan was thereafter ruled from Qiemo; the oasis and its river in time took their name, Cherchen or Qarqan, from the displaced kingdom. The Sui made the town a commandery in 609, but the streams feeding it shifted. When Xuanzang passed in 644 he wrote of Qiemo that 'a fortress exists, but not a trace of man', and the Tang called the place Boxian. Marco Polo crossed the province in the 1270s and found Muslim townspeople living by the road. In 1444 the oasis lay within the domains of the Moghul khan, a small pastoral halt between the Charklik and Khotan oases.

In 1514 Sultan Said Khan made the southern oases part of his new Yarkand Khanate. In Kashgaria the Black Mountain and White Mountain factions of the khojas feuded through the seventeenth century, and Qarqan changed masters with the rest of the desert's southern rim. In 1680 the Dzungar khan Galdan took Yarkand and turned the khanate into a client; around 1700 Tsewang Rabtan imposed direct Dzungar rule and no khan was left at Yarkand. Qing armies campaigning against the Khoja brothers reached Yarkand and Hotan in 1758 and 1759, and Qarqan passed with the rest of the southern route into the Qing Empire.
zh:
且末（维吾尔语称恰尔羌）是塔克拉玛干沙漠南缘的绿洲，车尔臣河引昆仑山雪水注入沙海。《汉书》记此为且末国，有二百三十户、一千六百一十口、胜兵三百二十人，地产葡萄等果木，商队沿南道把和阗美玉东运敦煌。442年，鄯善王比龙为避沮渠安周的兵锋，带着半数国人投奔且末，鄯善此后改从且末施政；日久，这片绿洲和旁边的大河也从流亡的鄯善国得名，称作车尔臣，也就是恰尔羌。609年隋朝于此设且末郡，但供养绿洲的河道后来改徙。644年玄奘路过，记且末「有城垣而无人烟」，唐代称这里为播仙。13世纪70年代马可·波罗经过这一地区，见到沿路而居的穆斯林居民。1444年，这片绿洲在蒙兀儿汗的疆域之内，是卡克里克与和阗诸绿洲之间一处畜牧为生的商队歇脚地。

1514年，萨亦德汗建立叶尔羌汗国，南路诸绿洲尽入版图。在喀什噶尔一带，和卓黑山派与白山派的争斗贯穿整个17世纪，且末也随沙漠南缘各地几度易主。1680年，准噶尔汗噶尔丹攻占叶尔羌，汗国沦为附庸；约1700年策妄阿拉布坦改行准噶尔直接统治，叶尔羌不再立汗。1758至1759年，清军征讨大小和卓，兵抵叶尔羌、和阗，且末随天山南路并入清朝版图。

en:
Aksu, 'white water' in Turkic, is the oasis watered by the river of that name on the northern edge of the Tarim Basin, where the northern Silk Road met the dangerous Muzart route, a glacier road across the Tian Shan into the Ili valley. Han annals knew the town as Gumo and listed copper, iron and orpiment among its products. The pilgrim Xuanzang, passing through in 629, called it Baluka; he noted fine cotton and hemp cloth sold to neighbouring oases, with tens of Sarvastivadin monasteries and more than a thousand monks. After the Chagatai realms split it became a Muslim Moghul land. In 1444 its Sunni Turki cultivators and weavers lived under Esen Buqa II, who kept his court at Aksu while rebuilding the loyalty of his amirs after years of aristocratic disorder.

Late in his reign Esen Buqa sheltered the fugitive sultans Kerei and Janibek, who afterwards founded the Kazakh Khanate. In 1514 the Chagatayid prince Sultan Said Khan overthrew the Dughlat lords of the western Tarim and founded the Yarkand Khanate, with Aksu among its chief cities. As khanal power weakened after the late sixteenth century, Aksu passed between appanage princes while Naqshbandi khojas overshadowed them. The White Mountain and Black Mountain factions fought from Kashgar and Yarkand and drew Kyrgyz tribes and the Dzungars into their wars. Galdan's army invaded in 1680 and set up puppet khans, and around 1700 Tsewang Rabtan ended the old Chagatayid line. Qing armies defeated the Dzungars in 1757 and posted an imperial agent at Aksu in 1758.
zh:
阿克苏在突厥语中意为「白水」，是塔里木盆地北缘、同名河流滋养的绿洲；塔里木盆地北侧的丝路在此接上木扎尔特路，那是一条翻越天山冰川、进入伊犁河谷的险路。汉代史籍称此城为姑墨，记其地产铜、铁和雌黄。629年玄奘路过时称其为跋禄迦，记下这里织的细棉布和麻布销往邻近绿洲，国内有数十所说一切有部寺院、僧徒千余人。察合台诸汗国分裂后，阿克苏成为穆斯林蒙兀儿人的领地。1444年，绿洲上种棉织布的逊尼派突厥语居民臣属也先不花二世；贵族多年纷争之后，他把汗廷设在阿克苏，重新争取诸异密的忠诚。

也先不花晚年收留了逃难的克烈与贾尼别克苏丹，二人后来建立哈萨克汗国。1514年，察合台系宗王萨亦德汗推翻杜格拉特部在塔里木盆地西部的统治，建立叶尔羌汗国，阿克苏是其主要城市之一。16世纪末以后汗权衰落，阿克苏在各个受封宗王之间转手，纳格什班迪派和卓的权势压过汗室。白山派与黑山派分别以喀什噶尔、叶尔羌为据点争斗，把吉尔吉斯诸部和准噶尔人卷入战端。1680年噶尔丹的军队入侵，扶立傀儡汗；约1700年，策妄阿拉布坦终结旧察合台汗统。1757年清军击败准噶尔，1758年向阿克苏派驻办事大臣。

en:
Beshbalik, the 'five cities' of Old Turkic and the Beiting of Chinese records, stood on an oasis at the northern foot of the eastern Tianshan. Its walls really did enclose five parts: an outer town, a ward at the northern gate, a western extension, an inner town and a small keep within. Tang China made it the headquarters of the Beiting Protectorate over the Western Regions, and the Uyghur kings of Qocho later kept it as a second capital; under Mongol rule the idiqut held the city with Altalun, a daughter of Genghis Khan, as his queen. Wars between the Yuan and Chagatai princes broke its caravan trade in the late thirteenth century, and renewed fighting in the early fifteenth left the walls derelict. The Ming envoy Chen Cheng, passing through in 1413, found the old court still giving its name to the whole country. In 1444 the ruins lay in the Muslim Moghul realm of Esen Buqa, and Ming records still called his polity Beshbalik, though no great city anchored the tract.

Esen Buqa used the northern Tianshan pastures to raid the Timurids, and after his death the Moghul lords divided between the courts of Turfan and Yarkand; in 1570 Yarkand captured the Turfan khan and brought the old Beshbalik line under its rule. Galdan's Dzungars took the oases in 1678 and held them until Qing armies conquered Dzungaria in 1755–1758. The Qing found the Beiting walls beyond repair, so they settled Green Standard troops on military farms nearby at Jimsar and in 1772 built a fresh fort, Kai'an Cheng, leaving the old five cities to the sand.
zh:
别失八里在古突厥语中意为「五城」，汉籍称北庭，坐落在东天山北麓的一片绿洲上。它的城垣确实由五部分组成：外城、北门一带的城厢、城西的延伸城、内城，以及内城中的小城。唐代以此为统辖西域的北庭都护府治所，后来高昌回鹘以它为陪都；蒙古统治时期，亦都护居于此城，他的可敦是成吉思汗的女儿。13世纪后期，元朝与察合台宗王连年交战，商路衰败；15世纪初战火再起，城垣就此荒废。明朝使臣陈诚1413年途经此地时，这座旧王庭的名字仍被用来称呼整个国家。1444年，故城处在也先不花所领的伊斯兰化蒙兀儿势力范围内，明代史籍仍把他的政权称作别失八里，但这片地方已没有大城作为中枢。

也先不花以天山北麓牧场为基地袭扰帖木儿王朝；他死后，蒙兀儿诸部分投吐鲁番和叶尔羌两庭。1570年，叶尔羌俘获吐鲁番汗，别失八里一系并入叶尔羌。1678年，噶尔丹的准噶尔军夺取这些绿洲，据守到1755至1758年清军征服准噶尔。清军发现北庭故城已无法修复，便在附近的济木萨派驻绿营兵屯田，1772年另筑恺安城，听任五城旧地没入荒沙。

en:
Hoboksar takes its name from the Hobok River and the long ridge of the Saur: in Mongol the river means 'sika deer', once numerous in its basin, and the ridge means 'horseback', after its straight crest. Saka, Xiongnu and Turkic camps had used the same grasslands before the Oirats. In 1444 the pastures belonged to the Oirat confederation led by Esen Taishi, who had succeeded his father Toghon in 1438 and ruled the Mongols with Taisun Khan as his figurehead. Hoboksar had no town, only seasonal camps whose sheep and horse herds moved between river and ridge.

Two centuries later a new Oirat power grew out of these camps. In 1636 Erdeni Batur united the Oirat tribes of northern Xinjiang and set his base here, and between 1639 and 1643 he built a castle five kilometres southeast of the present town, the fixed centre around which the Dzungar Khanate took shape. Qing armies destroyed the khanate in the wars of 1755-1758, and the pastures passed to the Tarbagatai councillor. In 1771 the Old Torghuts reached Hoboksar: fleeing Russian pressure on the Volga, Ubashi Khan's people had set out in January with all their herds, and of the estimated 150,000 to 400,000 who departed, perhaps 85,000 survived Kazakh raids, thirst and starvation to reach Dzungaria. The Qing settled the survivors here under their own banners, and in 1775 placed the Torghut North Road league and its two banners at Hoboksar.
zh:
和布克赛尔的名字来自和布克河与绵长的赛尔山：蒙语里河名意为「梅花鹿」，因流域曾经鹿群众多，山名则意为「马背」，取自平直的山脊。瓦剌人到来之前，塞种人、匈奴和突厥的营地都曾利用这片草场。1444年，这里属也先太师统领的瓦剌联盟；他1438年承袭父脱欢之位，立岱总汗为共主而实掌大权。和布克赛尔没有城镇，只有随季节在河与山之间转场的营地和牛羊马群。

两个世纪后，一个新的卫拉特政权从这些营地里兴起。1636年，巴图尔珲台吉统一新疆北部的卫拉特各部，在此设立大本营；1639年至1643年，他在今和布克赛尔东南五公里处修筑城堡，准噶尔汗国便围绕这个固定中心成形。1755年至1758年清军攻灭准噶尔，这片牧场转归塔尔巴哈台参赞大臣管辖。1771年，旧土尔扈特人抵达和布克赛尔：为躲避俄国在伏尔加河的压迫，渥巴锡汗的部众于1月带着全部牲畜启程，出发者约15万至40万人，熬过哈萨克人的袭掠和饥渴、抵达准噶尔时约存8.5万人。清廷将幸存者就地编旗安置，1775年又把土尔扈特北路盟及所属二旗设在和布克赛尔。

en:
Urumqi lies in a well-watered gap at the northern foot of the Tianshan, the pass between the Bogda Shan and the main Tianshan range joining the Dzungarian Basin to the Turpan Depression; its Oirat name means beautiful pasture. The Tang kept a garrison and tax post at Luntai here, on the northern route of the Silk Road, but after the Tang withdrawal the walled town disappeared, and for nearly a thousand years herdsmen and caravans used the crossing without a permanent city. In 1444 the country was the eastern edge of Esen Buqa's Moghulistan, grazing ground for Mongol herds and a staging point for caravans, not an oasis capital.

In the 1620s and 1630s the Khoshut Mongols pasturing here drifted off to Qinghai and Tibet in the wars that made the Dzungars masters of Dzungaria. Qing armies took the gap in 1755 and raised an earthen fort in 1758; banner garrisons, state farms and Chinese and Hui settlers followed, and within a few years the newcomers had opened more than five hundred shops. In 1763 the Qianlong Emperor named the walled town Dihua, and in 1772 a second town, Gongning Cheng, went up beside it for the Manchu garrison. The two lay side by side, Gongning Cheng holding the yamen and Dihua the markets. The scholar Ji Yun, exiled here under Qianlong, wrote his Ürümqi poems in the town and said its wine shops, with songs and dance every day, reminded him of Beijing.
zh:
乌鲁木齐位于天山北麓一处水草丰足的山口，博格达山与天山主脉之间的这条通道北连准噶尔盆地、南接吐鲁番洼地；其卫拉特语地名意为「优美的牧场」。唐代曾在此设轮台，驻军守护天山北麓的丝绸之路，向商队征税；唐势力退出西域后，有城墙的城消失了，此后近千年间，牧民和商队使用着这个山口，却没有固定的城市。1444年，这里是也先不花蒙兀儿势力的东缘，是蒙古人的牧场和商队歇脚地，而不是绿洲都城。

1620至1630年代，在准噶尔部雄踞准噶尔盆地的混战中，游牧于此的和硕特蒙古人陆续迁往青海和西藏。1755年清军夺取山口，1758年筑起一座土城；旗营、屯田和汉民、回族移民随后到来，没几年新来者开出的商铺就超过五百家。1763年，乾隆帝赐城名迪化；1772年，城旁又筑巩宁城驻扎满营。两城并立，巩宁城驻衙门，迪化城开市集。被贬到此的学者纪昀在这里写下《乌鲁木齐杂诗》，他说城中酒肆遍布、天天有歌舞，让他想起京城。

en:
Tannu Uriankhai fills the forested basin between the Sayan Mountains and the Tannu-Ola, where the Yenisei headwaters gather. Tuvan camps lived by reindeer, fishing, stock raising and fur hunting in the northern woods. The Mongol name Uriankhai meant the 'people living in the woods,' and the furs they took made the cold basin useful to outside lords. After the Yuan withdrawal from Mongolia, Oirat leaders drew the headmen into their confederation. In 1444 the camps belonged to the Oirat world, sending furs and service through local Tuvan and Mongol nobles rather than supporting a town or garrison.

Oirats, eastern Mongols and the Khotogoit Altan khans contested the basin for the next two centuries, and Dzungar lords later controlled it. Many Tuvans joined Amursana's rising against the Qing in 1755 and then fought under the Khotogoit prince Chingünjav in 1756 and 1757. After the Dzungar collapse in 1758, Qing authorities placed Tannu Uriankhai under the Uliastai military governor and organized its people into five banners and subordinate sumu companies. Local nobles delivered furs and livestock for the new administration, which still governed the basin in 1821.
zh:
唐努乌梁海位于萨彦岭与唐努乌拉山之间的森林盆地，叶尼塞河上游诸水在此汇合。图瓦人的营地依靠驯鹿、捕鱼、放牧和在北部森林猎取毛皮为生。蒙古语中的乌梁海意为「林中百姓」，他们出产的毛皮也使外部领主看重这片寒冷盆地。元朝势力退出蒙古后，瓦剌首领把各部首领拉入自己的联盟。1444年，这些营地属于瓦剌世界，通过图瓦与蒙古本地贵族献纳毛皮、承担差役，并不供养城镇或驻军。

此后两个世纪，瓦剌、东蒙古与和托辉特阿拉坦汗反复争夺这一盆地，准噶尔领主后来控制了此地。1755年，许多图瓦人参加阿睦尔撒纳反清，1756年至1757年又随和托辉特王公青衮杂卜作战。1758年准噶尔败亡后，清廷把唐努乌梁海划归乌里雅苏台定边左副将军管辖，将部众编为五旗及若干佐领。本地贵族为新衙门交送毛皮和牲畜，到1821年，这套治理方式仍在盆地施行。

en:
The Kherlen rises in the Khentii mountains and winds 1,254 kilometres east across the steppe to Hulun Lake. At its confluence with the Tsenker stood Avarga, the first camp-capital of the Mongols: Temüjin took it from the Jurkin clan and kept his ordus and stores there, his wife Börte held the camp while he marched on Khwarazm, and goods from across the empire passed through its warehouses until the court moved to Karakorum; under Kublai the camp became a shrine to Genghis Khan. On 23 September 1409 a Ming army under Qiu Fu crossed the river after a feigned Mongol retreat and was destroyed west of the Onon, and the Yongle Emperor led his own army across these pastures the next year. In 1444 the Kherlen grasslands belong to the eastern Mongols of the Great Khan Toghtoa Bukha, while real power lies with his Oirat taishi Esen.

After Esen was killed in 1455 the Mongols fell back into factional strife until Batumöngke, enthroned as Dayan Khan in 1480, reunited the tribes and gave the Khalkha tümen to his son Gersenji, whose descendants ruled these valleys as the Tüsheet and Setsen khans. In 1688 Galdan's Dzungars overran Khalkha; checked at Ulan Butung in 1690, he kept his camp on the upper Kherlen for years, and the Khalkha khans who had fled south submitted to the Kangxi Emperor at the Dolon Nor assembly in 1691. On 7 June 1696 the Kangxi Emperor reached the Kherlen with the middle-route army to find Galdan already gone; the khan fled west, and five days later his army was destroyed at Jao Modo by the western-route force under Fiyanggu. The Kherlen pastures were then divided into Khalkha banners under Qing rule.
zh:
克鲁伦河发源于肯特山，向东蜿蜒1254公里，横贯草原注入呼伦湖。克鲁伦河与僧库尔河汇流处的曲雕阿兰，是蒙古人最初的游牧都城：铁木真从主儿乞部手中夺得此地，在此安置斡耳朵和辎重；他西征花剌子模时，妻子孛儿帖留守大营，帝国各路货物在营中仓廒集散，直到汗廷迁往和林，忽必烈时这里又成了祭祀成吉思汗的祠庙。1409年9月23日，丘福率领的明军被蒙古佯败诱过克鲁伦河，在鄂嫩河以西全军覆没，次年明成祖亲率大军穿过这片草原。1444年，克鲁伦草原属于大汗脱脱不花治下的东蒙古，真正掌权的是他的瓦剌太师也先。

1455年也先被杀，蒙古再度陷入纷争，直到1480年巴图蒙克即达延汗位，重新统一诸部，把喀尔喀万户封给儿子格哷森札，其后人以土谢图汗、车臣汗之名统治这些河谷。1688年，噶尔丹率准噶尔军攻入喀尔喀；1690年他在乌兰布通受阻，此后多年把营帐扎在克鲁伦河上游，南逃的喀尔喀诸汗则于1691年在多伦诺尔会盟，向康熙帝归附。1696年6月7日，康熙率中路大军进抵克鲁伦河，噶尔丹已经西逃；五天后，其部众在昭莫多被费扬古率领的西路清军击溃，克鲁伦草原随后被划作清朝治下的喀尔喀各旗。

en:
Kobdo is the high country between the Govi-Altai ranges and the basin of the Khovd River, whose snowmelt runs from Tavan Bogd down to Khar-Us Nuur. Its valleys and semi-desert pastures were Oirat country, where herds of horses, sheep and camels moved between seasonal grazing grounds and the western Mongols followed the Tengri cult. In 1444 these pastures belonged to Esen Taishi, the de facto ruler of all the Mongols, who five years later captured the Zhengtong Emperor of Ming China at Tumu.

Esen was killed in 1455 and Oirat power collapsed for two centuries. Galdan restored it as Boshogtu Khan of the Dzungar, whose armies raided from the Tarim oases to the Kazakh steppe. He founded a settled town on the Khovd River in 1685, setting Taranchi and Central Asian captives to work in its gardens and fields. His army was destroyed at Zuunmod in 1696, and the next spring he took poison in the Altai near Khovd, with only some three hundred followers left. Qing garrisons then secured the country: a fort went up on the Khovd in 1730, and after the Dzungar collapse of the 1750s the town became the seat of the councilor governing the Kobdo banners. Floods wrecked the old riverside site, and in 1767 a new walled town was built on the Buyant River, where Qing troops, tribal banners and Altai caravans met.
zh:
科布多是戈壁阿尔泰山与科布多河流域之间的高地，科布多河汇塔万博格多山的雪水，注入哈尔乌苏湖。河谷和半荒漠牧场是瓦剌人的地方，马、羊、骆驼随季节转场，西蒙古人信奉腾格里。1444年，这些牧场属于总领全蒙古的也先太师；五年后，他在土木堡俘虏了明英宗。

也先1455年被杀，瓦剌的势力中落了两百年。噶尔丹重建西蒙古，成为准噶尔的博硕克图汗，兵锋从塔里木盆地的绿洲伸到哈萨克草原。他1685年在科布多河畔建起定居城镇，把塔兰奇和中亚俘虏安置在城郊的园圃和田地劳作。1696年昭莫多一战其军被歼，次年春他在科布多附近的阿尔泰山中服毒自尽，身边只剩约三百人。清朝随后在此经营：1730年在科布多河畔筑城设垒，18世纪50年代准噶尔败亡后，此城成为统辖科布多各旗的参赞大臣驻地。旧城遭洪水冲毁，1767年在布彦特河畔另筑带城墙的新城，清军、盟旗和阿尔泰山的商队都在此往来。

en:
The Chigestai and Bogdiin rivers meet in a mountain-girt valley west of the Khangai, high grazing country whose Mongol name Uliastai means 'place with poplars'. In 1444 there was no garrison town here, only seasonal camps: the Zavkhan basin was pasture of the Four Oirats, whose confederation Toghon had built and whose armies his son Esen now led in the name of the Taisun Khan. Esen had already taken Hami and overawed the Mongol principalities of Gansu, and the sheep, horses and camel trains of these valleys moved at his bidding. Five years later he carried the war against the Ming to the Great Wall, destroyed the imperial army at Tumu Fortress and led the captured Zhengtong Emperor into Mongolia. His supremacy did not outlive him: killed in a succession feud, he left the Oirat hold on the Khangai loosened.

In the sixteenth century Khalkha lords moved into these pastures. The Sain Noyon house descended from Tümengken, who won his title through patronage of the Gelug order. When Galdan invaded in 1688 the Khalkha submitted to the Qing, and the Sain Noyon banners returned to their grazing grounds after the Dzungar defeat of 1696. In 1725 the Qing detached their banners from the Tüsheet Khan domain to form Sain Noyon aimag. In 1733 they built the Uliastai fortress as a base for the Khalkha prince Tsereng, who had routed a Dzungar army near Erdene Zuu the year before; Tsereng became its first military governor, and at its height the garrison held some 3,500 men, with a Chinese trading quarter outside the walls. In 1755 the army that marched from here joined the Qing's final conquest of the Dzungar khanate. Uliastai remained the seat of the general commanding the Sain Noyon, Zasagt and Tannu Uriankhai lands, linked by camel routes to Urga, Khovd, Barkol and Hohhot.
zh:
奇盖斯泰河与博格丁河在杭爱山西侧群山环抱的河谷相会，这里是高寒牧场，蒙古语地名乌里雅苏台意为「有杨树的地方」。1444年这里还没有军城，只有逐季迁徙的营地：扎布汗河流域是四卫拉特的牧地，脱懽建立的联盟此时由其子也先借岱总汗之名统军。也先已夺下哈密、震慑甘肃的蒙古诸部，山谷间的羊群、马群和驼队都听其调遣。五年后他把对明朝的战争打到长城脚下，在土木堡歼灭明军，将正统皇帝俘入蒙古。但他的霸权没能随他活下来：他在继承权内斗中被杀，瓦剌对杭爱山的控制随之松动。

16世纪，喀尔喀贵族进入这片牧场。赛音诺颜一支出自图蒙肯，他因护持格鲁派而得此称号。1688年噶尔丹入侵，喀尔喀投附清朝，1696年准噶尔战败后，赛音诺颜各旗返回旧牧地。1725年，清朝将其旗分从土谢图汗领地析出，设立赛音诺颜部。1733年，清军筑乌里雅苏台城，作为喀尔喀亲王策棱的驻地——此前一年他刚在额尔德尼召附近大败准噶尔军；策棱为首任定边左副将军，军城极盛时驻兵约三千五百人，城外还有汉人商肆的买卖城。1755年，自军城出发的军队参加了清朝攻灭准噶尔汗国的最后一战。此后乌里雅苏台一直是统辖赛音诺颜部、札萨克图汗部和唐努乌梁海的将军驻地，驼道东连库伦，西接科布多、巴里坤和归化城。

en:
The eastern Gobi is a waste of gravel plains and dry watercourses without a river. Herders live on wells and groundwater, moving sheep, horses and Bactrian camels from camp to camp through sandstorms and the winter blizzards that blow off the plateau. These pastures formed the southern flank of the Eastern Mongols. In 1444 Borjigin taijis of the young Khalkha grouping grazed the desert edge, and the camps still worshipped Tengri; the Ming wall and its garrisons lay far beyond the sands to the south.

Dayan Khan enrolled the Khalkha among the three left-wing tümen, and the descendants of his son Gersenje later ruled as the Tüsheet, Zasagt and Setsen khans; Tibetan Buddhism spread among them from the later sixteenth century. In 1688 Galdan's Dzungars overran the Khalkha and the khans crossed this desert with their fleeing herds, and at Duolun in 1691 they submitted to the Kangxi Emperor, whose armies broke Galdan at Jao Modo in 1696. Under Qing rule the wells of Dzamiin Üüde, the 'road's gate', served the caravans where the silk, tea and princess roads crossed the southern Gobi: the station kept relay horses and a frontier watch, and the district belonged to the Govi Mergen Van banner of the Tüsheet Khan aimag. In 1820 the poet-monk Danzanravjaa, fifth of the Noyon Khutagt lineage, founded the Red Hat Khamar Monastery near Sainshand, on the eastern edge of the same desert.
zh:
东戈壁是一片没有河流的荒漠，砾石滩之间布满干河道。牧人靠井水和地下水过活，赶着羊、马和双峰驼逐井移牧，熬过沙暴和从高原上扑来的冬季风雪。这片牧场是东蒙古人的南翼。1444年，初兴的喀尔喀部孛儿只斤台吉们在沙漠边缘游牧，营地里的人仍信奉腾格里；南面沙海尽头之外，才是明朝的边墙和驻军。

达延汗把喀尔喀编为左翼三个万户之一，其子格哷森札的后裔后来分衍出土谢图汗、札萨克图汗和车臣汗三支，藏传佛教从16世纪后期起在他们中间传播。1688年噶尔丹的准噶尔军攻陷喀尔喀，诸汗带着逃荒的畜群越过这片戈壁，1691年在多伦向康熙帝称臣；1696年清军在昭莫多大破噶尔丹。清代，意为「道路之门」的扎门乌德诸井是南戈壁商道的穿漠之地：丝绸之路、茶道和古道「公主路」都从这里穿过，驿站在此换马、设兵巡边，这一带隶属土谢图汗部的戈壁墨尔根王旗。1820年，诺因呼图克图五世、诗僧丹津拉布贾在同一片沙漠东缘的赛音山达附近创建红教哈玛尔寺。

en:
The Setsen lands are the grasslands of the lower Kherlen, at the far eastern end of the Khalkha steppe: broad pastures watered by the Kherlen and its tributaries, where herdsmen graze horses, cattle and sheep. This is Genghis Khan's own country. At Avarga on the Kherlen he set up his first ordo after taking the pastures from the Jurkin; his family kept camp there while he campaigned in Khwarezm, and the goods of the early empire were collected and shared out there before Karakorum drew the court west. In 1444 the clans here pastured their stock under the Chinggisid khan Taisun, while the armed power of the eastern Mongols belonged to his Oirat taishi Esen, who five years later captured the Ming emperor in person at Tumu.

In the sixteenth century the northern Khalkha spread into these pastures, and early in the seventeenth Sholoi, a descendant of Dayan Khan's son Gersenji, took the title Gegeen Setsen Khan, after which the country was called the Setsen Khan's aimag. From 1638 his house sent the Manchu court the annual 'nine whites', eight white horses and one white camel. When Galdan's Dzungars overran Khalkha in 1688, the Setsen Khan's household and more than a hundred thousand households fled south across the Gobi and submitted to the Kangxi Emperor. At the Dolonnur assembly of 1691 the Khalkha entered the Qing order, and the Setsen pastures became the eastern route of the Khalkha banners, whose lords gathered every three years at Kherlen Bars on the river.
zh:
格根车臣是车臣汗部的牧地，位于喀尔喀草原最东端的克鲁伦河下游：克鲁伦河及其支流滋养着辽阔牧场，牧民在此放牧马、牛、羊。这里也是成吉思汗自己的故土。他从主儿乞部手中夺得这片草原后，在克鲁伦河畔的曲雕阿兰（阿布拉格）建立最早的斡耳朵；西征花剌子模时家眷仍留营于此，帝国早期的货物也在此汇聚分发，后来汗廷才西迁哈拉和林。1444年，此地部众在成吉思汗后裔岱总汗治下游牧，而东蒙古的兵权掌握在卫拉特太师也先手中；五年后，也先在土木之变中生俘了明朝皇帝。

16世纪，外喀尔喀诸部进入这片牧场；17世纪初，达延汗之子格哷森札的后裔硕垒称格根车臣汗，这片土地遂称车臣汗部。1638年起，其家族每年向清廷进献「九白」：八匹白马加一匹白驼。1688年噶尔丹的准噶尔军攻入喀尔喀，车臣汗家族率十万余户南下越过戈壁，归附康熙皇帝。1691年多伦诺尔会盟，喀尔喀纳入清朝秩序，车臣汗牧地被编为喀尔喀东路诸旗，部中领主每三年到克鲁伦河畔的巴尔斯城会盟一次。

en:
The Jirem steppe runs from the Nen and Tao'er rivers south to the Western Liao, its streams fattening the herds of the Nen Khorchin, who count themselves descendants of Khasar, Genghis Khan's brother. The Ming enrolled their forebears in the Fuyu Guard, one of the Three Uriankhai Guards set up in 1389. After the Oirats killed their khan Adai in 1438 the tribe drifted south, and in 1444 it grazed along the Nen and Onon under no strong lord; its surest tie to the settled world was the horse trade on the Ming border.

The Khorchin rode with Dayan Khan in his wars to reunite the eastern Mongols, and early in the Jiajing reign their chief Kuimuk Tasikhar led the left wing from the Onon and Argun to the Nen, absorbing the Jalaid, Dorbod and Gorlos. In 1624, pressed by Ligdan Khan of the Chahar, their chief Oba submitted to Nurhaci, the first Mongol leader to join the Later Jin, and Khorchin cavalry later fought in the Qing's wars. Marriage bound the alliance as firmly as war: one Khorchin chiefly family gave Hong Taiji his empress Xiaoduan, her niece Harjol, his favourite consort, and Harjol's younger sister Bumbutai. As Empress Dowager Xiaozhuang, Bumbutai had her young son Fulin placed on the throne after Hong Taiji died, held the court together through the regency of Dorgon, and as grand empress dowager backed the boy emperor Kangxi against the overmighty regent Oboi and through the Revolt of the Three Feudatories, when she gave her own savings to reward the armies. In 1636 the Qing organised the Khorchin into five banners, later six, and ten with the Jalaid, Dorbod and Gorlos; in the Kangxi reign their chiefs assembled at Jirem Mountain, which gave the league its name.
zh:
哲里木草原北起嫩江、洮儿河，南抵西辽河，众多河流滋养着连片牧场，放牧的是嫩科尔沁人。他们自认是成吉思汗之弟拙赤合撒儿的后裔，明初其先人被编入1389年设立的兀良哈三卫之一的福余卫。1438年可汗阿台被瓦剌人杀死后，部众向南流散；1444年时，他们游牧于嫩江与鄂嫩河之间，没有强主，和定居世界最稳的联系是明边的马匹互市。

科尔沁人曾随达延汗参加统一东蒙古的战事。明嘉靖初年，首领奎蒙克塔斯哈喇率左翼从鄂嫩河、额尔古纳河迁到嫩江流域，收服扎赉特、杜尔伯特、郭尔罗斯等部。1624年，因受察哈尔林丹汗逼迫，首领奥巴归附努尔哈赤，成为最早投向后金的蒙古部落，科尔沁骑兵后来也随清军出征。除了征战，联姻同样把双方绑在一起：科尔沁一个首领家族出了三位嫁给皇太极的后妃，孝端文皇后、她的侄女海兰珠（皇太极最宠爱的宸妃），以及海兰珠的胞妹布木布泰。布木布泰即孝庄文皇后：皇太极死后，她促成幼子福临继位，是为顺治帝，又在多尔衮摄政期间稳住朝局；尊为太皇太后以后，她辅佐年幼的康熙帝扳倒鳌拜，三藩之乱时还拿出自己的积蓄犒赏前线。崇德元年（1636年），清廷把科尔沁编为五旗，后来增为六旗，连同扎赉特、杜尔伯特、郭尔罗斯共十旗；康熙年间，各旗首领在哲里木山会盟，盟名便得自这座山。

en:
Xilin Gol is the grassland basin of the Xilin River and its seasonal streams on the Mongolian Plateau, horse and cattle country between the northern steppe and the Great Wall. Its most famous ground stands on the Luan: Shangdu, the summer capital Kublai Khan had his minister Liu Bingzhong lay out as Kaiping from 1256, with a walled palace city of marble and lacquered timber, parks and hunting grounds, and more than 100,000 people at its height. Marco Polo, who came around 1275, described the gilt marble halls and a portable cane palace that could be dismantled and carried away. Ming troops took and sacked the city in 1369; a garrison briefly kept the name Kaiping until the Ming withdrew behind the Wall, and by 1444 the empty walls stood in pasture grazed by Mongol herds.

Dayan Khan placed these grazing lands in the Mongol left wing, and they later belonged to the Chakhar tribes. As the Qing brought Inner Mongolia under their rule, ten banners of the Ujumchin, Khaughit, Abaga, Abganar and Sonid were set up between 1641 and 1667. In 1691 the Kangxi Emperor met the three Khalkha khans and more than five hundred lords at Dolon Nor in the south-east of these grasslands, and the Khalkha submission made there placed Outer Mongolia under Qing suzerainty. The ten Inner Mongolian banners held their own joint assembly at Khurkhaya in 1702. When the Qing revived these assemblies in 1728, the lords met on the northern bank of the Xilin, and the league took its name Xilin Gol from the river.
zh:
锡林郭勒是蒙古高原上锡林河等季节性河流滋养的草原盆地，夹在北方草原与长城之间，以牧马和养牛为生。这里最有名的地方在滦河河畔，就是上都。1256年起，忽必烈命大臣刘秉忠在此营建开平，后来升为上都，作为元朝夏都；城中有大理石与漆木构筑的宫城、园林和猎场，极盛时人口超过十万。约1275年到访的马可·波罗曾记述鎏金大理石殿，还有一座可以拆卸搬走的竹宫。1369年明军攻克并焚毁上都，一度设开平卫戍守，随后撤入长城以内；到1444年，空余的城垣立在蒙古牧人的牧场之间。

达延汗把这片牧地编入蒙古左翼，后来归属察哈尔诸部。清朝收服漠南蒙古后，1641年至1667年间陆续设立乌珠穆沁、浩齐特、阿巴噶、阿巴哈纳尔、苏尼特五部十旗。1691年，康熙帝在这片草原东南的多伦诺尔会见喀尔喀三汗和五百余名贵族，喀尔喀在会上归附，外蒙古就此归入清朝统辖。1702年，漠南这十旗在呼尔哈哈雅会盟。1728年清廷恢复会盟时，诸旗会于锡林河北岸，盟便以河得名，称锡林郭勒。

en:
Hulunbuir takes its name from the two great lakes of its steppe, Hulun and Buir, where the forests of the Greater Khingan meet the grasslands in the far northeast of Inner Mongolia. It has long been Mongol pasture: Temujin fought several of the decisive campaigns of his unification wars on this grassland, and after he took the title Genghis Khan he granted the country to his brothers; under the Yuan it was the appanage of the Prince of Qi. In 1388 the Ming general Lan Yu surprised the Northern Yuan khan Togus Temur beside Buir Lake, captured his camp and family and scattered his horde, and the khan was killed soon afterwards as the steppe tribes fell back on their old feuds. In 1444 Mongol herdsmen moved their camps with the seasons between the lakes and the Argun River, owning no master but their own chiefs.

The rising Later Jin conquered the Hulunbuir tribes in the early seventeenth century and enrolled them in the Eight Banners, and under the Kangxi emperor the country passed to the new Heilongjiang military government, facing the Russians across the Argun. To hold that river line the Qing in 1734 raised a walled city on the left bank of the Yimin and named it Hulunbuir after the two lakes. A vice commander-in-chief governed from it the Solon and New Barga mounted banners and the Oolot garrison, and for the rest of the dynasty the grassland kept its cavalry in readiness for the Qing's wars while its herds moved along the old seasonal rounds.
zh:
呼伦贝尔得名于草原上的呼伦湖与贝尔湖，地处内蒙古最东北，大兴安岭林海与草原相接于此，自古是蒙古人的牧场。铁木真统一蒙古诸部时，几次决定性的大战就打在这片草原上；称成吉思汗之后，他把这片土地分封给诸弟，元代这里是齐王的封地。1388年，明将蓝玉在贝尔湖边突袭北元可汗脱古思帖木儿，俘获可汗的营帐和家眷，击溃其部众，可汗不久败亡，草原诸部重新陷入纷争。1444年，蒙古牧人的营地随季节在两湖与额尔古纳河之间转场，只听命于各自的首领。

17世纪初，兴起的后金征服呼伦贝尔各部，将部众编入八旗；康熙年间这一带归新设的黑龙江将军管辖，与俄人隔额尔古纳河相望。为镇守这条河界，清廷于1734年在伊敏河左岸筑城，以呼伦、贝尔两湖命名为呼伦贝尔城。呼伦贝尔副都统驻在城中，统辖索伦八旗、新巴尔虎八旗和厄鲁特兵，终清一代，草原骑兵随时听调出征，牧群则依旧沿着古老的路线转场。

en:
The middle Nen crosses flat, well-watered steppe, pasture that the Korchin Mongols shared with Daur herdsmen and Solon hunters moving between the forests of the Greater Khingan and the river meadows. Qiqihar is Daur for a borderland or natural pasture. Through most of the fifteenth century there was no town here, only a seasonal camp at the place later called Bukui, where Mongols, Tungus and Jurchen bartered horses, cattle and sable. In 1444 the country belonged to the Korchin, eastern Mongols pasturing west of the Sungari, and no walled city stood on the Nen.

Qiqihar grew out of the Qing war with Russia. A post station opened at Bukui in 1665, and as Cossacks pushed down the Amur the court moved the Jilin river fleet here in 1674, stacking timber, barracks and arsenals along the Nen as the supply base for the Amur front. A water-borne brigade was added in 1683 and a firearms camp in 1684, the year the garrison's Muslims built the Bukui Mosque. Qing armies sailed and marched from this base to besiege the Russian fort of Albazin in 1685 and 1686, and the 1689 Treaty of Nerchinsk left the Amur valley to the Qing. A walled city was raised at Qiqihar in 1691, during the wars against Galdan, and in 1699 the Heilongjiang General moved his yamen from Mergen, making the city the seat of the empire's northernmost military government. Around 1700 it was also a mart of the Russo-Chinese fur trade and a place of exile, where convicts served out their sentences among the garrison camps and boatyards.
zh:
嫩江中游流经平坦湿润的草原，科尔沁蒙古人在此游牧，达斡尔牧人和索伦猎手则在大兴安岭林地与江畔草甸之间往来。「齐齐哈尔」是达斡尔语，意为边地或天然牧场。整个15世纪这里没有城郭，只有后来称作卜奎之处的季节性营地，蒙古人、通古斯人和女真人在此以马匹、牲畜和紫貂相交易。1444年，这片土地属于游牧在松花江以西的东蒙古科尔沁部，嫩江上还没有城墙环绕的城镇。

齐齐哈尔是在清朝对俄战事中长出来的军镇。1665年卜奎驿站设立；哥萨克沿黑龙江深入之际，清廷于1674年把吉林水师移驻于此，嫩江畔木材堆积、营垒相连，成为黑龙江前线的后援基地。1683年设水师营，1684年增设火器营，营中的穆斯林也在这年建起卜奎清真寺。清军从这里乘船、开拔，于1685、1686年两度围攻俄人据点雅克萨，1689年《尼布楚条约》签订，黑龙江流域归清。1691年，正当与噶尔丹交战之际，齐齐哈尔城版筑而起；1699年黑龙江将军衙门从墨尔根城迁来，这里成为大清最北军府的治所。1700年前后，它又是中俄毛皮贸易的商埠和发遣流人之地，罪囚在军营和船坞之间服苦役。

en:
Shenyang stands on the north bank of the Hun River, the old Shen Shui, and takes its name from the north-facing bank. The Liao and Jin kept a garrison town here as Shen Prefecture, and the Yuan coined Shenyang as the name of their circuit. In 1386 the Ming set up the Shenyang Central Guard, and three years later its commander Min Zhong faced the old Yuan earthen ramparts with brick and stone, cut four gates on the cross streets and drew double moats from the Hun; the inner wall ran a little over nine li around. In 1444 it was a guard town of soldier-farmers on the edge of the Jurchen hills, the northern edge of the Liaodong garrison line.

The Later Jin took the town in 1621 after the fighting along the Hun, and in 1625 Nurhaci moved his capital here from Dongjing at Liaoyang and raised the Great Administration Hall with the Ten Kings Pavilions ranged before it, where the khan sat in council with the banner chiefs. Hong Taiji rebuilt city and palace on a grid, gave the city the name Shengjing, 'the Rising Capital' and Mukden in Manchu, in 1634, and took the imperial title there in 1636 with the proclamation of the Qing dynasty. When Ligdan Khan's Chahar collapsed, the lama Mergen carried the dead khan's Mahakala golden Buddha to Shengjing on a white camel; lamas held that the beast knelt and died three li west of the walls, marking the ground on which Hong Taiji's Imperial Temple, the Shisheng Si, was completed in 1638 for the Mongols who had submitted.

After the court moved to Beijing in 1644 Shengjing remained the Qing secondary capital, with Nurhaci's Fuling tomb to the east and Hong Taiji's Zhaoling to the north, and Fengtian Prefecture was set up within the city in 1657. The Kangxi and Qianlong emperors lodged at the old palace on their eastern tours, and Qianlong added the western quarter, including the Wensuge Library, built to house a complete copy of the Siku Quanshu.
zh:
沈阳在浑河（旧称沈水）北岸，城名取自「水北为阳」。辽、金两朝在此置沈州、驻兵守城，元代设沈阳等路，始有「沈阳」之名。1386年，明朝改设沈阳中卫；三年后，指挥使闵忠把元代夯土城墙包砌砖石，四门对十字街，引浑河水为两道护城河，内城周长九里有余。1444年，这里是军户屯种的卫城，直面东面的女真山林，是辽东各卫防线的北缘。

1621年浑河一战后，后金攻占沈阳；1625年，努尔哈赤把都城从辽阳东京城迁来，建起大政殿和殿前两翼排开的十王亭，汗与八旗旗主就在这里议政。皇太极按井字街格局改建城池与皇宫，1634年赐名「天眷盛京」，满语称穆克登，1636年又在此去汗号称帝，改国号为清。林丹汗的察哈尔崩溃后，喇嘛墨尔根用白骆驼驮来玛哈噶喇金佛；相传白骆驼行至盛京城西三里伏地而死，喇嘛指为吉壤，皇太极便在该处为归附的蒙古部众敕建皇寺（实胜寺），1638年落成。

1644年清廷迁都北京，盛京作为陪都留存，努尔哈赤的福陵在城东，皇太极的昭陵在城北；1657年，城内设奉天府。康熙帝、乾隆帝东巡祭祖都驻跸故宫，乾隆增建西路，其中的文溯阁专为庋藏一部《四库全书》而建。

en:
Aigun commanded the middle Amur, where the river leaves the Xing'an ranges and bends east for the sea. In the Yongle reign a Ming fort held this bank for about twenty years, guarding the water route down to the Nurgan command; after the court withdrew, the banks returned to the Duchers, a Jurchen-speaking people who grew grain, raised horses and trapped sable for the fur trade. In 1444 their stockaded villages lined both banks, answerable to no Chinese official and only loosely tied to the rival Jurchen chiefs upstream.

Russian Cossacks reached the Amur in the 1650s, and in 1651 Yerofey Khabarov raised the fort of Albazin on a Daur chief's old town upstream. After his raids the Qing evacuated the Duchers into the Sungari and Hurka valleys. In 1683 Sabsu built a garrison at the old Aigun site, the first seat of the military governor of Heilongjiang, and fed his troops from crops planted along the river. In June 1685 the Qing army, which included former Zheng-family marines brought from Taiwan and skilled in river fighting, piled dry timber against Albazin's wooden walls and made the Russian commandant Tolbuzin surrender. The Russians slipped back and rebuilt the walls in earth, so a Qing army returned in 1686 for a year-long siege: Tolbuzin was killed by a cannon ball, and of more than eight hundred defenders barely a few score survived, most of them ill with scurvy, before orders came to ease the blockade for talks. The Treaty of Nerchinsk in 1689, settled in Latin with the Jesuits Gerbillon and Pereira interpreting, had the fort abandoned and destroyed and the Amur closed to Russia.

Aigun itself was rebuilt on the southern bank at a former Daur village as Sahaliyan Ula Hoton, 'Black River City'. The governor moved to Mergen in 1690 and later to Qiqihar, but a deputy lieutenant-general kept Aigun as the base of the Amur river fleet. When the Kangxi Emperor sent Jesuit surveyors to map the frontier in 1709, they found a well-defended garrison town ringed by provision villages.
zh:
瑷珲镇守黑龙江中游，江流在此冲出兴安岭，折向东方的海口。永乐年间，明朝为保障通往奴儿干都司的水路，曾在这一岸设堡驻军约二十年；朝廷撤守后，江岸重回久切尔人手中。这支操女真语的部族种谷养马，猎貂取皮，卖给收皮的商人。1444年，他们的寨栅散布大江两岸，不受流官约束，与上游互争雄长的女真酋长也只有松散的臣属关系。

17世纪50年代，俄国哥萨克进抵黑龙江；1651年，哈巴罗夫在上游一处达斡尔首领的旧城建起雅克萨堡。经过他的焚掠，清廷把久切尔人南迁松花江与牡丹江流域。1683年，萨布素在瑷珲旧址筑城屯兵，这里成为首任黑龙江将军的驻节地，军粮就取给沿江开出的屯田。1685年6月，清军中包括一批从台湾调来、擅长水战的原明郑水师，他们把干柴堆上雅克萨的木城墙，逼得俄人头目托尔布津投降。俄兵不久又潜回，改用土筑城，清军1686年再来，围城近一年：托尔布津中炮身亡，八百余名守军活下来的只剩几十人，大多已染上坏血病，这时放宽围困、准备谈判的命令也到了。1689年《尼布楚条约》以拉丁文定稿，耶稣会士张诚、徐日升从中传译，雅克萨依约拆毁，黑龙江对俄国关闭。

瑷珲本城则在南岸一处达斡尔旧村重修，满语名萨哈连乌拉霍通，意为「黑龙江城」。1690年将军衙门移驻墨尔根，后来再迁齐齐哈尔，但瑷珲仍留副都统一员，作为黑龙江水师的基地。1709年康熙派耶稣会士测绘边疆舆图时，他们见到的是一座守备严整、被屯田村落环绕的军镇。

en:
Tuwan is the rolling grass and woodland between the Nen and the upper Hulan, where the Xing'an hunting country gives way to the Songhua plain. Ming writers called the Tungusic clans here the 'river Jurchen'; the Sibe among them, whom some scholars trace to the medieval Shiwei, herded horses and cattle, scratched scattered fields of grain and trapped sable, trading ponies and pelts beyond the Kaiyuan border. The loose-reign guards scattered across the Amur country lapsed with the Nurgan command, and in 1444 the clans answered only to their own headmen. Six years earlier the Khorchin Mongols, defeated by the Oirats, had moved onto the Nen pastures, and their power was beginning to reach the Sibe camps.

By the mid-1500s the Sibe clans were Khorchin tributaries. Sibe horsemen rode in the nine-tribe coalition that Nurhaci routed at Gure in 1593, and over the following decades the Khorchin themselves submitted to the Later Jin. In 1692 the Kangxi Emperor bought the Sibe, Gūwalca and Daur from the Khorchin for silver, enrolled them in the upper three banners and posted the new bannermen to Qiqihar, Boduna and Girin Ula; from 1699 tens of thousands of banner soldiers moved south with their families to Mukden and Beijing, and in 1764 another levy was transferred to the Ili frontier. The grazing the clans left was closed to settlement; the Solon and Daur hunters who stayed in the hills were put under the Butha command set up under Kangxi, bound to a yearly tribute of sable pelts. Early in the nineteenth century Tuwan was still an empty pasture and imperial hunting reserve.
zh:
托温在嫩江与呼兰河上游之间，是小兴安岭猎场向松嫩平原过渡的丘陵草原与林地。明初把这一带的通古斯部落称作「江夷」，其中的锡伯人有学者认为源自中古的室韦；他们牧放马牛，零星开垦谷田，入山猎貂，把马匹和皮张拿到开原边外互市。明朝散置在黑龙江流域的羁縻卫所随奴儿干都司一同废弛，1444年的各部只听本部首领约束。六年前，被瓦剌击败的科尔沁蒙古刚迁到嫩江牧场，势力已经开始伸向锡伯人的营地。

到16世纪中叶，锡伯诸部都成了科尔沁的属部。1593年，锡伯骑兵随九部联军进攻建州，在古勒山被努尔哈赤击溃；此后数十年间，科尔沁自身也陆续归附后金。1692年，康熙皇帝以银两向科尔沁赎出锡伯、卦尔察和达斡尔人，编入上三旗，分驻齐齐哈尔、伯都讷和吉林乌拉；1699年起，数万旗兵家口分批南迁盛京和京师，1764年又有一支锡伯旗兵被调往伊犁边疆。诸部空出的牧场长期封禁，留在山里的索伦、达斡尔猎户归康熙年间设立的布特哈总管衙门管辖，岁岁贡纳貂皮。直到19世纪初，托温仍是人烟稀少的牧场与皇家围场。

en:
Bohori, the Boli of Chinese records, lies among the lowlands and channels where the Ussuri runs into the Amur. Before the Russians came it was Tungusic country: villagers fished the two rivers, hunted the riverine forest and passed furs along the Amur trade. Ming records placed the Bahulu Guard here under the Nurgan military administration, but the guard never grew into a walled town. In 1444 Jurchen and Oroch bands still lived by fishing, hunting and fur dealing along a frontier that Ming garrisons touched only lightly.

Qing records listed Bohori as a village station, a gashan, in 1643. Eight years later Yerofey Khabarov's Cossacks sailed down the Amur and, in September 1651, built a fortified winter camp in this river stretch, Achansk, named after the local Achan people. On 8 October, while many Cossacks were away fishing, about a thousand Achan and Ducher attackers stormed it and were beaten off. On 24 March 1652 the Ninguta commander Haise reached the fort with some two thousand Manchu and Korean troops and artillery; after a day's battle the Cossacks still held the wooden walls and seized the Manchu supply train, and Haise was later executed for the defeat. When the river ice broke that April, Khabarov burned Achansk and withdrew upstream. The 1689 Treaty of Nerchinsk stopped the Russian advance. French Jesuits surveying the Ussuri and Amur in 1709 found Nanai fishing villages, whom the Qing called the Fish-skin Tartars, and Bohori remained a loosely held Qing borderland under the Sanxing commandant until after 1821.
zh:
伯力在中国记载中又作勃利，地处乌苏里江汇入阿穆尔河处的低地与河汊之间。俄国人到来之前，这里是通古斯人的地方：村民在两条大江里捕鱼，在河畔森林狩猎，把毛皮沿阿穆尔河转送出去。明朝记载在此设巴忽鲁卫，隶属奴儿干都指挥使司，但卫所始终没有发展成有城墙的城镇。1444年，女真和鄂罗奇人群仍以捕鱼、狩猎和毛皮交易为生，散居在明朝驻军极少触及的边疆。

清朝记载在1643年把伯力登记为一处噶珊，即村落站所。八年后，叶罗费·哈巴罗夫率领哥萨克沿阿穆尔河而下，于1651年9月在这一段河道修起设防的冬营阿钱斯克，名字取自当地的阿钱人。10月8日，趁许多哥萨克外出打鱼，约一千名阿钱人和久切尔人猛攻营寨，被守军击退。1652年3月24日，宁古塔守将海色率约两千名携带火炮的满洲和朝鲜军队抵达；激战一整天，哥萨克守住了木墙，还截获清军的辎重队，海色后来因这一败被处死。当年四月河冰解冻，哈巴罗夫烧掉阿钱斯克，撤向上游。1689年《尼布楚条约》挡住了俄国的东进。1709年，沿乌苏里江和阿穆尔河测绘的法国耶稣会士见到那乃人的渔村，清朝称他们为「鱼皮鞑子」；直到1821年以后，伯力仍是三姓副都统辖下控制松散的清朝边地。

en:
Girin, from the Manchu Girin Ula, 'the place along the river', straddles the Songhua where the grain-growing river plain meets the forested Changbai foothills. A Buyeo royal town stood at the foot of Dongtuan Hill until Xianbei forces took it in 346, and Goguryeo fortresses later crowned Longtan Hill above the water. In 1409 the Ming built a shipyard on this bank, its vessels carrying troops, grain and gifts down the Songhua and the Amur to supply the Nurgan command far downstream. By 1444 the yard and river road lay in Haixi Jurchen country: the clans sold sable, ginseng and river pearls at the Kaiyuan border market, and the Ula, 'the river', was the strongest power on the middle Songhua.

Buyan took the title of beile in 1561 and built Ula city at the present Wula Street. Under his grandsons Mantai and Bujantai the kingdom held the trade road from the Amur to Kaiyuan, and contemporaries called its capital the greatest city of the East, the beile's halls rising storey upon storey above the river. Bujantai led the nine-tribe coalition against Nurhaci and was captured at Gure in 1593; Nurhaci installed him back at Ula, sealed five marriage alliances and swore seven oaths with him, but Bujantai turned to Yehe, and after the Jianzhou stripped him of the Eastern Sea clans Nurhaci marched thirty thousand men down the Songhua in 1613, stormed Ula and ended the kingdom, Bujantai fleeing to Yehe. The Qing turned the old city into its Buthai Ula tribute station, whose twenty-two game hills and sixty-four pearl rivers supplied the court with Eastern pearls, sturgeon, sable and ginseng. A naval yard was laid out on the river in 1661, the wooden walled town rose in 1673, and three years later the Ningguta general moved his seat there, making Girin the second city of the Manchu north-east after Mukden. The Kangxi emperor inspected the fleet in 1682 and later shortened the city's name to Girin.
zh:
「吉林」是满语吉林乌拉的简称，意为「沿江之地」，城在松花江岸，上接长白山林，下连宜于农耕的江河平原。扶余前期的王城坐落在东团山麓，346年被鲜卑军队攻破，高句丽后来又在俯瞰江流的龙潭山筑起山城。1409年，明朝在这处江岸设造船基地，所造船只载着官兵、粮草和赏赐，沿松花江、黑龙江远航，接济下游的奴儿干都司。到1444年，船厂和这条水路已处在海西女真地界：诸部在开原关市出售紫貂、人参和东珠，以「江」为名的乌拉是松花江中游最强的势力。

1561年布颜称贝勒，在今乌拉街营建乌拉城。传到孙子满泰、布占泰时，乌拉扼住了黑龙江至开原的贡市商路，时人把它的都城称作「东方第一大城」，贝勒的殿宇层楼叠阁，俯临江水。布占泰率九部联军攻打努尔哈赤，1593年在古勒山兵败被俘；努尔哈赤扶植他回乌拉继位，与他五次和亲、七次盟誓，布占泰却暗中倒向叶赫。建州夺尽东海诸部之后，努尔哈赤于1613年率三万大军顺松花江而下，攻破乌拉城，灭亡乌拉，布占泰逃奔叶赫。清朝把乌拉旧城改为打牲乌拉总管衙门，辖二十二处贡山、六十四处采珠河口，东珠、鲟鳇、貂皮、人参源源不断送入宫中。1661年江边再设水师船厂，1673年吉林木城筑成，三年后宁古塔将军移驻于此，吉林成为满洲东北仅次于盛京的第二大城。康熙帝1682年到此检阅水师，后来把城名简定为「吉林」。

en:
Ilan Hala, Manchu for 'three clans' and Ilantumen in Jurchen, was called Sanxing by the Chinese and stood where the Mudan River, then usually named the Hurka, enters the Sungari. Under the Liao and Jin it was the head town of the Five Nations, and it is remembered for the Jingkang disaster: when Jin armies took the Song capital in 1127, the deposed emperors Huizong and Qinzong were carried north and held here with Huizong's consort Wei, mother of the future Emperor Gaozong, and Huizong died at Wuguo in 1135. Under the Ming, Sanxing was, with Ninguta up the valley, one of the two main centres of the Jianzhou Jurchens in the Hurka country, and Qing writers later counted it among the early homelands of the Manchu clans. In 1444 Jurchen headmen controlled the river crossing, where fisheries, forest goods and tribute sables from the lower Sungari changed hands.

The Qing turned that standing into a permanent garrison. In 1714 Sanxing was walled and given a colonel's office, and in December 1731 the court created a deputy lieutenant-general's post there, which Aisin Gioro Qishihwu took up the following March. Under the Jilin general, his command ran along the middle and lower Sungari and Amur, over the Ussuri basin and across to Sakhalin, so the sable tribute of the river clans and the islanders entered the garrison's registers. Through 1821 Sanxing remained the chief Qing garrison for the whole lower Amur frontier.
zh:
依兰哈喇是满语「三姓」之意，女真语作依兰图门，汉文史籍称三姓，位于当时多称忽尔哈河的牡丹江汇入松花江处。辽金时期，这里是五国头城，到宋代更因靖康之祸为人所知：1127年金兵攻破宋都，被废的宋徽宗、宋钦宗二帝被掳北上，囚禁于此，同行的还有宋徽宗的妃嫔韦氏，即后来宋高宗的生母；徽宗于1135年死在五国城。明代时，三姓与河谷上游的宁古塔并为忽尔哈河流域建州女真的两大中心，清代文献也把这里列为满族先世的祖居地之一。1444年，女真首领掌握着这处渡江要地，下游松花江的渔产、山林货和贡貂在此转手。

清朝把这种地位变成固定军镇。1714年三姓筑城，设协领衙门；1731年12月，清廷在此增设副都统，爱新觉罗·七十五于次年3月到任。该职隶属吉林将军，辖区沿松花江、阿穆尔河中下游延伸，涵盖乌苏里江流域，一直到萨哈林岛，江畔和岛上各氏族缴纳的紫貂贡也归入三姓的册籍。直到1821年，三姓始终是清朝管辖整个阿穆尔河下游边疆的主要军镇。

en:
Hamheung lies on the coastal plain of the Seongcheon River, where it reaches East Korea Bay beneath the Hamgyong Mountains. The southern capital of Balhae, Namhae-bu, is thought to have stood in this area, and after Balhae fell the coast passed between Goryeo and the Jurchen until Goryeo retook it from the Yuan in 1356. The town was the home ground of Yi Seong-gye, founder of Joseon: his family house here was the birthplace of two future kings, Jeongjong and Taejong. After Taejong took the throne in 1400, the retired founder shut himself up in Hamheung and killed or imprisoned the envoys his son sent to placate him, which gave Korean the phrase 'Hamheung envoy' for a man sent on an errand from which he never returns. Hamheung became a walled bu in 1416 and the seat of the new northeastern province Hamgil-do, the base from which King Sejong secured the coast against Jurchen raiders. In 1444 it was the dynasty's provincial centre on a recently pacified borderland.

The governor's seat moved to Yeongheung after unrest in 1469 and the province changed its name, but Hamheung recovered the seat in 1509, when the name of the province settled as Hamgyeong. In the 1592 invasion Katō Kiyomasa's second army overran the town after crushing the Hamgyeong commander Han Geuk-ham at the Haejungchang granary; Jeong Mun-bu's Righteous Army fought back around Gyeongseong and Kilju and retook the province before the Japanese withdrew south early in 1593. Manchu forces raided Hamgyeong during the 1636-1637 invasion, and after King Injo's surrender Hamheung remained part of a Joseon kingdom bound to the Qing as tributary.
zh:
咸兴位于咸镜山脉脚下、城川江注入东朝鲜湾的沿海平原。一般认为，渤海国五京之一的南京南海府就在这一带；渤海灭亡后，这片海岸在高丽与女真之间易手，直到1356年高丽才趁元朝内乱将其收复。这里也是朝鲜王朝开国君主李成桂的起家之地，他在咸兴的旧宅生下了后来成为定宗和太宗的两个儿子。1400年太宗李芳远夺位后，太上王李成桂退居咸兴，把儿子派来缓和关系的使者或杀或囚，朝鲜语因此用「咸兴差使」比喻一去不回的人。1416年咸兴筑城升府，成为新设东北边省咸吉道的监营所在，世宗便从这一带着手巩固海岸、防备女真。1444年的咸兴，是王朝在新近平定的边疆上的道城。

1469年地方变乱后监营移往永兴，道名也一度更改；1509年监营迁回咸兴，道名固定为咸镜道。1592年壬辰战争中，加藤清正的第二军先在海汀仓击溃咸镜道将领韩克諴，随即进占咸兴；郑文孚组织义兵在镜城、吉州一带转战，收复道内，日军于1593年初南撤。1636年至1637年清军入侵时攻掠咸镜道，仁祖投降后，咸兴仍是向清朝称臣的朝鲜王朝的一部分。

en:
Hwangju is a walled town on the main western road of Korea, which runs from Hanyang through Kaesong to Pyongyang, close to the lower Taedong and the Yellow Sea fishing banks. It was Tonghol under Goguryeo and Chwiseong under Silla; early Goryeo renamed it Hwangju and placed Hwangju-mok there in 983. Late in the thirteenth century it passed under Yuan rule with the Dongnyeong administration, until King Gongmin recovered it. When Hwanghae Province was formed in 1417, Hwangju supplied the first character of its name, though the governor sat at Haeju. In 1444 it was a small Confucian prefectural town whose walls guarded the road and the coastal flats, and the local Hwangbo clan could claim a queen: its daughter became Queen Sinjeong, wife of King Taejo of Goryeo.

Armies kept using the road past Hwangju. King Sejo placed a garrison in the town, and in 1624 the hardest fight of Yi Gwal's rebellion took place here: at Singyo bridge the rebels routed the royal army under Chong Chung-sin and Nam I-hung and marched on to take Hanyang, the only time a Joseon rebellion drove the king from his capital. In 1627 the Later Jin came down the same road, their vanguard reaching Hwangju while reports reaching Hanyang claimed that both Pyongyang and Hwangju had fallen; raiders swept the district until the April peace ended the campaign. Hwangju remained a Hwanghae garrison town for the rest of the dynasty.
zh:
黄州是一座有城墙的城邑，扼守汉阳经开城通往平壤的朝鲜西海岸大路，地近大同江下游和黄海渔场。高句丽时这里称冬忽，新罗时改称取城；高丽初年定名黄州，983年设黄州牧。13世纪末，黄州随东宁府归入元朝统治，到恭愍王时才收复。1417年黄海道设立，黄州提供了道名的头一个字，道监营却设在海州。1444年，黄州是一座小小的儒教州城，城墙守着大路和海滨滩涂；本地的皇甫氏还出过一位王后，其女成为高丽太祖的王妃神静王后。

各路军队一再取道黄州城外。世祖在这里设镇；1624年李适之乱中最激烈的一仗就发生在此地：叛军在薪桥击溃郑忠信、南以兴的官军，继而攻下汉阳，这是朝鲜王朝唯一一次叛乱把国王赶出都城。1627年，后金沿同一条大路南下，前锋进抵黄州，送往汉阳的军报却声称平壤、黄州俱已陷落；游骑在这一带焚掠，直到四月议和，战事才结束。此后整个朝鲜王朝，黄州一直是黄海道的驻防要地。

en:
Wonju lies in a wide basin of the upper Namhan River, with Chiak Mountain rising to its south, in the Yeongseo country west of the Taebaek range. Silla kept one of its five secondary capitals here, and in 940 Wang Kon, founder of Goryeo, named the town Wonju for its open plains. In 1291 the local scholar Won Ch'ung-gap and the men of Wonju routed a raid by the Mongol rebel Qadan. In 1395 King Taejo joined the Gangneung and Gyoju circuits into Gangwon Province, taking the first word of each name, and planted the governor's office, the Gangwon Gamyeong, at Wonju; the governor conducted provincial business from his hall the Seonhwadang. A tale told on Chiaksan has a pheasant ring a mountain temple bell three times to save a monk from a serpent, after which the bird was found dead beneath the bell. In 1444 Wonju is the seat of the Gangwon governor and the chief town of the Yeongseo basin.

The Imjin War reached Wonju in 1592. Its magistrate Kim Chegap, a man of sixty-seven and a former pupil of the scholar Yi Hwang, sent the civilians into the hill fortress of Yeongwon on Chiaksan and held it against the Japanese until the walls were carried; he was killed with his wife and second son, and was later enshrined in the town's Chungnyeolsa. His nephew was Kim Si-min, the defender of Jinju. In 1594 the Lady Han, the future Queen Inyeol, wife of King Injo and mother of King Hyojong, was born in Wonju. The Manchu invasions of 1627 and 1636 ended with Joseon submitting to the Qing, but the Gamyeong kept its seat at Wonju, where successive governors ruled the mountain province for the rest of the period.
zh:
原州位于南汉江上游的宽阔盆地，雉岳山耸立于城南，属太白山脉以西的岭西地方。新罗时代这里是五小京之一；940年高丽太祖王建因这片原野平广，赐名原州。1291年，乡贡进士元冲甲率原州军民击退蒙古叛王合丹的窜犯。1395年，太祖合并江陵、交州两道，取两道首字置江原道，把观察使衙门江原监营设在原州，观察使在宣化堂总理全道事务。雉岳山还流传着雉鸡报恩的故事：一只雉鸡撞响山寺铜钟，从蛇口救下僧人，自己却死在钟下。1444年的原州是江原道观察使驻节之地，也是岭西盆地的首镇。

1592年壬辰倭乱波及原州。牧使金悌甲年已六十七，早年从学于退溪李滉；他把百姓撤入雉岳山中的领愿山城据守，直至城破，与夫人、次子一同战死，后奉安于原州忠烈祠。他的侄子，就是后来死守晋州的金时敏。1594年，仁祖的王妃、孝宗生母仁烈王后韩氏出生于原州。1627年和1636年满洲两度入侵，最终朝鲜臣服于清朝，江原监营则始终留驻原州，历任观察使在此治理群山环抱的江原道。

en:
Hanseong, the city later called Seoul, stands on the Han River ringed by granite hills. It held the Baekje capital of Wiryeseong and Goryeo's Southern Capital before Yi Seong-gye made it the seat of his new Joseon dynasty in 1394; named Hanseongbu the next year, the city was laid out around the new Gyeongbokgung palace and the Jongmyo shrine and girdled by a fortress wall climbing the surrounding ridges, whose southern Sungnyemun gate was completed in 1398 and rebuilt under Sejong in 1447. It held perhaps a hundred thousand people by the early fifteenth century. In 1444 King Sejong rules here over a Confucian capital of officials, scholars and the licensed shops of Jongno. Jang Yeong-sil, a technician born a government slave, completed the Jagyeokru water clock in the palace in 1434, and bowl-shaped sundials were set at a bridge and before Jongmyo for the city to read the hours; Sejong's native alphabet, the Hunminjeongeum, was proclaimed in 1446 over a protest memorial from the scholar Choe Manri.

Fire gutted much of Gyeongbokgung in 1553, and the rebuilt palace burned again when the Japanese seized Hanseong in June 1592 after the court fled north; with Ming help the occupiers were driven out in May 1593. Gyeongbokgung then stood in ruins for more than two and a half centuries, while Changdeokgung, restored by 1610, served as the working palace. In 1623 the Injo coup deposed Gwanghaegun there, and in 1636 the court fled the Manchus to Namhansanseong, submitting early the next year. The crew of the Dutch ship Sperwer, wrecked off Jeju in 1653, were brought to Hanseong and attached to the Military Training Agency through the long-settled castaway Jan Jansz Weltevree, until hardship scattered them south in 1659. In 1762 Yeongjo ordered Crown Prince Sado confined in a rice chest, where he starved to death. Catholic books from Beijing also found readers here: after Yi Seung-hun returned baptized in 1784 a house church met at Myeongryebang, and in the persecution of 1801 its leaders were beheaded outside Seosomun.
zh:
汉城，即后来的首尔，坐落于汉江之畔，四周环绕着花岗岩山岭。这里曾是百济慰礼城所在、高丽的南京；1394年李成桂定都于此，次年定名汉城府，以新建的景福宫和宗庙为核心，沿山脊修筑城墙，南门崇礼门1398年落成、1447年世宗时重修，15世纪初城中人口约有十万。1444年的汉城是世宗治下的儒教都城，官署、学者与钟路的特许市廛并立。出身官奴的技术家蒋英实1434年在宫中制成自击漏水钟，又在惠政桥和宗庙前设置仰釜日晷供百姓看时辰；世宗创制的训民正音1446年颁布，崔万里曾上疏反对。

1553年景福宫大火，多数殿阁焚毁；复建不久，1592年6月朝廷北逃，日军占领汉城，景福宫再次被焚，次年5月在明军支援下日军南撤。景福宫此后荒废二百七十余年，昌德宫于1610年前修复，成为历代国王处理政务的正宫。1623年，仁祖反正的军队在昌德宫废黜光海君；1636年清军入侵，王室退入南汉山城，次年出降。1653年，荷兰船「斯佩尔韦号」在济州近海失事，船员哈梅尔一行被押到汉城，经早年归化朝鲜的朴渊介绍编入训练都监，1659年因生计艰难被分散安置到南方。1762年，英祖下令将世子李愃关进米柜，最终饿死。来自北京的天主教书籍也在这里找到读者：李承薰1784年受洗归国后，明礼坊出现了家庭教会，1801年辛酉迫害中，教会首领被押到西小门外斩首。

en:
Sangju sits in the western hills of Gyeongsang, where the road from the Han River valley runs on toward Gyeongju and another climbs north over the Choryong pass to Chungju. The small state of Sabeol-guk held the country before Silla secured it by 505 and turned its fortress into one of the nine provincial ju guarding the route to the old Silla capital. Goryeo established Sangju-mok in 983, and in 1408 the Joseon court moved the Gyeongsang governor's seat to the town; the province itself pairs the names of Sangju and Gyeongju. In 1444 it is the administrative capital of Gyeongsang, set among farmlands known for the sambeak, the three whites of rice, silk and dried persimmons.

In the 1592 invasion the road north brought the war to Sangju. After Busan and Dongnae fell, Konishi Yukinaga's division covered nearly twenty kilometres a day. The Korean general Yi Il reached the town on 2 June with sixty cavalry; the three hundred men on his roster turned out to be conscripted clerks and students, so he opened the government granaries and hired nine hundred peasants, who had one day of drill before the Japanese arrived. A scout who brought warning was beheaded for spreading rumours. Six thousand seven hundred troops under Sō Yoshitoshi came through the woods and scattered Yi's levy at close range, and Yi fled north on foot after discarding his armour and horse, leaving the Choryong pass unguarded; the road to Chungju and Hanseong lay open. The governor's seat, moved repeatedly during the war, was settled at Daegu in 1601. Sangju remained a mok town and an inland market, collecting the rice, silk and persimmons of the country around it.
zh:
尚州坐落在庆尚西部丘陵，从汉江谷地通往庆州的道路经过这里，另一条路向北翻越鸟岭，通往忠州。新罗在505年前征服这一带以前，小国沙伐国曾立国于此；新罗把尚州城列为九处州治之一，扼守通往旧都的东西要道。高丽于983年置尚州牧，1408年朝鲜朝廷把庆尚道监营移到此处，「庆尚」道名也正是取自庆州与尚州。1444年的尚州是庆尚道的行政首镇，四乡农田以「三白」闻名，即米、丝绸和柿饼。

1592年倭乱中，北上的道路把战火烧到尚州。釜山、东莱陷落后，小西行长所部以每日近二十公里的速度北进。朝鲜将领李镒6月2日抵达时身边只有六十骑，兵册上的三百人竟是征来的书吏和生徒；他开官仓募得九百农民，才操练一天日军便到。一名斥候报信，反被他以谣言惑众斩首。宗义智率六千七百人穿过树林逼近，在近距离冲散这支新军，李镒弃马卸甲徒步北逃，鸟岭天险无人防守，通往忠州和汉城的路就此洞开。战乱中监营一再迁移，1601年固定于大邱。尚州此后仍是牧镇和内陆集市，四乡的米、丝绸和柿饼照旧在此集散。

en:
Jeonju is the chief town of the Honam plain in Korea's south-west, the richest rice country of the peninsula and the seat of the governor of Jeolla. The rebel general Gyeon Hwon made it, then called Wansan, the capital of his Later Baekje kingdom in 892. Forty years later his own son Gyeon Singeom overthrew him and confined him at Geumsansa temple; Gyeon Hwon escaped to his old enemy Wang Geon and returned with the Goryeo army that took the city and ended Later Baekje in 936. The next dynasty prized it as the home of its royal clan: Yi Seong-gye, the founder of Joseon, came from the Jeonju Yi clan, and in 1380, after defeating Japanese pirates at Hwangsan, he stopped at Omokdae hill, where his ancestor Mokjo had once lived, and held a victory feast there. King Taejong built Gyeonggijeon in 1410 to house King Taejo's portrait, and in 1439 an archive hall was built to keep a copy of the dynasty's Annals. In 1444 the governor of Jeolla ruled the province from the walled town.

The Japanese came for Jeolla's rice in 1592. On 14 August General Kwon Yul held the Ichi pass with about a thousand men against some fifteen thousand troops under Kobayakawa Takakage, barring the road from Geumsan; he commanded the defence of Haengju the following year. In the second invasion the town fell after all: once Namwon was lost in September 1597 the Japanese occupied Jeonju until their withdrawal. The Jeonju Annals were carried to safety by the town's own men. When the Japanese approached, the Gyeonggijeon caretaker Oh Hui-gil, with scholars An Ui and Son Hong-rok, moved Taejo's portrait and the archive books into Naejangsan, and the other three copies were burned. Gyeonggijeon was rebuilt in 1614, and the court later used the Jeonju volumes as the master text when it printed five new sets and placed them in mountain archives.
zh:
全州是朝鲜半岛西南湖南平原的首邑，全国最丰足的稻米产地，全罗道监营就设在此城。892年，叛将甄萱以当时的完山为都，建立后百济。四十年后，他的儿子甄神剑起兵将他推翻，囚禁在金山寺；甄萱逃脱后投奔老对手王建，又随高丽大军回到全州，于936年攻灭后百济。新王朝把这里视作王室本贯之地：朝鲜开国君主李成桂出身全州李氏，1380年他在荒山击败倭寇后，在先祖穆祖旧居所在的梧木台设庆功宴。太宗于1410年建庆基殿供奉太祖御真，1439年又建实录阁收藏王朝实录。1444年，全罗道监司在这座城墙环绕的城中统辖全道。

1592年，日军为夺取全罗的稻米而来。8月14日，权栗以约千人据守梨峙，挡住小早川隆景约一万五千人的军队，封住了从金山通向全州的道路；次年他又指挥了幸州之战。第二次入侵时全州终究不守：1597年9月南原陷落后，日军进占全州，直到撤退。全州本实录是被本城人救下来的：日军逼近时，庆基殿参奉吴希吉与儒生安义、孙弘禄把太祖御真和实录移入内藏山，其余三部实录都毁于兵火。庆基殿于1614年重建；后来朝廷以全州本为底本新印五部，分藏各处山中史库。

en:
Sakam was Siraya land on the coastal plain behind the Tayouan sandbar, where Taiwan-fu and later Tainan took shape. Its villages had close ties with Sinkan and faced the shallow Taikang inlet, which separated their fields from the anchorage beyond the sandbar. Villagers farmed the coastal plain, hunted deer in the grasslands and managed access to the landing places through their own village affairs. In 1444 no larger island ruler controlled the lagoon; Siraya communities held the landings, deer grounds and fields around Sakam.

The Dutch East India Company put the Tayouan anchorage to use in 1624 by building Fort Zeelandia as its base for trade with China and Japan. On 20 January 1625 Governor Marten Sonck bought a tract at Sakam from the Sinkan people for fifteen pieces of flowered cloth and laid out the Provintia settlement. After campaigns against neighbouring Siraya villages in 1635-36, the company brought in Chinese farmers, who turned much of the plain into rice paddies and sugar fields; deerskins, rice and sugar moved out through the Dutch forts. The Guo Huaiyi rising of 1652 was put down with Sinkan help, and Fort Provintia was built at Sakam in 1653.

Zheng Chenggong entered the lagoon through the Luerhmen channel in 1661, took Provintia and forced Zeelandia to surrender on 1 February 1662. Sakam became the seat of his Kingdom of Tungning, and in 1665 the Zheng administration built Taiwan's first Confucian temple there. Qing forces took the island in 1683, and Taiwan Prefecture was established the next year as its walled city spread over old Sakam. During the Lin Shuangwen rebellion of 1787-1788, rebels overran much of the surrounding countryside while Taiwan-fu held out until Fuk'anggan's army crossed from the mainland and restored Qing control.
zh:
赤崁是大员沙洲内侧滨海平原上的西拉雅地域，后来的台湾府和台南就在这里成形。这里的村社与新港社关系密切，村田外是水浅的台江内海，潟湖之外才是沙洲外的锚地。居民耕种滨海平原、在草地猎鹿，并通过村社事务管理登陆地。1444年，岛上还没有更大的政权控制这片潟湖，西拉雅诸社掌握着赤崁一带的登陆地、猎场和农田。

1624年，荷兰东印度公司利用大员锚地修建热兰遮城，作为对中国、日本贸易的基地。1625年1月20日，台湾长官宋克以十五匹花布向新港人购得赤崁一片土地，开辟普罗民遮。1635至1636年征讨邻近西拉雅村社后，公司招来汉人农民，把大片平原改造成稻田和蔗田；鹿皮、米和糖经荷兰人的城堡外运。1652年郭怀一起事被荷兰人联合新港等社镇压，1653年普罗民遮城在赤崁建成。

1661年，郑成功从鹿耳门水道进入台江内海，先取普罗民遮城，再迫使热兰遮城于1662年2月1日投降。赤崁成为东宁王国的治所，1665年郑氏官府又在这里建成台湾第一座孔庙。1683年清军取得台湾，次年设置台湾府，府城在旧赤崁一带扩展。1787至1788年林爽文抗清时，起事者控制了城外大片地方，台湾府城坚守到福康安率军从大陆渡海，才恢复清朝的控制。

en:
Known in older Chinese records as Shule, Kashgar is the oasis below the Pamirs where roads from Ferghana, the Tarim Basin and the high mountain passes meet. Its rivers water fields and bazaars in otherwise arid country. In 1444 this Sunni Muslim Turki merchant town was rebuilding after Timurid wars: the Eastern Chagatai khanate had recovered it in 1432, while Dughlat emirs kept much local power. The Id Kah Mosque had been built two years earlier by Saqsiz Mirza and incorporated parts of a religious complex from 996, giving Kashgar a large new congregational mosque for its Friday prayers. The oasis had been an early Muslim city of the Turkic east under the Karakhanids, then passed through Qara Khitai and Chinggisid realms before Timur's armies took it. Wool, livestock and caravan supplies changed hands in its bazaars.

Dughlat control ended in 1514, when Sultan Said Khan defeated Mirza Abu Bakr, founded the Yarkand khanate and kept his first court at Kashgar before moving it to Yarkand. Later, rival Naqshbandi networks known as the White Mountain and Black Mountain khojas divided the cities of Altishahr. In 1680 the White Mountain leader Afaq Khoja called in Galdan's Dzungar army; the Chagatai khans became puppets, and Tsewang Rabtan later imposed direct Dzungar rule. Qing forces took Kashgar in 1759 while suppressing the revolt of Burhan-ud-din and Khoja Jahan, then stationed a garrison and imperial councillor there. Id Kah was rebuilt as a golden-brick mosque in 1798. By 1821 Kashgar was a guarded Qing market on the Pamir roads, with Kokand and exiled khojas beyond the mountains.
zh:
喀什噶尔在汉文古籍中称疏勒，是帕米尔脚下的绿洲，费尔干纳、塔里木盆地和高山山口的道路在此相接。绿洲河流浇灌着干旱地带中的农田和巴扎。1444年，这座逊尼派突厥语穆斯林商城正从帖木儿系战争中恢复：东察合台汗国1432年收复此城，杜格拉特埃米尔仍掌握大量地方权力。艾提尕尔清真寺刚在两年前由沙克色孜·米尔扎建成，建筑还并入了996年宗教建筑群的一部分，为喀什噶尔提供了举行周五聚礼的大型清真寺。喀喇汗王朝时期，这里已是突厥语东方较早的穆斯林城市之一，后来又经历西辽和成吉思汗系政权，最后被帖木儿的军队攻占。羊毛、牲畜和商队补给都在巴扎交易。

1514年，萨亦德汗击败米尔扎·阿布·伯克尔，建立叶尔羌汗国，先在喀什噶尔设庭，后来才迁往叶尔羌，杜格拉特人的控制到此结束。此后，纳合昔班底教团中的白山派与黑山派和卓网络彼此敌对，分裂了回疆诸城。1680年，白山派首领阿帕克和卓引来噶尔丹的准噶尔军队，察合台系汗王沦为傀儡，策妄阿拉布坦后来又改为准噶尔直接统治。1759年，清军在平定波罗尼都和霍集占之乱时攻占喀什噶尔，随后驻军并派遣参赞大臣。1798年，艾提尕尔清真寺以黄褐色砖重建。到1821年，喀什噶尔仍是清朝在帕米尔道路上设防的商市，山外有浩罕和流亡和卓活动。

en:
Chanderi stands on the border of Malwa and Bundelkhand, among hills, lakes and forest south-west of the Betwa River, where the road out of Malwa runs north toward the Ganges plain. The town lives by cloth: Koli weavers settled there in the mid-1300s, and their handlooms made its name for sheer cotton and silk, later sold as Chanderi saris, while Jain merchants built a cluster of temples. Sultan Mahmud Khalji I of Malwa took the town in 1438 after a siege of several months, so in 1444 it is a fresh frontier acquisition of the Malwa sultanate. Passing through in 1445 after beating the Jaunpur army at Kalpi, the sultan ordered the seven-storey Koshak Mahal, a Mandu-style palace of which only three floors were ever finished.

The fort's hardest years came with the break-up of Malwa. Medini Rai, a wazir of Sultan Mahmud II who had gone over to Rana Sanga of Mewar, made Chanderi the capital of the Rajput kingdom the Rana gave him. After beating Rana Sanga at Khanwa, Babur stormed the fort in January 1528: that night the defenders' women burned in jauhar, and at dawn the men smeared the ashes on their foreheads, put on saffron kesariya robes and rode out to die in the rite called saka. Puran Mal retook the fort in 1529, and through the 1530s and 1540s it changed hands among Bahadur Shah of Gujarat, Humayun and Sher Shah Suri, who made it a Sur frontier post. Akbar's armies took it with the rest of Malwa in 1562 and made it a sarkar of the Malwa subah. The Bundelas seized it before the end of the century and held it under Ram Sab, a son of Raja Madhukar of Orchha; Devi Singh Bundela became its governor in 1646, and his line kept the town until 1811, when Jean Baptiste Filose captured it for Daulat Rao Scindia of Gwalior.
zh:
钱德里地处摩腊婆与本德尔肯德交界、贝特瓦河西南的丘陵湖泊林间，摩腊婆北上恒河平原的大路从这里经过。这座城靠织布立足：14世纪中叶科利族织工到此定居，手工织机织出的轻薄棉布和丝绸远近知名，后来以「钱德里纱丽」行销；耆那教商人也在城中建起成群庙宇。摩腊婆苏丹马哈茂德·卡尔吉一世围攻数月，于1438年拿下此城，所以1444年的钱德里还是苏丹国新到手的边镇。1445年，苏丹在卡尔皮击败江布尔军队后途经此地，下令修建七层的科沙克宫；这座曼杜风格的宫殿最终只建成三层。

堡垒最纷扰的岁月随摩腊婆的瓦解而来。梅迪尼·拉伊本是苏丹马哈茂德二世的维齐尔，投奔梅瓦尔的拉纳·桑加后，受封以钱德里为都的拉杰普特王国。巴布尔在坎瓦击溃拉纳·桑加后，于1528年1月强攻此堡：当夜守军女眷行乔哈尔投火自焚，黎明时分男人们把灰烬抹上额头、披上藏红色的凯萨里亚战袍，出城赴死，是为「萨卡」。普兰·马尔1529年收复堡垒；1530至1540年代，它在古吉拉特的巴哈杜尔·沙、胡马雍和舍尔沙之间几度易手，舍尔沙把它作为苏尔王朝的边防据点。阿克巴的大军1562年征服摩腊婆全境，钱德里成为摩腊婆苏巴下辖的一个萨卡尔。本德拉人在16世纪末夺取此城，由奥尔查王公马杜卡尔之子拉姆·萨卜据守；1646年德维·辛格·本德拉受任城主，其家族一直保有此地，直到1811年让-巴蒂斯特·菲洛斯为瓜廖尔的道拉特·拉奥·辛迪亚将它攻占。

en:
Cumaná lies at the entrance to the Gulf of Cariaco, where the Manzanares River meets the Caribbean, and in the tongue of its first inhabitants the name was said to mean 'union of sea and river'. In 1444 this coast belonged to the Cumanagoto and Chaima, whose forebears had come from the Orinoco basin, and pearl beds lay off the island of Cubagua.

From 1500 Spanish pearl fishers from Nueva Cádiz on Cubagua drew fresh water at the river mouth, and friars sent by Pedro de Córdoba began a peaceful mission. On 3 October 1515 Cumanagoto under the cacique Maragüey, avenging Spanish slave raids, destroyed the convent and killed the friars. Gonzalo de Ocampo answered with punitive raids and a fort he named Nueva Toledo; Bartolomé de las Casas arrived in 1521 to settle the land peacefully but left after quarrels with Ocampo. The Dominican Francisco de Montesinos refounded the town as Nueva Córdoba on 1 February 1562, and in 1569 Diego Fernández de Serpa, first governor of New Andalusia, renamed it Cumaná as his capital. By 1741 the city had 4,263 inhabitants. Antonio José de Sucre was born here, and on 15 July 1811 the city declared independence.
zh:
库马纳位于卡里亚科湾湾口、曼萨纳雷斯河注入加勒比海的地方，据说这个名字在最早的居民的语言里意为「海与河的交汇」。1444年，这片海岸属于库马纳戈托人和柴马人，他们的祖先来自奥里诺科河流域，近海的库瓦瓜岛一带蕴藏着珍珠。

1500年起，在库瓦瓜岛新加的斯采珠的西班牙人来河口取淡水，佩德罗·德科尔多瓦派来的修士也在此开始和平传教。1515年10月3日，库马纳戈托人在酋长马拉圭伊率领下报复西班牙人的猎奴袭击，捣毁修院，杀死修士。冈萨洛·德奥坎波随即出兵讨伐，修起一座要塞，命名为新托莱多；1521年巴托洛梅·德拉斯卡萨斯来到这里，想和平拓殖，却因与奥坎波不和而离去。多明我会修士弗朗西斯科·德蒙特西诺斯于1562年2月1日重建城镇，称新科尔多瓦；1569年，新安达卢西亚首任总督迭戈·费尔南德斯·德塞尔帕将其改名库马纳，定为首府。到1741年，城中有居民4263人。安东尼奥·何塞·德苏克雷生于此地，1811年7月15日，库马纳宣布独立。

en:
At Angostura — the 'narrows' deep inland from the Orinoco's delta — the great river contracts from a broad floodplain to a rocky gap barely 800 metres wide, the natural crossing between its lower banks. This is the old country of the Caribs: river villages fished and planted cassava, canoe-borne trade moved between the coast and the interior, and no war party could pass the strait unseen. In 1444 the crossing belonged to the peoples of the river.

On 1 August 1498, on his third voyage, Columbus sighted the freshening mouths of the Orinoco. The first Spanish town on the lower river, Santo Tomé de Guayana, was planted in 1576 near the Caroní confluence and destroyed by Dutch raiders three years later. Antonio de Berrío refounded it in 1595, and in 1617 an English expedition under Walter Raleigh sacked the place, his son Wat dying in the assault; Raleigh was beheaded in England the next year. Fernando de Berrío rebuilt it in 1620, but English and Dutch raiders burned it in 1629 and the Dutch again in 1637. Only on 22 May 1764 did Joaquín Moreno de Mendoza settle the town for good at the narrows, as Santo Tomás de la Nueva Guayana de la Angostura del Orinoco — Angostura, capital of Guayana Province. Humboldt passed through in 1800. In the wars of independence Manuel Piar's patriots defeated the royalists at San Félix, on the Chirica tableland, on 11 April 1817; the garrison abandoned Angostura that July, and the town became the republic's provisional capital. On 15 February 1819 Bolívar opened the Congress of Angostura there, which proclaimed Gran Colombia before the year ended and sat on until 1821.
zh:
安戈斯图拉意为「狭口」，地处奥里诺科河三角洲上游的内陆，浩荡的河面在此从开阔的泛滥平原收束为仅800米宽的岩石水道，是下游两岸的天然渡口。这里本是加勒比人的故土：河畔村落以捕鱼和种植木薯为生，独木舟商队往来于海岸与内陆之间，任何武装队伍都无法悄悄通过狭口。1444年，这座渡口掌握在河畔原住民手中。

1498年8月1日，哥伦布在第三次航行中望见了奥里诺科河淡水奔涌的河口。1576年，西班牙人在下游卡罗尼河汇流处建起第一座城镇圣托梅·德·圭亚那，三年后即被荷兰袭掠者摧毁。安东尼奥·德·贝里奥1595年重建此城；1617年沃尔特·雷利率领的英国远征队将其洗劫，雷利之子瓦特在攻城中丧命，雷利本人次年在英格兰被斩首。费尔南多·德·贝里奥1620年再度建城，但英荷袭掠者1629年、荷兰人1637年两次将其焚毁。直到1764年5月22日，华金·莫雷诺·德·门多萨才在狭口定下永久城址，命名为「奥里诺科河狭口的新圭亚那圣托马斯」，简称安戈斯图拉，成为圭亚那省首府。1800年洪堡曾途经此地。独立战争中，1817年4月11日，曼努埃尔·皮亚尔率领的爱国军在奇里卡台地的圣费利克斯击败保王军；守军于当年7月弃城，安戈斯图拉成为共和国的临时首都。1819年2月15日，玻利瓦尔在此召开安戈斯图拉议会，议会于年底宣布成立大哥伦比亚，会期一直持续到1821年。

en:
The Essequibo rises in the Acarai Mountains and runs 1,014 kilometres through forest and savanna to the Atlantic, the largest river between the Orinoco and the Amazon. In 1444 its lower banks, islands and swampy shore were Lokono country, the mainland Arawak people. Arawakan-speaking villagers farmed, fished and travelled by canoe, exchanging river and coastal produce while no European fort yet commanded the mouth.

European ships reached the estuary in 1498, and in 1596 Lawrence Kemys led a party upstream in search of the fabled Lake Parime. In 1616 Zeelanders under Joost van der Hooge founded the Dutch colony and began Fort Kyk-Over-Al on the Mazaruni, a side channel, using the post for trade with the indigenous population and for plantations where enslaved Africans grew cotton, indigo and cacao. The British seized Essequibo in 1665 and the French plundered it before Zeeland forces returned in 1667. British planters arrived after 1740, and by 1800 Essequibo and Demerara together contained about 380 sugarcane plantations. British privateers took the colony in 1781, the French held it from 1782 to 1783, and the Dutch then returned. A British occupation begun in 1796 was briefly interrupted in 1802 and 1803; Essequibo was merged with Demerara in 1812 and confirmed to Britain by the Treaty of London in 1814.
zh:
埃塞奎博河发源于阿卡拉伊山脉，穿过森林与稀树草原，奔流1014公里注入大西洋，是奥里诺科河与亚马孙河之间最大的河流。1444年，河下游两岸、岛屿与沼泽海岸是洛科诺人的土地，他们是大陆上的阿拉瓦克人。说阿拉瓦克语系语言的村民务农、捕鱼，乘独木舟往来，交换河上与沿海物产；当时河口还没有欧洲堡垒控制。

欧洲船只1498年到达河口。1596年，劳伦斯·凯米斯率队溯河而上，寻找传说中的帕里梅湖。1616年，约斯特·范德霍赫率领泽兰人建立荷兰殖民地，在支河马扎鲁尼河畔动工修建凯克-奥弗阿尔堡，以此同原住民贸易，并经营种植园；被奴役的非洲人在那里种植棉花、靛蓝和可可。1665年英军夺取埃塞奎博，随后法兰西人劫掠此地，泽兰军队1667年返回。1740年后英国种植园主到来，到1800年，埃塞奎博与德梅拉拉共有约380处甘蔗种植园。1781年英国私掠者占领殖民地，法兰西人1782年至1783年占据，随后荷兰恢复统治。1796年开始的英国占领曾在1802年至1803年短暂中断；1812年埃塞奎博与德梅拉拉合并，1814年《伦敦条约》确认其归属英国。

en:
The Demerara River runs 346 kilometres from the central Guiana rain forest to a shallow Atlantic estuary. Its Lokono name meant the river of letter wood. In 1444 Lokono communities moved along its banks and tidal creeks, fishing, planting and using the waterway as a road between forest, savanna and coast. No European fort, sugar works or permanent plantation yet stood on the shore.

Demerara is first mentioned as a trading post in 1691, and on 18 October 1745 the Dutch West India Company made it a separate colony on an uncolonized part of the Essequibo claim, enjoining settlers to keep peace with the Amerindians and respect their freedom and lands. Andries Pieterse became the first planter; within six months 18 large sugar plantations and 50 smaller holdings had been laid out. Laurens Storm van 's Gravesande at first governed from Fort Zeelandia, and in 1755 the administration moved to Borsselen Island while the lower guard post grew into Stabroek. Enslaved Africans carried the labour behind this boom. When Cuffy's Berbice revolt began on 23 February 1763, van 's Gravesande allied with Lokono, Kalina, Warao and Akawaio fighters, prevented the rising from entering Demerara and sent 50 soldiers east. By 1780 nearly 200 plantations lined the river. British forces took it without fighting in 1781, French forces in 1782, and the 1783 Treaty of Paris returned Demerara to the Dutch. A West Demerara slave revolt was crushed in 1795; the British seized the colony in 1796, restored it under the 1802 Peace of Amiens, retook it in 1803, and received formal cession in 1814.
zh:
德梅拉拉河从圭亚那中部雨林向北流淌346公里，注入水浅的大西洋河口。它的洛科诺语名称意为「蛇纹木之河」。1444年，洛科诺人沿河岸和潮汐溪汊活动，以捕鱼、耕作为生，并把这条水道当作往来森林、稀树草原与海岸的通路。此时岸边还没有欧洲堡垒、制糖工场或永久种植园。

德梅拉拉最早在1691年作为贸易站被提及；1745年10月18日，荷兰西印度公司将其设在埃塞奎博属地内尚未殖民的区域，另立为殖民地，并要求定居者与印第安人和平相处，尊重他们的自由和土地。安德里斯·彼得瑟成为第一个种植园主；六个月内，当地已开辟18座大型甘蔗种植园和50处较小农庄。劳伦斯·斯托姆·范·斯赫拉夫桑德起初从泽兰迪亚堡治理此地，1755年行政中心迁往博瑟伦岛，河口附近的哨站则发展为斯塔布鲁克。被奴役的非洲人承担了这场繁荣背后的劳动。1763年2月23日，科菲领导的伯比斯起义爆发，范·斯赫拉夫桑德与洛科诺、卡利纳、瓦劳和阿卡瓦约战士结盟，阻止起义蔓延到德梅拉拉，同时派出50名士兵东援。到1780年，河两岸已有近200座种植园。英军1781年兵不血刃占领德梅拉拉，法军1782年又将其夺取，1783年《巴黎条约》把它归还荷兰。1795年，西德梅拉拉的奴隶起义被镇压；英军1796年夺取殖民地，1802年依《亚眠和约》归还，1803年再度占领，并于1814年正式获得割让。

en:
Paramaribo lies on the west bank of the Suriname River, about ten kilometres from the Atlantic. In 1444 this low coast was a country of creeks, mangroves and raised village mounds. Lokono (Arawak) communities grew cassava on the higher ground, fished the river mouth and traded along the shore, while Kalina (Carib) groups also moved between the coast and savanna. The earliest Dutch records called an indigenous village near the river mouth Parmurbo, from which the later town took its name. No European power yet held the Guianas, and the canoe routes into the interior belonged to their indigenous users.

In 1613 Nicolaes Baliestel and Dirck Claeszoon van Sanen set up a Dutch trading post at Parmurbo; French and English traders also tried posts nearby. In 1650 settlers sent by Francis Willoughby, governor of Barbados, founded the English colony of Surinam, and in 1651 they strengthened the post as Fort Willoughby. During the Second Anglo-Dutch War a Zeeland squadron under Abraham Crijnssen sailed up the Suriname River and took the fort after a three-hour fight. The Treaty of Breda in 1667 confirmed Dutch control; the stronghold was renamed Fort Zeelandia and Paramaribo became the colony's chief town. The Society of Suriname, chartered in 1683, organized river plantations where enslaved Africans produced sugar, coffee, cocoa and cotton. Many escaped into rainforest Maroon communities, and eighteenth-century wars and treaties forced the colonial authorities to recognize inland Maroon territory and trading rights. British forces occupied Suriname from 1799 to 1802 and again from 1804 to 1816. In January 1821 a fire destroyed more than 400 buildings in the wooden town.
zh:
帕拉马里博位于苏里南河西岸，距大西洋约十公里。1444年，这片低海岸河汊纵横、红树林密布，村落建在堆高的土岗上。洛科诺（阿拉瓦克）人在高地种植木薯，在河口捕鱼并沿岸交易；卡利纳（加勒比）人也往来于海岸与草原之间。最早的荷兰文献把河口附近的原住民村落称作帕尔穆尔博，后来的城市便由此得名。此时还没有欧洲强国占领圭亚那，通向内陆的独木舟水路仍掌握在原住民手中。

1613年，荷兰商人尼古拉斯·巴利斯特尔和迪尔克·克拉斯松·范萨嫩在帕尔穆尔博设立贸易站，法国和英国商人也先后在附近建立据点。1650年，巴巴多斯总督弗朗西斯·威洛比派来的移民建立英国殖民地苏里南，1651年又把贸易站加固为威洛比堡。第二次英荷战争中，亚伯拉罕·克莱因森率领泽兰舰队沿苏里南河而上，经三小时战斗夺取要塞。1667年《布雷达和约》确认荷兰的控制权，堡垒改名泽兰迪亚堡，帕拉马里博成为殖民地首城。1683年获许成立的苏里南协会经营沿河种植园，奴役非洲人种植甘蔗、咖啡、可可和棉花。许多人逃入雨林形成马龙社群，18世纪的战争与和约迫使殖民当局承认马龙人的内陆领地和贸易权。英军在1799—1802年、1804—1816年两度占领苏里南。1821年1月，这座木结构城市发生大火，400多栋建筑被毁。

en:
Cayenne occupies an island at the shared mouth of the Cayenne and Montsinéry rivers, behind a mangrove coast. In 1444 Arawak and Palikur groups fished the beaches and creek mouths, while Kali'na (Galibi) communities held much of the shore and nearby islands. They grew cassava and moved by dugout along the coast; a hill above the river would later be named after the Galibi chief Cépérou. No European settlement yet interrupted that canoe-borne world.

Christopher Columbus's fleet sailed along the Guianese coast on 5 August 1498, but Spain never occupied Cayenne. In 1643 Charles Poncet de Brétigny brought 400 French settlers, bought a hill from the Galibis, named it Mont Cépérou and built Fort Cépérou. His introduction of slavery and harsh treatment of indigenous people helped provoke revolt, and by 1648 only 25 French settlers remained. Dutch traders occupied the ruins and, from 1660, developed sugar works around Fort Nassau. In May 1664 Joseph-Antoine Le Febvre de La Barre and Alexandre de Prouville de Tracy took the colony for France. An English force from Suriname sacked Cayenne in August 1667, though the Treaty of Breda returned it to French rule. A Dutch fleet under Jacob Binckes captured the town in March 1676, only for Jean d'Estrées to retake it on the night of 21 December. The surrounding plantations then expanded with enslaved African labour, producing sugar, indigo, cotton and spices. The French Convention abolished slavery in 1794 and the decree was proclaimed in Guiana on 14 June; Napoleon restored it in December 1802. An Anglo-Portuguese force took Cayenne in 1809 and administered it from Brazil until the last occupiers withdrew in 1817.
zh:
卡宴地处卡宴河与蒙特西内里河共同河口的岛屿，前方是红树林海岸。1444年，阿拉瓦克人和帕利库尔人在滩涂与河口捕鱼，卡利纳（加利比）人则据有大片海岸和近岸岛屿。他们种植木薯，乘独木舟沿岸往来；河畔一座高地后来以加利比首领塞佩鲁命名。此时还没有欧洲人定居，这里仍是独木舟串联的世界。

1498年8月5日，克里斯托弗·哥伦布的船队沿圭亚那海岸航行，但西班牙从未占领卡宴。1643年，夏尔·庞塞·德·布雷蒂尼率400名法国移民前来，从加利比人手中买下一座高地，命名为塞佩鲁山并修建塞佩鲁堡。他引入奴隶制，又严酷对待原住民，终于引发反抗，到1648年只剩25名法国移民。荷兰商人随后占据废墟，1660年起在拿骚堡一带经营制糖设施。1664年5月，约瑟夫-安托万·勒费夫尔·德·拉巴尔与亚历山大·德·普鲁维尔·德·特拉西为法国夺取殖民地。1667年8月，一支来自苏里南的英军洗劫卡宴，但《布雷达和约》仍将此地归还法国。1676年3月，雅各布·宾克斯率荷兰舰队攻占卡宴，让·德斯特雷则在12月21日夜收复。此后，周围种植园依靠非洲奴隶劳动扩张，出产蔗糖、靛蓝、棉花和香料。法国国民公会1794年废除奴隶制，法令于6月14日在圭亚那公布；拿破仑又在1802年12月恢复奴隶制。1809年，英葡联军攻占卡宴并由巴西的葡萄牙当局管理，最后一批占领军直到1817年才撤离。

en:
The mangrove coast and seasonally flooded plains of Amapá lie on the north side of the Amazon delta. In 1444 the country behind the shore was held by Arawak- and Carib-speaking peoples, among them the Tucuju, Waiãpi, Palikur and Maracá-Cunani, who farmed raised earth plots, fished and managed groves of bacaba palms. The rivers and channels gave access to the Amazon mouth, but there was no European town or permanent garrison here.

Vicente Yáñez Pinzón sighted this coast in February 1500. During the early seventeenth-century struggle for the delta, Portuguese expeditions from Pará destroyed English and Dutch posts, including the Dutch forts at Muturu and Nassau; in 1637 the Crown granted the Captaincy of Cabo do Norte. French claims survived the 1713 Treaty of Utrecht. A Portuguese military post was set up in 1738, São José de Macapá was founded on 4 February 1758, and work on its riverside fortress ran from 1764 to its inauguration on 19 March 1782. In 1808-1809 Luso-Brazilian and British forces used the area as a base against Cayenne.
zh:
阿马帕的红树林海岸与季节性泛滥平原位于亚马孙三角洲北岸。1444年，海岸后方的土地由阿拉瓦克语和加勒比语诸族群掌握，包括图库鲁人、瓦亚皮人、帕利库尔人和马拉卡-库纳尼人；他们垒起土台耕作、捕鱼，并经营巴卡巴棕榈林。河汊通向亚马孙河口，但此时欧洲人的城镇和常驻要塞尚未出现。

1500年2月，维森特·亚涅斯·平松望见这片海岸。17世纪初争夺三角洲时，来自帕拉的葡萄牙远征军摧毁英国与荷兰据点，其中包括荷兰的穆图鲁和拿骚要塞；1637年，葡萄牙王室封授北角都督辖区。1713年《乌得勒支和约》签订后，法国仍未放弃声索。葡萄牙1738年设立军站，圣若泽·德·马卡帕于1758年2月4日建立；河畔要塞1764年动工，1782年3月19日启用。1808至1809年，葡属巴西与英国军队以此地为基地进攻卡宴。

en:
Guajará Bay, where the Guamá River enters the Pará channel beside Marajó Island, was Tupinambá and Pacajá country in 1444. The Tupinambá knew the broad water as Guaçu Paraná, and their canoes used the igarapés and flooded forests to move between fishing grounds, gardens and camp sites on the edge of the Amazon. No European fort yet commanded the gateway between the great river and the Atlantic, although Marajoara exchange networks had long given the bay value beyond a simple anchorage.

In 1615 Francisco Caldeira Castelo Branco was sent from Portuguese Brazil to check French, Dutch and English trade up the Amazon. On 12 January 1616 he founded Feliz Lusitânia on the bay and raised the straw-roofed wooden Forte do Presépio, the nucleus of Belém. The Tupinambá rose under Guaimiaba and took the fort in January 1619; their attacks paused only for the chief's funeral before resistance continued into 1621. The Portuguese established the Haver-o-Peso customs post in 1625, taxing European goods and Amazonian forest produce, and Bento Maciel Parente strengthened the fort after his 1639 campaign against the Tapajós. The settlement, named Santa Maria de Belém do Grão-Pará, received city status in 1655. Sugar gave way to cattle, then rice, cotton and coffee in the eighteenth century, and in 1772 Belém became the capital of the separate State of Grão-Pará and Rio Negro, brought under the Brazilian colonial administration only in 1775.
zh:
瓜雅拉湾位于瓜马河注入帕拉河道、邻近马拉若岛的地方，1444年时是图皮南巴人与帕卡雅人的土地。图皮南巴人把这片宽阔水域称为瓜苏巴拉纳，他们的独木舟穿行于溪流和泛滥林间，往来亚马逊边缘的渔场、园圃和营地。此时还没有欧洲要塞控制这条大河通往大西洋的门户，但马拉若人的交换网络早已使这里不只是普通锚地。
