His son Yermak Mamrukov tried to unite the volosts of Berezov district in 1662 and 1663 and make Berezov his own base; the plot was uncovered and he was hanged there. By then the ostrog had become the permanent Obdorsk zastava, collecting yasak and guarding river traffic. In 1679 Prince Ginda Molikov won the right to petition Moscow directly, and later Obdorsk princes acted as intermediaries with nomadic Nenets. The fortifications were dismantled in 1807, leaving Obdorsk as a river village and volost centre.
zh:
鄂毕多尔斯克地区位于鄂毕河下游，大河在这里离开北方森林，穿过冻原流向卡拉海。1444年，河畔高地普尔诺瓦特-沃什是北汉特人鄂毕多尔公国的都城，狐狸是其王公徽记。这里的统治者与利亚平王公保持婚姻和军事联系，抵御孔达公国的袭扰，并在冻原边缘与涅涅茨人的营地相邻；贵族、战士和纳贡部众奉行萨满教与万物有灵仪式。莫斯科的军队此时尚未抵达北极鄂毕河。

1500年，鄂毕多尔王公接受莫斯科的保护，「鄂毕多尔」称号很快进入莫斯科大公头衔。直接统治要到1595年才到来：哥萨克在普尔诺瓦特-沃什修建鄂毕多尔斯克寨堡，这是俄国在西伯利亚最北的要塞。1600年，一位鄂毕多尔王公在莫斯科受洗，取名瓦西里；两年后，圣瓦西里教堂建起，但俄国权力仍要依靠与本地王公的妥协。1631年，马姆鲁克王公鼓动涅涅茨人进攻曼加杰亚。他的儿子叶尔马克·马姆鲁科夫在1662至1663年试图联合别列佐夫县各乡，以别列佐夫为自己的据点；密谋败露后，他在那里被绞死。此时寨堡已改为常住的鄂毕多尔关卡，负责征收牙萨克和守卫河路。1679年，金达·莫利科夫王公获得绕开托博尔斯克督军、直接向莫斯科请愿的权利；后来的鄂毕多尔王公则充当俄国与游牧涅涅茨人之间的中间人。1807年防御工事拆除，鄂毕多尔斯克成为河畔村庄和乡治中心。

en:
Berezov province lies on the North Sosva route between the lower Ob and the Northern Urals. In 1444 the Khanty settlement of Sugmut Vosh stood among birch woods and fisheries in the country of the Konda princes. Hunters and traders used its rivers and portages toward the Taz fur country, the land later known around Mangazeya. There was no Russian ostrog here, only a Khanty river town and the trails carrying sable toward Arctic and Ural routes.

Nikifor Trakhaniotov and Mikhail Volkonsky founded a fortress on the site in 1593 while Konda was being annexed. Berezov guarded the western approaches to Mangazeya, collected fur tribute and became one of the early Siberian service towns. Fires largely destroyed it in 1642 and 1719, and much of the Mangazeya traffic had shifted south to Verkhoturye by the late seventeenth century as the northern fur grounds were worked out. Its remoteness then gave the town a different use. A special exile ostrog was built in 1724. Alexander Menshikov, the powerful favourite of Peter the Great, died in Berezov in 1729 with his family; his daughter Maria, once meant to marry Peter II, is buried by the old cathedral. Alexei Dolgorukov and his family were confined there in 1730, and Andrei Ostermann died there after Empress Elizabeth banished him in 1742. In 1740 the French astronomer Joseph-Nicolas Delisle reached Berezov to observe a transit of Mercury, only for cloud to cover the sky. Mid-century gold finds made Siberia's first important gold mine nearby, worked by serfs and convicts.
zh:
别列佐夫地区位于北索西瓦河通道上，这条河路连接下鄂毕河与北乌拉尔山。1444年，汉特人的聚落苏姆特沃什坐落在孔达王公境内的桦林和渔场之间。猎人与商人经这里的河道和连水陆路，前往塔兹河一带的毛皮之地，也就是后来以曼加杰亚闻名的地区。此时这里还没有俄国寨堡，只有一座汉特河镇，以及把紫貂送往北极和乌拉尔商路的猎道。

1593年俄国兼并孔达期间，尼基福尔·特拉哈尼奥托夫和米哈伊尔·沃尔孔斯基在聚落旧址修建要塞。别列佐夫守卫通往曼加杰亚的西部门户，负责征收毛皮贡赋，成为西伯利亚最早的军役城镇之一。1642年和1719年的大火几乎将它焚毁；到17世纪后期，北方毛皮源渐趋枯竭，曼加杰亚商路的大量贸易南移至韦尔霍图里耶。偏远随后给这座城镇带来另一种用途。1724年，这里建起专门的流放寨堡。彼得大帝的宠臣亚历山大·缅希科夫与家人在1729年死于别列佐夫；他的女儿玛丽亚曾被许配给彼得二世，葬在旧大教堂旁。1730年，阿列克谢·多尔戈鲁科夫全家被软禁于此；安德烈·奥斯特曼在伊丽莎白女皇1742年将他流放后死在这里。1740年，法国天文学家德利斯勒远道而来，准备观测水星凌日，却被云层挡住视线。18世纪中期，附近发现金矿，成为西伯利亚第一座重要金矿，劳力是农奴和囚犯。

en:
Qashliq, also called Isker or Sibir, was the fortress on the middle Irtysh that gave the northern fur lands their political centre. The strongpoint stood on the river's right bank, seventeen kilometres above later Tobolsk. Khanty, Mansi and Selkup hunters lived in the forests and paid sable tribute, while Siberian Tatar beks of the Taibugid house controlled the river towns from Chimgi-Tura. In 1444 these lands were a remote northern appanage of Abu'l-Khayr Khan's Uzbek ulus. The Tatar ruling house was Sunni Muslim, among the northernmost Muslim rulers of the period, while many of its forest subjects still followed shamans.

As Golden Horde power split apart, the Shaybanid Ibak built an independent Tyumen khanate and seized Chimgi-Tura. Around 1495 the Taibugid Muhammad killed Ibak and moved his capital from Chimgi-Tura to Qashliq; the state then became known as the Khanate of Sibir. Shaybanid and Taibugid princes continued to contest the throne. After Ivan IV took Kazan in 1552, Yadigar Khan sought Moscow's protection, but Kuchum, a grandson of Ibak, overthrew him in 1563, stopped the sable payments and pressed Islam among the Tatar and forest populations.

Kuchum's attacks on Stroganov trading posts brought the Cossack ataman Yermak east with 840 men. On 26 October 1582, after winning at Chuvash Cape, Yermak occupied Qashliq. Kuchum withdrew into the steppe, and in 1585 his men surprised Yermak's camp and killed him. Muscovite commanders then secured the river route with permanent forts: Tyumen in 1586 and Tobolsk in 1587. Qashliq did not keep its place beside the new strongpoints; in 1588, after a Tatar prince was seized there, its inhabitants abandoned the old fortress. Kuchum fought on until 1598, when he was defeated on the Ob and fled to the Nogai steppe. His khanate's name, Sibir, passed to the whole country east of the Urals.
zh:
喀什里克又称伊斯克尔或失必儿，坐落在额尔齐斯河中游右岸，在后来的托博尔斯克上游约17公里，是北方毛皮之地的政治中心。森林中的汉特、曼西和谢尔库普猎人缴纳紫貂皮，泰布吉家族的西伯利亚鞑靼伯克则以成吉-图拉为中心控制各处河上据点。1444年，这里是阿布勒海尔汗乌兹别克兀鲁思偏远的北方封地。统治家族信奉逊尼派伊斯兰教，属当时最靠北的穆斯林统治者之一，而许多森林属民仍信奉萨满教。

金帐汗国分裂时，昔班尼系的伊巴克建立独立的秋明汗国并夺取成吉-图拉。约1495年，泰布吉系的穆罕默德击杀伊巴克，把都城从成吉-图拉迁到喀什里克，这个国家此后称西伯利亚汗国。昔班尼系与泰布吉系王公仍持续争夺汗位。1552年伊凡四世攻灭喀山后，叶吉格尔汗向莫斯科寻求庇护，但伊巴克之孙库楚姆于1563年推翻他，停止缴纳紫貂贡，并向鞑靼居民和森林诸部推行伊斯兰教。

库楚姆袭击斯特罗加诺夫家族的商站，后者便派哥萨克首领叶尔马克率840人东进。1582年10月26日，叶尔马克在楚瓦什角取胜后进占喀什里克。库楚姆退入草原，于1585年派人突袭叶尔马克的营地并将其杀死。莫斯科督军随后用永久要塞控制这条河路：1586年筑秋明，1587年筑托博尔斯克。喀什里克未能在新要塞旁维持下去；1588年一名鞑靼王公在此被俘后，居民放弃了旧堡。库楚姆坚持到1598年，最终在鄂毕河畔战败，逃往诺盖草原。他的汗国之名「失必儿」，被用来称呼乌拉尔山以东的整片土地。

en:
The Tura valley lies where the Siberian forest opens into grassland and the Tyumen Portage carries travel between the northern rivers and the old roads toward the Volga and Central Asia. Sable and squirrel pelts from Khanty and Mansi hunting grounds moved south through this country, and the Tatar town of Chimgi-Tura on the Tyumenka collected them. The town was the early seat of the Taibugid khans, a Muslim ruling house over Siberian Tatar herdsmen and largely shamanist Khanty, Mansi and Selkup forest peoples. The name Tyumen appears in a Russian chronicle in 1406. In 1444, as the Golden Horde broke apart, the country lay within Abu'l-Khayr's Uzbek confederation, while Taibugid and Shaybanid Chinggisids disputed the khan's title.

Around 1493 the Taibugid Muhammad killed the Shaybanid Ibak and moved his capital north to Qashliq, also called Sibir. The contest resumed when Kuchum, a Shaybanid, seized the throne in 1563, pressed Islam on his forest subjects and raided the trading posts of the Stroganov family. The Stroganovs sent Yermak east with 840 Cossacks. They stormed Chimgi-Tura on 1 August 1581, broke Kuchum at Chuvash Cape in 1582 and occupied Qashliq. Kuchum's men ambushed and killed Yermak in 1584, and the khan himself was not finally defeated on the Ob until 1598. On 29 July 1586 Tsar Fyodor ordered a wooden fort raised on the ruins of the Tatar town. Tyumen became the first Russian settlement in Siberia, held by streltsy and Cossacks against Tatar and Kalmyk raiders. A post station followed in 1605, Trinity Monastery in 1616, and stronger fortifications in 1640-1642. By the eighteenth century the garrison town had become a fur, leather and blacksmith market between central Russia, Siberia and China, with about seven thousand people in 1763.
zh:
图拉河谷位于西伯利亚森林接入草原的地带，秋明连水陆路把北方水系与通往伏尔加河、中亚的老路连接起来。汉特人和曼西人猎地出产的紫貂、灰鼠皮张经此南运，秋明卡河畔的鞑靼城镇钦吉-图拉负责收拢皮货。这座城镇早年是台不花别系诸汗的驻地，穆斯林王族统治着西伯利亚鞑靼牧民，以及大多仍信萨满的汉特、曼西和塞尔库普森林居民。1406年的一部俄国编年史已经出现「秋明」之名。1444年金帐汗国瓦解，这片土地处在阿布勒海尔的乌兹别克联盟范围内，台不花别系与昔班系的成吉思汗后裔正在争夺汗位。

约1493年，台不花别系的穆罕默德杀死昔班系的伊巴克，把都城北迁到又称失必儿的卡什雷克。1563年，昔班系的库楚姆夺取汗位，向森林属民推行伊斯兰教，并袭掠斯特罗加诺夫家族的商站。斯特罗加诺夫家族派叶尔马克率领八百四十名哥萨克东征。1581年8月1日，他们攻下钦吉-图拉；1582年在楚瓦什岬击败库楚姆，进占卡什雷克。1584年，库楚姆的人马伏击并杀死叶尔马克，库楚姆本人则到1598年才在鄂毕河畔最终战败。1586年7月29日，沙皇费奥多尔一世下诏在鞑靼旧城废墟上修建木堡。秋明成为俄国人在西伯利亚的第一处定居点，由射击军和哥萨克驻守，防范鞑靼与卡尔梅克袭掠者。1605年这里设置驿站，1616年三一修道院建成，1640至1642年又加固城防。到18世纪，这座军堡城镇已经成为俄罗斯中部、西伯利亚与中国之间的毛皮、皮革和铁匠业市场，1763年约有七千居民。

en:
Kurgan covers the middle Tobol in the southern Trans-Urals, where birch woods and forest-steppe give way to open grassland. Long before any Russian settlement, burial mounds called kurgans rose above its pastures, and the large mound beside the later fort gave the town its name. Tatar and Siberian inhabitants hunted furs, raised cattle and horses, and moved between river meadows and dry grazing. In 1444 the Tobol lands were ruled by Tatar beks of the Tyumen country, within Abu'l-Khayr Khan's Uzbek ulus. No fixed Russian town stood there yet.

Yermak's 1582 campaign opened the Tobol to Muscovite forts and peasant settlements. The strongest local post came later: in 1679 Timofey Nevezhin, a farmer from Tyumen, founded Tsaryovo Gorodishche, or Imperial Citadel, on the river. Its wooden stockade covered nearby Russian villages against nomad raids, although attackers several times plundered and burned the post itself. In 1782 Empress Catherine II granted the settlement town rights, made it the seat of an uyezd and renamed it Kurgan after the burial mound beside the old fort.
zh:
库尔干位于南乌拉尔以东的托博尔河中游，白桦林和森林草原逐渐让位于开阔草场。俄国村落出现以前，牧场上已矗立着许多被称为库尔干的古墓；后来要塞旁的大墓又给城镇提供了名字。当地鞑靼与西伯利亚居民猎取毛皮、饲养牛马，在河漫滩和干旱牧场之间转场。1444年，托博尔河一带由秋明地方的鞑靼伯克统治，归入阿布勒海尔汗的乌兹别克兀鲁思，固定的俄国城镇尚未出现。

1582年叶尔马克远征后，莫斯科的要塞和农民村落沿托博尔河推进。本地最重要的据点出现较晚：1679年，来自秋明的农民季莫费·涅韦任在河畔建立皇堡村，名字意为「皇城」。木栅栏护卫附近的俄国村屯抵御游牧民袭扰，但据点本身也几度遭劫掠焚毁。1782年，叶卡捷琳娜二世授予它城市权利，定为县治，并依旧堡旁的古墓将其命名为库尔干。

en:
The Usolka runs into the Kama in Great Perm, the Komi-Permyak country whose princes held Cherdyn and Pokcha while fur traders used the upper Kama and its portages. Around 1430 merchants from Vologda, the Kalinnikov family, began boiling brine on the Borovaya; when its springs proved weak they moved to the Usolka and raised brine pipes, towers and vats on the bank. The works became Usolye Kamskoye, the salt town later called Solikamsk. In 1444 it was a young industrial settlement of the Perm princes, profitable but exposed to Mansi raiders from beyond the Urals.

Moscow subjected Great Perm in 1472, and Ivan IV's charter of 1558 to the Stroganovs opened the Kama lands to wider settlement. The 1579 survey found a fortified posad of 190 households, 16 saltworks and 26 shops; two years later Pelym prince Kihek burned the town in a Mansi and Tatar raid. Artemy Babinov's road to Verkhoturye, opened in 1597, made Sol Kamskaya the starting point of the only overland road from European Russia into Siberia. Voivodes were appointed from 1613, and the Pyskor works that opened in 1635 was the first copper smelter in Russia; a later copper factory made samovars and table services for the imperial family. By the 1680s the district had 249 saltworks, 78 of them Stroganov property, and Solikamsk boiled more than half of the salt sold in Russia. It entered Siberia Governorate in 1708. Ninety-seven Swedish prisoners of the Great Northern War were billeted in the town in 1711, among them Captain Philipp von Strahlenberg, who went on to make the first study of Ural antiquities. A newer Siberian highway through Perm and Kungur then bypassed the town; Solikamsk became a uyezd town in 1781, and by the early nineteenth century lived on smaller soap, glass and leather works.
zh:
乌索尔卡河在大彼尔姆的土地上注入卡马河。这里是科米-彼尔姆人的家园，彼尔姆王公据有切尔登和波克恰，毛皮商人利用卡马河上游和各处连水陆路往来。约1430年，来自沃洛格达的商人卡林尼科夫家族先在博罗瓦亚河煮盐，因卤水淡薄，又转到乌索尔卡河畔，竖起提卤管、井塔和煮盐灶。这片盐场就是乌索利耶卡姆斯科耶，后来得名索利卡姆斯克。1444年时，它是彼尔姆王公治下一座新兴的工业聚落，靠盐获利，也时常遭到乌拉尔山外曼西人袭扰。

1472年，莫斯科迫使大彼尔姆臣服；1558年，伊凡四世下诏把卡马河一带的大片土地封给斯特罗加诺夫家族，引来更多移民。1579年税册记载，这里已是设防城郊区，有190户、16处盐场和26家店铺；两年后，佩雷姆王公基赫克在曼西人和鞑靼人的袭掠中烧毁全城。1597年，阿尔捷米·巴比诺夫开通通往韦尔霍图里耶的道路，卡姆斯卡亚盐镇成为俄罗斯欧洲部分进入西伯利亚的唯一旱路起点。1613年起向这里派驻督军；1635年投产的佩斯科尔工厂是俄罗斯第一座炼铜厂，后来的铜器厂还生产茶炊和皇室餐具。到1680年代，全地区有249处盐场，其中78处归斯特罗加诺夫家族，索利卡姆斯克出产的盐占俄罗斯市场售盐的一半以上。1708年它划入西伯利亚省。1711年，97名大北方战争中的瑞典战俘被安置到城中，瑞典军上尉菲利普·冯·施特拉伦贝格也在其中，他后来最早系统研究乌拉尔古物。新的西伯利亚大道改经彼尔姆和昆古尔，绕开了这座城；1781年它成为县城，到19世纪初只靠肥皂、玻璃和皮革等小厂维持。

en:
Tura is the upper Tura River country, where the Middle Urals sink low enough to let travellers pass from the Kama basin toward the Ob. Mansi hunters and fishermen, whom Russians called Voguls, lived in timber settlements along the river, keeping reindeer and trapping sable, and Neromkar was one of their strong places on the ground later occupied by Verkhoturye. In the fifteenth century the Mansi were grouped into small principalities such as Pelym and Konda, and southern communities felt the pull of the Tatar khanates. In 1444 Perm and Moscow still lay far beyond the pass: Tura was a pagan Uralic country, and its sable pelts moved through native traders rather than a Russian market.

That pass became valuable once Russia began the conquest of Siberia. A Muscovite river army had already beaten the Mansi prince Asyka near Pelym in 1483, but the first lasting road was Artemy Babinov's route from Solikamsk across the mountains in 1597. Vasily Golovin and Ivan Voyeykov raised the Verkhoturye ostrog on Neromkar the next year, and a customs house followed in 1600. Every winter sledge trains hauled goods from Solikamsk and stacked them in the town until the thaw. Furs paid as yasak went on to the Sable Treasury in Moscow, private pelts leaving Siberia paid a tenth of their value, and guards patrolled the woods to stop merchants slipping around the customs post. In 1695 the government closed every other legal road out of the Kama basin, leaving Verkhoturye the sole gate into Siberia; a men's monastery founded in 1604, the oldest women's monastery beyond the Urals from 1621, and a stone kremlin built between 1698 and 1714 gave the town its permanent shape. When the Siberian Route opened through Yekaterinburg in 1763 the trade drove south, and in 1783 Verkhoturye passed to Perm Viceroyalty, by then a quiet monastery and old-road town.
zh:
图拉是图拉河上游一带，中乌拉尔山在这里低伏下来，留出一条从卡马河流域通往鄂毕河流域的通道。曼西人（俄罗斯人旧称沃古尔人）是这里的居民：猎人和渔夫住在河畔的木寨里，养鹿、捕紫貂，涅罗姆卡尔便是他们的据点之一，后来的韦尔霍图里耶就建在这片地上。15世纪的曼西人分成佩雷姆、孔达等小公国，南部各部受鞑靼汗国影响。1444年，彼尔姆和莫斯科仍远在山口之外，图拉是信奉本地信仰的乌拉尔地方，紫貂皮经本地商人之手流转，还不进俄国市场。

俄国征服西伯利亚之后，这个山口身价倍增。莫斯科水路军队早在1483年就在佩雷姆附近击败曼西王公阿西卡，但第一条常年通行的路是阿尔捷米·巴比诺夫1597年探出的路线，从索利卡姆斯克翻越山岭。次年，瓦西里·戈洛文和伊万·沃耶伊科夫在涅罗姆卡尔筑起韦尔霍图里耶寨堡，1600年又设海关。每年冬天，雪橇队把货物从索利卡姆斯克拉来，堆在城里等开春解冻。作为牙萨克上缴的毛皮继续运往莫斯科的紫貂库，私商带出西伯利亚的毛皮要缴纳十分之一的税，林中还有巡逻队防备商人绕关。1695年，官府封闭了卡马河流域其他所有合法出路，只留韦尔霍图里耶这一道进入西伯利亚的大门；1604年创办的男修道院、1621年设立的乌拉尔山以东最古老的女修道院，以及1698年至1714年建起的石砌克里姆林宫，使小城初具规模。1763年西伯利亚大路改走叶卡捷琳堡，商路南移；1783年韦尔霍图里耶改隶彼尔姆总督区，那时已是一座安静的修道院城镇和旧路驿站。

en:
The Vyatka country fills the forested river basin that joins the Volga system northeast of Moscow. Its older population was Permian, the ancestors of the Udmurts; Russian settlers traditionally linked with Novgorod built Khlynov on the Vyatka, and the settlement enters reliable chronicles in 1374, when Vyatka boatmen sailed to Sarai on a raid. Those boatmen were ushkuyniki, fighters in shallow-draft vessels that could be carried across portages. Thick forests separated Khlynov, Kotelnich and Orlov from Moscow, and a popular assembly ran local affairs. In 1444 the land was not an ordinary Muscovite district: its boyars and armed merchants had backed Yury of Galich and Dmitry Shemyaka against Vasily II, and they bargained with Moscow and Kazan as their own wars required.

Vasily II's first two commanders failed outside Khlynov, reportedly after being bought off, and the third campaign forced submission in 1459. Khan Ibrahim of Kazan then extracted a promise that Vyatka would not join Moscow's campaigns against him. Ivan III ended the arrangement in 1489: Daniil Shchenya took Kotelnich and Orlov, besieged Khlynov, and deported its leading families after three atamans were executed in Moscow. The town later made its living as a mart. Siberian furs reached its Semyonovskaya fair with goods from the Urals and the White Sea country; the five-domed Assumption Cathedral went up in 1689, and five years later the merchant Spiridon Lyangusov led the first Russian trade caravan from Moscow to China.
zh:
维亚特卡指莫斯科东北、接入伏尔加水系的森林河流域。这里的原住民是彼尔姆人，即乌德穆尔特人的先民；相传与诺夫哥罗德有关的罗斯拓殖者在维亚特卡河畔建起赫雷诺夫。它在可靠编年史中首次出现于1374年，当时维亚特卡河兵乘船劫掠萨莱。这些河兵叫乌什库伊尼克，驾着可以拖过联运道的浅水船。密林把赫雷诺夫、科捷利尼奇和奥尔洛夫与莫斯科隔开，本地事务由市民会议处理。1444年的维亚特卡并不是安分的莫斯科属地：贵族和武装商人曾支持加利奇的尤里与德米特里·舍米亚卡对抗瓦西里二世，又按战事需要在莫斯科和喀山之间讨价还价。

瓦西里二世的前两任将领在赫雷诺夫城下失败，据说还被收买；第三次出征才在1459年迫使它臣服。喀山汗易卜拉欣随后逼维亚特卡许诺，不随莫斯科进攻喀山。1489年，伊凡三世终结了这种状态：丹尼尔·谢尼亚攻占科捷利尼奇和奥尔洛夫，围困赫雷诺夫；三名阿塔曼被解往莫斯科处死后，望族也被迁居他地。后来这座城靠商站立稳，西伯利亚毛皮连同乌拉尔和白海地区的货物来到谢苗诺夫市集；五穹顶的圣母安息大教堂建于1689年，五年后，商人斯皮里东·良古索夫率领第一支从莫斯科前往中国的俄国商队。

en:
Pelym is the cold northern Ural country around the meeting of the Pelym River and the Tavda, a land of taiga, portages and the old Cherdyn road across the mountains into Siberia. It was the seat of the Pelym princes, one of the Mansi (Vogul) chiefdoms whose hunters and reindeer herders trapped sable and travelled between the Kama and Ob basins. In 1444 Muscovite power stopped far to the west, and Pelym remained a pagan Uralic strongpoint from which Mansi raiding parties struck the Perm lands; furs, river routes and forest craft made the small chiefdom count for more than its population.

In 1455 Prince Asyka raided Ust-Vym, killed Bishop Pitirim and carried his plunder back to Pelym; a Muscovite river army under Fyodor Kurbsky-Cherny and Ivan Saltyk-Travin beat him outside Pelym on 29 July 1483, though Asyka got away. The last Pelym prince, Ablegirim, was defeated while the Russians secured the Cherdyn route and was taken with his family as hostages to Moscow. Cherdyn voivodes Pyotr Gorchakov and Nikifor Trakhaniotov built the Pelym ostrog on the site of his moving camp in 1591-1593, marking the eastern end of the road from Europe. A prefabricated timber fort was floated down from Upper Lozva in 1597 with the family of Ignaty Khripunov, the first Russians exiled to Siberia; Uglich townspeople implicated in the death of Tsarevich Dmitry followed, along with streltsy and Cossacks. Pelym served as a customs and yasak station on the Tavda, but the shorter Babinov road soon drew the Siberian trade south. Burned twice in the seventeenth century and twice rebuilt, it lived on as a remote place of exile for grandees: the Duke of Courland, Ernst Johann von Biron, was held here in 1741-1742, and Field Marshal Burkhard von Munnich from 1742 to 1762.
zh:
佩雷姆地处北乌拉尔的严寒地带，佩雷姆河与塔夫达河在此相汇，泰加林、水陆联运的渡口和翻山西伯利亚的古切尔登路都在这里。曼西人（俄罗斯人旧称沃古尔人）的佩雷姆王公以此为据点，部众猎紫貂、养鹿，往来于卡马河与鄂毕河流域之间。1444年，莫斯科的势力远止于西方，佩雷姆仍是信奉本地信仰的乌拉尔据点，曼西袭掠队从这里奔袭彼尔姆诸地；毛皮、河路与林中本事，让这个人口不多的小公国分量不轻。

1455年，王公阿西卡袭破乌斯季-维姆，杀死皮季里姆主教，带着战利品退回佩雷姆；1483年7月29日，费奥多尔·库尔布斯基-乔尔内和伊万·萨尔特科夫-特拉温率莫斯科水路军队在佩雷姆城外将他击败，阿西卡却脱身逃走。俄国人肃清切尔登路时，末代佩雷姆王公阿布列吉里姆兵败，与家人一起被作为人质送往莫斯科。1591年至1593年间，切尔登督军彼得·戈尔恰科夫和尼基福尔·特拉哈尼奥托夫在他移动王帐的旧址筑起佩雷姆寨堡，这里便是欧洲来路的东端。1597年，一座预制木寨从上洛兹瓦顺流漂来，同行的伊格纳特·赫里普诺夫一家是最早被流放西伯利亚的俄国人；因皇储德米特里之死获罪的乌格利奇市民随后也被押来，同行的还有射击军和哥萨克。佩雷姆本是塔夫达河上的海关兼牙萨克征收点，但更短的巴比诺夫路很快把西伯利亚贸易引向南方。它在17世纪两度焚毁又两度重建，此后作为遥远的要人流放地存续：库尔兰公爵恩斯特·约翰·冯·比龙1741年至1742年被囚于此，陆军元帅布尔克哈德·冯·明尼希1742年至1762年流放于此。

en:
Above the Samara Bend the Volga's right bank rises into a steep ridge called the Venets, on which the Russians later built Simbirsk; on the opposite bank stood the old Bulgar stronghold remembered as the Sinbirskoye gorodishche, which gave the place its name. After the break-up of the Golden Horde this country belonged to the Khanate of Kazan, its riverbank dotted with Tatar villages and weathered Bulgar earthworks, while the open steppe to the south and east was Nogai grazing ground. In 1444 there was no town here, only river landings and abandoned fortifications.

In 1648 the voevoda Bogdan Khitrovo, acting for Tsar Alexei Mikhailovich, raised a wooden eight-towered kremlin on the Venets to close the eastern end of the Belgorod defence line against raiders from the steppe. In the autumn of 1670 Stepan Razin's army battered the kremlin for a month and four assaults were beaten off; on 4 October Razin was twice wounded fighting Voevoda Baryatinsky's troops, and his men carried him to a boat and fled down the Volga. His ataman Fyodor Sheludyak failed before the same walls the following summer, and the tsar granted the town its first coat of arms for the two defences. Royal exiles and travellers also stopped here: in 1666 the widowed queen of Kakheti, Elena, lodged three months on her way to Moscow with her young son Nikoloz, who later ruled as King Erekle I. Peter I, driven ashore by a storm on his voyage to Astrakhan, presented the Trinity Cathedral with an icon of the Mother of God, and Catherine II wrote to Nikita Panin after her visit in 1767 that this was the sorriest town in Russia, every house but her merchant host's confiscated for tax arrears. In October 1774 Alexander Suvorov brought the captured Yemelyan Pugachev here in an iron cage to be interrogated before he was sent on to Moscow. Simbirsk became the seat of its governorate in 1796, and the novelist Ivan Goncharov was born here in 1812.
zh:
萨马拉河湾上游，伏尔加河右岸隆起一道名为「冠冈」的陡岭，俄国人后来在岭上建起辛比尔斯克；对岸立着伏尔加保加利亚时代的古堡辛比尔城址，辛比尔斯克之名即由此而来。金帐汗国瓦解后，这一带归属喀山汗国，河岸散布鞑靼人的村落和风化的保加利亚工事，东南方的开阔草原则是诺盖人的牧场。1444年这里还没有城镇，只有河埠与被弃的旧垒。

1648年，奉沙皇阿列克谢·米哈伊洛维奇之命，督军博格丹·希特罗沃在冠冈筑起八塔木构克里姆林，封住别尔哥罗德防线的东端，用以抵挡草原袭掠。1670年秋，斯捷潘·拉辛的大军围攻克里姆林整整一个月，四次强攻均被击退；10月4日，拉辛在与督军巴里亚京斯基所部交战时两次负伤，被部下抬上小船顺伏尔加河逃走。次年夏天，他的首领费奥多尔·舍卢佳克再攻同一道城墙仍告失败，沙皇因这两次守城赐下城徽。流落的王族也曾在此落脚：1666年，卡赫季王太后叶莲娜带着幼子尼古拉赴莫斯科，途中在此住了三个月，这个孩子后来成为伊拉克利一世。彼得一世乘船前往阿斯特拉罕时为风暴所阻曾在此停泊，向三一教堂赠予一尊圣母像；1767年叶卡捷琳娜二世到访后写信给尼基塔·帕宁，说这是全俄国最破烂的城，除她下榻的商人家外，全城房屋都因欠税被抄没。1774年10月，亚历山大·苏沃洛夫把被俘的叶梅利扬·普加乔夫装进铁笼押到这里审讯，随后转送莫斯科。1796年，辛比尔斯克成为辛比尔斯克省首府，小说家伊万·冈察洛夫1812年出生于此。

en:
Kazan lies where the little Kazanka River runs into the Volga. It began around the turn of the 11th century as a white-stone northern border fortress of Volga Bulgaria, facing the Mari and Udmurt forests, and under the Golden Horde it became the chief market of the middle Volga, coining money as 'New Bolgar' and linking the furs of Perm and Vyatka with Persia and Central Asia. In 1438 the ousted Horde khan Ulugh Muhammad seized the town, ringed it with a timber Kremlin and made it the capital of his new Kazan Khanate; its bazaars dealt in leather, weapons, grain and slaves, and in 1439 his army stood before Moscow. In 1444 Kazan was the strongest Muslim power on the Volga, its horsemen raiding Nizhny Novgorod and Ryazan.

In 1445 the khan crushed a Muscovite army at Suzdal and led Grand Prince Vasily II away captive. Ivan III broke the khanate's freedom after a long siege in 1487 and set a Moscow-backed ruler on the throne; when the Crimean Girey dynasty took power in the 1520s, Kazan launched some forty raids into Russian lands before 1545. The regent Söyembikä, a Nogai princess, held the city for her young son until the Russians built the river fortress of Sviyazhsk nearby in 1551, cutting her off from the Volga. Ivan IV's army closed on Kazan in 1552, breached the walls with mines after forty-nine days and stormed it on 2 October; mosques and palaces were ruined and many Tatars killed, exiled or baptised. The survivors were moved beyond the Bulak stream into the Old Tatar Quarter, while a white-stone Kremlin rose from 1556. In 1579, after a great fire, the girl Matrona dug up in the ruins the icon the Virgin had shown her in a dream, Our Lady of Kazan; Prince Pozharsky carried a copy before the militia that freed Moscow in 1612. Pugachev's rebels burned the wooden city in 1774 but could not take the Kremlin, and under Catherine II the Marjani Mosque became the first mosque lawfully built since the conquest. The Qur'an was printed in Kazan in 1801, and the university founded in 1804 made the city Russia's leading school of Oriental studies.
zh:
喀山位于卡赞卡小河汇入伏尔加河之处。11世纪之交，它本是伏尔加保加利亚一座白色石砌的北部边塞，面向马里人和乌德穆尔特人的森林；金帐汗国时期，它成为伏尔加河中游最大的商埠，以「新保加尔」之名自铸钱币，把彼尔姆和维亚特卡的毛皮同波斯、中亚连通起来。1438年，被逐下台的金帐汗兀鲁·穆罕默德夺取该城，围起木构克里姆林，以新建的喀山汗国为都；市集上交易皮革、兵器、粮食和奴隶，1439年他的大军甚至兵临莫斯科城下。1444年的喀山是伏尔加河上最强大的伊斯兰政权，骑兵四出袭掠下诺夫哥罗德和梁赞。

1445年，喀山军队在苏兹达尔击溃莫斯科军，俘虏大公瓦西里二世而去。1487年，伊凡三世经长期围城攻破喀山，改立受莫斯科支持的统治者；16世纪20年代克里米亚格莱王朝掌权后，到1545年为止喀山约四十次攻入罗斯土地。诺盖公主出身的摄政苏尤姆别卡代幼子守着喀山，直到1551年俄军在附近伏尔加河上筑起斯维亚日斯克要塞，切断了她与伏尔加河的联系。1552年伊凡四世的大军压境，经四十九天围攻，用地雷炸开城墙，10月2日突入喀山；清真寺和宫殿被毁，大批鞑靼居民被杀、流放或受洗。幸存者被迁往布拉克河沟外的老鞑靼街区，白石克里姆林则从1556年起在城中建起。1579年大火之后，女孩马特廖娜按圣母在梦中的指点，在废墟里掘出一尊圣像，即后来的喀山圣母像；1612年波扎尔斯基带着它的摹本，随民军解放莫斯科。1774年普加乔夫起义军焚毁木城，却没能拿下克里姆林；叶卡捷琳娜二世时代，马尔贾尼清真寺成为征服以来第一座获准合法修建的清真寺。1801年喀山印行《古兰经》，1804年创办的大学使这座城市成为俄国首屈一指的东方学中心。

en:
The Vetluga is a long left-bank Volga river through marshy forest, and its middle valley was Mari country, the Cheremis of Russian chronicles. Mari clans held the route between the Northern Dvina and Volga systems: boats and portages carried furs south, while a land road ran from the Kostroma lands deeper into Mari territory. Their stronghold was Yur, probably beside the later town of Vetluga. In the fourteenth century the kuguz Osh Pandash united local clans, brought in Tatar bands, and wore down Prince Andrey of Galich in a nineteen-year war. From 1443 the Mari on this border were tied to Kazan, so in 1444 Yur guarded a fur-hunting people of the old forest faith, between Galich, Nizhny Novgorod and the khanate.

At Epiphany in January 1468, Prince Semyon Yaroslavsky led a Galich army out for Ivan III, marching without roads through a bitterly cold winter. The chronicle says the troops killed or captured people, burned settlements and slaughtered livestock they could not carry away, returning when they were within a day's march of Kazan; Yur was completely burned and the middle Vetluga stayed thinly settled for decades. After Kazan fell in 1552, Mari risings known as the Cheremis Wars continued into the 1580s, and Russian forts along the Volga and Vyatka secured the conquest. Russian peasants resettled the valley and sent grain and timber rafts down to the Volga. A village near Yur became Voskresenskoye, and Catherine II chartered it as the town of Vetluga in 1778. Local legend adds that its petitioners danced in bast shoes before the empress to win the charter.
zh:
韦特卢加河是伏尔加河左岸的长河，穿过多沼泽的森林；其中游是马里人的土地，罗斯编年史称他们为切列米斯人。马里各部控制着北德维纳河水系与伏尔加河水系之间的通道：毛皮随小船和联运道南下，一条陆路又从科斯特罗马地区通向马里腹地。他们的要塞是尤尔，位置大约在后来的韦特卢加城一带。14世纪，首领奥什·潘达什联合各部，招来鞑靼武装，用十九年战争拖垮加利奇王公安德烈。1443年起，这一带的马里人臣属喀山，所以1444年的尤尔护卫着这个仍守山林旧信、以猎取毛皮为生的民族，夹在加利奇、下诺夫哥罗德和喀山汗国之间。

1468年1月主显节，谢苗·雅罗斯拉夫斯基奉伊凡三世之命率领加利奇军队出征，在严寒中离开道路穿越森林。编年史称他们杀戮或掳走人口，焚毁村落，宰杀带不走的牲畜，回师时距喀山只剩一日路程；尤尔被彻底烧毁，韦特卢加中游此后数十年人烟稀少。1552年喀山陷落后，马里人的起义以「切列米斯战争」之名延续到1580年代，伏尔加河和维亚特卡河沿线的俄罗斯要塞巩固了征服。俄罗斯农民重新垦殖河谷，把粮食和木材放排运往伏尔加河。尤尔故址附近的村庄后来成为沃斯克列先斯科耶，1778年由叶卡捷琳娜二世颁诏改建为韦特卢加城。当地传说还称，请愿者穿着树皮鞋在女皇面前跳舞，才换来这道建城诏令。

en:
The estuary of the Swan and Canning Rivers and the wetlands of the coastal plain are Wadjuk country, one of the Noongar lands of south-western Australia. The Swan and Canning divided Wadjuk groups, who followed six seasons rather than a single fixed round: summer families took fish and abalone on the reefs, while winter rains drew them inland toward the Darling Scarp to hunt kangaroo and gather roots. Red ochre from the river country and quartz from the scarp were carried into trade, and the Wagyl was remembered as the being who had shaped the rivers and lakes. In 1444 the harbourless coast was known to Noongar clans, not to European chart-makers.

Dutch ships sighted reefs on the western coast in 1619, but the Swan River itself was not entered until January 1697, when Willem de Vlamingh's expedition landed beside present Perth and named the Swarte Swaene-Revier for its black swans. Vlamingh sailed a short way upstream to the area of Heirisson Island, charted the waters and then departed without founding a settlement. A French expedition under Nicolas Baudin examined the river in 1801. Twenty years later, at the end of 1821, the Wadjuk still moved between the estuary, wetlands and scarp according to their seasonal round, and Perth itself had not yet been founded.
zh:
天鹅河与坎宁河的河口，以及海岸平原上的湿地，是瓦迪尤克（Wadjuk）人的土地，也是澳大利亚西南部农雅（Noongar）诸地之一。天鹅河和坎宁河把瓦迪尤克人的不同居群分隔开来；他们依六季循环安排生活：夏季到礁岩间捕鱼、采鲍鱼，冬季雨水补足内陆水源后，再到达令崖一带猎袋鼠、挖块根。河畔的红赭石和崖地的石英会进入商路，瓦吉尔则被认为塑造了这些河流与湖泊。1444年，欧洲海图还不认识这段缺少良港的海岸，熟悉它的只有农雅诸氏族。

1619年，荷兰船只已经望见西海岸的礁石，但直到1697年1月，威廉·德·弗拉明的探险队才在后来的珀斯附近登陆，因河中黑天鹅而将其命名为天鹅河。弗拉明沿河上溯到海里森岛一带，测绘水势后离去，没有建立定居点。1801年，尼古拉·博丹率领的法国探险队又考察了这条河。又过二十年，到1821年底，瓦迪尤克人仍随季节往返于河口、湿地和崖地之间，珀斯城此时尚未建立。

en:
Paredarerme, also called Oyster Bay Tasmanian, belonged to the peoples of Tasmania's central eastern coast. Their country centred on broad Great Oyster Bay, sheltered by the Freycinet Peninsula and Schouten Island, with Moulting Lagoon behind the shore. From autumn through winter, Oyster Bay bands gathered on the coast for shellfish and sea vegetables. At the end of July, swans and ducks gathered in the lagoon and river country; in August most bands moved up the Little Swanport and Prosser Rivers toward the Eastern Marshes to hunt birds, kangaroos and wallabies, while the Linetemairrener remained at the lagoon all year. In 1444, centuries after the sea had separated Tasmania from the mainland, these rounds linked the bay, rivers and interior as Paredarerme country.

Abel Tasman sighted Van Diemen's Land far to the west on 24 November 1642, but his ships did not enter Oyster Bay. The first recorded European visitor there was John Henry Cox, who sailed the Mercury into the water on 3 July 1789, named it after the seal colonies he had heard of, and met Aboriginal people. British colonists founded Hobart to the south in 1803–04, yet the bay itself remained under Oyster Bay use until 1821, when George Meredith arrived from Wales with his family and workers. With a grant from Lieutenant-Governor William Sorell, he established Great Swanport, later Swansea, opening farms, a tannery, a flour mill and nearby whaling stations.
zh:
帕莱达勒米（Paredarerme）又称牡蛎湾塔斯马尼亚语，通行于塔斯马尼亚岛中东部各族群之间。他们的土地以宽阔的大牡蛎湾为中心，外有弗雷西内半岛和斯豪滕岛遮蔽，岸后是莫尔廷潟湖。秋季至冬季，牡蛎湾各氏族群聚海岸，采集贝类和海菜。7月底天鹅与野鸭聚集在潟湖和河流一带；8月，多数氏族沿小天鹅港河与普罗瑟河上溯到东部沼泽，捕猎鸟类、袋鼠和沙袋鼠，利内特马伊雷纳人（Linetemairrener）则全年住在潟湖旁。1444年，在海水把塔斯马尼亚与大陆隔开数千年后，这些季节性往返仍把海湾、河流与内陆连成帕莱达勒米人的土地。

1642年11月24日，阿贝尔·塔斯曼在遥远的西方望见范迪门地，但他的船没有进入牡蛎湾。有记载第一个来到这座海湾的欧洲人是约翰·亨利·考克斯：1789年7月3日，他乘「水星号」驶入这片水域，因听说有大量海豹群而将其命名为牡蛎湾，并与原住民接触。1803年至1804年，英国殖民者在南方建立霍巴特，但海湾本身仍由牡蛎湾人使用，直到1821年乔治·梅雷迪思带着家人和雇工从威尔士前来。他经副总督威廉·索雷尔批准建立大天鹅港，即后来的斯旺西，开辟农场，并设立鞣皮坊、磨坊和附近的捕鲸站。

en:
The Adelaide Plains between Gulf St Vincent and the Mount Lofty Ranges are Kaurna country. The gulf was Wongga Yerlo, the western sea, while the River Torrens was Karrawirra Pari, and the ground that later became central Adelaide was called Tarndanyangga after a red kangaroo rock. More than twenty local groups lived across the plain, moving between coastal fishing grounds, grassy flats and wooded foothills and returning over generations to the same mound settlements. Their language belonged to the Thura-Yura family, and their country reached from Gulf St Vincent toward Cape Jervis and Port Wakefield. In 1444 those boundaries were maintained by Kaurna families alone.

British and French ships entered the gulf in 1802. On 30 March Matthew Flinders named it St Vincent after the Earl of St Vincent, and on 8 April he met Nicolas Baudin's French expedition at Encounter Bay, south of the Kaurna plain. The two navigators exchanged information peacefully even though their countries had recently been at war; Baudin's cartographers then mapped the same waters that Flinders had named. No town followed. In 1821 the River Torrens, the coastal camps and the grasslands where red kangaroos grazed remained Kaurna country, more than fifteen years before Adelaide was founded.
zh:
圣文森特湾与洛夫蒂山脉之间的阿德莱德平原，是高纳（Kaurna，中文资料常译考尔纳）人的土地。他们称海湾为翁加耶洛（Wongga Yerlo，意为西海），称多伦士河为卡拉维拉帕里（Karrawirra Pari）；后来成为阿德莱德市中心的地方叫塔恩丹扬加（Tarndanyangga），得名于一块红袋鼠岩。平原上分布着二十多个地方居群，人们往返于海边渔场、开阔草地和林木山麓之间，又世代回到同一批土丘聚落。他们的语言属于图拉—尤拉语系，领地从圣文森特湾延伸到杰维斯角和韦克菲尔德港一带。1444年，这些地界完全由高纳家族维系。

1802年，英国和法国船只先后进入这座海湾。3月30日，马修·弗林德斯以圣文森特伯爵之名将海湾命名为圣文森特湾；4月8日，他又在高纳平原南方的因康特湾遇到尼古拉·博丹的法国探险队。尽管两国不久前仍在交战，两位航海家还是和平交换了情报；随后博丹的制图师测绘了弗林德斯刚命名的水域。但城镇并未随之建立。1821年，多伦士河、海边营地和红袋鼠觅食的草原仍属高纳人的土地，距阿德莱德建城还有十五年以上。

en:
The Yarra River, Birrarung to its Wurundjeri owners, winds from forested ranges into Port Phillip, the great Kulin bay called Naarm. The Wurundjeri spoke Woiwurrung and shared the bay and its lower fishing grounds with the Boonwurrung. Fire kept grassy plains open for murnong roots, while Bolin Bolin lagoon supplied eels, fish and possums and the Birrarung carried camps, ceremonies and trade. At Mount William, Wurundjeri quarries produced greenstone axe heads traded far beyond Kulin country; gatherings of several hundred Kulin people met near the bay for marriage, ceremony and dispute. In 1444 the Wurundjeri population probably fluctuated around four hundred.

European ships entered the bay in 1802: John Murray took possession for Britain in March, and Matthew Flinders spent five days surveying it after entering on 26 April. In January and February 1803 Charles Grimes sailed with Charles Robbins into the Maribyrnong and up the Yarra as far as Dights Falls. On 16 October 1803 David Collins landed a convict and marine party at Sullivan Bay on the bay's southern shore, but poor water, thin soil, dangerous anchorage and armed resistance around the bay doomed the camp; it was abandoned in 1804 and removed to Van Diemen's Land. One escaped convict, William Buckley, remained living among Aboriginal people of the region. In 1821 no British town yet stood on the Yarra.
zh:
雅拉河在伍伦杰里人口中叫比拉朗（Birrarung），它从林木覆盖的山地蜿蜒流入库林人的大海湾——菲利普港，也就是纳姆（Naarm）。伍伦杰里人说沃伊沃隆语，并同布翁隆人共用海湾及下游渔场。人们用火维持开阔草地，以利采集山药菊（murnong）块根；博林博林潟湖出产鳗鱼、鱼和负鼠，雅拉河则串起营地、仪式与贸易。威廉山的伍伦杰里采石场制作绿岩斧头，斧刃远销库林地界之外；数百名库林人会在湾边聚会，联姻、举行仪式并调解争端。1444年前后，伍伦杰里人口大约在四百人上下浮动。

欧洲船只在1802年进入这座海湾：约翰·默里于3月代表英国宣布占有，马修·弗林德斯则在4月26日驶入后用五天测绘港湾。1803年1月至2月，查尔斯·格莱姆斯随查尔斯·罗宾斯的船队考察马里巴农河，并沿雅拉河上溯至迪茨瀑布。1803年10月16日，大卫·柯林斯率领罪犯和海军卫队在湾南岸的沙利文湾登陆扎营，但淡水不足、土壤贫瘠、锚地危险，加上湾周原住民的武装抵抗，使营地难以为继；1804年它便被废弃，人员迁往范迪门斯地。逃犯威廉·巴克利则留了下来，在本地区原住民中间生活。1821年，雅拉河畔还没有英国城镇。

en: The Wimmera River and its lakes—Hindmarsh, Albacutya and Tyrrell—water a flat country of mallee scrub and grassland between the Grampians, called Gariwerd by its people, and the Murray plains. It is the country of the Wergaia, who call themselves Maligundidj, the people of the mallee, perhaps twenty clans each holding its own ground under two matrilineal moieties, the black cockatoo and the white. Near Lake Tyrrell the Boorong clan read the seasons in the stars: the northern rise of Arcturus told them the wood-ant larvae were ready to gather, and the dusk setting of Vega that malleefowl eggs could be collected. In 1444 no European ship or station had touched the Wimmera, and life moved by that calendar.
zh: 维么拉河与欣德马什湖、阿尔巴库蒂亚湖、蒂勒尔湖等湖泊滋养着一片平坦的马利桉灌丛与草原，南抵当地人称为加里沃德的格兰扁山脉，北接墨累河平原。这里是韦尔盖亚人的家园，他们自称马利贡迪吉，意为「马利桉之地的人」，约有二十个氏族，各守领地，分属黑凤头鹦鹉与白凤头鹦鹉两个母系半偶族。蒂勒尔湖畔的布龙氏族以星象定时令：大角星从北方升起，便是采集木蚁幼虫的时候；织女星黄昏落下，提示眼斑冢雉的蛋可以捡拾。1444年，尚无欧洲人的船只或牧场进入维么拉，生活仍按这套星象历周而复始。

en:
West of the Blue Mountains the Wambuul, the Kalari and the Murrumbidgee, the 'big water'—the Macquarie, Lachlan and Murrumbidgee—wind across open plains, reed beds and marshes. The country between them is the land of the three rivers, home of the Wiradjuri, the largest Aboriginal people of New South Wales. Their clans kept yam fields on the floodplains, burned the grass to draw kangaroo and emu, and wore possum-skin cloaks, the mandiyaba, incised with burwurr designs; the Muurrai clan called the rich Bathurst Plains dalman, a place of plenty. In 1444 all of it was still wholly their own.

In May 1813 Blaxland, Wentworth and Lawson found a way across the Blue Mountains, and the surveyor George Evans, following them, sighted the Bathurst Plains and named the Macquarie. William Cox's convict-built road reached the plains in January 1815, and on 7 May 1815 Governor Lachlan Macquarie raised the flag at its depot and named the place Bathurst, Australia's first inland British settlement. Evans reached the Lachlan that year, and John Oxley traced its course in 1817 and the Macquarie's in 1818. When the governor opened the district to settlers in 1818, sheep and cattle began to spread over the old yam fields, and by 1821 Wiradjuri clans and newcomers watched each other uneasily across the Bathurst Plains.
zh:
蓝山以西，万布尔河（欧洲人后称麦夸里河）、卡拉里河（拉克兰河）与意为「大水」的马兰比吉河蜿蜒流过开阔的平原、芦苇荡与沼泽。三河之间是「三河之地」，维拉度里人的家园，他们是新南威尔士最大的原住民族群。各氏族在河漫滩上经营薯蓣田，放火烧草以吸引袋鼠和鸸鹋，身披负鼠皮斗篷「曼迪亚巴」，上面刻有「伯乌尔」纹样；穆赖氏族把丰饶的巴瑟斯特平原称作「达尔曼」，意为丰足之地。1444年，这一切还完全属于他们。

1813年5月，布拉克斯兰、温特沃思和劳森找到了翻越蓝山的路径，测量员乔治·埃文斯循路望见巴瑟斯特平原，并为麦夸里河命名。威廉·考克斯率流放犯修筑的公路于1815年1月通到平原；同年5月7日，总督拉克伦·麦夸里在终点营地升起英国国旗，将此地命名为巴瑟斯特，这是澳大利亚内陆第一个英国人定居点。埃文斯同年抵达拉克兰河，约翰·奥克斯利1817年溯流勘测拉克兰河，1818年又勘测了麦夸里河。1818年总督开放这一地区供人定居，牛羊开始蔓延到旧日的薯蓣田上；到1821年，维拉度里各氏族与新来者已在巴瑟斯特平原上紧张地互相打量。

en:
The sheltered coves and fishing grounds around Port Jackson and Botany Bay are Eora country. Its coastal clans, including the Cadigal on the southern shore of Port Jackson, spoke a coastal form of Dharug and took fish, shellfish, birds and plant foods from the harbour, beaches and sandstone hinterland. Clan boundaries were carefully observed, while ceremonies, marriages and trade linked the shore with inland Dharug and southern Dharawal people. In 1444 the harbour was known only to the people who paddled its waters in bark canoes and lit their camps along the coves.

On 29 April 1770 James Cook landed at Botany Bay on the coast's southern edge. The First Fleet under Arthur Phillip reached that bay in January 1788, then moved north to Sydney Cove in Port Jackson, where the colony of New South Wales was proclaimed on 7 February. The newcomers occupied fishing grounds and took Eora intermediaries; an epidemic in April 1789 killed about half the harbour people and emptied the bays of canoes. From 1790 the Bidjigal leader Pemulwuy waged a twelve-year resistance around Botany Bay, while Bennelong and other survivors maintained an Aboriginal presence in the growing town. Under Governor Lachlan Macquarie, from 1810 to 1821, convict labour laid out Sydney's streets, wharves and public buildings around the waters that remained Eora country within living memory.
zh:
杰克逊港与植物学湾一带避风的海湾和渔场，是约拉（Eora）人的土地。杰克逊港南岸的卡地哥等滨海氏族使用达鲁格语的海岸方言，从港湾、海滩和砂岩腹地获取鱼、贝类、鸟类与植物食物。各氏族严守地界，又通过仪式、婚姻和贸易，同内陆的达鲁格人及南方的塔尔瓦人往来。1444年，欧洲人的海图上还没有这座港湾，只有乘树皮独木舟航行、在海湾边扎营的约拉人熟悉这里的水路。

1770年4月29日，詹姆斯·库克在这段海岸南端的植物学湾登陆。1788年1月，亚瑟·菲利普率领第一舰队抵达植物学湾，随后北上杰克逊港内的悉尼湾，并于2月7日宣布建立新南威尔士殖民地。外来者占据渔场，又带走约拉人充当中介；1789年4月的一场疫病使港湾族群约减半数，海面上一度再难见到独木舟。1790年起，比吉加尔领袖佩姆乌在植物学湾周围坚持了十二年抵抗，班尼朗等幸存者则在不断扩张的城镇中保持原住民的存在。1810年至1821年拉克伦·麦觉理任总督期间，罪犯劳工在这片仍被上一代人视为约拉土地的水边，铺出悉尼的街道、码头和公共建筑。

en: Kamilaroi is the Gamilaraay country of the Namoi, Peel and Mooki river flats and the Liverpool Plains, enclosed by the Great Dividing Range, Liverpool Range and Warrumbungles. In 1444 small family bands moved over inherited grounds, hunting kangaroos, emus and possums, fishing the rivers, and gathering yams and sterculia grain ground into bread. John Oxley visited the Liverpool Plains in 1818; the next year, Aboriginal guides on the upper Hunter River told John Howe of 'Coomery Roy' country extending north-west beyond the Liverpool Range, probably the first record of the name.
zh: 卡米勒罗伊是加米拉赖人的土地，位于纳莫伊河、皮尔河、穆基河的河滩与利物浦平原之间，四面接大分水岭、利物浦岭和沃伦邦格尔岭。1444年，这里仍由一个个小型家族群使用各自承袭的土地，猎取袋鼠、鸸鹋和袋貂，在河中捕鱼，采集薯蓣和苹婆树籽磨制面饼。1818年，约翰·奥克斯利到访利物浦平原；次年，亨特河上游的原住民向导向约翰·豪说起库默里罗伊（Coomery Roy）的土地向西北延伸至利物浦岭以北，这可能是该名称最早的记录。

en: Gubbi-Gubbi is the coastal Kabi Kabi country between the Glass House Mountains and the mouth of the Burrum River, taking in the Mary River, called Moocooboola, Noosa and the Gympie hinterland, some 21,000 square kilometres of shore and ranges. In 1444 mobile family bands moved between coastal camps, river crossings and bunya-covered high ground, fishing, gathering and meeting on inherited grounds. Early European contact began by sea: on 17 May 1770 James Cook named the Glass House Mountains, and in 1799 Matthew Flinders sailed Pumicestone Passage and climbed Mount Beerburrum. In 1821 the coast still had no European settlement.
zh: 古比-古比是卡比卡比人的海岸家园，介于格拉斯豪斯山与巴勒姆河口之间，包括古称穆库布拉的玛丽河、努萨和金皮腹地，约有2.1万平方公里的海岸与山地。1444年，各个移动的家族群往返于海滨营地、河流渡口和生长大叶南洋杉的高地之间，捕鱼、采集并在承袭的土地上集会。欧洲人的早期接触从海上开始：1770年5月17日，詹姆斯·库克为格拉斯豪斯山命名；1799年，马修·弗林德斯驶过普米斯通海峡并登上比尔伯勒姆山。到1821年，这片海岸仍未出现欧洲人定居点。

en: The inland country of Yagalingu centres on Barunggam, on the headwaters of the Condamine River, and is Baruŋgam land. Its roughly 7,900 square miles of red-soil Western Downs extended from near Jackson and Dalby to Charley Creek and the Great Dividing Range, taking in Chinchilla, Jandowae and Tara. The Baruŋgam spoke Murrumningama, a Pama–Nyungan language close to Wakka Wakka, while Jarowair, Wakka Wakka and Mandandanji countries bordered theirs to the east, north and west. People stopped to eat at places on Dogwood Creek and Chinaman's Lagoon near Miles. In 1444 the Condamine waterholes and grassy open woodlands were still held entirely by Aboriginal clans.
zh: 亚加林古的内陆平原以巴伦加姆为中心，坐落在康达明河源头，是巴伦加姆人的土地。其约7900平方英里的红色土壤西部平原，从杰克逊和达尔比附近延至查利溪与大分水岭，涵盖钦奇拉、詹道伊和塔拉。巴伦加姆人使用与瓦卡瓦卡语相近的帕马—尼永甘语穆鲁姆宁加马语；贾罗韦尔、瓦卡瓦卡和曼丹丹吉人的土地分别在东、北、西三面相接。人们在迈尔斯附近的多格伍德溪和华人潟湖一带停留进食。1444年，康达明河的水塘和开阔林木草原仍完全由原住民氏族掌握。

en:
Turrbal country lies along Maiwar, the Brisbane River, where a double bend forms the pointed river crossing of Mianjin, also recorded as Meeanjin. Downstream, the river opens into Moreton Bay, whose sandy islands and fishing grounds belonged to Quandamooka families. Turrbal people took fish from the tidal reaches, gathered shellfish and plant foods in the wetlands and kept the surrounding open woodlands with fire; Barambin was a major meeting ground. In 1444 tracks, trade, mullet runs and seasonal gatherings linked the river, the bay and neighbouring Gubbi Gubbi country to the north, without any European frontier.

On 17 May 1770 James Cook's Endeavour passed the coast, named the Glass House Mountains and gave the name Morton's Bay to an opening he did not enter. The first recorded European to enter the bay was Matthew Flinders, sailing north in the Norfolk in 1799 with the Awabakal man Bungaree. Over 15 days he landed at Pumicestone Passage, Redcliffe and Coochiemudlo Island but missed the Brisbane River. At Bribie Island, Bungaree spoke with the Djindubari until a quarrel over a hat ended in gunfire at Point Skirmish. Yet the mouth of Maiwar remained hidden; in 1821 there was still no British settlement on Turrbal land.
zh:
图尔巴人的土地位于迈瓦（布里斯班河）沿岸。河道在米安金（也拼作Meeanjin）一带双曲环绕，形成尖角渡口，下游注入摩顿湾；湾内沙岛和渔场属于宽达穆卡人。图尔巴人在潮汐河段捕鱼，于湿地采集贝类和植物性食物，并用火维护周边开阔林地，巴兰宾则是重要集会地。1444年，步道、交换、鲻鱼汛和季节性集会把河流、海湾以及北面相邻的古比古比人土地连在一起，这里还没有欧洲人的边疆。

1770年5月17日，詹姆斯·库克的「努力号」驶过外海，为玻璃屋山脉命名，并把一个他并未驶入的水口命名为莫顿湾。1799年，马修·福林达斯乘「诺福克号」北航，阿瓦巴卡尔人班加里同行；他是有记载第一个进入这座海湾的欧洲人。十五天里，福林达斯在浮石海峡、雷德克利夫和库奇穆德洛岛登陆，却没有发现布里斯班河口。在布莱比岛，班加里与津杜巴利人交涉，最后因一顶帽子发生争执，船只在冲突角开火。但迈瓦河口仍未被发现；1821年，图尔巴人的土地上还没有英国定居点。

en:
The Falklands—East Falkland, West Falkland and their satellite islets—lie on the Patagonian Shelf about 500 kilometres east of the South American mainland. Canoe-using peoples from Tierra del Fuego may once have made the crossing, but no village, camp or indigenous polity survived into historical times. In 1444 the islands had no permanent inhabitants; their peat banks, tussac grass and sheltered waters were the domain of seabirds, seals and sea lions, and no European power yet kept a base there.

In 1600 the Dutch mariner Sebald de Weert made the first unquestionable European visit, sighting the north-western Jason Islands; on 27 January 1690 John Strong made the first recorded landing and named the Falkland Sound. Louis-Antoine de Bougainville founded Port Louis in 1764 with settlers from Saint-Malo, and John Byron's British expedition established Port Egmont the next year. France ceded its claim to Spain in 1766, and the Spanish took over the French post as Puerto Soledad in 1767, captured Port Egmont in 1770, and restored it after an agreement in 1771. Britain withdrew its garrison in 1774 but left a plaque asserting sovereignty. Puerto Soledad became a remote naval and penal station under the Viceroyalty of the Río de la Plata. On 13 February 1811 the last Spanish garrison sailed for Montevideo. In 1820 Buenos Aires sent a warship to assert its succession to Spanish rights, though no permanent administration followed before 1821.
zh:
福克兰群岛由东福克兰、西福克兰及周围小岛组成，坐落在南美大陆以东约500公里的巴塔哥尼亚大陆架上。火地岛使用独木舟的族群可能曾横渡到此，但历史时期开始时已没有定居村落、营地或本土政权。1444年，这里没有常住居民；泥炭地、丛生禾草与避风海湾是海鸟、海豹和海狮的天地，也没有任何欧洲强国在此设立据点。

1600年，荷兰水手塞巴尔德·德·韦特完成首次无可争议的欧洲人到访，望见了西北方的贾森群岛；1690年1月27日，约翰·斯特朗首次有记录地登陆，并把海峡命名为福克兰海峡。1764年，路易-安托万·德·布干维尔带领圣马洛移民建立路易港，次年约翰·拜伦率领的英国探险队设立埃格蒙特港。法国1766年把权利让给西班牙，西属当局1767年接管法国据点并改名索莱达港，1770年夺取埃格蒙特港，又在1771年达成协议后将其归还。英国1774年撤走驻军，但留下宣示主权的铭牌。索莱达港此后成为拉普拉塔总督辖区辖下偏远的海军与流放地。1811年2月13日，最后一支西班牙守军开往蒙得维的亚。1820年，布宜诺斯艾利斯派军舰宣示继承西班牙权利，但1821年以前仍未建立常设行政机构。

en:
The Cape Verde islands are ten volcanic islands lying far out in the Atlantic beyond Cap-Vert, the westernmost point of Africa. In 1444 they had no towns, fields or permanent inhabitants, and their dry harbours were still outside the regular sea lanes running down the Guinea coast. The nearest mainland cape had given the future archipelago its Portuguese name, but its place in Atlantic trade still lay ahead.

Navigators in Portuguese service reached the islands around 1460, and in 1462 settlers led by António da Noli founded Ribeira Grande on Santiago, the first permanent European settlement in the tropics. Its water and roadstead made it a port for ships bound for Guinea, India and Brazil, and a centre of the trade in enslaved Africans; the Church of Our Lady of the Rosary rose there in 1495, and Ribeira Grande became a bishop's see in 1533. Francis Drake sacked the town in 1585, after which São Filipe fortress was built, yet Jacques Cassard's French raid of 1712 completed its decline. Praia replaced it as capital of the islands in 1770.
zh:
佛得角是十座火山岛组成的群岛，远悬在非洲大陆最西端佛得角以西的大西洋中。1444年时，这里没有城镇、农田或常住居民，干燥的港湾也尚未进入沿几内亚海岸南下的常规航路。附近大陆海角的葡语名称后来赋予了这片群岛同样的名字，但它在大西洋贸易中的位置还要等到以后才显现。

为葡萄牙效力的航海者在1460年前后抵达群岛；1462年，安东尼奥·达·诺利率领移民在圣地亚哥岛建立里贝拉格兰德，这是热带地区第一个永久欧洲人定居点。水源和锚地使它成为前往几内亚、印度和巴西船只的港口，也是贩运非洲奴隶的中心。玫瑰圣母堂1495年在此建成，里贝拉格兰德又于1533年成为主教驻地。弗朗西斯·德雷克1585年洗劫此城，圣费利佩堡随后修建，但1712年雅克·卡萨尔率领的法国袭击最终促成其衰落。1770年，普拉亚取代它成为群岛首府。

en:
Fernando Po is the volcanic island later called Bioko, set in the Bight of Biafra beneath the peak of Pico Basile. Bantu-speaking settlers from the neighbouring mainland gradually became the Bubi clans, who farmed the rainy island and maintained only weak contacts across the water. In 1444 no European power had yet rounded its coast, and the Bubi controlled their own harbours, streams and hill paths.

Fernão do Pó sighted the island for Portugal in 1472 and named it Flor Formosa; the Portuguese later renamed the island in his honour and planted sugar works there. In 1641 the Dutch East India Company set up unauthorized trading posts and briefly centred its Gulf of Guinea slave trade on the island, until the Portuguese returned in 1648. As raiding increased, Bubi clans left exposed coastal settlements for the safer interior, where chiefs such as Molambo built the core of an island kingdom. The treaties of San Ildefonso in 1777 and El Pardo in 1778 transferred Fernando Po to Spain, but after an expedition and governorate from 1778 to 1780 the survivors withdrew. By 1821 the chief Lopoa led the Bubi while Spanish rule remained little more than a claim.
zh:
费尔南多波是后来改称比奥科的火山岛，坐落在邦尼湾中，巴希莱峰耸立其间。来自附近大陆的说班图语移民逐渐形成布比诸氏族，在这座多雨岛屿上耕作，只与对岸保持微弱联系。1444年时，还没有任何欧洲势力绕过它的海岸，布比人掌握着自己的港湾、溪流和山路。

1472年，费尔南·多·波为葡萄牙望见此岛，将其命名为「福尔莫萨花」；后来葡萄牙人又以他的名字改称该岛，并建立榨糖设施。1641年，荷兰东印度公司未经葡萄牙同意设立商站，一度把几内亚湾奴隶贸易集中于此，直到葡萄牙人1648年返回。随着掳掠加剧，布比诸氏族放弃易受攻击的沿海聚落，迁往更安全的内陆；莫兰博等首领在那里奠定了岛上王国的核心。1777年《圣伊尔德方索条约》和1778年《埃尔帕多条约》把费尔南多波割让给西班牙，但1778年至1780年的远征和总督统治结束后，幸存者便撤离了。到1821年，首领洛波阿统率布比人，西班牙统治仍几乎只是一纸主权宣称。

en:
St Helena is a volcanic island in the South Atlantic, lying about 1,800 kilometres west of the coast that Europeans would later call Angola. Its ravines held fresh water, its highlands could support fruit and livestock, and James Bay offered an anchorage, but in 1444 the island was uninhabited and still beyond the sea road around southern Africa. No ruler claimed it, and its springs and timber had value only after Portuguese ships opened the route from Europe to the Indian Ocean.

Portuguese navigators recorded the island in 1502; tradition credits João da Nova, while Estêvão da Gama's fleet left a clear account of landing there on 30 July 1503. They planted crops and animals but formed no permanent settlement. A Dutch post lasted from about 1645 until 1651, when it was abandoned for the Cape. English East India Company settlers landed on 5 May 1659 and built the Castle of St John, soon renamed James Fort, with Jamestown growing beneath its guns. Dutch troops seized the island in January 1673, yet Captain Richard Munden's squadron bombarded the fort while Richard Keigwin's party climbed the cliffs above Prosperous Bay; the Dutch surrendered on 5 May. St Helena then served Company ships as a watering and repair station until Napoleon arrived on HMS Northumberland on 15 October 1815. He stayed first at the Briars, moved to Longwood House on 10 December, and died there on 5 May 1821.
zh:
圣赫勒拿是南大西洋上的火山岛，位于后来欧洲人所称安哥拉海岸以西约1800公里。岛上山谷有淡水，高地能栽种果树、放养牲畜，詹姆斯湾也可停泊船只；但1444年时这里无人居住，仍在绕过非洲南部的航路之外。没有任何统治者占有此岛，直到葡萄牙船只打开欧洲通往印度洋的航路后，岛上的泉水和木材才显出价值。

葡萄牙航海者在1502年记下这座岛，传统上把发现者归于若昂·达·诺瓦；埃斯特旺·达伽马的船队则在1503年7月30日留下了明确的登陆记录。葡萄牙人带来作物和牲畜，却没有建立永久定居点。荷兰人约在1645年设点，1651年前为开辟好望角殖民地而将其放弃。英国东印度公司的移民于1659年5月5日登陆，修建圣约翰堡，不久改称詹姆斯堡，炮台下方逐渐形成詹姆斯敦。1673年1月，荷兰军队攻占该岛；芒登舰长的舰队炮击要塞，凯格温一行则攀上繁荣湾上方的悬崖，荷兰人于5月5日投降。此后圣赫勒拿长期作为东印度公司船只补水和修船的驿站。1815年10月15日，拿破仑乘「诺森伯兰号」抵达，先住布里尔斯，12月10日迁入朗伍德别墅，最终于1821年5月5日在那里去世。

en:
Socotra lies across the sea lanes joining the Gulf of Aden, the Guardafui Channel and the Arabian Sea, on the sailing route between the Red Sea and western India. Greek sailors knew the island as Dioskouridou, and the walls of Hoq Cave hold nearly 250 inscriptions and drawings left by visiting sailors between the first century BC and the sixth century AD in South Arabian, Greek, Ethiopic, Brahmi and Palmyrene scripts. Ships watered at Suq on the north coast and took on fish, frankincense, Socotrine aloes and dragon's blood, the red resin of the island's umbrella-crowned dragon's blood tree. The mountain people spoke Soqotri, of the same Modern South Arabian family as Mahri, while Arab and Indian traders lived along the coast. A Christian community survived in the interior: an Aksumite expedition consecrated a bishop on the island in 880 before an Omani fleet drove the Ethiopians out, and the Portuguese still found Nestorian Christians there in 1507. In 1444 Suq was the island's chief town, and the Mahri lords of Shihr and Qishn collected its tribute.

Mahri families from Qishn settled in strength around 1480 and built a fort at Suq. In April 1507 Tristão da Cunha and Afonso de Albuquerque stormed it after its commander Khawadjah Ibrahim, son of the sultan of Qishn, refused to surrender with his 130 men and died in the assault. The Portuguese renamed the fort São Miguel, turned its mosque into a chapel and built a church to Saint Thomas, the first they erected east of the Cape of Good Hope, while Franciscan friars baptised islanders of the old Christian community. Poor anchorage, famine and sickness forced the garrison out in 1511, and the Banu Afrar of Qishn recovered the island. Portuguese ships still called there for water and news: Estêvão da Gama's armada anchored in 1541 on its way to the Red Sea, Francis Xavier visited in 1542, and the poet Camões later wrote of the island's dry, barren hills. From the early seventeenth century Hadibu displaced Suq as the chief town, while the Banu Afrar held Socotra for another two centuries.
zh:
索科特拉岛横亘在亚丁湾、瓜达富伊海峡与阿拉伯海相接的海路上，地处红海通往印度西海岸的航线之间。希腊水手称它为狄奥斯库里岛，岛上的霍克洞穴岩壁上留有近二百五十处题刻和图画，是公元前1世纪至公元6世纪往来水手用南阿拉伯文、希腊文、埃塞俄比亚文、婆罗米文和巴尔米拉文刻下的。船只在北岸的苏格补给淡水，装载鱼类、乳香、索科特拉芦荟和龙血树脂；龙血取自岛上伞状树冠的龙血树，是一种红色树脂。山民操索科特拉语，与迈赫拉语同属南阿拉伯语族，阿拉伯和印度商人则住在沿海。内地还存留着基督教社群：880年，一支阿克苏姆远征军在岛上为主教授职，随后阿曼舰队赶走埃塞俄比亚人；1507年葡萄牙人登岛时，仍发现了景教徒。1444年，苏格是岛上首要城镇，希赫尔和基什恩的迈赫拉统治者向居民征收贡赋。

约1480年，来自基什恩的迈赫拉家族大举在岛上定居，在苏格修筑要塞。1507年4月，特里斯唐·达·库尼亚与阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克强攻该城；守将哈瓦贾·易卜拉欣是基什恩苏丹之子，率一百三十名守军拒绝投降，战死阵中。葡萄牙人把要塞改名圣米格尔，将清真寺改为礼拜堂，又修建圣多马教堂，这是他们在好望角以东建起的第一座教堂；方济各会修士还为古老基督教社群的岛民施洗。锚地条件差、饥荒和疾病迫使守军于1511年撤离，基什恩的巴努·阿夫拉尔家族收复该岛。此后葡萄牙船只仍常来补给淡水、探听消息：1541年，埃斯特旺·达·伽马的舰队在开赴红海途中停泊于此；1542年方济各·沙勿略到访；诗人卡蒙斯后来也写下诗篇，描绘岛上干旱荒芜的山丘。17世纪初以后，哈迪布取代苏格成为首要城镇，巴努·阿夫拉尔家族对索科特拉的统治又延续了两个世纪。

en:
Mahé is the largest island of the Seychelles, set in the Somali Sea north-east of Madagascar. In 1444 it had no permanent towns, fields or rulers. Arab and Swahili sailors may have known the archipelago from Indian Ocean voyages, and buoyant coco de mer nuts could drift as far as the Maldives and Indonesia, but no community had settled Mahé itself.

Ships of Vasco da Gama's Portuguese fleet sighted one of the high granitic islands on 15 March 1503, and the crew of the English Ascension made the first recorded landing in the Seychelles in January 1609. Lazare Picault reopened European contact in 1742; on 1 November 1756 Corneille Nicholas Morphey entered Mahé's north-eastern harbour and placed a Stone of Possession for France. The first French colonists in the archipelago landed on Sainte Anne in August 1770, and in 1778 settlers occupied the Mahé shore that became L'Établissement, later Victoria. The island capitulated to HMS Orpheus on 17 May 1794 and retained a largely neutral French administration until Captain Phillip Beaver of HMS Nisus took permanent possession on 23 April 1811.
zh:
马埃是塞舌尔最大的岛屿，位于马达加斯加东北方的索马里海。1444年，岛上没有固定的城镇、农田或统治者。阿拉伯和斯瓦希里水手或许已在印度洋航行中知道这片群岛，能漂浮的海椰子果甚至可随海流远至马尔代夫和印度尼西亚，但马埃本岛尚无人定居。

1503年3月15日，瓦斯科·达·伽马葡萄牙舰队的船只望见群岛中一座高耸的花岗岩岛；1609年1月，英国船「阿森松号」的船员留下了欧洲人在塞舌尔登陆的最早记录。拉扎尔·皮科1742年重新开启了欧洲人与群岛的接触；1756年11月1日，科尔内耶·尼古拉·莫尔菲进入马埃东北港湾，为法国立下「占有石」。1770年8月，群岛首批法国殖民者在圣安娜岛登陆，1778年又有殖民者占据马埃岛岸边，建立后来发展为维多利亚的莱塔布利斯芒。1794年5月17日，马埃向英国军舰「俄耳甫斯号」投降，但大体维持中立的法国行政体系；1811年4月23日，英国军舰「尼苏斯号」的菲利普·比弗舰长才正式实施永久占领。

en:
Hollhavai's principal island is Diego Garcia, the largest and southernmost atoll of the Chagos Archipelago, its near-continuous V-shaped rim, about sixty-four kilometres long, enclosing a lagoon of 124 square kilometres. In 1444 Diego Garcia had no permanent village or indigenous ruler. Its reefs and its position off the ordinary sea route to India kept most shipping away. Portuguese navigators probably sighted the Chagos early in the sixteenth century, with Pedro Mascarenhas the likeliest discoverer; Portuguese charts showed the archipelago by 1538, more than two centuries before its position was fixed with any accuracy.

French ships from Île de France surveyed Diego Garcia in September 1769 and claimed the atoll. Planters from Mauritius followed in the 1780s with enslaved workers brought mainly from Madagascar and Mozambique, and the French also shipped lepers to the island in the belief that turtle meat cured them. In 1786 the East India Company's Bombay government sent four ships to open a victualling station: the men found only a dozen mean French huts, took formal possession for George III in May, and withdrew in October after rats ruined their crops, the costs mounted and the governor of Île de France protested. In 1793 Lapotaire of Port Louis opened a factory worked by enslaved labour that pressed coconut oil and dried copra, and also shipped out salt fish, coir rope and sea cucumbers; by 1808 about a hundred enslaved people worked for him alone. British forces took Île de France in 1810, and the Treaty of Paris in 1814 confirmed Diego Garcia among the dependencies passing under British rule.
zh:
霍尔哈韦的核心是迪戈加西亚，查戈斯群岛最大、最南的环礁，近V形的礁环长约六十四公里，围着一座一百二十四平方公里的潟湖。1444年，迪戈加西亚没有定居村落，也没有本地统治者。暗礁环绕、位置又偏离通往印度的常规航线，大多数船只不会靠近。葡萄牙航海者可能在16世纪初望见查戈斯，发现者最可能是佩德罗·马斯卡雷尼亚斯；到1538年的葡萄牙海图上已绘有这组群岛，而它的位置还要再过两百多年才被比较准确地标定。

1769年9月，来自法兰西岛的法国船只测绘迪戈加西亚并提出主权要求。1780年代，毛里求斯的种植园主接踵而至，带来主要购自马达加斯加和莫桑比克的奴隶劳工；法国人还把麻风病人送来此岛，相信海龟肉能治这种病。1786年，东印度公司孟买政府派出四艘船，打算开设补给站：远征队只找到十几间简陋的法国棚屋，仍在5月以乔治三世的名义正式占岛，却因鼠患毁了作物、开支浩大，又遭法兰西岛总督抗议，于10月撤走。1793年，路易港的拉波泰尔开设使用奴隶劳动的工场，生产椰油和椰子干，还外销咸鱼、椰绳和海参；到1808年，仅他名下就约有一百名奴隶。1810年英军攻占法兰西岛，1814年《巴黎条约》确认迪戈加西亚作为附属岛屿转入英国统治。

en:
Mauritius is a green, mountainous Mascarene island east of Madagascar, girdled by reefs and lagoons. In 1444 it had no human inhabitants. Dodos and giant tortoises lived in its forests, ebony stands drew no timber fleets, and Arab sailors may have known the island as Dina Arobi, but there was no settled port or ruler to meet ships entering the Indian Ocean.

Portuguese seafarers visited the uninhabited island in 1507 and called it Cirne, yet they founded no colony. On 20 September 1598 Wybrand van Warwijck's Dutch fleet entered Grand Port and named the island after Maurice of Nassau. The Dutch East India Company established its first permanent post in 1638, using Mauritius as a refreshment station, cutting ebony and bringing Malagasy slaves to the settlements; cyclones, drought and bad harvests interrupted the colony and led to final abandonment in 1710, by which time the dodo had disappeared. Guillaume Dufresne d'Arsel claimed the island for France in September 1715 and renamed it Isle de France, with permanent settlers arriving from 1721. Bertrand-François Mahé de La Bourdonnais made the north-western harbour a fortified naval and commercial base; in 1736 it became Port Louis, the centre of an entrepôt economy sustained by plantations and enslaved labour. During the Napoleonic Wars French squadrons and corsairs raided British shipping from the island. The British attack on Grand Port failed in August 1810, but a larger army landed at Grand Baie that November and Governor Charles Decaen surrendered on 3 December. The Treaty of Paris in 1814 confirmed British rule and restored the name Mauritius.
zh:
毛里求斯是马达加斯加以东一座苍翠多山的马斯克林岛屿，四周环绕着珊瑚礁和潟湖。1444年，这里还没有人类居民。渡渡鸟和巨龟生活在林间，成片黑檀木尚未引来伐木船队；阿拉伯水手或许曾以迪纳·阿罗比（Dina Arobi）之名知道此岛，但岛上既没有固定港口，也没有统治者迎接驶入印度洋的船只。

1507年，葡萄牙海员到访这座无人岛，称之为西尔纳岛，却没有建立殖民地。1598年9月20日，维布兰德·范·瓦尔韦克的荷兰舰队进入大港，以拿骚的莫里斯之名将岛屿命名为毛里求斯。荷兰东印度公司1638年设立第一个永久据点，把毛里求斯用作船队补给站，采伐黑檀木，并把马达加斯加奴隶带到定居点；气旋、干旱和歉收使殖民多次中断，最终在1710年彻底放弃，此时渡渡鸟已经绝迹。1715年9月，纪尧姆·迪弗雷纳·达尔塞勒为法国占领此岛，改名法兰西岛，1721年起迎来永久定居者。贝特朗-弗朗索瓦·马埃·德·拉布尔多奈把西北港湾建设成设防的海军与商业基地；1736年，这里成为路易港，是依靠种植园和奴隶劳动维系的转口贸易中心。拿破仑战争期间，法国舰队和私掠船以此为基地袭扰英国航运。1810年8月，英军进攻大港失败，但同年11月一支更庞大的军队在格兰德贝登陆，夏尔·德康总督于12月3日投降。1814年《巴黎条约》确认英国统治，并恢复毛里求斯一名。

en:
Île Bourbon, the future Réunion, is a steep volcanic Mascarene island south-west of Mauritius, dominated by the high massif of the Piton des Neiges. In 1444 it was uninhabited. Arab traders may have known it as Dina Morgabin, the western island, and it perhaps appeared on an Arab map as early as the twelfth century, but its forests, ravines and open roadsteads held no permanent town or ruler.

Portuguese mariners sighted the island about 1507 and called it Santa Apolónia, yet they left no garrison. Jacques Pronis formally claimed it for France in 1642, and in 1649 it was named Île Bourbon for the French royal house. The French East India Company began colonization in 1665; Saint-Paul had received the first French settlement two years earlier, and Étienne Regnault founded Saint-Denis in 1669. The town became the permanent seat of colonial government in 1738. From the 1710s coffee estates turned Bourbon into a true plantation colony, and from the 1760s the Crown administered it directly through a society built on enslaved African and Malagasy labour. The island was renamed Réunion in 1793 and Isle Bonaparte in 1806. Cyclones and floods in 1806 and 1807 hastened the shift from coffee to sugarcane. On 7 July 1810 British forces landed on either side of Saint-Denis; Governor Jean-Chrysostôme Bruneteau de Sainte-Suzanne capitulated two days later. British occupation lasted until the island was ceremonially restored to France at Saint-Denis on 6 April 1815.
zh:
波旁岛，也就是后来的留尼汪，是毛里求斯西南一座地势陡峻的火山岛，内日峰高耸的山地主宰全岛。1444年，岛上无人居住。阿拉伯商人或许已知道这座被他们称为迪纳·莫尔加宾（Dina Morgabin）的西方之岛，它甚至可能在12世纪就出现在阿拉伯地图上，但林间山地、沟壑和开阔锚地之间还没有固定城镇或统治者。

约1507年，葡萄牙水手望见此岛，称其为圣阿波洛尼亚岛，却没有留下驻军。1642年，雅克·普罗尼正式为法国宣称该岛；1649年，岛屿以法国王室之名称为波旁岛。法国东印度公司1665年开始殖民，而法国人的第一个定居点已在两年前设于圣保罗；1669年，艾蒂安·勒尼奥建立圣但尼。1738年，圣但尼成为殖民地政府的固定驻地。从1710年代起，咖啡种植园使波旁成为真正的种植园殖民地；1760年代起，法国国王直接管辖此岛，而整个社会建立在非洲与马达加斯加奴隶劳动之上。1793年，岛屿改名留尼汪，1806年又改名波拿巴岛。1806至1807年的气旋和洪水加速了从咖啡向甘蔗的转变。1810年7月7日，英军在圣但尼两侧登陆，让-克里索斯托姆·布吕纳托·德·圣苏珊总督于两天后投降。英国占领持续到1815年4月6日，波旁岛才在圣但尼的仪式上正式交还法国。

en:
Eiriksfjord, now Tunulliarfik, cuts inland between Narsaq and Narsarsuaq in southern Greenland. Norse settlers from Iceland led by Erik the Red occupied it from 985; Brattahlíð, Erik's own estate, stood near the fjord head, and neighboring inlets held some of the densest farmland of the Eastern Settlement. The last certain written record from the colony is a wedding at Hvalsey in 1408. In 1444, colder years were shrinking the hay meadows and weakening the old Norse farms, while Thule Inuit, whose descendants would shape later Greenlandic society, hunted seal and whale from camps along the same coast.

During the following centuries the Norse ruins were left to peat and frost while Inuit families kept the fjord's hunting grounds. Dutch, Hamburg and English whalers were entering Greenland waters by the late 1500s. In 1751 Peder Olsen Walløe built a turf house and wintered at Qaqortoq, recognizing its harbor and hunting grounds. Anders Olsen founded Julianehåb there in the summer of 1775, naming it for Queen Dowager Juliane Marie, and Inuit from surrounding fjords brought sealskins, blubber and whale meat to the trade. A black-tarred log building was raised at the colonial harbor in 1797 and a stone smithy in 1804. When Denmark retained Greenland after its separation from Norway in 1814, Julianehåb was already the southern anchor of that commerce.
zh:
埃里克斯峡湾即今图努力雅菲克峡湾，在格陵兰南部从纳萨克与纳萨尔苏瓦克之间深入陆地。985年，红发埃里克率领来自冰岛的诺斯人到此定居；他自己的布拉塔里德庄园就在峡湾尽头附近，周围水道间的农庄是东殖民地最密集的农牧地带。殖民地最后一条可靠文字记录，是1408年在赫瓦勒塞举行的一场婚礼。1444年，转冷的年岁压缩着草场收成，旧日诺斯农庄日渐衰微；后来格陵兰因纽特人的先世图勒人则在同一片海岸扎营，捕猎海豹和鲸。

此后几个世纪，诺斯人的废墟没入泥炭与寒霜，因纽特家庭继续使用峡湾的猎场。到16世纪末，荷兰、汉堡和英格兰捕鲸船已进入格陵兰水域。1751年，佩德·奥尔森·瓦勒在卡科尔托克建起一座草泥房屋过冬，并看中这里的港口与猎场。1775年夏，安德斯·奥尔森在此创立尤利安娜霍布，以王太后尤利安娜·玛丽命名；周围峡湾的因纽特人把海豹皮、鲸脂和鲸肉带到交易站。1797年，殖民港边立起一座涂黑焦油的原木建筑，1804年又建成石砌铁匠铺。1814年丹麦与挪威分离、格陵兰留在丹麦王冠治下时，尤利安娜霍布已是这片贸易在南方的支点。

en:
Vestbygden was the smaller and more northerly of medieval Greenland's two Norse settlements. From about 985 Icelandic farmers occupied sheltered fjord heads in Nuup Kangerlua, the long fjord behind Nuuk; Sandnes was their greatest farm, and nearly a hundred farm ruins have been found across the district. Its growing season was shorter than in Eiriksfjord. When the Norwegian cleric Ivar Bardarson visited in the mid-1300s, he found empty farms. In 1444 the fjords and inner valleys belonged above all to Thule Inuit hunting seal, reindeer and whale, while the Norse houses stood abandoned.

Renewed European contact came with Hans Egede, the Dano-Norwegian missionary who reached the Nuuk district in 1721 hoping to find descendants of the lost colony. The early Hope Colony was moved to the Inuit settlement of Nûk in 1728 and named Godthåb; scurvy killed many of its first soldiers and convicts. Smallpox swept the district in 1733 and 1734, and Egede returned to Denmark in 1736, leaving his son Poul to continue the mission. The Moravian Brethren established New Herrnhut near Godthåb in 1747, drawing Greenlanders from the southeastern coast. When Denmark retained Greenland after its separation from Norway in 1814, Godthåb remained the small administrative and missionary center of the southwestern fjords.
zh:
韦斯特比格德是中世纪格陵兰两处诺斯殖民地中更小、也更靠北的一处。约985年起，来自冰岛的农人占据今努克后方努普康厄卢阿长峡湾里避风的峡湾尽头；桑内斯是当地最大的农庄，整个地区现已发现近百处农庄废墟。这里的生长季比埃里克斯峡湾更短。14世纪中叶，挪威教士伊瓦尔·巴尔达松前来时，见到的已是空寂农庄。1444年，这些峡湾与内陆谷地主要属于图勒因纽特人，他们捕猎海豹、驯鹿和鲸，诺斯人的房屋则已被遗弃。

欧洲人重新接触此地，始于丹麦—挪威传教士汉斯·埃格德。他1721年抵达努克一带，希望找到失落殖民地的后裔。早期的「希望殖民地」1728年迁到因纽特人的努克居点，定名戈特霍布；坏血病在最初的士兵和囚犯中造成大量死亡。1733至1734年，天花席卷这一地区，埃格德本人于1736年返回丹麦，留下儿子波尔继续传教。1747年，摩拉维亚兄弟会在戈特霍布附近建立新亨胡特传教站，吸引东南海岸的格陵兰人迁来。1814年丹麦与挪威分离而格陵兰留在丹麦手中时，戈特霍布已是西南诸峡湾狭小的行政与传教中心。

en:
Te Tai Tokerau, the long northern peninsula, is Te Hiku o Te Ika, the tail of the fish the demigod Māui drew from the sea. Its twin coasts frame the Hokianga and the Bay of Islands, with the sheltered harbour of Whangārei on the east. Polynesian voyagers beached their waka here from the fourteenth century — Hokianga tradition makes it the landing place of Kupe and of Nukutawhiti's Ngātokimatawhaorua — and some of the oldest Māori fishing villages grew on these warm shores. By 1444 the land was held by the Muriwhenua tribes, Ngare Raumati, Ngātiwai and Te Parawhau, kūmara gardeners and fishers whose pā crowned the volcanic cones, joined by coastal trade and canoe portages such as Mangapai.

In the generations after 1444 the chief Rāhiri, born at Whiria pā in the Hokianga around 1500, bound these lines into the Ngāpuhi, who spread from Kaikohe across the Bay of Islands. Abel Tasman coasted the country in 1642 without landing, and on 15 November 1769 James Cook, hauling in a hundred fish in Whangārei harbour, named the coast Bream Bay. In June 1772 the Frenchman Marion du Fresne and his men were killed in the Bay of Islands by Ngare Raumati. Whalers and timber traders followed, and in 1814 the chief Ruatara invited Samuel Marsden to preach New Zealand's first Christian sermon at Oihi; Ruatara's uncle Hongi Hika then led the Ngāpuhi into the Musket Wars. Defeated by Ngāti Whātua at Moremonui in 1807, Hongi raided the Bay of Plenty in 1818, met George IV in England in 1820 and, arming in Sydney with hundreds of muskets, marched his taua south against Auckland in 1821.
zh:
泰托凯劳是一道狭长的北部半岛，毛利语称「蒂希库奥蒂卡」，即半神毛伊从海中钓起的大鱼之尾。半岛两岸环抱霍基昂加与群岛湾，东岸还有避风的旺阿雷港。14世纪起，波利尼西亚航海者陆续驾独木舟在此登岸——霍基昂加传说此地是库佩与努库塔维蒂所乘「恩加托基马陶霍鲁阿号」的登陆之处，新西兰最古老的一批渔村就出现在这片温暖海岸。到1444年，此地分属穆里惠努阿诸部与恩加雷劳马蒂、恩加蒂瓦伊、蒂帕拉豪等族，他们种植库马拉、捕鱼为业，寨堡踞于火山锥顶，沿海贸易和芒阿派这类独木舟拖道把各部连成一片。

1444年之后的几代人里，约1500年前后出生在霍基昂加维里亚寨堡的酋长拉希里把各支系凝聚为雅普希（Ngāpuhi），其势力从凯科赫扩及群岛湾。1642年亚伯·塔斯曼沿海岸经过却未曾登陆；1769年11月15日，詹姆斯·库克在旺阿雷港捕得上百条鱼，把这片海岸命名为布雷姆湾。1772年6月，法国人马里翁·迪弗雷纳及其部下在群岛湾被恩加雷劳马蒂人袭杀。捕鲸船与木材商人随之而来，1814年酋长鲁阿塔拉邀塞缪尔·马斯登在奥希做了新西兰第一场基督教布道；鲁阿塔拉的叔父杭吉·希卡随后率领雅普希卷入火枪战争。1807年雅普希在莫雷莫努伊败于恩加蒂华图阿，杭吉1818年远征洗劫普伦蒂湾，1820年赴英格兰觐见乔治四世，又在悉尼购得数百支火枪，1821年率战团南下进攻奥克兰。

en:
Taranaki is the broad western shoulder of the North Island, gathered around the cone of Mount Taranaki, which rises 2,518 metres from the sea and stood tapu, never climbed by Māori. Its volcanic ring plain carried some of the richest kūmara soils in the country, and from about 1300 the voyagers of the Aotea, Tokomaru and Kurahaupō waka gardened the coast, hunted moa in the early centuries and ringed the headlands with pā. At Ngāmotu, the 'Islands' beside the future site of New Plymouth, fishing parties worked the Sugar Loaf islets, while to the south the Aotea descendants of Turi kept the Waingongoro shores. In 1444 the land was held by the tribes later known as Te Āti Awa, Ngāti Tama and Ngāti Mutunga in the north, and Taranaki, Ngāruahine and Ngāti Ruanui along the southern flanks, quarrelling over fishing grounds and cultivations.

The world beyond the horizon arrived only on 11 January 1770, when James Cook sailed past and named the cone Mount Egmont. No ship came closer for fifty years, but the musket reached Taranaki overland: in 1820 Te Rauparaha led the Ngāti Toa south from Kāwhia into northern Taranaki, where Ngāti Mutunga gave them Pukewhakamaru pā above the Urenui, and Waikato pursuers soon followed. In 1821 the great Āmiowhenua taua of Waikato and Ngāti Whātua, led by Pōtatau Te Wherowhero, swept the coast and besieged Te Ruaki pā in the south for three months; Ngāti Ruanui captives were carried away, and the tribes of Taranaki were drawn into the long agony of the Musket Wars.
zh:
塔拉纳基是北岛西部一道宽阔的山肩，环抱着塔拉纳基山那座2518米高、雪线分明的层状火山锥；此山在毛利人心目中是塔普禁地，从不攀踏。火山灰环平原铺着新西兰最肥沃的库马拉种植土，约1300年起，乘「奥特阿号」「托科马鲁号」「库拉豪波号」等独木舟而来的移民在沿岸耕作，最初几个世纪还以捕猎恐鸟为生，海岬上遍筑寨堡。在今新普利茅斯旁的恩加莫图——其名意为「群岛」——渔民在糖面包列岛间作业，南方瓦因贡戈罗河沿岸则是图里所率「奥特阿号」后裔的土地。1444年，北境沿海住着后来称作特·阿蒂阿瓦、恩加蒂塔马、恩加蒂穆通加的诸族，山南则有塔拉纳基、恩加鲁阿希内和恩加蒂鲁阿努伊，各部为渔场和园地时起争端。

山外世界直到1770年1月11日才出现：詹姆斯·库克乘船经过，把火山锥命名为埃格蒙特山。此后五十年没有船只靠岸，火枪反倒从陆路而来。1820年，特·劳帕拉哈率恩加蒂托阿（Ngāti Toa）离开卡菲亚南下进入北塔拉纳基，恩加蒂穆通加人把乌雷努伊河上游的普凯瓦卡马鲁寨堡让给他们，怀卡托追兵随即而至。1821年，波塔陶·特·维罗维罗率领怀卡托与恩加蒂华图阿的「环地」（Te Āmiowhenua）大战团横扫海岸，围攻南方的特鲁阿基寨堡三个月，恩加蒂鲁阿努伊俘虏被带走，塔拉纳基诸部就此被卷进火枪战争的漫长岁月。

en:
Te Moana-a-Toi, the Bay of Plenty, is the wide bight between the Coromandel Peninsula and Cape Runaway, named for Toi-te-huatahi, an ancestor of the earliest settlers. Its western arm is Tauranga, 'the anchorage', a sheltered harbour ringed by volcanic cones, where crews of the Tākitimu and Mātaatua canoes made their homes from the late thirteenth century. Their descendants, Ngāti Ranginui, traced their descent from Ranginui, son of the voyager Tamatea-pokai-whenua, and held the fortified villages of Maungatapu and Otūmoetai beneath the sacred peak of Mauao. In 1444 the harbour's tidal flats and fishing grounds made Tauranga one of the wealthiest places on the northern coast.

James Cook sailed through the bay in 1769 and named it for the well-stocked villages along its shores, and the potatoes he introduced soon joined the kūmara as a staple crop. Life changed little for a generation. From 1818, however, Ngāpuhi war parties from the north under Hongi Hika swept into the Bay of Plenty carrying newly traded muskets; the local iwi, still fighting with the wooden patu and stone weapons of old, could not hold their pā against gunfire, and the Tauranga peoples faced raid, capture and flight on the very eve of European settlement.
zh:
莫阿纳阿托伊意为「托伊之海」，即欧洲人后来所称的丰盛湾，是科罗曼德尔半岛与逃亡角之间的大海湾，得名于最早的先民之一托伊特胡阿塔希。海湾西端是陶朗加，意为「锚地」，这座被火山丘环绕的避风港自13世纪末起成为塔基蒂穆号、马塔阿图阿号两艘独木舟乘员的家园。他们的后裔雅提拉宜努伊人以航海者塔马泰阿·波凯韦努阿之子朗吉努伊为始祖，据有圣山毛奥（芒格努伊山）山下的马翁阿塔普、奥图莫埃泰等设防村寨。1444年，凭借港内潮滩和渔场，陶朗加是北海岸最富庶的地方之一。

1769年，詹姆斯·库克驶过海湾，见沿岸村落储粮丰足，便将其命名为丰盛湾；他带来的马铃薯很快与库马拉甘薯并列为主粮。此后近一代人光景，此地生活依旧。但自1818年起，洪吉·希卡率领北方恩加普希人的战斗队携新换来的火枪大举袭入丰盛湾；当地部落仍以传统的木制巴图棍棒和石制兵器作战，村寨挡不住枪弹，陶朗加诸部在欧洲人前来定居的前夜，陷入了遭劫掠、被掳走和四散逃亡的处境。

en:
This eastern coast runs from the swampy mouth of the Waimakariri and the volcanic harbours of Banks Peninsula down to Timaru. Earlier Waitaha communities were followed by Kāti Māmoe, who used river mouths, lagoons and fortified places among rich food grounds; near Timaru, rock art still shelters in the valleys of the Ōpihi and Opuha. At the future Kaiapoi site, eels and waterfowl crowded the Taerutu wetlands. In 1444 these lands and canoe routes were Kāti Māmoe country, with the more recent Waitaha absorbed into its communities.

Ngāi Tahu forces spread into Canterbury during the 1690s, overcoming or intermarrying with Kāti Māmoe. Around 1700 the chief Tūrākautahi established Te Kōhaka-a-Kaikaiāwaro, later called Kaiapoi Pā, which became the South Island's largest fortified village; pounamu from Arahura, muttonbirds from near Rakiura and obsidian from Tūhua passed through its trade, while kūmara and cabbage-tree roots grew nearby. On 17 February 1770 James Cook sighted Banks Peninsula but mistook it for an island and named it Banks Island. In 1809 Samuel Chase, sailing in the Pegasus, corrected the chart, yet through 1821 no European settlement had taken root on this coast.
zh:
这片东岸从怀马卡里里河多沼泽的河口与班克斯半岛的火山港湾，一直延伸到提马鲁。更早的怀塔哈社群之后是卡蒂马莫埃人，他们在丰饶的食场之间利用河口、潟湖和设防据点；提马鲁附近，岩画至今留存于奥皮希河与奥普哈河谷的岩荫下。在后来的凯阿波伊一带，鳗鱼和水禽聚集在塔埃鲁图湿地。1444年时，这些土地和独木舟航路属于卡蒂马莫埃人，更早的怀塔哈人已融入其社群。

17世纪90年代，纳塔胡部落进入坎特伯雷，通过战争与联姻吸纳或取代卡蒂马莫埃人。约1700年，酋长图拉考塔希建立特科哈卡-阿凯凯阿瓦罗，即后来的凯阿波伊要塞；它成为南岛最大的设防村落，阿拉胡拉的绿玉、拉基乌拉附近的鹱鸟和图胡阿的黑曜石都经此贸易，附近还种植甘薯与朱蕉根。1770年2月17日，詹姆斯·库克望见班克斯半岛，却误认作岛屿并命名为班克斯岛。1809年，塞缪尔·蔡斯乘「飞马」号修正海图，但直到1821年，这片海岸仍未出现欧洲人的定居点。

en:
Agadir lies on the Atlantic shore at the foot of the Atlas, just north of where the Souss River meets the sea. In Tachelhit its name means a fortified collective granary, and a map of 1325 already marks the anchorage as Porto Mesegina, after the Mesguina Berbers who fished and traded there. By the fifteenth century it served the sugar-growing Souss plain and was visited by vessels from the Iberian Peninsula. As Marinid power faded, the Souss slipped from the sultans' grasp into the hands of local Berber chiefs, so that in 1444 Agadir was a small harbour in their fragmented lands, already known to Portuguese and Castilian sea captains.

In 1505 the Portuguese nobleman João Lopes de Sequeira built a wooden fort below the hill for the colony of Santa Cruz do Cabo de Gué; King Manuel I bought it for the crown in 1513. Years of blockade by the Souss tribes followed, and on 12 March 1541 the Saadian sultan Muhammad al-Shaykh stormed the fortress after a long siege, taking some six hundred prisoners including the governor. In 1572 Abdallah al-Ghalib built the hilltop kasbah that gave the town its name Agadir N'Ighir, 'the fortified granary of the hill'. Under the Berber emirs of Tazerwalt it became a busy roadstead, shipping sugar, wax, copper and hides in exchange for European arms and cloth, and under Moulay Ismail the English and Dutch replaced the French as its chief traders. An earthquake ruined the town in 1731, and although the Dutch opened a post there in 1746, Sidi Muhammad ben Abdallah soon built up Essaouira instead, to chastise the rebellious Souss. After 1760 Agadir withered, and in 1789 a traveller found only a few houses crumbling into ruins.
zh:
阿加迪尔位于大西洋沿岸、阿特拉斯山脚下，地处苏斯河入海处以北。在塔谢尔希特语中，「阿加迪尔」意为设防的公共粮仓；1325年的一幅地图已把这片锚地标为梅塞吉纳港，得名于在此捕鱼贸易的梅塞吉纳柏柏尔人。到15世纪，这里已服务于种植甘蔗的苏斯平原，伊比利亚半岛的船只常来停泊。随着马林王朝势力衰落，苏斯脱离苏丹掌控，落入各地柏柏尔首领之手；1444年的阿加迪尔就是他们割据之地中的一座小港，葡萄牙和卡斯蒂利亚的船长都已知道这个停泊处。

1505年，葡萄牙贵族若昂·洛佩斯·德·塞凯拉在山脚下建起木堡，开辟殖民地圣克鲁斯，1513年曼努埃尔一世将其收归王室。苏斯各部族随后对它封锁多年，1541年3月12日，萨阿德王朝苏丹穆罕默德·谢赫在长期围攻后攻陷堡垒，约六百名葡萄牙人被俘，其中包括要塞总督。1572年，阿卜杜拉·加利卜在山顶修建卡斯巴，城市由此得名阿加迪尔恩伊尔，意为「山丘上的设防粮仓」。在塔泽尔瓦尔特的柏柏尔埃米尔治下，这里成为繁忙的开放锚地，输出糖、蜂蜡、铜和皮革，换回欧洲的武器和布匹；穆莱·伊斯梅尔在位时，英国和荷兰商人取代法国人成为主要贸易伙伴。1731年的地震摧毁了城镇，1746年荷兰人虽在此开设商馆，西迪·穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜拉却很快转而营建索维拉，以惩戒叛服无常的苏斯。1760年以后阿加迪尔日渐凋敝，1789年一位旅人见到的只剩几座倾颓的房屋。

en:
Arguin is a low, arid island in the Bay of Arguin, separated from the Mauritanian coast by reefs and shifting sandbanks. Berber fishermen and traders from the Sahelian shore knew these waters before the Portuguese caravels arrived; Nuno Tristão became the first recorded European visitor in 1443. In 1444 there was still no fort on the island, but its position at the edge of the newly opened Guinea route had already marked it for Atlantic rivalry.

Prince Henry the Navigator established a feitoria there in 1445, exchanging cloth, horses and wheat for gum arabic, gold and enslaved Africans, with about 800 captives shipped to Portugal each year by 1455. The Dutch West India Company took the fort on 5 February 1633, held it with an English interruption in 1665 and lost it to France in 1678. A Brandenburg captain occupied the abandoned works in 1685 and made a treaty with the local ruler, but French, Dutch and French assaults followed in 1721, 1722 and 1724. The French withdrew in 1728, leaving Arguin to its fishermen and the dangerous banks that had defeated every permanent settlement.
zh:
阿尔金是阿尔金湾中一座低矮干旱的岛屿，与毛里塔尼亚海岸之间隔着礁石和移动沙洲。葡萄牙卡拉维尔帆船到来之前，萨赫勒沿岸的柏柏尔渔民和商人已熟悉这些水域；1443年，努诺·特里斯唐成为有记载的首位欧洲来访者。1444年时岛上尚无堡垒，但它正处在新开辟的几内亚航路边缘，注定被卷入大西洋列强的争夺。

1445年，航海家恩里克王子在此设立商站，用布匹、马匹和小麦交换阿拉伯树胶、黄金和非洲奴隶；到1455年，每年约有八百名被掳者从阿尔金运往葡萄牙。荷兰西印度公司于1633年2月5日夺取堡垒，其间在1665年一度被英格兰打断，最终于1678年落入法国之手。1685年，一名勃兰登堡船长占领废弃工事并与当地统治者缔约，但法军、荷兰人和法军又在1721年、1722年和1724年接连攻占。1728年法国人撤走，把阿尔金留给渔民和那些使永久定居屡屡失败的危险浅滩。

en:
The Awlil coast is the desert edge where the Sahara meets the Atlantic just north of the Senegal River. Early Arab writers knew an island town of Awlil in the district of Senghana, and its sea-salt beds, worked by the Godala Berbers, supplied caravans along a coastal route to southern Morocco and down the Senegal's north bank. These Sanhaja nomads pastured camels between the dunes and the shore, and their kinsmen made up part of the Almoravid movement. In 1444 the salt trade still bound the coast to the Wolof kingdoms to the south, while Arab tribes were already pushing south across the desert.

In the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries the Bani Hassan Arabs entered the country, and the long struggle between the Hassani warriors and the Berber marabouts ended with Nasr ad-Din's death in 1674, leaving the Arab tribes masters of the desert edge. The Trarza emirate took shape in these wars, and with Brakna and Tagant it dominated the Senegal's north bank for the rest of the period. Its emirs grew rich on the gum arabic trade and the customs paid by the French at Saint-Louis, while their camelry crossed the river to raid: by the 1770s the Trarza were kingmakers in civil-war-torn Waalo, and around 1820 the Buurba of Jolof began paying them an annual tribute to buy off their slave raids.
zh:
特拉扎的奥利勒（Awlil）海岸地处沙漠边缘，在塞内加尔河口正北，撒哈拉与大西洋在此相接。早期阿拉伯作家记载过森加纳地区一座叫奥利勒的岛城；戈达拉柏柏尔人在此开采海盐，供应沿陆路前往摩洛哥南部、再顺塞内加尔河北岸贩盐的商队。这些桑哈贾游牧民在沙丘与海岸之间放牧骆驼，其同族还曾是穆拉比特运动的一部分。1444年，盐业仍把这片海岸与南方的沃洛夫诸王国连在一起，而阿拉伯部落已经开始穿过沙漠向南推进。

15至16世纪，巴尼哈桑阿拉伯人进入此地；哈桑尼武士与柏柏尔马拉布特的长期较量以1674年纳西尔丁之死告终，阿拉伯部落成为沙漠边缘的主人，特拉扎埃米尔国便在这场混战中成形，与布拉克纳、塔甘特并立，在此后的年代里控制塞内加尔河北岸。埃米尔们靠阿拉伯胶贸易和法国人在圣路易缴纳的关税致富，骑兵则渡河劫掠：到1770年代，特拉扎人已能在内战不断的瓦洛废立君主；1820年前后，卓洛夫的布尔巴也开始向他们缴纳年贡，以换取奴隶劫掠的止息。

en:
Cayor is the sandy country between the Senegal and the Saloum, a land of baobabs, lakes and marshes on the Atlantic shore. One of the oldest Wolof states, it was ruled under the Jolof Empire by a Great Lamane elected from the Fall family of Palene Ded, who each year led a great delegation to the Buurba's court to deliver tribute. From the 1440s Portuguese ships appeared offshore, trading horses and metal for slaves, and commerce began shifting from the inland court toward the coast. In 1444 Cayor was still a tributary land of Jolof, Wolof-speaking and ruled by its old rites, but its lords were already learning where the new wealth lay.

In 1549 the Lamane Dece Fu Njogu withheld tribute; his son Amary Ngone Sobel Fall routed the Jolof army at the lake of Danki and killed the Buurba Lele Foulifak, then succeeded as Damel and became the first Damel-Teigne of Cayor and Baol after his uncle's death. He founded a new, centrally placed capital at Mboul and reigned forty-four years. In the 1670s Nasr ad-Din's marabout rising overran Cayor: the cleric Ndiaye Sall seized power with the lingeer Yacine Bubu, but within months she turned against him and, with the aid of the Buur of Saloum, overthrew his theocracy. Lat Sukaabe Fall took the throne in 1693, ruled Cayor and Baol together, bound the marabouts to the crown with offices, and defied the French trade monopoly at Saint-Louis. In the 1750s and 1760s Cayor warred with Waalo and Jolof, until Trarza cavalry restored the exiled Damel Maissa Bigué in return for tribute and leave to raid for a month each year. In 1776 Torodbe clerics rose again; Damel Amari Ngoone Ndela crushed them and at Bunxoy destroyed the army of Abdul Kader of Futa Toro, capturing the almamy, treating him with honour and sending him home laden with gifts. The marabouts who fled helped found the Lebou republic on Cap-Vert.
zh:
卡约尔位于塞内加尔河与萨卢姆河之间，是大西洋沿岸一片沙质土地，遍布猴面包树、湖泊与沼泽。作为沃洛夫最古老的邦国之一，它在卓洛夫帝国治下由一位大拉曼统治；大拉曼出自帕勒纳德的法勒家族、经推举产生，每年率领庞大的使团前往布尔巴王廷缴纳贡赋。1440年代起，葡萄牙船只出现在外海，用马匹和金属换取奴隶，财货开始从内陆王廷向海岸转移。1444年的卡约尔仍是卓洛夫的纳贡之地，居民操沃洛夫语、按旧有礼制行事，但它的贵族已经看清新的财富在何处。

1549年，拉曼德塞·富·恩乔古数年不贡；其子阿马里·恩贡·索贝尔·法勒在丹基湖击溃卓洛夫大军，阵斩布尔巴·莱莱富利法克，随后继任达梅尔，并在舅父死后成为首位兼领卡约尔与巴奥勒的达梅尔-泰涅。他在居中的姆布尔另建新都，在位四十四年。1670年代，纳西尔丁的马拉布特浪潮席卷卡约尔：教士恩迪亚耶·萨尔借王太后亚辛·布布之手掌权，但不出数月亚辛便与他反目，联合萨卢姆的布尔推翻了他的神权统治。1693年，拉特·苏卡贝·法勒夺取王位，兼领卡约尔与巴奥勒，以官职把马拉布特绑在王权一边，并抵制圣路易法国人的贸易垄断。1750至1760年代，卡约尔接连与瓦洛、卓洛夫交战，后来特拉扎骑兵帮助流亡的达梅尔马伊萨·比盖复位，换取年贡和每年一个月的劫掠许可。1776年托罗多贝教士再起，达梅尔阿马里·恩贡·恩德拉将其镇压，又在本克索伊歼灭富塔托罗的阿卜杜勒·卡迪尔大军，生擒这位阿尔马米，待之以礼、厚赠遣归；逃散的教士则在佛得角半岛参与建立了莱布共和国。

en:
The Gabu country, between the headwaters of the Gambia and the Futa Jallon highlands, was long
worked by the farming Bainuk. In the thirteenth century Mandinka war bands led by Tiramakhan
Traore, a general of the Mali empire, conquered it and made it Mali's western military province;
the Nyancho warrior houses they installed settled over the older Mande and Bainuk lineages. In
1444 Gabu was still the empire's far western province.

As Songhai rose and Mali's Senegal lands were cut off, the Mandinka chiefs broke away, and in 1537
they made Kaabu an independent federation, its provinces growing from three to seven and encompassing
dozens of royal trading towns. Mansa Sala Sane moved the seat from Mampatim to Kansala, beside the
sacred wood where each new Mansaba was crowned. Its endless
wars of expansion produced captives on a vast scale: during the seventeenth and eighteenth
centuries as many as half the enslaved Africans sold into the Atlantic trade were said to come
