About the middle of the eighteenth century Shomvi clans from the Malindi shore settled here, followed by Omani kinsmen of the sheikh Shamvi la Magimba, who taxed the local trade and Nunge salt. In the eighteenth century it became a caravan halt and acquired its name, Bagamoyo, 'lay down your heart'. From the 1810s, as Oman made Zanzibar the emporium of the western Indian Ocean, Nyamwezi caravans from as far as Lake Tanganyika ended their march here with ivory and gum copal; by 1821 Bagamoyo was the rising market of the Mrima coast.
zh:
巴加莫约的锚地位于桑给巴尔海峡，与海岛遥遥相望。以南五公里的考莱8世纪已有人定居，其珊瑚石遗址可追溯至13至16世纪，包括两座清真寺和约三十座墓葬。这座商镇输出象牙、乌木和红树桩，换入中国瓷器。到15世纪，考莱的鼎盛期已过，1444年前后巴加莫约本身只是依附于它的一座小村，扎拉莫人和斯瓦希里人在此捕鱼、制盐、采胶，在基尔瓦主导的松散海上联盟里做些小本贸易。

16世纪，葡萄牙舰队击碎旧有的斯瓦希里秩序，考莱石城也沦为废墟，但这座小锚地延续了下来。18世纪中叶，绍姆维氏族从北方的马林迪海岸南迁至此，谢赫沙姆维·拉·马金巴的阿曼亲族随后而来，向当地贸易和嫩盖海岸出产的食盐抽税。18世纪里，这里成为商队驿站，得名巴加莫约，意为「放下你的心」。1810年代起，随着阿曼把桑给巴尔经营成西印度洋的商业中心，远自坦噶尼喀湖的尼亚姆韦齐商队驮着象牙和柯巴脂走到巴加莫约歇脚；到1821年，它已是姆里马海岸上升的商埠。

en:
The coast below Mombasa ends in a maze of coral reefs and mangrove creeks, running south as far as the bay of Tanga. By 1444 the Swahili stone town of Vumba Kuu, facing Wasini Island, stood at the southern limit of the world of coral mosques and Indian Ocean dhows; its merchants shipped ivory brought down from the interior and took back Indian cloth, glass beads and Persian and Chinese ceramics, and archaeology dates the town itself to the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries. Around it lay rival Shirazi towns, while the ridges behind were farmed by Digo clans, Mijikenda-speakers who still kept to the old spirits. Vumba Kuu kept its own diwan and stood at the southern edge of Mombasa's sphere.

Vasco da Gama passed this coast in 1498, and Portuguese fleets soon made the towns submit to Portugal and its customs at Mombasa, while Tanga survived only as a small trading post. Early in the seventeenth century the Vumba, led by Mwana Kyambi Ivoo and helped by their allies the Digo, made war on the Shirazi and overran their towns one by one; their last capital, Tumbe, fell around 1640 and was left a ruin. As Omani armies drove the Portuguese out of Mombasa at the end of the century, the Vumba diwanate lived on although Vumba Kuu itself was already a ruin, its lords still enthroned at the graves of their ancestors. From the 1750s the caves at Shimoni held captives for the coastal slave trade, and the Digo grew rich carrying ivory and slaves between shore and interior. By 1821 the whole coast answered to Muscat and the rising power of Zanzibar.
zh:
蒙巴萨以南的海岸遍布珊瑚礁与红树林水道，一直延伸到坦噶湾。1444年时，与瓦西尼岛隔海相望的斯瓦希里石城温巴库（Vumba Kuu），正处在珊瑚清真寺与印度洋独桅帆船世界的南端；城中商人把内陆运来的象牙装船，换回印度布匹、玻璃珠以及波斯和中国的瓷器，考古发掘表明城镇本身的年代为14至15世纪。它周围是互为对手的设拉子人诸城，身后的丘陵山脊则由迪戈人——讲米吉肯达语的部族——耕作，他们仍敬奉旧神。温巴库由自己的迪万治理，处在蒙巴萨势力范围的南缘。

1498年达·伽马驶过这片海岸，不久葡萄牙舰队便迫使诸城镇臣服于葡萄牙，听命于设在蒙巴萨的海关，坦噶则只是一个小小的贸易站。17世纪初，温巴人在姆瓦纳·坎比·伊沃率领下，靠盟友迪戈人相助对设拉子人开战，接连攻陷其城镇；他们最后的都城通贝约于1640年陷落，沦为废墟。阿曼军队在该世纪末把葡萄牙人逐出蒙巴萨，温巴库城本身虽已成废墟，温巴迪万政权却延续下来，首领仍在先祖的墓前即位。1750年代起，希莫尼的洞穴成为沿海奴隶贸易中关押俘虏的场所，迪戈人靠在海岸与内陆之间转运象牙和奴隶致富。到1821年，整条海岸都已臣服于马斯喀特和崛起的桑给巴尔。

en:
Zanzibar, the Arab name meaning 'coast of the blacks', is the green island of Unguja, set a day's sail off the Swahili shore behind a fine natural harbour. Bantu fishermen and farmers had settled it by the middle of the first millennium, and by the tenth century Unguja Ukuu and Kizimkazi in the south and Tumbatu in the north numbered among the Swahili exchange points where Gulf and Indian merchants took up gold, ivory and ambergris against Indian cloth. Coral stone replaced mud and thatch for the patrician houses, and the island's mosques were among the earliest on the coast. In 1444 Zanzibar was one of many autonomous Muslim city-states, its ruler among those who acknowledged the loose overlordship of Kilwa, then at its zenith.

Vasco da Gama visited Zanzibar in 1498, and in 1503 or 1504 Captain Rui Lourenço Ravasco extracted tribute from its sultan, opening nearly two centuries of loose Portuguese rule. From about 1571 the island was administered from Mozambique, and when the English ship Edward Bonaventure called in 1591 it found neither fort nor garrison, the local king still managing the island's affairs. In 1652 Omani squadrons began raiding the Portuguese-held coast at the call of Swahili towns, and after the fall of Fort Jesus at Mombasa in 1698 Zanzibar passed to the Yarubi imams of Oman. Arab traders settled in the harbour quarter of Stone Town while the island's own Mwinyi Mkuu continued to rule its villages from Dunga, and a revolt against Omani rule was suppressed in 1784. Early in the nineteenth century, under the Bu'Saidi sultans, Arab planters laid out the first clove shambas and the traffic in slaves and ivory through the harbour grew year by year, so that by 1821 Stone Town was already a thriving Omani emporium built on cloves, ivory and slaves.
zh:
桑给巴尔的阿拉伯语名称意为「黑人海岸」，它就是绿意盎然的温古贾岛，隔海与斯瓦希里海岸相望，岛后藏着一座优良的天然港湾。班图渔民和农民在一千纪中叶已在此定居，到10世纪，岛南的温古贾乌库、基济姆卡济和岛北的通巴图都已跻身斯瓦希里人的贸易据点，波斯湾和印度商人在此用印度布匹换取黄金、象牙和龙涎香。望族的住宅由泥墙茅顶改为珊瑚石砌成，岛上的清真寺也属于沿海最早的一批。1444年，桑给巴尔是众多自治的穆斯林城邦之一，在基尔瓦权势鼎盛之时，它的统治者也承认其松散的宗主权。

1498年瓦斯科·达伽马到访桑给巴尔，1503或1504年，鲁伊·洛伦索·拉瓦斯科船长向岛上的苏丹强索贡赋，开启了葡萄牙人近两百年的松散统治。约1571年起，该岛改由莫桑比克管辖；1591年英国船「爱德华·博纳文彻」号到访时，发现岛上既无堡垒也无守军，本地首领仍在处理岛务。1652年，应斯瓦希里诸城之请，阿曼舰队开始袭扰葡萄牙人控制的海岸；1698年蒙巴萨耶稣堡陷落后，桑给巴尔转入阿曼亚鲁卜伊玛目治下。阿拉伯商人在石头城的港区定居，岛上自己的姆维尼·姆库则继续在栋加统治各村落，1784年一场反抗阿曼统治的起义遭到镇压。19世纪初，在布·赛义德王朝治下，阿拉伯种植园主开辟了最早的丁香园，经港口流转的奴隶与象牙逐年增多，到1821年，石头城已是一座建立在丁香、象牙和奴隶之上的繁荣阿曼商埠。

en:
Mombasa occupies a coral island beside a sheltered Indian Ocean harbour. The town had traded there long before 1444: the Mnara mosque was built around 1300, and Ibn Battuta found Shafi'i Muslims and carefully built wooden mosques when he stayed for a night in the fourteenth century. As a Swahili city within Kilwa's sphere, it shipped ivory, gold, millet, sesame and coconuts toward the Red Sea, Arabia and India, and its harbour received vessels from Sofala, Cambay, Malindi and Zanzibar. In 1444 its old Mvita lineages, ocean traffic and Kilwa ties already made it a powerful rival of nearby Malindi.

Vasco da Gama met a cold reception in 1498, and the Portuguese sacked the town in 1500. Mombasa broke from Kilwa in 1502, but Francisco de Almeida attacked it in 1505 and Nuno da Cunha destroyed much of the city in 1528. The Ottoman captain Ali Bey seized it in 1585; after Zimba raiders struck Mombasa and the Portuguese returned in 1589, King Philip ordered Fort Jesus built above the old harbour between 1593 and 1596. In 1631 Sultan Yusuf ibn al-Hasan, called Dom Jerónimo by the Portuguese, killed the garrison, and Portuguese forces returned in 1632. Saif bin Sultan's Omani army took the fort in 1698 after a siege begun in 1696, and Portugal briefly reoccupied it in 1728 and 1729. From the 1740s the Mazrui liwalis held Mombasa and Fort Jesus in practice while resisting Oman; ivory, coastal provisions and the traffic in enslaved people sustained the island, and in 1821 Abdallah ibn Ahmad al-Mazru'i still governed there.
zh:
蒙巴萨坐落在印度洋一处遮蔽良港旁的珊瑚岛上。早在1444年以前，这里已是贸易城镇：姆纳拉清真寺约建于1300年，伊本·白图泰14世纪在此停留一夜时，见到的是沙斐仪派穆斯林和精工建造的木构清真寺。作为基尔瓦势力范围内的斯瓦希里城市，蒙巴萨把象牙、黄金、小米、芝麻和椰子运往红海、阿拉伯和印度，港内停泊着来自索法拉、坎贝、马林迪和桑给巴尔的船只。1444年，古老的姆维塔世族、远洋商路和与基尔瓦的联系，已使它成为近邻马林迪的强劲对手。

瓦斯科·达·伽马1498年在此受到冷遇，葡萄牙人随后于1500年洗劫城市。蒙巴萨1502年脱离基尔瓦，但弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达1505年发兵来攻，努诺·达·库尼亚又在1528年摧毁了大半个城市。奥斯曼将领阿里贝伊1585年夺取蒙巴萨；津巴武装袭掠该城后，葡萄牙人于1589年重返，腓力国王随后下令在1593年至1596年间于旧港上方修建耶稣堡。1631年，被葡萄牙人称为堂·热罗尼莫的苏丹优素福·伊本·哈桑歼灭当地驻军，葡萄牙军队1632年卷土重来。赛义夫·本·苏丹率领的阿曼军队经1696年开始的围攻，在1698年夺取要塞，葡萄牙又于1728年至1729年短暂占领。18世纪40年代起，马兹鲁伊家族的总督实际控制蒙巴萨和耶稣堡，抵抗阿曼统治；象牙、沿海给养和奴隶贸易维持着岛屿的运转，1821年时，阿卜杜拉·伊本·艾哈迈德·马兹鲁伊仍在此主政。

en:
Malindi lies on Malindi Bay at the mouth of the Galana River, where Bantu-speaking farmers and fishermen had long smelted iron and exchanged goods with vessels from the Indian Ocean. By the fifteenth century Muslim patrician families governed a Swahili stone town whose merchants exported ivory, rhinoceros horn, coconuts, oranges, millet and rice. In 1414 its ruler sent an envoy and a giraffe away with one of Zheng He's fleets. In 1444 Malindi was a prosperous sultanate in its own right and a persistent rival of Mombasa for leadership of this stretch of coast.

Vasco da Gama reached Malindi in 1498 and, unlike at Mombasa, was welcomed by the sultan: he made a trade agreement, hired a pilot for India and erected the limestone padrão later called the Vasco da Gama Pillar. A Portuguese factory was established in 1502, and Malindi supported Francisco de Almeida's attacks on Kilwa and Mombasa in 1505. The town remained Portugal's main base on the East African coast until 1593, when the Portuguese built Fort Jesus at Mombasa and the Sheikh of Malindi moved his court there, ruling from Mombasa until 1630. Malindi then lost merchants, shipping and court patronage. Its Portuguese chapel and the sea pillar stood among emptying streets, and by 1800 local Swahili description made the place a tract of bush and ruins; in 1821 the old harbour had not recovered.
zh:
马林迪位于加拉纳河口的马林迪湾，班图语农民和渔夫早已在此冶铁，并与印度洋上的船只交换货物。到15世纪，穆斯林望族治理着这座斯瓦希里石城，商人出口象牙、犀牛角、椰子、橙子、小米和稻米。1414年，马林迪统治者派使者带着长颈鹿，随郑和的一支船队前往中国。1444年的马林迪已是独立而繁荣的苏丹国，并长期与蒙巴萨争夺这段海岸的主导权。

瓦斯科·达·伽马1498年抵达马林迪，与在蒙巴萨受到的冷遇不同，他得到苏丹欢迎：双方签订贸易协定，他雇用了前往印度的领航员，并竖立后来被称为瓦斯科·达·伽马柱的石灰岩标柱。葡萄牙人1502年在此设立商馆，马林迪又在1505年支持弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达进攻基尔瓦和蒙巴萨。直到1593年，这里都是葡萄牙人在东非海岸的主要基地；此后葡萄牙人在蒙巴萨修建耶稣堡，马林迪谢赫也把宫廷迁往那里，并在1630年以前从蒙巴萨发号施令。马林迪随之失去商人、航运和宫廷庇护，葡萄牙小教堂与海上石柱空立于日渐荒废的街巷间；到1800年，当地斯瓦希里记载中的故地已是丛林与废墟，1821年时旧港仍未恢复。

en:
Lamu, called Amu by its own people, is a coral-stone town on an island of the same name, sheltered by the narrow channel between Lamu and Manda that serves as its harbour. It was founded around 1370 and grew into one of the Swahili trading cities, sending dhows to Arabia and India loaded with ivory, tortoiseshell, grain and termite-proof mangrove poles, and bringing back cloth and porcelain. An Arab traveller first wrote of it in 1441, after meeting a Lamu judge on pilgrimage at Mecca. Its patrician families ruled through a council of elders, the Yumbe, from a palace in the town. In 1444 Lamu was a wealthy, self-governing Muslim town of merchants, craftsmen and Quranic scholars.

In 1506 a Portuguese fleet under Tristão da Cunha blockaded the channel and forced the town to pay 600 meticals at once and a yearly tribute thereafter. When Ottoman corsairs raided the coast in the 1580s Lamu led the Swahili towns in revolt, and was brought to heel only with difficulty; Omani ships came to its aid from 1652, and in 1696 the Portuguese were driven out for good. The eighteenth century was Lamu's golden age: its merchants grew rich on Indian Ocean commerce, its patricians raised the coral houses and mosques of the old town, and Lamu became a centre of Swahili poetry and religious learning. Rivalry with Pate darkened the years after 1800, when the forces of Sultan Fumo Madi ibn Abi Bakr of Pate seized the town and began the great fort on the seafront. In 1813, at nearby Shela, Lamu's men destroyed a Pate–Mazrui invasion army in its boats on the beach; to secure the peace the town called in an Omani Busaidi garrison.
zh:
拉穆，本地人自称阿姆，是同名岛屿上的一座珊瑚石城；拉穆岛与曼达岛之间的狭窄水道风平浪静，正是它的天然良港。城镇约建于1370年，日后跻身斯瓦希里商业城市之列：独桅帆船载着象牙、玳瑁、粮食和耐虫蛀的红树木材驶往阿拉伯与印度，换回布匹和瓷器。一位阿拉伯旅行家1441年在麦加遇到一位前去朝觐的拉穆法官，该城之名始见于记载。城中望族通过名为「永贝」的长老会议、坐镇宫殿执政。1444年的拉穆是一座富庶自治的穆斯林城市，商人、工匠和古兰经学者云集。

1506年，特里斯唐·达·库尼亚率领葡萄牙舰队封锁港道，迫使拉穆当即缴纳六百梅提卡尔金币，此后年年进贡。1580年代奥斯曼私掠船袭掠海岸，拉穆领头举城反抗，葡萄牙人费尽周折才将其重新压服；阿曼舰队从1652年起跨海来援，1696年终于把葡萄牙人彻底逐出。18世纪是拉穆的黄金时代：商人因印度洋贸易致富，望族建起今日老城所见的珊瑚石宅邸与清真寺，拉穆也成为斯瓦希里诗歌和宗教学术的中心。1800年前后，与帕泰的争霸给岁月蒙上阴影：帕泰苏丹富莫·马迪·伊本·阿比·巴克尔的军队攻占拉穆，着手在海滨修建巨大的堡垒。1813年，在城郊的谢拉，拉穆人把帕泰与蒙巴萨马兹鲁伊家族的入侵联军歼灭于滩头的船上；为保长治久安，拉穆请来阿曼布赛义德王朝的驻军。

en:
Mogadishu, called Xamar by its people, is the historic harbour at the centre of the Benadir coast. It grew rich as the seat of the Sultanate of Mogadishu before entering the Ajuran political world in the 13th century while retaining a powerful coastal court. When Ibn Battuta visited in 1331, Sultan Abu Bakr ibn Shaikh 'Umar ruled an exceedingly large city of wealthy merchants, and its fine Benadir cloth was exported to Egypt. Gold, ivory and beeswax also drew ships from Cambay and Aden, while stone houses several storeys high, palaces and cylindrical-minaret mosques lined the town. In 1444 the Sunni Somali city was near the height of its medieval prosperity.

Vasco da Gama's returning fleet bombarded Mogadishu in 1499 but did not take it. In 1542 João de Sepúlveda captured an Ottoman ship off the port and shelled the city until its sultan accepted a Portuguese peace. Portuguese power was never made permanent: in the 17th century Mogadishu passed with much of southern Somalia into the Hiraab Imamate. In 1701 the quarters of Hamarweyn and Shingani united against seven French ships whose crews had hoped to seize the city, and the attackers were repulsed after eleven days. Hiraab rule preserved Mogadishu's independence and its Indian Ocean trade through the following century.
zh:
摩加迪沙在当地又称哈马尔，是贝纳迪尔海岸中心的历史名港。它曾是摩加迪沙苏丹国的都城，13世纪进入阿朱兰的政治圈后，仍保留着强有力的沿海宫廷，靠印度洋贸易臻于富庶。1331年伊本·白图泰到访时，苏丹阿布·贝克尔·伊本·谢赫·奥马尔统治着一座极大的城市，城中富商云集，优质的贝纳迪尔布料远销埃及。黄金、象牙和蜂蜡也吸引坎贝与亚丁的商船前来，多层石屋、宫殿和带圆柱宣礼塔的清真寺沿街而立。1444年，这座逊尼派索马里城市正接近中世纪繁荣的顶峰。

1499年，瓦斯科·达·伽马返航途中的舰队炮轰摩加迪沙，但没有将其占领。1542年，若昂·德·塞普尔韦达在港外俘获一艘奥斯曼船只并炮击城市，迫使苏丹接受与葡萄牙人的和约。葡萄牙势力始终未能在此扎根：17世纪，摩加迪沙与索马里南部大片地区转入希拉布教长国。1701年，哈马尔韦恩和欣加尼两个城区联合抵御七艘试图夺城的法国船，十一天后将攻击者击退。此后一个世纪里，希拉布的统治维持了摩加迪沙的独立及其印度洋贸易。

en:
Qardho, also called Gardo, lies on the arid uplands of the Bari region in the northeastern Horn, between the Cape Guardafui coast and the Nugaal valley. It is one of a chain of old settlements in northern Somalia: in the Arie valley nearby stand the ruins of a substantial walled town, and the city is close to the burial place of the forefather of the Marehan Darod clan. Pastoral Somali clans grazed camels and goats in the thorn scrub and gathered frankincense and myrrh from the hills, carrying them down to boats plying the Guardafui shore. Around the opening of the 15th century the Majeerteen, a Darod sub-clan, began building a seafaring sultanate known to outsiders as Migiurtinia, centered on the port of Aluula. In 1444 the people of Qardho were Sunni Muslims living on the edge of that rising polity.

In the 1520s the Portuguese chaplain Francisco Álvares, writing from Abyssinia, described a ruler at Cape Guardafui who was a vassal of the Adal sultanate; the barren coast between the cape and Mount Felis used thick cloth as money and exported goats, white salt and white gum, which the Portuguese found excellent for caulking ships. Accounts place the formation of the Majeerteen sultanate variously from the early 15th to the mid-18th century. Qardho itself remained an inland market and watering point on the caravan road between the mountains and the ports, bound to the house of Aluula as the sultanate's power grew toward its 19th-century peak.
zh:
加尔多（Gardo）坐落在非洲之角东北部巴里地区的干旱高地上，介于瓜达富伊角海岸与努加尔河谷之间。它是索马里北部一连串古老定居点之一：附近的阿里河谷留有一座带厚墙的大城镇遗址，城外不远处便是达鲁德族马雷汉支系始祖的安葬之地。索马里游牧氏族在灌丛中放养骆驼和山羊，从山间采集乳香与没药，运到瓜达富伊角沿岸与航船交易。15世纪初前后，达鲁德人的马吉尔廷支系以阿卢拉港为中心，开始建立一个擅长航海的苏丹国，外界称米朱提尼亚。1444年的加尔多居民是逊尼派穆斯林，生活在这个新兴政权的边缘。

1520年代，身在阿比西尼亚的葡萄牙神父弗朗西斯科·阿尔瓦雷斯记述，瓜达富伊角有一位向阿达尔苏丹称臣的统治者；海角与费利斯山之间的荒瘠海岸以厚布当货币，出口山羊、白盐和白胶，葡萄牙人发现这种胶用来填船缝极好。关于马吉尔廷苏丹国的形成时间，各种记载从15世纪初到18世纪中叶不等。加尔多始终是山地商路通往各港口之间的内陆集市和水源地，随着苏丹国走向19世纪的鼎盛，它也一直臣属阿卢拉的王帐。

en:
The Ogaden is the great semi-arid plateau between the Ethiopian highlands and the Somali coast, the rangeland of Darod Somalis—above all the Ogaden clan—whose camel herds move between wells across the Haud. Its earlier people, the Harla, are remembered as kin of the Harari and the Somali clans, and the region was one of Islam's earliest footholds in the Horn: it belonged to the Ifat Sultanate in the 13th century and to the Adal Sultanate in the 15th. Around the headwaters of the Shebelle, on the province's western edge, lay the Muslim land of Bale, noted for cotton and credited by the Egyptian writer al-Umari with 18,000 horsemen; the Emperor Amda Seyon conquered it for Christian Ethiopia in 1332. In 1444 these plains formed the western pastureland of the Adal sultan Badlay ibn Sa'ad ad-Din, who ruled from the Harar plateau and was arming for a renewed war with the highlands.

That war opened in 1445 at the Battle of Gomit, where Emperor Zara Yaqob defeated and killed Badlay. Through the following decades the raiding bands of Imam Mahfuz of Zeila crossed these marches on their way into Christian country. Bale was the first Ethiopian territory raided by the imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi, who sent an army to subdue it in 1531; the forces fought the bloody Battle of Bali, after which, the chronicler writes, its people embraced Islam. Somali riders of the Ogaden filled his ranks until he fell at Wayna Daga in 1543. From the 1530s Oromo migrants spread into the open plains of Bale, while the Ajuran Sultanate governed the eastern Ogaden from Qalafo on the upper Shebelle until its decline in the 17th century. After 1647 the Emirate of Harar maintained walled trading settlements in the region, and from the 17th century its caravan trails carried Arsi slaves to Berbera. In the 18th century scholars from Harar, led by Sheikh Muhammad Tilma Tiamo, began the conversion of the Oromo of Bale.
zh:
欧加登是埃塞俄比亚高原与索马里海岸之间辽阔的半干旱高原，是达鲁德系索马里人——尤其是欧加登氏族——的牧地，他们的驼群往来于豪德高原各处水井之间。更早的居民哈拉人被视为哈勒尔人和索马里诸族的亲族；这里是伊斯兰教在非洲之角最早的立足点之一，13世纪属伊法特苏丹国，15世纪归入阿达尔苏丹国。省境西缘、谢贝利河源头一带是穆斯林地区巴勒，以产棉闻名，据埃及作者欧麦里记载能出动一万八千骑兵；1332年埃塞俄比亚皇帝阿姆达·塞约恩将它征服，纳入基督教帝国。1444年，这片平原是阿达尔苏丹巴德莱·伊本·萨阿德丁的西部牧场，他以哈勒尔高原为根基，正在整军准备与高原王朝再战。

这场战争在1445年的戈米特之战打响，皇帝扎拉·雅各布击败并斩杀巴德莱。此后数十年，泽拉的伊玛目马赫富兹不断率劫掠队伍穿过这些边区，深入基督教地区。巴勒是伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐最早袭扰的埃塞俄比亚领土，他在1531年派军征服巴勒，双方经历了惨烈的巴勒之战；编年史家称当地人随后尽奉伊斯兰教。欧加登的索马里骑兵是他军中的重要部分，直到1543年他战死于瓦伊纳达加。1530年代起，奥罗莫移民散布到巴勒的开阔平原；阿朱兰苏丹国则以谢贝利河上游的卡拉福为治所统辖东欧加登，直至17世纪衰落。1647年后，哈勒尔酋长国在这一带维持筑墙的商站；也是从17世纪起，商队经此把阿尔西奴隶运往柏培拉。18世纪，以谢赫·穆罕默德·提勒马·蒂亚莫为首的哈勒尔学者开始向巴勒的奥罗莫人传教。

en:
Degehabur, in Somali Dhagaxbuur, lies on the northern edge of the Ogaden, where the Jarar valley gives passage through the Haud between the Harar plateau and the Gulf of Aden coast. It is dry pasture country, worked mainly by Somali herdsmen of the Ogaden clan, who move camels, sheep and goats between scattered wells, and their livestock fed the inland trade of the Muslim sultanates. In the 15th century the district belonged to Adal, linked to the Red Sea commerce of Zeila and Berbera, and in 1444 it shared the fortunes of Sultan Badlay ibn Sa'ad ad-Din, who was mustering his amirs for a renewed war with Christian Ethiopia.

Badlay's venture ended the next year at the Battle of Gomit in 1445, when Emperor Zara Yaqob defeated and killed him. Around the turn of the 16th century Imam Mahfuz of Zeila led his raiders through these lowlands into the highlands, and in 1529 Somali levies of the region fought with Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi when he broke Emperor Dawit II's army at Shimbra Kure; the jihad overran most of Ethiopia until the Imam fell at Wayna Daga in 1543. Adal's court withdrew to Aussa in 1577 as Oromo migrants spread across the plains to the west, while the Haud around Degehabur remained Somali and Muslim.
zh:
德格赫布尔（索马里语名Dhagaxbuur）位于欧加登北缘，贾拉尔河谷在此穿过豪德高原，连通哈勒尔高原与亚丁湾海岸。这里是干旱牧场，主要由欧加登氏族的索马里牧民经营，他们赶着骆驼、绵羊和山羊游走于各处水井之间，牲畜支撑着穆斯林诸苏丹国的内陆贸易。15世纪时这一地区归属阿达尔，与泽拉、柏培拉的红海商路相连；1444年它随苏丹巴德莱·伊本·萨阿德丁的阿达尔一同进退，后者当时正召集诸埃米尔，准备与基督教埃塞俄比亚重开战端。

巴德莱的冒险次年便告终：1445年戈米特之战，皇帝扎拉·雅各布将其击败击杀。15、16世纪之交，泽拉的伊玛目马赫富兹率劫掠队伍经这些低地深入高原；1529年，伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐在欣布拉库雷击溃皇帝达维特二世的大军时，当地的索马里兵也在他军中。这场圣战席卷埃塞俄比亚大部，直到1543年伊玛目战死于瓦伊纳达加。1577年阿达尔宫廷迁往奥萨，奥罗莫移民随之散布到西面的平原，德格赫布尔周围的豪德高原则仍是索马里穆斯林的牧地。

en:
Berbera has the only sheltered roadstead on the southern shore of the Gulf of Aden. Greek sailors of the first century knew it as Malao, a market for myrrh, frankincense and, rarely, slaves, and Arab geographers called these waters the Gulf of Berbera. Together with Zeila it was one of the two great harbours of the Adal Sultanate: dhows from Aden and Cambay called there to carry away gold, ivory, honey, wax and meat, as Duarte Barbosa recorded early in the sixteenth century. In 1444 its Somali townsmen, Sunnis of the Shafi'i school, kept the port for the sultans of Adal, who ruled from Dakkar on the Harar plateau.

A Portuguese fleet under Lopo Soares de Albergaria and António de Saldanha sacked Berbera between 1516 and 1518. The coast was then drawn into the jihad of Imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi, who conquered most of Abyssinia between 1529 and his death in battle at Wayna Daga in 1543. After Adal's collapse soon after, Berbera came into the keeping of its own Somali clans, above all the Habr Awal, whose Sa'ad Musa merchant houses ran the town and its great annual fair, held each year from October to April. Caravans from Harar and Banyan merchants from India gathered there, and no European was allowed past the market into the interior. In July 1750 the Isaaq clans crowned their first sultan, Guled, while the Habr Awal trader lineages continued to govern Berbera itself, and by the eighteenth century it was the busiest port of the entire Somali seaboard.
zh:
柏培拉扼守亚丁湾南岸唯一有遮蔽的锚地。1世纪的希腊水手称它为马劳，是贩运没药、乳香和少量奴隶的市场，阿拉伯地理学家则把这片海域称作柏培拉湾。它与泽拉同为阿达尔苏丹国的两大港口：杜阿尔特·巴尔博萨在16世纪初记载，亚丁和坎贝的独桅船到此载走黄金、象牙、蜂蜜、蜂蜡和肉类。1444年，城里信奉逊尼派沙斐仪学派的索马里商民，为定都哈勒尔高原达卡尔的阿达尔苏丹经营着这座港口。

1516至1518年间，洛波·苏亚雷斯·德·阿尔贝尔加里亚与安东尼奥·德·萨尔达尼亚率领的葡萄牙舰队洗劫了柏培拉。随后这片海岸被卷入伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐的圣战，他在1529年至1543年战死于瓦伊纳达加之间征服了阿比西尼亚大部。阿达尔随之崩溃，柏培拉转入本地索马里氏族、主要是哈布尔阿瓦尔人之手，其萨阿德穆萨商人世家掌管城务和每年10月到次年4月的盛大集市，哈勒尔商队与印度巴尼亚商人云集于此，欧洲人则被挡在市集之外，不得深入内陆。1750年7月，艾萨克诸氏族拥戴古莱德为第一任苏丹，柏培拉本身仍由哈布尔阿瓦尔商人世家治理；到18世纪，它已是整个索马里海岸最繁忙的港口。

en:
Dawaro was a Muslim principality on the eastern flank of the Ethiopian highlands, covering much of what is now the Arsi country, between Hadiya and the southern province of Bale. The Egyptian writer al-Umari measured it as five days' journey in length by two, a land of cereals and fruit where horses and pack animals were reared and iron needles called hakunas served as money; its people were Sunnis of the Hanafi school. After its ruler Haydara rebelled, Emperor Amda Seyon ravaged and garrisoned it in the 1320s, and it became a tributary province of the Christian empire, planted with military colonists under Dawit I and governed for Zara Yaqob by Fitawrari Barje, while the sultans of Adal never ceased to claim it. In 1444 Dawaro was the most fiercely contested borderland in the Horn, pressed between Zara Yaqob's garrisons and the rising power of Sultan Badlay.

Badlay invaded the following year and was defeated and killed at the Battle of Gomit in 1445. After Emperor Na'od was beaten by Imam Mahfuz of Zeila the Adalites briefly held Dawaro, until Dawit II won it back, but it was again among the first provinces to face Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi: raided in 1526–27, stripped of an army in the disaster at Shimbra Kure in 1529, and occupied in the summer of 1531, when its great church was destroyed and its people were offered Islam or the poll tax, with Amir Husain al-Gaturi made governor. After the Imam's death at Wayna Daga in 1543 his nephew Abbas, who ruled Dawaro together with Fatagar and Bale, was defeated and killed by the Emperor Gelawdewos; a band of 140 Portuguese banished to the province then held it for four months until Oromo migrants overwhelmed them after eleven or twelve days' fighting, when their powder ran out, and the old frontier kingdom vanished into the Oromo sea.
zh:
达瓦罗是埃塞俄比亚高原东翼的一个穆斯林小邦，辖地大体相当于今阿尔西地区，处在哈迪亚与南方的巴勒之间。埃及作者欧麦里称其地长约五日路程、宽约两日路程，出产谷物和水果，饲养马匹与驮畜，以一种叫哈库纳的铁针充当货币，居民是遵奉哈乃斐学派的逊尼派穆斯林。其统治者海达拉发动反叛后，皇帝阿姆达·塞约恩在1320年代纵兵蹂躏并在此驻军，达瓦罗遂成为基督教帝国的朝贡省份；达维特一世时迁来军屯户，扎拉·雅各布又任命菲茨乌拉里·巴尔热为总督，而阿达尔诸苏丹从未放弃对它的索取。1444年，达瓦罗夹在扎拉·雅各布的驻军与苏丹巴德莱崛起的势力之间，是非洲之角争夺最激烈的边地。

次年巴德莱大举入侵，1445年在戈米特之战兵败身亡。皇帝纳奥德被泽拉的伊玛目马赫富兹击败后，阿达尔一度据有达瓦罗，至达维特二世时收复；但它又是最先直面艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐的省份之一：1526至1527年遭其袭掠，1529年在欣布拉库雷的惨败中丧尽军队，1531年夏被占领——大教堂被毁，居民只能在改宗伊斯兰教与人头税之间作选择，埃米尔·侯赛因·勒加图里受命出任总督。伊玛目1543年战死于瓦伊纳达加后，兼治达瓦罗、法塔加尔和巴勒的其侄阿巴斯被皇帝加拉德沃斯击败击杀；被流放至此的一百四十名葡萄牙人据守此地四个月，与涌入的奥罗莫人激战十一二天，终因火药耗尽而撤走，这个古老的边地小邦就此没入奥罗莫人的海洋。

en:
Harar rises on a cool plateau of the eastern highlands, looking down the trade roads toward Zeila
and Arabia. Islam gained a foothold on the Harar plateau in the tenth and eleventh centuries through
trade with Zeila, and local tradition remembers the preacher Abadir Umar ar-Rida settling
there about 1216. The town first enters written history in the chronicles of Amda Seyon I, when in
1332 three of its governors marched against the Christian host at the battle of Das. In 1415 the
Walashma dynasty, back from Yemen, founded the sultanate of Adal and seated themselves at nearby
Dakkar. Thus in 1444 Harar was the sultanate's richest market and a seat of Muslim learning, the
City of Saints crowded with mosques and shrines, though not yet its capital.

Sultan Abu Bakr moved the court to Harar itself in 1520, and five years later Imam Ahmad ibn
Ibrahim, Gragn the Left-handed, made himself master of the town and launched from it the jihad
that ravaged Christian Ethiopia until he fell at Wayna Daga in 1543. Nur ibn Mujahid, marrying
Ahmad's widow Bati del Wambara, renewed the wars and slew Emperor Galawdewos in 1559; broken by
the Oromo at Hazalo soon afterwards, he ringed Harar with the great wall still called Jugol and
himself died of the plague in 1568. By 1577 Oromo bands had wasted more than a hundred villages
about the walls, and the sultans withdrew to Aussa. In 1647 the townsmen cast off Aussa and raised
Ali ibn Da'ud as their own emir; even the Oromo raid that reached the Asmadin Gate in September
1662 and killed the emir's son could not take the city. Through the following generations Harar
lived behind its gates by its caravans and its copyists, famed for illuminated Qur'ans and for
its trade into Shewa, and so the little emirate entered the year 1821.
zh:
哈勒尔坐落在东部高地一处凉爽的台原上，俯瞰着通往泽拉与阿拉伯半岛的商路。10至11世纪，
伊斯兰教经由与泽拉的贸易传入哈勒尔高地，民间传说则铭记着教士阿巴迪尔·
奥马尔·里达约在1216年到此定居。哈勒尔初载史册，是在阿姆达·塞永一世的编年史中：
1332年，它的三位长官率军参加达斯之战，抗击基督徒大军。1415年，从也门归来的瓦拉什马
王朝建立阿达尔苏丹国，定都在近旁的达卡尔。因此1444年时，哈勒尔已是苏丹国最富庶的
商镇和伊斯兰教学术中心，清真寺与圣徒墓密集，号称「圣徒之城」，只是尚未成为都城。

1520年，苏丹阿布·巴克尔把宫廷迁到哈勒尔；五年后，伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣
——即「左撇子」格兰——掌控全城，以此为基地发动圣战，横扫基督教埃塞俄比亚，直到他
1543年殒命瓦伊纳达加。努尔·伊本·穆贾希德娶艾哈迈德的遗孀巴蒂·德尔·万巴拉为妻，
再启战端，1559年阵斩皇帝加拉德沃斯；但他不久在哈扎洛被奥罗莫人击败，于是环哈勒尔
筑起后来称作贾戈勒的高大城墙，他本人也在1568年死于瘟疫。到1577年，奥罗莫游骑已在
城外焚毁百余座村庄，苏丹们退避阿乌萨。1647年，市民拒绝阿乌萨的统治，拥立阿里·
伊本·达乌德为自己的埃米尔；1662年9月，奥罗莫人一度突袭到阿斯马丁门下、杀了埃米尔
之子，却仍未能破城。此后一代代人在城门之内靠商队和抄经为生，以彩绘《古兰经》和通往
绍阿的贸易闻名，这个小小的埃米尔国就这样走入1821年。

en:
Zeila lies on a flat shore of the Gulf of Aden among small islands, the seaward end of the oldest
trade road out of the Ethiopian highlands. Greek sailors of the Periplus knew this coast as
Avalites, from which frankincense was shipped north, and Islam came early: its Mosque of the Two
Qiblas is dated to the seventh century, and by the ninth Zeila was already the seat of the Muslim
kingdom of Adal and later of Ifat. In 1332 its king fell in battle against Amda Seyon I, and in
1410 the Emperor Dawit slew Sultan Sa'ad ad-Din II before the town; his sons fled to Yemen and
returned in 1415 to rule Adal from inland Dakkar. Thus in 1444, no longer the capital, Zeila was
still the sultanate's sea gate, a wholly Muslim city of Somali merchants and Shafi'i scholars,
where the caravans of Harar unloaded incense and the wealth of the interior for Aden.

Early in the sixteenth century Duarte Barbosa found a populous town of whitewashed stone houses
and fine streets trading to Aden, yet Portuguese squadrons sacked it in 1517 and again in 1528.
It remained Adal's arsenal through the great war, for the Ottoman muskets and cannon that armed
Ahmad Gragn were unloaded on these quays. After his empire collapsed, nomad raids drove the ruler
Garad Lado to gird the town with a stout wall of five gates, and during the Adal civil wars a
Somali clan stormed and plundered it. From 1630 Zeila bowed to the ruler of Mocha across the
water, who farmed its customs for a price; an emir held the walls with a few cannon and
matchlockmen against inland nomads and brigands of the gulf. Shrunken from its old greatness but
still the harbour where Harar's caravans met the sea, it passed under that loose Yemeni and
Ottoman lordship into the year 1821.
zh:
泽拉位于亚丁湾一处平坦海岸，外有小岛环绕，是埃塞俄比亚高原最古老商路的出海一端。
《厄立特里亚海航行记》时代的希腊水手把这一带海岸称作阿瓦利特斯，乳香从此装船北上；
伊斯兰教来得很早，城中的双米哈拉布双朝向清真寺可追溯到7世纪，到9世纪泽拉已是穆斯林
阿达尔王国、后来又是伊法特苏丹国的都城。1332年，阿达尔国王在抵御阿姆达·塞永一世
的战事中败亡；1410年，埃塞俄比亚皇帝达维特又在城下攻杀苏丹萨阿德丁二世，苏丹诸子
逃往也门，1415年归来后改在内陆的达卡尔发号施令。所以1444年时，泽拉虽不再是都城，
却仍是苏丹国的海上门户：一座清一色穆斯林的城市，聚居着索马里商人和沙斐仪派学者，
哈勒尔商队把熏香和内陆的财富运到这里，再转贩亚丁。

16世纪初，杜阿尔特·巴尔博萨见到的泽拉人口稠密，灰白石屋夹着整齐的街道，与亚丁
贸易不绝；但葡萄牙舰队先后在1517年和1528年洗劫此城。大战期间它仍是阿达尔的军火
口岸，装备格兰的奥斯曼火枪与火炮都在这些码头起卸。他的帝国崩溃后，游牧部落不断
袭扰，统治者加拉德·拉多下令环城建起有五座城门的坚固城墙，而在阿达尔内战中，一个
索马里氏族还是攻破并劫掠了城市。从1630年起，泽拉臣服于海对岸的穆哈统治者，港口
关税被作价承包；一位埃米尔靠几门大炮和少量火绳枪手守城，抵御内陆游牧民和海湾海盗。
它已不复昔日盛况，但哈勒尔商队依旧在此入海——就在这种也门与奥斯曼松散的宗主权下，
泽拉走入了1821年。

en:
Shewa is the broad highland region at the heart of Ethiopia, Amhara country above the gorges of the Awash and the Blue Nile. It was from here that the Solomonic restoration began, when Yekuno Amlak of Tegulet overthrew the Zagwe in 1270, and emperors long kept their camps and capitals at Tegulet and Barara while the monastery of Debre Libanos drew pilgrims from across the realm. The southern district of Fatagar, with its royal town of Badeqe, faced the Muslim principalities of Hadiya and Adal. In 1444 Shewa was the Christian core of the empire of Zara Yaqob, rich in horses and grain, its southern lords watching the frontier.

Zara Yaqob founded Debre Birhan after a celestial light in 1456 and spent his last years there, but under his son the court returned to its wandering camps. In September 1528 Ahmad Gran's Adal army fell on Badeqe, the first named battle of its conquest; Shewa was overrun and its towns and monasteries sacked, until the imam's death at Wayna Daga in 1543 let Galawdewos restore Christian rule, though the emperor himself fell at Fatagar in 1559. From the 1570s Oromo clans moving north occupied most of Shewa, and by the end of the century the Amhara survivors were reduced to mountain enclaves around Menz. Negasi Krestos reunited those districts around 1682 and waged wars of reconquest; his successors ruled as meridazmachs, and Amha Iyasus, reigning from about 1744, fixed his capital at Ankober. During the Era of the Princes the kingdom of Shewa held its own, Asfaw Wossen dividing his time among Ankober, Debre Birhan and Angolalla until 1808.
zh:
绍阿是埃塞俄比亚腹地一片广阔的高地，是阿瓦什河与青尼罗河峡谷之上的阿姆哈拉之地。所罗门系王朝的复辟正是从这里开始：1270年，特古莱特的叶库诺·阿姆拉克推翻扎格维王朝；此后皇帝们长期在特古莱特和巴拉拉驻跸建都，德卜勒利巴诺斯修道院则吸引着全国的朝圣者。南部的法塔加尔区以王城巴德盖为中心，正对哈迪亚和阿达尔等穆斯林小邦。1444年的绍阿是扎拉·雅各布帝国的基督教腹地，出产马匹和谷物，南边的领主们守望着边疆。

1456年，扎拉·雅各布因天现异光建立德卜勒伯尔汉，并在那里度过晚年，但到他儿子在位时，朝廷又回到四处移动的营帐。1528年9月，艾哈迈德·格兰的阿达尔军队进攻巴德盖，这是其征服战争中第一场有记载的战役；绍阿被攻陷，城镇和修道院遭到洗劫，直到1543年伊玛目在韦纳达加战死，盖劳德沃斯才恢复基督教统治，而他本人于1559年在法塔加尔阵亡。1570年代起，北迁的奥罗莫诸部占据绍阿大部，到该世纪末，幸存的阿姆哈拉人退守门兹一带的山地据点。1682年前后，内加西·克雷斯托斯重新统一这些地区并发动收复战争；他的继承者以默里达兹马奇之号统治绍阿，约1744年即位的阿姆哈·伊亚苏斯定都安科伯尔。在「王侯时代」，绍阿王国自保一方，阿斯法·沃森在1808年之前轮流驻跸于安科伯尔、德卜勒伯尔汉和安戈拉拉。

en:
Wollo, known in the Middle Ages as Bete Amhara, is the highland country between the Bashilo and Wanchet rivers, dropping eastward to the Afar desert. It was the cradle of the restored Solomonic line: Abba Iyasus Mo'a founded the island monastery of Istifanos in Lake Hayq in 1248, and his pupil Yekuno Amlak overthrew the Zagwe in 1270. At Ambassel the flat-topped Amba Geshen held the emperor's male kinsmen for life and guarded the imperial treasury; Zara Yaqob passed nearly thirty years on its summit before coming to the throne in 1434. In 1444, under Zara Yaqob, Bete Amhara was the empire's most devoutly Christian province, a grain-rich plateau of churches and monasteries, and its governor was the highest military officer after the emperor.

On 28 October 1531 the imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi, called Gran, routed Lebna Dengel at Amba Sel and overran the province: Istifanos was looted and burned that November, and Amba Geshen, twice assaulted in vain, fell in 1540 and its garrison was put to the sword. Mekane Selassie, the vast church begun by the emperor Na'od and finished by his son Lebna Dengel around 1520, which the Portuguese Francisco Álvares had seen sheathed in gold, was destroyed in the same war. From the 1570s Oromo clans moving north settled the land, adopted Islam and renamed its districts after their own lineages; Christian Amhara survived only in the western highlands and around Ambassel. By the late eighteenth century the Muslim lords of Wollo could defy the emperor Tekle Giyorgis I, and his campaigns failed to subdue them.
zh:
沃罗在中世纪称贝特阿姆哈拉，是巴希洛河与万切特河之间的高地，东缘直落阿法尔沙漠。这里是所罗门王朝中兴的摇篮：伊亚苏斯·莫阿1248年在海格湖的岛上创建伊斯蒂法诺斯修道院，他的门生耶库诺·阿姆拉克于1270年推翻扎格维王朝。安巴塞尔的格申山是一座平顶要塞，皇帝的男性亲族终身囚禁于此，国库也存放在山上；扎拉·雅各布1434年登基前在山顶度过了近三十年。1444年扎拉·雅各布在位时，贝特阿姆哈拉是帝国基督教信仰最虔诚的省份，这片盛产谷物的高原上教堂与修道院林立，本省总督也是仅次于皇帝的最高军职。

1531年10月28日，伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐（绰号格兰）在安巴塞尔击溃皇帝勒布纳·丹加尔（达维特二世）的大军，席卷全省；同年11月伊斯蒂法诺斯修道院遭洗劫焚毁，格申山两次击退进攻后于1540年陷落，守军尽数被杀。梅卡内·塞拉西大教堂由纳奥德皇帝兴工、其子达维特二世建成，约1520年落成，葡萄牙人弗朗西斯科·阿尔瓦雷斯曾见它通体包金，也在这场战争中被毁。1570年代起，北迁的奥罗莫诸部落地居于此，改宗伊斯兰教，并以本部落之名重命地名；信奉基督教的阿姆哈拉人只在西部高地和安巴塞尔一带存留下来。到18世纪末，沃罗的穆斯林领主已能公然抗拒特克勒·吉约吉斯一世，皇帝的征讨也未能将其制服。

en:
Tadjoura (Afar Tagórri) clusters around its wells on the northern shore of the gulf that takes its name, said to mean 'the place of goatskin water-flasks'; it is counted the oldest town on the Djibouti coast. Its Muslim Afar, known to the Arabs as Danakil, pastured camels and goats on the arid coast and sent caravans inland toward the Awash and Shewa. In the fourteenth century the coast obeyed the rulers of Zeila, and in 1444 Tadjoura belonged to the Adal sultanate, which under Sultan Badlay was arming for its great war with Christian Ethiopia. Zeila quite overshadowed it, and Tadjoura remained a small anchorage where Red Sea traders took water, livestock and salt.

Afar tradition places the founding of the local sultanate, whose rulers bore the title dardar, in the fifteenth century, and from the sixteenth Tadjoura was the seat of the Ad-Ali line. The port lived in the shadow of Zeila through Adal's wars with Ethiopia and the Ottoman conquest of Massawa in 1557, and eighteenth-century European travellers barely noticed it. In 1810 the Adoimara Afar, the 'white house', defeated their rivals the Asa-yamara, opening the way for the development of the port and its links with the Ethiopian interior.
zh:
塔朱拉（阿法尔语称塔戈里）依偎在同名海湾北岸的水井四周，地名意为「备有羊皮水囊之地」，被视为吉布提海岸最古老的城镇。当地穆斯林阿法尔人——阿拉伯人称之为达纳基尔人——在干旱的海岸放牧骆驼和山羊，商队则深入内陆，通往阿瓦什河与绍阿。14世纪时这一带海岸臣属于泽伊拉的统治者；1444年，塔朱拉是阿达尔苏丹国的一部分，苏丹巴德莱正在集结大军，准备与基督教埃塞俄比亚决战。但塔朱拉的光芒始终被泽伊拉掩盖，不过是红海商人补充淡水、装运牲畜和食盐的小锚地。

按阿法尔人的传说，当地苏丹国建于15世纪，统治者号称「达尔达尔」；16世纪起，塔朱拉成为阿德阿里一系的都城。在阿达尔与埃塞俄比亚连年交战、奥斯曼于1557年夺取马萨瓦的年代，这座港口一直活在泽伊拉的阴影里，18世纪的欧洲旅人几乎没有留意过它。1810年，阿法尔人的「白房子」阿多伊马拉支击败对手阿萨亚马拉，为港口发展及其与埃塞俄比亚内陆的联系开辟了道路。

en:
The Taqali massif is the high core of the Nuba Mountains, rising out of the dry Kordofan plain. Its Tagale people and their Nuba neighbours farmed the terraced valleys, spoke Kordofanian tongues and kept to their own gods while Muslim states rose and fell along the Nile. The surrounding semi-desert could not feed an invading army, and the rocky hills were a natural fortress. In 1444 the highland villages answered to no outside master, and no chronicle yet knew a kingdom of Taqali.

Oral tradition dates the Taqali kingship to the early sixteenth century, when the Funj founded the kingdom of Sennar; whether legend or history, the hills bought their peace with an annual tribute, and Sennar never conquered them. Some scholars believe the state took shape between 1750 and 1780, when Muhammad Wad Jayli began the work of unification and his son Ismail made himself makk of the '99 hills' of the Nuba. Abakr succeeded his father without bloodshed in 1800. The tribute to Sennar was still being paid in 1821, when Egyptian armies overran the Funj kingdom and Taqali stood alone.
zh:
塔哥里高原是努巴山脉高耸的核心，矗立在干旱的科尔多凡平原之上。这里的塔哥里人与相邻的努巴各部在梯田间耕作，操科尔多凡语族的语言，信奉自己的神祇，任凭穆斯林政权在尼罗河畔兴亡更迭。外围的半荒漠养不起入侵的大军，岩石山地本身就是天然要塞。1444年，高原上的村落不受任何外来主人统辖，史书中也还没有塔哥里王国这个名字。

口传传统把塔哥里王权的起源追溯到16世纪初丰吉人建立森纳尔王国之时；无论传说还是信史，群山以年年进贡换取和平，森纳尔始终未能征服这里。一些学者认为国家成形于1750至1780年间：穆罕默德·瓦德·吉里开始统一之业，其子伊斯玛仪成为努巴「九十九山」的马克（国王）。1800年，阿布·巴克尔和平继位。向森纳尔纳贡的惯例一直维持到1821年——这一年埃及军队攻灭丰吉王国，塔哥里独自暴露在强敌面前。

en:
Fazughli is hill country on the Sudanese-Ethiopian frontier, where Blue Nile highlands overlook the gold-bearing Tumat valley. Medieval Alodia once claimed the borderlands, and the Jebel Mahadid archaeological sites suggest that Nubian settlers were already moving into the Qwara hills in the fourteenth century as that Christian kingdom declined. Gumuz, Burun and Bertha communities held the valleys and ridges, trading gold and horses toward the Ethiopian world. In 1444, before the Funj sultanate had risen at Sennar, neither a lowland Nile ruler nor the Ethiopian crown firmly controlled the scattered hill settlements, yet neighboring merchants and princes already knew the value of their goldfields.

After Alodia's capital Soba fell around 1500, oral traditions describe Alodian exiles joining the highland peoples and forging the Kingdom of Fazughli, a buffer between Sennar and Ethiopia. Portuguese reports of 1607 and 1622 praised its fine gold and horses. Emperor Susenyos conquered the kingdom in 1615, but Ethiopian control slipped after the death of Yohannes I. In 1685 Sennar subdued the Hamaj princelings and kept the local ruler in office with the title of manjil. The Hamaj elite remained Christian for at least a generation before converting to Islam by the mid-eighteenth century. In 1761-1762 Muhammad Abu Likayik, a commander from Fazughli, seized power at Sennar and began the Hamaj Regency, which lasted until the Turco-Egyptian invasion of 1821.
zh:
法索格利（中文资料常作法祖格利）是苏丹与埃塞俄比亚交界处的山地，青尼罗河高地俯瞰着产金的图马特河谷。中世纪的阿勒底亚曾控制这片边地，杰贝勒马哈迪德遗址显示，随着这个基督教努比亚王国衰落，努比亚定居者在14世纪已进入夸拉山区。古穆兹人、布龙人和贝尔塔人据有山谷与山脊，以黄金和马匹同埃塞俄比亚方面交易。1444年，丰吉人尚未在森纳尔建立苏丹国，尼罗河谷地的统治者和埃塞俄比亚皇帝都未牢固控制这些分散的山寨，但周边商人与王公都已知道此地金矿的价值。

约1500年阿勒底亚首都索巴陷落后，口述传统称阿勒底亚遗民加入高地诸族，形成法索格利王国，在森纳尔与埃塞俄比亚之间充当缓冲。1607年和1622年的葡萄牙记载都称赞这里的优质黄金与良马。1615年，埃塞俄比亚皇帝苏斯尼约斯征服该王国，但约翰尼斯一世死后，埃塞俄比亚的控制逐渐丧失。1685年，森纳尔降服哈马杰诸酋长，保留本地统治者并授予其「曼吉尔」头衔。哈马杰精英在被征服后仍保持基督教至少一代人，到18世纪中叶已改宗伊斯兰教。1761至1762年，出身法索格利的将领穆罕默德·阿布·利凯利克夺取森纳尔政权，开启哈马杰摄政，其统治一直延续到1821年土埃入侵。

en:
Sidamo is the green highland country between lakes Hawassa and Abaya, east of the Bilate River that divides it from Wolayta. Coffee grew wild in the misty mountain forests, and beans gathered here went out with the caravan trade towards the Red Sea. Sidama oral tradition remembers an earlier people, the Hofa, inhabiting the lake country before the Sidama arrived; in 1444 these valleys lay beyond the Christian empire to the north and the Muslim sultanates to the east.

Sidama oral tradition remembers the clans as once dwelling in Bale on the upper Dawa. In the early sixteenth century the expanding Oromo drove them west into the lake country, where they drove out the Hofa. The Cushitic-speaking Sidama farmed and raised cattle, divided into rival clans: the eight Yemericho clans of the first settlers and the twelve more numerous Aletta. Each clan followed its mootichcha, a king chosen from the kingly families and presented to the people at the Fichche, the Sidama new-year gathering.
zh:
锡达莫是阿瓦萨湖与阿巴亚湖之间、比拉特河以东的青翠高地，河对岸便是瓦莱塔。雾气缭绕的山林里野生着咖啡，采摘的豆子随商队走向红海商路。锡达莫人的口述传统记得，在他们到来之前，湖群地带住着霍法人；1444年，这片谷地位于北方基督教帝国与东方穆斯林苏丹国的势力范围之外。

锡达莫人的口述传统称，诸氏族原本住在达瓦河上游的巴莱。16世纪初，向外扩张的奥罗莫人迫使他们西迁到湖群地带，他们又驱逐了原住的霍法人。说库希特语的锡达莫人以农耕和畜牧为生，分成彼此争战的氏族：最早定居的八支耶梅里乔氏族，以及人数更多的十二支阿莱塔氏族。各氏族有自己的穆蒂恰，即由王族选出、在锡达莫新年菲切大会上向族人宣告登位的首领。

en:
Darfur is the Sahelian country around the volcanic Marrah Mountains, whose springs and wells make settled life possible in a dry plateau. The Daju had formed a kingdom there by the twelfth century, but by 1444 Tunjur rulers held power around mountain centres such as Uri and Ain Farah, taking tribute from Fur villages and from caravan roads linking the interior to Egypt and the central Sudan. The future capital Al-Fashir was not yet a royal town; the wealth of the country moved in slaves, ivory, horses, cloth and salt along desert-edge routes.

Around 1600 Sulayman Solong established the Keira sultanate, made Islam the religion of his court and expanded over neighbouring Masalit, Zaghawa, Birged, Beigo and Tunjur communities. Slaves and ivory from the south were exchanged through the northern caravans for horses, weapons and cloth. Muhammad Tayrab, ruling from about 1753 to 1785, put down Birged and Tunjur revolts and conquered Kordofan around 1785, carrying Darfur's power toward the Nile. After the civil war that followed his death, Abd al-Rahman al-Rashid pitched his itinerant court, or fashir, at Rahad Tendelti in the north; the settlement around the palace became Al-Fashir. In 1821 Muhammad Ali's Turco-Egyptian army seized Kordofan and routed a Darfur army near Bara on 19 August, though it did not then push on into the Marrah Mountains.
zh:
达尔富尔是环绕火山高地迈拉山的萨赫勒之地，山泉和水井使干燥高原上的定居生活成为可能。达朱人12世纪已在山区立国，但到1444年，通朱尔统治者已在乌里、艾因法拉赫等山地据点掌权，向富尔人的村落和通往埃及、苏丹中部的商路征取贡赋。后来的首府法希尔此时还不是王城；奴隶、象牙、马匹、布匹和盐顺着沙漠边缘的道路流动，构成此地的财富。

1600年前后，苏莱曼·索龙建立凯拉苏丹国，把伊斯兰教立为王庭宗教，并征服邻近的马萨利特、扎加瓦、比尔吉德、贝戈和通朱尔社群。南方的奴隶与象牙经北方商队换得马匹、武器和布匹。穆罕默德·泰拉布约1753—1785年在位，镇压比尔吉德人和通朱尔人的叛乱，又在约1785年征服科尔多凡，把达尔富尔的势力推向尼罗河。他死后的内战结束后，阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·拉希德把流动王庭「法希尔」设在北方的拉哈德·坦德勒提；围绕王宫形成的聚落便是后来的法希尔。1821年，穆罕默德·阿里的土埃军队夺取科尔多凡，并于8月19日在巴拉附近击溃达尔富尔军队，不过当时尚未深入迈拉山。

en:
The Bayuda is the stony and sandy desert embraced by the great bend of the Nile, running from the crossings below Korti south towards the river confluence. Scorched pasture and the wells of the Wadi Abu Dom and Wadi Muqaddam sustain Arabized Nubian herdsmen of the Ja'al country, Ja'ali and Shaigiya clans who move camels, sheep and cattle between the desert and the Nile banks; diggers had worked the gold-bearing wadis since the early Arab centuries, and its wells served parties striking across the bend to shorten the long river loop. By the fifteenth century Christian Makuria was only a memory here, its court long gone from Dongola, and the desert clans answered to no strong master. In 1444 they lived by their herds and wells and the escort they gave caravans, while Nubian-speaking farmers still held the Nile villages on either flank.

The coming of the Funj tied these loose lands to Sennar: by 1523 Amara Dunqas's rule reached as far north as Dongola, and for a time the northern marches were governed for him by the Abdallabi chiefs of Qarri. Under Sheikh Ajib their power ran from Dongola to the Ethiopian hills, until the Funj broke him at the battle of Karkoj in 1611–12 and confirmed his sons as vassal lords of the whole north. Around 1690 the Shaigiya, whose mailed riders controlled the Nile edge of the Bayuda, threw off Qarri and Sennar and lived by raiding caravan and village alike. When Mamluk fugitives from Egypt seized Dongola in 1812 the old order was already crumbling, and in 1820 the Shaigiya horsemen were broken by Turkish fire at Korti, opening the desert road to the conquest of Sennar.
zh:
百卢达是被尼罗河大弯三面环抱的石质沙海，北起库尔提以下的渡河处，南延至两河汇流之地。焦渴的牧场和阿布多姆干河、穆卡达姆干河的水井，养活着达尔贾阿尔的阿拉伯化努比亚牧人——贾阿林和沙伊吉亚诸部；他们驱赶骆驼、绵羊和牛群，在沙漠与尼罗河岸之间转徙。早自阿拉伯时代初期，采金人就在这一带干河中翻掘含金矿脉，行旅也借这些水井横穿河曲，省去尼罗河上的漫长绕行。到15世纪，基督教的马库里亚在此只余下记忆，栋古拉的宫廷早已迁离，沙漠部族再无强势的君主。1444年，他们赖以为生的是畜群、水井以及为商队护航所得的报酬，两侧河畔的村庄里则仍住着说努比亚语的农人。

丰吉人的到来把这片松散的土地与森纳尔连在一起：到1523年，阿马拉·敦卡斯的势力已北达栋古拉，北境一度由驻在加里的阿卜杜拉比酋长替他管辖。谢赫阿吉布当权时，其势力从栋古拉一直伸展到埃塞俄比亚山地，直到丰吉人在1611至1612年的卡尔科杰之战将其击灭，并确认他的儿子们为整个北方的藩属首领。约1690年，扼守百卢达尼罗河畔的沙伊吉亚人摆脱加里与森纳尔自立，披甲骑手以劫掠商队和村落为生。1812年逃出埃及的马穆鲁克余部夺取栋古拉时，旧秩序已然倾颓；1820年，沙伊吉亚骑兵在库尔提被土耳其人的火器击溃，横穿沙漠、征服森纳尔的道路就此打开。

en:
El Obeid grew up around deep wells in the sandy wastes of central Kordofan, a caravan halt called Lobeid, 'the little white one', later remembered as the 'bride of the sands'. Herdsmen and millet farmers of the Nuba and Nubian fringe kept their old beliefs while merchants passed between Darfur, Dongola and the Nile. Tradition remembers the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries as the age of the Musaba'at, when Lobeid throve on the caravan trade; later the Funj of Sennar made themselves felt through their clients, the Ghudiyat. In 1444 the wells and the thorn-scrub country around them owned no firm master, yet the great caravans still came north to Egypt and east to the Nile.

In 1734 Isawi of the Musabba'at, of an exiled branch of Darfur's royal house, drove out the Ghudiyat and beat off the Funj, but after his death Kordofan fell to Muhammad Abu Likaylik, the strongman of Sennar. Around 1772 Hashim of the Musabba'at won the country back and began to build a state, only to be expelled by the Funj in 1780; their defeat in 1784 left Kordofan to the viceroys of Darfur. Under them the merchants went untaxed, the Dongolawi founded Bara as a second market town, and caravans from Egypt and Abyssinia unloaded at Lobeid. That prosperity ended in 1821, when Muhammad Ali Pasha sent his son-in-law the Defterdar with some 4,500 men and eight guns to conquer Kordofan; the Egyptian army founded the modern town of El Obeid that same year.
zh:
奥贝德（即欧拜伊德）起于科尔多凡中部沙海中的几眼深井，商旅称之为卢拜德，意为「小白城」，后来又有「沙漠新娘」之名。努巴与努比亚边缘地带的牧民和粟农守着旧有信仰，商人则在达尔富尔、栋古拉与尼罗河之间往来。按当地传统，15至16世纪是穆萨巴阿特人的时代，卢拜德靠商队贸易兴盛；后来森纳尔的丰吉人通过附庸古迪亚特人在此施加影响。1444年，这些水井和周围的荆棘荒野并无稳固的主人，大商队却依旧北去埃及、东往尼罗河。

1734年，出身达尔富尔王族流亡支系的穆萨巴阿特首领伊萨维赶走古迪亚特人，击退丰吉人；他死后，科尔多凡落入森纳尔的强权人物穆罕默德·阿布·利凯利克之手。约1772年，穆萨巴阿特人的哈希姆起兵收复故土、着手建国，却在1780年被丰吉人驱逐；1784年森纳尔一方惨败，科尔多凡改由达尔富尔的总督治理。这一时期商人免税，栋古拉人建起第二座商镇巴拉，来自埃及和阿比西尼亚的商队在卢拜德卸货。繁荣止于1821年：穆罕默德·阿里帕夏派女婿德夫特达尔率兵约四千五百人、携炮八门征服科尔多凡，埃及人同年在水井旁筑起欧拜伊德城。

en:
The Gezira, the 'island' of fertile plain enclosed by the Blue and White Niles, was for centuries the granary of the Christian Nubian kingdom of Alodia. As Alodia crumbled, Arab Bedouin drifted into its pastures with Islam and the Arabic tongue, and by the fifteenth century the Abdallabi tribal federation dominated the district, while ancient towns such as Arbagi lived on as Muslim settlements. In 1444 the confluence country was ruled in fragments by Nubian lords and Arab sheikhs, its grain and cattle sent north down the Nile and east to the Red Sea.

In 1504 the Funj of Amara Dunqas advanced up the Blue Nile, allied with the Abdallab and made the Gezira the centre of their sultanate, whose capital rose at Sennar; David Reubeni in 1523 found him a Muslim sultan forever touring his herds. Royal caravans carried gold, ivory and slaves across the plain, Sufi sheikhs settled in the villages, and market towns multiplied in the seventeenth-century boom. Slave-army revolts and the Hamaj seizure of power in 1762 broke the monarchy, and after 1802 the Gezira was all that remained of the sultanate. The regent Muhammad Adlan gave it thirteen years of order before his murder early in 1821, and in May the Turco-Egyptian army reached the confluence.
zh:
杰济拉在阿拉伯语中意为「岛屿」，是青尼罗河与白尼罗河环抱的肥沃平原，几个世纪里一直是基督教努比亚王国阿洛迪亚的粮仓。阿洛迪亚瓦解后，阿拉伯贝都因人带着伊斯兰教和阿拉伯语进入这片牧场，到15世纪阿卜杜拉布部落联盟已主导此地，阿尔巴吉等古城也作为穆斯林聚落延续下来。1444年的两河汇流之地由努比亚首领和阿拉伯谢赫分地而治，谷物和牲畜沿尼罗河北运、东销红海。

1504年，阿马拉·敦卡斯率丰吉人沿青尼罗河北上，与阿卜杜拉布结盟，把杰济拉变成其苏丹国的中心，定都附近的森纳尔；1523年大卫·鲁本尼路过此地时，见到的已是一位不断巡行牧场的穆斯林苏丹。王室商队载着黄金、象牙和奴隶穿过平原，苏菲派谢赫在村落中定居，17世纪的繁荣年代集镇纷纷兴起。奴隶军叛乱和1762年哈马吉人夺权瓦解了王权，1802年以后苏丹国的政令只行于杰济拉。摄政穆罕默德·阿德兰维持了十三年秩序，于1821年初遇刺，5月土埃军队抵达两河汇流处。

en:
Gojjam is the broad highland folded inside the great loop of the Abbay, the Blue Nile: Mount Choqa rises at its centre and the southern shore of Lake Tana marks its northern edge. Amda Seyon's campaigns of 1316–17 brought it into the Christian empire, yet it kept the standing of a kingdom, marked as one on an Italian map of about 1451, and Lebna Dengel still called it a kingdom within his empire when he wrote to the king of Portugal in 1526. Its revenues sustained the empress's household from the days of Queen Eleni onward. In 1444 Gojjam was an Amhara Christian land under its own governor, and the island monastery of Daga Estifanos in Lake Tana had been founded by a monk trained at Hayq.

After the battle of Zari in 1531 the army of Ahmad Gran slew the governor of Gojjam and overran the province, which the chronicle Futuh al-Habasha counts among Adal's conquests. Oromo war-bands reached it in the luba of Robale between 1570 and 1578, and Christian Gafat fleeing them crossed the Abbay to settle in Gojjam. On 10 March 1607 Susenyos defeated the emperor Yaqob at Gol in the south of the country and took the crown; the Catholic revolts of his later reign were partly fought here too, his half-brother holding Melka Amba until defeated. Fasilides threw stone bridges across the Abbay gorges, and later emperors repeatedly repulsed Oromo incursions. In the eighteenth century Gojjam coffee was shipped from Massawa with the beans of Ennarea and the Lake Tana shore. During the Era of the Princes the province passed to its own warlords, and on 14 November 1770 the Scot James Bruce reached the springs of Gish Abay, which Europe took for the source of the Nile.
zh:
戈贾姆是被阿巴伊河（青尼罗河）大河湾环抱的广阔高地，乔卡山耸立中央，北缘是塔纳湖南岸。阿姆达·塞约恩1316至1317年的征伐把它并入基督教帝国，但它始终保持王国的地位：约1451年意大利人绘制的地图仍把它标为王国，勒布纳·丹加尔1526年致葡萄牙国王的信中也说戈贾姆是帝国之内的王国。从埃莱妮皇后的时代起，这里的赋税就用于供养皇后一宫。1444年的戈贾姆是由自己的总督治理的阿姆哈拉基督徒之地，塔纳湖岛上的达加·伊斯蒂法诺斯修道院，正是由海格湖出身的修士创建。

1531年扎里之战后，艾哈迈德·格兰的军队杀死戈贾姆总督、占领全省，阿达尔编年史《富图赫·哈巴沙》把它列入征服之地。1570至1578年罗巴莱轮值期，奥罗莫武装攻入此地，逃离奥罗莫人的基督教加法特人渡过阿巴伊河到戈贾姆定居。1607年3月10日，苏西约斯在南部的戈尔击败皇帝雅各布、夺得皇位；他晚年与天主教有关的叛乱也有一部分在这里进行，其弟据守梅尔卡安巴，最终兵败。法西里德斯在阿巴伊河峡谷上修建石桥，后继皇帝也屡次击退奥罗莫入寇。18世纪，戈贾姆出产的咖啡与恩纳雷亚、塔纳湖畔的咖啡一起从马萨瓦港出海。王子时代中，全省落入本地军阀之手；1770年11月14日，苏格兰人詹姆斯·布鲁斯抵达吉什阿拜的泉眼，当时的欧洲将那里当作尼罗河的源头。

en:
The cool uplands north of Lake Tana, beneath the peaks of Semien, are among the oldest Christian
farmlands of Ethiopia, worked by Amhara peasants and the Qemant. The name Gondar first appears in
the fourteenth century under Amda Seyon I, as a military colony guarding the caravan tracks along
which Sudanese and Red Sea goods entered the highlands; the Solomonic emperors themselves kept no
fixed capital but moved their camp from province to province. So in 1444, while Zara Yaqob
(r. 1434–1468) ruled the empire, Gondar was no more than a village in Wegera. No castle yet stood
there, though its springs, its fields and the roads meeting nearby already made it a natural
stopping place.

War reached the lake country when the imam Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi's Adal armies overran the
Christian highlands, until Emperor Galawdewos, with Portuguese musketeers, destroyed them at
Wayna Daga, east of the lake, on 21 February 1543 and slew Ahmad. The later Jesuit troubles proved
almost as dangerous: when Susenyos imposed the Roman faith the provinces rose, and in 1632 he
abdicated for his son Fasilides. Fasilides restored the old church and in 1636 planted his camp at
Gondar, raising the great stone keep of Fasil Ghebbi with Indian masons, five churches and the
riverside bathing pavilion that still bears his name. Yohannes I (1667–1682) ordered Muslims and
Beta Israel into their own quarters, and under Iyasu I the city held more than 60,000 people,
described to Europe for the first time by the French physician Charles Poncet. In May 1769 the
Tigray warlord Ras Mikael Sehul put the young emperor Iyoas to death; the Gondarine kings kept
their palaces through the era of the princes, but real power had passed elsewhere, and so the
gilded, impotent city entered the year 1821.
zh:
塔纳湖北面、瑟门群峰之下的凉爽高地，是埃塞俄比亚最古老的基督教农耕地之一，世代耕作的是
阿姆哈拉农民与克曼特人。贡德尔之名最早见于14世纪阿姆达·塞永一世在位时，当时这里是一处
军屯，扼守苏丹与红海商货进入高原的商路；而所罗门王朝的皇帝们并不设立固定都城，只带着
营帐巡回各行省。因此1444年扎拉·雅各布（1434—1468年在位）君临帝国之际，贡德尔
不过是韦盖拉的一座小村，城堡尚未动土，唯有泉水、田畴和交会于此的道路，使它天然适合
歇脚驻跸。

伊玛目艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐的阿达尔大军横扫基督教高原，战火终于烧到湖畔：
1543年2月21日，皇帝加拉德沃斯在葡萄牙火枪手支援下，于湖东的瓦伊纳达加全歼敌军，
阵斩艾哈迈德。后来的耶稣会之争几乎同样凶险：苏塞尼奥斯强制推行罗马公教，各省群起反抗，
他只得在1632年禅位于子法西利德斯。法西利德斯恢复旧教，并于1636年把行营设在贡德尔，
征来印度石匠筑起法西尔格赫比大石堡，又建了五座教堂和以他命名的河畔浴场。
约翰尼斯一世（1667—1682年在位）令穆斯林与贝塔以色列人各居
单独坊区；到伊亚苏一世时，全城人口超过六万，法国医生夏尔·庞塞最先把它的盛况介绍给
欧洲。1769年5月，提格雷军阀拉斯·米卡埃尔·苏胡尔弑杀幼帝伊约亚斯；在随后的「诸王
时代」里，贡德尔的皇帝们仍居宫殿，实权却已旁落，这座金碧辉煌而无力自保的都城就这样
走入1821年。

en:
The Butana is the grazing plain between the Nile, the Atbara and the Blue Nile, the 'Island of Meroe' of old, whose seasonal wells fattened the cattle that bore its name. In the fifteenth century it formed the eastern farmland and cattle-ground of the Christian kingdom of Alodia, worked by Nubian villagers while Arab tribes, the future Abdallab among them, moved across it with their flocks. In 1444 the lords of Soba still held the Butana in name, but the camel tracks that ran east to Suakin and the Red Sea were slipping into the hands of Arab sheikhs.

Late in the century the Arab chief Abdallah Jamma'a overthrew Alodia and made Qarri his capital, until the Funj of Amara Dunqas defeated him near Arbaji in 1504; the Abdallab then ruled the Butana as viceroys of the north with the title manjilak, levying customs on the caravans between Mecca and Lake Chad. Sheikh Ajib al-Kafuta repulsed an Ottoman invasion in 1576 and raided as far as Aswan, then waged a Muslim holy war against Sennar, until Sultan Adlan I slew him at Karkoj in 1611–12; his pardoned sons returned to Qarri, while Shukria Arabs made themselves the armed overlords of the open plain. In the mid-eighteenth century Sheikh Abdallah III moved his court to Halfayat al-Muluk, and Qarri, a customs post with little trade of its own, lapsed into ruin. Its last sheikh, Nasir, submitted to the Turco-Egyptian army without a fight in 1821.
zh:
布塔纳是尼罗河、阿特巴拉河与青尼罗河之间的草原，古称「麦罗埃岛」，季节性水井养肥了以这片土地命名的牛群。15世纪时，这里是基督教阿洛迪亚王国东部的农田和牧地，努比亚农人在村中耕作，后来被称为阿卜杜拉布人的阿拉伯部落已赶着畜群穿行于平原。1444年，索巴的君主名义上仍领有布塔纳，但东通萨瓦金和红海的骆驼商道正逐渐落入阿拉伯谢赫手中。

该世纪末，阿拉伯首领阿卜杜拉·詹马推翻阿洛迪亚，定都盖里（Qarri），1504年阿马拉·敦卡斯率领的丰吉人在阿尔巴吉附近将其击败；此后阿卜杜拉布人以「曼吉拉克」之衔担任北方副王，统治布塔纳，向麦加与乍得湖之间的商队征收关税。谢赫阿吉卜·卡富塔1576年击退奥斯曼入侵，兵锋远达阿斯旺，随后以伊斯兰圣战为名举兵对抗森纳尔，1611至1612年被苏丹阿德兰一世杀于卡尔科季；他的儿子获赦返回盖里，旷野平原则由舒克里亚阿拉伯人以武力称雄。18世纪中叶，谢赫阿卜杜拉三世把宫廷南迁至哈勒法耶特穆鲁克，盖里这个自身没有多少贸易的税卡就此荒废。末代谢赫纳西尔于1821年向土埃军队不战而降。

en:
East of the Atbara the steppe climbs to the Taka hills, where the Gash river spreads its seasonal flood over the pastures around what is now Kassala. This was the inland country of the Beja, Cushitic-speaking herdsmen who had grazed camels and cattle between the Nile and the Red Sea since antiquity, and who by the fifteenth century, through intermarriage with incoming Arab tribes, were Muslims, if stubbornly independent ones. In 1444 the Beja clans owned no prince, moving between wells under their own sheikhs and selling their herds at Suakin on the coast.

After the Funj founded their sultanate in 1504 the Taka entered the loose orbit of Sennar, whose power at its peak ran east to the Red Sea and levied camels from the Beja clans; the Ottomans took Suakin in 1526, and in the 1530s the slaving armies of Ahmad Gragn swept west from the Ethiopian highlands as far as the Taka hills before turning back. In the seventeenth century Beja clans pushed south after fresh grazing, and the Hadendoa emerged in the eighteenth as the dominant tribe of eastern Sudan, forever feuding with the Bisharin. As Sennar tore itself apart in civil wars the Taka slipped free under its own sheikhs after 1791, and when the Turco-Egyptian army conquered Sennar in 1821 its rule stopped at the Nile and the Gezira; the Beja kept their wells and pastures.
zh:
阿特巴拉河以东，草原渐次抬升为塔卡丘陵，加什河的季节性洪水在今卡萨拉一带漫过牧场。这是贝扎人的内地家园：操库希特语的牧民自古在尼罗河与红海之间放牧骆驼和牛群，到15世纪经与迁入的阿拉伯部落通婚，已成为穆斯林，却始终桀骜不驯。1444年的贝扎各部不奉君王，随各自的谢赫辗转于水井之间，把牲畜赶到红海之滨的萨瓦金出售。

1504年丰吉苏丹国建立后，塔卡进入森纳尔的松散势力范围，丰吉鼎盛时势力东抵红海，向贝扎各部征取骆驼；奥斯曼人于1526年夺取萨瓦金，1530年代艾哈迈德·格兰的掠奴大军从埃塞俄比亚高原向西扫荡，兵锋远及塔卡丘陵方才折返。17世纪，贝扎部落向南开拓新牧场，哈登多亚人到18世纪已成为苏丹东部的主导部落，与比夏林人争斗不休。塞纳尔在内战中四分五裂，1791年以后塔卡便在本族谢赫治下脱离控制；1821年土埃军队攻灭森纳尔，其统治止于尼罗河和杰济拉，贝扎人得以保有自己的水井和牧场。

en:
The highland country around Aksum and Debarwa was the old Christian core of the Ethiopian world. Aksum had once linked Red Sea commerce with the interior as capital of the Aksumite kingdom; after the court moved south it remained a shrine city, its Church of Our Lady Mary of Zion restored under Dawit I in 1406 and the site of Zara Yaqob's coronation in 1436. North of the city, above the Mereb River, Debarwa held the palaces of the Bahr Negash, governor of Medri Bahri and overseer of routes climbing inland from Massawa. In 1444, under Emperor Zara Yaqob, Tigrinya-speaking lords, priests, farmers, and merchants shared grain villages and church lands on the northern edge of a united Solomonid Ethiopia.

Francisco Alvares, visiting in the 1520s, found Aksum full of ancient stone thrones and stelae, while Debarwa kept a crowded Thursday market and the governor's fortress-house. In 1535 Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Ghazi's forces overran the district, burned Aksum, and destroyed the old church; Cristovao da Gama's Portuguese passed through a depopulated Debarwa during the rainy season of 1542. Ottoman troops seized Massawa in 1557 and built a fort at Debarwa, and the rebellious Bahr Negash Yeshaq leaned on them against Emperor Menas after 1561. Emperor Sarsa Dengel took Debarwa in 1576, destroyed the Ottoman fort, and rebuilt Aksum's church in 1580. Oromo raiders burned the church in 1611, Fasilides restored it in 1655, and it survived the rebel burning of the town in 1678 to serve Iyasu I's coronation in 1693. Charles-Jacques Poncet found Debarwa still called the capital of Tigray around 1700, though Adwa was overtaking it; amid later fragmentation Aksum fell to the rulers of Tigray, and Wolde Selassie granted lands to its church in 1794.
zh:
阿克苏姆与德巴尔瓦周围的高地，是埃塞俄比亚世界古老的基督教核心。阿克苏姆曾作为阿克苏姆王国都城，连接红海商路与内陆；王廷南移后，它仍以圣城身份延续。1406年，达维特一世修复锡安圣母教堂，1436年扎拉·雅各布又在此加冕。城市以北、马雷布河上方的德巴尔瓦，是梅德里·巴赫里总督的驻地，掌管从马萨瓦通向高原的道路。1444年，在扎拉·雅各布皇帝治下，这里是所罗门王朝统一埃塞俄比亚的北缘：操提格雷尼亚语的贵族、祭司、农民和商人围绕谷物村落与教会土地生活。

1520年代，弗朗西斯科·阿尔瓦雷斯到访时，阿克苏姆仍可见古代石座与方尖碑，德巴尔瓦则有热闹的周四集市和堡垒般的总督宅邸。1535年，艾哈迈德·伊本·易卜拉欣·加齐的军队席卷此地，焚毁阿克苏姆并拆毁旧教堂；1542年雨季，克里斯托旺·达·伽马率领的葡萄牙军经过德巴尔瓦，见到居民因战乱逃散。奥斯曼军队1557年夺取马萨瓦，并在德巴尔瓦筑垒；1561年后，反叛的总督伊沙克又借奥斯曼人对抗米纳斯皇帝。萨尔萨·丹格尔皇帝1576年攻克德巴尔瓦、摧毁奥斯曼堡垒，1580年重建阿克苏姆教堂。1611年奥罗莫袭击者烧毁教堂，法西利德斯于1655年重修；1678年叛军焚毁城镇而教堂幸存，并在1693年用于伊亚苏一世加冕。1700年前后，夏尔-雅克·蓬塞仍称德巴尔瓦为提格雷首府，但阿杜瓦已逐渐超过它。帝国权威分裂后，阿克苏姆转入提格雷统治者之手；沃尔德·塞拉西于1794年向当地教堂赐地。

en:
Dunqula, Old Dongola, rises from the east bank of the Nile facing the mouth of the Wadi Howar, once the capital of the Christian kings of Makuria. Its granite-columned cathedral and royal throne hall made it the chief city of Nubia for nine centuries; then Arab raids emptied the streets, the throne hall itself became a mosque in 1317, and the royal court departed in 1364. Caravans still set out from here for Darfur and Kordofan, and a hereditary Nubian lord styled mekk kept his seat in the old citadel of a half-deserted town. In 1444 Dongola was a Muslim Nubian town on the edge of a vanished Christian world, its people farmers along one narrow strip of river, its mekk soon to be drawn into the orbit of the rising Funj.

By 1523 Amara Dunqas's Funj realm stretched north to Dongola, and the town became the seat of the sultanate's northern provinces: the mekk ruled on the spot and even bore the Arabic title of malik while sending tribute to Sennar. An Ottoman army marching up the Nile against the Funj was crushed at Hannik by the Third Cataract in 1585, which fixed the frontier with Egypt. Around 1600 the mekk Qashqash held Dongola, and when the Frenchman Poncet visited in 1699 he found a half-ruined place whose castle could still overawe the Arabs of the open country. Trade ebbed as the Shaigiya horsemen made themselves independent on the river to the south, and in 1812 the Mamluks fleeing Muhammad Ali's purges seized the town and founded a new Dongola downstream. When the Turks arrived in 1821, the old northern capital had passed into history.
zh:
栋古拉旧城（旧栋古拉）坐落于尼罗河东岸，与豪瓦尔干河口隔河相望，曾是基督教马库里亚诸王的都城。花岗岩柱大教堂与王宫中殿使它在九个世纪里稳居努比亚首城之位；此后阿拉伯人的袭击令街巷十室九空，王宫大殿于1317年改为清真寺，王室宫廷也在1364年迁离。前往达尔富尔和科尔多凡的商队仍从此出发，一位称「梅克」的世袭努比亚首领在半荒废城池的旧堡中保有座位。1444年的栋古拉是一座穆斯林努比亚城镇，伫立在已逝基督教世界的边缘，居民是尼罗河一线狭地上的农人，梅克不久便被卷入兴起的丰吉势力范围。

到1523年，阿马拉·敦卡斯的丰吉疆土已北展至栋古拉，旧城成为苏丹国北方诸省的治所：梅克在本地称尊，甚至使用阿拉伯语「马利克」（王）的称号，同时向森纳尔纳贡。1585年，沿尼罗河上犯的奥斯曼军队在第三瀑布附近的哈尼赫被击溃，第三瀑布就此成为与埃及的边界。约1600年，梅克卡什卡什据有栋古拉；1699年法国人蓬塞到访时，见到的是一座半毁之城，城中的城堡仍能震慑旷野上的阿拉伯人。随着沙伊吉亚骑兵在南方河道割据自立，商路日渐萧条。1812年，为躲避穆罕默德·阿里清洗而逃出埃及的马穆鲁克人夺取此城，在下游另建了新栋古拉。1821年土耳其军队抵达时，这座古老的北方都城已成陈迹。

en:
Berber stands on the east bank of the Nile, just above the mouth of the Atbara, where the river road of Nubia meets the desert road to Sawakin. A town since Meroitic times, by the fifteenth century it belonged to the Arabized Nubians of the Ja'al country, Muslim camel- and cattle-owners living beside Nubian-speaking villagers, its livelihood resting on the Nile traffic and the caravans that crossed the Bayuda. In 1444 it was a small market town of the northern Sudan without a strong sovereign, the nearest thing to a gateway between the Nile bend and the Red Sea.

Under the Funj sultans Berber came into its own. It became the crossing-place of pilgrimage caravans making for the Hijaz and the chief emporium where the goods of the Sudan changed hands: ivory, ostrich feathers and hides moving out through Sawakin, and cloth, silk, perfumes and spices coming back, and travellers ranked its brick-built qaysariyya market with those of Fez, Cairo and Jeddah. From the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries the town was famed for its khalwa Quranic schools, which drew students from across the Sudan. It shared the fortunes of the north, governed through the Abdallabi lords of Qarri and then left to the riverine Arab chiefs as Sennar weakened, raided and overawed by the independent Shaigiya; when Burckhardt visited in 1813 it was still a busy caravan town. Eight years later the Ottoman Egyptian conquest carried the Funj age away.
zh:
柏柏尔位于尼罗河东岸，阿特巴拉河汇入口以北不远，是努比亚河路与通往萨瓦金的沙漠商道交会之处。早在麦洛埃时代这里已有城镇；到15世纪，此地属于达尔贾阿尔的阿拉伯化努比亚人——穆斯林骆驼客和牧人与说努比亚语的村民为邻，城镇的生计系于尼罗河运输和横穿百卢达的商队。1444年，它是苏丹北部一座没有强势君主的小集镇，也是尼罗河大弯与红海之间最近似门户的地方。

在丰吉苏丹治下，柏柏尔迎来全盛：它成为赴汉志朝觐商队的渡河之地，也是苏丹货物易手的总集散地——象牙、鸵鸟羽和皮革经此运往萨瓦金，布匹、丝绸、香料和香水由原路折返；行旅把当地砖砌的盖萨里亚大市场与非斯、开罗和吉达的市集相提并论。16至17世纪起，此城又以赫勒瓦古兰经经学学校闻名，学生从苏丹各地负笈而来。它与整个北境共沉浮：先由驻加里的阿卜杜拉比领主统治，森纳尔衰落后落入河畔阿拉伯酋长之手，又遭自立的沙伊吉亚人侵扰威压。1813年布尔克哈特到访时，这里仍是繁忙的商队城镇；八年后，奥斯曼埃及的征服为丰吉时代画上句号。

en:
Massawa grew up after the old Red Sea port of Adulis declined, its harbour occupying the islands of Basé and Taulud near the Dahlak Archipelago. From the eleventh century the Dahlak sultans made it the link between Muslim shipping on the Red Sea and the Christian Ethiopian highlands, where caravan routes from Ethiopia met traffic from Arabia. Beja and Tigre peoples lived along the shore, while a qadi headed the Muslim merchant town. Its allegiance was loose: the port paid tribute irregularly to the Bahr Negash and other highland governors, but remained tied to Dahlak, itself a vassal of Aden. In 1444 it was therefore the hot, arid sea outlet of Medri Bahri, where highland claims met Indian Ocean commerce.

Emperor Zara Yaqob pushed his authority to the coast in the mid-fifteenth century and fortified the Gerer peninsula, while Abyssinian troops sacked Massawa and Dahlak in 1464–65. Portuguese squadrons used the harbour early in the next century as their gateway to allied Ethiopia, but in 1557 Özdemir Pasha seized it for the Ottomans and tried to make Massawa the centre of the province of Habesh. The highlands resisted conquest, so Ottoman authority was exercised through a Balaw naib, while the local sharia qadi kept wide jurisdiction along the coast. In 1809 a Turkish governor was appointed, followed in 1813 by an Egyptian one, tightening direct rule as the Red Sea became an Ottoman-Egyptian frontier.
zh:
马萨瓦兴起于古老红海港口阿杜利斯衰落之后，港区位于达赫拉克群岛附近的巴塞岛和陶卢德岛一带。11世纪起，达赫拉克苏丹把这里作为红海穆斯林航运与埃塞俄比亚基督教高地之间的纽带，来自埃塞俄比亚的商路在该处接上阿拉伯半岛的海上交通。贝扎人与提格雷人居住在沿岸，一名卡迪主持这座穆斯林商镇。它的臣属关系松散：港口不定期向巴赫勒·尼加什等高地统治者纳贡，却仍依附达赫拉克，而达赫拉克又是亚丁的附庸。1444年，这里因此是梅德利巴赫里炎热干旱的出海口，高地权势与印度洋贸易在此相接。

15世纪中叶，皇帝扎拉·雅各布把权威推向海岸，在格雷尔半岛修筑要塞；1464至1465年，阿比西尼亚军队洗劫马萨瓦和达赫拉克。下一个世纪初，葡萄牙分舰队把该港用作进入盟邦埃塞俄比亚的门户，但1557年厄兹代米尔帕夏为奥斯曼人夺取马萨瓦，试图将其建为哈贝什省的中心。高地挡住了进一步征服，奥斯曼人便通过巴莱乌人的纳伊布行使统治，当地沙里亚法庭的卡迪则在沿海保有广泛司法权。1809年，一名土耳其总督被派到此地；1813年又改派埃及总督，红海成为奥斯曼—埃及边疆，直接统治也随之加强。

en:
Aswan, ancient Syene, lies immediately north of the Nile's first cataract, the natural break between Upper Egypt and Nubia. Its granite quarries supplied temples and obelisks, while the garrison and customs post below the cataract checked every vessel moving between Egypt and the southern caravan lands. The tenth-century Fatimid tombs show the town's continued Islamic life, and in 1444 it was the Mamluk Sultanate's southern gateway, a Sunni Egyptian river market for Nubian livestock, ivory and desert trade.

After the Ottoman conquest of 1517, Aswan remained part of the Egyptian eyalet, though Mamluk beys and Upper Egyptian Arab houses disputed real power in the south. In 1767 Humam ibn Yusuf, shaykh of the Hawwara, ruled a broad domain reaching from Minya to Aswan; his war with Ali Bey al-Kabir ended in defeat and Humam's death while fleeing toward Nubia in 1769. During the French invasion, Louis-Nicolas Davout's cavalry defeated Osman Hassan Bey's Mamluks near Syene on 12 February 1799 and then rested in Aswan. After the French withdrawal in 1801 and Muhammad Ali's rise in 1805, the town became a base for Cairo's renewed control of the southern frontier.
zh:
阿斯旺古称赛伊尼，坐落在尼罗河第一瀑布北侧；这道瀑布是上埃及与努比亚之间的天然分界。当地花岗岩石场为神庙和方尖碑供料，瀑布下方的驻军与税关则检查往来埃及和南方商路的每一艘船。10世纪的法蒂玛墓地显示这里在伊斯兰时代仍延续着城市生活。1444年，阿斯旺是马穆鲁克苏丹国的南部门户，也是逊尼派埃及人的河港市集，交易努比亚牲畜、象牙和沙漠商货。

1517年奥斯曼征服后，阿斯旺隶属埃及省，但南方实权长期由马穆鲁克贝伊和上埃及阿拉伯家族争夺。1767年，哈瓦拉部落长老胡马姆·伊本·优素福控制了从明亚到阿斯旺的广阔地区；他与阿里贝伊·卡比尔交战，最终兵败，1769年在逃往努比亚途中死去。法国入侵期间，路易-尼古拉·达武的骑兵于1799年2月12日在赛伊尼附近击败奥斯曼·哈桑贝伊的马穆鲁克军，随后进入阿斯旺休整。1801年法军撤出、1805年穆罕默德·阿里崛起后，这座城成为开罗政府重新控制南部边疆的基地。

en:
Suakin occupies a coral island beside a long Red Sea inlet, with the mainland quarter of the Geyf facing it. It was still a small Beja settlement when al-Hamdani named it in the tenth century, then grew after the southern port of Badi was abandoned. In 1264 a Mamluk expedition intervened in its disputes over merchants' goods, and in 1317 its ruler formally accepted Mamluk suzerainty and an annual payment. As Mamluk power weakened late in the fourteenth century, the Hedareb took the port and made it their capital. Indian shipping, African pilgrims bound for Mecca and, by the next century, Venetian merchants passed through its customs house. In 1444 Suakin was thus a wealthy Beja and Arab Muslim port under loose Mamluk overlordship.

A Portuguese fleet besieged Suakin in 1513 and another force briefly held it in 1541, during the struggle for the Red Sea. After the Ottoman conquest of Egypt in 1517 the town entered the Ottoman sphere, and from the mid-1550s Özdemir Pasha made it the residence of the pasha of Habesh. The Ottomans repaired the Shafi'i and Hanafi mosques, strengthened the coral fort and built roads and public buildings. The sea route around Africa gradually drew Indian commerce away, although caravans from the Funj sultanate of Sennar still brought trade up to the coast. Early in the nineteenth century the Swiss traveller Burckhardt found two-thirds of the houses in ruins, Suakin's great age of medieval prosperity long past.
zh:
萨瓦金坐落在红海一道长湾旁的珊瑚岛上，对岸是大陆上的盖夫街区。10世纪哈姆达尼提到它时，这里还只是贝扎人的小聚落，后来南方港口巴迪被废弃，萨瓦金才得以发展。1264年，马穆鲁克远征军因商人货物纠纷介入当地；1317年，萨瓦金统治者正式接受马穆鲁克宗主权并缴纳年款。14世纪末马穆鲁克势力衰弱，赫达雷布人夺取港口并将其定为都城。印度船只、前往麦加的非洲朝觐者，以及下一世纪的威尼斯商人，都曾经过这里的税关。1444年，萨瓦金因此是一座处在马穆鲁克松散宗主权下、富裕的贝扎与阿拉伯穆斯林港口。

红海争霸期间，葡萄牙舰队1513年围攻萨瓦金，另一支军队又于1541年短暂占领该港。1517年奥斯曼征服埃及后，萨瓦金进入奥斯曼势力范围；1550年代中期，厄兹代米尔帕夏把这里作为哈贝什帕夏的驻地。奥斯曼人修缮沙斐仪派和哈乃斐派清真寺，加固珊瑚石要塞，并修筑道路与公共建筑。绕非洲好望角的航路逐渐带走印度贸易，不过来自丰吉人森纳尔苏丹国的商队仍把货物送到海岸。19世纪初，瑞士旅行家布尔克哈特发现城中三分之二的房屋已成废墟，萨瓦金中世纪的繁荣时代早已远去。

en:
Kharga is the southernmost of Egypt's western oases, set in a long desert depression about 200 kilometres west of the Nile. Its wells made it a stage on Darb al-Arba'in, the Forty Days Road that linked Darfur and Kordofan with the Egyptian Nile. Caravans drove camels, donkeys, cattle and horses northward and carried gold, ivory, slaves, textiles and salt between Sudan and Egypt; Ibn Hawqal described the road in the tenth century. In 1444 the oasis was a remote Arabic-speaking Muslim possession on the desert edge of the Burji Mamluk state, valued for water, livestock and passage rather than for dense settlement.

The Ottoman conquest of 1517 placed Kharga under the sovereignty of Cairo's new Ottoman governors, but its fortunes continued to follow the camel caravans. In 1698 the French traveler Poncet left Kharga on his journey toward Ethiopia and later described the waterless marches where the bones of camels marked the road. William George Browne joined a caravan on the same route in 1793 and became the first Englishman to record the journey from within. Their accounts show Kharga less as an isolated refuge than as the Egyptian gate of a still active Sudanese trade road.
zh:
哈里杰是埃及西部诸绿洲中最南的一处，坐落在尼罗河以西约200公里的狭长沙漠洼地中。这里的水井使它成为「四十日路」上的驿站，这条商路把达尔富尔、科尔多凡同埃及尼罗河谷连接起来。商队把骆驼、驴、牛和马赶往北方，也在苏丹与埃及之间贩运黄金、象牙、奴隶、织物和盐；10世纪时，伊本·豪盖勒已记载过这条道路。1444年，哈里杰是布尔吉马穆鲁克国家沙漠边缘一处遥远的阿拉伯语穆斯林属地，其价值在于水源、牲畜和通行，而不是稠密人口。

1517年奥斯曼征服埃及后，哈里杰在名义上归开罗的奥斯曼总督统辖，但它的兴衰仍随骆驼商队起伏。1698年，法国旅行者蓬塞从哈里杰出发行往埃塞俄比亚，后来记述了沿途无水路段和标示道路的骆驼白骨。1793年，威廉·乔治·布朗随商队走同一条路，成为第一个亲身记录这段旅程的英国人。他们的记载表明，哈里杰并非孤立的避难绿洲，而是一条仍在使用的苏丹商路的埃及门户。

en:
Qasr Ibrim crowns a sheer cliff on the eastern bank of the Nile in Lower Nubia, some 240 kilometres south of Aswan. The Romans knew it as Primis: after Gaius Petronius's campaign against Kush in 23 BC, their engineers rebuilt it into the strongest fortress in the Nile valley. It passed to Makuria in the early eighth century and became a chief Christian centre of Lower Nubia, seat of the Eparch of Nobatia; its cathedral went up in the first half of the eighth century, and the largest hoard of Old Nubian documents ever found later came from its ruins, including the archive of the eparchs. Timothy, the last known bishop of Faras, resided here and was buried in the cathedral around 1375. In 1444 the Christian kingdom of Dotawo, the Nubian name under which Makuria lived on, still held the cliff castle commanding the Nile, even though Islam had long triumphed in Egypt to the north.

Early in the sixteenth century, after Selim I's Ottomans had conquered Egypt, a garrison of Bosnian soldiers was installed in the fortress and part of the cathedral became a mosque; the Bosnians married into the Nubian population and held the rock for nearly three centuries. The Mamluks who fled Muhammad Ali's Cairo massacre of 1811 found refuge here, drove out the descendants of the Bosnian garrison and held out against his troops until 1813, when Ibrahim Pasha dislodged them with artillery fire. They were the last occupants of the cliff, and the old fortress was left deserted above the river.
zh:
伊布里姆堡雄踞下努比亚尼罗河东岸的岩壁之上，北距阿斯旺约二百四十公里。罗马人称之为普里米斯，公元前23年盖乌斯·佩特罗尼乌斯远征库施后，由罗马工匠将其重建为当时尼罗河谷最坚固的要塞。8世纪初它并入马库里亚王国，此后成为下努比亚的基督教中心，诺巴蒂亚都督驻节于此；大教堂建于8世纪上半叶，后来从其废墟中出土的古努比亚语文献数量为各地之最，其中包括历代都督的档案。最后一位有记载的法拉斯主教蒂莫西就长住于此，约1375年葬在大教堂中。1444年，以努比亚语自称「多塔沃」的马库里亚基督教王国仍占据着这座扼守尼罗河的崖堡，尽管伊斯兰早已在北方的埃及取得胜利。

16世纪初，塞利姆一世的奥斯曼军队征服埃及后，在堡内派驻一支波斯尼亚守军，大教堂的一部分被改成清真寺；这些波斯尼亚士兵与当地努比亚人通婚，在崖上驻守了近三百年。1811年逃过穆罕默德·阿里开罗清洗的马穆鲁克退守此地，逐走波斯尼亚守军的后裔，继续抵抗其军队，直到1813年易卜拉欣帕夏以炮火将他们逐走。他们是这座崖堡最后的驻守者，此后古要塞便荒废在河水之上。

en:
Guam, Guåhan in Chamorro, is the largest and southernmost island in the Marianas. By 1444 its villages had taken shape around latte stones, the pillar-and-capstone foundations raised for houses and important buildings. Coastal matua families held the fishing grounds while mana'chang communities lived inland, with achaot serving as go-betweens; kinship and inheritance ran through women, and seamanship, pottery and weaving were highly developed. Hagåtña was already a prominent west-coast village, and the island remained a world of Chamorro chiefs, ancestors and independent settlements.

Ferdinand Magellan reached Guam on 6 March 1521 after crossing the Pacific and his fleet named the Marianas the Islands of Thieves. Miguel López de Legazpi claimed Guam for Spain in 1565, but permanent colonization began only in 1668, when the Jesuit Diego Luis de San Vitores arrived and Chief Kepuha granted land at Hagåtña for the first church. Chief Hurao besieged the new Spanish post in 1670, and Matå'pang killed San Vitores in 1672. The wars that followed ended in reducción, with people from about 180 villages concentrated into seven towns by the early 1680s. Guam then served the Acapulco-Manila galleons until that route closed in 1815, leaving a Spanish Catholic and garrison island by 1821.
zh:
关岛在查莫洛语中称瓜汉（Guåhan），是马里亚纳群岛最大、最南的岛屿。到1444年，岛上村落已围绕拉提石发展，这种石柱加半球形石帽的结构用于承托房屋和重要建筑。沿海的上层家族掌握渔场，下层社群居住内陆，中层充当中间人；亲属与继承沿母系计算，航海、制陶和纺织都十分发达。哈加特纳已是西岸重要村落，全岛仍是查莫洛酋长、祖先祭祀和各独立聚落的世界。

1521年3月6日，斐迪南·麦哲伦横渡太平洋后抵达关岛，他的船队把马里亚纳称为盗贼群岛。1565年，米格尔·洛佩斯·德莱加斯皮代表西班牙宣称占有关岛，但永久殖民迟至1668年才开始：耶稣会士迭戈·路易斯·德·圣维托雷斯到来，酋长克普哈在哈加特纳捐地修建第一座教堂。1670年，酋长胡劳围攻新设立的西班牙据点；1672年，马塔庞杀死圣维托雷斯。随后的战争以集村政策告终，到17世纪80年代初，约180个村落的人口被集中到七座城镇。此后关岛为阿卡普尔科至马尼拉的邮船提供补给，直到该航线1815年终止；到1821年，这里已成为西班牙的天主教驻军岛屿。

en:
The land around Rabaul is the northern tip of New Britain's Gazelle Peninsula, where a flooded volcanic caldera opens into Simpson Harbour. Ash from Tavurvur and Vulcan made the coastal soil unusually fertile. The Baining, likely the peninsula's earlier inhabitants, gardened taro on rotating clearings and kept much of the forested interior, while coastal villages looked across St George's Channel toward New Ireland. In 1444 no town stood on the mangrove-fringed harbour, no foreign power claimed it, and no Christian mission had reached it; kin groups, fishing, gardens, and the threat of eruption set the rhythm of life.

For centuries the harbour was known only to local seafarers. On 27 February 1700 William Dampier became the first recorded British visitor to New Britain, which he named Nova Britannia, but the voyage did not establish a post. In 1767 Philip Carteret took HMS Swallow through St George's Channel and named the Duke of York Islands between New Ireland and New Britain; he likewise made no annexation. By 1821 the caldera still had no European fort or mission, and Gazelle remained in the hands of its own villagers and elders.
zh:
拉包尔一带是新不列颠岛加泽尔半岛北端，海水侵入的火山口形成辛普森港。塔乌鲁尔与武尔坎火山喷出的火山灰使沿海土壤异常肥沃。拜宁人很可能是半岛较早的居民，他们在轮垦地上种植芋艿，并活动于林木茂密的内陆；沿海村落则隔着圣乔治海峡与新爱尔兰相望。1444年，红树林环绕的港湾旁还没有城镇，没有外来政权宣称占有，也没有基督教传教站抵达；亲属群体、渔业、园圃和火山威胁构成了生活的基本面貌。

此后数百年间，使用这片港湾的仍是本地海民。1700年2月27日，威廉·丹皮尔成为有记载的第一位到访新不列颠的英国人，并将该岛命名为新不列颠，但这次航行没有留下据点。1767年，菲利普·卡特里特指挥「燕子号」穿过圣乔治海峡，为新爱尔兰与新不列颠之间的约克公爵群岛命名，同样没有宣布吞并。到1821年，火山口旁仍没有欧洲人的要塞或传教站，加泽尔仍掌握在本地村民和长老手中。

en:
Hanuabada, the 'big village' in the Motu language, stands on piles over a sheltered harbour on the south-eastern coast of New Guinea. Behind the shore live the Koitabu, hill people who intermarried with the Motu and shared their villages, each divided into iduhu clans. The women shaped cooking pots from local clay, while the men built lakatoi — several dugout hulls lashed together with a platform and a crab-claw sail — for the annual hiri voyages. Fleets of up to twenty craft and six hundred men sailed west into the Gulf of Papua carrying as many as 20,000 pots, and brought back sago and timber. In 1444 the Motu lived by fishing, pottery and trade.

The hiri cycle ran on for the next four centuries. In 1606 the Spanish ships of Luís Vaz de Torres explored the southern coast from Milne Bay to the Gulf of Papua, yet no European landing or post followed at this harbour, and the Motu kept their own customs and their annual voyages. Through 1821 no outside power ruled here; the lakatoi fleets remained the village's only link to the wider world.
zh:
哈努阿巴达在莫图语里意为「大村」，是新几内亚岛东南海岸一座掩蔽港湾上的木桩水上村落。岸后住着科伊塔布人，他们是来自内陆山地的居民，与莫图人通婚杂居，村落按「伊杜胡」氏族划分。莫图女人用当地陶土烧制炊罐，男人则把几艘独木舟捆在一起、上架平台、挂上蟹钳形帆，造出「拉卡托伊」多体船，用于一年一度的「希里」远航。多达二十艘船、六百名水手的船队载着多至两万个陶罐向西驶入巴布亚湾，换回西米和木材。1444年时，莫图人靠捕鱼、制陶和贸易为生。

此后四个世纪里，希里远航周而复始。1606年，路易斯·巴斯·德·托雷斯的西班牙船队考察了从米尔恩湾到巴布亚湾的南部海岸，但没有欧洲人在这个港湾登陆或设点，莫图人照旧保留着自己的习俗和年年成行的远航。直到1821年，这里不受任何外来政权统治，拉卡托伊船队仍是这座村庄通往外部世界的唯一纽带。

en:
The Solomon Islands province lies in the double island chain east of New Guinea; Guadalcanal, locally called Isatabu, is the largest land, with rain-forested mountains behind its northern coast. Poha Cave and Vatuluma Posovi show occupation by 4500–2500 BC, and Lapita potters reached the islands around 1200–800 BC. By 1444 Melanesian villagers lived from taro and yam gardens, fishing, and inter-island canoe trade; sacred shrines bound clans together across a sea of many languages. No outside power ruled the chain.

The first known European ships came from Peru. Mendaña's two vessels, with Pedro Sarmiento de Gamboa commanding the flagship, reached Santa Isabel on 7 February 1568 and spent six months surveying Malaita, Guadalcanal, Makira and neighbouring islands. Pedro de Ortega took part in the exploration. The expedition gave the Spanish name Islas Salomón but founded nothing. A second voyage tried to plant a colony on Nendö in 1595; Mendaña died there on 18 October and Isabel Barreto led the survivors away. Queirós passed through in 1606, still without lasting occupation. Carteret sighted islands in 1767, Bougainville named Choiseul in 1768, and La Pérouse was wrecked at Vanikoro in 1788; whalers later called for provisions, but in 1821 no foreign flag yet ruled the Solomons.
zh:
所罗门群岛省位于新几内亚以东的双列岛链中；最大岛屿是本地称伊萨塔布的瓜达尔卡纳尔岛，雨林山地横亘北岸后方。波哈洞与瓦图卢马·波索维遗址表明，公元前4500年至前2500年已有人居住，拉皮塔陶工约在公元前1200年至前800年抵达。到1444年，美拉尼西亚村民以芋艿、薯蓣园圃和渔业为生，并靠独木舟维持岛际贸易；神圣神龛把众多语言社群中的氏族联系在一起。当时没有外来政权统治这条岛链。

最早有记载的欧洲船只来自秘鲁。门达尼亚的两艘船于1568年2月7日抵达圣伊莎贝尔岛，旗舰由佩德罗·萨尔米恩托·德·甘博阿指挥；远征队随后用六个月测绘马莱塔、瓜达尔卡纳尔、马基拉及邻近岛屿，佩德罗·德·奥尔特加也参与了探索。远征队留下西班牙名「所罗门群岛」，却没有建立据点。1595年，第二次航行试图在恩登岛建立殖民地；门达尼亚于10月18日病死，伊莎贝尔·巴雷托带领幸存者离去。基罗斯1606年再经此地，仍未形成持久占领。卡特里特1767年望见多座岛屿，布干维尔1768年为舒瓦瑟尔岛命名，拉彼鲁兹1788年在瓦尼科罗岛失事；此后捕鲸船前来补给，但到1821年，所罗门群岛仍未受外国旗帜统治。

en:
Vanuatu is a chain of active volcanic islands, and Espiritu Santo in the north is the largest. Lapita seafarers reached the group around 1100–700 BC, bringing yams, taro, bananas, pigs and chickens; later Melanesian settlement produced more than a hundred closely related Oceanic languages. In 1444 authority belonged to autonomous village networks rather than a single kingdom. Garden land, reefs, ancestral shrines, exchange voyages and graded ceremonial titles ordered life across islands where eruptions could suddenly remake the landscape.

The European intrusion began in 1606, when Pedro Fernandes de Queirós, a Portuguese navigator sailing for Spain, reached Espiritu Santo, believed it the edge of Terra Australis, and proclaimed La Austrialia del Espíritu Santo. His New Jerusalem on Big Bay lasted barely a month after clashes with islanders and sickness; Luis Váez de Torres sailed the remaining ships west. Bougainville returned in May 1768 and called the group the Great Cyclades. James Cook charted it from July to September 1774 and named it the New Hebrides. Bligh passed the Banks Islands in 1789, and the first recorded whaleship, Rose, called in February 1804. By 1821 these ships brought provisions and news, but no foreign sovereignty.
zh:
瓦努阿图是一列活火山岛，北部的圣埃斯皮里图岛面积最大。拉皮塔航海者约在公元前1100年至前700年抵达，带来薯蓣、芋艿、香蕉、猪和鸡；后续美拉尼西亚定居者发展出一百多种彼此相近的大洋洲语。1444年，权力属于自治的村落网络，而不是统一王国。园圃土地、礁石、祖灵神龛、交换航行和等级仪式头衔维系着各岛秩序，火山喷发也可能骤然改变地貌。

欧洲人的闯入始于1606年：为西班牙效力的葡萄牙航海家佩德罗·费尔南德斯·德·基罗斯抵达圣埃斯皮里图岛，以为自己到了南方大陆边缘，并将其命名为圣灵南方大陆（La Austrialia del Espíritu Santo）。他在大海湾建立的「新耶路撒冷」因与岛民冲突和疾病仅维持约一个月，路易斯·巴斯·德·托雷斯随后率领余部西航。布干维尔1768年5月重返此地，把群岛称为大基克拉泽斯；詹姆斯·库克1774年7月至9月测绘群岛，并命名为新赫布里底。布莱1789年经过班克斯群岛，有记载的第一艘捕鲸船「玫瑰号」于1804年2月到访。到1821年，这些船只带来补给与消息，却还没有带来外来主权。

en:
Hawaiʻi, the Big Island, is the largest and south-easternmost island of the Hawaiian chain, a volcanic land overshadowed by Mauna Kea and Mauna Loa, with rainy Hilo on one flank and the drier Kona coast on the other. Its ahupuaʻa land divisions ran from forested uplands to reefs, linking gardens, bird and stone resources, and fishing grounds. By 1444 villages were spread through Kona, Kohala, Hāmākua, Hilo, Puna and Kaʻū; the dense basalt of Mauna Kea had become an important adze source after 1400. Aliʻi chiefs and kahuna priests governed through heiau temples and kapu rules, while fishponds and taro gardens sustained a ranked society along the Kona shore where Kailua later arose.

James Cook entered Kealakekua Bay in Resolution and Discovery on 17 January 1779 and was killed there on 14 February in a quarrel over a stolen boat. Muskets and ships soon entered Hawaiian succession wars. Kamehameha won the first fighting on the island in 1782 and controlled Hawaiʻi by 1791; in 1795 he conquered Maui, Oʻahu, Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi, made Kailua his seat, and accepted the submission of Kauaʻi and Niʻihau in 1810, completing the kingdom. George Vancouver gave him four bulls and eight cows in 1793–1794, and a kapu on hunting let the herds multiply.
