Augustinian canons founded Darley Abbey nearby around 1160, and much of the shire later passed to the Duchy of Lancaster. In 1444 Derby was a small Catholic borough and county town with neither court nor cathedral, living from the shire's metals and wool.

The abbey buried James Tuchet, Baron Audley, after he fell at Blore Heath in 1459, and it surrendered to the Dissolution in 1538. During the Civil War Parliament made Sir John Gell governor of Derby, and his garrison skirmished for Parliament across the Midlands. In 1692 the Derby engineer George Sorocold built the first civic piped water supply in England, wheel-pumps raising Derwent water into wooden pipes. From 1717 John Lombe raised a five-storey silk mill on a Derwent island, fitted with machines whose workings he had learned while employed in a silk-throwing mill in Piedmont; it was the first successful silk mill in Britain, employed some 300 workers, and Lombe died in 1722, rumoured poisoned by Italian rivals. Bonnie Prince Charlie's army entered Derby on 4 December 1745, the furthest point of its march on London, and turned back at Swarkestone Bridge after a council of war at Exeter House. In 1771 Richard Arkwright, financed by Samuel Need and Jedediah Strutt, opened his water-powered cotton mill at Cromford; Strutt built his own mills at Belper and Milford, and the Derwent valley filled with the first generation of textile factories. The painter Joseph Wright, known as Wright of Derby, lived and worked in the town, showing candlelit scenes of scientific experiments at the Royal Academy.
zh:
德比坐落在奔宁山麓德文特河的一处渡口，是一座靠铁、铅和羊毛立足的郡城。罗马人在此设有德尔文提奥要塞和村镇，为峰区铅矿供应物资，也冶铁、制陶；维京人把久拉比建成丹麦法区五城之一；917年7月，麦西亚女领主埃塞尔弗莱德攻破这座堡镇，把这一带重新纳入英格兰人的麦西亚。约1160年，奥斯定会修士在附近创办达利修道院，郡内大片土地后来归入兰开斯特公国。1444年，德比是一座信奉天主教的小自治镇兼郡治，没有王宫也没有大教堂，靠全郡的金属和羊毛为生。

1459年奥德利男爵詹姆斯·图谢在布洛希思阵亡后葬于达利修道院，修道院则在1538年的解散运动中交出产业。内战期间，议会任命约翰·盖尔爵士为德比总督，他的驻军在米德兰兹为议会四处作战。1692年，本地工程师乔治·索罗科尔德建成英国第一套城市管道供水系统，用水车把德文特河的水抽进木制管道。1717年起，约翰·洛姆在德文特河中的小岛上建起五层丝厂，机器的门道是他在皮埃蒙特一座捻丝厂做工时摸清的；这是英国第一座成功的丝厂，雇有约三百名工人，洛姆本人1722年死去，传闻是被意大利仇家毒杀。1745年12月4日，小王位觊觎者查理的军队进抵德比，这是他们进军伦敦的最远点；在埃克塞特宅召开军事会议后，大军从斯沃克斯通桥掉头北返。1771年，理查·阿克莱特在塞缪尔·尼德和杰德戴亚·斯特鲁特资助下于克罗姆福德开办水力棉纺厂，斯特鲁特又在贝柏和米尔福德自建工厂，德文特河谷里布满第一代纺织厂。画家约瑟夫·赖特人称「德比的赖特」，在本城生活作画，把烛光下科学实验的场景送进皇家美术学院的展览。

en:
Cremona lies on the left bank of the Po in the richest grain country of Lombardy; canals water its fields and carry the harvest out to river barges. As a Ghibelline commune of the Lombard plain it passed to the Visconti in 1322, and in June 1431 a Visconti fleet beat off a Venetian attack on the river below the walls. Its brick Torrazzo, among the tallest bell towers in Italy, rises beside the cathedral and carries a great astronomical clock. In 1441 Filippo Maria Visconti gave Cremona as a dowry when his daughter Bianca Maria married the condottiero Francesco Sforza at San Sigismondo. Seven years later, with Sforza's army away, a Venetian squadron attacked the river bridge and Bianca Maria led the defence herself until her husband returned and destroyed the ships. In 1444 the city, fat on Po valley grain and the fustian woven in its workshops, was held by Sforza in person, the captain the ageing duke in Milan could neither pay nor defy.

Sforza seized the duchy in 1450 and favoured Cremona, and Ludovico il Moro paid for work on its cathedral and baptistery. The Italian Wars moved back and forth over the Po valley: Venice held the city from 1499 to 1509, when Agnadello returned it to French-ruled Milan, and Spanish troops took it in 1524 after the castle of Santa Croce surrendered. Famine in 1628 and plague in 1630 marked the long years of Spanish rule that followed, and Cremona passed to Austria in 1707. Politics moved elsewhere, and Cremona became the workshop of the finest string instruments in Europe: Andrea Amati, who died in 1577, founded the violin-makers' school, Antonio Stradivari, born around 1644, worked here until his death in 1737, and the Guarneri and Rugeri families worked beside them. Claudio Monteverdi was born here in 1567, and the painter Sofonisba Anguissola, born about 1532, went to Madrid in 1559 as drawing teacher and lady-in-waiting to Philip II's queen. With the rest of Lombardy the city passed through the Napoleonic Kingdom of Italy and returned to Austria in 1815 as part of Lombardy-Venetia.
zh:
克雷莫纳位于波河左岸，处在伦巴第最富庶的产粮区，水渠灌溉着田野，也把粮食运上河中的驳船。作为波河平原上的吉伯林派公社，它1322年转入维斯孔蒂家族之手；1431年6月，一支维斯孔蒂舰队在城墙下的河面击退来犯的威尼斯舰队。砖砌的托拉佐钟楼是意大利最高的钟楼之一，矗立在大教堂旁，钟面上装着巨大的天文钟。1441年，菲利波·马里亚·维斯孔蒂把克雷莫纳作为女儿比安卡·马里亚的嫁妆，她在圣西吉斯蒙多教堂嫁给雇佣兵首领弗朗切斯科·斯福尔扎。七年后，斯福尔扎大军在外，一支威尼斯舰队攻打河桥，比安卡·马里亚亲自督战守城，直到丈夫回师歼灭敌船。1444年，这座靠波河平原粮食和作坊织出的粗棉布致富的城市握在斯福尔扎本人手中，他正是米兰那位年迈公爵既付不起军饷、也惹不起的大将。

1450年斯福尔扎夺取公国后厚待克雷莫纳，卢多维科·摩尔人还出资修建大教堂和洗礼堂。意大利战争的大军在波河平原上来回拉锯：威尼斯1499至1509年占据此城，阿尼亚代洛一战后它被还给法国治下的米兰；1524年圣十字城堡投降，西班牙军队入城。在西班牙统治的漫长岁月里，1628年饥荒、1630年瘟疫相继袭来，克雷莫纳于1707年转归奥地利。政治风云移向别处，克雷莫纳却成了全欧洲最精良弦乐器的作坊：1577年去世的安德烈亚·阿马蒂开创了制琴流派，约1644年出生的安东尼奥·斯特拉迪瓦里在此制琴，直到1737年去世，瓜尔内里和鲁杰里两大家族也在城中做活。克劳迪奥·蒙特威尔第1567年出生于此；约1532年出生的画家索福尼斯巴·安圭索拉1559年前往马德里，担任腓力二世王后的绘画教师兼侍从女官。与伦巴第其余地区一样，克雷莫纳经历了拿破仑的意大利王国，1815年作为伦巴第-威尼托王国的一部分重归奥地利。

en:
Graz guards a crossing of the Mur where the river leaves the Alps for the broad, grain-rich Graz plain. Its Slavic name means the little fort above the ford, and Bavarian settlers laid out a market below the Schlossberg, first documented in 1128 and securely attested from 1140. The Otakars made it chief town of Styria, the Georgenberg treaty of 1186 carried the duchy to the Babenbergs, and from 1379 it was the residence of the Inner Austrian line of the Habsburgs. Frederick III kept court here longer than anywhere else, building the Burg from 1438 beside the new Gothic cathedral. In 1444 Graz was the working capital of Inner Austria, a Catholic German market town whose fortress hill watched the roads to the south.

Ottoman raiders reached the Mur in 1480, and the cathedral keeps the Landplagenbild of 1485, a votive painting showing the three scourges of the day together: locusts, plague and the Turks. Maximilian I added the double-spiral staircase to the Burg and in 1496 expelled Styria's Jews. By mid-century most burghers were Lutheran: the Styrian estates built their Renaissance Landhaus to Domenico dell'Allio's designs, Archduke Karl II founded the Jesuit university in 1585, and Johannes Kepler taught mathematics at the Protestant school from 1594, his friends including the Graz-born Hans Ulrich von Eggenberg, later Ferdinand II's chief minister. The preachers were driven out in 1598 and the Protestant schools closed in 1599; Kepler left for Prague in 1600, and the whole court moved to Vienna in 1619. French troops entered Graz in 1797 and again in 1805. In 1809 the Schlossberg fortress, rebuilt against the Turks and held by Major Hackher and 800 men, resisted a full French siege and was never taken; the Treaty of Schönbrunn ordered its demolition anyway, and the citizens ransomed the clock tower and bell tower, the only parts left standing.
zh:
格拉茨扼守穆尔河上的渡口，河水在此流出阿尔卑斯山，进入盛产谷物的格拉茨平原。城名来自斯拉夫语，意为渡口上方的小堡；巴伐利亚移民在城堡山下开设市集，1128年首见记载，1140年已有确切凭证。奥塔卡尔家族把它经营成施泰尔马克的首邑，1186年的《格奥尔根贝格条约》把公爵领地传给巴本贝格家族，1379年起这里成为哈布斯堡内奥地利支系的驻地。腓特烈三世在此居留的时间比在任何地方都长，1438年起兴建城堡，旁边又建起哥特式主教座堂。1444年的格拉茨是内奥地利实际的都城：一座讲德语的天主教商业城市，城堡山上的要塞监视着南通的道路。

1480年奥斯曼袭扰军进抵穆尔河；主教座堂里保存着1485年的《天灾图》，这幅还愿画把当时的三大灾祸画在一起：蝗灾、瘟疫和土耳其人。马克西米利安一世在城堡中增修双螺旋楼梯，又于1496年把犹太人逐出施泰尔马克。到16世纪中叶，市民多数已皈依路德宗：施泰尔马克等级会议按多梅尼科·德利·阿利奥的设计建成文艺复兴式州议会大厦，卡尔二世大公1585年创办耶稣会大学，约翰内斯·开普勒则自1594年起在新教学校教授数学，与他交好的有生于格拉茨的汉斯·乌尔里希·冯·埃根贝格，后者后来官至费迪南德二世的首席大臣。1598年新教牧师被逐，1599年新教学校关闭，开普勒1600年前往布拉格，整个宫廷也于1619年迁往维也纳。法军1797年进入格拉茨，1805年再度占领。1809年，为抵御土耳其人改建的城堡山要塞由哈克尔少校率八百人据守，顶住法军的全面围攻，始终未被攻克；《申布伦条约》仍下令拆毁要塞，市民出资赎下时钟塔和钟楼，那是仅存的两处建筑。

en:
Somogy is the rolling livestock country south of Lake Balaton; with Tolna and Baranya it runs east to the Mecsek hills and Pécs. Cattle fattened on its pastures for the western cattle roads, and Kapos Castle watched the road toward Slavonia. Somogyvár had been the seat of Koppány, who rose against King Stephen I at the birth of the Christian kingdom and was defeated around 997; his lands went to Pannonhalma Abbey. After the Mongol invasion Béla IV gave Kapos its first castle. At the eastern foot of the Mecsek, Pécs stood on the site of the Roman town of Sopianae, had been a bishopric since 1009, and held Hungary's first university, founded by Louis I in 1367. In 1444 Catholic Hungarian nobles and church estates ran the cattle country, while the Ottoman advance in the Balkans moved the frontier closer.

From 1459 the humanist Janus Pannonius, the leading Latin poet of Hungary, held the see of Pécs and brought Italian learning to the city. Mohács in 1526 ended that world: Suleiman's army sacked Pécs, and Ferdinand and John Zápolya divided the county's loyalties. The Ottomans held the city briefly during the 1529 march on Vienna; when they returned in June 1543, the bishop handed over the keys himself after the Flemish and Walloon mercenaries had deserted the night before. Pécs became a sanjak centre, its churches turned into mosques with minarets, its market into a bazaar with baths. Kaposvár fell in September 1555 after a five-day siege. The wars emptied Somogy: county government ceased and the land was split among the Kanizsa, Szigetvár, Koppány and Simontornya sanjaks. In 1664 Nicholas Zrínyi burned Pécs and raided Babócsa and Berzence, yet the Peace of Vasvár left southern Transdanubia to the Ottomans. Louis of Baden recovered Kaposvár and Pécs in 1686, and Szigetvár and Kanizsa fell within the next four years.

The Habsburgs razed Kapos Castle in 1702; the Esterházy family revived the town and won market rights in 1703, and Kaposvár became county seat in 1749. Pécs was made a free royal city in 1780, as herds and settlers returned.
zh:
绍莫吉是巴拉顿湖南岸起伏的畜牧之乡，与托尔瑙、巴兰尼亚合为一省，向东一直到迈切克丘陵和佩奇。牧场上养肥牛群，供应西行的牛商路，考波什城堡控扼着通往斯拉沃尼亚的道路。绍莫吉堡曾是科帕尼的据点：匈牙利基督教王国初立之时，他起兵反对伊什特万一世，约在997年战败，封地被赐给潘农哈尔马修道院。蒙古入侵之后，贝拉四世为考波什建起第一座城堡。东端迈切克山下的佩奇建在罗马城市索皮阿奈的故址上，1009年成为主教驻地，拉约什一世1367年又在这里创办匈牙利第一所大学。1444年，信奉天主教的匈牙利贵族和教会领有着这片牛乡，而奥斯曼在巴尔干的推进正把前线越推越近。

1459年起，匈牙利首屈一指的拉丁语诗人、人文主义者雅努斯·潘诺尼乌斯担任佩奇主教，把意大利的人文学术带进城里。1526年莫哈奇战役终结了这一切：苏莱曼的军队洗劫佩奇，斐迪南与亚诺什·绍波尧伊两王并立，使这一地区的效忠分裂。奥斯曼军1529年进军维也纳途中一度占领佩奇；1543年6月他们再来时，佛兰德和瓦隆雇佣军在前一夜逃走，主教亲自交出城门钥匙。佩奇成为桑贾克中心，教堂改成带宣礼塔的清真寺，集市换成了巴扎和浴室。考波什堡1555年9月在五日围攻后陷落。连绵的战争使绍莫吉人口流散：县政停摆，土地被划入考尼饶、锡盖特堡、科帕尼和希蒙托尔尼奥四个桑贾克。1664年，兹里尼·米克洛什焚毁佩奇，袭击包博乔和拜尔任采，但沃什瓦尔和约仍把外多瑙南部留给奥斯曼。巴登的路德维希1686年收复考波什堡和佩奇，锡盖特堡和考尼饶也在随后四年内攻克。

1702年哈布斯堡拆毁考波什城堡，埃斯特哈齐家族复兴了这座小镇，1703年取得市集权，考波什堡又于1749年成为县治。1780年，佩奇成为自由王家城市，畜群和移民陆续回到这一地区。

en:
Ghent grew up where the Leie joins the Scheldt, on water-meadows whose sheep supplied its looms. By the thirteenth century it was the second largest city in Europe north of the Alps after Paris, with as many as 65,000 people inside the walls and four thousand weavers working English and Scottish wool; the belfry, cloth hall and merchants' quays showed where the city's wealth lay. In 1340 John of Gaunt, later Duke of Lancaster, was born here, and 'Gaunt' is the old English form of Ghent. In 1432 the brothers Hubert and Jan van Eyck installed their polyptych of the Adoration of the Mystic Lamb in the church of St John, later St Bavo's Cathedral, one of the most famous paintings in Europe. In 1444 Ghent belonged to Philip the Good's Burgundian Netherlands: Flemish-speaking, Catholic, rich from cloth, and jealous of its privileges.

Taxes and princes wore those privileges down. Philip the Good's army crushed a Ghent revolt at Gavere in 1453, and the centre of the cloth trade shifted toward Antwerp. The emperor Charles V was born in the city in 1500, yet after the Ghent Revolt of 1539 he stripped it of its rights, made its leading citizens parade in shirts with nooses around their necks, and demolished St Bavo's Abbey to raise a Spanish fortress. In the town hall on 8 November 1576 the provinces signed the Pacification of Ghent against Spanish rule; Ghent then ran a Calvinist republic from 1577 until Alexander Farnese's long siege forced its surrender in 1584.

French armies held Ghent in 1745–1748, and from 1794 the city belonged to revolutionary and Napoleonic France. In 1800 Lieven Bauwens smuggled a Mule Jenny spinning machine and British machine drawings out of England and set up cotton mills here. The Treaty of Ghent, signed in December 1814, ended the war between Britain and the United States, and under the United Kingdom of the Netherlands the university opened in 1816.
zh:
根特兴起于利斯河汇入斯海尔德河之处，河畔水草场上的羊群供养着城中织机。13世纪时，它已是阿尔卑斯山以北仅次于巴黎的第二大城市，城墙内人口多达六万五千，仅织工就有四千，加工英格兰和苏格兰羊毛；钟楼、织物厅和商船码头就是财富所在。1340年，后来的兰开斯特公爵、人称「冈特的约翰」便出生于此，而冈特正是根特的旧英文叫法。1432年，胡贝特和扬·凡·艾克兄弟把多联画《根特祭坛画》（又称《神秘羔羊之爱》）安置在圣约翰教堂，也就是后来的圣巴夫主教座堂，这是欧洲最著名的画作之一。1444年，根特属于好人菲利普的勃艮第尼德兰：居民操弗拉芒语，信奉天主教，靠布匹致富，对城市特权看得极重。

赋税和君主一步步削去这些特权。1453年，好人菲利普的军队在哈弗勒镇压根特起义，布匹贸易的重心也移向安特卫普。1500年查理五世出生在根特，但1539年根特起义之后，他剥夺城市权利，命名流身着衬衣、颈套绳索游街，还拆毁圣巴夫修道院，在原址修起西班牙要塞。1576年11月8日，尼德兰诸省在市政厅签署《根特协定》，共同反对西班牙统治；1577年起根特建立加尔文派共和国，直到1584年亚历山大·法尔内塞经长期围困迫其投降。

1745年至1748年，法军一度占领根特；1794年以后，城市归属革命法国和拿破仑帝国。1800年，利芬·鲍文斯从英国偷运出一台骡机和英国机器图纸，在根特办起棉纺厂。1814年12月签署的《根特条约》结束了英国与美国之间的战争；尼德兰联合王国治下，根特大学于1816年创立。

en:
Namur began around the meeting of the Sambre and Meuse, a river crossing on old routes through the Ardennes. Celtic traders used the site before the Romans defeated the Aduatuci and opened the region, and a Merovingian stronghold later occupied the rocky spur above the confluence. A county took shape there in the tenth century. Its counts could build on the Meuse's north bank, while the bishops of Liège held Jambes across the water, so the medieval town grew unevenly around its bridge and castle. In 1421 John III, the last local count, sold Namur to Philip the Good of Burgundy. In 1444 it was therefore a Catholic, Walloon-speaking district of the Burgundian Netherlands, where bridge tolls and the count's fortress watched traffic between Flanders, Hainaut and the Rhineland.

After Charles the Bold died in 1477, Namur passed with the Burgundian inheritance to the Habsburgs and then to Spain. Its walls kept pace with siege warfare: the Médiane fort was built after 1542 and the larger Terra Nova took shape between 1631 and 1675. In 1692 Louis XIV's army besieged Namur from 25 May to 30 June. Vauban directed the French attack; Menno van Coehoorn defended the citadel and held it for twenty-five days after the town surrendered. Vauban then rebuilt the captured fortress, but William III retook Namur for the Grand Alliance in 1695. The Barrier Treaty of 1709 gave the Dutch a garrison there, and after the Treaty of Utrecht in 1713 Austrian officials ruled the town while Dutch troops occupied the citadel. French forces under General de Valence invested it on 19 November 1792, received the surrender of the 3,000-man garrison on 1 December, and France annexed the region in 1794.
zh:
那慕尔兴起于桑布尔河与默兹河汇流处，控制着穿过阿登的古道渡口。凯尔特人已在此贸易，罗马人击败阿杜亚都契人后打开这一地区；后来一座墨洛温要塞占据汇流处上方的岩岬。10世纪，那慕尔伯国成形。伯爵们只能在默兹河北岸营建，对岸的让布属于列日主教，因此中世纪城镇围绕桥梁和城堡不均衡地发展。1421年末代本地伯爵约翰三世把那慕尔卖给勃艮第公爵好人腓力。1444年，这里因此是勃艮第尼德兰境内一片讲瓦隆语的天主教土地，桥梁税和伯爵要塞监视着佛兰德、埃诺与莱茵兰之间的往来。

1477年大胆查理死后，那慕尔随勃艮第遗产转入哈布斯堡家族手中，后来归西班牙统治。当地工事随攻城战不断改进：中线堡垒建于1542年以后，更大的「新地」堡垒在1631至1675年间成形。1692年5月25日至6月30日，路易十四的军队围攻那慕尔。沃邦指挥法军进攻，梅诺·范·科霍恩防守城塞，在城区投降后又坚守二十五天。法军攻占后由沃邦重建堡垒，但威廉三世在1695年率大同盟军队夺回那慕尔。1709年《屏障条约》允许荷兰在此驻军；1713年《乌得勒支和约》签订后，奥地利官员治理城镇，荷兰军队驻守城塞。1792年11月19日，德·瓦朗斯将军率法军围城，12月1日接受三千名守军投降；法国于1794年兼并这一地区。

en:
The Vaud is the broad country between the Jura and Lake Geneva, vineyards along the shore and pastures on the slopes, with the episcopal city of Lausanne at its centre. The Romans made Aventicum, whose amphitheatre still stands outside the modern town, the capital of their Helvetian province. The house of Savoy later gathered the scattered lordships into the Barony of Vaud: Peter of Savoy built up its power from 1234, and Amadeus VI bought the barony back into his house in 1359. Savoyard castles ringed the lake, above all Chillon on its rock at the eastern end, which guarded the road to the Great St Bernard pass and held the dukes' prisoners. Lausanne, Morges, Vevey and Nyon lived from the lake traffic, and herdsmen drove cattle over the Jura passes. In 1444 the French-speaking Vaud belonged to the dukes of Savoy, ruling from Chambery, a Catholic land of vines and herds.

In the Burgundian Wars the Swiss confederates destroyed Charles the Bold's army at Grandson in March 1476 and beat him again at Murten in June, though most of the Vaud returned to Savoy. In 1530 the duke locked the Geneva prior Francois Bonivard in Chillon for six years; a Bernese army under Hans Franz Naegeli freed him while overrunning the whole Vaud in 1536 on its march to relieve Geneva. That October, in Lausanne cathedral, Viret, Farel and Calvin out-argued the Catholic clergy at the Lausanne Disputation, and Bern split the country into twelve bailiwicks and imposed the Reformation; Savoy formally ceded the Vaud by the Treaty of Lausanne in 1564. Rule from German-speaking Bern fed resentment, and Major Abraham Davel rose for Vaudois liberty in 1723 and was beheaded at Vidy. In January 1798 the Vaudois proclaimed the Lemanic Republic as French troops entered; the Bourla-Papey rebels burned the feudal title deeds in 1802, and the Act of Mediation made the Vaud a sovereign canton in 1803, its independence confirmed at the Congress of Vienna in 1815.
zh:
沃州是汝拉山与莱芒湖之间的一片广阔乡野，湖畔葡萄园连片，坡地牧场铺开，中心是主教驻节的洛桑。罗马人把阿旺蒂库姆建成海尔维第行省的首府，圆形竞技场的残址就在阿旺什城外。后来萨伏依家族把零散领地合成沃州男爵领地：萨伏依的彼得自1234年起经营此地，1359年阿梅迪奥六世又把男爵领地购回家族。萨伏依人的城堡环列湖边，最著名的是湖东端岩岛上的希永堡，扼守通往大圣伯纳德山口的道路，也关押公爵的囚徒。洛桑、莫尔日、沃韦、尼翁诸城依湖为生，牧民赶着牛群翻越汝拉山口。1444年，讲法语的沃州属于从尚贝里发号施令的萨伏依公爵，是一片信天主教、种葡萄又牧牛的土地。

勃艮第战争中，瑞士邦联军1476年3月在格朗松歼灭大胆查理的军队，6月又在穆尔滕取胜，但沃州大部仍归还萨伏依。1530年，公爵把日内瓦修道院院长弗朗索瓦·博尼瓦关进希永堡，一关六年；1536年，汉斯·弗朗茨·内格利率伯尔尼军驰援日内瓦，横扫沃州时将他释放。同年10月，维雷、法雷尔和加尔文在洛桑大教堂的辩论中驳倒天主教士，伯尔尼把沃州划为十二个辖区、强制推行宗教改革；1564年《洛桑条约》中萨伏依正式割让沃州。德语区伯尔尼的远程统治积怨甚深，1723年亚伯拉罕·达维尔少校为沃州的自由举事，在维迪被斩首。1798年1月法军入境，沃州人宣布成立莱芒共和国；1802年「烧纸者」起义焚毁封建契据，1803年《调停法案》使沃州成为主权州，其独立在1815年维也纳和会上得到确认。

en:
Augsburg lies on the Lech and Wertach rivers below the Alps, on the site of the Roman colony Augusta Vindelicorum. Its medieval wealth came from roads carrying cloth and metal between Germany, the Alpine passes and Italy, and from weavers who made the city one of South Germany's textile towns. It became a Free Imperial City in 1276, and after the craftsmen's rising of 1368 the guilds sat in government beside the patrician families. The bishop had moved his residence to Dillingen, while the city itself remained Catholic. In 1444 Augsburg was a self-governing Swabian cloth town, already rich enough to attract printers, painters and merchant houses.

The sixteenth century made it a bankers' city. The Fugger and Welser families financed the Habsburgs, controlled mines in Tyrol, Bohemia and Hungary, and kept agents in the main European markets. Jakob Fugger, born in Augsburg, paid for the Fuggerhäuser, the Renaissance chapel at St Anne's, and the walled Fuggerei settlement for poor citizens. Augsburg's presses, armourers, goldsmiths and instrument makers served the same imperial court, while its diets brought Luther, Protestant princes and Charles V into the city: Luther faced Cardinal Cajetan there in 1518, the Augsburg Confession was presented in 1530, and the Religious Peace of Augsburg followed in 1555. The Swedish occupation and imperial-Bavarian siege of 1634-35 left the population starving and badly reduced. Bavarian troops entered in December 1805, and the old Free Imperial City passed to Bavaria as the Empire dissolved.
zh:
奥格斯堡坐落在阿尔卑斯山北缘的莱希河与韦尔塔赫河畔，城址原为罗马殖民城奥古斯塔-温德利科鲁姆。中世纪时，连接德意志、阿尔卑斯山口和意大利的道路运输布匹与金属，织工则让它成为南德纺织城镇之一。1276年它成为帝国自由城市，1368年手工业者起义后，行会与城市贵族共同执政。主教已把驻地迁往迪林根，城市仍奉天主教。1444年的奥格斯堡是一座自治的施瓦本布业城镇，富庶到足以吸引印刷匠、画家和商人家族。

16世纪，银行家成了这里的主角。富格尔和韦尔瑟家族向哈布斯堡家族放贷，控制蒂罗尔、波希米亚和匈牙利的矿山，并在欧洲主要市场派驻代理人。出生于奥格斯堡的雅各布·富格尔出资修建富格尔宫、圣安娜教堂的文艺复兴礼拜堂，以及供贫民居住的围合社区福格社区。印刷所、甲胄匠、金匠和科学仪器匠也为同一个帝国宫廷服务。帝国议会又把宗教争端带进城里：1518年路德面对卡耶坦枢机，1530年《奥格斯堡信纲》上呈，1555年《奥格斯堡和约》签订。1634至1635年，瑞典占领与皇帝、巴伐利亚联军的围城使市民挨饿，人口大减。1805年12月巴伐利亚军队入城，这座老牌帝国自由城市在帝国解体之际并入巴伐利亚。

en:
Zürich stands where the Limmat flows out of Lake Zürich; the Roman customs post of Turicum stood on its Lindenhof hill. In 853 Louis the German founded Fraumünster Abbey for his daughter, and its abbess came to hold the market, the tolls and the mint. After 1218 the city held directly of the emperor, and Rudolf Brun's guild revolution of 1336 put the craft guilds in power. Zürich joined the Swiss confederates in 1351 and grew rich on wool, linen and the carrying trade. In 1440 the Toggenburg inheritance dispute tore it out of the alliance: the council allied with Frederick III of Habsburg, and in July 1443 Burgomaster Rudolf Stüssi was killed at St. Jakob an der Sihl defending the bridges against the confederate assault. The walls held, and in November 1444 the Catholic trading city was still at war with its former allies.

The confederate oaths were renewed in 1450. The military commander Hans Waldmann, popular after the Burgundian Wars, made himself burgomaster and ruled the town until a rural rising had him beheaded in 1489. In 1519 Huldrych Zwingli began preaching at the Grossmünster. The open quarrel with the old church began in Lent 1522 at printer Christoph Froschauer's table, when sausages were served in defiance of the Lenten fast, and Froschauer's press later printed the Zurich Bible. The dispute with the Anabaptists ended with Felix Manz drowned in the Limmat in 1527, and Zwingli himself fell at Kappel in 1531 when the Catholic cantons surprised Zürich. Heinrich Bullinger then led the city church, and Protestant refugees from Italy, France and England strengthened its printing and textiles.

Zürich proclaimed itself a republic in 1648, and the French invasion of 1798 ended the old oligarchy. In September 1799 the city became a battlefield of the Coalition Wars: along the Limmat and through the gates André Masséna's French army defeated Rimsky-Korsakov's Russians. Under the Act of Mediation of 1803 Zürich became capital of the reconstituted canton.
zh:
苏黎世位于利马特河流出苏黎世湖之处，林登霍夫山上曾是罗马人的税站图里库姆。853年，德意志人路易为女儿建立圣母修道院，后来女修道院院长掌握了市场、关税和铸币权。1218年后城市直属皇帝，1336年鲁道夫·布伦发动行会革命，手工业行会开始执政。1351年苏黎世加入瑞士邦联，靠羊毛、亚麻和转运贸易致富。1440年，托根堡继承权争端把它推出同盟：市议会与哈布斯堡的腓特烈三世结盟，1443年7月，市长鲁道夫·施图西在锡尔河畔的圣雅各布抵御同盟军队进攻、防守桥梁时战死。城池守住了，1444年11月，这座天主教商业城市仍与先前的盟友处于交战状态。

1450年，苏黎世重新宣誓入盟。在勃艮第战争中赢得声望的将领汉斯·瓦尔德曼自立为市长、把持市政，直到1489年被一场乡村暴动送上断头台。1519年，慈运理开始在苏黎世大教堂布道。与旧教会的公开决裂发生在1522年大斋期，印刷商克里斯托夫·弗罗绍尔的餐桌上端出香肠，公然破斋，他的印坊后来还印出了苏黎世译本圣经。与重洗派的争端以费利克斯·曼茨1527年被溺死在利马特河告终，1531年天主教诸州突袭苏黎世，慈运理本人在卡佩尔战死。海因里希·布林格随后主持城市教会，意大利、法兰西和英格兰的新教难民增强了这里的印刷与纺织业。

1648年苏黎世宣布成立共和国，1798年法军入侵，旧寡头政权告终。1799年9月，这里成为反法同盟战争的战场：安德烈·马塞纳的法军沿利马特河、在城门之间击败里姆斯基-科尔萨科夫的俄军。1803年《调停法案》颁布后，苏黎世成为重建的苏黎世州首府。

en:
St. Gallen is the abbey town of the Irish monk Gallus, who built a hermitage in this valley around 612; Benedictines founded the monastery on his cell in 719. Its scriptorium and library made it one of the great schools of medieval Europe, where Notker the Stammerer wrote the sequences sung in the mass and Notker Labeo translated learned works into Old High German. Its library still keeps the Plan of Saint Gall, drawn around 825, the only large architectural drawing to survive from the Latin West between Rome and the high Middle Ages, showing an ideal monastery that was never built. In 1207 the abbot became a prince of the Empire. Beside his walls a weavers' town grew up: the cloth guild led the council by the middle of the fourteenth century, and in 1415 the burghers bought their liberty from King Sigismund. In 1444 the province was therefore two polities side by side, a wealthy guild city allied to the Swiss confederates and the Catholic prince-abbot ruling the monastery and the surrounding pasturelands.

The town swore an Everlasting Alliance with the confederates in 1454 and bought its final release from the abbot three years later. In 1489 Mayor Ulrich Varnbüler backed the destruction of the new monastery the abbot was building at Rorschach; four protecting cantons marched in, fined the town and drove him into exile. In the 1520s the humanist Joachim von Watt, known as Vadian (physician, geographer and later burgomaster), carried the Reformation through the city, while the abbey kept the old faith. During the Toggenburg War of 1712 Bern and Zürich carried off part of its library, and the abbot later had the church and library rebuilt in late baroque style by Peter Thumb. French invasion ended the prince-abbot's state in 1798. The canton of St. Gallen was formed in 1803, the monastery was dissolved in 1805, and the textile town soon had one of Switzerland's first mechanical spinning mills.
zh:
圣加仑是围绕爱尔兰修士加卢斯发展起来的修道院城。约612年，加卢斯在这座山谷建起隐修所，719年本笃会在他的小屋旧址上建院。抄写室和藏书室使这里成为中世纪欧洲的大学问中心之一，诺特克·巴尔布卢斯在此写下弥撒中唱诵的续唱，诺特克·拉贝奥把学术著作译成古高地德语。藏书室里还保存着约825年绘制的《圣加仑修道院平面图》。这是罗马陷落后到中世纪盛期之间拉丁西方唯一留存下来的大型建筑图，描绘了一座从未动工的理想修道院。1207年，院长受封帝国亲王。修道院墙外长出一座织工之城：14世纪中叶，织布工行会已主导市议会，1415年市民从西吉斯蒙德国王手中购得自治权。因此1444年的这片地方是两个并立的政权，一座与瑞士邦联结盟的富庶行会城市，和统治着修道院及周围牧场的天主教修道院长。

1454年，城市与邦联宣誓缔结永久同盟，三年后又向院长赎得彻底自由。1489年，市长乌尔里希·瓦恩比勒支持拆毁院长在罗尔沙赫兴建的新修道院，四个保护州随即出兵，城市被处罚金，瓦恩比勒被迫流亡。1520年代，人文主义者约阿希姆·冯·瓦特（人称瓦迪安，身兼医生、地理学者，后任市长）把宗教改革推行全城，修道院则仍奉旧教。1712年托根堡战争中，伯尔尼和苏黎世运走了藏书的一部分；后来院长请彼得·图姆主持，把教堂和藏书室按晚期巴洛克风格重建。1798年法军入侵，修道院长的世俗国家崩溃。1803年圣加仑州成立，1805年修道院解散，这座纺织城很快建起瑞士最早的机械纺纱厂之一。

en:
The Valais is the long valley of the upper Rhone, shut between the Pennine and Bernese Alps on the road from Lake Geneva to Italy over the Great St Bernard pass. The Romans called it Vallis Poenina and traded through Octodurus; the hospice on the pass, founded in 1049, sheltered travellers crossing into Italy and kept the mountain dogs used for rescue. In 999 King Rudolph III of Burgundy made the bishop of Sion count of the Valais, yet the dukes of Savoy made themselves masters of the French-speaking lower valley, while German settlers from Hasli pushed up-river, and from 1384 the Morge below Sion marked the border. The seven German-speaking tithings had their liberties confirmed in 1354, routed the bishop's and Savoy's men at Visp in 1388, and drove out the lords of Raron. In 1444 the Valais was a divided Catholic land, Savoyard below Sion and self-governing above it, and the witch trials begun in 1428, among the first in Europe, had by then sent at least 367 people to the stake.

In 1475 the tithings allied with Bern and routed a Savoyard army at the Planta outside Sion in November, then overran the lower valley as far as Saint-Maurice. They became an associate member of the Swiss Confederation in 1529, kept the Catholic faith while the Vaud turned Protestant, and held the Chablais lands taken in 1536 except for Evian and Thonon, which the Treaty of Thonon returned to Savoy in 1569. In 1634 the tithings stripped the bishop of his secular power and proclaimed the federal Republic of the Seven Tithings under a Landeshauptmann. In May 1800 Napoleon crossed the Great St Bernard with an army of forty thousand on his way to Marengo. He made the Valais the separate Rhodanic Republic in 1802, and after the Simplon road was driven across the Alps he annexed it in 1810 as the French department of the Simplon. Austrian troops entered in 1813, and on 4 August 1815 the Valais joined the Swiss Confederation as its twentieth canton.
zh:
瓦莱是罗讷河上游的一道长河谷，夹在彭尼山与伯尔尼山之间，从莱芒湖取道大圣伯纳德山口进入意大利的道路穿谷而过。罗马人称此地为波宁河谷，经奥克托杜鲁姆通商；1049年在山口上建起的旅舍为翻山去意大利的旅人提供食宿，还饲养着用于雪地救援的山犬。999年，勃艮第国王鲁道夫三世把瓦莱的世俗权力封给锡永主教，但讲法语的下瓦莱落入萨伏依公爵之手，来自哈斯利的德意志移民则沿河上溯开垦；1384年起，锡永下方的莫尔日河成为分界。七个讲德语的「十庄」1354年获皇帝确认自由，1388年在菲斯普击溃主教与萨伏依的军队，又赶走拉龙家族。1444年的瓦莱是一片分裂的天主教土地：锡永以下属萨伏依，上游自治；始于1428年的猎巫是欧洲最早的一批，到这时至少已有367人被送上火刑柱。

1475年，十庄与伯尔尼结盟，11月在锡永城外的普朗塔击溃萨伏依军队，随后进占下瓦莱直至圣莫里斯。1529年它成为瑞士邦联的联系成员；邻邦沃州改宗新教时，瓦莱仍奉天主教。1536年夺取的沙布莱土地都留在手中，只有埃维昂和托农依1569年《托农条约》归还萨伏依。1634年，十庄褫夺主教的世俗权力，成立由最高执政管辖的联邦式七个十庄共和国。1800年5月，拿破仑率四万大军翻越大圣伯纳德山口，前往马伦戈作战。1802年他把瓦莱立为独立的罗达尼亚共和国；辛普朗山路穿越阿尔卑斯山修通后，他又在1810年将其吞并，划为法国的辛普朗省。1813年奥军进入瓦莱，1815年8月4日，瓦莱作为第二十个州加入瑞士邦联。

en:
Ulm sits on the upper Danube below the Swabian Jura, where the Blau flows out of the karst spring at Blautopf and into the river. The town's fortune rested on textiles: Ulm merchants sold sealed cotton-and-linen fustian across Europe and kept houses in Venice, Vienna, Antwerp and Constantinople. Its citizens showed the same confidence in stone and law. In 1377 they began the minster inside the walls with their own money, after the old parish church outside the gates had proved vulnerable in war; local sculptors and altar-carvers shared in the prosperity paid for by cloth. The 1397 Schwörbrief gave the guilds thirty council seats to the patricians' ten. In 1444 Ulm was a Catholic self-governing imperial city, near the peak of its medieval trade.

Around 1500 it ruled three towns and fifty-five villages and hosted the Swabian League. The citizens voted for the Reformation in 1531, and iconoclasm broke up the workshops that had made its carved altars; work on the minster also stopped in 1543, leaving the planned steeple unfinished. Ulm surrendered to Charles V in the Schmalkaldic War, and the occupations, plagues and indemnities of the following centuries left it bankrupt by 1770. Bavaria took the city in 1802. Three years later Napoleon's manoeuvres around Ulm trapped General Mack's Austrian army and forced it to surrender without a major pitched battle. In 1810 Ulm passed to Württemberg; the Danube's right bank became Bavarian Neu-Ulm, leaving the old city on the Württemberg side.
zh:
乌尔姆位于施瓦本山缘的多瑙河上游，布劳河从布劳托普夫喀斯特泉流出后在此汇入干流。城市的财富靠纺织：乌尔姆商人把加盖本城印鉴的棉麻粗绒布销往欧洲各地，并在威尼斯、维也纳、安特卫普和君士坦丁堡设有商馆。市民也把这种自信投入石头建筑和城市法。1377年，因城门外的老教区教堂在战乱中难以保全，市民自筹资金在城墙内动工修建大教堂；本地雕刻师和祭坛工匠也随布匹贸易成名。1397年的《大誓书》规定行会占三十个市参事席位、城市贵族占十席。1444年，乌尔姆是一座自治的天主教帝国城市，正处在中世纪贸易的高点。

1500年前后，乌尔姆管辖三座城镇和五十五个村庄，并接待施瓦本同盟集会。1531年市民投票接受宗教改革，毁像行动拆散了制作雕刻祭坛的工坊；大教堂工程也在1543年停工，规划中的大尖塔尚未完工。施马尔卡尔登战争中，它向查理五世投降。此后几个世纪的占领、瘟疫和赔款不断消耗城市，到1770年乌尔姆已经破产。1802年巴伐利亚接管城市；三年后，拿破仑在乌尔姆周边机动，困住马克将军的奥军，未经大规模决战便迫其投降。1810年乌尔姆转属符腾堡，多瑙河右岸成为巴伐利亚的新乌尔姆，老城留在符腾堡一侧。

en:
Chur sits at the first bend of the Alpine Rhine, where the broad valley narrows and the roads divide for the Julier and Septimer passes on one side and the Splügen and San Bernardino on the other. On a rocky ridge above the Plessur the Romans kept a late fort, and Curia Raetorum, already chief town of the province of Raetia prima, became the seat of the first bishopric north of the Alps in the fourth century. Emperor Otto I gave the see toll and mint rights, and from 1170 the bishops ranked as princes of the Empire, holding the Septimer road all the way down to Chiavenna. The townspeople answered episcopal and Habsburg pressure with leagues of their own, forming the God's House League in 1367 and storming the bishop's residence in 1418–22 until the prelate gave way. In 1444 Chur was a Catholic bishop's city and at the same time the leading town of a valley league, already bound to the Grey League and the League of the Ten Jurisdictions while the common Three Leagues were still taking shape.

Fire destroyed most of the town in April 1464. The German-speaking craftsmen who rebuilt it stayed, organised five guilds, and under the constitution of January 1465 took civic power out of the bishop's hands. The leagues allied with the Swiss Confederates and in 1499 fought Austria in the Swabian War. Johannes Comander preached the Reformation from St. Martin's from 1523, and four years later the town's churches gave up the mass, though the Catholic bishop kept his seat and estates. The Thirty Years' War brought the Bündner Wirren. Austrian troops seized Chur in 1621 and a French and Swiss force retook it in 1624, and Jörg Jenatsch, the Protestant pastor turned military commander whom many of his followers called the saviour of Graubünden, was killed in the town in January 1639. The Three Leagues emerged from the war as a free state, and in 1803 their lands entered Switzerland as the canton of Graubünden, with Chur as their principal town.
zh:
库尔坐落在阿尔卑斯莱茵河出山后的第一道弯处，宽谷到此收窄，道路分成两股，一股通向尤利尔和塞普蒂梅山口，一股通向斯普吕根和圣贝纳迪诺山口。普莱苏尔河畔的岩丘上有罗马晚期要塞，本是第一雷蒂亚行省首要城市的库尔西亚·雷托鲁姆，4世纪成为阿尔卑斯山以北第一个主教区的驻地。奥托一世授予主教关税和铸币权，1170年起主教位列帝国诸侯，把塞普蒂梅大道一直控制到基亚文纳。市民则以自己的同盟回应主教和哈布斯堡的压力：1367年缔建神所同盟，1418至1422年又数度攻入主教府邸，逼主教让步。1444年的库尔既是天主教主教城市，又是一个山谷同盟的首要城市，已与灰色同盟和十辖区同盟联结，而共同的三同盟仍在成形之中。

1464年4月，大火烧毁大半个库尔。参与重建的德语工匠留居下来，组成五个行会，凭1465年1月的宪法把市政权力从主教手中接过。三同盟与瑞士邦联结盟，1499年在士瓦本战争中对奥地利作战。约翰内斯·科曼德从1523年起在圣马丁教堂宣讲宗教改革，四年后城内教堂停止弥撒，但天主教主教仍保留驻地和领地。三十年战争期间的邦联动乱重创这座城市：奥地利1621年占领库尔，法国和瑞士联军1624年将其收复；被许多追随者称作格劳宾登救星的新教牧师、军事领袖约尔格·耶纳奇（Jörg Jenatsch），1639年1月在城中被杀。战后三同盟成为自由邦，1803年其领地作为格劳宾登州加入瑞士，库尔为全州首要城市。

en:
Bremen grew up on a dune bank of the Weser, at the furthest point upriver reached by the tides, where seagoing ships could still unload; the Schlachte quay became one of the busiest wharves in northern Germany, with beer, grain, cloth and herring passing through. Charlemagne made the town a bishop's seat in 787, and the Hamburg-Bremen archbishopric long directed the missions of the northern seas. Adam of Bremen, a canon of the cathedral, wrote his history of the Hamburg bishops in the 1070s and set down in it the first European account of Vinland. The merchants joined the Hanseatic League in 1260 and steadily pared back the archbishop's temporal rule; in 1404 they raised the great stone Roland on the market square and built the town hall beside it. In 1444 Bremen was a largely self-governing Catholic merchant city of the Empire, run by a council of guild-masters and busy buying rights and estates along the lower Weser.

Bremen went over to the Reformation in 1522, early for northern Germany. As the Weser silted up, Dutch engineers built Germany's first artificial harbour downstream at Vegesack in 1619-23. The Linz Diploma of 1646 recognised Bremen as holding directly of the emperor, and the city defended that standing for decades against Sweden and then Hanover, which had acquired the surrounding duchy in 1715 and acknowledged the free city in 1720. Its merchants opened a direct trade with the United States in 1783. Heinrich Olbers, a physician practising in Bremen, fitted an observatory into the upper floor of his house and discovered the asteroids Pallas and Vesta there in 1802 and 1807. French troops occupied the city in 1806, and in 1811 Napoleon made it capital of the Bouches-du-Weser department; the French left in 1814 and the restored free city joined the German Confederation in 1815. In 1817 a Bremen wharf launched the first German-built steamship, the paddle-wheeler Weser. Two years later the Brothers Grimm published 'The Town Musicians of Bremen', about a donkey, a dog, a cat and a rooster who set off to live as musicians in the city and never get there.
zh:
不来梅兴起于威悉河的一处沙丘河岸，地处潮汐能到达的河流最上游，海船仍可靠岸卸货；施拉赫特码头后来成为北德意志最繁忙的码头之一，啤酒、谷物、呢绒和鲱鱼在此进出。787年查理大帝在此设立主教区，汉堡-不来梅大主教区长期主持北方海域的传教。大教堂的教士不来梅的亚当在11世纪70年代撰写汉堡主教史，书中记下了欧洲人对文兰的最早一段记载。商人于1260年加入汉萨同盟，逐步削去大主教的世俗权力；1404年他们在集市广场竖起巨大的石制罗兰像，又在旁边建起市政厅。1444年的不来梅是帝国境内一座高度自治的天主教商人城市，由行会长老组成的市政议会主政，并不断在威悉河下游购置地权与庄园。

1522年不来梅改宗新教，在北德意志算是很早。威悉河泥沙淤积日重，1619至1623年荷兰工匠在下游的维格萨克建成德国第一座人工港。1646年的《林茨证明》确认不来梅直属于皇帝，此后城市先对瑞典、再对汉诺威苦苦维系这一地位，后者1715年取得周边公国，1720年承认了不来梅的自由城市身份。1783年不来梅商人开通与美国的直接贸易。在不来梅行医的海因里希·奥伯斯把住宅顶层改成观星台，于1802年和1807年在那里先后发现智神星和灶神星。1806年法军占领城市，1811年拿破仑将它设为威悉河口省的省会，1814年法军撤离，恢复自由的不来梅于1815年加入德意志邦联。1817年，不来梅船坞下水德国人自建的第一艘蒸汽船——明轮汽船「威悉号」。两年后，格林兄弟发表《不来梅的城市乐手》：驴子、狗、猫和公鸡结伴前往不来梅，想在那里靠卖艺为生，最终却没有走到。

en:
Cuneo occupies a wedge of high ground (its name means 'wedge') between the Stura and the Gesso, the last strong point before the Maddalena and Tenda passes into Provence. It began in 1198 as a free commune, founded by villagers fleeing the lords of Montferrat and Saluzzo, and Emperor Frederick II confirmed its liberty in 1238. In 1259 the town put itself under Charles I of Anjou, count of Provence, and with Alba became the chief Angevin base in Piedmont, striking its own coin; a civic seal of 1379 read Conium caput est Pedemontis, 'head of Piedmont'. Genoese, Provençal and Catalan merchants kept loggias in the open trading town until 1382, when it passed to Savoy and the dukes walled it into a fortress aimed at France. In 1444 a Savoyard garrison held the wedge above the two rivers, its grid of streets running down from the citadel.

Armies from beyond the Alps sat before those walls at least six times between 1515 and 1691, Swiss in French pay, French royal troops and Catinat among them, and every time the town held. The great test was 1557, when the marshal of Brissac invested it from May to late June; its relief saved the state of Emmanuel Philibert, who in 1559 named Cuneo a city and 'most faithful and unconquered', adding the Savoy cross to its arms. In 1744 a Franco-Spanish army broke the Alpine forts and besieged it for five weeks; Baron Leutrum defended the walls while Charles Emmanuel III marched from Saluzzo and fought the besiegers at Madonna dell'Olmo on 30 September. The Piedmontese lost the battle, but their enemies were so weakened that they abandoned the trenches and raised the siege. Napoleon's men entered unopposed in April 1796 after the Sardinian collapse at Montenotte, and Cuneo became capital of the French Stura department. An Austro-Russian army retook it in 1799, the last siege the walls ever saw, and Marengo gave it back to France the next year; after Napoleon's fall the town returned to the House of Savoy.
zh:
库内奥位于斯图拉河与杰索河之间的一块楔形高地上，城名即意大利语「楔子」之意，是通往马达莱纳山口和滕达山口、进入普罗旺斯之前最后一处要冲。它始于1198年：逃离蒙费拉托与萨卢佐封建主的村民建立自由公社，皇帝腓特烈二世于1238年承认其自由。1259年，库内奥投附普罗旺斯伯爵安茹的查理，与阿尔巴同为安茹家族在皮埃蒙特的首要据点，可自铸钱币；1379年的一方城玺自称「皮埃蒙特之首」。这座开放的商镇里设有热那亚、普罗旺斯和加泰罗尼亚商人的商馆，直到1382年并入萨伏依，公爵们把它改造成一座对着法国的要塞。1444年，萨伏依驻军守着两河之间的楔形高地，棋盘式街道从城塞向下铺开。

1515至1691年间，山外的军队至少六次兵临城下，拿法国佣金的瑞士人、法国王军和卡蒂纳先后在其列，城墙却一次未破。最严峻的考验是1557年，布里萨克元帅从5月围城到6月底；解围救了埃马努埃莱·菲利贝托的国家，他于1559年封库内奥为城市，赐号「至忠无敌」，并把萨伏依十字添进城徽。1744年，法西联军连破阿尔卑斯要塞，围城五周；洛伊特伦男爵据城死守，卡洛·埃马努埃莱三世从萨卢佐驰援，9月30日在奥尔莫圣母之战中迎击敌军。皮埃蒙特一方虽然战败，敌军也损失惨重，最终放弃战壕、解除包围。1796年4月，撒丁军队在蒙特诺特溃败后，拿破仑的部队兵不血刃入城，库内奥成为法国斯图拉省省会。1799年奥俄联军一度将其夺回，这是这座城经历的最后一次围城，次年马伦戈战役后复归法国；拿破仑失败后，库内奥重归萨伏依王室。

en:
Frankfurt grew up at the Franks' ford across the Main, a shallow rocky crossing of the river; it is first named in 794, when Charlemagne held a church council at his palace. Louis the German kept one of his chief seats here, and his palace church became St Bartholomew's, the imperial cathedral whose tall spire Madern Gerthener raised. German kings had been elected at Frankfurt since the twelfth century, and the Golden Bull of 1356 made it the Empire's fixed election city; in 1372 the council bought out the imperial bailiff and Frankfurt became a free imperial city. Its wealth came from the fairs, first recorded in 1150 and placed under imperial protection by Frederick II, which drew merchants from across the Empire as the Provençal fairs declined. The council sat in the Römer, a merchant's house bought in 1405. In 1444 Frankfurt was a self-governing Catholic city living on its fair trade, with a Jewish community going back to 1150; eighteen years later the Jews were shut into the Judengasse, a single walled lane down by the river.

From 1562 the kings were crowned emperors in the cathedral as well, and the coronation procession ran from St Bartholomew's to the Römer; the last was Francis II, who in 1792 set the day on 14 July, Bastille Day. Charles VII, shut out of occupied Bavaria, kept his whole court here from 1742 to 1744. A book fair opened in 1478 and became the meeting place of the German printing trade, and in 1585 the merchants agreed common exchange rates for the coins in circulation, the beginning of the Frankfurt stock exchange. The city introduced the Reformation in 1533, then returned its collegiate churches to Catholic rites to keep the fairs and elections safe. The poet Goethe was born and grew up here. French troops occupied Frankfurt in 1792 and bombarded it in 1796, when the Judengasse was opened; in 1806 the city passed to the prince-primate Dalberg, who titled himself Grand Duke of Frankfurt in 1810. The allies ended that grand duchy in 1813, and the Congress of Vienna restored the free city in 1815 as the seat of the German Confederation's Bundestag.
zh:
法兰克福起于美因河上一处「法兰克人的渡口」，那是一道水浅可涉的石质河床；794年查理曼在当地行宫召开宗教会议，城名首见于记载。日耳曼人路易曾以此为主要行宫之一，他的行宫教堂后来成为操办帝国大典的圣巴多罗买主教座堂，高耸的尖塔出自马德恩·格特亨纳之手。自12世纪起，德意志国王多在法兰克福选出，1356年金玺诏书正式定这里为固定选王之城；1372年市议会买下皇帝委派的地方管辖权，法兰克福成为帝国自由城市。它的财富来自市集：市集1150年已有记载，又获腓特烈二世的帝国保护，普罗旺斯旧市集衰落后，全帝国的商人转投于此。市议会在1405年购入的商人宅邸「罗马厅」里办公。1444年的法兰克福是一座靠市集立足的自治天主教城市，犹太社区可追溯到1150年；十八年后，犹太人被赶进沿河一道筑墙隔开的小巷「犹太巷」。

1562年起，国王又在此加冕为皇帝，加冕行列从圣巴多罗买教堂一路走到罗马厅；末代皇帝是弗朗茨二世，他在1792年特意把加冕日定在7月14日，即巴士底狱陷落的日子。查理七世因巴伐利亚被占、回不去故土，1742至1744年带着整个朝廷滞留于此。1478年书市开办，成为德意志印刷业的聚会之地；1585年商人为市面流通的各色货币定出统一兑换比价，这便是法兰克福证券交易所的起源。城市1533年引入宗教改革，后来为保住市集和选王特权，又把修院教堂交还天主教礼仪。诗人歌德出生并成长于此。1792年法军占领法兰克福，1796年的炮击之后犹太巷终获开放；1806年城市归首席侯爵达尔贝格，他1810年自称法兰克福大公。1813年反法联军终结这个大公国，1815年维也纳会议恢复自由城市，德意志邦联议会设在此地。

en:
Charolais is the rolling cattle country of southern Burgundy around Charolles, where the Arconce winds between wooded ridges. Its pastures had long raised the large white cattle that took the region's name, oxen bred for the plough and sold on to farmers in the Nivernais and the Bourbonnais. At Paray-le-Monial, Count Lambert of Chalon and Mayeul, abbot of Cluny, founded a Benedictine priory in 973, and the Romanesque church that replaced it was built on the plan of Cluny Abbey itself. Charolles became the seat of a county in 1277, and in 1390 the count sold Charolais to Duke Philip the Bold of Burgundy, after which the title Count of Charolais went to the Burgundian heir. In 1444 that heir was the young Charles, later called the Bold, ruling under his father Philip the Good.

When Charles fell at Nancy in 1477, Louis XI seized the county, but the Charolais rose for Mary of Burgundy. The Treaty of Arras in 1482 put it into Margaret of Austria's dowry, and the Treaty of Senlis returned it to Philip the Fair in 1493; it stayed with the Spanish Habsburgs as a fief lying inside the kingdom of France. When the Spanish crown failed to pay the million francs promised to the Great Condé in 1659, the Parlement of Paris adjudged Charolais to him in 1684, and Louis XV united the county to the royal domain in 1761. The old priory town of Paray had meanwhile acquired a different kind of fame: from 1673 to 1675 the Visitation nun Margaret Mary Alacoque reported visions of the Sacred Heart of Jesus there, and with her Jesuit confessor Claude de la Colombière she spread the devotion that sent Catholic pilgrims to her convent at Paray.
zh:
沙罗勒是勃艮第南部以沙罗勒镇为中心的起伏牧地，阿尔孔斯河在林木葱郁的山梁间蜿蜒。当地牧场很早就饲养一种以本地命名的白色大牛，培育作耕牛，再转卖到讷韦尔和波旁奈的农户手中。973年，沙隆伯爵朗贝尔与克吕尼修道院长马约尔一同在帕赖勒莫尼亚勒建立本笃会修道院，后来取代旧堂的罗曼式教堂依照克吕尼修道院的平面建造。1277年沙罗勒成为伯国首府；1390年，伯爵把沙罗勒卖给勃艮第公爵勇敢的腓力，此后沙罗勒伯爵头衔封给勃艮第继承人。1444年，这位继承人就是少年查理，即后来的大胆查理，当时仍在父亲好人腓力治下。

1477年查理战死于南锡，路易十一夺取伯国，沙罗勒人却起兵支持勃艮第的玛丽。1482年的《阿拉斯条约》把它列入奥地利的玛格丽特的嫁妆，1493年的《桑利斯条约》又将它归还美男子腓力；此后它作为法兰西王国境内的一块封邑，留在西班牙哈布斯堡家族手中。西班牙王室无力偿付1659年许诺给大孔代的100万法郎，巴黎高等法院遂于1684年把沙罗勒判给他；1761年，路易十五将伯国并入王室领地。古老的修道院城镇帕赖还得到另一种名声：1673年至1675年，圣母往见会修女玛加利大·玛利亚·亚拉高在那里多次得见耶稣圣心的异象，她在耶稣会神师克洛德·拉·科隆比耶尔的协助下传播圣心敬礼，天主教信徒纷纷前往她在帕赖的修道院朝圣。

en:
Aachen occupies a basin of sulphur springs on the Wurm, west of the Rhine and close to the Flemish border. Romans knew the spa as Aquae Granni. Pepin the Short kept a residence there, and Charlemagne spent most winters in Aachen between 792 and his death in 814, making the town the political centre of his court. His palace chapel, modelled on San Vitale in Ravenna and consecrated in 805, became his burial church; his remains were later placed in the golden shrine of Charlemagne. In 802 the Jewish merchant Isaac returned to the court with Abul-Abbas, the elephant sent by Harun al-Rashid. For nearly six centuries kings came to the chapel for coronation at the high altar and enthronement on Charlemagne's throne, beginning with Otto I in 936 and ending with Ferdinand I in 1531. Frederick Barbarossa made Aachen an imperial city in 1166, and the display of its relics drew pilgrims from 1349 onward. In 1444 it was a Catholic free imperial city living by woollen cloth, pilgrimage and the springs, too small to overawe Jülich, Liège or its other Rhenish neighbours.

Ferdinand I's coronation in 1531 was the last held at Aachen, as Frankfurt became the usual coronation city. The Reformation split the town, and in 1598 Spanish troops from the Netherlands backed the removal and expulsion of Protestant office-holders; many Protestant coppersmiths had already moved to Stolberg and Vaals, taking skill and trade from Aachen's brass workshops. The Thirty Years' War passed the city with little fighting, but on 2 May 1656 a bakery fire destroyed 4,664 houses. Aachen rebuilt its bathing trade and hosted the treaties of Aix-la-Chapelle in 1668 and 1748. French forces occupied the city in 1794 and abolished its imperial constitution; the Peace of Lunéville confirmed French rule on the left bank of the Rhine in 1801. After Napoleon's defeat, Aachen passed to Prussia in 1815 and hosted the allied congress that met there in 1818.
zh:
亚琛位于莱茵河以西、武尔姆河畔的一片硫磺温泉盆地，靠近佛兰德边境。罗马人把这里的温泉称作阿奎斯·格拉尼。矮子丕平在此设有行宫；792年至814年去世前，查理大帝多数冬天都住在亚琛，使这里成为宫廷的政治中心。他的行宫礼拜堂参照拉文纳的圣维塔莱教堂，805年祝圣，后来成为安葬他的教堂；他的遗骸安放在后来制成的查理大帝金圣龛中。802年，犹太商人以撒带着哈伦·拉希德赠送的大象阿布·阿拔斯回到这座宫廷。近六百年间，国王们来到这座礼拜堂，在主祭坛前加冕并登上查理大帝宝座；仪式始于936年的奥托一世，终于1531年的斐迪南一世。1166年，腓特烈一世（红胡子）把亚琛立为帝国自由城市；1349年以后，教堂展示圣物，吸引大批朝圣者。1444年，亚琛是天主教帝国自由城市，靠毛纺、朝圣和温泉维持，却不足以压服于利希、列日等莱茵邻国。

1531年斐迪南一世的加冕礼是亚琛最后一次国王加冕，此后法兰克福成为常用加冕地。宗教改革使城市分裂；1598年，来自尼德兰的西班牙军队支持罢免并驱逐新教官员，许多新教铜匠此前已迁往施托尔贝格和法尔斯，也把技艺和生意带离亚琛的黄铜作坊。三十年战争几乎没有波及这里，但1656年5月2日，一场从面包房燃起的大火摧毁4664栋房屋。亚琛重建温泉业，并在1668年和1748年两度促成《亚琛和约》。1794年法国军队占领城市，废除帝国城市宪制；1801年《吕内维尔和约》确认法国对莱茵河左岸的统治。拿破仑失败后，亚琛于1815年并入普鲁士，1818年又承办反法同盟列强会议。

en:
Alençon guards a crossing of the Sarthe on the southern march of Normandy, where the medieval town grew below a castle of the lords of Bellême. In 1051 William of Normandy besieged it during a revolt; the garrison waved animal hides from the walls to mock his tanner grandfather, and William maimed thirty-two captured men before the town surrendered. From the thirteenth century the county was an apanage for sons of the kings of France, and Duke Peter's great keep later dominated the town. Raised to a duchy and peerage in 1414, Alençon lost Duke Jean I at Agincourt the next year and opened its gates to Henry V in 1417. Jean II was captured at Verneuil in 1424, ransomed after three years, and fought beside Joan of Arc. In 1444 an English garrison still held the drapers' town and the livestock country around it, while the dispossessed Jean II waited on Charles VII.

In 1449 four burghers let Jean II back into Alençon, and all four were ennobled. The duke later joined the dauphin's revolt and was tried in 1458 and again in 1472. His daughter-in-law Marguerite of Lorraine completed the churches of Notre-Dame and Saint-Léonard and founded the Poor Clares' convent in 1497. The duchy returned to the crown on the death of the childless Charles IV in 1524, passed to Catherine de' Medici as a widow's estate in 1559, and went to her youngest son Francis in 1566. Alençon's best-known product was needle lace. Colbert set up a royal workshop in 1665 to copy Venetian lace and reduce court spending on imports; Marthe La Perrière changed the stitch and mesh ground, and point d'Alençon took its own name around 1675. Demand fell after the Revolution, but orders for Napoleon's marriage to Marie-Louise in 1810, including bed hangings and curtains, brought the lace makers fresh work.
zh:
阿朗松扼守萨尔特河渡口，位于诺曼底朝向曼恩的南部边隘，中世纪城镇在贝莱姆领主城堡下方发展。1051年，诺曼底公爵威廉平定叛乱时围攻此城；守军在城头挥舞兽皮，嘲笑他的鞣皮匠祖父，威廉于是残害三十二名战俘，阿朗松随即投降。13世纪以后，这里成为法国诸王子的封地，皮埃尔公爵修建的大塔楼俯瞰城镇。1414年，阿朗松升为公爵兼贵族院领地，让一世次年战死阿金库尔，城市在1417年向亨利五世开城。让二世1424年在韦尔讷伊被俘，囚禁三年后由重金赎回，后来与圣女贞德并肩作战。1444年，英军仍占据这座呢绒城和周围的畜牧乡野，失去领地的让二世随侍查理七世。

1449年，四名市民做内应，让二世得以收复阿朗松，四人后来都受封贵族。让二世后来参加王太子的叛乱，1458年和1472年两度受审。他的儿媳玛格丽特·德·洛林主持完成圣母院和圣莱奥纳尔教堂，并在1497年创建贫穷修女会修道院。1524年，绝嗣的查理四世去世，公国收归王室；1559年成为卡特琳·德·美第奇的寡妇封邑，1566年转封她的幼子弗朗索瓦。阿朗松最出名的物产是针绣花边。1665年，科尔贝设立皇家作坊，仿造威尼斯花边以减少宫廷的进口开支；玛尔特·拉佩里耶尔改进针法和网底，约1675年形成独有的「阿朗松花边」。大革命后花边需求大减，拿破仑1810年与玛丽·路易丝成婚时订购的床帏和帘幕，又为花边匠带来一批新活计。

en:
The Sundgau is the rolling country of southern Alsace, between the Vosges and the Jura; the gap of the Burgundian Gate between the two ranges carries the road from France to the Upper Rhine. Its lords were the counts of Ferrette, whose town Altkirch grew up round a church and a castle above the Ill. About 1106 a Cluniac monk named Morandus settled in the Saint-Christophe priory there; he was canonised within the century, became the patron saint of the Sundgau, and his head-reliquary of 1428 drew pilgrims to Altkirch. When the comital line failed in 1324, Joanna of Ferrette married Duke Albert II of Austria and brought the land to the Habsburgs, who ruled it from Ensisheim as part of Further Austria. Plague, the Basel earthquake of 1356 that shattered some twenty castles, and the passing mercenary companies, English in the 1370s and Armagnac in 1439 and 1444, left about a hundred villages deserted. In 1444 the Sundgau was a Catholic, German-speaking Habsburg district, thinly peopled after a century of marching armies.

The Six-Pfennig War of 1466 brought Swiss columns through the country to relieve Mulhouse; Duke Sigismund mortgaged Upper Alsace to Charles the Bold in 1469 and redeemed it in 1474, and the Swabian War of 1499 sent the Swiss through again. In 1492 a stony meteorite, the oldest recorded fall in Europe of which pieces are kept, dropped into a wheat field outside Ensisheim and was carried into the town. Peasants rose under Heinrich Wetzel in 1524 and submitted after defeats at Illzach and Wattweiler; the district then stayed Catholic under Austrian rule. The Thirty Years' War reached it in 1632: Swedes, imperial troops and French soldiery passed in turn, the peasant rising of 1633 ended at Blotzheim, plague thinned the survivors, and of the deanery's 75 priests only five were alive at the peace; some districts lost up to four fifths of their people.

The Peace of Westphalia gave the Sundgau to France in 1648, and Louis XIV granted the county of Ferrette to Cardinal Mazarin in 1659. Between 1654 and 1687 Catholic settlers from Lucerne and Solothurn, and Anabaptists fleeing persecution, were offered tax freedom to refill the empty villages. In the Dutch War Turenne drove the imperials out after fighting at Brunstatt and Blotzheim, and from 1680 Vauban built the Rhine fortress of Huningue and fortified Landskron castle on the border height. Altkirch's Catherine's fair was the greatest cattle market of the district by the 1500s, with the grain of this small Alsatian granary sold beside the beasts, and ironworks and cloth mills spread in from neighbouring Mulhouse in the 1700s.
zh:
松德高是阿尔萨斯南部、孚日山脉与汝拉山脉之间的起伏乡野，两山之间的勃艮第之门是法国通向上莱茵的大路。本地的领主是费雷特伯爵，其治所阿尔特基什在伊尔河畔一座教堂和城堡周围兴起。约1106年，名叫莫兰杜斯的克吕尼修士住进当地的圣克里斯托弗修道院，他在12世纪内被封圣，成为松德高的主保圣人；1428年制成的圣首圣匣吸引朝圣者前往阿尔特基什。1324年伯爵男嗣断绝，费雷特的约翰娜嫁给奥地利公爵阿尔布雷希特二世，土地归入哈布斯堡，作为前奥地利的一部分由恩西赛姆统辖。瘟疫、1356年震毁约二十座城堡的巴塞尔大地震，以及1370年代英国雇佣兵和1439、1444年阿马尼亚克雇佣兵的轮番过境，使上百座村庄荒废。1444年的松德高是讲德语、奉天主教的哈布斯堡辖区，久经兵燹，人烟稀少。

1466年六芬尼战争中，瑞士军队为救援米卢斯穿越此地；西吉斯蒙德公爵1469年把上阿尔萨斯抵押给大胆查理，1474年才赎回，1499年士瓦本战争中瑞士兵锋再度波及。1492年，一块石陨石落在恩西赛姆城外的麦田里并被抬进城中，这是欧洲有记载、且仍有残块存世的最古老陨石坠落。1524年农民在海因里希·韦策尔率领下起事，在伊尔扎克和瓦特韦勒败降，此后这一带在奥地利统治下始终坚持天主教。三十年战争1632年蔓延到此，瑞典军、帝国军和法国雇佣兵轮番过境，1633年的农民起事败于布洛蔡姆，瘟疫又夺去更多人命；松德高铎区原有的75名神父战后只剩五人，部分地区损失了多达五分之四的人口。

1648年《威斯特伐利亚和约》把松德高划归法国，1659年路易十四将费雷特伯国封给马萨林枢机。1654至1687年间，来自卢塞恩和索洛图恩的天主教移民以及受迫害的再洗礼派信徒得到免税承诺，迁入荒废的村庄。荷兰战争中，蒂雷纳在布伦施泰特和布洛蔡姆作战后将帝国军队逐出；1680年起，沃邦在莱茵河畔修建于南格要塞，又加固了边境高地上的兰兹克龙城堡。阿尔特基什的凯瑟琳集市到16世纪已是松德高最大的牛市，这块阿尔萨斯小粮仓出产的谷物与牲畜一同在市上出售；18世纪里，冶铁和呢绒织造从邻城米卢斯传播开来。

en:
St. Martin is a small island in the northern Leewards, ringed by beaches and salt ponds. The Kalinago knew it as Soualiga, 'the island of salt', and the Arawaks before them as Oualichi, 'the island of women'; Arawak villagers settled it first, and Kalinago groups displaced them around 1300–1400. In 1444 its people fished, farmed and scraped salt from the pans, untouched by Europe.

On 11 November 1493, the feast of St Martin of Tours, Columbus named the island now called Nevis after the saint while anchored offshore; confused charts later transferred the name to this island. The Dutch settled first: their West India Company built Fort Amsterdam in 1631 and began working the salt pans, but Spain, still at war with the Republic, seized the island in 1633 and held it for fifteen years; Peter Stuyvesant's attempt to retake it in 1644 was repulsed. The Spanish withdrew in 1648, and French settlers from St. Kitts and Dutch settlers from St. Eustatius divided the island on 23 March 1648 by the Treaty of Concordia. The border shifted sixteen times in the wars that followed, and French rule covered the whole island from 1795 to 1815, after which the old partition returned. Cotton, tobacco and sugar plantations meanwhile drew in enslaved Africans, who soon outnumbered the Europeans.
zh:
圣马丁是背风群岛北部一座小岛，海滩环绕，遍布盐池。卡利纳戈人称之为苏阿利加，意为「盐之岛」，更早的阿拉瓦克人则称其为瓦利奇，意为「女子之岛」；阿拉瓦克村民最先在此定居，约1300至1400年间被卡利纳戈人取代。1444年时，岛民捕鱼、务农、从盐池中刮取海盐，欧洲人尚未涉足。

1493年11月11日（图尔的圣马丁瞻礼日），哥伦布在今尼维斯岛外海停泊时以这位圣徒命名该岛；后来因海图混淆，名称转移到了圣马丁。荷兰人最先定居：荷兰西印度公司1631年修建阿姆斯特丹堡并开始开采盐池；正与荷兰共和国交战的西班牙1633年夺取该岛，据守十五年，彼得·斯泰弗森特1644年试图反攻未果。西班牙人1648年撤离后，来自圣基茨的法国移民与来自圣尤斯特歇斯的荷兰移民于1648年3月23日签订《协和条约》，瓜分全岛。此后的战争中边界先后十六次变动，1795至1815年全岛处于法国统治之下，之后又恢复旧日分治。棉花、烟草和甘蔗种植园在此期间引入大批非洲奴隶，奴隶人数很快超过欧洲人。

en:
Annaba, the later Bône, began as Hippo Regius, the seaport of Numidia beside the Seybouse river beneath the wooded Edough massif. Augustine was its bishop from 396 and died there in 430 while the Vandals besieged the city. The low-lying ancient site was abandoned in the eleventh century for a defensible height nearby, where the Sanhaja Berbers walled a new town called Bouna. It was raided by a Pisan fleet in 1034, taken by the Normans of Sicily in 1153 and by the Almohads in 1160, and passed to the Hafsids in 1250; a Castilian occupation in 1360 was only an interlude. In 1444 Bona is a fortified port answering to Tunis, shipping the timber of the Edough and the grain of the Seybouse plain to Italy and receiving Andalusian refugees from Granada.

Ottoman corsairs made themselves masters of the town in 1533. In 1535 a Spanish squadron sent by Charles V seized its citadel, but the Turkish blockade and a hostile countryside wore the garrison down until Charles ordered it evacuated in 1540. The Turks then rebuilt the walls, added Fort Cigogne and attached Bona to the Regency of Algiers and its Beylik of Constantine. For two and a half centuries its roadstead served the corsairs, whose galleys were built from Edough timber, while merchants loaded grain, wool and hides. In the eighteenth century the town shared the beylik's prosperity: the Sidi Brahim mosque was founded in 1768, and Salah Bey of Constantine built his two-minaret mosque in 1791, its halls serving both the Maliki and Hanafi rites.
zh:
安纳巴后来欧洲人称之为博讷，最初是塞布斯河畔、林木葱郁的埃杜格山下的努米底亚海港希波勒吉乌斯。奥古斯丁396年起在此任主教，430年汪达尔人围城时死于城中。11世纪，低平的古城被放弃，人们在附近一处易守难攻的高地上筑起新城布纳，由桑哈贾柏柏尔人筑墙据守。1034年比萨舰队劫掠此城，1153年西西里诺曼人将它攻占，1160年落入阿尔摩哈德王朝之手，1250年转归哈夫斯王朝；1360年卡斯蒂利亚曾短暂占据。1444年的布纳是听命于突尼斯的设防港口，把埃杜格山的木材和塞布斯平原的谷物运往意大利，并接纳来自格拉纳达的安达卢西亚难民。

1533年，奥斯曼海盗成为此城之主。1535年，查理五世派出的西班牙舰队夺取了城堡，但土耳其人的海上封锁和充满敌意的内陆使守军日益难支，查理终于1540年下令撤离。土耳其人随后重修城墙、增建锡戈涅堡，把布纳纳入阿尔及尔摄政国及其君士坦丁贝伊领。此后两个半世纪里，这里的锚地为海盗所用，他们的桨帆船用埃杜格山的木材建造，商人则在此装运谷物、羊毛和皮革。18世纪，该城分享了贝伊领的繁荣：西迪·易卜拉欣清真寺建于1768年，君士坦丁的萨拉赫贝伊1791年又建起双宣礼塔清真寺，殿内同时为马立克和哈乃斐两个教法学派服务。

en:
Mpangu and its chief town Sundi lay in the Inkisi River valley, in the broken country between the manikongo's Mbanza Kongo and the Malebo Pool. Mpangu had once been a kingdom of Kongo dia Nlaza, the old Seven Kingdoms of the middle Congo, until Kongo's conquests up the Inkisi in the fifteenth century made it a royal province, whose governor the mwene Mpangu ranked among the crown's highest officers. Its people farmed the valley sides, worked copper and wove the raffia cloth that served as currency all down the river. In 1444 that cloth trade and the road to the Pool made Mpangu a wealthy northern march looking onto the lands of the Tio.

The future Afonso I ruled at Sundi before he took the throne, and in 1521 Henrique, the Kongo-born bishop, came home to govern Mpangu. Under Álvaro II, Sundi was restyled a duchy on the European pattern, and its duke Manuel Jordão made and unmade kings until Ambrósio I removed him from office in 1628. Early in that century the lands of the old Seven Kingdoms wove as much as 100,000 metres of raffia cloth a year for the Luanda market alone. Catastrophe came at Mbwila in 1665, where António I fell to the Portuguese: Kongo split into warring houses, and Sundi's dukes of the Kimpanzu line ruled the Inkisi valley as all but independent lords until royal authority began to reknit in the early eighteenth century.
zh:
姆潘古及其重镇松迪（史称恩松迪）地处因基西河谷，是夹在马尼刚果的姆班扎刚果与马莱博湖之间的丘陵地带。姆潘古本是刚果河中游古国「刚果·迪亚·恩拉扎」七王国之一，15世纪刚果沿因基西河扩张，将它并为王室行省，其长官姆韦内·姆潘古位列王廷最高级的总督之一。当地人耕作坡地、炼铜，并编织沿河全境当作货币使用的拉菲草布。1444年，凭借布匹贸易和通往马莱博湖的大道，姆潘古成为富庶的北疆，与特约人的土地相望。

后来的阿方索一世在登基前曾镇守松迪；1521年，刚果出生的主教恩里克归国，出任姆潘古总督。阿尔瓦罗二世时代，松迪按欧洲建制改称公国，公爵曼努埃尔·若尔当一度能废立国王，直至1628年被安布罗西奥一世免职。17世纪初，旧七王国故地仅销往罗安达的拉菲草布每年就多达十万米。1665年大难临头：安东尼奥一世殒命姆布维拉战场，刚果裂为诸家混战，金潘祖一系的松迪公爵作为近乎独立的诸侯统治因基西河谷，直到18世纪初王权才重新收拢。

en:
The Tana is the longest river in Kenya. It rises in the cold highlands of Mount Kenya and the Aberdares, swings far north through the dry Nyika plains, then turns east through a wide delta to enter the Indian Ocean at Ungwana Bay by Kipini. By 1444 its lower banks were held by the Pokomo, Bantu farmers and fishermen who planted the riverine flats after the two yearly floods and were split into upper-river and delta clans; their tongue, descended from old Kingozi, lies close to Swahili. Their kinsmen had traded and intermarried with the Arabs of Lamu as early as the twelfth and thirteenth centuries, and Pokomo teachers sat in the mosques of Pate. Near the river mouth stood the Swahili stone town of Ungwana, whose Friday mosque, first built in the fourteenth century, was rebuilt around 1400 to 1450 with rows of columns and a seven-step coral minbar. Beyond that narrow green belt of riverine forest stretched dry plains roamed by herdsmen and hunters.

The Portuguese reached this coast in 1506, when the fleet of Tristão da Cunha forced Lamu to pay tribute, and in the 1580s the archipelago towns rose against them with Turkish prompting; an Omani fleet came to Lamu's aid in 1652. Ungwana was in time abandoned to the bush, but the Pokomo stayed in their river villages along the whole lower Tana. Oromo-speaking Warra Daya herdsmen, first named in a fifteenth-century Arabic source, moved into the Juba lands in the sixteenth century, and their pressure crept closer in the centuries that followed, although they did not cross the Tana in force until after 1821. Under the loose Omani protectorate of the late seventeenth and eighteenth centuries Lamu knew its golden age, until in 1812 a Pate-Mazrui army was cut down on the beach at Shela and Lamu called in an Omani garrison.
zh:
塔纳河是肯尼亚最长的河流，发源于肯尼亚山与阿伯德尔山脉的寒冷高地，先向北远远穿过干旱的恩伊卡平原，再折而向东，经宽阔的三角洲从基皮尼附近的翁瓜纳湾注入印度洋。到1444年，下游两岸的主人是波科莫人：这些班图农民和渔人趁一年两度的汛期在河畔平地耕作，分作上游与三角洲两支氏族；他们的语言由古老的金戈齐语演变而来，与斯瓦希里语相近。早在12至13世纪，波科莫人的先民便与拉穆的阿拉伯人通商联姻，波科莫出身的经师还曾在帕泰的清真寺讲学。河口附近立着斯瓦希里石城翁瓜纳，城中的聚礼清真寺初建于14世纪，1400至1450年间又以成排石柱和七级珊瑚石敏拜尔重建。河林这条狭窄绿带之外，是牧人和猎手出没的干旱平原。

1506年葡萄牙人来到这片海岸，特里斯唐·达·库尼亚的舰队迫使拉穆纳贡；1580年代，群岛诸城在土耳其人鼓动下起而反叛，1652年阿曼舰队前来援助拉穆。翁瓜纳后来被弃于荒野，波科莫人却始终守着塔纳河下游一长串河畔村落。讲奥罗莫语的瓦拉达亚牧人最早见于15世纪的阿拉伯文献，16世纪迁入朱巴河地区，此后几个世纪里他们的压力步步逼近，但在1821年以前尚未大举渡过塔纳河。在17世纪末至18世纪松散的阿曼保护下，拉穆步入黄金时代；1812年，帕泰—马兹鲁伊联军在谢拉海滩被歼，拉穆随后请来阿曼驻军。

en:
Åland is the Swedish-speaking archipelago between Roslagen and Finland Proper, about 6,500 granite islands and skerries strung across the sea lane from Stockholm to Åbo. Its farmers fished, hunted seal and carried coastal traffic; the islands were Christianised in the eleventh century and their first stone churches rose in the 1200s. Kastelholm Castle, on the main island, was begun in the 1380s and first named in a charter of Queen Margaret in 1388; it served both as a fortress and as the seat of a royal fief, and it was besieged in 1433 during the Engelbrekt rebellion. In 1444 Åland was a Catholic Swedish land of fishermen and seafarers, governed from Kastelholm, and its harbours were the relay points for every ship and messenger passing between Sweden and Finland.

Danish fleets burned Kastelholm in 1507 and held the islands from 1510 until Gustav Vasa recovered them in 1521; he kept the surrounding forests as a royal hunting ground, and a yard there employed about fifty shipwrights. The arms granted to Åland in 1560 bear a golden deer, a charge drawn up for Öland and attached to these islands by a heraldic mistake. Eric XIV was briefly held prisoner in the castle in 1571. It was battered in the 1599 war against Sigismund and repaired by 1631, and the Kastelholm witch trials were heard there in 1665 and 1668. From 1638 the crown's new Stockholm to Åbo post route ran through the islands: Åland farmers crewed the open mail boats that relayed the post from island to island, work that turned deadly in winter storms and drifting ice. Russian troops occupied Åland for most of the Great Northern War, from 1714 to the Peace of Nystad in 1721, and again in 1742 and 1743, until the Peace of Åbo ended that occupation. Fire gutted the decaying castle in 1745, and in 1809 the Treaty of Fredrikshamn handed Åland to Russia with the rest of Finland.
zh:
奥兰是罗斯拉根与芬兰本部之间讲瑞典语的群岛，约六千五百座花岗岩岛屿和岩礁散布在斯德哥尔摩通往奥布的海路上。岛上居民打鱼、捕海豹，兼营近海航运；群岛11世纪基督教化，13世纪建起最早的石砌教堂。主岛上的卡斯特霍姆城堡兴建于1380年代，1388年玛格丽特女王的一份特许状首次提到它；城堡既是要塞，也是王室封地的治所，1433年恩厄尔布雷克特起义期间曾遭围攻。1444年，奥兰是瑞典的天主教渔民和海民之地，由卡斯特霍姆管辖，往来瑞典与芬兰的船只和信使都要在岛上港湾中转。

丹麦舰队1507年焚毁卡斯特霍姆，并从1510年起占据群岛，直到1521年古斯塔夫·瓦萨将其收复；他把城堡周围的森林留作王室猎苑，当地船厂雇有约五十名船匠。1560年颁给奥兰的纹章画着一只金鹿，这个图案本是为厄兰设计的，因纹章差错配给了奥兰。1571年，埃里克十四世曾被短暂囚禁在城堡中。城堡在1599年对抗齐格蒙特的战争中受创，1631年修复，1665年和1668年又在此审理卡斯特霍姆猎巫案。从1638年起，王室新设的斯德哥尔摩至奥布邮路穿过群岛：奥兰农民驾驶无篷邮船，在岛屿间接力运送邮件，冬季风暴和流冰使这份行当常有性命之虞。大北方战争期间，俄军从1714年起占领奥兰，直到1721年《尼斯塔德和约》签订；1742年至1743年群岛再度被占，以《奥布和约》收场。1745年大火烧毁日渐荒废的城堡，1809年《弗雷德里克港和约》把奥兰连同芬兰其余部分割给俄罗斯。

en:
East Frisia is the North Sea coast around the mouth of the Ems, east of the Lauwers: a strip of terps, drained marsh, heath moor and offshore islands, with the wide Dollart inlet biting into the shore. Its villagers elected their own judges and claimed Frisian freedom, but floods, plague and clan feuds let chieftain families make themselves masters of the seaports and the Ems approaches. Focko Ukena overthrew the tom Brok dynasty and was himself driven out in 1433 by a league led by the Cirksenas of Greetsiel. In 1444 Ulrich Cirksena was the strongest of the northern chieftains, while Emden, an old Frisian trading place on the Dollart, still lacked imperial town privileges. The Catholic, Frisian-speaking country lived from dike farms, fishing, salt-marsh grazing and Ems shipping, a web of chiefdoms with no count over them.

Frederick III enfeoffed Ulrich as imperial count in 1464, and Maximilian I later granted Emden its town privileges and the 'little angel on the wall' coat of arms. Edzard I's wars over Groningen brought the Saxon Feud of 1514–1517, an imperial ban and an invasion, but the Cirksenas held on. The Reformation took early root in Emden: Johannes a Lasco preached there in the 1540s and Menno Simons found shelter. When the Dutch Revolt closed the Flemish and Brabantine ports, thousands of Protestant refugees made Emden the busiest transshipment harbour of the North Sea, and the Synod of Emden in 1571 founded the Dutch Reformed Church. The burghers rose against Count Edzard II in 1595, and the Treaty of Delfzijl made Emden a self-governing city under Dutch protection, its offices run in the Brabant dialect; the political writer Johannes Althusius, author of a systematic theory of federal government, served it as syndic for over thirty years. When the last Cirksena count died heirless in 1744, Prussia occupied the county, and in 1752 Frederick the Great chartered an Emden company to trade with Canton. French troops seized the port in 1757 and an Anglo-German force recovered it the next year. After the Kingdom of Holland and French annexation, East Frisia passed to Hanover in 1815.
zh:
东弗里斯兰是埃姆斯河口、劳沃斯河以东的北海海岸，一条由人工丘、排干的沼泽、荒原和近海岛屿组成的地带，宽阔的多拉德湾深深咬入岸线。村民自选法官、奉行「弗里斯兰自由」，但洪灾、瘟疫和宗族仇杀让首领家族控制了海港与埃姆斯河通道。福科·乌克纳推翻汤姆·布罗克王朝，自己又在1433年被格雷茨尔的西克瑟纳家族牵头的同盟赶走。1444年，乌尔里希·西克瑟纳是北方最有实力的首领，而多拉德湾畔古老的弗里斯兰商埠埃姆登还没有取得帝国城市特权。这片操弗里斯兰语的天主教土地以围堤农庄、渔业、盐沼放牧和埃姆斯河航运为生，是一张首领领地的网络，头上没有伯爵。

1464年，腓特烈三世封乌尔里希为帝国伯爵；马克西米利安一世后来授予埃姆登城市特权和「墙上小天使」城徽。埃查德一世争夺格罗宁根，引发1514至1517年的萨克森纷争，招来帝国放逐令和外敌入侵，但西克瑟纳家族撑了过来。宗教改革很早就扎根埃姆登：约翰内斯·阿·拉斯科1540年代在此传道，门诺·西蒙斯也曾避难。荷兰起义使佛兰德和布拉班特诸港封闭后，数千名新教难民把埃姆登变成北海最繁忙的中转港，1571年的埃姆登宗教会议也在这里创立了荷兰归正会。1595年，市民起兵反抗埃查德二世伯爵，《代尔夫宰尔条约》使埃姆登成为荷兰保护下的自治城市，官署里甚至通行布拉班特方言；系统提出过联邦政体理论的政论家约翰内斯·阿尔特胡修斯在此担任法务官三十余年。末代西克瑟纳伯爵1744年无嗣而终，普鲁士随即占领伯国；1752年，腓特烈大帝特许成立一家以埃姆登为基地、与广州通商的公司。1757年法军夺取港口，次年英德联军将其收复。经过荷兰王国和法国的吞并之后，东弗里斯兰于1815年转属汉诺威。

en:
Bari is Apulia's leading Adriatic port, set on a low promontory where the ancient harbour of Barium met the Via Traiana. An Arab emirate ruled it from 847 to 871, and after two more centuries of Byzantine rule the Normans took it in 1071. Sixteen years later sailors from Bari carried the relics of Saint Nicholas from Myra in Asia Minor to a new basilica above the harbour, whose crypt Pope Urban II consecrated in 1089; the same pope held a council of 185 bishops here in 1098, while the First Crusade was being fought, and crusaders and pilgrims made the shrine one of the busiest in the Mediterranean. William I of Sicily destroyed the city in 1156, and Frederick II rebuilt its castle. Bari took the Aragonese side in the long Angevin war, and when Alfonso V of Aragon secured Naples in 1442 it became a Catholic, Neapolitan royal port, shipping the wine and olive oil of its hinterland across the Adriatic.

In 1464 Ferdinand I made the city the centre of a new Duchy of Bari for Sforza Maria Sforza; the Sforzas enlarged the harbour and drew merchants to the town, though Charles VIII's French army occupied it during the 1494-1495 invasion. Isabella of Aragon, widow of the duke of Milan, settled here in 1501 and reshaped the Norman-Swabian castle for artillery, bringing Lombard merchants and officials in her household. Her daughter Bona, widow of Sigismund I of Poland, returned in 1556 to take possession of the duchy; she died in the castle in November 1557, suspected of having been poisoned by trusted members of her household, and was buried in the Basilica of Saint Nicholas, after which Bari passed to the Spanish crown. The composer Niccolo Piccinni, born here in 1728, was among the most popular masters of Neapolitan opera buffa. In 1813 Joachim Murat laid out the grid-plan Borgo Nuovo beyond the old walls.
zh:
巴里是普利亚在亚得里亚海上的首要港口，坐落在低矮的海角上，古罗马港口巴吕姆当年就在这里与图拉真大道相接。847年至871年，一个阿拉伯埃米尔国以这里为中心；又经过近两百年拜占庭统治，诺曼人在1071年攻占此城。十六年后，巴里水手把圣尼古拉的遗骨从小亚细亚的米拉迎回，在港口上方新建宗座圣殿安放，教皇乌尔班二世于1089年祝圣它的地窟；第一次十字军期间的1098年，同一位教皇又在巴里召开有185名主教参加的公会议，十字军战士和朝圣者使这座圣龛成为地中海最热闹的朝圣地之一。西西里国王威廉一世1156年摧毁巴里，腓特烈二世后来重建城堡。漫长的安茹战争中巴里站在阿拉贡一边，1442年阿方索五世拿下那不勒斯后，它成为天主教那不勒斯的王家港口，把内地出产的葡萄酒和橄榄油运往亚得里亚海对岸。

1464年，费迪南一世以巴里为中心新设巴里公国，封给斯福尔扎·玛丽亚·斯福尔扎；斯福尔扎家族扩建港口、招徕商人，不过查理八世的法军仍在1494年至1495年入侵时占领过此城。米兰公爵遗孀阿拉贡的伊莎贝拉1501年定居巴里，把诺曼-施瓦本城堡改造成可架设火炮的要塞，随行带来伦巴第商人和官员。她的女儿、波兰国王齐格蒙特一世的遗孀博娜1556年回到巴里接管公国，1557年11月在城堡中去世，疑似被亲信下毒，葬于圣尼古拉宗座圣殿，巴里随后并入西班牙王室。1728年出生于此的作曲家尼科洛·皮钦尼，是那不勒斯喜歌剧最受欢迎的大师之一。1813年，若阿尚·缪拉在旧城外规划了棋盘式的新堡区。

en:
Lucania, more often called Basilicata by the fifteenth century, is a belt of Lucanian Apennine ridges between the Gulf of Taranto and the Tyrrhenian coast. Potenza, its chief town, perches above the Basento and looks over mule roads linking Naples, Apulia and the Calabrian passes. The northern stronghold of Melfi mattered to dynasties: the Hautevilles built their conquest of southern Italy from there, and in 1231 Frederick II promulgated the Constitutions of Melfi, laws that used paid officials and taxation to restrain local barons. Angevin rule later let many of those barons recover power in the interior. When Alfonso V of Aragon won Naples, Innico de Guevara became count of Potenza, and his government effectively took root in 1444. That year the county was Catholic and Neapolitan, its wealth lying chiefly in pastures, livestock, hill towns and mule trains.

The mountains kept feudal power alive long after the crown's laws were issued. Greek and Albanian refugees settled around Vulture and Matera as Ottoman forces advanced in the later fifteenth century, and in 1485 barons plotting against Ferdinand I gathered at Miglionico. On 1 April 1502 Louis d'Armagnac and Gonzalo Fernández de Córdoba met at Rionero to divide the Kingdom of Naples, but the bargain collapsed and Spanish government followed. Matera's inhabitants turned on the harsh tax-farmer Giovan Carlo Tramontano and killed him on Christmas night 1514; fourteen years later imperial landsknechts sacked Melfi during the fighting remembered as the 'Bloody Easter'. Masaniello's revolt reached Basilicata in 1647 and drove the Prince of Celano from Potenza. French rule after 1806 made Potenza capital of the province of Basilicata and abolished feudal courts, though armed royalist bands held out in the mountains.
zh:
卢卡尼亚在15世纪更多被称作巴西利卡塔，是塔兰托湾与第勒尼安海岸之间一道卢卡尼亚亚平宁山脊。首府波坦察高踞巴森托河上方，俯瞰连接那不勒斯、普利亚和卡拉布里亚山口的骡道。北方重镇梅尔菲决定过多个王朝的命运：欧特维尔家族从这里出发征服南意大利；1231年，腓特烈二世又在此颁布《梅尔菲宪法》，以领取薪俸的官吏和税制约束地方男爵。安茹王朝统治时，许多男爵重新掌握内陆权力。阿拉贡的阿方索五世取得那不勒斯后，伊尼科·德·格瓦拉成为波坦察伯爵，其政权到1444年才真正扎根。这一年，波坦察是天主教那不勒斯王国的伯国，财富主要在牧场、牲畜、山城和骡队身上。

王室法律颁布之后，山区仍长期保留着封建势力。15世纪后期奥斯曼军队推进，希腊和阿尔巴尼亚难民到武尔图雷与马泰拉一带定居；1485年，密谋反对费尔南多一世的男爵们在米廖尼科集会。1502年4月1日，路易·德·阿马尼亚克和贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德·科尔多瓦在廖内罗会谈，准备瓜分那不勒斯王国，协议破裂后，西班牙政府接管此地。1514年圣诞夜，马泰拉居民袭击严苛的包税人乔万·卡洛·特拉蒙塔诺并将他杀死；十四年后，帝国雇佣军在史称「血腥复活节」的战事中洗劫梅尔菲。1647年，马萨涅洛起义蔓延到巴西利卡塔，把切拉诺亲王赶出波坦察。1806年后的法国统治把波坦察定为巴西利卡塔省首府并废除封建法庭，但保王派武装仍在山区坚持抵抗。

en:
Mitau, called Jelgava in Latvian, lies on the flat Semigallian plain where the Driksa runs into the Lielupe, the waterway that carried the region's grain and timber down to the sea. Liv fishermen had settled the river island of Pilssala by the tenth century, and in 1265–66 Master Konrad von Mandern raised a stone castle there as the Order's southern bulwark. The knights used it to subdue the surrounding Semigallians by 1290, and Lithuanian raiders stormed and plundered it in 1345. In 1444 Mitau was the Order's chief fortress in Semigallia, guarding the road from Riga into Lithuania while rafts paid toll below its walls.

When the Order collapsed in 1561, Gotthard Kettler made the castle the seat of his new Duchy of Courland, a Polish fief; Mitau was granted town rights in 1573 and became the duchy's capital in 1578. Swedish and Polish armies took and retook it in the 1620s and 1650s; Charles XII occupied it in 1701, the Russians took it in 1705 despite Lewenhaupt's victory at nearby Gemauerthof, and plague followed. Anna, widow of Duke Friedrich Wilhelm and niece of Peter the Great, ruled in Mitau from 1711 until she left for the Russian throne in 1730. Her favourite Ernst Johann von Biron was elected duke in 1737 and brought in Bartolomeo Rastrelli to raise a vast Baroque palace on the island. Building began in 1738, stopped at Biron's fall two years later with much of the dressed stone carted to St Petersburg, and was finished only in 1772 after his return from exile.

Biron opened Mitau's first public library, and the last duke, Peter von Biron, founded the Academia Petrina in 1775 and hosted the adventurer Cagliostro at the palace in 1779. Russia annexed Courland in the Third Partition of 1795 and made Mitau the seat of the Courland Governorate. From 1798 the exiled Louis XVIII kept a French court there, with the Versailles lever and coucher observed. His niece Marie-Thérèse married the duc d'Angoulême there in 1799, and the king came back incognito for a second stay in 1804–07. A French-sponsored ducal government sat briefly at Mitau in 1812.
zh:
米陶今称叶尔加瓦，位于瑟米加利亚平坦的平原上，德里克萨河在此汇入利耶卢佩河，这条水路把当地的谷物和木材运往大海。利夫渔民早在10世纪已在皮尔斯萨拉河洲上定居。1265至1266年，骑士团首领康拉德·冯·曼德恩在洲上筑起石堡，作为骑士团的南方屏障，凭它到1290年征服了周围的瑟米加利亚人；1345年立陶宛突袭者攻破并洗劫了这座城堡。1444年，米陶是骑士团在瑟米加利亚的首要要塞，扼守从里加通往立陶宛的大路，城墙下的木排还要逐一纳税。

1561年骑士团崩溃，戈特哈德·克特勒把城堡定为新建库尔兰公国的驻地，公国是波兰的封国；米陶1573年获得城市权，1578年成为公国首都。1620和1650年代，瑞典与波兰的军队几度攻占又几度弃守此城；1701年卡尔十二占领米陶，1705年莱文豪普特虽在城外的格毛埃特霍夫击败一支俄军，城市仍于是年落入俄国之手，瘟疫也随大军席卷乡间。俄国的下一任女皇就出自这座宫廷：安娜是弗里德里希·威廉公爵的遗孀、彼得大帝的侄女，自1711年起在米陶统治公国，1730年动身前往圣彼得堡登基。她的宠臣恩斯特·约翰·冯·比隆1737年被选为公爵，延请巴尔托洛梅奥·拉斯特雷利在河洲上兴建宏大的巴洛克宫殿。工程1738年开工，比隆两年后失势便告停工，大量琢石被运往拉斯特雷利在圣彼得堡的工地，直到他流放归来，宫殿才于1772年落成。

比隆开设了米陶第一座公共图书馆；末代公爵彼得·冯·比隆1775年创办彼得学院，1779年还在宫中接待过冒险家卡廖斯特罗。1795年第三次瓜分波兰，俄国吞并库尔兰，把米陶定为库尔兰省省会。1798年起，流亡的路易十八在宫中维持法式朝廷，连凡尔赛起床、就寝的朝仪都一一照旧。他的侄女玛丽-泰蕾兹1799年在此与昂古莱姆公爵成婚，1804至1807年他又匿名回来寄居过一段。1812年，一个法国扶植的公国政府曾在米陶短暂开会。

en:
Kovno, Lithuanian Kaunas, commands the confluence of the Neman and the Neris, where river traffic from the Lithuanian interior met the road to Prussia. The grand dukes built a brick castle there in the mid-fourteenth century to bar the Teutonic Order from the upper Neman; only Grodno had another brick castle on the river. The town first appears as Kawen in the Order's chronicles in 1361, and in 1362 the Knights took the castle after a siege of several weeks. About 400 defenders were killed, the commander Vaidotas was captured trying to break out with 36 men, and Kęstutis and Algirdas reached the field in time only to watch it fall. River fighting went on until Lithuania secured Kovno in 1404. Vytautas rebuilt the castle and completed the Church of the Assumption there in 1400, a vow he had made after nearly drowning at the Vorskla in 1399. In 1408 the town received Magdeburg rights, with privileges over the public scales and the wax and wool trades, and in 1413 it became the seat of Kaunas county. In 1441 a Hanseatic kontor opened there, the only one in the Grand Duchy. In 1444 Kovno was a river port of German merchants, timber wharves and customs dues, with the elder of Kovno holding the castle.

By the sixteenth century Kovno had a public school and hospital. Bona Sforza made the eldership a royal domain and launched the Volok land reform there in 1533. Brick merchants' houses went up and a town wall was begun, but wars and hard times left it unfinished. Plague struck in 1657 and Russian armies stormed the town in 1665; the Swedes occupied it from 1701 to the Altranstädt peace of 1706, plague returned in 1708 and fires hit in 1731 and 1732, while the old castle crumbled into the river and became a jail. The rebel Samogitian Division withdrew through the county during the Kościuszko rising of 1794, and the Third Partition of 1795 gave Kovno to Russia. In June 1812 Napoleon bridged the Neman above the town and led the Grande Armée into Russia, watching the crossing from a mound that keeps the name Napoleon's Hill; the army came back through the town in its winter retreat and left Kovno devastated.
zh:
科夫诺（立陶宛语称考纳斯）扼守涅曼河与内里斯河的汇流处，立陶宛内地的河运在这里接上通往普鲁士的大道。14世纪中叶，大公们在此建起砖石城堡，阻挡条顿骑士团溯涅曼河深入；当时整条河上，这样的砖石城堡只有格罗德诺还有一座。1361年，城镇首次以「卡文」之名出现在骑士团编年史中。次年，骑士团围攻数周后破城：约四百名守军战死，守将瓦伊多达斯率三十六人突围时被俘，科斯图提斯和阿尔吉尔达斯赶到战场，只来得及看着城堡陷落。沿河的争夺持续到1404年，立陶宛才稳固据有科夫诺。维陶塔斯重建城堡，又在1400年建成圣母升天教堂，还的是1399年沃尔斯克拉河之战中险些溺死的愿。1408年城镇获颁马格德堡法，取得公用秤及蜡、毛贸易特权，1413年成为科夫诺县治。1441年，汉萨同盟在此开设商站，这是立陶宛大公国境内唯一的汉萨商站。1444年的科夫诺是一座河港，德意志商人、木材码头和关税支撑着它，城堡则是科夫诺长老的居所。

到16世纪，城里已有公立学校和医院。博娜·斯福尔扎把科夫诺长老区收为王室领地，1533年从这里推行沃洛克土地改革。商人的砖房建起，城墙也动工了，却因后来的战乱和凋敝半途而废。1657年瘟疫来袭，1665年俄军几度攻城；瑞典人1701年占领科夫诺，直到1706年《阿尔特兰施泰特条约》才撤军，1708年瘟疫再至，1731和1732年连遭大火，旧城堡崩塌入河，后来改成监狱。1794年柯斯丘什科起义中，萨莫吉希亚师撤退时经过本县；1795年第三次瓜分后，科夫诺并入俄国。1812年6月，拿破仑在城上游架桥渡过涅曼河，率大军攻入俄国，他在城外一座土丘上观战渡河，那土丘后来名为拿破仑丘；当年冬天大军撤退时再经此城，科夫诺成了一片废墟。

en:
Grodno guards a Neman crossing in Black Ruthenia, on the old border with the Yotvingian lands; its name comes from the Ruthenian horod, a fortress. It appears as Goroden in the Kievan Chronicle of 1128. Across the river rises the Kalozha Church of Saints Boris and Gleb, built before 1183 with blue, green and red faceted stones in its walls, the only Black Ruthenian church to survive. Teutonic armies raided Grodno repeatedly from 1283. Vytautas held the town as his appanage from 1376 to 1392 and planned the Grunwald campaign from it; after the Knights burned the castle in 1393 he ordered a brick Gothic one built in 1398. The grand dukes allowed a Jewish commune in 1389, among the first in Lithuania. In 1444 Casimir IV confirmed its rights, granted the stag of Saint Hubert as its coat of arms and licensed three yearly fairs; an Orthodox and a Catholic burgomaster took turns leading the council. Grodno was then a mixed Ruthenian market town on the roads to Masovia and Vilnius.

Monarchs kept returning to the castle. Casimir IV died there in 1492. Stephen Báthory made the castle his residence and wartime headquarters; for much of the 1580s Grodno served as the de facto capital of the Commonwealth. He rebuilt the Old Castle in Renaissance taste and died there on 12 December 1586. The Great Synagogue went up in 1578 under Rabbi Mordechai Yaffe, after expulsion in 1495 and readmission in 1503. Ivan Khovansky's Russians sacked Grodno in 1655, and it was retaken in 1659. From 1678 every third Sejm met in the castle, rebuilt by Krzysztof Pac for the senate and the chamber of envoys; Grodno was called the Commonwealth's third capital. Charles XII's Swedes wrecked the town in 1708. Between 1765 and 1780 Antoni Tyzenhauz opened eighteen workshops, added a royal medical school and botanical garden in 1775, and began printing Gazeta Grodzieńska in 1776. The last Sejm of the Commonwealth met there in 1793 and accepted the Second Partition under Russian guns. After the rising collapsed Kościuszko reached it that year, and Stanisław August Poniatowski signed his abdication in the castle on 25 November 1795.
zh:
格罗德诺扼守黑罗斯境内的涅曼河渡口，古时与约特温人之地接壤，城名来自鲁塞尼亚语的「霍罗德」，意为要塞。它在1128年的《基辅编年史》中以「戈罗坚」之名出现。河畔矗立着圣鲍里斯与格列布·卡洛扎教堂，建于1183年以前，墙面嵌着蓝、绿、红三色多面刻石，是唯一留存下来的黑罗斯风格教堂。条顿军队从1283年起屡次来犯。维陶塔斯1376至1392年领有这座城市作为封邑，并在这里筹划格伦瓦德战役；骑士团1393年烧毁城堡后，他在1398年下令修建砖砌哥特式新城堡。1389年，大公们允许犹太人在此建立公社，这是立陶宛最早的犹太社区之一。1444年，卡齐米日四世确认城市权利，把圣胡伯特牡鹿定为城徽，批准每年三次集市，市议会由东正教和天主教市长轮流主持。此时的格罗德诺是一座鲁塞尼亚人混居的商业城市，道路通往马佐夫舍和维尔纽斯。

君主们不断回到这座城堡。1492年卡齐米日四世在此去世；斯特凡·巴托里把城堡当作王宫和作战大本营，1580年代的大部分时间里，格罗德诺实际上承担联邦都城的职能。他把旧城堡按文艺复兴风格重建，并于1586年12月12日死在这里。犹太社区的大会堂1578年在拉比莫迪凯·约斐主持下建成，而这个社区刚经历过1495年被逐、1503年获准返回。1655年伊万·霍万斯基的俄军洗劫格罗德诺，城市1659年收复。自1678年起，联邦每三次议会中就有一次在城堡召开；克日什托夫·帕茨把城堡重建成元老院和使节厅的会场，人们把格罗德诺称作联邦的「第三首都」。1708年卡尔十二世的瑞典军队重创此城。1765至1780年，安东尼·蒂森豪斯开办十八家工场和工厂，1775年增设王家医学院和植物园，1776年起印行《格罗德诺报》。联邦最后一届议会1793年在格罗德诺召开，在俄军炮口下接受第二次瓜分。起义失败后，柯斯丘什科于同年抵达格罗德诺；1795年11月25日，斯坦尼斯瓦夫·奥古斯特·波尼亚托夫斯基在城堡签署退位书。

en:
Wizna guards a crossing of the Narew on the eastern edge of Mazovia. A gord stood there from the eleventh century, watching the river road towards Grodno against Yotvingian and Galindian raiders; a customs chamber is recorded from the mid-eleventh century and a castellany from 1170. The gord changed hands in the border wars more than once. Lithuanians held it from 1286, the Teutonic Knights stormed and burned it in 1294, and Duke Bolesław II rebuilt it two years later. In 1382 Siemowit IV pledged Wizna to the Knights for 7,000 florins, and the Order held it until he bought it back in 1401. In 1435, when the land passed to Władysław I of Płock, a new town laid out north of the old gord received Chełmno rights. In 1444 Wizna was a frontier castle of the Masovian Piasts on the Lithuania–Kraków road, with timber and forest goods floated down the Narew.

After the Wizna Land was incorporated into the Crown in 1495, the town hosted the diets of its county, and Queens Bona and Anna Jagiellon stopped there on their travels. The late-Gothic church of St John, founded by Duchess Anna of Mazovia, was finished in 1525, and when Sigismund Augustus died at Knyszyn in 1572 his coffin rested in that church on the road to Kraków. The castle burned in 1603, and nearby Łomża steadily drew trade away; Augustus the Strong granted extra fairs in 1710. Wizna passed to Prussia in the Third Partition of 1795, to the Duchy of Warsaw in 1807 and to Russia in 1815.
zh:
维兹纳扼守纳雷夫河的一处渡口，位于马佐夫舍的东部边陲。11世纪起这里就有堡垒，监视通往格罗德诺的河道，抵御约特文吉人和加林迪亚人的袭扰；11世纪中叶已有海关的记载，1170年起设有城主辖区。这座堡垒在边境战争中几度易手：1286年起被立陶宛人占据，1294年条顿骑士团攻陷并将它焚毁，波列斯瓦夫二世公爵两年后亲自重建。1382年，谢莫维特四世以7000弗罗林把维兹纳典给骑士团，直到1401年才赎回。1435年这片土地转入普沃茨克公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫一世之手，旧堡以北新建的城镇获得海乌姆诺法，按棋盘格式铺成街市。1444年的维兹纳是马佐夫舍皮雅斯特王公的边塞城堡，地处立陶宛通往克拉科夫的大道，木材和林产沿纳雷夫河顺流而下。

1495年维兹纳地区并入波兰王国后，城镇是县议会的召开地，博娜王后和安娜·雅盖隆卡路过时都曾在此停留。马佐夫舍的安娜公爵夫人捐资修建的晚期哥特式圣约翰教堂1525年完工；1572年齐格蒙特·奥古斯特在克内申去世，灵柩运往克拉科夫途中就停放在这座教堂。城堡1603年毁于火灾，商路也渐渐被附近的沃姆扎拉走，1710年强者奥古斯特特许增设集市。1795年第三次瓜分后维兹纳归属普鲁士，1807年并入华沙公国，1815年转归俄国。
