Naxi ritual specialists, the dongba, wrote their sacred books in a pictographic script of their own. In 1253 the Naxi chief A-tsung A-liang submitted to Khubilai when the Mongol army crossed the Jinsha on leather rafts against Dali, and the Yuan made his house rulers of the Lijiang route. In 1382 A-jia A-de led the Naxi into the Ming camp as the Ming entered Yunnan, and the Hongwu emperor named him prefect of Lijiang with the new surname Mu. The Mu prefects campaigned with the imperial armies and grew rich as masters of the tea-horse caravans; Mu Sen served in Wang Ji's Luchuan campaign of 1441 and died the next year, leaving the young Mu Qin to succeed him. In 1444 Lijiang was a loyal, prosperous Ming native prefecture astride the Tibetan road.

Over the next two centuries the Mu fought their way into the Tibetan gorges to the north, building monasteries and bringing Karma Kagyu lamas to their capital. The Mu residence in Dayan struck the traveller Xu Xiake, who stayed there as the ruler's guest in 1639, as 'as splendid as a king's palace'. Under Mu Zeng, who succeeded in 1599, the Mu pushed the frontier to the Yalong and to Lithang and Bathang, sent silver to Beijing against the Manchus, printed the Lijiang Kangyur and sheltered the exiled tenth Karmapa. His son Mu Yi, who had studied under Xu Xiake, submitted to the Qing in 1659 and refused Wu Sangui's summons during the Three Feudatories war. In 1723 the Yongzheng court replaced the Mu with appointed officials, reducing the house to an empty local rank, and in 1770 Lijiang County was set up under a regular prefecture. Through all these years Naxi muleteers kept carrying Pu'er tea north into Tibet.
zh:
丽江是金沙江大弯处的纳西故地，背倚玉龙雪山的皑皑雪岭；这座雪山被纳西人奉为神山，是保护神三朵的居所。市镇大研始于大理国时期，地当滇藏古道要冲，雪泉穿街绕巷而过；纳西人的东巴祭司用自造的象形文字书写经书。1253年忽必烈革囊渡江征讨大理，纳西首领阿琮阿良归降，元朝授以丽江路宣抚使之职，子孙世袭。1382年明军刚入云南，阿甲阿得即率先归附，明太祖授为丽江知府，赐姓木。木氏随明军征战，又凭节制茶马商队致富；木森1441年随王骥征麓川，次年病卒，年幼的木嵚嗣位。1444年的丽江，是地处入藏要道、忠诚而富庶的明朝土知府辖地。

此后两百年间，木氏不断向北面的藏地峡谷用兵，广建寺院，迎请噶玛噶举派僧人到丽江。大研城中的木府，在1639年土司木增的客人徐霞客笔下是「宫室之丽，拟于王者」。木增1599年袭位，势力在他治下达到极盛，疆土北推至雅砻江及理塘、巴塘；他向明廷输银助饷对抗后金，主持刊刻丽江版《甘珠尔》，还收留过失势的第十世噶玛巴，其子木懿曾受教于徐霞客。木懿1659年归清，三藩之乱时拒绝响应吴三桂。1723年雍正朝改土归流，以流官取代木氏，将其降为无实权的土职；1770年设丽江县，隶丽江府。其间纳西马帮始终把普洱茶北运藏区，茶马互市不绝。

en:
Bozhou covers the wooded mountains and valleys around present-day Zunyi, where the Sichuan basin rises toward the Guizhou plateau. Yang Duan seized the country in 876 during the Tang wars with Nanzhao, and the Yang house ruled for twenty-seven generations. Its strongest keep was Hailongtun on Longyan Mountain. Begun in 1257 as a Southern Song defence against the Mongols, it stood among cliffs on four sides, with walls and nine passes controlling the way up. The Yangs submitted to the Yuan in 1277 and to the Ming in 1372. In 1444 Bozhou was formally one of the great Guizhou tusi, while a chiefly house of Yi origin kept authority over its mountain fields and stockaded villages.

Yang Yinglong inherited the chiefship in 1572, and his quarrels with subordinate chiefs and Ming officials widened into raids across the Sichuan, Guizhou and Huguang borders. After his son, held as a hostage in Chongqing, died there, Yang took Qijiang in 1599 and threatened Chongqing itself. The Wanli Emperor put Li Hualong in command of more than 320,000 troops from three provinces. Eight columns invaded on 26 March 1600; Liu Ting forced the Lou Mountains and drove Yang back to Hailongtun, which Yang had rebuilt in 1596 with three rings of walls and nine stone gates. The Ming army besieged the castle in the fourth month and broke through in the sixth. Yang burned his palace and hanged himself; Chinese accounts put the campaign at 114 days. In 1601 the Ming abolished Bozhou and divided the land into Zunyi and Pingyue prefectures.
zh:
播州在今遵义一带的山林与河谷间，位于四川盆地向贵州高原抬升之处。876年，杨端趁唐朝与南诏交战控制此地，杨氏此后传了二十七世。他们最坚固的据点是龙岩山上的海龙囤。这座山城1257年始建，本为南宋抵御蒙古的防线，四面悬崖，城墙和九座关隘卡住上山通路。杨氏1277年降元，1372年又归附明朝。1444年，播州在名义上是贵州大土司之一，源出彝族的杨氏仍实际管辖山间田地和各处寨堡。

杨应龙1572年袭职，后来与下属土司、明朝官员的冲突扩大成四川、贵州、湖广边界上的连番攻掠。他留在重庆为质的儿子死后，杨应龙1599年攻陷綦江，直接威胁重庆。万历帝命李化龙统率三省三十二万多军队。1600年3月26日，明军八路进兵，刘綎攻破娄山关，把杨应龙逼回海龙囤。杨应龙曾在1596年重修此城，设三重城垣、九道石关。明军四月合围，六月破城，杨应龙焚毁宫殿后自缢；中文记载称此役历时114日。1601年，明朝废除播州，将其地分设遵义、平越二府。

en:
Langzhong, called Baoning under the Yuan, Ming and Qing, lies on the middle Jialing River where the Sichuan basin runs into the Qinling and Daba highlands; hills ring the town, the river bends around it on three sides, and the Sichuan-Hanzhong road has to pass its walls. It was for a time a capital of the Ba kingdom in the Warring States age, and Qin made it a county seat in 314 BC. Under the Han and Tang the town was known for astronomical learning, and its most celebrated commander came from the Three Kingdoms: Zhang Fei, the Shu Han general, governed Baxi from Langzhong for Liu Bei for seven years. In 221, on the eve of the campaign against Wu, his own officers murdered him here; he was buried in the town, where a shrine raised over his grave was rebuilt again and again after fires and wars. Under the Tang, Li Yuanying, Prince of Teng, governed it as prefect and laid out the lavish garden-palace later called the Langyuan. In 1444 Baoning was the walled garrison city of northern Sichuan, kept busy by Jialing river traffic and its long-worked salt wells.

Baoning saw the hardest fighting of the Qing reconquest of Sichuan. In 1652 the Qing generals Wu Sangui and Li Guohan drove in from Shaanxi and took Chengdu, Jiading and Chongqing, but the Southern Ming commander Liu Wenxiu came back with sixty thousand men, retook Xuzhou and Chongqing and in the tenth month trapped Wu in Baoning, blocking the Jiameng and Liangshan passes behind him. On the tenth day of the eleventh month the garrison sortied and smashed Zhang Xianbi's division, the weak point of the siege, and routed the Southern Ming army; Liu Wenxiu was stripped of his rank by Sun Kewang, yet the battered Qing force could not follow up and most of Sichuan stayed under Southern Ming control. For more than ten years of the Shunzhi reign Baoning served as the Qing's temporary provincial capital, where the governor and grand coordinator resided and four provincial examinations were held, and under the Qing it remained the headquarters of the Northern Sichuan brigade command.
zh:
阆中在元明清三代称保宁，位于嘉陵江中游，四川盆地在此接上秦岭、大巴山地；群山四合，江水绕城三面，四川往来汉中的通道历来非经此城不可。战国时这里曾是巴国的都城，公元前314年秦国在此设县。汉唐时阆中以天文历算之学著称，而它最有名的守将出自三国：蜀汉名将张飞为刘备以巴西太守镇守阆中七年。221年伐吴出征前夜，他被自己的部将杀害，葬在城中，百姓在墓前立祠，祠庙历经兵火、屡毁屡建，即张桓侯祠。唐代滕王李元婴出任刺史，在城中大修园林宫苑，后称「阆苑」。1444年的保宁是川北的城守重镇，嘉陵江上舟楫往来，城周盐井开采已久。

保宁经历了清军收复四川时最惨烈的一战。1652年，清平西王吴三桂、定西将军李国翰由陕西入川，连下成都、嘉定、重庆；南明将领刘文秀率兵六万反攻，收复叙州、重庆，于十月把吴三桂困在保宁，并分兵扼守葭萌关、梁山关，断其退路。十一月十日，守城清军出城突击，击破围城诸营中最弱的张先壁部，南明军大溃；刘文秀被孙可望革职，而清军也伤亡惨重、无力扩大战果，四川大部仍在南明手中。清顺治年间，保宁做了十余年四川临时省治，总督、巡抚驻节于此，先后举行四科乡试；清代又在此设川北镇总兵署，为川北军事重心。

en:
Songqu is the plateau country on the eastern rim of Tibet: the Minshan ranges where the Min and Fu rivers rise beneath the snows of Xuebaoding, opening northward into the great Zoige marshes along the bend of the Yellow River. Amdo Tibetan herders graze yaks and dzo on the high pastures, while Qiang farmers hold the lower Min valley. The Tang planted the Songzhou garrison here in 618 to guard the Tibetan frontier, and Songtsen Gampo, emperor of the rising Tibetan empire, tested that gate with an invasion; the fighting ended in a marriage settlement, and in 641 Princess Wencheng was given to him at Songzhou before travelling on to Tibet. The Ming walled a city at Jin'an in 1379 and formed the Songpan Guard, whose orders ran little beyond the walls while the grasslands stayed with Tibetan tribes and lamas; early in the fifteenth century a disciple of Tsongkhapa founded Gelugpa monasteries across the Gyalrong country to the south. In 1444 Songzhou was the Ming frontier market where Sichuan tea was bartered for Tibetan horses, and Tibetans called the place Sungqu.

Raids and risings troubled the Songpan border throughout the Ming, and in time the court left day-to-day control to a Tibetan lama well disposed toward China. The Qing stationed a brigade general in the walled city; during the Yongzheng reign the guard became the civil Songpan Subprefecture, promoted in 1760 to the directly administered Songpan Independent Subprefecture. Tea and horses kept the town alive throughout: Sichuan tea went up the trails into the grasslands, and Tibetan ponies, cattle and sheep came down the Min valley to the basin.
zh:
「松曲」是青藏高原东缘的岷山山地：岷江、涪江发源于此，主峰雪宝顶终年积雪，山地向北敞开，接上黄河弯曲处的若尔盖沼泽大草原。安多藏族牧民在高山牧场上放牧牦牛和犏牛，羌族农人耕种岷江下游的河谷。618年唐朝在此设松州，扼守吐蕃边境；崛起的吐蕃赞普松赞干布曾向这道关口用兵，冲突最后以和亲收场，641年文成公主在松州交付，再前往吐蕃与他成婚。1379年，明朝在进安镇筑城设松潘卫，但朝廷号令出不了城墙多远，草地仍在藏族部落和喇嘛手中；15世纪初，宗喀巴的一位弟子在南方的嘉绒地区广建格鲁派寺院。1444年的松州是明朝边塞互市之所，川茶在此换取藏地马匹，藏语称这地方为「松曲」。

整个明代，松潘边外屡有袭扰和起事，朝廷后来把日常管束交给一位亲近中原的藏族喇嘛。清朝在城中设总兵驻守；雍正年间改卫设松潘厅，1760年升为松潘直隶厅。茶马互市始终养着这座边城：四川的茶叶沿山道运上草地，藏地的马匹和牛羊顺着岷江河谷进入四川盆地。

en:
Xiangyang guards the middle Han River, where every north-south road between the Nanyang plain and the Yangtze has to cross: walled Xiangyang stood on the south bank and Fancheng on the north, facing each other across the water. The Longzhong hills west of the town were where Zhuge Liang farmed until Liu Bei called him out to plan the Three Kingdoms. Xiangyang's longest trial was the Mongol siege of 1268-1273. Liu Zheng, a Song turncoat, had urged Kublai that the Song could only be broken here; the Mongols ringed the cities with forts, closed the Han, and beat off eight relief forces. In 1273 the engineers Ismail and Ala al-Din brought up their giant counterweight trebuchets, the Muslim trebuchets. Fancheng fell first and was sacked; Fan Tianshun hanged himself, Niu Fu burned to death after street fighting, and Lu Wenhuan surrendered Xiangyang only after the Mongols pledged to spare the people. Under the Ming the twin cities were the heavily garrisoned gate of Huguang, and in 1436 Zhu Zhanshan, the Prince of Xiang and uncle of the Zhengtong Emperor, moved his court here from Changsha. In 1444 his palace stood in Xiangyang while Fancheng's wharves worked with junks and mule trains.

After refugee risings in the empty mountains west of the cities drew a million followers in the 1460s and were crushed, the Ming court founded Yunyang Prefecture in 1476 to register the survivors. In 1641 Zhang Xianzhong came back from Sichuan, stormed Xiangyang, killed the Prince of Xiang Zhu Yiming, and opened the princely treasury, handing 500,000 taels to the starving; the grand secretary Yang Sichang died of fear and grief within the year. In 1643 Li Zicheng took the cities, made them his capital as Xiangjing, and proclaimed himself King of Xinshun. In early 1796 the White Lotus teacher Qi Lin was executed here after a planned Lantern Festival rising leaked out; his widow Wang Cong'er raised 40,000 to 50,000 followers a month later, campaigned through Henan, Shaanxi and Sichuan, and in 1798, after a failed attack on Xi'an, leapt to her death on Maoshan in Yunxi at twenty-two. The war lasted until 1804.
zh:
襄阳扼守汉水中游，南阳盆地通往长江的南北大路都要在此过河：南岸是城墙坚固的襄阳城，北岸是樊城，二城夹江对峙。城西的隆中山，就是诸葛亮受刘备三顾之前躬耕读书的地方。襄阳最严酷的考验是1268至1273年的蒙古围城。降蒙的宋将刘整向忽必烈进言，灭南宋必先取襄阳；蒙古军在二城四周筑起长围堡垒，封锁汉水，接连打退南宋八次援军。1273年，工匠亦思马因和阿老瓦丁督造的巨型配重式抛石机投入攻城，当时称回回炮；樊城先破并遭屠戮，守将范天顺自缢，牛富率残部巷战、重伤后投火而死，吕文焕得到不屠城的保证后献襄阳出降。明代以襄、樊为湖广门户，驻有重兵；1436年，襄王朱瞻墡把藩邸从长沙移到襄阳，他是洪熙帝之子、当朝正统帝的叔父。1444年，王府居于襄阳城内，樊城码头则挤满江船和旱路上来的骡车队。

1460年代，襄、樊以西空旷的秦巴山地挤满避荒逃赋的流民，流民两度起事、附和者上百万，被官军剿杀；1476年明廷改剿为抚，新设郧阳府，把归附流民编入户籍。明末，张献忠从四川回师，1641年攻破襄阳，处死襄王朱翊铭，又打开王府库房，发银五十万两赈济饥民；总领剿匪军务的督师阁臣杨嗣昌当年忧惧而死。1643年李自成进占襄、樊，改其名为襄京，作为都城，自称新顺王。清朝保留了这里的重兵。1796年正月，白莲教首齐林预定元宵举事、事泄被杀；其妻王聪儿一个月后率众四五万起兵，转战河南、陕西、四川，1798年攻西安失利，在郧西茅山跳崖自尽，年二十二岁。这场战争一直打到1804年。

en:
Jingzhou, the old Jiangling, stands on the Yangtze where the river leaves the hills for the lakeland of the Jianghan plain; the kings of ancient Chu kept their capital at Ying nearby. Under the Ming it was the seat of Jingzhou Prefecture, fed by the plain's rice and fish, and a saying ran that when Huguang reaped, the empire was fed. Below its walls the Shashi anchorage handled the river traffic, and in 1400 the Prince of Liao, Zhu Zhi, was moved here from the Liaodong frontier and installed in the old palace of the Prince of Xiang. In 1444 his heirs held court within the walls, grain barges worked the Shashi wharves, and the garrison watched the middle Yangtze.

The town gave the late Ming its strongest minister, Zhang Juzheng, known to contemporaries as Zhang of Jiangling. Born here in 1525 into a Jingzhou Guard military household, he was a child prodigy whom the prefect renamed Juzheng and the provincial governor deliberately failed once to temper him. As the Wanli Emperor's senior grand secretary for ten years he carried through the Single Whip tax reform and the evaluation system, employed Qi Jiguang on the northern frontier and Pan Jixun on the Yellow River, and left the granaries full when he died in 1582. The young emperor then settled scores: the Zhang family was attainted, seventeen people starved in the sealed mansion, his eldest son hanged himself under torture, and Zhang's honours were restored only in 1622. The Princes of Liao left the Wanshou Pagoda, raised at Shashi in 1548-1552 to pray for the emperor, and the eighth prince was later stripped of his rank. In 1643 Li Zicheng's army took Jingzhou and its newly enfeoffed Prince of Hui fled south through Hunan; a Qing army under Lekedehun retook the city early in 1646. During the Three Feudatories' war Qing armies massed here and kept Wu Sangui from crossing the Yangtze, and in 1683 the court planted a permanent Eight Banners garrison of 5,500 men under a general, the only one of the fourteen interior garrisons posted away from a provincial capital.
zh:
荆州古称江陵，城在长江出丘陵、入江汉平原湖网之地的江口，上古楚国的郢都就在附近。明代为荆州府治，平原盛产稻米鱼鲜，俗谚说「湖广熟，天下足」。城下的沙市码头经办江上往来，1400年辽王朱植从辽东边地移封至此，以原湘王府故址为邸。1444年，辽藩后人在城内开府，沙市江边粮船停泊，府城驻军看守着这一段漫长的长江中游。

荆州走出了晚明最有权势的大臣张居正，时人称之为张江陵。他1525年生于这里的荆州卫军籍人家，少年即有神童之名，知府为他改名「居正」，乡试时湖广巡抚顾璘又故意让他落榜，以此磨砺他。万历初年他任内阁首辅十年，推行一条鞭法和考成法，用戚继光守北边、用潘季驯治黄河，1582年去世时太仓充实。年轻的万历帝随即清算：张家被抄，府门封死，困死家中的老弱有十七口，长子张敬修受刑不过，自缢身亡；他的名誉直到1622年才恢复。辽王留下的是万寿宝塔，1548至1552年建于沙市江边，为皇帝祈寿，第八代辽王后来因劣迹被废。1643年李自成军攻占荆州，刚就藩的惠王南逃湖南；1646年初清将勒克德浑夺回此城。三藩之乱时清军主力屯驻荆州，使吴三桂始终不能突破长江防线；1683年清廷在此设荆州将军，派驻八旗兵五千五百人，是内地十四处驻防中唯一不驻在省会的一处。

en:
Yuanling, the walled seat of Chenzhou Prefecture, is a town on the Yuan River at the head of the water road that climbs from Dongting Lake towards Guizhou. Junks carried out the red cinnabar called chensha, 'Chenzhou sand', the Jietan tea of its hills and other mountain goods for the lower Yangtze. The country had a name for books as well as ores: at Er'you Mountain, where the You River joins the Yuan, a cave was said to have hidden five cartloads of the classics carried off by the Qin erudite Fu Sheng during the burning of the books, and the two You hills became a Chinese byword for a great library. Nearby stood the Longxing Monastery, founded by imperial order in 628, where Wang Yangming stopped in 1511 on his way from exile in Guizhou to take office at Luling and lectured for a month on the learning of innate knowing. South and west the folded ridges were Miao country, whose unregistered villages answered to their own headmen. In 1444 Yuanling was a frontier market of soldiers and traders, where the registered empire ended at the walls.

When the Miao rose under the Wanli Emperor, the Ming ran a hundred-ninety-kilometre wall of stone and watchtowers along the ridge crests from Guzhang to the Fenghuang passes, spending forty thousand taels to shut the 'raw Miao' away from the administered lowlands; late-Ming rebellions tore it down. In 1679 the failing Zhou of Wu Sangui's heirs made its last Hunan stand at Wugang and the Chenlong Pass, and the fall of the pass opened Guizhou to the Qing. In the first month of 1795 the Miao rose under Shi Sanbao of the Huanggua stockade, joined by Shi Liudeng in Guizhou and Wu Bayue, killing the garrison commander Ming'antu and nearly two thousand troops at Yaxi. Fukang'an and Helin led five columns in and burned dozens of stockades, but both commanders died on campaign in 1796, the year Shi Sanbao was taken and executed in Beijing. The hills were not settled until 1806, when the Qing rebuilt the frontier wall and ringed the Miao country with forts and military farms.
zh:
沅陵是明代辰州府的府治，沅水边的一座城，扼守从洞庭湖溯江通往贵州的水路起点。江船把山中的辰砂（因辰州得名的朱砂）、碣滩茶等山货运往下江。这里除了矿砂也以藏书闻名：酉水汇入沅水处的二酉山上，相传有石洞在秦代焚书时藏过博士伏胜偷运出来的五车典籍，「二酉」后来成了藏书宏富的代称。山下有628年（唐贞观二年）敕建的龙兴讲寺；1511年，王守仁从贵州贬所赴庐陵知县任，途经沅陵，在寺中讲授良知之学一个月。城西南的重山叠岭是苗疆，未入籍的苗民各依头人生活。1444年的沅陵是一座兵商杂处的边地商镇，编户齐民的世界到城墙为止。

万历年间苗民起事，朝廷耗银四万两，沿山脊筑起一道190公里长的石墙和敌楼，北起古丈，南至凤凰诸关，要把「生苗」和设有官府的平地隔开；明末的战乱又把它拆毁。1679年，吴三桂继承人岌岌可危的周国在湖南的最后据点退守武冈和辰龙关，关城一破，贵州便向清军敞开。1795年正月，永绥黄瓜寨的石三保联合贵州石柳邓、吴八月等人起事，在鸭酉击杀总兵明安图所部近两千人。福康安、和琳分兵五路进剿，焚毁数十寨，但两人都在1796年病殁军中，石三保也在这一年被俘，押到北京处死。苗山到1806年才告平定，清廷随即重修边墙，沿苗疆广设营哨、屯田驻守。

en:
Hengyang, then called Hengzhou, straddles the Xiang River south of Mount Heng, the Southern Sacred Peak. Huiyan Peak, the first spur of the sacred mountain, rises inside the city; geese flying south for the winter were said to turn back there, and Hengzhou was called the Goose City for it. Its wharves were the first great staging point in the traffic of goods between the Yangtze country and Guangdong and Guangxi. On a rock where two rivers meet stood the Shigu Academy, founded in 810 and later numbered among the four great academies of China, and pilgrims for the Southern Peak passed its cliffs on their way into the hills. This country also gave China Cai Lun, the Eastern Han eunuch who made paper from bark, rags and old fishing nets; he was a man of Leiyang. In 1444 Hengzhou was one of the richest prefectural seats in the Hunan basin, with river junks moored below the academy cliffs.

The last Ming reigns brought the city a prince and then ruin. Zhu Changying, the Prince of Gui, kept his court at Hengzhou, and in the autumn of 1643 Zhang Xianzhong's army sacked the city; the prince fled through Yongzhou into Guangxi and died at Wuzhou, while his son Zhu Youlang, carried south in the same flight, was enthroned as the Yongli Emperor in 1646. A Hengzhou scholar refused the new dynasty: Wang Fuzhi, who had fought the Qing as a young man, withdrew to Stone Boat Mountain outside the city and spent some forty years writing the philosophical works that made him one of the leading Confucian thinkers of the early Qing. In 1652 the Southern Ming general Li Dingguo retook Hengzhou in battle and killed the Qing prince Nikan. The city had an emperor of its own in 1678, when Wu Sangui proclaimed his Zhou dynasty here and renamed Hengzhou Dingtian as his capital; he died within months, and Qing troops took the city back in 1679.
zh:
衡阳当时叫衡州，城跨湘江，地处南岳衡山之南。南岳第一峰回雁峰就在城中，相传北雁南飞，到这里便歇翅北返，衡州因此别称雁城。衡州的码头是长江流域与两广之间货物往来的第一个大站。城边两江相会处的石鼓山上有石鼓书院，始建于810年，后来位列天下四大书院，去南岳进香的香客经过崖下，再往山中寺院。这一带还走出过蔡伦：东汉宦官蔡伦是耒阳人，用树皮、破布和旧渔网改进了造纸术。1444年的衡州是湖南盆地最富庶的府城之一，书院崖下泊满江船。

晚明给这座城送来一位亲王，随后是一场兵祸。桂王朱常瀛的藩邸就在衡州，1643年秋张献忠军攻破城池，桂王经永州逃入广西，死在梧州；随他一同南逃的儿子朱由榔，1646年被拥立为帝，是为永历帝。本地学者王夫之年轻时曾起兵抗清，此后隐居城外的石船山，用近四十年时间著书，成为清初最重要的儒家思想家之一。1652年，南明将领李定国克复衡州，阵斩清朝亲王尼堪。1678年，吴三桂在衡州称帝，国号周，改衡州为定天府、立为都城，数月后即病死；1679年清军收复衡州。

en:
Runing is the plain of the upper Huai River, crossed by the Ru and Hong rivers. Its seat, Ruyang, stood on the Xuanhu bulge, a tongue of high ground in a bend of the Ru shaped like a hanging gourd, and was known in earlier times as Caizhou. The surrounding country was old Cai, home of Li Si: born at Shangcai, he went west to serve Qin and became the chancellor who, under the First Emperor, standardized Qin law, weights and measures and the script. Caizhou itself is remembered for an ending. In 1233 the Jin emperor Aizong fled here before the Mongols; a Mongol army and Song troops under Meng Gong ringed the city and cut the river dykes to flood it. In the first month of 1234, with the walls breached, Aizong passed the throne to his marshal Wanyan Chenglin and hanged himself in the Youlan Pavilion; Chenglin was crowned in the morning and killed in the street fighting before nightfall, the last emperor of the Jin. Meng Gong carried Aizong's remains south to Lin'an. The Yuan raised Caizhou to Runing Prefecture in 1293, and the Ming kept it. In 1444 Ruyang was a prefectural seat on the post road south from Kaifeng, set among the wheat, hemp and cotton lands of south-eastern Henan.

In 1474 Zhu Jianze, sixth son of the Emperor Yingzong, took up his fief here as Prince of Chong; the posting stations he established along the road gave a roadside halt the name Zhumadian, 'the horse station'. In the intercalary eleventh month of 1642 Li Zicheng's rebel army stormed Runing and carried off the reigning prince Zhu Yougui, whom they titled Earl of Xiangyang and put to death at Biyang when he refused to serve. The Qing kept Runing Prefecture, but in 1724 Guangzhou and its four counties were detached as an independent department. The smaller prefecture remained a posting and grain centre on the road from Beijing to the Yangtze.
zh:
汝宁地处淮河上游平原，汝河、洪河穿行其间。府治汝阳城坐落在汝水弯曲处一块状如悬瓠的舌形高地上，古称悬瓠城，更早的名字是蔡州。这一带是古蔡地，秦相李斯的故乡：李斯为上蔡人，西入秦国，佐始皇帝统一法律、度量衡和文字。蔡州为人记住，是因为一个王朝在此收场。1233年金哀宗为避蒙古逃入此城，蒙古军与孟珙所率宋军合围，并决河堤灌城。1234年正月城破之际，哀宗把帝位传给东面元帅完颜承麟，自己在幽兰轩自缢；承麟上午即位，当天便死于巷战，是金朝最后一位皇帝。孟珙将哀宗遗骸带回临安。1293年元朝升蔡州为汝宁府，明代沿袭。1444年的汝阳是开封南下驿道上的府城，周围是豫东南出产麦、麻、棉花的田畴。

1474年，明英宗第六子崇简王朱见泽就藩汝宁府，他在沿途设置驿站，一处歇马换马的驻所便有了「驻马店」之名。崇祯十五年闰十一月，李自成军攻破汝宁，俘走在位的崇王朱由樻，封他为襄阳伯；朱由樻拒不从命，被杀于泌阳。清代仍置汝宁府，1724年光州及光山、固始、息县、商城四县划出另置直隶州。缩小后的汝宁府一直是北京通往长江路上的驿传与粮食集散之地。

en:
Shangqiu lies on the flat alluvial borderland where Henan meets Shandong and Anhui. It is old Shang country: Xie, ancestor of the Shang kings, was enfeoffed here, and Cheng Tang founded the Shang dynasty with his first capital at Nanbo nearby; after the Zhou conquest the descendants of Shang were enfeoffed as the state of Song, whose capital Suiyang stood on this site. Confucius's ancestors were lords of Song, and Zhuangzi was born in Song's Meng. Under the Han, Suiyang was the capital of the kingdom of Liang, whose King Xiao held the city through the Rebellion of the Seven States and played host to writers such as Sima Xiangru. Its great siege came in 757, in the An Lushan rebellion: Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan held Suiyang with 6,800 men against Yin Ziqi's 130,000, and the archer Nan Jiyun shot out one of Yin's eyes from the wall. The city fell after ten months and the defenders were executed, but the rebels had lost 120,000 men and never reached the canal country of the southeast; the siege turned the course of the war. In 960 Zhao Kuangyin, formerly military governor of the Guide army based at Songzhou, named his new dynasty Song after the town; in 1127 the Emperor Gaozong was crowned at its Yingtian palace before fleeing south. Reduced to Guide Subprefecture under Kaifeng in the early Ming, the city was in 1444 the chief market of eastern Henan, with the trading town of Zhuji hard by the walls and the Yellow River dykes looming close.

A Yellow River flood wrecked the old city in 1502; it was rebuilt on higher ground to the north, and the new walled Guide city was completed in 1511. In 1545 Guide was raised to a prefecture and Shangqiu County created. This was the home of the essayist Hou Fangyu (1618-1655), one of the Four Young Masters of the late Ming; his Nanjing romance with the courtesan Li Xiangjun became the plot of Kong Shangren's drama The Peach Blossom Fan. Local tradition also makes nearby Yucheng the home of Mulan. In 1725 the last character of the county's name was altered to honour the taboo on Confucius's personal name, and Guide stayed the granary and forwarding centre of the eastern plain.
zh:
商丘地处河南与山东、安徽交界的冲积平原，地势平坦。这里是古商地：商王先祖契受封于此，成汤灭夏建商，最初的都城南亳就在附近；周灭商后，商的后裔受封建立宋国，都城睢阳就在此地。孔子的先世出自宋国公室，庄子也生于宋国蒙地。汉代睢阳是梁国都城，七国之乱时梁孝王据城死守，又以梁园招徕文士，司马相如便在他的座上。757年安史之乱中，著名的睢阳围城战在此上演：张巡、许远以六千八百人拒尹子奇十三万大军，南霁云在城头一箭射瞎尹子奇一目。十个月后城破，守城者被杀；叛军折损十二万人，终没能进入运河所在的东南，这场围城也扭转了战局。960年，曾以宋州为治所的归德军节度使赵匡胤取「宋」为国号；1127年宋高宗在应天府即位，随后南逃。明初降为开封府属归德州，到1444年，这里已是豫东最大的商镇，朱集商镇紧贴城郭，黄河大堤也近在城边。

1502年黄河洪水毁去旧城，城址北移高地，1511年新的归德城修筑完工。1545年归德州复升为府，添设商丘县。这里是明末散文家侯方域（1618—1655年）的故里，他为「明末四公子」之一，在南京与李香君的情缘后来成了孔尚任《桃花扇》的本事。相传花木兰也是邻近虞城人氏。1725年为避孔子名讳，县名末字改写，归德一直是豫东平原的粮仓与货物转运中心。

en:
Ningwu covers the high ridges at the headwaters of the Fen and Sanggan rivers, where tracks from the Datong basin and the Ordos frontier turn south toward Taiyuan. Rivers cut narrow valleys through the hills, and Ming patrols and Mongol raiders used those gaps to move between the steppe, northern Shanxi and the Taiyuan plain. In 1444 the famous later fortress had not yet been built. Ming forces watched the mountain routes, with Datong ahead of them and Taiyuan behind.

Ningwu Pass was completed in 1467 and its walled town enlarged in 1498. With Pianguan and Yanmen Pass it formed Shanxi's Three Outer Passes, the line defending the province's northern flank. In 1644 Li Zicheng's rebel army stormed the pass on its march toward Beijing. Zhou Yuji, the Ming commander of the Three Passes and an officer from Jinzhou Guard in Liaodong, held out until he was killed. His death removed the last major barrier in northern Shanxi, and Li's army pushed on toward Beijing.
zh:
宁武在汾河、桑干河源头一带的高山上，大同盆地和河套前沿通向太原的山路都要经过这里。河谷切开山岭，巡逻军和蒙古骑兵常借这些缺口，在草原、晋北与太原平原之间往来。1444年，后来那座著名关城还没有建成，明军监视着这些山道，前方是大同，后方是太原。

宁武关于1467年建成，1498年又扩建关城，与偏头关、雁门关合称山西「外三关」，共同防守山西北翼。1644年，李自成率军进取北京，强攻宁武关。三关总兵周遇吉是辽东锦州卫军官，他率部坚守到战死。宁武失守后，晋北再没有能阻挡大顺军的重要关口，李自成立即向北京推进。

en:
Lu'an covers the Shangdang highland of southeastern Shanxi, where the Taihang and Taiyue ranges ring the basin and the three headwaters of the Zhuozhang River meet. Shangdang Commandery was set up here in 348 BC and later became one of the Qin Empire's thirty-six commanderies; the Northern Zhou created Luzhou in 578. The town mattered because roads from Taiyuan crossed the nearby Taihang passes before descending to the North China Plain. In 1444 the Ming district was still called Luzhou, the name Lu'an Prefecture belonging to a later administrative change.

That change followed a mountain rebellion. Chen Qing rose at Qingyang Mountain in 1524 and held out until Ming forces suppressed the revolt in 1528. In the second lunar month of 1529 the court accepted Xia Yan's proposal for tighter control, raised Luzhou to Lu'an Prefecture, placed the seat at Changzhi, and formed Pingshun County from lands taken from Huguan, Lucheng and Licheng. The new county gave officials a foothold in the country where the rebels had operated. Lu'an's other Ming claim was silk: about a thousand registered loom households wove Luzhou silk, a cloth traded well beyond Shanxi.
zh:
潞安覆盖晋东南上党高地，太行山、太岳山环绕盆地，浊漳河三个源头在境内汇合。前348年，上党郡在此设立，后来成为秦朝三十六郡之一；578年，北周设置潞州。从太原先经附近太行山口、再下华北平原的道路经过这一带，使这里长期驻有官府和军队。1444年，明代行政区仍称潞州，「潞安府」是后来才有的名称。

潞安设府和一场山地起义有关。1524年，陈卿在青羊山聚众起事，直到1528年才被明军镇压。1529年二月，朝廷采纳夏言加强控制的建议，升潞州为潞安府，府治设在长治，并从壶关、潞城、黎城划地设置平顺县。新设的县让官府在起义军活动过的山地中有了据点。潞安在明代还以丝织闻名，登记在册的机户约有一千家，所织「潞绸」销往山西以外。

en:
Yan'an lies among the barren loess ridges of northern Shaanxi, the Yan River and the North Luo cutting south through deep gullies toward Guanzhong, with the Ordos grasslands and the Ming wall beyond them to the north. It was a fortress commandery under the Northern Wei and a Song front against the Western Xia. In 1080 the polymath Shen Kuo was put in charge of the Fu-Yan border command; in the Fu and Yan country locals drew a black 'fat water' seeping from the springs to burn for light, and in his Dream Pool Essays Shen named it shiyou, 'rock oil', the Chinese word for petroleum ever since, even making ink from its soot called 'Yanchuan stone liquid'. The prefecture was renamed Yan'an in 1089, and after the Ming took it in 1369 it stayed a rough frontier prefecture of millet fields and post stations. In the southern county of Zhongbu, Qiaoshan holds the mausoleum of the Yellow Emperor, where dynasties conducted national sacrifices: in 1371 the Hongwu Emperor sent envoys with a prayer text he had written himself, and Ming courts kept sending officials to the rites. In 1444 the prefecture's millet harvests and post stations supply the garrison posts facing the Ordos.

In the late 1620s drought and famine ran across the northern Shaanxi plateau year after year. Wang Er rose in the seventh month of 1627, and the late-Ming rebellions spread from his rising; many of their chiefs came from Yan'an's own counties. Gao Yingxiang, a horse trader from Ansai, styled himself the Dashing King and was captured and executed in 1636. His nephew Li Zicheng, a dismissed postal courier from Mizhi, inherited the title, seized Beijing and overthrew the Ming in 1644, and Zhang Xianzhong's columns campaigned through the prefecture as well. The Qing kept Yan'an Prefecture, but in 1725 its three subordinate departments were placed directly under the province, leaving the prefecture with eight counties.
zh:
延安在陕北贫瘠的黄土塬梁之间，延河与北洛河顺着深沟大壑向南流向关中，北边过了明代边墙，就是鄂尔多斯草原。北魏时这里已是军镇，北宋时又是抵御西夏的前线。1080年，沈括出任鄜延路经略安抚使，主持对西夏防务；鄜、延一带有黑色的「脂水」从泉间渗出，当地人采来点灯，沈括在《梦溪笔谈》里把它定名为「石油」，这个名称一直沿用，他还扫集烟灰制墨，号为「延川石液」。1089年延州升为延安府，1369年入明以后，仍是地瘠民贫的边地军府，塬上种粟，驿路连通北方要塞。南部中部县的桥山上有黄帝陵，历代在此举行国祭：1371年，洪武帝亲撰祭文、遣官致祭，明代朝廷也一再派员赴祭。1444年的延安以粟米收成和驿路供应着正对鄂尔多斯的边军。

1620年代末，陕北高原连年旱灾饥荒。1627年七月王二举事，明末大乱从他这里蔓延开来，各路首领多出自延安属县：安塞的马贩子高迎祥自称闯王，1636年兵败被俘处死；他的外甥、米脂被裁驿卒李自成接过闯王名号，1644年攻入北京、推翻明朝，张献忠的人马也在延安府境内往来转战。入清以后仍设延安府，1725年三个属州改归省直隶，府下只余八县。

en:
Tianshui fills the upper Wei valley where the Loess Plateau meets the Qinling, the last well-watered basin on the road west out of the Guanzhong plain. The early Qin lords kept their seat at Qin Yi in these hills, and in 688 BC Duke Wu of Qin set up Gui county here, one of the oldest counties in China. Silk Road caravans climbed the Wei valley, and monks came with them: around 400 the Later Qin cut the first Maijishan caves into a cliff south of the city, and most of the painted clay figures the grottoes are known for were modelled under the Northern Wei and Northern Zhou, the caves linked by wooden walkways stacked up the rock face. The country also raised soldiers. The Han 'Flying General' Li Guang was a man of Chengji in Tianshui commandery, and Jiang Wei was born in Ji county here; in 228, when Zhuge Liang's first northern army entered the commandery, his own prefect suspected him and shut the gates, and Jiang Wei went over to Shu to become Zhuge Liang's most trusted successor. The poet Du Fu lodged in Qinzhou in 759 while fleeing the An Lushan wars and made the cliff the subject of his poem 'Mountain Temple'. In 1444 the city is Qinzhou, a subprefecture of Gongchang in Ming Shaanxi, trading Wei-valley grain and the tea and horses exchanged here from the early Hongwu years, its Fuxi Temple the city's chief shrine.

The Fuxi Temple was rebuilt on a grand scale under the Hongzhi and Jiajing emperors, while the Maijishan caves saw only scattered repairs through the Ming and dropped out of common notice. On the night of 21 July 1654 an earthquake broke on the country south of Qinzhou, put at magnitude eight by older accounts and at moment magnitude 7.0 by a newer study: walls and cave dwellings collapsed across four provinces and more than 30,000 people died. The city recovered, and in 1729 the Yongzheng Emperor raised Qinzhou to an independent department under the new province of Gansu, governing Qin'an, Qingshui and the neighbouring counties.
zh:
天水占着渭河上游的盆地，黄土高原在这里接上秦岭，是关中平原西行路上最后一处水足土肥的地方。秦国先世的都邑秦邑就在这片山里，前688年秦武公置邽县，是中国最早的县之一。丝绸之路的商队沿渭河西行，僧人也随商队而来：约400年前后，后秦在城南麦积山的崖壁上开出第一批洞窟，其中最有名的泥塑多为北魏、北周时的作品，洞龛靠层层叠架在崖面上的栈道相连。这一带也出名将。西汉的「飞将军」李广是天水郡成纪人；姜维生于境内冀县，228年诸葛亮第一次北伐兵入天水，本郡太守疑心他有异心、闭门不纳，姜维只得投奔蜀汉，后来成了诸葛亮最倚重的接班人。诗人杜甫在安史之乱中流寓秦州，于759年作《山寺》一诗写麦积山。1444年这里是明朝陕西巩昌府属州秦州，渭河谷地的粮食和洪武初年以来的茶马交易在此集散，城中的伏羲庙是最主要的祠庙。

伏羲庙在弘治、嘉靖年间大规模重修，成了后来的格局；麦积山在明代只有零星修补，渐渐少有人知。1654年7月21日夜，秦州以南发生大地震，早先估计为八级，较新的研究作矩震级7.0，城墙和窑洞在四省范围内崩塌，三万余人死去。秦州城后来慢慢恢复，1729年雍正帝升秦州为甘肃直隶州，管辖秦安、清水及周边诸县。

en:
Pingliang lies on the upper Jing in the Longdong loess country, the first broad, well-watered basin west of the Guanzhong, with the Kongtong range, sacred to Daoists, rising beyond its western walls. In 228 Zhang He defeated Ma Su at the Jieting pass in these hills and wrecked Zhuge Liang's first northern campaign. In 787 the Tibetans ambushed a Tang peace party at Pingliangchuan; the chief envoy Hun Jian got away only by reaching the prepared camp of Luo Yuanguang, later granted the imperial surname Li as Li Yuanliang, who then fortified Liangyuan in these hills against Tibetan raids. Pingliang became a county under the Northern Zhou and a prefectural seat under the Jin and Yuan. The Ming valued the place for horses: the Shaanxi Imperial Stud, set up in 1406, grazed cavalry herds on the Longdong pastures for the northern garrisons, and in 1424 the fief of the Princes of Han was moved here from Kaiyuan in Liaodong, taking over the mansion of the late Prince of An. In 1444 the young Prince Zhu Fanyi has just died without an heir and the succession is open, while stud herds and livestock markets spread around the walls.

The Han princes kept their court at Pingliang and laid out the Warm Spring garden outside the walls until 1643, when Li Zicheng's rebel army stormed the city and carried off the last prince; he was put to death in Shanxi in the collapse of 1644. Within a generation Pingliang was a rebel stronghold again. Wang Fuchen, the Qing Shaanxi commander-in-chief, a cavalry soldier nicknamed 'Ma Yaozi', rose in the twelfth month of 1674, killed the imperial commissioner Mo Luo, seized Lanzhou and made Pingliang his base; a Qing army under Dong'e besieged it for eight months without success. In 1676 the Kangxi Emperor sent Tuhai west, and in the fifth month his men carried the Hushandun redoubt commanding the city; in the sixth Zhou Peigong went into Pingliang and talked Wang into surrender, and the Shaanxi-Gansu front was settled. Wang was later summoned to the capital and took poison on the road in 1681.
zh:
平凉在陇东黄土高原的泾河上游，是关中西行之后第一个宽阔水足的盆地，城西就是道教名山崆峒山。228年，张郃在境内的街亭击败马谡，诸葛亮第一次北伐功败垂成。787年，吐蕃在平凉川伏击前来会盟的唐朝使团，主使浑瑊单骑逃到骆元光早有防备的营寨才捡回一命；骆元光因此被赐姓李、改名元谅，他后来驻防境内良原，修城屯田，吐蕃屡攻不克。平凉北周时立县，金元时为府治。明朝看重这里的马：1406年设立的陕西苑马寺在陇东草场为北方诸镇牧战马，1424年韩王封国又从孤悬边外的辽东开原迁来，入居已故安王的旧府。1444年，年轻的韩王朱範圯刚刚无嗣而终，爵位虚悬；城外四野遍布官马的监苑和牲畜市集。

韩藩世代居此，在城外经营暖泉园林，直到1643年李自成军攻破城池，掳走末代韩王，他在1644年大顺政权崩溃时被杀于山西。不到一代人，平凉又成了叛军营盘：清陕西提督王辅臣行伍出身，绰号「西路马鹞子」，1674年十二月在宁羌起兵，杀经略莫洛，攻破兰州，以平凉为大本营；董额率清军围城八个月不克。1676年康熙帝派图海西征，五月清军夺取俯瞰全城的虎山墩，六月周培公入城说降王辅臣，陕甘战局就此了结。王辅臣后来被召赴京，1681年在途中饮毒而死。

en:
Liangzhou guards the eastern mouth of the Hexi Corridor, where the Qilian range gives way to the Alashan desert. The Han drove the Xiongnu from these pastures, and at Leitai in the later city an Eastern Han general's tomb held a bronze troop of thirty-nine horses and fourteen chariots, one horse galloping with a hoof on a flying bird. Guzang was the capital of one Liang kingdom after another in the Sixteen Kingdoms era. After Lu Guang took Kucha in 384 the Kuchean translator Kumarajiva was kept at Guzang for eighteen years, mastering Chinese, until Later Qin forces took him to head Chang'an's translation office. In 412 the Northern Liang king Juqu Mengxun moved his capital to Guzang and began the Tiantishan Grottoes in the cliffs south of the city. In 1247 Sakya Pandita, Tibet's leading prelate, met the Mongol prince Godan here and settled Tibet's submission to the Mongols. Ming armies took the city in 1372 and made it Liangzhou Guard, the easternmost of the garrisons west to the Jiayu Pass, and in 1437-1439 the garrison built its Confucian temple, one of the northwest's largest. In 1444 it was a soldier-farmer town on a quieting frontier, taking horses and livestock from the Qilian pastures as caravan trade withered behind the sealed passes.

In 1524 the Turfan khan seized Dunhuang and the Ming closed the Jiayu Pass; after 1539 the corridor wall was rebuilt, leaving Liangzhou among the last markets on the imperial edge. Li Zicheng's rebels overran it in 1643 and Qing forces under Ajige retook the corridor in 1645. The Muslim officers Milayin and Ding Guodong overran most of Gansu in 1648 before being crushed, and in 1674-1676 Zhang Yong's garrison held the cut-off corridor for the Qing through the Three Feudatories' revolt. Soldier-farmers were brought in from the 1720s for the western wars, and in 1724 the guard became Wuwei County, seat of Liangzhou Prefecture and the Zhuanglang tea-horse office. In 1804 the scholar Zhang Shu opened a brick-sealed temple pavilion and found the Liangzhou stele of 1094, Tangut on one face and Chinese on the other; its bilingual text recovered the lost Tangut script.
zh:
凉州扼守河西走廊东口，祁连山在此让位于阿拉善荒漠。汉人逐出匈奴、开辟边地后，城中雷台的一座东汉将军墓随葬了整套青铜车马仪仗，39匹铜马、14辆铜车中有一骑三足腾空，一足踏在飞鸟背上。古城姑臧是十六国时期诸凉政权相继建都之地。龟兹高僧鸠摩罗什384年被吕光携至姑臧，软禁18年间通晓汉语，后秦攻破姑臧后把他迎往长安主持译场。412年北凉王沮渠蒙逊迁都于此，在城南山崖开凿天梯山石窟。1247年，吐蕃最高僧官萨迦·班智达在此会见蒙古宗王阔端，议定吐蕃归附蒙古。1372年明军取城，改置凉州卫，为通向嘉峪关的诸军卫中最东的一座；1437至1439年又建起规模居西北前列的武威文庙。1444年的凉州是军户屯田的边城，集散祁连牧场的马匹牲畜，西去的商队贸易已随关塞封闭而萧条。

1524年吐鲁番汗攻占敦煌，明朝封闭嘉峪关；1539年后走廊边墙重修，凉州成了帝国边缘最后几处市口之一。1643年李自成部袭取凉州，1645年阿济格率清军收复河西。1648年回族军官米喇印、丁国栋一度席卷甘肃大部，旋遭镇压；1674至1676年三藩之乱中，张勇所部为清朝守住了与内地隔绝的走廊。1720年代起大批军户被迁来屯垦，供给西征军需；1724年凉州卫改为武威县，为凉州府治所，庄浪茶马厅也设在这里。1804年，学者张澍打开城中一座寺庙里砖封多年的碑亭，发现了1094年刻成的凉州碑，一面刻西夏文、一面刻汉文，学者借此重新释读了失传的西夏文字。

en:
Taozhou is the upper Tao River high country, where the loess hills run into the Tibetan plateau between the Min range and the western grassland. Under the Tang it was a frontier prefecture on the road into Tibet, and it raised two of the dynasty's generals. Li Sheng retook Chang'an from the rebel Zhu Ci and was made Prince of Xiping; his son Li Su led a picked force through a snowstorm at night in 817 to seize Caizhou and capture Wu Yuanji, the raid remembered as 'taking Caizhou on a snowy night'. Both were men of Lintan here. In 1379 the eighteen Tibetan clans of Taozhou rose against the Ming, and Mu Ying and Li Wenzhong's army crushed them; a guard city went up on the old Tuyuhun fortress site of Honghe, southern soldier-farmers worked the valleys, and Tibetan chiefs kept their clans, the enfeoffed Jiu tusi ruling seventy-six of them. Sichuan tea changed hands here for Tibetan horses, and green stone from the Tao gorge was carved into inkstones, prized since Song times. Its most famous son was a Tibetan boy of Lintan who became the eunuch Hou Xian: he led five embassies to Tibet, Nepal, Bengal and Jaunpur, twice sailed with Zheng He, and died in 1438 at the monastery the Xuande Emperor granted him. In 1444 Tibetan herders, monks and Han soldier-farmers answer to the Ming through the guard, its tusi chiefs and a Buddhist clergy office.

The official tea-horse exchanges, held every three years with gold tallies, stopped in 1449, and by the time Yang Yiqing had the system revived private trade had long overtaken the official marts. In 1589 the Mongol chiefs Huoluochi and Zhenxiang raided Hezhou, Lintao and the Tao valley; the Ming put Zheng Luo over the four Shaanxi garrisons, and two years later he induced the Shunyi Khan Cüreg to withdraw east. Qing troops arrived in 1645, and the old guard was in time converted into the Taozhou subprefecture, with an officer charged to manage Tibetan affairs. When the Jahriyya revolt broke out to the east in 1781, Taozhou Tibetan clans marched with the Qing armies sent against it.
zh:
洮州是洮河上游的高地，黄土丘陵在岷山和西面的草原之间接上青藏高原。唐代这里是唐蕃古道上的边州，出过两员唐朝大将。李晟从叛将朱泚手中收复长安，封西平王；其子李愬在817年雪夜率精兵奇袭蔡州、生擒吴元济，史称「雪夜下蔡州」。父子都是本地临潭人。1379年洮州十八族反明，沐英、李文忠率军讨平，随后在吐谷浑旧戍洪和城的故址筑起卫城，南方调来的军户在河谷屯田，藏族头人照旧领有部众，受封的咎姓土司管辖七十六族。川茶在这里交换番马，洮河峡谷的绿石琢成砚台，宋代以来就是名砚。本地最出名的人物是临潭藏族少年出身的太监侯显：他五度出使西藏、尼泊尔、榜葛剌和沼纳朴儿，两度随郑和下西洋，1438年在宣宗所赐的侯家寺圆寂。1444年，藏族牧民、僧人和汉族军户通过卫所、土官和僧纲司听命于明朝。

以金牌信符三年一次的官营茶马互市1449年停罢，到杨一清奏请恢复的时候，私贩早已盖过官市。1589年，蒙古首领火落赤、真相台吉入犯河州、临洮和洮河谷地，明廷以郑洛经略陕西四镇，两年后他促使顺义王撦力克东归。1645年清军抵达，旧卫后来改设洮州厅，专派官员管理藏民事务。1781年哲合忍耶之乱在东边爆发，洮州藏族各部随清军出征助剿。

en:
Xining lies in the valley of the Huangshui, the corridor called Tsongkha that joins the Gansu plain to the Tibetan plateau. In the 1030s the Tibetan king Gusiluo made his city of Qingtang here a power that sold Hexi horses to the Song, traded with the Western Regions and beat off an invasion by Li Yuanhao of Western Xia; the Song recovered Qingtang in 1104 and named it Xining, 'peace in the west'. The Ming made it a guard in 1373 and in 1397 moved the tea-horse office here, weighing Sichuan tea out against the horses of Tibetan and Mongol herdsmen. Tsongkhapa, founder of the Gelug order, was born in these hills in 1357; his mother raised a stupa over the spot in 1379, and a sandalwood tree growing there was said to bear the Buddha's image on every leaf. In 1444 it was a frontier guard town where tea, wool, livestock and western-lake salt changed hands under the walls, pilgrims climbed to the stupa, and a Hongwu-era mosque served Muslim merchants.

In 1560 a meditating monk built a small retreat beside the stupa, seven monks at first, the seed of Kumbum Monastery. The Third Dalai Lama stopped there on his way to meet Altan Khan by the Koko Nor and ordered a larger monastery, completed in 1583; the Fourth Dalai Lama passed through in 1603 appointing its abbot, and halls and colleges went up under the Wanli Emperor and the Qing, drawing pilgrims from across the plateau and Mongolia. Qing troops occupied Xining in 1645. In 1724, after Nian Gengyao's armies crushed the Khoshut rising of Lobzang Danjin around the Koko Nor, the court stationed an imperial resident at Xining over the Mongol and Tibetan tribes of Qinghai, and in 1725 the guard became Xining Prefecture with its own county. Run from Gansu but ruling the Koko Nor lands, Xining passed on tea and horses into Tibet and forwarded the western-lake salt east.
zh:
西宁地处湟水河谷，藏语称这一带为宗喀，是甘肃平原通向青藏高原的通道。11世纪30年代，吐蕃王裔唃厮啰以青唐城为都，向宋朝出售河西马匹，与西域通商，并死守青唐、击退了西夏李元昊的大军；1104年北宋收复青唐，取西陲安宁之意改名西宁。1373年明朝改设西宁卫，1397年又将茶马司迁到这里，以四川茶叶交换吐蕃、蒙古各部的马匹。格鲁派创始人宗喀巴1357年就出生在这一带山间，1379年其母在降生处建起佛塔，相传塔旁长出的檀香树每片叶子上都显出佛像。1444年的西宁是一座边卫之城，城下集散茶叶、羊毛、牲畜和西海的湖盐，朝圣者攀山前往佛塔，洪武年间所建的清真寺接待着穆斯林商人。

1560年，修行僧人在塔旁建起一座只住七名僧人的小寺，是塔尔寺的雏形；三世达赖喇嘛前往青海湖畔会见俺答汗途中在此驻足，命人扩建寺院，大寺1583年落成；1603年四世达赖喇嘛从蒙古赴西藏途中经过该寺，任命了法台，万历年间及入清以后佛殿、经学院陆续兴建，全高原乃至蒙古的信众都来朝觐。1645年清军进占西宁。1724年，年羹尧的大军平定和硕特台吉罗卜藏丹津环青海湖的叛乱后，清廷在西宁设立钦差办事大臣，统辖青海的蒙古、藏族各部，1725年又改西宁卫为西宁府、置西宁县。隶属甘肃、管辖青海地面的西宁，把茶叶和马匹转送入藏，也把西海湖盐转销东方。

en:
Mergen lay at the head of the Nen, where the river breaks out of the Khingan ranges on its long run south to the Songhua. The Jurchen knew the water as the Na, and under the Jin the valley belonged to the Puyu military command. After the Ming pulled back from the Amur it became hunting country: Solon and Daur clans pastured cattle and horses along the stream, Oroqen bands ranged the higher woods, and sable pelts passed through their headmen to the frontier fairs. Mergen itself was only the name of a tributary river. In 1444 there was no walled town between the Khingan pines and the Nen fords, only clan camps and stockades.

The valley's clans were swept into the wars of the Manchu rise. Their kinsman Bombogor, the Solon chief born at Yaksa on the Amur, held out against Hong Taiji through the campaigns of 1639 and 1640: five hundred Solons and Daurs fought two Manchu regiments on the Huma, but the banners stormed four Amur strongholds, Yaksa among them, and Bombogor was caught making for Mongolia and taken to Mukden to be executed; the Nen clans were enrolled with the rest in the Eight Banners. Daur and Solon refugees from the Cossack raids of the 1650s swelled the upper valley. In 1685, preparing the advance on Albazin, the Kangxi Emperor walled Mergen and made it the sixth station on the new post road from Qiqihar to Aigun, the mustering point for troops and grain moving to the front. From 1690 to 1699 the military governor of Heilongjiang sat here. After he moved to Qiqihar the court placed a deputy lieutenant-general at Mergen in 1710, over the Butha hunting tribes whose parties carried the yearly sable tribute to Beijing.
zh:
墨尔根在嫩江上游，江水从兴安岭群峰之间冲出，一路南奔松花江。这条江古称难水、那河，金代河谷属蒲与路辖地。明朝从黑龙江流域撤守以后，这里成了猎场：索伦、达斡尔部落沿江牧放牛马，鄂伦春人的游猎队伍出入高处山林，貂皮经头人之手运往边市。墨尔根本是墨尔根河的名字，1444年时，兴安岭的松林与嫩江的渡口之间没有一座城，只有部落的营地和木寨。

河谷里的部落被卷进满洲崛起的战事。索伦酋长博木博果尔生在黑龙江上的雅克萨，他抗清到1640年：五百名索伦人和达斡尔人在呼玛河迎战两旗清军，清军仍连克雅克萨等四座黑龙江城寨；博木博果尔在逃往蒙古途中被擒，押赴盛京处死，嫩江各部也一同编入八旗。17世纪50年代，为躲避哥萨克劫掠，达斡尔、索伦难民涌向上游，充实了两岸村屯。1685年，为筹备进兵雅克萨，康熙敕建墨尔根城，把它定为齐齐哈尔至瑷珲驿道上的第六站，开往前线的兵丁和军粮在此集结。1690至1699年，黑龙江将军衙署驻在这里；移治齐齐哈尔后，朝廷又于1710年设墨尔根副都统，管辖布特哈打牲部落，猎户年年向京师贡纳貂皮。

en:
Iman is the valley of the Niman, one of the greatest tributaries of the Ussuri, called the Iman on Russian maps and the Bolshaya Ussurka on later ones; 'Niman' means 'goat' in Manchu, and a fishing village stood where the river joins the Ussuri. Cedar and spruce forests above the valley produced the goods the country was known for, ginseng and sable, while the camps lived on elk, deer and salmon. In 1444 the Woji clans held Ming patents that no one enforced and sold their best pelts to Jianzhou Jurchen traders coming up from the south.

Eidu's columns brought the Ussuri roads to Nurhaci: the Suifen clans submitted in 1610, and after Zhakuta fell in 1611 Jianzhou power ran as far as the Amur and the Ussuri. Chinese accounts place Onufriy Stepanov's Cossacks rowing up the Ussuri in 1655, the first Russians seen on the river, though the Russian records of his party say nothing of the voyage. In 1658 a Qing fleet carrying Manchu and Korean musketeers caught his eleven boats below the Sungari mouth and destroyed them, ending Cossack raiding on the Amur for years. The Treaty of Nerchinsk in 1689 left the Niman country to the Qing, ruled first through the Ningguta deputy and after 1732 through the new deputy at Sanxing, who collected a fixed tribute of choice ginseng and sable. No garrison or town was planted in the valley, only scattered Woji camps in closed forest.
zh:
尼满是尼满河的河谷。尼满河是乌苏里江最大的支流之一，俄国旧地图上作伊曼河，后来改称大乌苏尔卡河；「尼满」在满语中意为山羊，河汇乌苏里江处有一个渔屯。河谷上方的冷杉、云杉林出产这里最出名的两样货，人参和紫貂，林中营地则靠马鹿、驼鹿和鲑鱼为生。1444年，渥集诸部头人握着无人管束的明朝敕书，把最好的皮货卖给从南方上来的建州女真商人。

把乌苏里江各路带给努尔哈赤的是额亦都的大军：1610年绥芬路归附，1611年扎库塔城被攻下，建州势力一直延伸到黑龙江和乌苏里江。据中文记载，奥努弗里·斯捷潘诺夫的哥萨克1655年曾划船进入乌苏里江，是这条江上出现的第一批俄国人，但俄方关于这支队伍的记载对此次航行只字未提。1658年，一支载有满洲和朝鲜火枪手的清军舰队在松花江口外截住他的十一条船，将其击毁，黑龙江上的哥萨克劫掠因此中断多年。1689年《尼布楚条约》把尼满地方留给清朝，先经宁古塔副都统管辖，1732年起改归新设的三姓副都统，按定额征收上等的人参和貂皮。谷中始终没有派驻防、建城镇，只有散落的渥集营地和封禁的山林。

en:
Sartu is the middle of the Songnen plain, the flat marsh grassland between the Nen and the lower Sungari, where spring gales carry alkali dust off the dried-out lakes. Its Mongol name is usually read as 'where the moon rises', from sara the moon, though a Manchu explanation takes it for 'the windy place'. The early Ming posted the Fuyu Guard here, one of the three Uriankhai guards, and in 1444 Qasarid Mongol clans still roamed it with no fixed town or fortress.

In the 15th century Ajnagha, a sixteenth-generation descendant of Genghis Khan's brother Khasar, pitched his tents on both banks of the Nen, and his line took the name Dorbod, 'the four', from its place in the allotment of pastures. Late in the Ming his son Aduchi followed the Khorchin chief Ooba in submitting to Nurhaci's Later Jin. Aduchi's son Seleng was made a duke in 1636, and in 1648 the Dorbod were organised as a jasak banner under the Jirim league, with the Sartu steppe inside its bounds. The grassland stayed banner pasture for the rest of the period: a jasak ruled from felt camps, flocks and herds moved after water and grass, and no walled seat or civilian magistrate was ever set over it.
zh:
萨尔图在松嫩平原中部，嫩江与松花江下游之间，是低平的沼泽草原，春风卷起干涸湖泡上的碱尘。地名是蒙古语，通常解作「月亮升起的地方」（萨尔为月，图是「有」的后缀），也有满语式的说法，意为「多风沙之地」。明初这里是兀良哈三卫之一福余卫的牧地；1444年，合撒儿后裔的蒙古诸部在此游牧，没有固定的城郭要塞。

15世纪，成吉思汗之弟哈布图哈萨尔的第十六世孙爱纳噶率部在嫩江两岸驻牧，这一支按分牧次序排行第四，得名杜尔伯特。明末，爱纳噶之子阿都齐随科尔沁首领奥巴归附后金；1636年阿都齐之子色棱以功封辅国公，1648年杜尔伯特部编为一扎萨克旗，隶属哲里木盟，萨尔图草原就在旗界之内。此后的近两百年里，草原一直是旗地：札萨克在毡帐中理政，人畜逐水草迁徙，这里没有筑起城郭，也没设过文官衙门。

en:
The Alchuka, the river later called the Ashi, crosses the flat grain country south of the Sungari. The Jurchens knew the water as the Anchuhu, meaning gold, and when Wanyan Aguda took the imperial title on its banks in 1115 he named his dynasty the Jin after it: the Liao had taken iron for their name because it was hard, he said, but even iron decays, while gold never changes. His capital, Shangjing Huining, joined a north and a south walled city around an imperial quarter, six square kilometres of rammed-earth walls ringed by moats. The palaces begun in 1124 were built on the pattern of the Northern Song capital at Kaifeng, and Han settlers by the tens of thousands were moved up to fill the new city, until Han households made up more than half of Huining's people. Four emperors ruled here for thirty-eight years. In 1153 the prince of Hailing moved the court to Zhongdu and had the palaces destroyed and the Shangjing title revoked; it was restored in 1173, and at the fall of the Jin the ruins passed to the Mongols. In 1444 Haixi Jurchen bands farmed and hunted beside the overgrown earthen walls.

When Nurhaci and Hong Taiji gathered the Jurchens into the Later Jin, the Ashi bands were drawn into the Eight Banners. The valley long stayed a quiet Manchu backwater. Under the Yongzheng emperor a vice commander-in-chief was posted here, and a walled garrison town named Alchuka rose on the river, taking its Manchu name from the old waterway; banner troops and official estates then spread across the plain, and the gold-water country of the Jin became grain country again.
zh:
阿勒楚喀河（后来称阿什河）流经松花江以南平坦的谷物之乡。女真人称此水为按出虎，意为金子。1115年，完颜阿骨打在河畔称帝，便以金作国号：他说辽以镔铁为号，取的是铁坚硬，可铁终究会锈坏，只有金子不变不坏。都城上京会宁府由南北两城和中间的皇城组成，约六平方公里的夯土城墙外绕着护城河。1124年起修建的皇城仿照北宋都城开封的规制，又有数以十万计的汉人被迁来充实新城，会宁府一多半的人口都是汉户。这里历经四代皇帝、凡三十八年。1153年海陵王迁都中都，拆毁宫殿、削去上京称号；1173年称号恢复，金末废墟归入蒙古。1444年，海西女真诸部在野草丛生的夯土城墙旁耕猎。

努尔哈赤、皇太极统一女真建立后金时，阿什河畔的部众被陆续编入八旗。此后河谷长期是满洲边地一处僻静角落。雍正年间，朝廷在此派驻副都统，河畔筑起名为阿勒楚喀的驻防城，满语城名取自古河名；旗兵和官庄随后遍布平原，金朝的「金水」之乡又成了产粮之地。

en:
Tsetserleg lies in a high valley of the northeastern Khangai, beneath Bulgan Mountain between the North and South Tamir rivers, at about 1,700 metres; its Mongolian name means a flowered pasture. In 1444 this was summer grazing and hunting forest of the Khalkha rather than a town. Herders moved horses, cattle, sheep and camels up the Tamir valleys for the warm season, and trappers carried furs out of the Khangai woods. The country belonged to the descendants of Gersenji Khongtaiji, who had divided the Khalkha among his sons, and clan shrines and pasture rights, rather than walls or a fixed market, ordered life in the valley.

The valley drew people in once the Gelug order arrived. A monastic camp, the Zaya khuree, was founded below Bulgan Mountain in 1586 and enlarged in 1631. In 1679 the Zaya Gegeen returned from Tibet and built four great da-tsangs on the old site; the main Guden temple went up in 1696, with the Laviran and Semchin temples beside it. Lamas, pilgrims and caravan traders settled around the temples and made a seasonal pasture into a fixed religious and market town. The local lord Tumenkhen earned the title Sain Noyon for defending the Gelug order, and in 1725 the Qing formed his lands into Sain Noyon aimag, taken from Tüsheet and Zasagt territory. From 1728 its nobles gathered at Tsetserleg every three years for the assembly the Chinese records call the Qiqierlig league.
zh:
车车尔勒格坐落在杭爱山东北坡的高山谷地中，布尔干山下、北塔米尔河与南塔米尔河之间，海拔约1700米，蒙古语意为繁花牧场。1444年，这里是喀尔喀人的高山夏牧场和狩猎山林，还不是城镇。牧人在暖季把马、牛、羊和骆驼赶上塔米尔河谷，猎人从杭爱密林里带出毛皮。这一带属于格埒森扎后裔的领地，他把喀尔喀分封给诸子，谷地里维系秩序的是氏族祭祀和牧场权利，没有城墙，也没有固定市集。

格鲁派传入之后，谷地才聚来人烟。1586年，扎雅库伦在布尔干山下奠基，1631年扩建。1679年，扎雅葛根从西藏返回，在旧寺基础上建立四大扎仓；主殿古登殿1696年落成，拉维兰殿和森琴殿建于其侧。喇嘛、朝圣者和往来商队在殿宇周围定居，把季节性牧场变成固定的宗教与集市城镇。本地领主图蒙肯因护持格鲁派获封「赛音诺颜」；1725年，清朝以其领地设赛音诺颜部，从土谢图汗部和札萨克图汗部划出。1728年起，部内贵族每三年到车车尔勒格会盟，清代称齐齐尔里克盟。

en:
Bayankhongor is sheep, horse and camel country: its pastures run from the cold southern spurs of the Khangai down to the edge of the Gobi, high grass in the north giving way to semi-desert, with no walled town anywhere in 1444. Herders shifted camp with the seasons, and their stock was wealth in itself rather than goods sold in cities. These steppes belonged to the Oirat world of Toghon and his son Esen, whose confederacy held the Khalkha lords in its shadow.

After Esen's fall the Khalkha moved into the grazing grounds. Tümengken, a great-grandson of Gersenji Khongtaiji, endowed the Gelug church, and the Fourth Dalai Lama gave him the title Sain Noyon, 'the good lord'; his followers became the core of the later banners. In 1688 Galdan's invasion drove the Khalkha to seek Qing protection, and the bannermen returned after the Dzungar defeat of 1696. In 1725 the Yongzheng emperor split the western banners off from the Tüsheet Khan domain to make Sain Noyon aimag, a counterweight to the great khanates, with its assembly at Tsetserleg. The house's most celebrated soldier was Tsereng, great-grandson of Tümengken: he defeated a Dzungar army near Erdene Zuu and became the first military governor at Uliastai. The banners kept the pastoral order below the Khangai, their dues paid in horses and livestock, into the nineteenth century.
zh:
巴彦洪戈尔是牧放羊群、马群和骆驼的地方：牧场从杭爱山南缘的寒冷山地一直铺到戈壁边缘，北部是高寒草原，南部渐成半荒漠，1444年全境没有一座城垣。牧民随季节转场，牲畜本身就是家财，而不是入市买卖的货物。这片草原属于脱懽、也先父子的瓦剌世界，喀尔喀诸贵族处在这个联盟的兵威之下。

也先败亡后，喀尔喀人进入这片牧场。格哷森札札赉尔的曾孙图蒙肯供养格鲁派，第四世达赖喇嘛授他「赛音诺颜」称号，意为「好领主」，他的部众后来成为各旗的核心。1688年噶尔丹入侵，喀尔喀向清朝求援归附，1696年准噶尔战败后旗兵返回旧牧地。1725年，雍正帝把西部各旗从土谢图汗领地析出置赛音诺颜部，以与大部落相制衡，会盟地在齐齐尔里克。这一家族最出名的军人是图蒙肯的曾孙策棱：他在额尔德尼召附近大败准噶尔军，成为乌里雅苏台首任定边左副将军。杭爱山下各旗保持游牧秩序，以马匹牲畜当差纳贡，进入19世纪。

en:
The Ruo Shui, called the Ejin in its lower course, runs north out of the Gansu corridor into the Gobi and spends itself in the reed beds and marshes of Juyan Lake. The Han made this their farthest frontier against the Xiongnu, settling soldier-farmers here from 102 BC; thousands of their inscribed wooden slips have survived in the dry sand, recording the daily rounds of the watchposts. The Western Xia built Khara-Khoto, the 'black city', near the lake in 1036. Genghis Khan took it in 1226, Kublai had it rebuilt at three times its old size, and it stood where the roads from Karakorum, Shangdu and Kumul met; Marco Polo knew it as Etzina, a town of camels, cattle and good falcons on the edge of a desert that stretched forty days' journey to the north. In 1372 a Ming army reached the walls and the defender Buyan Temur surrendered; the people were moved south into the corridor and the black city was abandoned. Torghut herders later told of its last commander Khara Bator: the besiegers diverted the Ejin, and he killed his family and himself, or broke out through the north-west wall, where a gap wide enough for a rider remains. In 1444 the ruins and river meadows are Oirat pasture, far beyond the Jiayu Pass.

For three centuries no town returned. In 1704 Arabjur, a Torghut prince of the Kalmyk khanate on the Volga, was on his way back from a pilgrimage to Tibet when the Dzungars blocked his road; stranded outside the Jiayu Pass, he submitted to the Qing, who made him a beizi and settled his band at Serteng near Dunhuang. His son Danzhong, hard pressed by the Dzungars, asked to move inward, and in 1731 the court assigned him the Ejin valley; the little horde took its name from the river and in 1753 was enrolled as the Ejin Torghut Banner, answering to no league but directly to the Lifan Yuan at Beijing. Herders watered their herds along the Ejin while the ramparts of the black city crumbled on the old lake bed.
zh:
弱水下游称额济纳河，自河西走廊向北流入戈壁，消失在居延海的芦苇荡和沼泽间。汉朝曾以此为抵御匈奴的最远边塞，自公元前102年起迁徙戍卒屯田；他们写下的数以千计的木简在干沙中留存下来，记着烽燧每日的巡逻。西夏于1036年在湖畔筑起黑水城。该城1226年被成吉思汗攻取，忽必烈时扩建到旧城的三倍，地处和林、上都、哈密三路交会之处；马可·波罗称它亦集乃，说这里多有骆驼、牛群和良隼，城北便是要走四十日的大沙漠。1372年明军兵临城下，守将卜颜帖木儿献城投降，居民被南迁河西走廊，黑水城就此废弃。土尔扈特牧人后来相传，最后的守将哈日巴特尔被围城的明军截断河水，杀了家人后自刎；另一种说法是他从西北角墙突围而出，那里的缺口宽可容一骑通过。1444年，城址废墟与河畔草场都是瓦剌人的牧场，远在嘉峪关外。

此后三百多年间再没有城镇。1704年，游牧于伏尔加河的卡尔梅克汗国土尔扈特台吉阿喇布珠尔自西藏礼佛归来，被准噶尔堵住去路，滞留在嘉峪关外，于是归附清朝，清廷封他为固山贝子，把他的部众安置在敦煌附近的色尔腾。其子丹忠受准噶尔逼迫，请求内徙，清廷于1731年将额济纳河流域划为牧地，这一小支部队便以河为名，1753年正式编为额济纳土尔扈特旗，不入会盟，直属京师的理藩院。牧人沿额济纳河饮马放牧，黑水城的城墙在古湖床旁倾塌。

en:
Korla guards the narrow, well-watered exit where the Konqi River leaves Bosten Lake and cuts through the Tiemen Pass on the road from Kucha to Turpan. Han records called the oasis Yuli and counted 9,600 people; by the third century it followed neighbouring Karashahr, whose basin Chinese writers described as ringed by mountains and defended by hard passes on the way toward Kucha. The lake and the Kaidu and Konqi rivers supplied fish, salt and reeds and watered rice, millet, wheat, barley and pulses, while herders raised horses, cattle and sheep. After Uyghur rule in the ninth century and the later Mongol conquest, the district became a Chagatai border fief. In 1444 the Korla-Karashahr corridor sat on the loosely governed eastern edge of the Moghul world, where Turkic Muslim cultivators sold grain and livestock and Buddhist Mongol families pastured animals around the lake.

In 1605 Bento de Góis, a Portuguese Jesuit travelling overland from India to determine whether Marco Polo's Cathay was China, spent three months in Cialis, a caravan city usually identified with Karashahr or Korla, while moving with Kashgarian merchants toward Turpan and Jiayuguan. Chagatai power gave way before the Dzungar campaigns of 1680. Qing forces secured the route in 1758 and posted garrisons and military settlers around Yanqi. In 1771 Torghut Mongols returning from the Volga were resettled in Bayingolin, placing their Buddhist camps beside Muslim oasis towns. The Tiemen road kept carrying grain, livestock and caravan goods between Kashgar, Turpan and the Qing frontier.
zh:
库尔勒扼守孔雀河出博斯腾湖后切穿铁门关的狭窄水口，处在库车通往吐鲁番的道路上。汉代文献称这片绿洲为尉犁，记载有9600人；到3世纪时它依附邻近的焉耆。汉文记载说焉耆盆地四面环山，通往龟兹的山道险狭、易守难攻。湖泊与海都河、孔雀河水系出产鱼、盐和芦苇，也灌溉稻、粟、麦和豆类，牧人则畜养马、牛、羊。9世纪回鹘统治及其后的蒙古征服之后，这里成为察合台人的边缘封地。1444年，库尔勒—焉耆通道位于蒙兀儿世界松散控制的东缘，突厥语穆斯林农耕者出售谷物和牲畜，信仰佛教的蒙古家庭则在湖畔牧放畜群。

1605年，葡萄牙耶稣会士鄂本笃从印度走陆路东来，要弄清马可·波罗所说的契丹是否就是中国；他随喀什噶尔商人经吐鲁番前往嘉峪关时，在通常被比定为焉耆或库尔勒的商队城昔阿里斯停留了三个月。察合台势力在1680年的准噶尔战事后退去。1758年清军控制这条通道，在焉耆周围派驻军队、安置屯垦者。1771年，从伏尔加河流域东归的土尔扈特蒙古人被安置在巴音郭楞，佛教蒙古营地与穆斯林绿洲城镇相邻。铁门关道路继续运送谷物、牲畜和商货，联系喀什噶尔、吐鲁番与清朝边疆。

en:
South of the Khangai foothills the steppe thins into the Black Gobi, a riverless expanse of gravel and salt marsh where herders grazed horses, sheep and Bactrian camels around scattered wells. In 1444 the Four Oirats stood at the height of their power under Esen taishi, who ruled the Mongols in the name of Taisun Khan. During the 1440s his men took Hami on the Silk Road, brought the Mongol princes of Gansu to heel, and drove tribute horses south along the desert tracks to the Ming court. When the Ming cut the gifts granted to his envoys and refused a princess for his son, Esen prepared for war; the camps around these wells still worshipped Tengri.

In July 1449 he invaded China, destroyed the Ming army at Tumu, and captured the Zhengtong Emperor. The Ming court enthroned the emperor's brother, and the captive lost his value as a bargaining chip; Esen made peace in 1450 and sent the Zhengtong Emperor home. He proclaimed himself khan in 1453 and was killed in a vassal's rebellion within two years, and Oirat power withdrew westward after him. These pastures then passed to the westernmost of the Khalkha: Gersenji's eldest son Ashikhai founded the ruling line, and in 1596 Subadai took the title Zasagt Khan. The khanate's feuds gave Galdan his opening after the Tüsheet Khan Chakhundorj killed the Zasagt Khan Shar in 1687; the Dzungars overran the country the next year, and in 1691 Shar's brother submitted with the other Khalkha lords at Dolonnur. Under the Qing the nineteen banners of the Zasagt league gathered every three years at Biduriyaa Nuur, by the source of the Zag River.
zh:
杭爱山麓以南，草原渐渐稀成黑戈壁，一片没有河流的砾石滩和盐沼，牧人围着零星井泉牧放马、羊和双峰驼。1444年，四卫拉特在太师也先治下正值强盛，也先奉岱总汗之名号令蒙古。1440年代，他的人马夺取丝绸之路上的哈密、压服甘肃的蒙古诸王公，贡马沿南方沙漠古道送往明朝。明朝削减贡使的赏物、又拒绝把公主嫁给他的儿子，也先便开始备战；这些井泉边营地里的牧人仍信奉腾格里。

1449年7月他大举入边，在土木堡歼灭明军，俘走明英宗。明廷随即改立英宗之弟，被俘的皇帝失去了要挟的价值；1450年议和之后，也先把英宗放回。1453年他自立为汗，不出两年就在部属叛乱中被杀，瓦剌势力也随他西退。这片牧场随后归入喀尔喀最西的一支：格哷森札的长子阿什海开创了统治一脉，1596年素巴第称札萨克图汗。1687年土谢图汗察珵多尔济攻杀札萨克图汗沙喇，汗部内讧给了噶尔丹可乘之机；次年准噶尔军席卷喀尔喀，1691年沙喇之弟随喀尔喀诸部在多伦诺尔臣服清朝。清代，札萨克图盟十九旗每三年会盟于札克河源的毕都尔诺尔湖畔。

en:
The Black Sea coast between Taman and Abkhazia is a narrow shelf of beaches and oak forests pressed beneath the Caucasus, home to the coastal Adyghe clans: the Natukhaj in the north, the Shapsug along the central shore and the Ubykh around the mouth of the Sochi river. Greek ships once traded at Sinda and Gorgippia here, and the north wall of an eleventh-century Byzantine basilica still stands at Loo. From the thirteenth to the fifteenth century Genoa held the Black Sea monopoly, keeping the fortified factory of Mapa on the site of Anapa and, further south, the posts of Layso and Costa near modern Sochi, where silk and salt were exchanged for timber, wax, horses and captives. Timur's columns swept down to the shore in 1395, yet no invader cared to hold the forested ravines behind it. In 1444 Genoese vessels still ride at anchor in these roadsteads, while the Orthodox coastal clans answer only loosely to the grand prince of Circassia and live by fishing, herding and the trade passing through their inlets.

The Ottoman fleet that took Caffa in 1475 seized Mapa as well, and by 1481 a fort guarded the roadstead, administered through the Kafa sanjak. The shore clans kept their arms and much of their old faith: when Evliya Celebi passed through in 1641 the castle had no regular garrison, the Shapsug around it paid tithe only under compulsion, and Don Cossacks had sacked it more than once. Around 1781-1784, when Russia annexed the Crimea, Ferah Ali Pasha rebuilt and enlarged Anapa into the great slave mart of the Circassian coast, where Caucasian captives were shipped to imperial harems and galleys. It became the most fought-over fort on the shore: Russian troops stormed it in 1791 and the peace of Jassy handed it back; they took it again in 1807 and 1809, and the Treaty of Bucharest returned it once more in 1812. In 1821 Anapa is again an Ottoman stronghold, with the unconquered Ubykh and Shapsug in the hills behind it.
zh:
从塔曼到阿布哈兹之间的黑海海岸，是一条被高加索群山压在海边的狭窄地带，遍布沙滩与橡林，住着阿迪格人的沿海氏族：北方的纳图哈伊人、中部海岸的沙普苏格人、索契河口一带的乌比赫人。希腊商船古时到此地的辛达与戈尔吉皮亚贸易，洛奥的林谷中残存着11世纪拜占庭巴西利卡的墙垣。13至15世纪，热那亚垄断黑海贸易，在安纳帕故址设有设防商站马帕，又在南方今索契附近设有莱索、科斯塔等商站，以丝绸、食盐交换木材、蜂蜡、马匹和俘虏。1395年帖木儿的大军曾席卷至海岸，但没有征服者愿意深入背后林木丛生的峡谷。1444年，热那亚船只仍在这些锚地停泊，沿岸信奉东正教的氏族只在名义上服从切尔克西亚大公，靠渔猎、畜牧和经由各小港湾转口的贸易为生。

1475年，攻陷卡法的奥斯曼舰队把马帕也一并夺取；到1481年，一座要塞已守在锚地旁，归卡法桑贾克管辖。沿海各部保留着武器和大半旧信仰：1641年埃夫利亚·切莱比路过时，城堡没有常驻守军，附近的沙普苏格人只在武力逼迫下才缴什一税，顿河哥萨克还曾几度洗劫此地。1781至1784年俄国吞并克里木前后，费拉赫·阿里帕夏重修扩建安纳帕，把它变成切尔克斯海岸最大的奴隶市场，高加索俘虏从这里被运往帝国的后宫和桨帆船。它也成了海岸上争夺最激烈的要塞：俄军1791年强攻得手，《雅西和约》却把它交还；1807年和1809年两度再占，1812年《布加勒斯特和约》又一次还给苏丹。1821年的安纳帕重新成为奥斯曼要塞，背后山中是始终未被征服的乌比赫人和沙普苏格人。

en:
Guria is the well-watered Black Sea coast between the Rioni and the Chorokhi, backed by the mountains of Meshketi. Its fisheries and the anchorages of Batumi and Tsikhisdziri drew Trapezuntine and Italian merchants, while the Gurieli princes kept their seat inland at Ozurgeti. At Shemokmedi, the monastery founded in the fifteenth century served both as a bishop's seat and as the burial church of the Gurieli dynasty, and its cellars were used to hide church treasures when the coast was raided. In 1444 the land was Orthodox and formally part of the crumbling Kingdom of Georgia, though the Gurieli already ruled it in practice. That same year a Burgundian flotilla under Geoffroy de Thoisy tried to sack Batumi, which the raiders called Vaty: the landing party was routed, de Thoisy was captured, and only the Emperor of Trebizond secured his release.

After helping Bagrat of Imereti defeat George VIII at Chikhori in 1463, the Gurieli won a semi-independent principality, with Giorgi I Gurieli recognized as a sovereign prince in 1491. A joint raid with Odishi on the sea-rovers of Jiketi in 1533 ended in disaster: the Dadiani was killed and Mamia I Gurieli was captured. The Ottomans took Batumi and lost it again in the 1540s, and Mamia II retook the town and Adjara in 1609; on 3 December 1614 he nevertheless signed a treaty at Batumi ceding Adjara and promising yearly tribute. After Mamia was murdered in 1625, Odishi defeated Guria at Lanchkhuti, blinded Simon II and reduced the country to a client. The Ottomans secured Batumi permanently in 1703 and garrisoned the coast in 1723. Guria sided with Russia in the war of 1768-1774, and Ottoman reprisals, slave raiding and forced Islamization emptied whole districts. Mamia V asked for Russian protection in December 1809, and the principality was formally taken under the tsar on 8 April 1811. When the Imeretian rebellion of 1820 spread into Guria, Russian troops crushed it, stormed Shemokmedi and demolished the monastery's fortifications.
zh:
古里亚在黑海东岸，据有里奥尼河与乔罗赫河之间水源丰沛的海岸，背后是梅斯赫季山地。渔场加上巴统、齐希斯吉里两处锚地，引来特拉比松和意大利商人；古里埃利王公的驻地在内地的奥祖尔盖蒂。15世纪修建的舍莫克梅季修道院既是主教座堂，也是古里埃利王朝的安葬教堂，海岸遭袭时还在地窖里替各修道院藏匿圣器。1444年，这片土地信奉东正教，名义上属于日趋瓦解的格鲁吉亚王国，实际已由古里埃利家族做主。同年，若弗鲁瓦·德·图瓦西率领一支勃艮第舰队攻打欧洲人称作瓦蒂的巴统：登陆队被击溃，图瓦西被俘，最后靠特拉比松皇帝出面才获释。

古里埃利家族协助伊梅列季的巴格拉特在1463年的奇科里战役击败格奥尔基八世，换得半独立公国，吉奥尔基一世·古里埃利1491年被承认为主权王公。1533年与奥季希联手征讨吉赫季海盗，反遭惨败：达季阿尼战死，马米亚一世·古里埃利被俘。奥斯曼人1540年代一度占领巴统又失守，马米亚二世1609年收复巴统和阿扎尔，却仍在1614年12月3日于巴统签约，割让阿扎尔、承诺年年纳贡。1625年马米亚被杀后，奥季希在兰奇胡提击败古里亚，弄瞎西莫内二世，把这里降为附庸。1703年奥斯曼长期占据巴统，1723年在海岸驻扎守军。1768至1774年战争中古里亚站在俄国一边，随之而来的报复、奴隶掳掠和强迫伊斯兰化使许多地区荒无人烟。马米亚五世1809年12月请求俄国保护，公国于1811年4月8日正式归入沙皇治下。1820年伊梅列季起义蔓延到古里亚，俄军将其镇压，攻入舍莫克梅季，拆毁了修道院的防御工事。

en:
Kabardia is the foothill country between the Baksan, Chegem, Malka and upper Terek, where Adyghe clans moving east from the western Caucasus settled the plains as Golden Horde power receded. By 1444 their princes and warrior nobles were consolidating the Eastern Circassian polity later called Greater Kabardia, while Balkar and Ossetian neighbours held the high gorges. Flocks of sheep, herds of cattle and sturdy mountain horses grazed between valley auls and summer pastures, supplying the wool and mounts sold north to the steppe. Christianity brought by Byzantine and Georgian contacts still shaped much of religious life, though older mountain customs remained strong, and raiders from the Kuma kept princely retinues in arms.

Crimean and Ottoman pressure drew Kabardia into the dynastic struggles of its neighbours, and its princes learned to play Moscow against the khanate. In 1561 Prince Temryuk Idarovich married his daughter Kuchenay, baptized Maria, to Ivan the Terrible; she died eight years later, and rumour said Ivan had poisoned her. Muscovite musketeers and Cossacks had already intervened for Temryuk in the princely wars of 1562-1567, defeating a rival coalition and its Dagestani ally Shamkhal Buday. Over the following century Crimean and Ottoman influence made Sunni Islam dominant, yet Kabardia could still strike hard: in 1708 Kurghoqo Hatokhshoqo destroyed a Crimean-Ottoman army under Qaplan I Giray in a night attack near Mount Kanzhal. The Treaty of Belgrade in 1739 recognized Kabardia as a free buffer between Russia and the Ottoman Empire, but Russia's completion of Mozdok fortress in 1763 opened a new frontier war. In 1818, as Russian frontier armies tightened their grip, Aleksey Yermolov founded the fort of Nalchik in this foothill basin.
zh:
卡巴尔达位于巴克桑河、切格姆河、马尔卡河与捷列克河上游之间的山麓地带。金帐汗国势力衰退时，从西高加索东迁的阿迪格诸部进入平原；到1444年，王公和武士贵族正在整合这个后来被称为大卡巴尔达的东切尔克斯政权，巴尔卡尔人与奥塞梯邻人则据守高山峡谷。河谷村落与夏季牧场之间放牧着绵羊、牛和强健的山马，羊毛和马匹向北卖到草原。拜占庭和格鲁吉亚传来的基督教仍影响着大部分宗教生活，但古老山地习俗依旧牢固，来自库马草原的袭扰也使王公骑兵常年保持武备。

克里木和奥斯曼的压力把卡巴尔达卷入周边王朝的角逐，卡巴尔达王公也学会在莫斯科与汗国之间周旋。1561年，王公捷姆留克·伊达罗维奇将女儿库切涅伊嫁给伊凡雷帝，她受洗后改名玛丽亚；八年后她死去，有传言说是伊凡毒杀了她。莫斯科射击军和哥萨克已在1562至1567年的王公内战中出兵支持捷姆留克，击败敌对王公联盟及其达吉斯坦盟友沙姆哈尔·布代。此后一个世纪里，在克里木与奥斯曼影响下，逊尼派伊斯兰教逐渐成为主流，但卡巴尔达仍能重击来犯者：1708年，库尔戈科·阿塔茹金趁夜袭在坎扎尔山附近击溃卡普兰一世·格莱率领的克里木—奥斯曼大军。1739年《贝尔格莱德条约》承认卡巴尔达为俄罗斯与奥斯曼之间的自由缓冲地，但俄国1763年建成莫兹多克要塞后，新的边境战争随之爆发。1818年，阿列克谢·叶尔莫洛夫在这片山麓盆地建起纳尔奇克要塞，此时俄国边防军已步步收紧对卡巴尔达的控制。

en:
Khundzia is the high Avar country around Khunzakh, a strong aul on a plateau about 1,600 metres above the Caspian lowlands. From the fifth to the twelfth century the town, then called Humraj, was the capital of the Christian kingdom of Sarir, and from the early thirteenth century it was the seat of Avar rulers bearing the title nutsal. Crosses and ruined chapels across the Avar valleys show that Christianity brought from Georgia lived on among highlanders into the fourteenth and fifteenth centuries. In 1444 the nutsal ruled through a loose network of village assemblies, the djamaats, and pasturelands rather than a centralised kingdom, and most Avar tribes were only then turning to Islam. Livestock, high pastures and raiding gave the highlanders both wealth and leverage over the lowlands.

The Ottomans and Safavids fought over Dagestan through the sixteenth century, while the shamkhals of Gazi-Kumukh overshadowed the nutsals until the two empires withdrew. Once Islam took firm hold in the eighteenth century, Avar war parties joined the raids into Georgia that Georgians call Lekianoba; leaders named in Georgian chronicles and Avar epic include Umma-Khan, Nursal-Bek and Mallachi. In September 1741 Nader Shah's army pushed into the mountains, and highland contingents harried its columns through Andalal around Chokh and Sogratl until the shah withdrew; the Avar epic The Battle with Nader Shah and the Lak Song of the Hero Murtazali made the mountain victory the best-remembered story in Dagestan. Umma Khan V came to the throne at Khunzakh at the age of twelve, and his own people called him the Great or the Mad. King Erekle II of Georgia, the khans of Derbent, Quba, Baku, Shirvan, Shaki and Karabakh, the Ottoman pasha of Akhaltsikhe and the highland valleys of Tusheti all paid him tribute. He kept Avaria out of Sheikh Mansur's rising against Russia and died at Balaken in March 1801; two years later the khanate submitted to the tsar.
zh:
库因吉是以洪扎赫为中心的阿瓦尔高地。洪扎赫是一座坚固山村，坐落在高出里海低地约1600米的高原上。5至12世纪，这里时名胡姆拉季，是基督教王国萨里尔的都城；13世纪初起，又成为称「努察尔」的阿瓦尔统治者驻地。阿瓦尔山谷里随处可见十字架和小堂残迹，说明从格鲁吉亚传来的基督教在山民中一直延续到14、15世纪。1444年，努察尔的权力建立在各山村议事会（贾马阿特）和牧场组成的松散网络之上，不是一个集权王国，多数阿瓦尔部落此时才陆续改信伊斯兰教。牲畜、高山牧场和外出袭掠，既是山民的财富来源，也是他们制约低地的手段。

16世纪，奥斯曼与萨法维在达吉斯坦反复争夺，加齐库穆赫的沙姆哈尔长期压过努察尔，直到两大帝国先后退出。18世纪伊斯兰教在高地巩固后，阿瓦尔武装频频加入袭掠格鲁吉亚的行动，格鲁吉亚史家称之为「列基亚诺巴」；乌马汗、努尔萨尔-别克、马拉奇等首领的名字，既见于格鲁吉亚编年史，也写进阿瓦尔史诗。1741年9月，纳迪尔沙阿的大军深入群山，高地联军在乔赫和索格拉特利一带的安达拉尔不断截击其纵队，沙阿最终撤退；阿瓦尔史诗《与纳迪尔沙阿之战》和拉克人的《英雄穆尔塔扎利之歌》，把这场山地胜仗唱成了达吉斯坦最有名的故事。乌马汗五世十二岁在洪扎赫继位，族人叫他「伟大者」或「狂人」。格鲁吉亚国王伊拉克略二世，杰尔宾特、库巴、巴库、希尔凡、舍基、卡拉巴赫诸汗，阿哈尔齐赫的奥斯曼帕夏，乃至图舍季的山村，都向他纳贡。他拒绝参加谢赫曼苏尔的反俄起义，1801年3月死于巴拉肯；两年后，汗国归附沙皇。

en:
Tarki, also written Tarku, climbs the Tarki-tau ridge above the Kumyk coastal plain, a short distance from the Caspian. Fishing villages and the Derbent-Astrakhan road lay below it, and tracks over the ridge climbed into the Dagestani mountains, so the town linked Caspian caravans with highland herdsmen and markets. Some scholars place Samandar, the Khazar capital of the eighth century, on this site; Armenian chronicles mention it as early as the seventh century, the Catalan Atlas marked it in 1375, and Timur passed through in 1396. In 1444 it was the lowland stronghold of the Kumyk shamkhals, who as Muslims ruled from the mountain fastness of Gazi-Kumukh and bore the title Vali of Dagestan. Tarku watched the coastal road and gave the dynasty its foothold on the sea.

The shamkhal's first embassy to Moscow laid rich gifts before Ivan the Terrible in 1556, among them an elephant never before seen in the Russian capital. A year later troops sent at the request of a Kabardian prince took Tarki and withdrew. Chopan-shamkhal, elected in 1569, held the height of Kumyk power: his sister married Shah Tahmasp I, and at Safavid feasts a seat beside the throne was kept for him as the defender against Russia. He marched with the Ottomans and Crimeans against Astrakhan in 1570, later campaigned for the sultan against the Qizilbash, and through much of the 1580s and 1590s acknowledged Ottoman suzerainty. Russian expeditions into the mountains were checked, and in 1605 Soltan-Mut of Endirey surrounded and destroyed an 8,000-strong Russian army at Karaman, north of the Kumyk settlement of Anji. After the Gazi-Kumukh polity broke up in the 1640s the shamkhals made Tarki their permanent seat. Stepan Razin's Cossacks sacked the town in 1668. Peter the Great received the shamkhal's submission when he marched past on his Persian campaign; the ruler accepted Russian subject status in 1776, the Treaty of Gulistan confirmed the takeover in 1813, and Burnaya Fortress rose above Tarki in 1821.
zh:
塔尔基又译塔尔库，沿塔尔基套山的山脊展开，俯瞰库梅克滨海平原，距里海不远。山下是渔村和杰尔宾特通往阿斯特拉罕的大道，翻山小径攀入达吉斯坦群山，这座城因此把里海商队同高地牧民和市集连在一起。有学者认为，8世纪可萨汗国的都城萨曼达尔就在此处；亚美尼亚编年史早在7世纪已提到它，1375年的《加泰罗尼亚地图集》标有此城，1396年帖木儿也曾途经此地。1444年，这里是库梅克沙姆哈尔的低地要塞：这位穆斯林统治者在山中险地加齐库穆赫执政，领有「达吉斯坦瓦利」的称号，塔尔基则扼守滨海道路，为王朝守住通向大海的落脚点。

1556年，沙姆哈尔首派使团前往莫斯科，向伊凡雷帝献上厚礼，其中有一头俄都前所未见的大象。一年后，俄军应一名卡巴尔达王公之请攻占塔尔基，随即撤走。1569年继位的乔潘-沙姆哈尔把库梅克势力推到顶峰：他的妹妹嫁给沙阿塔赫玛斯普一世，萨法维宫廷大典时御座旁还专设他的席位，身份是抵御俄国的藩屏。他1570年随奥斯曼人与克里木人进攻阿斯特拉罕，后来又为苏丹讨伐基兹尔巴什，1580至1590年代大体承认奥斯曼宗主权。俄军深入山地的远征屡屡受阻，1605年，恩迪列伊的苏丹-穆特在库梅克人居地安吉以北的卡拉曼包围并歼灭八千俄军。1640年代加齐库穆赫政权解体后，沙姆哈尔一族把塔尔基定为常驻驻地。1668年，斯捷潘·拉辛的哥萨克洗劫此城。彼得大帝远征波斯时途经此地，接受沙姆哈尔臣服；1776年，塔尔基统治者接受俄国臣属地位，1813年《古利斯坦条约》确认俄国占领，1821年布尔纳亚要塞在城上方建成。

en:
Alania guards the northern mouth of the Darial Pass, where the Terek cuts through the Caucasus east of Mount Kazbek. Dar-i Alan means 'Gate of the Alans', and together with the coastal road at Derbent it forms one of only two crossings of the whole range; armies and traders have filed through it and walls have guarded it since before the birth of Christ. The medieval Alan kingdom, long Christian through Byzantine and Georgian contacts, was broken by the Mongol capture of Maghas in 1239-1240 and Timur's campaigns at the end of the fourteenth century. Its Iranian-speaking survivors withdrew into steep gorges where tower villages grazed cattle on high summer pastures. In 1444 no king rules from lost Maghas; these people are forming the Ossetian highland societies later called Iron and Digor, keeping Orthodox rites beside older customs, while Kabardian princes hold the neighbouring plains and by the end of the century the pass itself.

War kept coming through the gate. In 1614 Safavid troops of Abbas I entered the mountains on his Georgian campaigns, and local tradition has a cave fortress in the Kurtat Gorge blocking their path and forcing them back. As Kabardian contacts brought Islam to the western communities, Orthodox elders turned to Russia: priests sent from Moscow arrived in 1744, and Empress Elizabeth received an Ossetian embassy seven years later. Northern Ossetia came under Russian rule in 1774, and ten years later the Russians built Vladikavkaz, 'ruler of the Caucasus', on the Terek near the village of Zaur; Ossetians call the town Dzaudzhikau. Regular passage through Darial opened in 1799, and after Georgia was annexed in 1801 the Georgian Military Road linked the fortress to Tiflis and turned the old Alan gate into an imperial garrison.
zh:
阿兰扼守达里亚尔山口北端，即捷列克河在卡兹别克山以东切穿高加索之处。达里亚尔一名源出波斯语，意为「阿兰之门」；它与杰尔宾特的滨海通道合起来，是整条高加索山脉仅有的两个缺口，军队和商队自古在此鱼贯而过，城墙早在公元前就守在峡谷中。中世纪阿兰王国长期受拜占庭和格鲁吉亚影响而信奉基督教，却在1239至1240年蒙古攻陷马加斯、14世纪末帖木儿远征之后瓦解。说伊朗语的幸存者退入陡峭峡谷，在塔楼村落中生活，夏季把牲畜赶上高山牧场。1444年，旧都马加斯已无国王；这些人正形成后来称为伊龙和迪戈尔的奥塞梯山地社会，在古老习俗之外保留东正教仪礼，邻近平原握在卡巴尔达王公手中，到该世纪末连山口本身也被他们占据。

战争不断从这道门进来。1614年，阿拔斯一世的萨法维军队在格鲁吉亚战役中进入山地，当地相传库尔塔特峡谷中的岩洞要塞挡住去路，迫其退兵。卡巴尔达的影响把伊斯兰教带入西部社群，东正教长老则转向俄罗斯：莫斯科派来的司铎1744年抵达，七年后伊丽莎白女皇接见了奥塞梯使团。北奥塞梯于1774年并入俄国，十年后俄军在捷列克河畔扎乌尔村附近修建弗拉季高加索要塞，其名意为「统治高加索」，奥塞梯人称之为扎乌吉考。达里亚尔通道1799年开通常规定期通行；1801年格鲁吉亚被兼并后，格鲁吉亚军用道路把要塞与第比利斯相连，使古老的阿兰之门成为帝国驻军之地。

en:
The wooded highlands of mountainous Karabakh rise above the steppe of Ganja and the Kura. Long the Armenian land of Artsakh, it was held by princes of the House of Hasan-Jalal, descendants of its old kings, who weathered Seljuk and Mongol rule from clifftop fortresses. In the thirteenth century Hasan-Jalal Dawla built the Gandzasar monastery, later seat of the catholicos of Aghvank. After the Khachen principality broke up in the fifteenth century, its lands became the five melikdoms of Gulistan, Jraberd, Khachen, Varanda and Dizak; castles such as Kachaghakaberd and Jraberd, linked by signal beacons, made up the Armenians' old sghnakh defence system, each melik kept an armed following, and the five lords saw their highlands as the last holdout of Armenian independence. In 1441 a Hasan-Jalalyan commander in Qara Qoyunlu service brought the Armenian catholicosate back from Sis to Etchmiadzin. In 1444 the meliks held their villages and pastures under the loose overlordship of Jahan Shah.

After the battle of Qarabagh in 1469 the highlands passed to Uzun Hasan's Aq Qoyunlu, and then to the Safavids; Shah Abbas I confirmed the meliks' semi-independent standing by edict. At the end of the seventeenth century the princes carried their case to Europe: Israel Ori, a Karabakh Armenian who had served in the armies of Louis XIV, pleaded for help to Pope Innocent XII and the Emperor Leopold I, and died in 1711 with nothing gained. The meliks' sons fought the Ottoman incursions of the 1720s, and Nader Shah, taking Karabakh from the governors of Ganja, gave the five princes command over neighbouring lands. They fell to a family feud: in 1747 Panah Ali Khan of the Turkic Javanshir clan seized the lowlands, and Melik Shahnazar II of Varanda, feuding with his peers, became his vassal and yielded the Shusha cliff-fort, where Panah built Panahabad. By the 1750s the other four melikdoms had been folded into the Karabakh Khanate. A charter of the Emperor Paul in 1799 had recognised the princes' rights, but power lay with Ibrahim Khalil Khan, who submitted to Russia at Kurekchay in 1805; the Treaty of Gulistan in 1813 confirmed the tsar's rule, and the meliks entered Russian service as army officers.
zh:
梅利卡特林木茂密的山地高耸在占贾和库拉河草原之上。这里古称阿尔察赫，哈桑-贾拉良家族的王公是此地列王的后裔，凭借山顶要塞熬过了塞尔柱和蒙古人的统治。13世纪，哈桑·贾拉尔·道拉修建甘扎萨尔修道院，这里后来成为阿格万卡托利科斯的驻锡地。15世纪哈琴公国解体后，领地分成古利斯坦、贾拉贝尔德、哈琴、瓦兰达、迪扎克五个梅利克国；卡恰卡卡贝尔德、贾拉贝尔德等城堡以烽火相连，组成亚美尼亚人古老的「斯格纳赫」防御体系，每位梅利克都蓄有武装随从，自认守着亚美尼亚人最后的自治之地。1441年，一名在黑羊王朝军中效力的哈桑-贾拉良将领促成亚美尼亚卡托利科斯教座从西斯迁回埃奇米阿津。1444年，梅利克们在贾汉沙赫的松散宗主权下掌管着山村和牧场。

1469年卡拉巴赫战役后，山地转入乌尊·哈桑的白羊王朝之手，后来又归萨非王朝，沙阿·阿拔斯一世曾下诏确认梅利克们的半独立地位。17世纪末，王公们把求援的事带到欧洲：卡拉巴赫人伊斯拉埃尔·奥里曾在路易十四的军队中服役，他向教皇英诺森十二世和奥地利皇帝利奥波德一世求援，1711年死去时一事无成。梅利克们的子弟在1720年代抗击奥斯曼入侵，纳迪尔沙赫把卡拉巴赫从占贾总督手中收回后，授予五位王公统辖邻地的军权。自治断送于一场内讧：1747年，突厥贾万希尔部的帕纳赫·阿里汗夺取低地，与同侪相争的瓦兰达梅利克沙赫纳扎尔二世向他称臣，献出舒沙悬崖要塞，帕纳赫在上面建起帕纳哈巴德堡；到1750年代，其余四国均被并入卡拉巴赫汗国。沙皇保罗1799年的诏书曾承认王公们的权利，但实权在易卜拉欣·哈利勒汗手中，他于1805年在库列克恰伊投降俄国；1813年《古利斯坦条约》确认了沙皇的统治，梅利克们以军官身份进入俄国效力。

en:
Kakheti covers the warm Alazani and Iori valleys east of the Tsiv-Gombori Range, shut off to the north by the Caucasus. Its vineyards lie in one of the oldest wine-growing lands known: Alaverdi monastery in the Alazani valley has a wine cellar cut in the tenth to twelfth centuries, and its eleventh-century Cathedral of Saint George, over fifty-five metres high, was for centuries the tallest church in Georgia; the Alaverdoba feast was kept there each year at the grape harvest. Telavi was an old market and craft town, while Gremi later became the royal seat. Wine, grain, cattle and silk made the lowlands richer than most war-torn Georgian provinces. In 1444 Kakheti was Orthodox land within the weakening Kingdom of Georgia, but its strong local lords and the distance from Tbilisi were already pulling it toward separate rule.

After Qvarqvare II of Samtskhe captured King George VIII in 1465, the dethroned king made Kakheti his realm in 1466; his son Alexander I was recognized as its king in 1490. Levan founded Gremi as his capital, and in the sixteenth century Gremi, Zagemi, Karagaji and Telavi served the Ghilan-Shemakha-Astrakhan silk route between Iran and the Volga. The Peace of Amasya in 1555 assigned Kakheti to Safavid Iran. Shah Abbas I invaded in 1614-1616, killing tens of thousands, carrying more than 100,000 people into Iran and razing Gremi in 1615. The Kakhetian rising of 1659 stopped plans to settle Turkoman tribes on the emptied land, and in the 1670s King Archil moved his court to Telavi and rebuilt the town.

In 1744 Nader Shah granted Kakheti to Erekle II, who was born in Telavi and died there in 1798. When Iran fell into civil war in 1747, Erekle and his father Teimuraz II of Kartli ruled in all but name. Erekle united Kartli and Kakheti in 1762, and in Telavi he opened a theological seminary and a theatre. The Russian protectorate he accepted at Georgievsk in 1783 did not save Tbilisi: Agha Mohammad Khan's army sacked the city in 1795, and Russia annexed Kartli-Kakheti in 1801. Telavi ceased to be a royal capital.
zh:
