Toungoo closed on the city in 1541. Bayinnaung defeated the Shan and Arakanese relief armies while a five-month siege brought famine to Prome, and King Minkhaung surrendered on 19 May 1542. The river defences mattered again in the Konbaung-Hanthawaddy war. In 1754 a Hanthawaddy army reported at 10,000 men with 200 war boats besieged Prome to bar Alaungpaya's route south. Konbaung forces relieved the city in 1755 and opened the Irrawaddy campaign that ended with the fall of Pegu two years later.
zh:
旧称普罗美的卑谬（Pyay）位于伊洛瓦底江一处狭窄江段，上缅甸来的船只从这里进入三角洲，城西还有道路通往若开。附近的莫扎坐落着骠人都城室利差呾罗的圆形城垣、水道和水塘，城内曾容纳农田与住宅，围合面积约46平方公里；缅语名「卑谬」就来自这座旧城。蒲甘、宾亚和阿瓦统治时期，卑谬是面对罕礁越利的南方江河要塞，镇守者多为资深王子，其中包括后来登位的那罗波帝。1430—1431年，罕礁越利和叛服无常的东吁曾围攻此城。1444年时，卑谬是阿瓦在干旱地带以南的首要军城，也是上缅甸与三角洲之间的上座部佛教商镇。

1482年，沙耶瓦底总督达多敏绍趁敏康二世忙于央米丁叛乱，夺取卑谬自立，阿瓦军队攻城失败，卑谬成为小王国。它后来与色隆的掸邦联盟联手，1525年随联军洗劫阿瓦，并把诗僧信摩诃拉塔达拉带回卑谬。他以本生经故事写成的比釉诗在缅甸流传很广，1529年在卑谬去世。1532年，掸邦联盟反戈攻击旧日盟友，掳走国王勃因兑。色隆死后勃因兑逃脱，其子那罗波帝却紧闭城门，勃因兑最后死于城外山林。

1541年，东吁进围卑谬。勃印曩击败掸邦和若开的援军，五个月围城使城中陷入饥荒，国王敏康终于在1542年5月19日出降。到贡榜与罕礁越利交战时，卑谬的江防仍能决定战局。1754年，一支据称有一万人、二百艘战船的罕礁越利军队围攻卑谬，企图堵住雍籍牙南下之路。贡榜军1755年解围，打开沿伊洛瓦底江推进的战线；两年后，勃固陷落。

en:
Yawnghwe, Nyaungshwe in Burmese, holds the northern shore of Inle Lake, the broad freshwater lake in the southern Shan hills. Intha fishermen work its shallow water standing at the stern and wrapping one leg around an oar; Pa-O villages cover the surrounding ridges, and Danu, Shan and Taungyo settlements share the cotton-growing shore. The saopha's timber haw stood at Yawnghwe, with smaller dependencies such as Loi-ai and Mawnang paying allegiance. Local tradition says the town began in 1359, when two brothers from Tavoy received leave to build a capital and brought thirty-six families with them. In 1444, under Hso Hseng Hpa, Yawnghwe accepted the nearer overlordship of Hsipaw.

After Ava fell in 1527, Yawnghwe followed Hsipaw into the Confederation of Shan States. Bayinnaung's conquest of 1557 ended the long rule of Hso Yawk Hpa and put a Burmese-approved saopha, Sao Maw Hkam, in his place. The sharpest local fight of the restored Toungoo expansion came in January 1601: Nyaungyan Min brought seven regiments, three vanguard units were thrown back at an outer post, Ava musketeers broke a Shan sortie, and Anaukpetlun's men closed the retreat before the saopha surrendered and was reappointed. In the Konbaung period, the lake's annual eighteen-day Hpaung Daw U festival gave Nyaungshwe its largest ceremony. Four Buddha images left the pagoda on a hintha-shaped royal barge towed by leg-rowing boats, and when they reached Yawnghwe the saopha received them at his haw.
zh:
永贵，缅语称良瑞，占据茵莱湖北岸。茵莱湖是掸南山间的大型淡水湖，茵达渔夫站在船尾、以一腿绕桨划船；湖畔山脊上分布着勃欧村寨，达努、掸人和当尤人的聚落则共享出产棉花的湖岸。诏法的木宫在永贵，洛艾、芒囊等小属邦向其称臣。当地相传，1359年两名来自土瓦的兄弟获准修建都城，并带来三十六户人家。1444年，索森帕治下的永贵承认邻近的昔卜为宗主。

1527年阿瓦陷落后，永贵随昔卜加入掸邦联盟。1557年勃印曩征服掸地，索约帕的长期统治结束，缅方认可的召莫坎接任诏法。1601年1月，重建东吁势力的良渊王带来最激烈的一场地方战事：七个团进攻良瑞，三个先遣团被外围据点击退，阿瓦火枪手击破出城的掸军，阿那毕隆的人马截断退路，诏法投降后获准留任。贡榜时期，茵莱湖每年为期十八天的帕瑞佛塔节是良瑞最盛大的法会。四尊佛像供在欣塔形御舫上，由腿划船队拖离佛塔；抵达永贵时，诏法在木宫亲自迎像。

en:
Mawkmai lies in a wide, well-watered plain between the north-south ridges of the southern Shan hills; the Nam Yun runs past the town and rice covers the valley floor. Its tracks went west to Mong Nai, east toward Kengtung and south to Chiang Mai in Lanna. Hill cattle, rice and the tobacco grown in the Langko district on the Tang River were the country's products, and later court tradition called the older polity in these valleys Lokavadi. In 1444 no saopha state of Mawkmai yet existed, and this grain land was a remote edge between Mong Pai, the greater Shan mongs and Lanna.

Bayinnaung's armies subdued the southern Shan country in 1556 and 1557, drawing these valleys into the Toungoo system and leaving the local headmen in place. The recorded state began in 1767, when Hsai Khiao, a noble from Chiang Mai, founded Mawkmai; its rulers took the saopha title and traced their line back to the old Lokavadi tradition. Hsai Khiao ruled until about 1800, and Hsai Kyaw and Awk Hkun followed him. Rice, Langko tobacco and hill cattle remained the state's wealth.
zh:
茂梅位于南掸山地南北走向山岭之间一片水源充足的宽谷中，南云河流经城旁，谷底种满水稻。山路西通孟乃，东往景栋，向南可抵兰纳的清迈。山地牛、稻米和唐河畔朗科地区出产的烟草是这里的物产，后来的宫廷传统把这片谷地更早的政权称作洛卡瓦迪。1444年，茂梅诏法邦尚未建立，这片产粮之地只是孟拜、诸掸邦勐与兰纳之间的偏远边地。

1556至1557年，勃印曩的军队征服南掸地区，把这些谷地纳入东吁体系，本地首领仍留任治理。有明确记载的茂梅邦始于1767年，清迈贵族赛乔建邦，统治者称诏法，并把世系追溯到古老的洛卡瓦迪传统。赛乔统治至约1800年，其后由赛觉、奥坤相继继位。稻米、朗科烟草和山地牛始终是全邦的财富。

en:
Dagon was a Mon town on the southern edge of the Irrawaddy delta, where the Yangon River meets the river from Pegu, with fishing hamlets and rice fields spread below Singuttara Hill. What drew travellers there was the Shwedagon Pagoda on the hill, said to hold eight hairs of Gautama Buddha together with relics of the three Buddhas before him. King Binnya U of Hanthawaddy raised the stupa to eighteen metres in 1362-1363, and by the next century pilgrims came from all over the kingdom. In 1444 Dagon was still a small Mon timber town, its quays busy mostly with pilgrim boats and the rice trade, the gilded spire above the river its landmark.

Shin Saw Pu, the only queen regnant in Burmese history, abdicated at Pegu and moved to Dagon in 1460, built a palace beside the pagoda and spent her last years there. She raised the stupa to forty metres and had it gilded; the chronicles say she gave her own weight in gold, twenty-five viss, to be beaten into leaf for it. Her successor Dhammazedi cast the greatest bell in the country for Shwedagon on 5 February 1484: 180,000 viss of copper, tin, silver and gold covered in inscription, which the Italian gem merchant Gasparo Balbi still saw there in 1583. Dagon passed to Tabinshwehti with the conquest of Pegu in 1538-1541. In 1600 the Portuguese freebooter Filipe de Brito seized the town from his base at Syriam, and in 1608 he carried the bell off to melt into cannon, but the raft sank with it at the meeting of the Bago and Yangon rivers and it was never raised. King Anaukpetlun took Syriam in 1613 and had de Brito impaled. In 1755 Alaungpaya captured Dagon, enlarged the town and renamed it Yangon, meaning 'end of strife'. An earthquake threw down the spire in 1768, and King Hsinbyushin rebuilt it to ninety-nine metres in 1775. By the 1790s the East India Company kept a factory there, and the town held some 30,000 people by the early nineteenth century.
zh:
大光是伊洛瓦底三角洲南缘的一座孟人城镇，位于仰光河与来自勃固的河道交汇处，辛古塔拉山（Singuttara）下散布着渔村和稻田。把旅人引来的是山上的瑞德宫大金塔，相传塔中供有释迦牟尼的八根头发，以及在他之前三位佛陀的圣物。1362至1363年，勃固国王彬尼亚乌把佛塔加高到十八米，到下一个世纪，全王国的香客都来此朝拜。1444年，大光还是一座小小的孟人木构城镇，码头上往来的多是香客船和稻米，河面上方鎏金的塔尖是它的标志。

缅甸历史上唯一的女国王信修浮1460年在勃固退位，迁居大光，在塔旁修建宫殿度过晚年。她把塔身加高到四十米、施以鎏金，据史书记载还捐出与自己等重的黄金二十五缅斤，锤成金箔贴满塔身。继位的达马塞底于1484年2月5日为大金塔铸造全国最大的铜钟，以十八万缅斤（约294吨）铜、锡、金、银铸成，钟身刻满铭文；意大利宝石商人加斯帕罗·巴尔比1583年还在寺中见过它。1538至1541年东吁征服勃固，大光归入德彬瑞梯的版图。1600年，葡萄牙冒险家菲利普·德·布里托从沙廉据点出兵占据大光，1608年他劫走大钟打算熔铸大炮，木筏却在勃固河与仰光河汇流处连钟沉入泥中，大钟再未被捞起。1613年，阿那毕隆攻克沙廉，将德·布里托以木桩刑处死。1755年，雍笈牙攻占大光，扩建城镇，改名仰光，意为「战乱平息」。1768年地震震落塔尖，1775年辛标信把塔身重建至九十九米。到1790年代，英国东印度公司已在此开设商馆，19世纪初全城约有三万人口。

en:
The Minsin country covers the forested upper Chindwin, where the river breaks out of the Hukawng Valley below the Patkai ridge. Kachin Singpho villages held the animist high ground, while Khamti Shan grew rice on the river flats, washed gold from the gravel and worked the Hukawng mines for salt and amber. The valley's amber reached China as early as the Han dynasty, and Yunnanese traders crossed the hills to buy its gold and amber; hill caravans also carried ivory, copper and silver between Assam and Yunnan. Minsin itself was only a riverside village below Hkamti, and in 1444 the whole country answered loosely to the sawbwa of Mogaung.

A Mogaung host passed through in 1524 on its raid against Sadiya. In January 1817 a much larger army used the same forest road: Bodawpaya sent eight thousand men over the Patkai into Assam, and chiefs of Mogaung, Hukawng and Manipur joined on the march, bringing its strength to about sixteen thousand at Namrup. The hosts returned year after year, until the Ahom kingdom passed under Burma in 1821. The crown's hold up this river stayed thin, and it named a Shan myosa at Singkaling Hkamti only in 1820.
zh:
敏辛一带是钦敦江上游的密林之地，江水在巴特开山岭下从胡康河谷穿出。克钦新颇人的村寨据在高处山地，信奉泛灵信仰；坎底掸人在江边平坝种稻，从砾石中淘金，并在胡康的矿坑采盐和琥珀。这里的琥珀早在汉代就已流入中国，云南商人翻山而来收购黄金和琥珀，山里的马帮还在阿萨姆与云南之间贩运象牙、铜和银。敏辛本身只是坎底以下的一个江畔村落，1444年整个地区名义上听命于孟拱诏法。

1524年，一支孟拱军队曾经此远征萨地亚。1817年1月，一支大军沿着同一条林道而来：波道帕耶派兵八千翻越巴特开攻入阿萨姆，孟拱、胡康和曼尼普尔的酋长沿途从征，到南鲁普时兵力已扩至约一万六千人。此后缅军连年往返，阿洪王国终于1821年落入缅甸治下。缅王在这条江上游的统辖始终松散，迟至1820年才在辛坎林坎底封授一位掸族谬萨。

en:
Katha is a bluff landing on the west bank of the Irrawaddy, just below the hills where the river leaves its Bhamo defile. The Kadu held these valleys before the Shan came south, and their chronicle names the place Kasa. In Shan it was the 'Mulberry Market', the landing where boats from the northern Shan country and the jade hills changed cargo: jade from the mines beyond Mogaung went down the river and over the hills to Tengyue and Yunnan, a route Ming caravans already worked. Local lore told of a Yunnanese muleteer who picked up a green stone in the thirteenth century to balance his load, found it was fine jade and could never locate the spot again. In 1444 Katha belonged to Mong Yang.

In the mid-1570s the fighting between Bayinnaung and the Mong Yang chief Si Ge turned on this ground. Si Ge drew the Burmese army into the country about Katha, blocked the defiles and cut its supply line, until the starving troops ate their elephants and horses. A Ming relief force reached Tengyue but was called back, and only Yue Feng's two thousand men led the king out by a byway. The Burmese returned in 1579 and Si Ge, betrayed by his own followers, was killed; the Ming generals Liu Ting and Deng Zilong swept the Mohnyin country in 1583 and 1584. Katha then served the later Burmese dynasties as a royal river station on the upper Irrawaddy. In 1769 the Qing invasion was stopped at Kaungton upstream, and the peace of 1770 reopened the jade caravans with Katha left in Burmese hands.
zh:
杰沙（《明史》作戛撒）是伊洛瓦底江西岸一处陡崖上的码头，江水刚从北方八莫峡谷的群山间穿出。掸人南下之前，嘎都人据有这些河谷，嘎都编年史把此地称作卡萨。掸语旧名意为「桑树集市」，北部掸地和玉石之山来的船只都在这里换载：孟拱以远矿区的翡翠顺江而下，再翻山运往腾越和云南，明代的马帮商队已在走这条路。当地人传说，13世纪有个云南赶马人随手拾起一块绿石压住驮子，回去才知是上等翡翠，再找却再也寻不到产地。1444年，杰沙属孟养。

1570年代中期，莽应龙与孟养首领思个的交战就在这一带展开。思个把缅军诱入杰沙附近，扼守险隘、截断粮道，围得饥困的缅军宰杀象马为食。明朝援军已抵腾越却被召回，最后靠岳凤率兵两千，领缅王由小路脱身。1579年缅军再来，思个被部下出卖遇害；明将刘綎、邓子龙又于1583至1584年攻入孟养之地。此后缅甸诸王朝把杰沙当作伊洛瓦底江上游的王家江泊之所。1769年清军征缅，在更上游的老官屯被阻；1770年和议重开玉石商路，杰沙仍在缅甸手中。

en: Mong Kung, Maingkaing in Burmese, occupies a well-watered valley of the Nam Teng in the southern Shan hills, between Hsipaw and Mong Nai. Forested ridges and streams made it a small timber-producing mong, and its Shan name means 'the town of saddlery'. Shan villagers formed the majority, with a substantial Palaung population, but its court could not stand against Hsenwi or Mong Nai. In 1444 Mong Kung was held by Mong Nai, and its subordination continued to shift with the balance of hill power.
zh: 孟贡，缅语称迈凯，位于掸南山地南滕河畔一处水源充足的谷地，北接昔卜，南连孟乃。林密溪多，使它成为出产木材的小勐；掸语地名意为「马具之乡」。居民以掸人为主，也有不少德昂人，但小邦宫廷无力对抗兴威或孟乃。1444年，孟贡归孟乃控制，此后其臣属关系仍随山地势力的消长而改变。

en:
Ruhuna is the wet southern lowland of Sri Lanka, the old principality whose princes raised rebellion against the kings of Anuradhapura; its ancient towns Magama and Tissamaharama stood among the southern rice lands. At the island's southernmost tip stood Devinuwara, which Europeans later called Dondra, a port owned almost entirely by its temple. The Tenavaram complex held a Buddhist vihara, a shrine to Vishnu, whom the Sinhalese worshipped as the god Upulvan, and a Shiva temple counted as the southernmost of the five ancient Ishwarams built around the island. Merchants lived in the temple's streets, and its gopurams were sheathed in gilded brass and copper, bright enough at sea for sailors to steer by. Ibn Battuta visited in the fourteenth century and Zheng He in the fifteenth. In 1444 the kings of Kotte ruled the coast, but Devinuwara still ranked among the island's great emporiums on the voyage to the Malabar ports.

In February 1587 the Portuguese captain De Sousa d'Arronches sacked the complex, smashed its shrines and threw much of their stonework off the cliff into the sea, laying waste the southern coast. A Buddhist vihara and the Vishnu shrine were rebuilt on the promontory afterwards. During the wars around Kandy the Dutch took Galle in 1640 and inherited the Portuguese hold on the coast when Colombo fell in 1656, and all the coastal trade ran through their ports. Their rule lasted until 1796, when a British expedition seized the Dutch possessions during the French Revolutionary Wars, and the Kandyan Convention of 1815 brought the inland kingdom under British rule as well.
zh:
鲁胡纳是斯里兰卡湿润的南部低地，古时是一个王公屡屡起兵对抗阿努拉德普勒诸王的诸侯国；马加马和蒂瑟默哈拉默两座古城就坐落在南方稻田之间。岛屿最南端是德维努瓦拉（欧洲人后来称栋德勒），这座港口几乎全归神庙所有。特纳瓦兰神殿群里有佛寺、毗湿奴神庙（僧伽罗人把这位神奉作乌普万），还有一座湿婆庙，是环岛而建的五座古湿婆神庙中位置最南的一座。商人住在神庙的街巷里，神庙塔楼包着镀金铜皮，海上远远就能看见，水手借它辨认航向。伊本·白图泰14世纪到访过，郑和15世纪也曾停泊。1444年，科特王朝统治沿海，德维努瓦拉仍是通往马拉巴尔各港航线上的著名商埠。

1587年2月，葡萄牙将领德索萨·达龙什洗劫神殿群，捣毁庙宇，把大量石材抛入崖下海中，南部海岸尽遭蹂躏。事后海角上重建了佛寺和毗湿奴神庙。康提战争期间，荷兰人1640年夺取加勒，1656年科伦坡陷落后又接管葡萄牙人在沿海的地盘，沿海贸易尽入其手。荷兰人的统治维持到1796年，英国远征军趁法国革命战争夺取这些荷兰属地；1815年《康提协定》签订，内陆的康提王国也归入英国治下。

en:
Salavata, the Sinhalese Halawatha that the Portuguese would call Chilaw, lies on the lagoon coast halfway between Colombo and Jaffna. Its shallows are pearl banks: the Tamil name Cilapam means a pearl fishery, and divers had worked them since antiquity. Behind the coast the Demala Pattuva, held by semi-independent chiefs under the kings of Kotte, grew cinnamon and coconuts and supplied the trade road running up the island. A short way inland stood Munneswaram, one of the five ancient Ishwaram temples of Shiva in the region, its stones in place since around 1000, and its Kali shrine drew Sinhalese Buddhist worshippers as well as Tamil Hindus. In 1444 Parakramabahu VI ruled from Kotte, and the coast drew merchants to its ports and pilgrims of both peoples to the temple.

Around 1450 Parakramabahu summoned Munneswaram's chief priest and had the temple's villages and tax-free revenues reaffirmed on a granite slab. The Portuguese reached the island in 1505 and tore the temple down to its basement in 1578: Jesuits set a Catholic chapel on the foundations and smashed the main image with iron bars, and they later recorded five hundred conversions in the district, though the villagers had hidden many of the idols first. Rajasinha I of Sitawaka rebuilt the temple during his wars with the Portuguese, who destroyed it again early in the next century, and the villagers rebuilt it themselves. In 1753 Kirti Sri Rajasinha of Kandy raised a new superstructure, reconsecrated the shrine, crowned it with a silver finial and endowed its priests with fresh land.
zh:
萨拉瓦塔，僧伽罗语称哈拉瓦塔，葡萄牙人后来叫它奇洛，地处科伦坡与贾夫纳之间的潟湖海岸。沿海浅滩是珠蚌栖息之地，泰米尔名「奇拉帕姆」意即采珠场，采珠人自古便在此潜水取珠。海岸背后的德马拉帕图瓦由半独立酋长在科特诸王治下领有，种植肉桂与椰子，供应纵贯岛屿的商道。往内陆不远是穆内斯瓦兰，为岛上五座古老湿婆神庙「伊什瓦兰」之一，约1000年便已立庙；庙中的迦梨神龛既吸引泰米尔印度教徒，也引来僧伽罗佛教徒。1444年，波罗迦罗摩巴忽六世在科特在位，港口招来商人，两个族群的香客都往神庙礼拜。

1450年前后，波罗迦罗摩巴忽召见穆内斯瓦兰住持，把神庙所属村庄和免税收入刻在石板上重新确认。1505年葡萄牙人来到岛上，1578年把神庙拆得只剩地基：耶稣会士在原址建起天主教礼拜堂，用铁杵砸碎主神像，他们后来记载当地有五百人受洗，不过村民事先藏起了不少神像。悉多伐迦国王罗阇辛哈一世在对葡战争中重建神庙，17世纪初葡萄牙人再度拆毁，村民又自己把它修起。1753年，康提国王基尔季·室利·罗阇辛哈重建殿宇上部，为神庙重新开光，在塔顶安上银制宝顶，又向祭司封赐新的土地。

en:
Trincomalee occupies one of the finest natural harbours in the Indian Ocean, a deep bay on Ceylon's east coast guarded by the Swami Rock promontory, which ships could enter in almost any weather. Tamil seafarers have used it since antiquity. Crowning the headland stood Koneswaram, the Shiva temple the saint Sambandhar hymned in the 7th century and pilgrims called the Kailash of the South; while worshippers climbed the rock, merchants loaded pearls, elephants, cinnamon and muslin for the westward run. The port and its Vanni hinterland were an appanage of the Tamil kings of Jaffna, who had the shrine's Sanskrit chronicle compiled in 1380. In 1444 Trincomalee is a wealthy Tamil trading town under Jaffna's suzerainty, caught between the rival kings of Jaffna, Kandy and Kotte.

By the 1580s the local chiefs paid tribute direct to the Portuguese commander at Mannar. A Danish fleet under Ove Gjedde seized the headland in 1620, but it was the Portuguese who destroyed the great temple in 1622, the 'Temple of a Thousand Columns', and built Fort Triquinimale from its granite the next year. In league with Rajasinghe II of Kandy, the Dutch took the fort in 1639, yielded it to the Kandyans to pull down, and returned around 1660 to raise Fort Fredrick on the promontory and Fort Ostenburg at the harbour mouth. In 1782 the British stormed the forts during the Fourth Anglo-Dutch War and lost them within weeks to the French admiral Suffren, who handed them back to the Dutch. British troops came again in 1795 and made the bay their chief naval station in Ceylon.
zh:
亭可马里占据着印度洋最好的天然良港之一：锡兰东岸的深水海湾，斯瓦米岩海角守在港门，船只几乎在任何天气都能进出。泰米尔水手自古在此停泊。岬角顶端矗立着科内斯瓦拉姆湿婆神庙，7世纪圣人桑班达尔曾为它作颂，香客称之为「南冈仁波齐」；香客登岩朝拜时，商人正把珍珠、大象、肉桂和细布装上西行的商船。港口与后方的万尼地方是泰米尔人贾夫纳国王的封邑，1380年贾夫纳王命人将该庙的梵文编年史整理成书。1444年的亭可马里是贾夫纳宗主权下一座富庶的泰米尔商镇，夹在贾夫纳、康提和科特三个相争的王国之间。

1580年代起，当地首领直接向驻马纳尔的葡萄牙司令官纳贡。1620年奥弗·吉德率丹麦舰队夺取海岬，但最终毁庙的是葡萄牙人：1622年他们拆掉科内斯瓦拉姆大庙，即其口中的「千柱庙」，次年用庙中花岗岩筑起特里基尼马莱堡。荷兰人与康提国王拉杰辛赫二世联手，1639年攻下堡垒，先交给康提人拆毁，1660年前后又重返岬角，在海角上修筑弗雷德里克堡，并在港口咽喉建成奥斯滕堡。1782年第四次英荷战争中英军强攻得手，不出几周堡垒又落入法国海军将领叙弗朗之手，后者将其交还给荷兰。1795年英军卷土重来，把这座海湾经营成他们在锡兰的首要军港。

en:
Kumari is the southern tip of the Indian peninsula, where the Western Ghats give way to sea on three sides. Sailors rounding the coast took their bearings from the headland, which Ptolemy and Marco Polo both knew as Cape Comorin. Its temple houses the virgin goddess Kanya Kumari, a holy shrine of the Shaktas; legend says the rice cooked for her wedding to Shiva was never eaten after the bridegroom failed to appear, and turned into the small rice-like stones lying on the shore. Inland, the wet paddies of Nanjilnad and the district of Edainadu linked the cape to the Tamil country and to Malabar. After the Ay chiefs this land became the southern march of Venad, whose rulers kept a palace and warriors at Kottar against raids from the Madurai sultanate, with Padmanabhapuram as their chief seat. In 1444 Kumari is a Hindu frontier of Venad, a borderland of Tamil and Malayalam speech and a landmark for every ship rounding the peninsula.

Marthanda Varma, who came to power in 1729, put down the local lords, annexed the neighbouring estates and made this country the southern core of his new kingdom of Travancore, ruled from Padmanabhapuram. On 10 August 1741 a Dutch East India Company force tried to force a trading post at Colachel; his army, with fishermen attacking the landing boats from the sea, routed the Dutch and captured their commander, Eustachius De Lannoy. The captive admiral entered Marthanda Varma's service, trained the Travancore army on European lines with firearms and artillery, and rose to its senior command as Valiya Kappithan; he died at Udayagiri Fort in 1777. Travancore later walled the Aramboly pass against invasion from the Carnatic. The same walls were tested during Velu Thampi Dalawa's revolt, when a British column under Colonel Leger broke through them into Travancore in 1810.
zh:
库马里是印度半岛的最南端，西高止山在此没入大海，陆地三面临海。绕过海岸的水手都以这座海角辨认方向，托勒密和马可·波罗的记载里都有它，当时称科摩林角。角上的神庙供奉处女女神库马里，是印度教性力派的圣地；相传她与湿婆的婚事因新郎失约未成，喜宴上煮好的米饭没人动过，化作滩上米粒状的小石。内陆南吉纳德的水田和埃代纳德地区，把海角同泰米尔地区和马拉巴尔连在一起。阿伊酋长之后，这片土地成为韦纳德的南部边地，统治者在科塔尔设宫屯兵，防备马杜赖苏丹国的袭击，以帕德马纳巴普拉姆为要镇。1444年，库马里是韦纳德的印度教边疆，泰米尔语和马拉雅拉姆语在这里相邻，也是每艘绕过半岛的船只都认得的地标。

1729年即位的玛尔坦达·瓦尔马镇压地方领主、兼并邻近领地，以帕德马纳巴普拉姆为都城，把这片土地经营成新王国特拉凡哥尔的南部根基。1741年8月10日，荷兰东印度公司派兵在科拉切尔强设商馆；他的军队在海上渔民攻击登陆小艇的配合下击溃荷军，俘虏了司令尤斯塔修斯·德·拉努瓦。这位被俘的海军将领转而为玛尔坦达·瓦尔马效力，按欧洲操典用火药武器和炮兵编练特拉凡哥尔军队，最后做到军队最高统帅，1777年在乌代吉里堡去世。特拉凡哥尔后来在阿兰博利山口筑墙设防，挡住卡纳蒂克方向的来路。韦卢·坦皮·达拉瓦起事期间，这道墙受了考验：1810年莱杰上校的英军纵队破墙而入，攻入特拉凡哥尔。

en:
Samana is an old town of the Punjab Malwa plain, southwest of Sirhind in the country between the Sutlej and the Ghaggar, on the track the Delhi armies used toward the west. Raja Jaipal's territories included it with Bathinda, and after Muhammad Ghori's victory in 1192 it was entrusted to Qutb ud-Din Aibak together with Sunam and Ghuram, after which it grew up as a Sirhind frontier town. In 1444 its governor held it for Bahlul Khan Lodi, the Afghan chief of Sirhind, who had tried and failed to take Delhi the year before. Samana already bore a double character then, as a seat of scholars and Sufi pirs and as a recruiting ground for the professional executioners who served the courts of Delhi and Sirhind.

Bahlul seized the Delhi throne in 1451 and founded the Lodi dynasty, and his cousin Qutb-ud-Din Khan, the governor of Samana, secured the new regime by arresting the minister Hamid Khan. Under Akbar the town was a pargana of the Sirhind sarkar, listed in the Ain-i-Akbari at a revenue of 12,822,270 dams and a levy of 2,000 foot soldiers and 700 cavalry. Its grim trade fixed Samana in Sikh memory. Sayyid Jala-ud-Din, who executed Guru Tegh Bahadur at Delhi in 1675, was a Samana man, and so were the Baig brothers who put Guru Gobind Singh's young sons to death at Sirhind. Banda Singh Bahadur made the town his first target: in November 1709 his Sikhs stormed and sacked it in the opening action of his rising, and Mughal troops retook it only late in 1710. In 1742 the Phulkian Sikh chief Ala Singh took Samana and kept it through Ahmad Shah Durrani's invasions, until the Afghan king recognized it among his possessions; after Ala Singh founded Patiala State in 1763 and the Sikhs took Sirhind in 1764, Samana became a town of the Patiala kingdom.
zh:
瑟马纳（常译萨马纳）是旁遮普马尔瓦平原上的旧城，地处西尔欣德西南、萨特莱杰河与克格尔河之间，正压着德里朝廷向西用兵的道路。拉贾·贾伊帕尔的领土曾把它与珀丁达一并包括在内；1192年穆罕默德·古尔获胜后，此地连同苏纳姆和古拉姆被交给库特布—乌德—丁·艾伯克，此后作为西尔欣德的边镇发展起来。1444年，瑟马纳总督为西尔欣德的阿富汗首领巴赫鲁尔汗·洛迪守城，此人前一年进兵德里刚刚受挫。那时的瑟马纳已有两副面孔：它既是学者和苏菲派导师云集之地，也是为德里和西尔欣德宫廷供应职业刽子手的招募之乡。

巴赫鲁尔1451年攻下德里王位、建立洛迪王朝，他的堂亲、瑟马纳总督库特卜—乌德—丁汗随即逮捕大臣哈米德汗，为新政权稳住局面。阿克巴时期，瑟马纳是西尔欣德专区下的一个帕尔加纳，《阿克巴政典》记载其税额为12822270达姆，须提供两千步兵和七百骑兵。这份血腥行当让瑟马纳刻进了锡克人的记忆：1675年在德里处死古鲁·得格·巴哈杜尔的赛义德·贾拉—乌德—丁是瑟马纳人，在西尔欣德处死古鲁·戈宾德·辛格年幼诸子的贝格兄弟也出身此城。班达·辛格·巴哈杜尔把这里选作第一个目标，1709年11月，他的锡克军队起兵第一仗便攻破并洗劫了此城，莫卧儿军队迟至1710年底才将其夺回。1742年，普尔基安派锡克首领阿拉·辛格攻取瑟马纳，在艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼的历次入侵中守住此地，阿富汗国王后来承认它归其所有；阿拉·辛格1763年建立帕特亚拉国家、锡克人1764年攻占西尔欣德后，瑟马纳成为帕特亚拉王国的城镇。

en:
Dindigul takes its name from the bare rock that rises between the Palani and Sirumalai hills. Its name is said to join two Tamil words, one meaning a headrest or pillow and the other rock, and the hill overlooks the road from the Tamil plain in the north to the Madurai country in the south. The Tamil epic Silappathikaram already places the town on the northern edge of the Pandya kingdom of Madurai, and for centuries it sat in the borderlands shared by the Pandyas, Cheras and Cholas. In the fourteenth century the Madurai Sultanate held it, until Vijayanagara forces under Kumara Kampana ended that sultanate in 1378. In 1444 Dindigul was a Tamil Hindu march town of the Vijayanagara Empire.

The Madurai Nayak king Muthu Krishnappa built the citadel on the rock in 1605, with a lower fort at its foot, and the eighteen palayams of Dindigul Seemai, clusters of villages under their own poligars, answered to it. Chanda Sahib took the town in 1736 and Mysore took it six years later. When the poligars withheld tribute, the Mysore court sent a young officer, Haider Ali, to subdue them in 1755, the first independent command of the soldier who later mastered all of Mysore. His governor Purshana Mirsaheb rebuilt the walls and strengthened the garrison; Mirsaheb's wife died there in childbirth, and her Begambur tomb gave the quarter its name. A British force took the fort in 1783 and returned it to Mysore the next year. While it was back in Mysore hands it sheltered Velu Nachiyar, the widowed queen of Sivagangai, and her commanders the Maruthu Pandiyar brothers, whom Haider Ali backed against the East India Company. In 1788 Haider Ali's son Tipu Sultan was crowned king of Dindigul, but British troops retook the rock in 1790 and Tipu ceded it to the Company in 1792, the first part of the Madurai country to come under British rule. It served as a British strongpoint in the Polygar Wars that followed.
zh:
丁迪古尔得名于突起在帕拉尼山与西鲁马莱山之间的裸岩，地名相传由泰米尔语里意为「头枕」和「岩石」的两个词拼成；岩上可俯瞰北连泰米尔平原、南接马杜赖地区的道路。泰米尔史诗《脚镯物语》已把此城记在以马杜赖为都的潘地亚王国北境，此后千余年它一直处在潘地亚、哲罗、朱罗三强的交界地带。14世纪这里归马杜赖苏丹国，1378年库马拉·坎帕纳率领毗奢耶那伽罗军队攻灭该苏丹国。1444年，丁迪古尔是毗奢耶那伽罗帝国治下的泰米尔印度教边镇。

1605年，马杜赖纳亚克君主穆图·克里希纳帕在岩顶修建岩堡，又在山脚筑下堡，丁迪古尔塞迈的十八个帕莱亚姆（各由波利加尔管辖的村群）都听命于此。1736年昌达·萨希卜夺取该城，六年后又为迈索尔所得。各地波利加尔拒缴贡赋，迈索尔朝廷于1755年派年轻军官海德尔·阿里前往镇压，这是他独当一面的第一仗，后来他掌握了整个迈索尔。他任命的长官普尔沙纳·米尔萨希卜重修城墙、加强驻军；其妻在此难产而死，她的贝甘布尔陵墓也成了所在街区的名字。1783年英军攻占岩堡，次年交还迈索尔。岩堡在迈索尔手中时，还曾收留西瓦甘加的寡后韦卢·纳奇亚尔和她的将领马鲁图·潘迪亚尔兄弟，海德尔·阿里支持他们对抗东印度公司。1788年，海德尔·阿里之子提普苏丹加冕为丁迪古尔之王；英军1790年再克岩堡，提普于1792年将其割让给东印度公司，这里成为马杜赖地区第一块落入英国统治的土地，在随后的波利加尔战争中充当英军据点。

en:
Cannanore is the pepper port of North Malabar, on an open roadstead below Ezhimala. Greek pilots knew the anchorage as Naura, and the Periplus of the Erythraean Sea placed it near the northern end of the pepper coast. The Mushika kings kept their seat on the Ezhimala headland, and their Kolathiri successors became one of the four great houses of Malabar, holding the shore between the Chandragiri river and Calicut. Arab seamen had settled around Madayi and Dharmadom; the mosque at Madayi carries an Arabic foundation inscription dated 1124. Around 1400 the poet Cherusseri Namboothiri composed Krishna Gatha at the court of Udayavarman Kolattiri, giving Malayalam one of its first major literary poems. In 1444 the Kolathiri still ruled from Ezhimala, although wars with the Zamorin to the south had cost him Pantalayini Kollam and other tracts, and Cannanore remained a pepper mart in Calicut's orbit.

The Portuguese made this bay one of their first Indian footholds. They opened a factory in 1501, and Vasco da Gama made a treaty with the Kolathiri the next year. Francisco de Almeida began St Angelo Fort above the bay in October 1505; Lourenço de Almeida defeated the Zamorin's fleet offshore in 1506, and a Kolathiri and Zamorin army besieged the new garrison for four months in 1507 without taking it. After the battle of Diu in 1509, Francisco de Almeida used the fort to hold his successor Afonso de Albuquerque prisoner for six months during their dispute over the governorship of Portuguese India.

The Muslim Arakkal house gave Cannanore its own dynasty: its rulers were called Ali Raja, its ruling queens Arakkal Beevi, and they held the town with the southern Laccadive Islands under matrilineal succession. The Dutch captured St Angelo in 1663, rebuilt its bastions and sold the fort to the Ali Raja in 1772. The French kept a rival base at nearby Mahé from 1724, while the British held Tellicherry. Arakkal called in Hyder Ali of Mysore in 1766, but British troops stormed St Angelo in 1790. The Bibi surrendered her sovereignty in 1796, and Kerala Varma Pazhassi of Kottayam fought on from the Wynaad hills until his death in 1805. In 1816 Mahé returned to France and Cannanore became a British cantonment.
zh:
坎纳诺尔是北马拉巴尔的胡椒港，位于埃济马拉山下的开阔锚地。希腊水手把这里称作诺乌拉，《厄立特里亚航海记》将它标在胡椒海岸北端。穆希卡诸王曾在埃济马拉岬角设治，其后裔科拉蒂里王族成为马拉巴尔四大王朝之一，据有昌德拉吉里河与卡利卡特之间的海岸。阿拉伯海商早已在马代伊、达尔默德姆一带定居，马代伊清真寺存有1124年的阿拉伯文奠基铭文。约1400年，诗人切鲁谢里·南布迪里在乌达亚瓦尔曼·科拉蒂里宫中写成《黑天之歌》，是马拉雅拉姆语最早的重要文学长诗之一。1444年，科拉蒂里仍以埃济马拉为统治中心，但同南方扎莫林的战争已使他失去潘塔拉伊尼·科拉姆等领地，坎纳诺尔还是卡利卡特势力范围内的胡椒商埠。

葡萄牙人把这个海湾当作他们最早的印度据点之一。1501年他们设立商站，次年瓦斯科·达·伽马同科拉蒂里立约。1505年10月，弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达在海湾上方动工修建圣安杰洛堡；1506年，洛伦索·德·阿尔梅达在港外击败扎莫林的舰队；1507年，科拉蒂里与扎莫林联军围攻新堡守军四个月，仍未破城。1509年第乌战役后，弗朗西斯科·德·阿尔梅达因葡属印度总督继任之争，还曾把阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克囚禁在这座堡垒中六个月。

穆斯林阿拉卡尔家族让坎纳诺尔有了自己的王朝：统治者称阿里·拉贾，女王称阿拉卡尔·比比，按母系继承，统辖本城和南拉克代夫群岛。荷兰人1663年夺取圣安杰洛堡，改建棱堡后又在1772年卖给阿里·拉贾。法国人从1724年起在附近的马埃保有竞争据点，英国人则占据塔利切里。1766年阿拉卡尔召来迈索尔的海德尔·阿里，但英军1790年强攻拿下圣安杰洛堡。1796年比比放弃主权，科塔亚姆的喀拉拉·瓦尔马·帕扎西则在瓦亚纳德山区坚持作战，直到1805年死去。1816年马埃归还法国，坎纳诺尔成为英国兵站。

en:
Salem fills a basin in the Eastern Ghats on the Thirumanimutharu River, with hill roads running west into Kongu and east toward the Carnatic. The country was settled in Sangam times, when Roman coins of the first century reached its markets; later Pandya, Pallava, Chola and Hoysala armies disputed the passes. Tamil records call the area Mazhanadu and then Salem Nadu. Vijayanagara rule in the fourteenth century left the hill roads and weaving villages to poligars, local military chiefs who held fortified posts above the routes. In 1444 Salem was a Tamil Hindu district under Vijayanagara overlordship, its handlooms producing cotton carried toward the coast.

The Madurai Nayaks and their poligars inherited these posts, until the Anglo-Mysore wars brought Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan's armies through the basin. After Tipu's defeat, the East India Company formed Salem district on 4 April 1792, with Salem town as its headquarters. The hills remained armed country: during the Second Polygar War of 1801, Dheeran Chinnamalai, a Kongu chieftain, used the region as a base against the Company. He was captured and hanged in 1805.
zh:
塞勒姆位于东高止山的盆地中，蒂鲁马尼穆塔鲁河穿流而过，山路西入贡古、东往卡纳蒂克。桑伽姆时期这里已有定居点，1世纪的罗马钱币曾流入当地市场；后来潘地亚、帕拉瓦、朱罗和曷萨拉的军队反复争夺山口。泰米尔文献把这一带先后称为马扎纳德和塞勒姆纳德。14世纪毗奢耶那伽罗确立统治后，山路和织村交给波利加尔管理；这些地方军事首领在道路上方的据点筑堡驻守。1444年，塞勒姆是毗奢耶那伽罗宗主权下的泰米尔印度教地区，手工织机已经织造运往海岸的棉布。

马杜赖纳亚克及其波利加尔首领接管了这些据点，后来英迈战争把海德尔·阿里和提普苏丹的军队引入盆地。提普战败后，东印度公司于1792年4月4日设立塞勒姆县，以塞勒姆城为治所。山地仍有武装活动：1801年第二次波利加尔战争期间，贡古首领迪兰·钦纳马莱以此地为基地对抗东印度公司，后于1805年被俘并遭绞死。

en:
Nagapattinam, long called Negapatam by European traders, was a roadstead on the Tamil coast at the edge of the Kaveri delta, and early Portuguese writers named it the city of Coromandel. The Cholas used it as a commercial port and a base for fleets sailing east, and in the early eleventh century the Sailendra king of Srivijaya built the Chudamani Vihara there with the patronage of Rajaraja Chola, a Buddhist monastery for travellers across the Bay of Bengal. Its Shiva and Vishnu temples drew pilgrims as well as merchants, and the Vishnu temple is one of the hundred-and-eight Divya Desams. Thanjavur passed to Vijayanagara in the late fourteenth century, and in 1444 the port's boatmen and weavers worked the Coromandel cloth trade under the emperor's distant authority.

The Portuguese opened a trading post here in the mid-sixteenth century. After the Vijayanagara army fell at Talikota in 1565 the Thanjavur Nayaks ruled the delta on their own account, and in 1676 Ekoji of Thanjavur handed Nagapattinam and its surrounding villages to the Dutch, who had already opened a mint striking gold pagodas stamped in Tamil. They built ten churches and a hospital, and in 1690 moved the governor's seat from Pulicat, making the port the capital of Dutch Coromandel. The British besieged it in November 1781 in the Fourth Anglo-Dutch War: the Dutch held the walls with five hundred European soldiers, fifty-five hundred local troops and two thousand sent by Hyder Ali of Mysore, until a breach forced the surrender. The Treaty of Paris in 1784 confirmed the cession, and from 1799 Nagapattinam was the British headquarters of the Tanjore district.
zh:
纳格伯蒂讷姆是泰米尔海岸、高韦里三角洲边缘的一座锚地，早期葡萄牙作家把它称作「科罗曼德之城」。朱罗王朝把这里当作商港和东航舰队的基地；11世纪初，在朱罗王罗茶罗乍一世资助下，室利佛逝的夏连特拉王在此修建楚达马尼精舍，供横渡孟加拉湾的旅人礼佛。城中的湿婆庙和毗湿奴庙既迎朝圣者也迎商人，那座毗湿奴庙是108座毗湿奴圣地之一。14世纪末坦焦尔并入毗奢耶那伽罗；1444年，在皇帝的遥远权威下，港中的船工和织工经营着科罗曼德的布匹贸易。

葡萄牙人16世纪中期在此开设商站。1565年毗奢耶那伽罗军在塔利科塔战败后，坦焦尔的纳亚克诸侯自行统治三角洲。1676年，坦焦尔的埃科吉把纳格伯蒂讷姆及周边村庄交给荷兰人，后者已在当地开设造币厂，铸行压有泰米尔文的宝塔金币。荷兰人建起十座教堂和一所医院，1690年把总督驻地从普利卡特迁来，此港成为荷兰科罗曼德的首府。第四次英荷战争期间，英军1781年11月围城：荷方靠500名欧洲士兵、5500名本地士兵和迈索尔的海德尔·阿里派来的两千人据守城墙，城墙被轰开缺口后投降。1784年《巴黎条约》确认割让，1799年起纳格伯蒂讷姆成为英属坦焦尔县的驻地。

en:
Tharangambadi, which the Danes shortened to Tranquebar, was a Tamil fishing town on a low beach at the mouth of an Uppanar distributary of the Kaveri, not far from the busier roadstead of Nagapattinam; its name means the place of the singing waves. The Masilamani Nathar Shiva temple was founded in 1306 on land granted by Maravarman Kulasekara Pandyan I, and a Catholic congregation of Tamil fishermen converted by Portuguese missionaries already lived in the village before any Dane arrived. In 1444, under the loose rule of Vijayanagara, its boatmen and weavers shared in the Coromandel cloth trade while the delta's greater ports took most of the shipping.

In 1620 the Danish admiral Ove Gjedde, sent by Christian IV, agreed terms with Raghunatha Nayak of Thanjavur: the village, a plot for Fort Dansborg and the right to collect customs, against an annual tribute to Tanjore. It was the first Danish trading post in India. The fort survived a Nayak siege and the collapse of the Danish East India Company, and it might have been abandoned altogether had not an illiterate commoner, Eskild Kongsbakke, held it with a few men until a royal frigate reached him in 1669. Zion Church, the oldest Protestant church in India, was consecrated in 1701. The Lutheran missionary Bartholomaus Ziegenbalg set up a printing press in 1712 and two years later issued Tamil translations of the Gospels and Epistles. British forces occupied the town in February 1808 and held it until September 1815, when it returned to Danish rule; in 1821 Tranquebar remained a small treaty port paying its tribute to Tanjore.
zh:
德伦格巴尔是高韦里河一条入海水道乌帕纳尔河口低岸上的泰米尔渔村，泰米尔人称作塔兰甘巴迪，意为「歌唱的海浪之地」，丹麦人把它省称为特兰奎巴；不远处就是更繁忙的纳格伯蒂讷姆锚地。马西拉马尼纳塔尔湿婆庙1306年由马拉瓦尔曼·库拉塞卡拉·潘迪亚一世赐地修建；丹麦人到来之前，村里已住着经葡萄牙传教士施洗的泰米尔渔民天主教社群。1444年，在毗奢耶那伽罗的松散统治下，船工和织工参与科罗曼德布匹贸易，但大部分航船都泊向三角洲上更大的港口。

1620年，丹麦国王克里斯蒂安四世派出的海军将领奥弗·格德与坦焦尔的拉古纳塔·纳亚克议定条款：丹麦人以每年向坦焦尔纳贡为条件，取得这座村庄、修建丹斯堡的地皮和征收关税的权力。这是丹麦人在印度的第一个商站。堡垒顶住了纳亚克军队的围攻，也熬过了丹麦东印度公司的倒闭；若不是不识字的平民埃斯基尔德·孔斯巴克带少数人守着几乎搬空的堡垒、直到1669年王家护卫舰到来，这里差点被彻底放弃。1701年落成的锡安教堂是印度最古老的新教教堂。路德宗传教士巴托洛梅乌斯·齐根巴格1712年装起印刷机，两年后印出泰米尔语《新约》。英军1808年2月占领此地，一直控制到1815年9月才交还丹麦；1821年时，德伦格巴尔仍是一座向坦焦尔纳贡的小型条约港。

en:
Kanchipuram lies on the Vegavathi, a tributary of the Palar, among the palm-fringed fields of the Tondai country. The Pallavas made it their capital in the sixth century, ringed it with walls and moats and filled it with temples. For centuries it was the ghatikasthanam, a seat of Hindu, Jain and Buddhist learning: the Chinese pilgrim Xuanzang, who came in 640, found a city six miles around whose people honoured learning and justice, and the poet Kalidasa called Kanchi the best of cities. In 1444 it belonged to Vijayanagara, a weaving city whose fine cotton went out through the Coromandel ports and a pilgrimage city whose pilgrims crowded the Varadharaja, Ekambareswarar and Kamakshi temples.

The Kailasanathar, raised by the Pallavas, is its oldest surviving temple. Ekambareswarar is counted as the earth shrine among the five Pancha Bhoota lingams of Shiva; Krishnadevaraya built its eleven-storey southern gopuram, nearly 190 feet high, and Vijayanagara builders added its thousand-pillared hall. Fifteen of the hundred and eight Vaishnava Divya Desham temples stand in the city, and the Kanchi matha has its seat here. Emperors from Harihara II to Deva Raya II had their grants cut in stone; Krishnadevaraya came twice and endowed Varadharaja Perumal, where sixteen of his inscriptions survive, and Achyuta Deva Raya had himself weighed against pearls in the city and gave them to the poor.

War reached the temple city as often as the forts of the plain. Gajapati armies from Odisha raided in 1463-1465 and again in 1474-1475, a Bahmani raid followed around 1480, and the governor who restored imperial rule here, Saluva Narasimha, took the Vijayanagara throne in 1486. After Talikota the empire ebbed, and within fifteen years the city had passed between Golconda, Bijapur, Shivaji and the Mughals; when fighting neared it in 1688 the priests, fearing Aurangzeb, carried the temple images south and brought them back only after his death in 1707. The Marathas and the Nizam of Hyderabad held it in their turn before it passed to the nawabs of Arcot. In 1780 Hyder Ali's rockets cut down a Company army at Pollilur beside the city, and in 1794 the East India Company attached the district to its Chingleput collectorate.
zh:
建志补罗（甘吉布勒姆）坐落在帕拉尔河支流维加瓦蒂河畔，四周是通代地区棕榈掩映的田野。6世纪，帕拉瓦王朝定都于此，环城筑起城墙与护城河，广建神庙。此后数百年间，它是「加提卡斯塔南」，即印度教、耆那教与佛教的义学之地：640年到此的中国求法僧玄奘记下，此城周回六英里，居民敬重学问、崇尚公义；诗人迦梨陀娑也把建志称作诸城之冠。1444年，它属于毗奢耶那伽罗帝国，织工的精美棉布经科罗曼德各港外销，香客挤满瓦拉达拉贾、埃坎巴雷什瓦拉和迦马克希三大神庙。

帕拉瓦人所建的凯拉萨纳塔神庙是城中现存最古的神庙。埃坎巴雷什瓦拉神庙被列为湿婆五大元素灵伽中的「地」灵伽，其十一层高约57米的南门楼为克里希纳·德瓦·拉亚所建，毗奢耶那伽罗工匠又加建了千柱殿。毗湿奴派一百零八座至福圣地神庙中，有十五座在这座城里，建志道院也设于此。从哈里哈拉二世到德瓦·拉亚二世，历代皇帝把颁赐刻石；克里希纳·德瓦·拉亚两次临幸，厚赐瓦拉达拉贾神庙，庙中留有他的十六道诏令；阿周陀·德瓦·拉亚在此以珍珠等身称量，把珍珠散给穷人。

战火烧到这座圣城的次数，不比平原上的要塞少。奥里萨的伽贾帕蒂军队于1463至1465年、1474至1475年两度来犯，约1480年巴赫马尼苏丹国又来抄掠；在此恢复帝国统治的地方长官萨卢瓦·纳拉辛哈于1486年夺取皇位。塔利科塔之战后帝国大势渐去，十五年间建志补罗在高康达、比贾布尔、希瓦吉与莫卧儿之间几度易手。1688年战火烧到城下，祭司们畏惧奥朗则布，把各庙神像南运，直到1707年奥朗则布死后才迎回。此后它又经马拉塔人与海得拉巴尼扎姆之手，才归于阿尔果德纳瓦布。1780年，海德尔·阿里在城旁的波利卢尔用火箭击溃东印度公司军队；1794年，公司把这一带划入钦格尔布特行政区。

en:
Nellore stands on the Penna River not far above its mouth on the Bay of Bengal, amid rice fields watered by the river; its name is read from the Telugu and Tamil word for paddy, nellu, and the medieval town was known as Vikrama Simhapuri. The Talpagiri Ranganatha temple, built in the twelfth century, rises on the bank, its seventy-foot gateway tower, the Gaaligopuram, capped by gilded vessels. Close by is the great Nellore tank, excavated under the Kakatiya ruler Ganapati Rudradeva. In the thirteenth century the poet Tikkana Somayaji lived at the court of Manumasiddhi, lord of Vikrama Simhapuri, and translated the last fifteen books of the Mahabharata into Telugu; he was the second of the three poets, after Nannaya and before Errana, who carried the epic into the language. After Pallava, Chola and Kakatiya rule, the town entered the Vijayanagara order, and in 1444 it was a Telugu Hindu town on the empire's northern coast.

With the empire's decline Nellore passed to the Sultanate of Golconda, then to Mughal overlords and the Nawabs of Arcot. In 1758 a Maratha force under Balwant Rao seized it from the local lord Najeebullah, who then fought his own brother, the Nawab of Arcot, while the British and French companies backed rival sides. The East India Company took the town's revenues in 1781 and the district around it in 1801, when the Penna settlement became part of the Madras Presidency.
zh:
内洛尔位于本内尔河畔，距该河注入孟加拉湾的河口不远，四周是河水灌溉的稻田；地名一说来自泰卢固语和泰米尔语里意为「稻谷」的词，中世纪时这里称维克拉马辛哈普里。河岸上的塔尔帕吉里·兰加纳塔神庙建于12世纪，庙前高约70英尺的门楼塔楼称「风塔」，顶端饰有鎏金瓶；附近的大内洛尔水池开凿于卡卡提耶君主伽那帕提·鲁陀罗提婆时期。13世纪，诗人提卡纳·索摩亚吉在维克拉马辛哈普里之主马努马悉提的宫廷中生活，把《摩诃婆罗多》最后十五篇译为泰卢固语；在把这部史诗带入泰卢固语的三位诗人中，他排在纳纳亚之后、埃拉纳之前，是第二位。历经帕拉瓦、朱罗、卡卡提耶统治后，内洛尔归入毗奢耶那伽罗秩序，1444年它是帝国北部沿海的一座泰卢固印度教城镇。

毗奢耶那伽罗衰落后，内洛尔先后落入戈尔康达苏丹国、莫卧儿宗主和阿尔科特纳瓦卜之手。1758年，巴尔万特·拉奥率马拉塔军队从当地首领纳吉布拉手中夺取该城；纳吉布拉随后与身任阿尔科特纳瓦卜的兄弟开战，英国和法国的东印度公司各助一方。东印度公司于1781年取得该城税收，1801年又接管周边地区，这座本内尔河畔城镇并入马德拉斯管辖区。

en:
Addanki is a Telugu town in the plain between Nellore and the Kondavidu hills. Its oldest claim to fame is a stone inscription of 848 set up for Pandaranga, a commander and scholar-poet serving the Eastern Chalukya king Gunaga Vijayaditya III. It recounts his victories from the Boya campaign onward and the grant of land his king gave him, and it carries one of the earliest verses known in Telugu; local tradition holds it to be the first poem written in the language, and the stone was unearthed near the town's Thousand Pillar Temple. After Delhi's armies took Kakatiya Warangal in 1323, the Kakatiya commander Prolaya Vema Reddi made himself an independent ruler, founded the Reddi kingdom and made Addanki his capital in 1325. His son Anavota Reddi later moved the court to the hill fort at Kondavidu. In 1444 the town still belonged to the shrinking Reddi realm, pressed between Vijayanagara and the rising Gajapatis.

The Reddi kingdom came to an end in 1448, and its Rajahmundry branch was later absorbed by the Gajapatis. The coast stayed disputed between Odisha and Vijayanagara until Krishnadevaraya defeated Prataparudra Deva and brought the coastal country back under Vijayanagara in the early sixteenth century.
zh:
阿丹基（Addanki）是内洛尔与孔达维杜山地之间平原上的泰卢固城镇。它最古老的名气来自一方848年的石刻铭文，为效力于东遮娄其君主古纳加·维贾亚迪蒂亚三世的将领兼学者诗人潘达朗加而立。铭文记述他从博亚战役起的历次战功和君主赐田，还刻有已知最早的泰卢固语诗作之一，当地相传这就是第一首泰卢固语诗；石碑出土于镇上的千柱神庙附近。1323年德里的军队攻陷卡卡提耶的瓦朗加尔后，卡卡提耶旧将普罗拉亚·韦马·雷迪自立政权，于1325年建立雷迪王国并以阿丹基为都，其子阿纳沃塔·雷迪后来把宫廷迁往孔达维杜山城。1444年，此城仍属于日渐缩小的雷迪势力，夹在毗奢耶那伽罗与崛起的加贾帕蒂之间。

雷迪王国于1448年终结，拉贾蒙德里一支后来被加贾帕蒂吞并。沿海地带长期是奥里萨与毗奢耶那伽罗的争夺之地，直到16世纪初克里希那德瓦拉亚击败普罗塔普鲁陀罗·提婆，把安得拉沿海重新收入毗奢耶那伽罗。

en:
Chandragiri guards the hill road southwest of Tirupati, between the Penukonda uplands and the Tamil plain. Its fortress, girdled with rectangular bastions and a steep moat, was built in the eleventh century by Immadi Narasimha Yadavaraya, a chief ruling from Narayanavanam; his line held it for three centuries before it passed to Vijayanagara in 1367. In 1444 the fort was an imperial stronghold on the exposed northern frontier, facing Kapilendra Deva's Gajapatis. Its governors came from the Saluva family: Saluva Narasimha's father had held the post, and Narasimha himself was named Maha Mandaleshwara of Chandragiri in 1452, decades before he seized the imperial throne. The Gajapatis captured the fort in 1460.

It later returned to Vijayanagara and became a residence of emperors. Krishnadevaraya stayed here before his coronation at Penukonda, and tradition says he met his future queen Chinna Devi in the fort; the Dvaita scholar Vyasatirtha, spiritual adviser to both Saluva Narasimha and Krishnadevaraya, also held his seat at this court. After the defeat at Talikota in 1565, with Golconda pressing Penukonda, the Aravidu emperors moved their capital here, the fourth capital of their reduced realm. In August 1639 the court granted a strip of empty coast to Francis Day, a factor of the English East India Company; the stronghold the English raised there, Fort St. George, was their first fortress in India and grew into Madras. Golconda annexed Chandragiri in 1646, after which it passed to Mysore. While the rest of the works fell to ruin, the Raja Mahal and Rani Mahal, built of stone, brick and lime without timber, remained.
zh:
钱德拉吉里扼守蒂鲁帕蒂西南的山路，位于佩努孔达高地与泰米尔平原之间。要塞围以矩形棱堡，壕沟深陡，11世纪由以纳拉亚纳瓦纳姆为治所的首领伊马迪·纳拉辛哈·亚达瓦拉亚修建；其家族据守三百年，1367年转入毗奢耶那伽罗之手。1444年，这座要塞是帝国暴露北疆上的重镇，直面卡皮伦德拉·德瓦的加贾帕蒂。镇守此地的长官出自萨卢瓦家族：萨卢瓦·纳拉辛哈的父亲曾任此职，纳拉辛哈本人也在1452年受封钱德拉吉里的「大曼达莱什瓦尔」，数十年后他才夺取帝国皇位。1460年，加贾帕蒂攻占这座要塞。

钱德拉吉里后来重归毗奢耶那伽罗，成为帝王驻跸之地。克里希那德瓦拉亚在佩努孔达加冕前曾居于此，相传他就是在这座堡中遇见未来的王后奇纳·德维；德瓦伊塔学派学者毗耶娑提尔塔曾先后担任萨卢瓦·纳拉辛哈和克里希那德瓦拉亚的精神导师，也常驻这一宫廷。1565年塔利科塔战败后，戈尔康达进逼佩努孔达，阿拉维杜皇帝迁都至此，这里成为缩小后帝国的第四都城。1639年8月，朝廷把一段荒无人烟的沿海土地批给英国东印度公司的商馆官员弗朗西斯·戴；英国人在那里筑起的圣乔治堡是他们在印度的第一座要塞，后来发展为马德拉斯。1646年钱德拉吉里并入戈尔康达，其后转归迈索尔。其他工事纷纷倾圮，以石材、砖和石灰建成、不用一木的拉贾宫与拉尼宫却留存下来。

en:
Seringapatam is an island in the Kaveri, about four miles long, named for the Ranganathaswamy temple consecrated there around 984. The river cuts it off on every side, and walls along the banks made it the strongest place south of the Tungabhadra. Under the Vijayanagara emperors a mahamandaleshvara held the island as a viceregal seat, watching over the feudatory rajas of Mysore and Talakad; in 1444 the governor still holds it for the emperor, and the Wadiyar rajas across the water at Mysore are among his vassals.

Raja Wodeyar I took the island from the viceroy in 1610 and held Navaratri on it; in time two things came to mark sovereignty over Mysore, the nine-night festival of Chamundeshwari and possession of this fort. A Bijapuri army under Ranadulla Khan beat against the walls in 1638 and could not cross the river. Under Hyder Ali and Tipu Sultan the island became the seat of Tipu's 'God-given' sultanate, crowded with palaces, mosques, arsenals and dungeons for British prisoners. Lord Cornwallis came before the walls on 5 February 1792 and in five weeks forced Tipu to give up half his kingdom. The British returned in 1799: after a month's siege, on 4 May, an army of the East India Company and Hyderabad under General Harris breached the rampart by the Water Gate, and Tipu was killed fighting in the gap. His treasure was carried to England, his sword and a wooden automaton of a tiger mauling a redcoat among the spoils. The Wadiyars were restored and the capital moved back to Mysore.
zh:
塞林伽巴丹是高韦里河中的一座河洲，长约四英里，因约984年落成的朗加纳塔斯瓦米神庙得名。河水四面环绕，沿岸又筑城墙，使它成为栋格珀德拉河以南最难攻取的据点。毗奢耶那伽罗皇帝以一位摩诃曼达莱什瓦拉驻守此洲，就近监视迈索尔、塔拉卡德的藩属罗阇；1444年，总督仍替皇帝守着河洲，对岸迈索尔的瓦迪亚罗阇还是他的臣属。

1610年，拉贾·瓦迪亚一世从总督手中夺取河洲，在岛上举行九夜节；后来在迈索尔宣示主权要看两件事：举办祭祀查蒙德斯瓦里的九夜庆典，以及据有这座要塞。1638年，拉纳杜拉汗率比贾布尔军队来攻，被挡在河外。海德尔·阿里与蒂普苏丹时代，河洲成为蒂普「神赐」苏丹国的都城，宫殿、清真寺、军械库和关押英国战俘的地牢遍布其间。1792年2月5日，康沃利斯兵临城下，五周后迫使蒂普割让半个王国。英军1799年再度来攻：围困一个月后，5月4日，哈里斯将军率领的东印度公司与海得拉巴联军在水门附近轰开城墙，蒂普在缺口处力战身亡。他的财宝被运往英国，战利品中有他的佩剑，还有一具老虎扑咬英兵的木制机关。瓦迪亚家族随后复位，都城迁回迈索尔。

en:
Sira lies on the dry northern edge of the Mysore plateau, on the road that leaves the Vijayanagara capital, threads the gaps of the eastern hills and runs on to the Tamil country. Grain from the surrounding villages gathers in its market before moving north toward the Tungabhadra, and the roads around it are ringed with the hill-forts of local palaigars. In 1444 it is a fortified market town of the empire, a staging post on the long route south into the Carnatic.

A Bijapuri army took Sira in 1638 and the Adil Shahis held it until 1687, when Aurangzeb, fresh from the fall of Bijapur, made the small town the capital of a new Mughal province, the Carnatic-Balaghat subah. Its first governor, Qasim Khan, ruled seven parganas reaching as far as Kolar, and even the rajas of Chitradurga and Mysore paid tribute at Sira; eight years later he died, either cut down by Maratha raiders or by his own hand after they seized a treasure in his charge. Governors after him lasted a year or two until Dilavar Khan's term of 1726 to 1756 gave the province a generation of order. The Marathas overran Sira in 1757 and again after the battle of Sira in 1767. The town is most closely tied to Hyder Ali, whose father had served the subah as faujdar of Kolar: when he took Sira in 1761 he styled himself Nawab of Sira. Tipu Sultan won it back from the Marathas in 1774.
zh:
锡拉位于迈索尔高原干燥的北缘，毗奢耶那伽罗帝都出城、穿过东山山口再通往泰米尔地区的大道经过此地。四乡征集的粮米在它的市上集中，再北上运往栋格珀德拉河；城外沿路林立着当地帕莱加尔的山寨。1444年，锡拉是帝国治下一座设防集镇，也是大军南下卡尔纳蒂克长途上的一站。

1638年，比贾布尔军队攻占锡拉，阿迪尔·沙希王朝守到1687年；刚攻灭比贾布尔的奥朗则布把这座小镇升格为莫卧儿新省卡尔纳蒂克-巴拉加特苏巴的治所。首任总督卡西姆汗下辖远及科拉尔的七个帕尔加纳，连吉德勒杜尔加和迈索尔的罗阇也到锡拉纳贡；八年后他死去，一说被马拉特突袭者砍杀，一说他们劫走他押运的财宝后他自尽。此后总督一年一换，直到迪拉瓦尔汗1726至1756年任职才给该省带来一代人的安定。马拉特人1757年攻陷锡拉，1767年又在锡拉之战后再占其地。这座城镇最出名的一段与海德尔·阿里有关：他的父亲曾在该苏巴担任科拉尔的法吉达尔，1761年海德尔夺取锡拉后便自称锡拉纳瓦卜。1774年，蒂普苏丹把它从马拉特人手中夺回。

en:
Gutti, also called Gooty, is a single fortified rock rising three hundred metres above the Rayalaseema plain, its summit girdled with ramparts, bastions and fifteen gateways, and a Narasimha temple stands within the walls. Eight damaged inscriptions cut into the rock near the temple belong to the Western Chalukya king Vikramaditya VI, and the oldest surviving works date from that late Chalukya period; the kings of Vijayanagara rebuilt the hill-fort, and an inscription of Bukka Raya calls Gooty a foremost durg. In 1444 a Telugu garrison held the rock for Deva Raya II, watching the dry road from the Tungabhadra into the Carnatic.

Under Venkata II the fort passed to the Qutb Shahis of Golconda, and with Golconda it fell to Aurangzeb in 1687. Around 1746 it was seized by Murari Rao Ghorpade, a Maratha general and grandnephew of Santaji Ghorpade who had once taken Tiruchirappalli and made the Carnatic commander Chanda Sahib his prisoner; he made Gooty his permanent seat eight years later, repaired the works and gave the small gateways their stucco ornamentation, and his territory ran east as far as Madras and Pondicherry. In 1775 Hyder Ali of Mysore besieged the hill and forced him to surrender when the garrison's water failed after two months. Gooty passed to the Nizam by the Treaty of Seringapatam in 1792 and was ceded to the East India Company with the Ceded Districts in 1800.
zh:
古提（又译戈奥特伊）是从拉雅拉西玛平原拔起三百米的一座独岩山堡，山顶以城墙、棱堡和十五座城门环绕，墙内还有一座那罗希摩神庙。寺旁岩壁上的八方残损铭文属于西遮娄其国王维克拉马迪亚六世，现存最古老的工事也建于遮娄其后期；毗奢耶那伽罗君主重修了这座山堡，布卡·拉亚的一方铭文把古提称作诸堡之首。1444年，一支泰卢固戍军替德瓦拉亚二世把守岩山，监视从栋格珀德拉通往卡纳蒂克的干旱大道。

文卡塔二世在位时，山堡转归高康达的库特卜沙希王朝，1687年随高康达一同落入奥朗则布之手。约1746年，穆拉里·拉奥·戈尔帕德夺取此山。他是马拉塔名将、桑塔吉·戈尔帕德的侄孙，曾攻下蒂鲁吉拉帕利、生擒卡纳蒂克将领昌达·萨希卜；八年后他把古提定为常驻据点，整修工事并给各小城门添上灰泥塑饰，领地向东一直伸展到马德拉斯和本地治里。1775年，迈索尔的海德尔·阿里围攻山堡，两个月后守军水源断绝，穆拉里·拉奥被迫出降。1792年《塞林伽巴丹条约》把古提划归尼扎姆，1800年它随「割让诸县」一并割让给东印度公司。

en:
Adavani, recorded as Adoni in later sources, guards the dry road between the Tungabhadra and the Deccan. Its fortress climbs three joined granite hills, its walls and gateways piled irregularly tier on tier; an observer who saw it in 1780 wrote that it needed a garrison of 30,000 men, and a visitor forty years later found its enclosures full of tanks, fountains and noble houses. The black soil of the plain below grows grain for the camps and markets of the Rayalaseema. From the fourteenth century Adoni was a north-western frontier fort of Vijayanagara, and in 1444 a Telugu garrison held the heights for Deva Raya II.

In the following century the fort passed to kinsmen of the imperial minister Aliya Rama Raya. After the rout of Talikota in 1565 its commander made himself independent, and in 1568 Ali Adil Shah I of Bijapur took Adoni. Its most notable Adil Shahi governor was Siddi Masud, a Habshi (Abyssinian-born) wazir of Bijapur who held it in the 1670s: he rebuilt the walls, cleared the forest around the town, laid out the new quarters of Imtiazgarh and Adilabad, built the Shahi Jama Masjid and kept painters of the Kurnool school at work. In 1688 he surrendered the fort to Aurangzeb's general Firuz Jang. Under the Nizams Adoni was a Deccan governorship; Salabat Jung, once its governor, was placed on the Nizam's throne with French backing in 1751. Tipu Sultan took it in 1786 after a month's siege, defeating the combined armies of the Nizam and the Marathas, and after its return to Hyderabad it was ceded to the East India Company with the Ceded Districts in 1800.
zh:
阿达瓦尼（后世文献记作阿多尼）扼守栋格珀德拉河与德干之间的干旱大道。堡垒沿三座相连的花岗岩山层层攀筑，城墙和门楼错落堆叠；1780年一名看过此堡的人写道，驻守它需要三万兵力，四十年后又有访客见到堡内遍布水塘、喷泉和显贵宅邸。山下平原的黑土种植谷物，供给拉雅拉西玛的军营与市集。14世纪起阿多尼是毗奢耶那伽罗的西北边关，1444年，一支泰卢固戍军在山头上为德瓦拉亚二世守堡。

进入16世纪，堡垒转到帝国权臣阿里亚·拉马·拉亚的亲族手中。1565年塔利科塔溃败后守将据堡自立，1568年比贾布尔的阿里·阿迪尔·沙阿一世攻占阿多尼。这里最出名的阿迪尔沙希长官是西迪·马苏德，一个出生于阿比西尼亚的哈布什人，官至比贾布尔维齐尔，1670年代出镇此地：他重修城墙、清除城镇周围的丛林、辟建伊姆蒂亚兹加尔和阿迪拉巴德两处新市街、兴建皇家聚礼清真寺，还养着一批卡努尔画派的画师。1688年，他向奥朗则布的将领菲鲁兹·江献堡。尼扎姆时期，阿多尼是德干的一处方镇；曾任此地总督的萨拉巴特·江1751年在法国支持下登上尼扎姆之位。1786年，提普苏丹围攻一个月后拿下城堡，击败尼扎姆与马拉塔联军；阿多尼交还海得拉巴后，于1800年随「割让诸县」移交东印度公司。

en:
Kondavidu is a ridge fortress in the Guntur country, high above the coastal plain between the Krishna and Godavari deltas. After the fall of Warangal in 1323, Prolaya Vema Reddy moved his capital from Addanki to the hill and strengthened its walls; his Reddy successors ruled the surrounding district for almost a century, endowing temples and tanks. Traffic below the ridge moved between the Krishna crossings and the delta roads, and gravels along the Krishna later yielded the diamonds sold as Golconda stones. In 1444 the Reddy line no longer held Kondavidu, leaving its forts in the border wars between Kapilendra Deva's Gajapatis, the Bahmani sultans and Vijayanagara; Reddy rulers at Rajahmundry kept the last remnant of the older kingdom.

The Bahmanis took Kondavidu in 1458 and fought Gajapati armies for its forts during the 1470s. Krishnadevaraya of Vijayanagara captured the ridge in 1516, and Golconda forces attacked it in 1531 and 1536 before storming it in 1579 and naming the fortress Murtazanagar. A short distance away, the Kollur pits were opened around 1619; English and Dutch visitors two years later reported 20,000 to 30,000 diggers and buyers from neighbouring kingdoms. Aurangzeb's Mughal army absorbed the fort with Golconda in 1687. The French repaired and extended its works in 1752, and the East India Company took it over with the Guntur Circar in 1788.
zh:
孔达维杜是贡土尔地方的山脊要塞，高耸在克里希纳河与戈达瓦里河三角洲之间的沿海平原上。1323年瓦朗加尔陷落后，普罗拉亚·韦马·雷迪把都城从阿丹基迁到山上，加固城墙；其后裔统治周边近一个世纪，修建寺院和水池。山脊下的道路连接克里希纳河各处渡口与三角洲通道，河畔砾石层后来出产的钻石以戈尔孔达钻石之名出售。1444年，雷迪王统已不再据守孔达维杜，各座堡垒陷入卡皮伦德拉·德瓦的加贾帕蒂、巴赫马尼苏丹国和毗奢耶那伽罗之间的边境战争；拉贾蒙德里的雷迪统治者保留着旧王国最后一支余脉。

巴赫马尼王朝1458年攻占孔达维杜，1470年代又与加贾帕蒂军队争夺各处堡垒。毗奢耶那伽罗的克里希纳德瓦拉亚1516年拿下山脊；戈尔孔达军队1531年和1536年两度来攻，最终于1579年破城，将要塞命名为穆尔塔扎讷格尔。不远的科卢尔矿坑约在1619年开凿，两年后英国和荷兰访客记载，那里有两三万名挖掘工，邻近各王国的珠宝商也前来购买。1687年，奥朗则布的莫卧儿军队随戈尔孔达一并吞并要塞。法军1752年修补并扩建工事；1788年，东印度公司随贡土尔萨尔卡尔接管此地。

en:
Chitradurga sits on the Vedavati in a valley choked with granite boulders, and its fort, the Kallina Kote or Stone Fort, rides a whole ridge of hills above the town. Raised in stages between the eleventh and thirteenth centuries by the Chalukyas and the Hoysalas, it was enlarged over the next four hundred years, most of all by its Nayaka chiefs, and runs to seven concentric walls with nineteen gateways, granaries and oil stores, temples and rain-fed tanks cut into the rock, so that a garrison on the hill could not easily be starved of water. The upper fort holds eighteen temples, the oldest of them the Hidimbeshwara. In 1444 this is a northern march of the Vijayanagara Empire, held by Bedar warrior chiefs, dandanayakas whose clans watch the roads north towards the Tungabhadra.

Governors who made themselves kings, the Nayakas of Chitradurga kept the fort for two centuries after Talikota, maneuvering between Bijapur, the Mughals and the Marathas; when Aurangzeb set up the subah of Sira in 1687 Chitradurga was counted among its tributaries. Bharamappa Nayaka, who ruled from 1689 to 1722 and is regarded as the greatest of the line, fought the Mughals and spent his reign raising walls, bastions, palaces, tanks and temples. The last ruler, Madakari Nayaka V, faced Hyder Ali of Mysore, who besieged the hill in 1760 and again in 1770 and took it at the third attempt in 1779, after the Marathas and some of the garrison's own officers deserted; Madakari was led away a prisoner and killed. During one of the sieges Obavva, a watchman's wife, is said to have killed the attackers as they squeezed one by one through a crack in the rock, using her onake, the long pestle for pounding rice. Hyder Ali added a mosque inside the walls, and after Tipu Sultan fell to the British in 1799 the district passed to the restored Kingdom of Mysore.
zh:
吉德勒杜尔加坐落在韦达瓦蒂河畔满是花岗岩巨石的河谷，城中的卡利纳科特意即「石堡」，骑跨着镇子上方的整条山脊。石堡于11至13世纪由遮娄其人和曷萨拉人分期修筑，此后四百年间不断扩建，出力最多的是历代纳亚卡首领。堡内共有七重同心围墙、十九座城门，还有凿入岩体的粮仓、油库、神庙和承接雨水的蓄水池，山上守军不易因缺水被困。上堡有十八座神庙，最古老的是希丁贝什瓦拉庙。1444年，这里是毗奢耶那伽罗帝国的北部边镇，由贝达尔人武士首领丹达纳亚卡们据守，其族人警戒着通往栋格珀德拉河方向的道路。

纳亚卡们本是总督，后来自成一系之主，塔利科塔之战后在比贾布尔、莫卧儿与马拉特之间周旋，据守石堡两百年。1687年奥朗则布设立锡拉苏巴，吉德勒杜尔加被登记为纳贡国之一。1689至1722年在位的巴拉马帕·纳亚卡被视为这一系最杰出的统治者，他与莫卧儿交战，任内大修城墙、棱堡、宫殿、水池和神庙。末代马达卡里·纳亚卡五世遇上了迈索尔的海德尔·阿里：后者1760年和1770年两度围攻山寨，1779年第三次进攻才得手，当时马拉塔人和守军里的部分军官倒戈，马达卡里被俘遇害。相传在一次围城中，卫兵之妻奥巴瓦趁敌兵从岩石裂缝中逐个钻入，用舂米的长杵「奥纳克」将来犯者一一击毙。海德尔·阿里在堡内增建了一座清真寺；1799年蒂普苏丹败于英国人后，这一地区划归复辟的迈索尔王国。

en:
Honnavar is the roadstead where the Sharavati meets the Arabian Sea on the Kanara coast, loading pepper, betel nut and cardamom from the Western Ghats onto Arab dhows long before European ships came north. In 1342 Ibn Battuta landed here and found Hunawar under Sultan Jamaluddin, a ruler he praised for his power and justice; later the port passed, with the rest of Kanara, under Vijayanagara. In 1444 Kannada-speaking farmers and fishermen make up the town, local chiefs and Nawayath Muslim merchants run its wharves, and the spice trade pulls Arab shipping south of Goa.

Around 1470 the Bahmani armies of Mahmud Gawan campaigned down the Konkan to this coast. For fifty-four years the country behind the port belonged to Chennabhairadevi, the Jain queen of Gersoppa, whom the Portuguese called the Pepper Queen: from Honnavar, Mirjan and Karwar her ships carried pepper, saltpetre and betel nut to Surat and on to Europe, and she kept her court at Mirjan fort and built Jain basadis across her lands. When Vijayanagara broke at Talikota in 1565 she withdrew from Mirjan to an island in the Sharavati. Four years later the viceroy Luís de Ataíde took Honnavar and built a fort there; in the monsoon of July 1571 five thousand men of Gersoppa, two thousand of them supplied by the Adil Shah of Bijapur, attacked it with four hundred horse, but two hundred men Ataíde sent by sea got through the rains and the fort held.

In 1653 Keladi's general Timmanna Nayaka stormed the Portuguese fort during his drive down the coast, and Queen Chennamma carried Keladi's frontier to Mirjan in 1676. Maratha troops seized Mirjan in 1757 amid a Bednore succession feud, and when Hyder Ali extinguished Bednore in 1763 Honnavar passed to Mysore. In the war with Tipu Sultan, Major Torriano took Mirjan and pressed on to Honnavar in 1783-84, and with Tipu's fall in 1799 the port passed to the East India Company.
zh:
霍纳沃尔是卡纳达沿海沙拉瓦蒂河注入阿拉伯海处的外港，早在欧洲船只到来之前，西高止山的胡椒、槟榔和豆蔻就从这里装上阿拉伯单桅帆船。1342年伊本·白图泰登岸，见到胡纳瓦尔在苏丹贾马鲁丁治下，他称许这位君主国势强盛、断事公正；后来此港随整个卡纳达并入毗奢耶那伽罗。1444年，城中居民是说卡纳达语的农夫和渔民，码头由本地酋长和纳瓦亚特穆斯林商人经办，香料贸易把阿拉伯商船吸引到果阿以南。

1470年前后，马哈茂德·加万率领巴赫曼尼大军沿肯坎海岸南下，兵锋抵达此地。此后五十四年间，港口腹地属于格尔索帕的耆那教女王琴纳拜拉黛维，葡萄牙人称她「胡椒女王」：胡椒、硝石和槟榔从霍纳沃尔、米尔姜和卡尔瓦尔装船，运往苏拉特，再转销欧洲；她以米尔姜堡为居城，在境内广建耆那教巴沙迪庙。1565年毗奢耶那伽罗在塔利戈塔崩溃后，她从米尔姜退入沙拉瓦蒂河中的岛屿。四年后，葡属印度总督路易斯·德·阿塔伊德攻占霍纳沃尔、筑起堡垒；1571年7月雨季，格尔索帕出兵五千、骑兵四百围攻，其中两千人由比贾布尔的阿迪尔沙阿提供，阿塔伊德派两百人走海路冒雨赶到，堡垒守住了。

1653年，凯拉迪的大将蒂曼纳·纳亚卡南下途中攻克这座葡萄牙堡垒；1676年琴纳玛女王把凯拉迪边界推进到米尔姜。1757年，马拉塔军队趁贝德努尔继业内讧夺取米尔姜；1763年海德尔·阿里攻灭贝德努尔，霍纳沃尔并入迈索尔。与提普苏丹交战期间，托里亚诺少校于1783至1784年拿下米尔姜、进逼霍纳沃尔；1799年提普败亡，港口归入东印度公司。

en:
Mudgal stands on the southwestern edge of the Raichur Doab, the fertile triangle between the Krishna and the Tungabhadra, and its hill fort guarded the tracks running from the Tungabhadra crossings to the larger stronghold of Raichur. Seuna Yadava inscriptions in the town show an eleventh-century settlement, later an outpost of the Kakatiyas of Warangal, until Ala-ud-din Bahman Shah, the first Bahmani sultan, took it together with Raichur. Once the Bahmanis fixed their capital at Gulbarga, the two forts became the prizes over which the Bahmani sultans and Vijayanagara fought for generations. In 1444 Mudgal was a Bahmani garrison town set in a Kannada Hindu countryside, on a frontier that raiding armies crossed every few years.

With the break-up of the Bahmani kingdom Mudgal passed to the Adil Shahi sultans of Bijapur. Krishnadevaraya's decisive victory at Raichur in 1520 carried the doab to Vijayanagara and drove the Bijapur army back across the Krishna; Jesuits had already built a Roman Catholic church in the town before 1557, a trace of the Portuguese networks reaching into the Deccan. The Deccan sultans' confederate victory at Talikota in 1565 returned the doab to Bijapur. Aurangzeb's Mughals absorbed it in 1686, and after 1724 it passed to the Nizam of Hyderabad.
zh:
穆德格尔位于赖丘尔河间地西南缘，处在克里希纳河与栋格珀德拉河之间这片肥沃三角之中，城堡守卫着从栋格珀德拉河各渡口通往赖丘尔大要塞的道路。城中的塞乌纳·亚达瓦铭文表明，11世纪这里已有聚落，后来成为瓦朗加尔卡卡提雅王朝的前哨，直到巴赫曼尼开国苏丹阿拉丁·巴赫曼沙把它与赖丘尔一同攻取。巴赫曼尼定都古尔伯加后，两座堡垒成了巴赫曼尼苏丹与毗奢耶那伽罗世代争夺的目标。1444年，穆德格尔是一座巴赫曼尼驻军城镇，坐落在说卡纳达语的印度教乡野之间，边境每隔几年就有袭掠的军队经过。

巴赫曼尼王国瓦解后，穆德格尔转归比贾布尔的阿迪勒·沙希苏丹。1520年，克里希纳德瓦拉亚在赖丘尔取得决定性胜利，把整个河间地带入毗奢耶那伽罗版图，比贾布尔军队被逐过克里希纳河；1557年之前，耶稣会士已在城中建起一座罗马天主教堂，留下葡萄牙人的关系网伸入德干的痕迹。1565年德干诸苏丹在塔利科塔合力获胜，河间地复归比贾布尔。1686年奥朗则布的莫卧儿军队吞并此地，1724年后转归海得拉巴尼扎姆。

en:
Rajapur lies a few miles up a navigable creek that opens into the Arabian Sea, midway between Dabhol and Goa. Tracks over the Western Ghats carried pepper, spices and textiles from the Deccan upland to its wharves, and ships carried them on to Arabia and the Red Sea. In 1444 it was a small Marathi-speaking creek town on Vijayanagara's southern Konkan border, quieter than the Muslim harbour of Dabhol to the north and close to the expanding Bahmani frontier.

Bijapur's rise gave the creek its busiest years. The sultans used it as an approach to their Deccan capital, and merchants and shipping moved south from war-battered Dabhol during the 1500s. By the late 1640s Henry Revington ran an English East India Company factory here, buying saltpetre, pepper, calicoes and cotton; Jacques Boureau opened a French lodge in 1669.

The European warehouses were drawn into Maratha and Bijapur wars. In January 1660 Shivaji's general Doroji sacked Rajapur, but Shivaji condemned the raid, dismissed Doroji and ordered the plunder restored. A few months later, English grenades and gunners from Rajapur helped Siddi Jauhar press the five-month siege of Panhala, the hill-fort guarding the route from Bijapur to the coast. Shivaji escaped, while Baji Prabhu Deshpande's rearguard died at Pavan Khind. Holding the factory responsible, Shivaji plundered it in December 1661 and carried Revington and three other factors into hill-fort captivity. He released them in 1663 after learning the company had not authorized aid to Siddi Jauhar, and in 1672 offered 5,000 pagodas toward the losses. The French lodge closed in 1688, and Rajapur returned to being a small Maratha creek port.
zh:
拉贾布尔在一条可通航河湾上游，北距达布尔、南距果阿都不远，河湾西入阿拉伯海。跨越西高止山的小路把德干高原的胡椒、香料和织物运到码头，再由海船转往阿拉伯与红海。1444年，它是毗奢耶那伽罗南康坎边境上一座讲马拉地语的河湾小镇，规模不及北方的穆斯林港口达布尔，附近又是巴赫马尼苏丹国不断推进的边界。

比贾布尔兴起后，这条河湾迎来最繁忙的年月。苏丹们把它作为进出德干都城的通道，16世纪里，商人与海船陆续从饱受战祸的达布尔南移。1640年代末，亨利·雷温顿已在此主持英国东印度公司商馆，收购硝石、胡椒、白布和棉花；雅克·布鲁则于1669年开设法国商馆。

欧洲商馆很快被卷入马拉塔与比贾布尔的战争。1660年1月，希瓦吉的部将多罗吉洗劫拉贾布尔，希瓦吉却谴责这次行动，将多罗吉革职并下令归还财物。几个月后，拉贾布尔流出的英国手榴弹和炮手帮助西迪·乔哈尔把帕纳哈拉堡围困五个月；这座山间堡垒扼守比贾布尔通往海岸的道路。希瓦吉最终脱身，巴吉·普拉布·德什潘德率领的后卫则在帕万金德战死。希瓦吉认定商馆应对此负责，于1661年12月将其洗劫，把雷温顿等四名商馆人员押往山间堡垒。得知公司并未批准援助西迪·乔哈尔后，他在1663年释放四人，又在1672年提出赔付五千帕戈达金币。法国商馆于1688年关闭，拉贾布尔重新成为马拉塔治下的小河湾港。

en:
Daman lies at the mouth of the Daman Ganga, where the river enters the Gulf of Khambhat: the older town of Moti Daman stands on one bank and the larger Nani Daman quarter on the other. In the thirteenth century the town belonged to the Ramnagar state, later a tributary of the Gujarat sultans. By 1444 it was a fortified port on the sultanate's southern edge. Its quays handled the traffic between Surat, the Konkan and the Arabian Sea ports, and its boatyards built and equipped the war fleets Gujarat sent against the Portuguese.

A storm drove Diogo de Melo's ships to Daman in 1523, the first Portuguese sight of the harbour. Knowing the town's yards fitted the fleets that fought them, Viceroy Nuno da Cunha sent António Silveira in 1534 to wreck the shore works and shipyards while Martim Afonso de Sousa bombarded the fortifications. Constantino de Braganza occupied the town in 1559 and rebuilt Moti Daman as a Portuguese fortress. A Mughal army that appeared before the walls in 1581 withdrew without pressing the siege, and the garrison crossed to the Nani Daman bank in 1614. The wars against the Siddis and Marathas cost the Portuguese Bassein in 1739 and Chaul a year later, yet Daman held out. The treaty of 1780 added seventy-two inland villages, the nucleus of the later Dadra and Nagar Haveli enclave, and in 1821 Daman was still a fortified Portuguese enclave on the coast.
zh:
达曼位于达曼甘加河注入坎贝湾的河口，较早的莫蒂达曼在河的一岸，面积更大的纳尼达曼在另一岸。十三世纪时这里属于拉姆讷格尔土邦，后来成为古吉拉特苏丹的藩属。到1444年，达曼已是苏丹国南缘的设防港口：码头和船坞既吞吐苏拉特、孔坎与阿拉伯海各港之间的商船，也建造、装配古吉拉特出海迎战葡萄牙人的战舰。

1523年，一场风暴把迪奥戈·德·梅洛的船只吹到达曼，葡萄牙人第一次见到这个港湾。1534年，印度总督努诺·达·库尼亚得知达曼船坞正为敌方舰队装配船只，便派安东尼奥·西尔韦拉捣毁岸防工事和船坞，马丁·阿方索·德·索萨同时炮击堡垒。1559年，总督康斯坦丁诺·德·布拉干萨占领达曼，把莫蒂达曼改建成葡萄牙要塞。1581年，一支莫卧儿军队进抵城下，未认真攻城便撤退；守军又在1614年进占纳尼达曼一侧河岸。此后与西迪人和马拉塔人的战争使葡萄牙人1739年丢掉巴塞因，次年又失焦尔，达曼却始终守住。1780年的条约为其增加七十二个内陆村庄，即后来达德拉—纳加尔哈维利飞地的由来；1821年时，达曼仍是海岸上的葡萄牙设防飞地。

en:
Kolhapur lies on the Panchganga in the southern Desh, with the Sahyadri hills to the west and the great hill-fort of Panhala on a spur eighteen kilometres to the north-west. Pilgrims call the town Dakshin Kashi, the Benares of the south: its Mahalakshmi or Ambabai temple, traditionally dated to 634, is one of the Shakti Pithas. Panhala, the largest of the Deccan hill-forts, was built between 1178 and 1209 for the Shilahara king Bhoja II; the Shilaharas had kept their capital at Kolhapur from about 940 and ruled southern Maharashtra until 1212, patronising Jain monasteries from the fort. Yadava and then Khalji rule followed, and in 1444 Kolhapur is a Marathi-speaking Hindu country under Bahmani governors, living by pilgrimage, millet and the teak of its western hills.

After the Bahmani break-up the country passed to the Adil Shahis of Bijapur, and the forts above the town became a Maratha target. Shivaji took Panhala in 1659 and on 28 December routed a Bijapuri army under Rustam Zaman outside Kolhapur. In 1660 a Bijapuri army under Siddi Jauhar besieged the fort; Shivaji slipped out to Vishalgad while Baji Prabhu Deshpande held the Pavan Khind pass with the rearguard and died there, and Panhala returned to Bijapur until Shivaji retook it in 1673. It fell to Aurangzeb in 1701, and the emperor received the English envoy Sir William Norris there before Maratha troops retook it within months. In 1707 the dowager Tarabai, worsted by Shahu in the Maratha succession war, retired here with her son Shivaji II and set up a Bhosle principality of her own; the treaty of Warna in 1731 confirmed its separation, and the court later moved down from Panhala to Kolhapur. The Marathi poet Moropant, born in the fort, wrote much of his verse in its Parashar caves. By the eighteenth century its vegetable-tanned leather sandals were known across the Deccan as Kolhapuris. British expeditions marched on Kolhapur late in the century, and after the Maratha confederacy collapsed in 1818 the state entered treaty relations with the East India Company.
zh:
戈尔哈布尔位于德什南部的五河之畔，西倚萨希亚德里山林，德干最大的山间要塞潘哈拉雄踞在西北18公里外的山嘴上。香客称这里为「南迦尸」：城中的摩诃拉克希米（又称阿姆巴巴伊）神庙相传建于634年，是印度教性力派圣地之一。潘哈拉堡1178至1209年间为什拉哈拉王波贾二世所建；什拉哈拉王朝约940年起以戈尔哈布尔为都，统治南马哈拉施特拉至1212年，王室在堡中供养耆那教僧院。此后历经亚达瓦与卡尔吉两代统治，1444年的戈尔哈布尔是巴赫曼尼总督治下一片说马拉地语的印度教乡土，靠朝圣、小米和西山出产的柚木为生。

巴赫曼尼王国解体后，此地归入比贾布尔的阿迪勒·沙阿王朝，城外群山上的堡垒成了马拉塔人的目标。1659年希瓦吉夺取潘哈拉，12月28日又在戈尔哈布尔城外击溃鲁斯塔姆·扎曼率领的比贾布尔军队。1660年西迪·乔哈尔率军围堡，希瓦吉带少数人脱身退往维沙拉尔加尔，巴吉·普拉布·德什潘德率后卫扼守帕万金德隘口、战死阵中；潘哈拉复归比贾布尔，直到1673年希瓦吉才再次拿下。1701年堡垒落入奥朗则布之手，这位皇帝在堡中接见英国使节威廉·诺里斯爵士，几个月后马拉塔军队便又夺回。1707年，王太后塔拉拜在马拉塔继业之争中被夏胡击败，携儿子希瓦吉二世退守于此，另立邦斯莱封国；1731年的《瓦尔纳条约》确认了分治，王廷后来从潘哈拉迁至戈尔哈布尔。马拉地语诗人莫罗潘特出生在这座堡垒，多在堡中的波罗奢罗洞窟作诗。到18世纪，本地植鞣皮凉鞋已以「科尔哈普里」之名行销德干。18世纪末英国曾出兵远征戈尔哈布尔，1818年马拉塔联盟瓦解后，该土邦与东印度公司缔约。

en:
Junnar stands on the old caravan road where goods from the Konkan ports of Kalyan and Chaul climb through the Western Ghats into the Deccan, and the hill fort of Shivneri commands the pass above the town. Merchants have used the route for two thousand years: the Buddhist caves at Lenyadri and Manmodi, cut into the hills around Junnar in the early centuries AD, carry inscriptions left by Greek and Saka donors. In 1444 Junnar was a walled market town and a governor's seat of the Bahmani sultanate. The traffic passing beneath Shivneri's walls carried spices, salt and horses inland, and the cotton of the Desh down to the coast.

A generation later Afanasy Nikitin, a merchant from Tver in Russia, waited out a two-month monsoon in the town and left one of the few European eyewitness accounts of Bahmani India. He wrote that for four months water and mud lay everywhere day and night, the season when farmers ploughed and sowed wheat, rice and pulse. In 1490 Malik Ahmad made Junnar the first capital of his independent Nizam Shahi sultanate, before laying out his new city of Ahmadnagar in 1494; early in the 1600s Malik Ambar brought the hard-pressed court back while moving between capitals in his war with the Mughals. In 1595 Sultan Bahadur Nizam Shah granted Shivneri and Chakan as a fief to the Maratha chief Maloji Bhosale, and on 19 February 1630 Maloji's grandson Shivaji was born in the fort and spent his childhood there. He took his name from Shivai Devi, the goddess whose small temple stands inside the fort. An English traveller who visited Shivneri in 1673 reported that the fort could not be taken and held provisions for a thousand families for seven years. The town and fort changed hands repeatedly in the Maratha-Mughal wars of the later seventeenth century, and passed to the British only in 1819, after the Third Anglo-Maratha War.
zh:
朱尼尔（久纳尔）坐落在一条古商道上，卡利扬、焦尔等孔坎港口的货物经此翻过西高止山进入德干，城后山顶的希沃内里堡扼住山口。这条路上的商队已往来了两千年：城郊山间的石窟群（Lenyadri、Manmodi）开凿于公元初年，窟中留有希腊人与塞种施主的题记。1444年，朱尼尔是巴赫曼尼苏丹国一座有城墙的集镇和总督驻地，驮着香料、食盐和马匹进山、又把德什棉花运往海岸的商队，都要从希沃内里的墙下经过。

此后一代人，俄罗斯特维尔商人阿发那西·尼吉丁在城中避了两个月雨季，留下了少数出自欧洲目击者笔下的巴赫曼尼印度记录之一。他写到，连续四个月昼夜遍地是水和泥，农夫就在这时犁地，播种小麦、稻米和豆类。1490年，马利克·艾哈迈德以朱尼尔为自己独立的尼扎姆·沙希王朝的第一个都城，1494年才另建新都艾哈迈德讷格尔；17世纪初，马利克·安巴尔在与莫卧儿交战、辗转迁都之际，把处境艰难的朝廷又带回这里。1595年，苏丹巴哈杜尔·尼扎姆沙把希沃内里和查肯作为封地赐给马拉地首领马洛吉·邦斯莱；1630年2月19日，马洛吉之孙希瓦吉出生在这座堡垒，并在此度过幼年，他的名字就取自堡内小庙供奉的希瓦伊女神。1673年，一位到访希沃内里的英国旅人记述，此堡无法攻取，存粮可供千户人家吃七年。17世纪后期的马拉地—莫卧儿战争中，城与堡几度易手，直到1819年第三次英国—马拉地战争之后才归入英国。

en:
Nashik spreads along the upper Godavari, which rises in the Brahmagiri hills near Trimbak to the west before beginning its long course across the Deccan. Long before the Muslim conquests its river ghats and the Panchavati quarter drew Hindu pilgrims, and the town is one of the four places that share the twelve-year Kumbh festival; near the source stands Trimbakeshwar, one of the twelve jyotirlinga shrines of Shiva. The Buddhist Pandavleni caves nearby were carved in the early centuries AD. Delhi's armies took Nashik with Daulatabad early in the fourteenth century, and around 1350 it passed to the Bahmani sultans. In 1444 it was therefore an ancient Hindu tirtha of temples and Brahman houses set inside a Muslim-ruled marcher province, its pilgrim traffic and crafts overseen by Bahmani officers.

With the break-up of the Bahmani state the country around Nashik went to the Nizam Shahis of Ahmadnagar, and early in the seventeenth century the Mughals took it and renamed the town Gulshanabad, the City of Roses. The Kazipura gate of 1667 and the Delhi gate of 1681 remain from their building. In 1680 the Mughal governor of the Deccan destroyed twenty-five temples in the town, and Aurangzeb had the jyotirlinga temple at Trimbakeshwar torn down; it was rebuilt only under the Peshwa Balaji Baji Rao. Two years later the emperor's rebel son Prince Akbar sheltered briefly in Nashik on his flight to the Konkan. The Marathas were already pressing in, and the masonry of the sacred Ramkund pool was completed under their patronage in 1696. In 1751-52 the district passed to the Peshwa, the old name of Nashik returned, and over the next generation Maratha sardars lined the river with stone temples, ghats and mansions. War came back in April 1803, when Amrit Rao, adopted son of the former Peshwa Raghunath Rao, sacked the town. On 19 April 1818, during the Third Anglo-Maratha War, a British detachment entered Nashik without a fight, and the town passed to the Bombay Presidency.
zh:
纳西克建在戈达瓦里河上游两岸，河水发源于城西特里姆巴克附近的布拉哈吉里山间，东流横贯德干。早在穆斯林征服之前，这里的河坛与潘查瓦蒂街区就吸引着印度教香客，纳西克又是十二年一度的大壶节四大举办地之一；河源附近的特里姆巴克什瓦尔（Trimbakeshwar）是湿婆十二处林伽神庙之一，城郊的潘杜佛教石窟则开凿于公元初年。14世纪初，纳西克随道拉塔巴德被德里大军攻取，约1350年转归巴赫曼尼苏丹。1444年的纳西克，是穆斯林治下边省中一座古老的印度教圣地，寺院与婆罗门宅院栉比，香客往来和百工技艺都在巴赫曼尼官吏管辖之下。

巴赫曼尼瓦解后，纳西克一带归属艾哈迈德讷格尔的尼扎姆·沙希王朝，17世纪初被莫卧儿夺取，改城名为古尔尚纳巴德，意即「玫瑰城」；1667年的卡济普拉门和1681年的德里门都是那时所建。1680年，莫卧儿的德干总督毁掉城中二十五座神庙，奥朗则布还下令拆毁特里姆巴克什瓦尔的林伽神庙，这座庙直到佩什瓦巴拉吉·巴吉·拉奥时才重建。两年后，皇帝的叛子阿克巴王子逃往孔坎途中，曾在纳西克短暂避难。此时马拉地人已步步进逼，圣池拉姆昆德的石砌工程于1696年在他们资助下完工。1751至1752年，这一地区归入佩什瓦，纳西克旧名恢复；此后数十年间，马拉地诸将沿河次第建起石庙、河坛与宅邸。1803年4月战火再至，前佩什瓦拉古纳特·拉奥的养子阿姆里特·拉奥纵兵劫掠此城。1818年4月19日，第三次英国—马拉地战争期间，一支英国部队兵不血刃进入纳西克，城市并入孟买管辖区。

en:
Dharangaon lies in the black-soil cotton plain of eastern Khandesh, on the road carrying piece goods from Burhanpur toward Surat. In 1444 it was a weaving and market town under the Faruqi sultans, who ruled Khandesh from Burhanpur. Local cotton went to its looms and then on to buyers in the Deccan and Gujarat. By the Mughal conquest around 1600, two of its cloths, jirifaf and bhiran, were well enough known to be named in the Ain-i-Akbari.

English factors, writing the name as Dongong or Drongom, opened a factory here in 1674 to buy cotton cloth. Shivaji's Marathas sacked the town in March 1675 and returned in 1679 with the raja of Berar, striking one of the busiest marts in this part of Khandesh. The East India Company still loaded 20,000 pieces of cloth and 2,500 mans of turmeric in its 1683 purchase, but two years later Sambhaji's men burned the houses and the factors escaped after only two hours' warning. After Maratha forces took Khandesh in 1760, Bhil raiders repeatedly crossed the district and Maratha commanders answered with mass reprisals. Dharangaon came under British rule with the rest of the Peshwa's Khandesh lands in 1818.
zh:
达朗格阿奥恩位于坎德什东部的黑棉土平原，布尔汉布尔的布匹经这里运往苏拉特。1444年，它是法鲁克苏丹治下的纺织集镇，法鲁克王朝以布尔汉布尔为都统治坎德什。当地棉花先送入织机，再由商人带往德干和古吉拉特。到1600年前后莫卧儿征服时，这里出产的吉里法夫和比兰两种布已十分有名，连《阿克巴则例》都记下了名字。

英国商人把此地拼作东贡或德隆戈姆，1674年为采购棉布开设商馆。希瓦吉的马拉塔军队1675年3月洗劫此镇，1679年又与贝拉尔罗阇联兵返回，攻打的是坎德什这一带最繁忙的商埠之一。东印度公司仍在1683年购入两万匹布和2500芒德姜黄；两年后，桑巴吉的军队焚毁屋舍，商馆人员只提前两小时逃走。1760年马拉塔取得坎德什后，比尔袭掠者反复进入这一地区，马拉塔将领则以大规模报复维持秩序。1818年，达朗格阿奥恩随佩什瓦的坎德什领地一起归入英国统治。

en:
Sholapur lies on the black-cotton plain of the southern Deccan, where the Sina and Bhima water broad cotton lands. Marathi villagers grew cotton and wove cloth for inland markets before the Deccan sultanates took the region, and the fort beside Siddheshwar Lake guarded their roads and stores. Inscriptions there call the old town Sonnalage or Sonnalpur. In the twelfth century the Lingayat teacher Siddheshwar preached at Sholapur, set up sixty-eight lingas and gave his name to the lake and the town's patron shrine. In 1444 it was a Bahmani market and garrison town in the southern maidan, its Marathi-speaking Hindu population ruled by Muslim governors.

The break-up of the Bahmani kingdom turned that fort into a marriage prize between Bijapur and Ahmadnagar. Bijapur held Sholapur and its five and a half districts in 1511. In 1523 Ismail Adil Shah entertained Burhan Nizam Shah in the fort for a month during Burhan's wedding to the Bijapuri princess Mariam. Bijapur then refused to surrender the fort as her dowry, and the dispute fed forty years of war; an Ahmadnagar invasion in 1524 was broken between Sholapur and Naldurg.

The fort changed hands with every later Deccan war. Malik Ambar stormed it for Ahmadnagar in 1623, but the Mughal settlement of 1636 awarded Sholapur to Bijapur. It was ceded to Aurangzeb in 1668, and his camp stood here during the final siege of Bijapur in 1686. During the next half-century Hyderabad and the Marathas fought over it, and by the 1760s it was a Peshwa fortress. Thomas Munro's troops escaladed the town on 10 May 1818; five days later the garrison marched out, ending resistance at the last rallying point of Peshwa Baji Rao II.
zh:
绍拉布尔地处德干南部的黑棉土平原，西纳河与比马河浇灌着大片棉田。德干诸苏丹国控制这里以前，讲马拉地语的乡民已在种植棉花、织布供应内陆市场，悉德什瓦尔湖畔的堡垒则守护道路和仓储。堡内碑铭把旧城称作索纳拉吉或索纳尔布尔。12世纪时，林伽雅特派导师悉德什瓦尔在此传道，立下六十八座林伽，湖泊和城中守护祠庙后来都以他为名。1444年，它是南部马坦一座巴赫曼尼的商镇兼驻防城，讲马拉地语的印度教百姓由穆斯林官员统治。

巴赫马尼王国解体后，这座堡垒成了比贾布尔与艾哈迈德讷格尔之间的婚姻聘礼。1511年，比贾布尔保有绍拉布尔及其所辖五个半县区。1523年，布尔汉·尼扎姆沙迎娶比贾布尔公主玛丽亚姆，伊斯梅尔·阿迪尔沙在堡中设宴款待整整一个月。事后比贾布尔拒绝按嫁妆约定交出堡垒，争执延续成四十年战事；1524年，艾哈迈德讷格尔的入侵军队在绍拉布尔与纳尔杜尔格之间被击溃。

此后每一场德干战争都会牵动这座堡垒。1623年，马利克·安巴尔为艾哈迈德讷格尔强攻得手，但1636年的莫卧儿安排又把绍拉布尔判给比贾布尔。1668年，它被割让给奥朗则布；1686年最后围攻比贾布尔时，奥朗则布的大营就设在此地。随后半个世纪里，海得拉巴与马拉塔反复争夺绍拉布尔，到1760年代它已是佩什瓦的堡垒。1818年5月10日，托马斯·门罗所部攀城攻入城区；五天后守军开出堡垒，佩什瓦巴吉·拉奥二世最后一处集结据点的抵抗就此结束。

en:
Devarakonda takes its name from a granite hill fort in the Nalgonda country, raised in the fourteenth century by the Recherla Nayakas, the Velama warrior line also called Padmanayaka. The fort crowns one hill ringed by three others, so that no enemy force could easily get at it. Around 1360 Anapotanayaka made Rachakonda his chief seat and put his brother Madanayaka in command here. The Recherlas won Telangana in 1368, when their cavalry, fighting alongside Bahmani troops, killed Kapaya Nayaka at Bhimavaram; they helped defeat the Bahmanis in their turn at Pangal in 1419 with a Vijayanagara coalition. Rachakonda fell to the Bahmanis in 1430, but the southern hill fort held out. In 1444 Devarakonda was one of the last independent Telugu Hindu Nayaka strongholds, with Bahmani power to its west and the Kondavidu Reddy lands to its east.

The chiefs kept their freedom by changing patrons, fighting at one time for Vijayanagara, at another for the Bahmanis or the Gajapatis of Orissa. With an Orissan army under Hamviradeva they recovered Rachakonda and their other lost forts by 1461, only to hold them as Gajapati tributaries. A Bahmani campaign against Orugallu in 1475 ended their line, and the surviving chiefs took service with Vijayanagara. Devarakonda passed with the rest of Telangana to the Qutb Shahi sultans of Golconda in 1518, to Aurangzeb's Mughals in 1687, and to the Nizam of Hyderabad in 1724.
zh:
德瓦拉科恩达得名于纳勒贡达地区的一座花岗岩山寨，14世纪由雷切尔拉纳亚卡（又称帕德马纳亚卡·韦拉马）的武士首领修筑。城堡雄踞一座山头，另外三山环列，敌军很难逼近。约1360年，阿波塔纳亚卡以拉查孔达为大本营，派兄弟马达纳亚卡镇守此地。1368年，雷切尔拉骑兵与巴赫曼尼军队联兵，在比姆瓦拉姆（Bhimavaram）击杀卡帕亚·纳亚卡，夺得特伦甘纳；1419年他们又随毗奢耶那伽罗联军在潘加尔（Pangal）击败巴赫曼尼人。1430年拉查孔达失守，这座南方山寨却坚守不降。1444年，德瓦拉科恩达是泰卢固印度教纳亚卡首领仅存的独立据点之一，西临巴赫曼尼势力，东接孔达维杜·雷迪诸地。

首领们靠改换宗主维持局面，一时为毗奢耶那伽罗出战，一时又依附巴赫曼尼或奥里萨的加贾帕蒂王朝。他们借哈姆维拉提婆的奥里萨军队，到1461年前收复拉查孔达等失陷堡垒，却只能以加贾帕蒂藩属的身份据守。1475年，巴赫曼尼进攻奥鲁加卢，这一政权告终，幸存首领转投毗奢耶那伽罗效力。德瓦拉科恩达随后随特伦甘纳于1518年转归戈尔孔达的库特卜·沙希苏丹，1687年并入奥朗则布的莫卧儿帝国，1724年归海得拉巴尼扎姆。

en:
Pathri lies on the upper Godavari plain in the heart of Marathwada, ringed by the cotton-growing villages whose cloth passed through its bazaars. In 1444 it was the chief town of a revenue district in the Bahmani province of Berar, whose governor sat at Ellichpur. One Pathri family had already reached the Bahmani court: its Brahmin Kulkarni line produced Malik Hasan Bahri, vazir of the kingdom, and Hasan's son Malik Ahmad, founder of the Nizam Shahi sultanate of Ahmadnagar.

After the Bahmani collapse Pathri passed to the Imad Shahis of Berar. In 1526 Burhan Nizam Shah of Ahmadnagar came to reclaim his ancestors' home district, took Pathri from the king of Berar and overran the whole province. When Akbar's armies entered the Deccan, Berar was ceded to the Mughals by the treaty of March 1596; the attempt to win it back brought on the two-day battle of Sonpet on the Godavari, begun on 8 February 1597, where Abdur Rahim Khan-i-Khanan was first beaten and then routed the allied armies of Ahmadnagar, Bijapur and Golconda. The Ain-i-Akbari lists Pathri as one of Berar's sixteen sarkars, with eighteen parganas including Nanded and Parbhani, and notes a thriving jewel trade at Jetanpur within its lands. Malik Ambar swept through Berar in 1610 and again in 1620 before Shah Jahan restored Mughal rule. The old fort is ringed with the domed tombs of Sufi saints, the dargah of Shah Ismail Qadri among them; local tradition says the graves of forty aulias and four qutubs lie in the town. In 1724 Asaf Jah's victory at Sakharkherda made Pathri part of the Nizam's Hyderabad, though the Nagpur Bhosles long levied a share of its revenues.
zh:
帕特里地处戈达瓦里河上游平原、马拉特瓦达腹地，四周村庄广种棉花，织出的棉布在它的市集集散。1444年时，它是巴赫曼尼贝拉尔省（省督驻埃利奇布尔）下辖一个赋税区的首镇。镇上已有一个家族踏入巴赫曼尼朝堂：这一支婆罗门库卡尔尼（村吏）家族出了马利克·哈桑·巴赫里，官至王国的维齐尔，其子马利克·艾哈迈德正是艾哈迈德讷格尔尼扎姆·沙希苏丹国的建立者。

巴赫曼尼瓦解后，帕特里归入贝拉尔的伊马德·沙希王朝。1526年，艾哈迈德讷格尔的布尔汗·尼扎姆沙为收复祖先故里而来，从贝拉尔王手中夺取帕特里，进而横扫全省。阿克巴的大军进入德干后，贝拉尔依1596年3月的条约割让给莫卧儿；夺回此地的尝试引发1597年2月8日起在戈达瓦里河畔的松佩特两日大战，莫卧儿统帅阿卜杜勒·拉希姆汗-伊-汗纳南先败后胜，击溃艾哈迈德讷格尔、比贾普尔与戈尔康达的联军。《阿克巴则例》把帕特里列为贝拉尔十六个萨卡尔之一，下辖南德德、帕尔巴尼等十八个帕尔加纳，还记载境内杰坦普尔的珠宝生意十分兴旺。1610年和1620年，马利克·安巴尔两度席卷贝拉尔，最后由沙贾汗恢复莫卧儿统治。旧堡周围环布着苏菲圣徒的圆顶墓冢，沙·伊斯梅尔·卡迪里的陵寝即在其中；当地相传，四十位奥利亚和四位库特布葬在城中。1724年，阿萨夫·贾在萨卡尔凯尔达之战获胜，帕特里并入海得拉巴尼扎姆的领地，那格浦尔的邦斯莱家族则长期在这里分取一份赋税。

en:
Nander, more commonly written Nanded, is a river town on the north bank of the Godavari, where the Nandgiri fort guards a crossing on the road between the Bahmani capital at Bidar and the northern province of Berar. Older inscriptions name the place Nanditat or Nandigrama. Tughluq troops seized the crossing in 1318, and in the Bahmani century it changed hands more than once, taken by a Gond chief in 1398 and won back by Ahmad Shah in 1428. In 1444 it is a Marathi-speaking Hindu district inside the Bahmani sultanate. To the east the country is covered by Kandhar Fort, attributed to the Rashtrakuta king Krishna III.

Armies kept passing through. In 1527 Burhan Nizam Shah of Ahmadnagar defeated the sultan of Berar near the town, and in 1602 Malik Ambar lost a battle here to the Mughal commander Khan Khanan; Ambar was an Ethiopian-born slave who rose to be minister and de facto ruler of Ahmadnagar, and led its long wars against the Mughals. Mughal troops took Nanded fort in 1617 and forced Kandhar to surrender in 1631 after a siege of nineteen days. Shivaji's Marathas held the district in 1670 before Mughal rule returned.

The town's great name in history belongs to the Sikhs. Guru Gobind Singh reached Nanded in August 1707 in the camp of the emperor Bahadur Shah I, and stayed behind when the emperor marched south. Two assassins set on him there: he cut one down with his talwar, but the wound reopened while he strung a bow a few days later and he died in 1708.
